Review: Most beautiful stay at Mussoorie...such a gorgeous property. I really left my heart back there. The food,  the staff, the rooms were  just excellent  Chef Prakash Negi is just fabulous he went out of his way to ensure the kids enjoyed good food as well.   Mussoorie is beautiful as it is but this hotel made the trip so special for us.  The location is just fabulous Right at the heart of Mussoorie on the mall road, we could walk down to do our shopping whenever we felt like. The Savoy is one of those rare hotels that not just justify the hype surrounding them but far exceed the expectations created by the hype. While every member of the staff we interacted with was extremely helpful, I would especially like to mention Vikas at the reception, Sandeep at the bar, and Aditya at the restaurant for the care they took to make our stay memorable (I hope I got the names right). I loved the hotel's location. It's right next to Mall Road, but within the property, you never feel that you are in the middle of the town. The rooms are so well-designed and comfortable that we spent much of our time lazying around in the room or in the balcony or enjoying the beautiful hotel property.  Particular mention also must be made of the measures the hotel has taken to keep everything sanitized and minimize contact because of the pandemic. Hats off to the Savoy team!…

The owners have renovated the hotel very well with chintz upholstery and beautifully crafted furniture lending an old world charm to the place.The main building of the hotel has large sitting areas, high ceilings and a grand dining room which is large and spacious. There are well manicured lawns and open sit outs with every room. The hotel has an activity center with friendly staff which caters to both outdoor games such as basketball, cricket, croquet, trampoline and badminton. The indoor games include TT, billiards, air hockey, board games and football. The spa of the hotel is adequate , friendly and reasonably priced…

It was overall an amazing experience. We completely enjoyed our stay at this property. It was beyond our expectations. ❤️. Everything was upto the mark. Food quality was upto the mark. Rooms were well maintained. Anything required was just a call away. Staff was very polite and helpful.

Savoy is a over 100 year old heritage luxury hotel located right in the heart of Mussoorie, near the Library chowk (its before the mall road barrier so taking your car/taxi upto the hotel is no issue)  If you like old heritage buildings then this one is a real pleasure to look at.. you can spend half a day just exploring the hotel and clicking those old arches and designs..  Great breakfast buffet spread.. (I didn't have any other meals there so cant comment)  Very hospitable and polite staff, happy to walk the extra mile  Nice spacious rooms, I took a superior room which is away from the main building and has a personal sit out area overlooking the valley  I would put the room rent at a bit costly, but looking at the summer season all hotel were quoting higher

I stayed there in march , it was a great stay , memorable one. Services are good, room are cozy and have a great view from room. Front office staff was excellent . they took a very special Care of us. Keep it up .... Hope to see u soon guys...

One of the oldest hotels in Mussorie, The savoy is gives you the feeling of the Bristish era luxury hotels. The rooms are elegantly designed and lavish. The food at the Savoy was simply awesome.. the breakfast grand and the restaurant had live music a night. We never felt the need to eat at other restaurants. The hotel is very close to the taxi stand and the main market area where one can plan local trips.  Dont forget to ask for extra heater during winter..and take rooms with the mountain view

Sleeping Beauty and Cinderella got to sleep in castles and now you can turn those fairy tales into your own reality by staying in ITC Savoy  facades and powerful towers, humoungous grounds dotted with beautiful flowers and the views of the valley’s rolling hills and the quaint city below, add to its historic beauty making it a must visit. It doesn't get better than this!   There are several categories of rooms but they are all thoroughly grand and luxurious, spacious and beautiful rooms with gorgeous views,  feature en suite bathroom,a private balcony/ sit-out area for reading or enjoying a cozy meal!   The Dining area is humongous, made in historic grandeur and the perfect spot to enjoy lavish meals. The breakfast buffet is rather elaborate and exciting with a huge spread and…

I stayed with my family during the weekend at the Hotel. The front office team was very cooperative and helpful. We used the in room dining facility and the quality of food was very good so was the service. Overall the property is excellent.

I would like to share my review on this property  We were there from 13 May to 15 May 2017 for birthday celebration of our friend at Room No 26,27,28,29 , we really enjoyed alot , i must say this is one of Best property and i stayed here repeatedly from 2 years   Staff was very supportive and kind   Rooms and especially the washroom are very clean   Location is too gud , as Mall road is just 20 meters from hotel main enterance   Breakfast is very lavish and overall food quality was very good     Must suggest every1 to prefer this hotel with overview of property , location , food and service   Thanks  Daman

I visited this resort with my family. V wre 8 couples and wanted to enjoy. We recommend never opt for this hotel if u wish to have a nice holiday

The room was very nice and spacious. The staff was extremely nice. Take the free breakfast as it is very big and the food is amazing. The staff is very helpful wherever you go and will always go out of their way to help you in anything. The view from some of the rooms are amazing. Try and take the suite.

This was my first stay at savoy Mussoorie. We all loved your hospitality especially my kids were so sorted with all the activities. I must add that your staff is so courteous and helpful. Food was also really good. I have already blocked my Stay  with our family for July. We look forward to it. Thank you for your kind assistance Mr. Pathak and Mr. Nalin nevertheless your entire staff who took great care of us.

Refurbished and redone in new avatar it still maintains  charm of old Savoy.Maple/ teakwood interior, the walls,ceiling are just awesome. From outside also it gives majestic look. Very good food of all varieties . Indian cuisine was excellent.staff very courteos . sprawling lawns add to its glory.should not be missed

For first time, I am really impressed by any hotel as much by The Savoy. We stayed in suite room for 3 nights and it was wonderful experience to be there. Everything about the hotel was perfect. The interiors and hotel structure take you back in history. The hotel staff is the best thing about the hotel. Weather it was evening bonfire or games, or Morning Bfast, every detail has been well crafted and people make you feel among friends. Staff is most friendly ever. Thanks for a wonderful experience.

I stayed in the hotel for four nights from 1st to 4th May, 2017. It is a great hotel when it comes to customer service, great property location, amazing food. The property is at a prime location and at the same time beatifully maintained. The food is also very well prepared and the staff is very courteous. I would recommend  this hotel to any person looking for a perfect holiday in Mussoorie.

With kids studying in Mussoorie boarding school Mussoorie has become a frequent visit and Savoy is our preferred accommodation.  I am writing this review because after the stay I received a call from the hotel and was requested to post a review on TripAdvisor   Upon checkin we were informed that the hotel has been now upgraded to WelcomHotel category within the ITC portfolio. Not sure how they decide this because I did not notice any evident upgrade in terms of the property itself. There were stains on the room walls and amenities are still the same.Of course the prices seemed to have increased.   Having said that it is always a pleasure to stay at the Savoy.  On the downside - there was a wedding and extremely loud music played until about midnight.   And still the wifi doesn't…

I went to Mussourie after a gap of 15-20 years with my wife and my younger son.  I was quiet apprehensive about driving to Mussourie and what if my teenaged son gets bored.  However, as soon as we checked it, it was like visiting home.  The location and ambience of the hotel is great.  You come down to Library chowk in no time and go for a walk on the mall road  The staff is extremely helpful and well trained.  The breakfast, high tea and dinner were just too good.    The rooms are big and well maintained.  The entertainment program organised by the hotel allows you to interact with other guests.  The General Manager, Mr. Pathak, interacted with everyone ensuring that they feel at home away from home.  We had a great vacation and I am already looking forward to my next visit…

I had visited the Savoy as a young boy ,8 years old, and it was then at its impressive best. I had then heard of it going down in service , infrastructure and all standards.  Decided to give it a try when I heard of the IT Welcomgroup take over , and it definitely lived up to expectations.  The service was courteous, very attentive and discreet.  The food was excellent. The hotel has retained it's wonderful colonial charm and the rooms are actually suites done up in a very old world english way exuding the character of a British hill station cottage. The bar is also full of character with Chesterfield leather armchairs and wood panelling.the lighting seemed too bright and it would add to the Ambience if more lamps were used rather than the ceiling lights.  The dining outlet is…

I visited The Savoy with my family over the weekend and we had a great time at this property. The staff was sweet and courteous. We had the most fun participating in the many activities organised by the hotel to keep patrons engaged. We spent most of our evenings in the games room which had Table Tennis, Pool, Foosball, Air Hockey and party games with bonfire in the garden. My brother and I enjoyed our yoga classes in the mornings as well. The scenic beauty at and from the hotel is unparalleled. Great variety at the breakfast buffet with delicious food. The Savoy is definitely worth the stay!

One of  the best places ever stayed in the hills. Truly heaven in the queen of hills. Food was excellent with great service. Mr vivek Negi and Ms Anisha were super helpful in the Dining Hall. Very very personal sevice. Beautifully maintained property with Mr Ashok adding romance to the place with his soulful singing . Thanks team Savoy.

1. The property is beautiful and is maintained very well. (Have added a few photos). 2. The staff is also exceptional. Right from front desk, to entertainment zone (which has all board games, Table Tennis, Air Hockey, Billiards Table, mini Pool table, Gym etc)!  3. Food was great as well (we are vegetarian) and so was The Grand Dining Hall. The breakfast spread was wide and one is spoiled for choices. The staff here was very efficient as well. We enjoyed dining here. 4. Very prompt service (as many times as you like) to drop off and pick up from the Hotel entry, which is a few meters away from Library end of Mall road.  Special mention of all the staff at the property who always had a smile on. Any requirement was promptly catered to.   Special thanks to the girls at the…

Thank you for making our stay wonderful. The rooms were clean and comfortable. And the surroundings well maintained. Even the corridors had a beautiful & pleasing fragrance. The food was delicious and warm, when ordered by room service. And the breakfast had a large variety which catered to every taste. It was perfect. The staff are the best. From the gardeners, Shibu the guard at the gate. The front door boys, the house keeping staff, the entire breakfast team and the management. All were friendly, helpfull and attentive. Its difficult to name each one here, but without a doubt Savoy has the best staff. Bravo !!

Thank you to all the staff at this place for making our stay relaxing and rejuvenating. looking forward to my next visit already.  if you are travelling with kids go for ground floor room as there is ample play area around.

This review is only for the restaurant which I went with a group of friends for dinner.  There was buffet with a good selection of international cuisine which we decided to go for.  The food were of good quality, and the taste of all dishes I tried were excellent.  Service was good too.  Though it was buffet which is typically self service, the waiters served us soup at the beginning of our meal, as well as coffee/tea at the conclusion of our meal.  The building and decor is colonial English mansion, refurbished very nicely. It is among the best place to eat in the Dehradun/Mussoorie area, good for celebrations for memorable occasions.

We are staying with family for a period 09 Apr - 13Apr at the Savoy. They have just changed from Fortune brand to ITC Welcome group and the trademark "namaste" is very visible. Checkin desk was super efficient and accommodating on the 09th, I asked for an international courier, which was arranged promptly. Housekeeping staff are simply superb and very efficient, rooms are super clean and luxurious. The dining staff - Alisha, Kul winder, Vivek, Kailash andvthe dining team are simply superb and very attentive....the guest to service staff ratio is efficient and the manager deserves compliments for planning Chefs churn out delicious food.....2 thumbs up Now for the hotel management - time to change carpets, brown bathroom mats and sofas.....they need a change....proto, housekeeping…

We (my wife, son and I) stayed at The Savoy for 3 nights (March 28 - 31).   We were a little nervous about the trip since this is the first time we took our toddler son away from home for this long. The main things we were nervous about: food, whether my son will get "adjusted" to the place, any special requests from us which the hotel may not be willing or equipped to do. The hotel proved to be beyond our expectations.   Food: We had chosen the package that came with breakfast and dinner included. It was totally worth it. We liked pretty much everything we had there. The South Indian dishes during the breakfast tasted as if the chef was actually from the South, which surprised me. We asked for dosas during breakfast, which they obliged. For dinner, we were lucky that they…

I stayed at the Savoy during February 2017.  I would rank it as one of the best hotels in Mussoorie for location and ambiance.  It is British old style, reminiscent of the days of the Raj.  The staff are very helpful and the breakfast was very good.

very nice place and equally wonderful staff. Food was also very nice. Well maintained property. They called before had to check if there is any special occasion that we are celebrating and arranged cake for my husbands birthday. Just wonderful experience. Must visit whenever you are in Mussourie, Loved the architecture.

Was in Savoy for the third time nd surprisingly it's always been better than before.... The team was really very professional as well as friendly.. Hospitality, food, the amazing lawn, spacious rooms... JUST HAD A GREAT TIME...... :))

The Savoy is an over 100 years hotel, a charming British old style architecture where Delhiites and government officials would rush during summer months. It is located at a steep slope, and the hotel provides its car to drop and pick up hotel guests to the rather small Mall, a 5 minutes walk away. It was a wonderful and luxurious stay, with modern decorated rooms with a sitout overlooking the hills, huge dining hall with 4extravagent  buffet breakfast, excellent service from the staff. The only drawback was the 45 steps to the restaurant, a deterrent for mobility problem guests. There is a spa( expensive) and gameroom for entertainment. The most delightful experience was when we woke up to a heavy overnight snowfall covering the lawns, which continued for 2 days ! Snowfall in…

One of the best hotels I have ever visited. It has a vintage charm. Outstanding architecture. Brilliant hospitality. Very open area. The food is awesome and very delicious. Breathtaking snow peak views from the rooms. Great mix of old charm and modern style.

It was an amazing experience and Alisha n Tenzing were very Co operative. Moreover, one staff member, who is from Darjeeling and whose name I have forgotten, was also very co-operative and made our stay very comfortable. Thanks to all for their co-operation and hospitality.

Beautiful hotel with charming ambience, lovely gardens and away from the hustle bustle. Had visited with my family including my father who is 77 years old. The Savoy staff were very sweet and made special simple food for him. Staff was helpful and courteous and showed us around the property with a nice explanation about the history of the place. Kids also enjoyed the beautiful open areas and had fun exploring about. Would definitely like to visit again

Had some good times thank you savoy,would love to visit again.Thanks for the hospitality which all the staffs have served.Peace and privacy perfectly maintained.Nice location,snowfall added mesmerizing memories.high quality of service and attention to detail remains.the staff is amazing the rooms have been comfortable and immaculate,rooms were spacious.a lot of small things added to a perfect stay.dealt with service rapidly and thoroughly.

fortune the savoy as the name it was immense experience the mesmerizing staff smile and class of property.Thank you savoy and the best thing the snow straight from heaven.Thank you hope to see you soon.

This is a very good hotel run by the ITC group which is a reputed chain of hotels. The property is big and spacious, which is a big plus in a hill station. The facility is more than a hundred years old and is reminiscent of the old colonial British era. The room (No. 14) was spacious, has a ladies powder room and the bathroom was also big enough with a small balcony with an excellent view. Rooms are cosy and comfortable. The breakfast buffet is a good spread and the service in the restaurant is very good with hospitable and smiling staff. No complaints about the room service or the food. There is a large well maintained lawn in the middle of the property along with an entertainment facility which is nice for children. The gym and the entertainment is in the same room which is a…

Like there's a saying ''Don't die with dreams, Die with your memories". I too created some of my best memories in Mussoorie and Fortune the savoy made it possible for me.Mesmerising staff aaah that smile and it's geographical location was perfectoo.Hope to see you soon Fortune the savoy. Thank you

This is the property which will be your lifetime experience. From the location to everything, this place can make your trip the memorable one.  The interiors of this place can easily make you fall in love with them. They have beautifully maintained the charm of 19th century. Staying here, will make you feel that you are living in the history. The View is amazing. Although there are so many stairs in this place which may not be comfortable for the old aged people. Do prefer their basic category room as they are the best in the view. Food was also good in taste.  Also the location of this hotel is perfect as the mall road is just few meters away.   I would definitely love to visit this place again and again.

Located just off the Mall road is one of the best hotels in Mussourie. The moment you enter it, the grandeur overwhelms you. It's a 19th century English mini palace. Superb view from the hotel! Staff are extremely polite and courteous. I got calls two days prior to my arrival to make sure of my time of arrival. Rooms are compact in size but with all facilities.   The Grand dining room and the Writers bar will make you fall in love with the hotel. The food service makes you feel special. Specially Alisha and Vishnu! They also have live singers every evening which keeps the atmosphere peppy!  Minus points - the hotel has a lot of steps and is definitely not disabled friendly. They do have a car to the entrance of the Mall road but there's a lot of walking inside the hotel. Wifi is…

My wife and I decided to lunch at the Savoy, to relive our childhood memories, and we were not disappointed! The hotel has been renovated by the current owner Fortune/ ITC without infringing on the old world charm of the buildings. The fittings are new and modern but the panelled dining rooms and tiled floors carry the memories of yesteryears. The food was good, and the ambience warm, serene and inviting.

Fantastic facility, excellent in terms of service, courtesy, food, cleanliness, decor and the proximity to attractions and shopping. Nice view of the town, valley and a distant view of Himalayan range on a sunny day.  Highly recommend - 5 stars!

We were part of a group of about 70 people. The hotel managers, chefs, and all the staff were incredibly polite, helpful, and welcoming. The food was fabulous, the bed was very comfortable, and room was good. The property has so much historic charm, and yet can accommodate modern guest needs. We would stay here again, and highly recommend it!

Rooms stands on expectations and to the hotel image. Staff and service excellent. Gym in hotel is not too good. There food is good and buffet is really amazing with numbers of variety of food to eat. Ambience of hotel 👌👌

Bombay travels booked us at this hotel. As soon as we reached the hotel, we were greeted by pleasant n warm smile n a warm welcome drink!!!As we arrived late evening we could not see much of the hotel. But next morning we were delighted to be in the small balcony for a cup of tea n watch the lovely mountain view( cud not sit there for long as was very cold). Two dinners at the hotel were exceptionally good n live music on the last dinner was a treat.Big spread for breakfast too(Medu Vedas were delicious ) It's a heritage property. Lovely lawns outside our rooms with bone fire (chargeable)was set for some guests the night we arrived. Above all the each n every staff was not only helpful but warm n courteous too!!!! Waiting to go back!

One of the best places to stay in Mussoorie. Close to the market but yet feel secluded in the serenity and peace of the mountains. Its a heritage property converted into a hotel. We went there during diwali time and it was an unforgettable experience. Their service was exceptional. As its a heritage property, everything had a very English touch to it, from the rooms to the lobby to their dining room.  One thing I loved about this hotel was their food spread. Their breakfast and dinner buffet are a must try. You feel lost looking at the choices they have. As this hotel is up a hilly slope, the walk probably uphill gets tiring for the elderly. I do recommend the hotel to have a shuttle service at least for the elderly to walk up the slope. The hotel has a nice lobby-cum-passage…

Its an amazing place to stay Looking for a place to clear your mind n refresh ur mood this is where u need to go.. 😍😍  Mussoorie + fortune the savoy=perfect combo  Cant get enough with it..  I just love this place n the feel of it The staff is really friendly n amazing n helpful

We visit Mussoorie every time we come to India and have always been interested in visiting the Savoy originally out of sheer curiosity and then to see what was happening to the place. The first time was 18 years ago, and the place was very delapidated, with water coming through in various places and very few (if any) guests. It was very sad as it has a long history.  Over the years we have visited or on some occasions tried to visit to see what was happening on the site which was. This year we went to see what changes there were and what a transformation, while the builders have pretty much renewed the property, it has retained it's ambience. We were very fortunate in that we were given a conducted tour.  It is now extremely impressive with luxurious comfortable rooms which are…

It's a perfect place for family vacation in Mussoorie and once inside you feel the old world charm of Raj era along with plush modern luxury. The place is very near to the mall road but away from the hustle bustle of Mussoorie  The hospitality of the hotel is very good and I would recommend all my friends to stay here and would certainly stay here on my future Mussoorie trips.

the hotel property was excellent but the management and staff were below average the room service was too slow the fruits you asked for in the morning were delivered to your room in arond 4 hours even the buffet did not offered variety and there was no staff to serve you anything no doubt the property was good but the management was below average

Perhaps one of ITC's best properties in India...spread across 5 lush acres of greenery with a colonial and imperial hotel plush and lush and reminiscent of a colonial era gone by, The Savoy is a delight to visit and spend time in....beautiful interiors rich in tapestry and furniture all exuding the British Raj, this hotel is only for those who want a bite of history and solitude. A must visit..

A beautifully hotel,if you are staying in this hotel you don't need to go anywhere else in mussorie(if it's a short stay). Everything about this hotel is just marvelous weither it's staff,food,Spa,it's grand dinning hall everything will just make fall in love with this hotel.Located at the centre of mussorie this hotel is at the best location, mall road is just 20 steps away.The staff is very generous and very sweet n helpfull.I am not going to stay anywhere else in when I will revist mussorie,Thank u Fortune savoy for making our stay memorable

This was half way through our Indian holiday- and a welcomed 2 days. The staff were superb- and went out of there way to help. Very quiet. Great food at the restaurant. Only 2 issues - one was wifi- but at the foothills of the Himalayas it is understandable. The only other fault- the one preventing five stars- the incessant playing of dodgy western pop music. Not needed.

Fortune the Savoy in Mussoorie is an old heritage property and a grand hotel.The staff warmly welcomes you,as you inhale every inch of its mesmerising beauty and the rooms are very luxurious.Well,not to forget the yummy and the very tasty food.If anyone is planning or plans to visit Mussoorie in future I would suggest them to prefer this hotel !!!

Stayed with family from 14th to 17th January, we had a wonderful time. The property is beautiful, the location is in the heart of Mussoorie. The food is absolutely top class and f&b service team is fantastic, I travel a lot and have seen places around the world, this f&b service team is probably the best in the business ... few names ... Alisha, Arjun were outstanding. The Chef needs to be hugged for outstanding food served. House keeping folks are always smiling and tirelessly make your stay very very comfortable. Whoever is running the show is doing a great job. Take care of your people they are gold.

The Fortune Savoy is a beautiful hotel filled woth old world charm. Beautifully managed with extremely caring staff. It was such a treat having our meals here. I say meals as we got mixed up with our bookings. Anyway this place is a pure treat.

5* property on Mall Road. About 117 years old with Morden amenities. Food is delicious yummy testy. One point must notice the staff is very helpful 24*7. Mall Road pickup and drop facility is free. Room is centrally heated. My little princess is only 2/5 years but staff care just like own children. I hats off for staff.

The best one in town,u cant forget the hospitality courtesy of staff best food nd the bestest way to take care of guest like pampering them,will definately always b there whenever i can And special thanks to abhishek and rishab  Stay blessed guys and wish u all the best for future success

We put up at the Savoy for 3 days in the last week of December and we spent all of those three days patting ourselves on our backs for having chosen this hotel. The grandeur of the property and the warmth of the staff was matched only by the cheerful sunny weather in Mussoorie on those days. The view of the mountain ranges from the hotel is majestic - in fact, far better than what one would get from the Gun Hill , as we realized the next day. And the terrace next to the dining hall is the perfect place to laze in the winter sun, with the glittering peaks completing the picture. Not really surprising - considering that the founders of the hotel  115 years back would have picked the most scenic spot in the Mussoorie of those days. And what a choice of location !! This serene…

The property is damn amazing!!!The view was scenic and the staff was very polite and Very helpful!!  Especially Miss Tenzin from the staff is very sweet. Food was also very good. Its a must visit property!!!

We picked Mussoorie for our New Years Eve. We are 14 friends. We were booking Jaypee but since it was sold out decided on going to Fortune Savoy.  Turned out the location of the hotel was excellent. Just next to the Mall Road. Due to the New Year's Eve rush, the road to the hotel was totally jam, we were lucky we didn't have to take the car as we were on the Mall Road.   The property was excellent. The pictures are true to the hotel. The Dal at the hotel is excellent if you like makhani dal.   The worst part of the hotel is room service. This hotel doesn't have sufficient staff for high season and also doesn't have sufficient crockery and cutlery. We asked for spoons they never came and wine glasses they said they had only 2-3 glasses and those were taken up at the bar.   Except…

The hotel is on mall street entrance but once you enter the property you are "transported away" from the hustle and bustle of the street. The staff were excellent. The breakfast buffet was excellent. Christmas eve dinner buffet was superb. The room is spacious, clean, comfortable with stunning mountain views. Wifi was stable, 4 devices allowed to connect. Excellent games room for kids. Would definitely stay again if in Mussoorie

One of my favourite in the hills !!! Brings back memories of my childhood..... so luxuriously beautified by ITC. I keep coming back to this place for a feeling of being in British times & the atmosphere of being genuinely in the hills😊

This property has picturesque views and serene lawns! Its a quaint property away from the hustling mall road which is crowded year round. The amenities are just perfect and the colonial feel, furniture and interior of the hotel just makes it the right hotel to stay at. The architecture clearly gives away an old world charm which is mesmerising in its own way. The hotel could definitely improve on the quality and taste of the food. Nothing negative otherwise. Courteous and warm staff. Highly recommended.

An awesome place to be on a weekend gateaway, the property itself is a place to be. You can get that royal feel..Not at all haunted😃😃, you can experience best in class service and the food they serve is just lip smacking 😁😁..though the price you may seems to be on a higher side. But over a fab place to be .. keep it up guys

we have booked three rooms and we were amazed by the services provided. the property is an heritage. quality of food is ultimate. staff is always very curious to serve you. it has very big lawn where you can play cricket and badminton and the best part is the property is uphill so view from the rooms were ultimate. our room has big corridors so we almost had party all the time.

Great place to relax. Amazing mix of old world charm and modernity. Great food, decent rooms and facilities. Extremely courteous and helpful staff especially Chefs Sabhyasachi and Prakash and Tenzing, Pramod and Abhishek at the reception. Negatives- poor in-house wifi connection, gym is not properly maintained though the other activities are nice.

A Victorian era bungalow converted to a charming and cosy heritage hotel,Fortune The Savoy really uplifts your spirits once you step on its premises.Situated just above the Mall Road,this resort is an oasis of calm and a paradise for people loving a quiet,classy vacation. The hotel offers a fantastic view of the snow clad Himalayas as well as panoramic sunrise and sunset weather permitting. The rooms are cosy,with the chamber rooms having additional dressage and study areas and the French windows looks very elegant. The washrooms needs some maintenance in terms of fittings and drainage though. The food is good and has a wide spread at the  Grand Dining Room which offers lavish buffets for breakfast ,lunch and dinner.There is an elegant bar at the corner to enjoy your favourite…

Hotel is located in accessible location to Mussoorie Mall road, has ample parking facility, well maintained open area, one can see scenic view of Himalayan mountain ranges. Rooms are spacious with good facilities and cleanliness. Very good hotel in the heart of Mussoorie. Overall, we enjoyed it. The hotel was kind enough to make us comfortable to celebrate birthday of my daughter and provided complimentary cake and decorated room before we entered. As a gesture they also upgraded room.

Am so glad we booked into this property for our stay. The property by itself is elegant and well maintained and has this old world charm to it. Everything was nice about this place. Right from the check-in - stay - service - checkout. Everyone in the staff was very courteous. Miss tenzing very well explained us about the property and facilities on our arrival before we could ask for it. Loved it from the very moment when i saw the mountains from the balcony of my room. The grand dining room is the gem of this heritage hotel. If anyone wants to enjoy their holidays away from the hush hush then this property is a must visit. A stay at this property is serenity at its best.

Travelling from delhi to mussorie considering the traffic and the fact that we left delhi quite late in evening we reached mussorie at 1 am. In spite of such a delayed arrival the staff at reception (Arvind and Vasu) were very welcoming and quickly did our check in without wasting a minute.   Vaibhav from in room dining delivered our dinner as fast as he could. He was quite friendly and helped us in ordering the right food for the night.   Talking about food, breakfast was amazingly delicious all three days. Especially the South Indian cuisine preparations which was the highlight of the breakfast. Same with high tea which was again delicious.  Their tomato and basil soup followed by dal fortune and butter naan was just out of the world if you are wondering what to order for…

We stayed here for 3 nights and had a great time. Overall experience was fantastic. Hotel is at a very good location. Main market is just walking. Rooms and food quality was excellent. Staff was highly courteous and polite. Hotel has an amazing ambience. Looks beautiful in night. I will certainly like to stay here again and again.

We had visited Savoy in the mid of August .The property is very well renovated & lies in the heart of Mussoorie .When we arrived there we were welcomed with smiling faces. The staff were very friendly & helpful .we had booked ourselves a chamber room which have the most amazing view. The reception team helped us a lot to know about the places of interest in Mussoorie. This was our second visit to the hotel and this property is remarkable.  I may only come back to Mussorie to stay at the Fortune Savoy. The property is beautiful, very well maintained and the service is impeccable. The staff is pleasant, welcoming and always ready to help. The location of the hotel is perfect, right on the mall road yet away from all the hustle bustle. I am definitely coming back to this hotel!!

A hundred year old property, welcomed us with open arms in the peltering rain and long awaited cold winds after the sweltering heat of Delhi. Although we checked in late the staff was ever polite and guided us through the awesome heritage property. It was a small family vacation wherein we had decided that we would not go sightseeing and the beautiful hotel with its amenities ensured we kept our promise although we went to the Mall road.The early morning sight from the balconies was beautiful, on one side the misty hills and valleys and on the other the well manicured lawns with fountains. A place even though in the midst of the city gives you the experience of 'Far from the maddening crowd". A beautiful heritage property, with soft spoken courteous staff, recreation centre to…

Moved into this hotel after staying at the JW Marriott close by ( 18 mins , 7 Kms ) to get " closer" to the city .  The idea was to be able to walk into the mussorie city and enjoy the local feel ( mall road , library walk etc ) , but what took us by surprise was the beauty of this property .   The staff plus the 100 + years property is immaculate and makes you feel " at home" straight .   It also reminded me of the Taj getaway property at Madurai . Similar fauna ...... Minus the peacocks ...   We got our rooms after an hour of waiting which we spent walking around the property and taking in the mist and beauty of the scenery around .   The room itself is designed with a very good taste of upholstery taking you back in time to the pre independence era during the British raj .  …

We have visited Savoy, Mussoorie  in June'16 and found it an excellent place to spend holidays with family and friends. It's near mall road yet away from city pollution and surrounding ambiance makes it more special with exclusive balconies having valley / hill view.  It's a full entertainment package for kids as there are more than enough activities for them to keep busy among themselves.  The food preparation was awesome and each dish seems prepared with best of chefs in breakfast buffet.  We had an overall excellent experience and hope to visit it soon again.

We stayed for 3 nights in their suite.the property is beautifully maintained and the staff was very courteous and polite.the food in buffet was very tasty .the location is also perfect ,although walking distance from mall road still no chaos nd gives the the calmness nd peace that u need on a holiday .

This hotels elegance, infrastructure, hospitality and scenic view is a must availed thing. We were so impressed with the hotel's infracture.. Looks like classy British building.. All the staffs were courteous and humble. They provided the best of their services and did not give a single chance of loop holes. Definately gonna be there next time..

Location 7 star, entrance 5 start, rooms 7star. Felt delighted to visit this place as its mind blowing beautiful. Heritage property with perfect blend of natural beauty and modern amenities. Its place worth planing to stay for 3 to 7 nights. Heritage beauty can be explores for a photoshoot too. It has first English bar with so many English writer visited the place. View from rooms and over all is awesome. Simple unbelievable in the lap of mother nature. Worth rating 5* ultimate property.

Charming is the word to describe The Savoy. Straight up, I would like to comment on their great location, perfect for stepping down to the Mall Road for a quick break. This is the type of hotel you would typically like to stay in at a place like Mussoorie. An old world charm coupled with great service, robust food and place for your kids to run around and enjoy the fresh air. I sat on one of their quaint benches with my father-in-law sipping beer and enjoying the sun for more than 3 hours! Apart from the usual, this place is steeped in history. 300 year old trees, parties hosted by our erstwhile colonial lords and ladies, quaint rooms etc make this a very interesting experience. I gave a few suggestions to management to improve customer experience even more which they will…

Beautiful property. Memorable time we had. Breakfast to Dinner, food is delicious!! Spend lots of time sitting in balcony, watching clouds floating by the property, engulfing the entire facade of hotel in deep mist. Surreal. Open air dinner amongst the clouds, perfect. Writer's bar, perfectly designed - feels like walking in a bar in 1850s- comfortable and charming.  Staff is just excellent - warm smiles, helpful nature!! Personally I would stay again here if I come to Mussorrie.

We stayed for one night but thoroughly enjoyed the serene atmosphere of this Hotel, as it was raining also. Nice food,warm hospitality, lavish breakfast. Though being a peak season in Mussoorie property was grossly over priced. Property 5 Stars  Breakfast 5 Stars Service 4 Stars  Rooms 4 Stars  Value for Money 4 Stars

Awesome hotel Awesome service Awesome food Simply Awesomeeeeee!!!! Location... Awesome again... I'm in love with this hotel and would be looking forward to going back for sure. So Thankful to all staff at the hotel who made this weekend getaway with the family a memorable one...

Currently I am staying at room no. 29 of this hotel with my family. Im sorry to say that my experience has not been nice at all. Everything here seems  to have such restrictions that i feel like i am in a hostel, not a hotel. We just returned from the restaurant and even tried to explain the staff there about what a good level of service is.   Even though the property is nice and food was pretty decent, the restrictions that the staff has imposed on us in the restaurant and other areas, have literally pissed me off. I am never coming back to this property.

You don't have to look any where else while in this Quuen Of the Hills.Its the BEST. Great location,historic building & architecture, friendly & courteous staff,royal dinning hall with world class cuisine. Rooms are so spacious & well laid out you can dance in the room & from the room balcony can have a wonderful view of the adjoining hills.Well  manicured lawns & hundreds of glooming flowers is another plus of this hotel. The only minus was during the period of our stay WiFi was out of order. Hope they make it fast & trouble free when we Vostok next. Courtesies extended by their manager Mr Abhishek Solomon  & his team are unforgettable particularly sending a birthday cake to my room & joining in my birthday celebrations on 15th May,16.

It live up to the standards of ITC hotels. Fortune Savoy is like a heaven in Mussoorie. There is not a single thing i can point out which i did not like in this hotel. From Service to people to property to food everything was beyond expectations. We stayed in suite rooms and they were unimaginably beautiful.  For sure wen i will visit mussoorie again, i will prefer to stay in Fortune The Savoy. A must visit....

Had been so many times to Mussoorie but never liked the hustle and bustle of the place as I am an ardent fan of nature. There is so much construction that you hardly enjoy the beauty. But when I stayed in Fortune The Savoy, my opinion completely changed. I found it quaint and surrounded by the elegant beauty of mountains. Though the room was small but quite comfortable. Very beautiful property with old school charm.., manicured lawn, panoramic view. Food was good. Enjoyed live music at dinner time. Singer was awesome .. felt totally nostalgic. Staff was very warm and make you feel at home. Once you are here, you would not want to go anywhere.. This is the magic of this resort.

If there was anything that was close to heaven in Mussoorie I can responsibly say that it  had to be FORTUNE SAVOY . It's the most beautiful property in Mussoorie, surrounded by luscious green trees, some even about 300 years old and amazing landscaped gardens. The grounds are extremely well manicured and we took some memorable pictures around the property  Lets start with the Front Desk. Right from the entrance gate, the staff makes you feel like you're family and you've finally come home. They anticipate your every need. They're passionate and warm. A special mention to Mr. MAYANK UPPAL, who went out of the way to help us  suggest and find some fantastically good places like Landour Area, Bakeries and Shopping places. Also Mr. Pramod and Ms. Tensing at the Front desk were…

Loved the quiet and solitude! Excellent service too. Ideal for a romantic getaway, away from the crowds. The personalized service was excellent. My wife and I were surprised to see a lovely cake awaiting us in the room on our anniversary day!😃

I have been to Mussourie quite a few times during my school days, considering I am a DehraDun gal. This time however it was special since I was traveling from New Delhi to the place after a gap of more than 10 years and with a lot of friends. For those who are planning to travel from Delhi or other places for the first time, you have to reach DehraDun first via air, train or road and then move on to Mussourie.   We had a weekend booking for The Savoy and a quick search on Google told us about the amazing history of this hotel+ Its mention in the Rudyard Kipling Stories + the famous ghost stories - hauntings and sightings of other guests.   We reached Dehradun via Train and had booked a mini bus to take us to Mussourie which is an hour and a half drive through the mountains. We…

Fortune The Savoy is certainly the best hotel our family has stayed in . The location is just perfect.We had booked suites for two nights which were really cozy . The hotel is truly traditional in character and has all the modern comforts.The bathrooms were clean and  the toiletries of good qualities were provided . The food was delicious and had good variety.The staff was courtious and service was very good.It was really an amazing experience !

I stayed 4 nights at the savoy with my wife and daughter. We booked a suite. The suite was well appointed and really cozy. The bathroom was nice and clean with good fittings. Hot water running 24 hours. The toiletries were of a very good quality. What impressed me most was how well the hotel was maintained. The furniture is colonial and looked just great. I felt transported back to 1902 when the hotel was opened. Everything is so traditional including the lock and key to the door. The service was good and the breakfast had a wide variety of fare. The hotel also has a spa which is professionally run. The therapy was relaxing. They also have a games room and a gym. The view from the hotel is good. On the last day the hotel sent me a farewell cake. That was so touching. The…

I visited this place in the month of May along with my parents. The hotel has victorian feel to it and is pleasing to the eyes. Facilities provided match up to the 5-star rating. The staff each and everyone one of them are helpful, humble and always on toes to make your stay a better one. The writers bar & the beer garden are two places which i felt are the highlight for this hotel. The hotel property is huge and mesmerising.  The staff is remarkable efficient and takes care of all your requests and needs , even if they are a little out of their way. They are ready to serve you their best with amazing hospitality skills, great food and the best musical symphony.  I had a once is lifetime experience here with the perfect weather & some nice new people.

I visited Savoy with my family - my wife and 3 year old twins. This was a very peaceful place (despite being bang in the middle of the hustle and bustle of a very busy and crowded city centre) with all amenities of a 5 star hotel. The service was amazing and the staff was pleasant. The breakfast was excellent and we all thoroughly enjoyed it.   Overall great job Team Savoy for making our vacation a memorable one! I just cannot think of anything negative!   And did I mention that this is one of the oldest properties in Mussoorie and anyone who is an aficionado of antiques and all things that exude history will feel like a kid in a candy shop during their stay here...😀

British era architecture restored to its original with all modern comforts....the best place in Mussorie...food great yet very reasonable, staff very courteous and ambience great....shall be our Mussorie favourite....beats JP and JW

We stayed there last month for 2 nights, Services was good, food can be more better. SPA was very good. Staff was very friendly . Hotel is at nice location and room was good. Parking was there but driver accommodation is not available (This is not good).  Overall we enjoyed .......Thanks Savoy Team

We stayed here in November 2015 and it is a wonderful oasis in the chaos that mussoorie has become. The food in the restaurant was awesome, the dining room was the grandest I have ever seen in a hotel ( see pics with this review ) and the grounds were huge, well maintained and beautiful. the service was very prompt and though there were a lot of bollywood stars staying in the hotel for some movie, the staff made sure other guests were not disturbed because of that. The location of the hotel is awesome, right next to the Library at the end of mall road.

On Family Holidays, I have always stayed in Five Star Hotels all across the country, so I am well aware of the kind of service most of the hotels provide. The stay at Savoy has exceeded my expectations.  The service of the staff, from the people at reception to the dining hall, to the room service everything is just excellent. I have never seen hospitality to this extent, where everyone is ready to accomodate your wishes.  We stayed for almost 5 nights and enjoyed each day.  The recreation center is also great with many games to help you unwind.  The only glitch we faced was in terms of Wifi, which was non existent in the rooms. However gave good signals outside.   In all, I can say that you receive value for each penny that you spend.

Its old and heritage property, well maintained by Fortune.... Nice to stay there.... after 27th Year visited in same hotel.Staff is very cooperative good service, great ambience, scenic view is good. very near to Kitab ghar side

Had selected this resorts after lot of research work, lot of stories are attached with the past of this resort. But it was wise decision in the end.  Check In was smooth without any delay. Rooms were well decorated with the touch of colonial architecture. One of the biggest beds i have ever seen in my lifetime in any of the hotels. Every room has balcony. Lawns are very well maintained adds to beauty of the property.  We have opted for MAP + Hi Tea. Breakfast was excellent with loads of option of continental & Indian dishes. All the dishes were good in taste but south Indian was by far the best.  Hi Tea was also having good variety. Dinner was also good with nice spread, yummy Indian sweets & soothing live music.  Overall it was great experience.

one of the best hotels in mussoorie. luxurious experience with a touch of indian heritage. From rooms to dining hall everything is nicely maintained and gives you a pure sense of luxury and serenity. 5 star rating from our side.

Excellent Place, scenic view, very well maintained, Ever smiling staff and great food, kinda made it one of our best family stays.  This was expected from a high-end ITC Fortune maintained property  What made the difference was the personal attention to each n every guest by the support staff.  WOW feeling,all thanks to them-my elderly parents n kids have rated this property on service benchmark as 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟STAR✨

The Resort is located in the heart of Massorrie "The Queen of hills". We had an exceptional experience of pure luxury. The resort looks beautiful in the evenings. The staff was really humble and helpful especially the duty manager Mr. Sahil Goel. Would love to visit again.

It's a nice property just next to Mall Road library side , u can have a feel of heritage when u stay here . It's has nice rooms we opted for base category room and trust me it's the best as it has big balcony outside and front side big park  U can enjoy tea in the morning sitting outside and viewing the mountains . Breakfast is also good nice options available for vegetarians and non vegetarian.. Staff is very polite and humble .. Spa is also good must try body treatment blueberry .. Over all nice experience  Will surely come again waiting for nice package..

Awesome awesome awesome awesome!!! Go for the executive rooms The best place to stay in mussoorie Bit costly but still the best.  Great buffet spread with great high tea Chill and relax at the property Very courteous staff

Great property, greatest location! Next to library on the Mall Road. Absolutely beautiful... Go for any room. All are same and have absolute privacy. Loved this place to core. The hospitality is one of the greatest I had experienced in the world. This review will be incomplete if I don't mention Abhishek, Ashish and Mayank's name. So much care and affection. I can say this because I went with a two and half old infant. They ensured our stay was not just relaxing but mesmerising. Private sitting area outside the room. Great valley view. Rooms are spic n span clean. Grand dinning is actually grand and spectacular. Food is good too. Every penny worth spent for!

This is by far one of the best properties i've stayed at in India. I had been here end March with my spouse for 4 days and we fell in love with the place the moment we entered. This property has a quaint vintage look and feel. The rooms are spacious and well maintained. The food was the best we had at Mussoorie. Their Dal Makhani is a must try! The view from here was mystical and what worked to our advantage was the weather.  I strongly recommended anyone and everyone travelling to Mussoorie to stay at this property.

It was a short Family Outing. We went on 30th March and had a wonderful experience in this hotel. Stayed for two nights.   Likes: The entrance is very different. The location is perfect. Heritage feeling is awesome. Rooms well done. Dining area excellent. Breakfast menu is good. Kids liked Omelette the most. Just 50 rooms so NO rush in the dining area or anywhere else. cooperative staff.   Dislikes : Internet is chargeable. These days you get free Hi Speed internet in all good hotels. I did recommended some maintenance issues in the bathrooms.   Overall a good experience.......

Well this is one of the best hotels I have stayed in which is located on a hill. A very peaceful location with friendly staff , amazing service and delicious food . It has amazing facilities such as a basketball net a trampoline and many more that makes your stay a joyful one. The Royal interiors of the hotel make you feel special during your stay. I would love to stay here again on my next trip to mussoorie. Thanks a lot for making my stay a good one.

Right from the moment u enter u feel u have come to some palace. Huge area is given for parking and the rooms are spread across very nicely. The moment u enter the rooms u feel pleasant. Very spacious and well equipped. Theres a huge space outside room for having tea or dinner with super view. The food menu is too good and with loads of variety. They have two conference rooms but both are small. A big lawn for party or corporate events. Overall a superb place to be.  Only negative part was the WiFi was chargeable and not complimentary.

Absolutely brilliant. The property, The Ambiance, The upkeep, The Staff. Absolutely as and how you need it. They listen to you and all your requirement s are fulfilled. Special mention to the GM Mr. Chopra, he was standing himself at the buffet. And for Mayank, you have a problem, get in touch with this guy. Just make the wiFi free.

Stayed at the Savoy for three nights during Holi break. The property itself is very beautiful and well maintained , the rooms are neat and clean, locations good and the food is also nice.  The reason for the low rating is the service. For starters the house keeping was very poor for everything you had to call them 3-4 times we had 4 rooms at the hotel and we asked them for 8 glasses to which they replied that there would be a charge for the glasses have not heard this anywhere. The next day we asked for a couple of wine glasses but all we got were regular water glasses the reason was that since there was a small party going on in the hotel they were out of wine glasses . The staff in general is very rude and doesn't  even greet you properly while your'e staying there others will…

Awesome place ! Enjoyed the stay a lot ! Helpful and friendly staff... Good food... Equipped with all amenities... Spacious suites... Nice view of distant snow-covered pesks Centrally located with walkable distance to Mall road...

Yes J W marriate has opened and then there are other . But nothing is as convenient and has a beautiful view than this one . It was one of those places where the British will have lavish evening last and Cabrate . The rooms are bigger . The entire hotel is made up of wood . It will cost you half of what J W charges and it will give you an experience of a life time . I was transported to a bye gone era while I was here . Although I have visited mussorie 6 times I had never heard of this hotel because it was closed until fortune bought it . All in all a lovely place good spacious rooms for family with kids . Nice service . Near to the Mall Road . Overall an awesome experience .

A gothic style architectured hotel, just at the end ( or at the beginning .. whichever way one looks at it  )  of bustling Mall road. In spite, of being close to the Mall road , it maintains the hilly silence and calm. Very courteous staff, nicely maintained rooms and great food is a boon. The best part of their service is the pick and drop facility from the main gate, on demand and whatever number of times it may be. The only thing we felt missing was a free WiFi, which we feel should have been provided.   A wonderful property, still maintaining the old world charm, stone's throwaway from the Mall road and offering great service, makes it a very nice place to stay in heart of Mussoorie.

We stayed at Savoy in Feb 2016...... the property is awesome... the rooms are huge and well maintained... the food is great and they have  a big spread for breakfast. We had an early checkin which was handled very well by the front office staff... and we were in ours room within 15 mins.

Unplanned trip with friends and after spending 2 days in Mussorie we decided to have food in some good hotel and then we choosen Fortune Savoy and our decision was so good that they made our night with so delicious food and desert.  We have ordered Phirni and Brownie with Ice cream and it was so mouth watering desert. Thanks to all the team and Fortune for everything. Will surely get back soon when we are in Mussorie.

While planning a weekend in Mussoorie we had absolutely set our minds on experiencing the hospitality at this heritage property. Reading lots and lots of exemplary reviews on TripAdvisor had left no doubt as to where we would be staying in Mussoorie. Anything short of the word “paradise” would not even get close to describing Fortune The Savoy.   The hotel staff was extremely courteous in all their dealings and came across as highly trained and motivated to look after their guests in accordance with the famed hospitality of the Fortune group. Right from our pick-up at the Jolly Grant airport to check-in, the entire process was seamless. When we were ushered into our room we were spellbound and absolutely delighted and glad with the choice we had made. The room was done up…

I had taken a suite at Fortune The Savoy. I had heard all sorts of stories before I got there, but trust me, there is nothing but amazing staff and solitude. Wonderful food (if you ever get a chance to chat with the head chef, please do - he is great company!), great rooms and just the vibe that I was looking for. If I ever do come to Mussourie, Fortune is the place to stay.

I am the sort of traveller who would research, research & then reach out to folks who have been to the property, take in each review, speak to the hotel & then go with my instinct with some more research backing that decision. Its pretty much as simple as that.  Fortune The Savoy did well on the research front but did even better on the actual experience. The hotel has an old world charm with beautiful rooms, sprawling gardens, a decently equipped gymnasium and a sumptuous breakfast spread. But my favourite bit has got to be their service. Right from the watchman at the entrance of the property to Sahil at the front office (helped us check in), to Hema (assisted with reservations) and Kuldeep (Breakfast) were exceptional. We travelled as a family of six and were also celebrating…

Charming rooms with vintage feel, located right next to the hustle bustle of the mall Road but once you step into the property you will leave all the behind. You are immediately be transported back to the colonial era. The staff is very courteous and showed us all around the property before leading us to our charming little room with Barrick vintage decor. Amenities provided are very good and upto the mark. All meals were included in our package and there were no complaints from the buffet. There are some sports activities for children and a fitness centre.

We had a fabulous stay at the savoy. The food was excellent, amenities, service and location of the hotel are amazing. An absolute must visit. At the front desk Sahil was very helpful and cooperative. Chef sabyasachi catered to our every need, even if there was something we needed extra off the buffet they obliged and provided it for us.

We visited the Fortune Savoy as a family for afternoon tea. My cousin ( who is a local) and I (from London) did a reccy of the place to investigate disabled access as my mother is unable to walk much. We were assured that although there were no lifts there would be no access issues for my mother to negotiate to enjoy the afternoon tea we were going to book. We arrived a couple of days later for our afternoon tea and I was very impressed with the way they managed to find us a wheel chair for mum and with assistance of four members of staff carried her up to the dining area in the wheelchair up many flights of stairs. This was really appreciated and welcoming. Upon sitting down for our afternoon tea, despite phoning and making a reservation, we were told that as it was out of…

Fortune The savoy is an amazing property built in 1890. Enjoyed every moment of the stay. Hotel has best in class rooms, lawns, landsacpe & facilities. The staff at the reception, restaurant & service are very courteous & helpful. This property has more of an resort feel but Hotel It is worth to stay here as the same would double up your pleasure in Mussorie.

Enjoyed every moment of my stay. The staff, both in the reception and the dining hall is very helpfull and polite and go out of their way to help you. Their was a little problem of hot water but the reception changed my room so that also was solved. The rooms are also very nicely done. I stayed in one of their Premier rooms. Did not get a chance to meet the G. M. even though he was in the hotel , otherwise I would have thanked him personally.

We as a family of 2 adults and 2 kids travelled to Mussoorie for a weekend starting from 12th feb. Right from the front desk (Mr.Sahil) to the Coffee Shop ( Mr.Vivek) and not to forget the all-time favourite Mr.GopalKrishna in the restaurant ....all was great. We booked an Exclusive room with sit outs on both sides of room (Room No.25). The kids had some great memories of play area and we as a couple had wonderful SPA. It was overall an exceptional trip where all our needs were taken care of.  Will definitely plan again and would recommend ....Cheeeersss

During my visit to mussorie in February I along with my friends visited here for the perfect dining in the beautiful restaurant and very fine preparation of every item of dishes.presentation of food is by wel mannered staff is appreciable. Ambience is very nice .view is good , one must dine here for hygienic food .

Excellent hospitality, awesome property - must visit!!!  Had a wonderful time this weekend,  perfect place to rejuvenate  Staff very helpful Beautiful well stocked bar!!!!!  Food is good,  buffet breakfast layout was perfect

Very nice and well maintained hotel with all the amenities.Regarding Food quality and service i don't have words 2 say.Everything was perfect,ample parking ,place is very happening, almost have all the indoor and outdoor games,very supportive security and staff perfect location,perfect view from the balcony....nice experience...I suggest you all to enjoy this superb property....

My stay at the Savoy was amazing. The service was wonderful and all the staff was very kind.  I'll never forget the view of the snow peaked Himalayas and the sense of history that the Savoy offers. The libraries, lounge, and dinning room were beautifully restored and the rooms where charming and very comfortable. There was an amazing selection of food and it was delicious. This was definitely a highlight of my trip to India. I did use wifi but do not remember if I had to pay or if it was free.

I stayed in this hotel with my family and friends for 3 nights from 23 jan to 26 th jan. Service and hotel staff behaviour was too good. We played cricket there. It was just awesome feel. Location is superb( near to mall road).food was very tasty. I recommend everyone for this awesome property.

An exquisite charming colonial hotel in the Queen of Hills, Savoy is a rare hotel that offers style, old-world charm, great ambiance and delectable food. Didn't stay here as it was quite expensive but it is worth paying a visit if you're going to Mussorie.

Me and my family went for the family get together in Jan to mussoorie. We stayed at the savoy. I almost liked everything about the hotel. The Gothic style infrastructure coupled up with modern amenities, pure luxury amidst nature.   Pros of the property: 1) kid friendly: ample of space for kids to play. Many activities for all age people.   2) location: walking distance from mall road (library side)  3) beautiful interiors: property doesn't only maintain its old age charm by its charming european gothic architecture but its also equipped with new amenities like ac, dryer, electric kettle, comfortable beds, geyser, small but modern bathrooms with shower area.  4) huge gardens: we totally enjoyed basking in the winter sun at this heritage property  Cons:  1) poor service: had to…

we went to mussoorie after 15 year. Last time i had seen this hotel was in totally bad shape. But they time it was a pleasant surprise to see this hotel well renovated. it is a very good property with nice rooms and very good dinning hall. food is very good. one problem the hotel has is the monkey menace. you have to keep your windows closed. but definitely worth staying.

We stayed here after our religious trip to  Rishikesh  and have to say that we were immensely impressed. The hotel is beautiful and although the weather was bitterly cold we were made to feel very much at home. There was ample heating in the bedrooms, the only down side is that the restaurant was extremely cold at this time of year and we had to dine in our coats but this is no fault of the hotel. The restaurant is so authentic to the era and serves excellent food. We opted for the BB package but would recommend the DBB as buffet has a wide choice of cuisine to choose from. The staff throughout are extremely helpful and polite. At the time of our visit it was the low season in the area but this suited us as we do not like the hustle and bustle of people. I would recommend this…

Fortune the savoy is a beautiful property in Mussoorie, so accessible to the mall road and at the same time offers a peaceful stay. Hotel facilities, room are in good condition. Great food with taste and quality. We get to meet Ajay Devgan as well, he was staying in the hotel along with his shoot team. Overall I would recommend this hotel for good food and beautiful property. I found the service to be floppy sometimes, but that could just be due to busy mornings, my friend who visited recently had no complaints on service. I enjoyed my stay!

We visited the Savoy in the third week of October and had one of our best holidays. The town one side, the Savoy is a world in itself. With breadth taking views on all sides, plenty of area to walk around, great food, especially the buffet breakfast, ample car parking and fantastic service, this is a place you would love to come back to Mussoorie for.

Went to spend Christmas at the property and had booked 3 suites. After a warm reception we were quickly ushered to our room.  Tastefully furnished the suite was very comfortable. The service was perfect, a special mention of Kuldeep, who was deputed to look after us did a wonderful job.  The food was really god with the executive chef taking pains to make special dishes. The breakfast spread was sumptuous.  All in all a very pleasant stay, would strongly recommend to anyone traveling to Musoorie.

We had a phenomenal experience at the hotel .... the moment we landed , we were greeted with some rain and snow which clearly beaten our expectation by yards . The locale is spectacular to say the least with some stunning views of the Himalayan ranges in its pristine glory . The External areas were sprawling and serene and it got elevated to a different level with the bright sunshine and clear blue skies . The Entrance from the Reception into the Hotel is grand . You get transported to a different era altogether and it is genuinely terrific. It will continue to amaze you as you get into the Ballroom turned Restaurant with its Rich European décor and gigantic chandeliers and great staff  . The rooms are pretty comfortable with sitting areas both in the front and on the Rear . Net…

Scenic beauty.. Classy rooms.. Awesome place to stay.. Beautiful campus and view from the campus.. Ancient feel, variety of food.. Very helpful staff .. Pleasant stay.. What all alternatives can i give about this place.. Each room has a small balcony where we can have our decent time with loved ones, wooden flooring adds into the ancient touch.. Make sure to go out to the hotel for dinning or else food gets bit colder due to pleasant and chilled atmosphere.. The moment your drive up the winding road to the main entrance,  it's like you are swept into a bygone Era!
