Loved the Entire Setup inspite of rumoers of being a Haunted Property, The Hotel has lot to offer and hospitable staff makes it even more entertaining and enriching for visitors. I have my in laws house in Mussorie however; stayed here on official Trip and also there is noone staying in Mussoorie house. We had Fun. Rooms are Excellent with ancient TOuch and lavish Finish and posses best of things desired and required. It has big Central Lawn where our office party was organized. food was a bit of dissappointment and I would not reccomend to eat in the Hotel. Most of the Veg Snaks were completely cold everytime I tried picking up anything also no varity, Breakfast Menu was Lavish but quality and Taste has a big Question Mark

The recent coming back to the hotel for a stay was an incredible remembrance of the re opening of this grand resort of the hills in 2013. Built and opened in 1902, Savoy speaks of its history right from its entrance. The breath taking beer garden view through the cobbled pathway to the porch is a delightful experience. The Hi tea at the Grand dining room and the sniff of the esters of the single malt at the writers bar are the experiences people have talked about now over a century. its time to go and relive this magic. Suggest to go for the Suite rooms they are expensive but they give you the most memorable stay experience .

We had an amazing dinner at Fortune Savoy's restaurant. The food was excellent specially murg saagwala and dal makhani (a-la-carte menu). Live music at the restaurant provided a wonderful experience.The hotel property is beautiful and totally worth a visit.  The way to the hotel from the main gate is quite steep but the good thing is that the hotel provides free ride from the hotel to the main gate.

Nice Destination and nice hotel (Savoy). It’s good if you want to visit hill station near NCR.   It’s not so crowded and have many surrounding places to visit like kempty fall,  Though Mall road doesn't have much to explore but you can enjoy the hot milk n Jalabi over there. you can enjoy a long walk with your friends or family at night, the wind blow at night is sooo awesome you will forget the time you spend there. At Savoy the experience was really very nice. It’s very good hotel when you want to enjoy the stay rather then the surroundings. Very spacious lawn and very nice rooms. You will feel the luxury of the hotel when you stay there. Location of the hotel is very nice but the breakfast menu is very limited. Secondly i think at least WiFi should be free at this class of…

Four of us were in Mussorie last week & we stayed at Fortune Savoy. The property is beautiful, the rooms are really Comfy & its not HAUNTED, though monkeys can be a nuisance. The breakfast spread was good except for a few items like paranthas & french toast. The only shortcoming that I experienced was that the F&B and FO staff is not that active. They forgot few of my requests... it could be because they had too many people staying...m not sure. You cant call this Property " Value for money" but its a nice option if you are ready to spend a bit

The hotel is really eye catching and beatiful with  utmost luxuries ...and the staff is also very helpful we had lost our valuables in the hotel but we were able to find it with the help of the staff and management whose determination also adds to the plus points of this property

The hotel has been newly renovated & refurbished. New additions have improved the quality of stay as the far rooms are now connected by covered corridors and it helps during rains.  Location is great as it is at one end of the Mall on a hill (the hotel car will pick you up at the gate to save the walk up). The view from the northern rooms overlooking the mountains is great. The sit outs behind the rooms are big (but could not sit there for long as there was some foul smell there in the mornings). The hotel needs to improve on its breakfast menu.

Comfortable rooms, good food and Excellent service... Situated in a very good place..went with family..rooms were neat and cleaned regularly...buffet was pretty good... Had lot of variety..location trip coordinators are also available

My wife and I stayed at this recently renovated heritage hotel in the Himalayan hills at Mussoorie just above Old Rajpur in North India . The hotel is quite exquisite and beautifully restored . We stayed in one of the high end rooms which was impeccable in every respect . The views of the high Himalayas are spectacular. The rooms all have cable TV and we were able to access the World Cup of cricket which was fun . The Writers Bar is fantastic as was the batman who served us . The dinning room is a pure Raj experience though a little expensive . This hotel is well worth a stay though I suspect in high season it may become honeymooners heaven .  Check it out !

This is an old property where recent renovations give it all the modern amenities yet it maintains an old feel. The hotel is located in the heart of Mussourie. Which means you can walk into the city center/  Mall road. It also means that during peak season getting in and out, via a car, could be a challenge as this is the busiest part of the city.   The rooms are tastefully designed and the entire premises is well maintained. The restaurant and especially the bar is worth a visit even if you are not staying there.    Yet there is something amiss. Both big and small things. An almost empty hotel, offers upgrades or other benefits, especially in the off-season. None were offered. Quality of breakfast can be significantly improved. Several people drive to Mussoorie from across…

Very nice place with awesome ambience and awesome food , colonial style . A must visit. A walk away from mall road .Only trouble is steep walk from entrance to the main hotel, tighten up ur shoes for this place.

A fantastic renovation of an old British Hotel. We only visited for a drink & viewed several rooms. The spacious rooms are superbly renovated complete with lots of original features. The views of the Himalayas are fantastic. One could easily loose oneself here. The drinks were quite pricey & we didn't try the food. A great place to recuperate. Beautiful Gym & Spa.

Good location and reasonably priced, if going with family to enjoy Mall Road then worth it. Good places near by is kalsung andany other specialities like fruit cream and mutton burgers. So this place keeps you busy and if you prefer to go to a more secluded place you could go to chaar dukan and have waffles and cold coffee.

Lovely property on the mall. Has a lot of history and heritage behind it. Professionally managed by the Fortune group now. Good food, convenient but had a few inconsistencies in services including an odd checkin goof up, salon guy being clueless with wifes hairdo, milk served of different capacities, car not available for the uphill climb at the entrance, buffet being half when occupancy was low. I think the hotel comes alive only when its full. If not it does seem a bit dull.  I did get the the haunted vibe which i did feel as well on 1-2 occasions.

I will begin with the Breakfast. I have never ever seen such an immense variety of food, and that too in breakfast. The buffet is simply amazing. The property, location resembles British era. You can simply spend your day in Fortune, not doing anything and yet will not be bored.

it is amazing hotel. right from check in to leaving, staff was very courteous and helpful. it is very conveniently located with mall just a few mins away. the room we had was spacious and clean. the hotel has a huge lawn and a playing area for guests. one of the best hotels to stay in mussorie.

Stayed there with a group of friends and had a good time. Great location just the end of the mall, good rooms but small, nice lawns with ample of sunshine. The food was good but very monotonous. Still enjoyed their restaurant because of the live singing that's organised there on weekends. Would won't mind going again.

Starting from the beginning from check in which was smooth and efficient by the welcoming staff.  We were given the chambers room which we had booked for our one night stay for our wedding anniversary eve about which we had informed the staff n they were courteous enough to make arrangement for a cake for us at the dinner.  We requested for a room upgrade which they said was not possible as their rooms were under renovation.  The room was clean and we were welcomed into Room no 44 on the ground floor, it was a nice spacious room with a queen bed and had enough space to accommodate an extra bed for our son.  Nice view of the valley from the back yard of the room and from the windows, we could see their lush lawns from our room door which felt very nice.  The dinner at the dining…

The hotel itself was quite nice. A short walk away is the mall road. One problem for me was the repeating power cuts in our hotel room. Live entertainment at dinner was superb. A very nice hotel to stay in for both business and leisure. Truly a mix of the old days and modern technology.

I chose this property for a two-day getaway. I am glad I did. The old world charm, mixed with all modern amenities, was just perfect for my taste. My favourite spot was the bar-cum-reading room. I think I spent hours sipping on wine and reading the books :)  Each room and space is tastefully done. I loved the fact that there was music played in the gardens nearly 24x7! The staff is extremely courteous.  My overall experience was splendid! Must try :)

Visiting Savoy and staying there took me back in time. ITC has done a wonderful job of restoration. My congratulations to them. But... The hitel is not disable or old people friendly. Too many stairs. This need needs to be addressed. Rest all is awesome. The check in is fast. Rooms are very very good. The entire property is amazing. Staff is very kind. Housekeeping marvellous. BUT THE FOOD.... I SHALL GIVE THREE OUT OF TEN... SERVICE IS GOOD AND THEY TRY TO SATISHFY YOU BUT COOKING IS NOT UPTO WTHE MARK. i am sure with Mr. Nawab there - he shall make it number one.

We stayed at the savoy in November and they upgraded us to a bigger which was certainly delightful. The room itself has an old world English charm what with the Victorian cupboard et al. The upkeep and service is also what one would expect at an ITC concern establishment. However the attitude of the staff and the overall quality of dinner was absolutely sub par. Breakfast again had limited options and at best was strictly okay. I would definitely stay here again but would never venture eating there.

It was really out of world experience from Check in till check out.We booked 20 rooms for 22nd and 23rd Nov 2014.Each one of us really enjoyed,weather it was food,spa,banquet,room service,decor,everything was superb.

We stayed at Fortune Savoy in November 2014 and it was a great experience. Right from the hospitality to food to the location, everything was excellent. Hotel also arranged a cake to make our wedding anniversary dinner special..

This month i got to spend 4 days at Savoy, Mussoorie. I was on a business trip to facilitate a leadership workshop for 40 participants. During the course of all 4 days, I was super happy to experience the extraordinary service provided by the F&B and Guest Services departments. To name a few people who went an extra mile to deliver their best services : Chandrabir - F&B Manager, Kuldeep - F&B Staff member and Nishant - Guest Relation Manager...  Well done guys... Keep up the Good Work :)

we were there for three nights. it was abt 2 hrs drive from dehradun but was totally worth it. the hotel is probably more than 100 years old. their decor is really nice. the suites were cozy and clean. visited their spa which is good too. they have a nice breakfast spread. dont forget to try their non veg kebab platter and spicy chilli paneer. lastly but most importantly they have wonderful staff who are always there to help you. i would like to thank our butler kuldeep for all his help. overall it was really a gud experience and if u are wondering no there are no ghosts there.

the property is excellent... visited on 4th and 5th nov, just on the corner of mall road, Mussoorie. it is a sprawling 11 acre property, and the promoters have done an amazing job of restoring the place to its original look, yet have included all the modern amenities which are a must for today's travel. the staff is very polite and helpful, the food is great, nice gym and spa... and the best part... a well maintained garden where you can soak in sunlight.. also full marks for the background music which plays everywhere in the hotel..(not the rooms)...excellent choice of music... only one suggestion... try to add ramps for wheelchairs and baby prams...

It's a true heritage property; clam and quite location with excellent vally view . Good place for family break; very close to the mall road ;  property is located very close to the starting point of the  mall road . The grand dinning hall as well as bar is must visit place in the property; the property itself has lot of amenities for you and your family to spend a whole day .

I've had an amazing experience in a short but therapeutic weekend getaway at Fortune the Savoy in Mussoorie. Its picturesque with an old world charm. There is a definite British feel to it too that only adds to its appeal. The location and property itself is beautiful and very well maintained. Far from the maddening city, the perfect ambience and lovely view is very inviting. The rooms are great and the staff very professional and kind. The food has great range, is fresh and delicious. We had great service and the staff was cordial and welcoming. There is something in it for all ages - with the children’s play area, rejuvenating spas and in the lap of nature – overall a great way to unwind. I'll surely go back and this time for a longer stay because Savoy is the queen of the…

I have had an amazing experience with Fortune The Savoy. It is a beautiful property, with the old world charm and amazing view. The food is delicious, the staff is friendly and helpful. I have stayed at the hotel a couple of times, and I have never had a complaint.  The hotel has open lawns and an amazing view to offer. Spacious rooms, beautiful decor, nice ambience, amazing food and awesome staff.  A must visit if you travel to Mussoorie.

The hotel is situated on the Mall Road. Although the climb is a steep one mainly due to the ongoing seswerage work for which the hotel car cannot travel the full distance, it's definitely an amazing place to stay. Very well maintained property, with large rooms & extremely courteous & hospitable staff who are always ever ready to offer their services. The view of the Doon valley sitting at the open area is picturesque. The gardens are well maintained & definitely it's a must place to stay when you are in Mussoorie.The Recreational area is superb.

We were looking for a 5 Star property in Mussoorie.. Of the 3 available options we zeroed on Fortune The Savoy.. I must say It was a wise decision made on a family holiday.. Best Location- just across Mall Road, Very Classy, Beautiful & Elegant Property, Grand Restaurant, Nice Breakfast Spread and Delicious Food, Children Play Area, Very Courteous Staffs..  Must Try the Corner Suite Room on ground floor.. Please note that Wifi in room is not free.  My Special Thanks to Manager Ravindra and all the team for making our stay a memorable one.   I personally recommend Fortune- The Savoy..

This hotel has a old-world charm like no other I have visited in my memory. It is located at a very convenient location near the library, and my father and I traveled the whole mall road by foot.  The marble in the building and the wood inside the rooms gives the hotel a very luxurious feel. The Victorian era architecture is superb and the gardens are brilliant. This hotel has an old-world aura about it, being more than hundred years old, and I loved it. The food was absolutely brilliant. I would suggest you to include the breakfast and dinner buffets in your package as they are great. The high tea was also good. The staff could have been a little more warm, but they weren't rude too.   The only major problem was in the shower. While taking bath, it sends spurts of extremely hot…

We have stay ITC savoy on 22nd June 2014 to 24 June 2014 to celebrate our marriage anniversary. Thanks for upgrade to suite.... Love to see that ITC restored the Savoy to its past glory.... We've spent a couple of days in June to celebrate our marriage anniversary. However there is scope of improvement in every area specially the reception guys need to be trained. Housekeeping services needs improvement also. One more important thing that management should provide dormitory services to the personal drivers along with food. As most of the guest came mussorie by road and hence the facility for drivers are must. Regards Dheeraj kumar singh

Stayed with my daughter during her admission to a School here in Mussoorie.  The check in was okay, but I was a bit surprised when the person at the front desk asked for the printed copy of my booking receipt from Booking.com through which I have booked ( which most hotels never asked)  The rooms are lovely, one of the best this side of the country. The downside is that since its a big property, they are bit too far from the reception and the restaurant- the inclement weather did not help.    The food is good and room service is swift in spite of the distance from the kitchen to our room.  The gym is well equipped for a normal cardio-workout. The glass walls have great views, its a pleasure to work out here.  Soft music from the outdoor speakers in the lawn really calms your…

Really wanted to spent some time with nature and silence and choose Mussoorie as the place and Fortune The Savoy as the hotel. When reached Mussoorie and seen the crowded mall road really disappointed but after reaching inside the hotel, everything changed inside the gate a long drive way and big lawn and the big calm hotel. Really a great place to stay for few nights to relax .

Stayed with family with an intention for 3 nights but eventually stayed for 4 nights. The property is very well maintained having all the required aminities. The spa and the well equiped gym is worth mentioning. They also have activities arranged for kids which my 5 yr old daughter really enjoyed during our stay. The staff and the service is obviously as high and expected as in a star property who does make your stay more comfortable. Only few issues which we felt should be adressed. The bath area should be provided with a telephone shower and I do fail to understand how come the use of Wifi in such a high end hotel is chargable. Never the less thanks to all for such a lovely stay.

The hotel is one of the better locationsinthe hills in India....except perhaps Taj Madikeri. Beautiful, high roofed quaint rooms with a view of the himalayas... a very friendly team, excellent service and total satisfaction.

Hi.  After exactly a year, we visited this hotel once again and spent five nights here. The same charm and the same hospitality. Only, most of the old faces (the staff who had served us last year) were missing. In their place was mostly new faces. At least at the front office and reception, we could only see Mr. Keshav Chand an old hand with his cheerful smile and ever helping nature.  The best part was the dining and the restaurant! Pradeep once again went out of his way to help us and serve us. He also remembered us from last year and it was like meeting old family member once again. Keep up the good work, Pradeep and keep smiling.  The second person who was very helpful to us was Deepak, again in the Grand Dining, the restaurant of this magnificent hotel.  However, it needs…

Visited this place with family and found the best place in mussorrie. Nicely and clean rooms decorated with great care.you dont feel like going out if you are staying inside this heritage property. Above all this place is not at all haunted

Stayed at the property for a night (4th Sept'14). We were 5 of us on a business offsite and were looking for some peace after a horrible experience at one other property in Mussourie. And an experience to remember was what we got.  This property just transports you back in time to the colonial era. The grandeur with which the Britishers used to live comes alive in all its magnificence. And to top it all its located at the best location in Mussourie.   1) The interiors are very tastefully done with a lot of attention to detail. The grand dinning hall, the bar and the library just overwhelm you and look as of they are straight from the sets of some period drama. 2) The property has huge and very well maintained lush green lawns. And they become even more lush in the monsoon and…

Its a wonderful property admist of city and easily accessible. The main attraction is the location which is just walking distance away frm mall road. luxurious rooms with wonderful valley view from balcony . Loved the overall ambience of the place and furnishing .  Hotel staff was  friendly and all the requests weretaken care of nicely . But luxry comes with prize ...i found it bit overprized .  But overall it was a heavenly experience .

There is no denying the dramatic impact that this magnificently restored property makes upon arrival. The location is breath-taking and our upgraded room in the old section was extremely comfortable and delightfully furnished. But for a newly renovated property, there were signs of flawed workmanship and perhaps inadequate attention to the detail and upkeep which I will leave the visitor to discover. The friendly staff while looking the part and at times seemingly operating from a memorized script are the minus factor here [notable exception was our man Friday, Kuldeep from Bombay]. For example, we were mis-informed on arrival not once but twice as to breakfast start times [which apparently has always been at 8am and not 7:30am]. The outsourced Wi-Fi for which you pay extra…

Great place enjoyed a lot. I would recommend this location of india to all.  I had trip this august but i would suggest it is best from august to decemeber and january. It's nicest place in india. i love it.

We stayed at this place as wanted to escape the heat of Delhi for few days during weekdays. As it was during the week, the hotel wasn't busy and as expected, we had full attention of the staff. All our special requests were taken care off. So full marks for the good effort by them as we enjoyed our stay. Only few suggestions for improvements: 1. Wifi connections should be made easy and reception staff should know some IT know-how rather than referring everything to IT. Also, even in chains like Taj and Oberoi, you can use three devices on one paid connection. Alas, this was not possible here. IT staff had to provide another complimentary coupon to get our phone (2nd device) on to internet. 2. The drain pipes upstairs, both outside and behind our room (39) were broken and water…

Visiting this marvelous place for my wife's birthday was probably our best decision. The entire landscape is pro-European. So much so that one often forgets he's staying in India. The architecture, interiors, hospitality, food are all spell-binding. The suite itself is so comfy that one doesn't want to get out of it. The center of attraction is however the Nostradamus bar & the Grand Dining Room: we were completely awe-struck by their sheer simplicity but royal architecture. The food and service were just another feather on the hat. A must-visit place for sure!!

It is a Gothic architectural building. I celebrated my birthday at Fortune the Savoi on 20th July. Beautiful ambience of huge restaurant, perfect Indian & continental cuisines. Separated bar rooms. Worth staying…it is the best place to visit in Massoorie, Planning to visit again & again.

The hotel is near yet so far from the hustle-bustle of Mall Road. You get transported into a different world once you enter this hotel! Beautifully restored this hotel has set high standards of service with each and every staff taking extra effort to make you feel special. Special mention of all the staff at the grand dining hall. The rooms, gym, lawns are all done up and maintained impeccably. We look forward to visiting this place soon!

The Hotel which has been restored, could have been done with a wee bit of finesse! Considering the old world charm & yet located so near the Hub of Mussoorie, there could not be a better located place than the Savoy. We were told about the mid-night visitor in the property, but were disappointed to see / hear any such reality in the story!!  Considering the fact that the Hotel will be getting more rooms / Banquet Halls, I am sure that the Fortune group would bring out the "total package" in bringing the Old World Charm to this Savoy of theirs!    Its a good idea to go by Train to Mussoorie, rather than the drive from Delhi, ofcourse if it can be avoided. Abundance of Cabs available from the Hotel for day trips. Over the years, Kempty Falls is a big No-No! Lal Tibba, can be…

Have been visiting this hotel for a year now . Have stayed here many times . Great hospitality and good food . Outdoor activity such as croquet is fun the kids love it . As my son studying in mussoorie visiting this hotel every two months now feeling as if my second home .   The property is a typical British property and haven't seen such huge hotel on a hill .  Hearing about the history of the hotel is also great that so many famous personality use to stay here . Proud of staying in this hotel now   Nitin Gupta   Kanpur   Uttarpradesh

Its quite a memorable experience to visit Savoy restored and opened last year in Mussoorie .It deserves to be in the top list of the best hotels in India for a very good reason. The Hotel is beautiful, elegant, quiet, exotic and a piece of history in itself. Once you enter in the property you feel the touch of history, beauty and Luxury. It is highly recommended Luxury hotel to experience a memorable stay in Mussoorie. The entire premises are absolutely perfect - worthy of  ITC tag. The lawns are incredible and the rooms are finest example  of preserved piece of history and luxury of British era. The service is immaculate in all respects. The facilities are also amazing - including the Gym.  All in all - awesome service, picture perfect setup, excellent property, beautifully…

Very good old hotel renovated to almost five star facility. Reasonable price food etc. Three categories of rooms available. Very good location, good cultured staff, Grand dining room, Outdoor furniture for balcony view/party.

Loved it! It was worth my money and the services were great. Best luxurious and the biggest hotel I've seen in that city. The interiors are beautiful with a very modern concept too. I would love to visit this place soon again with my family next time. Keep up the good work!

Compliments to the ITC group to have been able to restore The Savoy, Mussoorie to its original grandeur. The Grand Dining Room, the Lounge and The Bar takes you back in time, with oakwood paneling , leather tapestry and high ceilings. The Rooms also very pretty with wood and pretty tapestry with a for opening at the back. My only complaint was to the loud music being played all day (7am to 12midnight) in the courtyard which i found very disturbing and despite our repeated requests to turn the volume down or to shut it, there was no relief forthcoming. But overall, a lovely experience to be back at The Savoy

This hotel beats the any other five star hotel hands down...superb location, excellent hospitality..all in all we had a superb family vacation for four days..some staff names that we remember sachin, ajay, arjun, jeetu, amit, the person who looks after the recreational area, housekeeping staff....thanks to team Fortune Savoy. Will surely return soon !!

I loved my 3 day stay at fortune the savoy and if i plan to visit mussorie again in future than the savoy is gonna be my first n last choice, everything right from the entrance to the room n washroom was just mind blowing, staff is more than happy to assist its guest at any point of time. When it comes to food, hats off to the chef, amazing food. Restarent is good and i personally liked the pastries and cakes at high tea.  All in all, great hotel with great architecture, excellent staff; amazing food; picterseque surrounding with an equally interesting and mysterious history and undoubtly bright future.

Our stay at fortune the savoy was just perfect. It's just located near to the library. Very calm b sceniric environment. Simply loved the grand dinning hall breakfast. Service was really quick and just what we expected. Hygienic and cleanliness was one thing that made loved the complete experience.  Will definetly visit again!

With its colonial architecture and majesty the property completely amazes you. I stayed at Savoy with my family for one night and had a wonderful and comfortable stay..!!We received a warm welcome of our arrival and at every step the staff was courteous.    The rooms are beautiful and wonderfully done with all modern amenities yet have the comfort and coziness of home.   The location is just wonderful and I would say all those people looking for something serene would completely love it.   The Restaurant is beautiful and wonderfully done up. The food was delicious and all of us loved it especially the desserts. Hospitality is commendable!! The staff is ever ready to help you. I would highly recommend this property to all!!

We went for three days vacation and really enjoyed our stay in the hotel. Before going to the hotel we find from internet that it s a haunted property and almost made our mind to cancel our stay but fortunately we moved ahead with our plan to visit, and found its a superb property not a haunted one and staff was also very nice, we had a pefect time and look forward to stay there

We stayed at Fortune Savoy during our visit to Mussoorie. Positives: The location of the hotel is great - walking distance from the mall.  Once you enter the hotel you are transported to another world. The lawns are beautiful, the dining room is grand and the rooms are comfortable. The breakfast buffet is impressive. The recreation room has several games and can keep kids occupied for a long time.  Negatives: The dinner buffet was too expensive for what was on offer.

Stayed in the Valley View Room with Balcony.The rooms are very good in all ways.The view from the balcony is also great.Staff was courteous and helpful.Whenever you feel like going to the market just get out of the hotel and you are there.Breakfast was good. Lunch and dinner Buffets can be improved a bit. Menu was fine , taste wise thoda maza kum aaya.But no complaints, enjoyed the stay very much. If you go for the valley view room , try to get the 6th floor rooms.

Located at the library in Mussorie ,this place is in right at the centre ,yet it seems to be far away ,in solitude from the crowds of the town. The quietness is unbelievable,the sky so clear and the air so refreshing. Even if you want you cant see the town,can only see the mountains around.  The architecture is very old but beautifully preserved. The wooden structure all around is not found anywhere else. The dining hall is a marvel and you feel like a king sitting in it Food is good,especially the breakfast. South Indian dishes were one of the best I had in recent times. Staff is courteous The place is haunted they say. Yes it will give you haunting memories for the rest of your life. Shall come back again ,whenever I am in Mussorie.

we got more than what we went seeking....spent three days in absolute peace, soaking in the beauty of the property, walking n wondering, playing n lazing....the weather added to make this visit a perfect dream come true. hotel staff is very helpful and courteous...rooms are spotless clean, every need taken care of , very comfortable with breathtaking view from the balconies..the breakfast spread was a delight...ranged from american to europian to indian..both north n south n much more...my daughter had her fill of running,climbing,breathing fresh air...she was a fairy with wings there..worth every penny spent..infact more than that...looking forward to another visit soon !!! the architecture is one of its kind and i salute the team behind the renovation who have brought this…

I checked in with my family took 4 Rooms, it was one of the finest experiences on a Hill station where I have been going from years. Breakfast spread was one of the best I had after staying in so many 5 Star properties. Good recreation activities for children and if you carrying your Cricket you can play with tennis ball.   Very Helping staff..Arjun, Chandrabir, Sandeep, Nishant..Thanks to the GM for giving a great family holiday.  Little on a height which gives a great view of Hills but at same time coming up or going down by shuttle is the best option which the hotel provides in 5 mins as you can't come up walking.  Very Close to mall road a some time congestion is there so avoid taking your own cars...Walking ideal.  Thank you Team Fortune Savoy..

Experience starts from Awesome and ends with awesome!!! Everything from front-desk to food to property to landscape to room service to cleanliness to kids room - is just awesome. Enjoyed the stay for 1 day with my family. I was not getting a room anywhere in Mussoorie as I didn't do a pre- booking. When I called Savoy guys while on way from Dehradun to Mussoorie , they offered me Suite for the rates of their lower category room. My kids really enjoyed the Suite to the fullest which is very spacious and organised. The room service staff is very courteous and the service is very prompt. Quality of food is very good and kids enjoyed the food ordered as per their wish.

It would be somewhat presumptuous to review a property that has defied objective description for more than a century by sheer virtue of the magnificence of its environs and the history that it holds within its cavernous hallways. Suffice it to say that I salute the vision of those who restored it in recent times without compromising too much of its truly enviable heritage. It is not the hotel, therefore, that I intend to review.   My wife and I had the great good fortune of staying down the hill at a cozy apartment overlooking Christ Church (arguably the oldest British church in the Himalayan range), courtesy the generosity of a dear friend. It was but natural to drive up with family we were visiting for dinner at the Savoy one evening.  We had reservations at the Grand Dining…

Good work to preserve the old architectural work. Its a nice hotel with excellent staff, open areas and beautifully decorated rooms.  One big surprise was the question on every guest or staff's mind, which kept us engaged at all times - is it a haunted property or not?  Thought nothing felt or nothing to share specifically, but it gives you some bit time to explore (if interested)... :) A thing of my interest particularly is GOOD FOOD and MUSIC. Both these were up to great standards, with live band during one particular day with old Hindi Bollywood songs to cheer about!!  Overall a pleasant experience.

Mussoorie seemed a perfect choice for a short getaway to escape the fury of Delhi summer and we decided to try out the iconic Savoy instead of our old favourite -Jaypee,The hotel has everything going for it -a fantastic location bang on the Mall road,huge grounds,the ITC brand advantage and a huge dose of history and nostalgia.Years ago I had visited this hotel when it was shut down and I must compliment the architect who has revamped this property without taking away its original flavours.Well appointed rooms, a great breakfast spread, location,the Writer's Bar are the pros of this hotel. On the flip side there is a serious dearth of activity.At 9 am in the morning we were the only family in the dining hall! The hotel can arrange some evening entertainment for the…

Difficult to believe that such a huge hotel could be so centrally located in such a commercial hill station. Huge lawn and open spaces. Rooms...innovatively done....totally different layout. Huge parking. Average food.

Excellent Hotel.. Super Location ..!! Had been so many times to mussorie but never knew about this property. Its a super excellent property with beautiful views, lovely gardens & balconies to sit just outside the rooms. Loved the overall experience of staying here & would definitely stay again. Only let down was house keeping, which needs to be better, hence 4 star rating. Also i advise everyone to choose there activity tours carefully as some of them are super nice & others are super wastage of time & money & mind you they aren't cheap.

The hotel is so beautiful that one feels transported to another world. It is located in the centre which makes it easily accessible(although the traffic jams in Mussoorie are a pain).The rooms are exquisitely done, true British style. We loved the lawns, the huge rooms and the overall ambience. The food was good but everything paled in comparison to the grandeur of the Hotel. The staff, although helpful, seemed a little forgetful and preoccupied. But overall a wonderful experience.

We visited Mussoorie from 21st to 25th May,2014 & stayed at Fortune The SAVOY in Savoy Chambers. I am glad that I chose this hotel from earlier reviews on Trip Advisor...Excellent property which underwent thorough renovation only last year or so....Other 5 star properties in Mussoorie are very far from the most happening Mall Road. Savoy is just 3 minutes walk from the Mall Road & yet located at a height ( steep ascent awaits you !!) & hence secluded from the hustle & bustle. We had visited Mussoorie 25 years ago & this time we were celebrating our Silver Anniversary at Savoy...In a casual chat with front office girl ( Dilpreet) , I mentioned this to her & to our surprise the Savoy Team came to our room with a delicious Cake to celebrate our Anniversary.A real sweet gesture.…

This is the best property in Mussoorie. A stone's throw from the mall, yet so secluded and private because of the huge property. This was the famous Savoy Hotel of Mussoorie that was opened in 1902. ITC has done a wonderful job of restoring it. Beautifully maintained, heritage property with wooden ceilings and floors, huge rooms and impeccable service. We stayed from May 20 to 24, 2014. We were in a suite which was huge. There is a living room with a 32 inch LCD, a big bedroom with a 42 inch LCD, a dressing room with a dresser and a balcony and a mid sized bathroom. The dining room is wonderful and the Writers Bar is amazing. Ruskin Bond and Ganesh Salil have spent a lot of time in this bar and it really feels great sitting here in the leather sofas, sipping a drink and reading…

We went to savoy in may 2014.When we entered we were greeted properly with a friendly and good staff.The dinning room was huge and spacious.The staff on the first day in the dine area  was laethargic but on the second day they became active.Then comes the room,the rooms were spacious and clean...the bathrooms were clean too.The room service were excellent,in a day they cleaned the room twice.The location is great,the mall road just starts as soon as we get down.The place being haunted is rubbish!!!!!!!!!!overall it was a great family trip!!!

We stayed with 4 persons in the Sayoy Hotel in April 2014. From the beginning we were welcomed very friendly and everything was prepared excellent. The hotel was freshly renovated in the colonial style it was built. The rooms were decorated very tasty , nothing was missed, it was fantastic clean. The public areas of the hotel like the restaurant, the bar, the gym ... were mantained very good. Food was excellent, staff was top friendly. Overall very good, we will come again.

Excellent ambience, beautiful property, friendly staff. Was there for two days with my wife and 4 year old son. Would have loved to stay longer, my son did not want to come back. A perfect holiday destination. Hope to visit again.

What a fabulous property! It's huge, you need to spend a day just taking in the beautifully done landmark. It's like living in a piece of history... After all, the Queen of England, Nelson Mandela and the Nehru's stayed here. The Savoy is mentioned many a time in Ruskin Bonds novels, Agatha Christie too has a short story based at the Savoy... The rooms are very spacious, the property is very well maintained, the service is great, the food is good. Must, must do on your check list.

I stayed in the hotel for three nights with my family. Property is well maintained and located near to mall road. Rooms are comfortable but feels smaller according to the prices. We opted the room on map basis. On first dinner , buffet was served with enough variety and was ok in taste. The worst story happened on the second evening, when very limited menu (no buffet) ( only one dal, one paneer dish, and one vegetable was offered without any curd, no choice for rice, no Chinese, no soups at all. When we opposed and asked for the buffet or ala carte, then the chief chef came to us and explained me the meaning of MAP ( meal at plan). He said that, meal at plan is as per chef choice and the guest cannot demand any thing beyond the prescribed menu.( even if the prescribed menu is at…

We stayed at one of their signature savoy suits on the first floor. Decor was nice and classy.But overall the suite and the service couldnt measure up to the 23000 a night price tag.Menu choices are extemely limited specially if you look through the room service menu. No chinese, italian thai etc. NOT EVEN ICECREAM!!!! Be ware if you are on a breakfast, dinner included package. They didn't lay out a buffet and curtly handed out a so called TDH menu for dinner with less than three items in each category (soups/salad, Veg, non-veg) to choose from. Dessert had two options GULAB JAMUN and MUFFINS!!!!! If you deviate from this menu or order from room service, it was billable. Imagine being treated as such after paying 23grand a night for 3days.Also the hotel needs a drivers…

I have covered half the globe and have stayed in the best of places but to have stayed in fortune the savoy was a world class experience.The property ,the prompt staff and their efficiency,the location and the activities for the guests ranging from games like TT, snooker air hockey carom etc to a live band in the Grand dining is all out of the world.. It's a serene surrounding with music playing always in the background ..:) Just a little change that the staff should do is keep the temperature of the air condition personalised..and not centrally heated. Rest assured its a must visit!

This is a famous Mussoorie hotel from the British Raj. It is a wonderful location overlooking the mountains. Back in the day, The Savoy was noted as a writers hangout, and famous authors are listed in the Writer's Bar. The hotel was the setting of one of Agatha Christie's murder mysteries. The Savoy was sadly run down for many years and has now been restored to something of its former glory.  The restoration is tasteful, if a bit bland, the owners have been sensitive to leave the fine old woodwork and are working on the gardens. All the modern comforts are available: comfy beds, lots of pillows, snowy white linens, convenient well-stocked bathrooms, WiFi, etc.. The staff are exceptionally polite.

Certainly the hotel is Savoy class after the renovation last year. The classic charm has been maintained and the feeling of space is quite a contrast to the congested surroundings. Spacius and manicured lawns add to the charm. The restaurant is excellent and so also is the bar. Rooms, though a little small, are well appointed and maintained with wide varandahs and courtyard. Activity room is quite warm and enjoyable. It is truly an experience to stay there.

I stayed at this beautiful hotel for 3 nights. In my opinion this is the most beautiful and sought after hotels in the queen of hills in India. I mapped the hotel across at all hours of day and night and except efficient and helpful staff, astounding service and delicious culinary fare complimented by great interiors and royal bars and restaurant there was nothing "haunted" here. In fact all historical venues in the world have people with incidents in the past times and this does not make the place haunted. The activity room has plenty of games to choose from. Help at hand appears from the thin air. The staff is eager to assist with a smile.  I have stayed at The Savoy in Ooty in Iris cottage occasional;y for 3 years. The staff used to tell me stories that would make me smile…

Good stay overall, and very friendly and nice people who make your stay worthwhile.   The best part of the stay were the activities the hotel offered.   Pros: Amazing attention to detail.  Location is very good. Just near Library Chowk .  Great staff,  A well balanced mix of history and modern facilities.  Good ambiance, large open spaces Nice sitting areas outside your rooms. comfortable furniture and beds, not too low, not too high, just right.  Room had safety-vault, iron and other facilities  Cons:  No Spa (under construction)  Suggestion: Do talk to Mr. Mohindroo ( in activities) and he has some great ideas and options to make mussoorie trip worthwhile.  He has immense knowledge about the area and suburbs.

no spa...no...jaccuzzi....no pick and drop service to the mall....and be surprised that the view from normal room os much better than the suits!!!! U cannot get out of ur room in the mornings coz of monkey menance. Food is good and staff is helpful

It was my 1st wedding anniversary and I planned to go to Mussoorie. I was confused between the Jaypee and Fortune Savoy but at last I chossed Savoy because of its location. But when I stayed I found many more reason. The ambience is so majestic that you will feel that you are 50 years from now. The staff was very helpful and also upgraded our room for free. Nicely maintained with decent food.

We stayed at Fortune the Savoy from 4th to 8th March. We had booked a Fortune suite and we had a fabulous time. The hotel, the facilities, the service were all amazing! The hotel spa was not yet operational but that should be working soon, but other than that I cannot think of anything to criticise about the hotel. The service in particular was impeccable, with the staff being courteous, friendly and informative at all times. The activities director was excellent, and he taught us how to play both pool and croquet while we were there. Location of the hotel is excellent as it is right next to mall road. A point to be noted is that cars are not allowed on mall road most of the time, and tourist cars are not allowed at all, so being located next to mall road is a huge advantage.

Well I am quite late in reviewing this hotel (stayed here in September last year), but nevertheless wanted to review it. The moment we reached here, we knew that we had made a right choice. It is a lovely property nestled in the hills. The staff was courteous and greeted us every time they saw us. The room was an icing on the cake, amazingly beautiful, large, and with a lovely view. The food was a little repetitive, but that didn’t dampen our spirits. Overall, we had a great time. I would definitely recommend it to everyone. It is worth every penny.

This is the very first time I have come across a Hotel, where they oversell the rooms of property and then simply drop and email to the customer that we would not be able to accommodate your confirmed booking as we are fully sold out.  I would definitely, inform everyone to not just check but double and triple check with the hotel your confirmed booking before going there directly and feeling sorry that the hotel has again oversold the rooms of the property.

I wish we had stayed at the Savoy for more than one night. Since my job involves travel and staying at hotels, I am not easily impressed. However, Savoy has trul,y charmed me with its ambience hospitality and facilities. The spacious lounging arrangement with loads of good books and attentive staff, a menu card straight out of a british raj novel, lovely rooms and recreational facilities ensure that if you wish to stay within the property and are happy looking at the hills around you then you do not need to step out.

Mussoori is a beautiful place hidden away in the mountains. With whining road and building built on the edges of cliffs it's a interesting place. The savory is a beautiful place to stay but I would recommend getting a room with a view if you going to be staying here for a few days. The breakfast was limited I think it was because of the time of year and it was low season. The service was outstanding from everyone, from the door man to the waiters in the restaurant. The guy at the travel desk is very well spoken and well informed. He is happy to share the good spots to go to even if you have your own driver. Speak to him if you don't know what to do.   The rooms are beautiful, modern and spacious. The rooms are well heated and the very comfortable. Every detail in the rooms and…

During our holiday at Mussourie we went for dinner at Fortune Savoy and was impressed by the food quality , taste and service.. perhaps next time we would like to stay at The Savoy,, it has a colonial feel and idealy located.

We stayed for three  nights in Feb 2014 in a suite at Fortune Savoy. It has excellent location with distant views of mountains.  There is a fitness centre which I used one day. It is really nice to be looking at the mountains and walking on the tread mill. The food was very good (we are Vegetarians)  after a group arrived. Before that there were very few guests and food variety was poor. People are really attentive, polite and  helpful. Sometimes you might feel service is overbearing!  Bar is good. Both food and drinks are expensive. The place (dining area and room) is really kept very clean and ambience particularly in dining area is top class. It is very well maintained. Rekindles childhood memories of castles in the clouds The green sloping roofs the open spaces ,the large bedrooms and even bigger bathrooms makes one want to stay on forever. The Victorian architecture the high roofs,the beautiful bar with books you always wanted to read. Restaurant served delicious food the guy singing solo provided great entertainment at dinner. Full marks to the staff of savoy they deserve a pat in the back. It's luxury all the way,if you have the money splurge!!!

A beautiful hotel in the hills of Mussoorie. The rooms are so cosy, the room serves even better. The staff & managment are so humble and courteous. The restaurant churns out extremely delectable dishes along with the live music. We visited when the hotel was covered in snow, there was snow right outside our rooms. I have been visiting Mussoorie for the past 35 years and this hotel won hands down by far IN EVERYTHING. The rooms, the decor, the heating, the bathrooms, the service, the restaurant, the reading lobby,  the location was all perfect. We all personally applaud & thank the staff and management of the hotel for giving us such a beautiful time in the hotel, we did push you all to the limits but you came out true winners...all of you.. thank you.. Excellent location, very good food, taste as well as service.. however choice of food was not too much even though we were a group of 60+. Fantastic room interiors. Staff very good.For sure not a haunted property, simply ignore 100 year old story .

Mussoorie does not have very many luxury hotels and Jaypee is a close competitor to Savoy in terms of luxury and services. Savoy post renovation restores the charm of a by-gone era and is beautifully restored. The suites are large and tasteful, the sit out areas are plenty and charming and the service is great too. The food menu available to us during this weekend was limited as the occupancy was low. A great experience nonetheless.

I had been to the old Savoy in Mussoorie as a boy and at that time it was on its last legs of its glorious days. The ITC group has revived the hotel to a level not even seen in its earlier avatar. Its fascinating as to how the original ornate woodwork has been faithfully restored. The understated ambience is unmatched and it gives one a glimpse of life in the late 19th century. The rooms are very tastefully done and probably more English than the English.The beautiful landscaping and the view of the 'Third Pole' on a clear sunny day completes the picture. A must for travelers wanting to re-visit an old era with modern facilities, an awesome bar and a fantastic dining experience.

I recently had the experience of staying at Savoy in Mussoorie.It is a brilliant case study of conservation, preservation and restoration of a heritage property. It now has charm, warmth,  vibrant life,wonderful architechure,a fabulous Writer's bar and gorgeous food.  Savoy was once the most treasured resort for the rich and famous of India.It had fallen on hard days. I was amazed at its revival. To my mind, this is ITC's finest property and it has done a brilliant job of reviving it. It has brought glory back to MUSSOORIE.  The resort provides a fascinating view of the Indian Himalayas, the ambience is unique and the hospitality  is amongst the finest!. The high point is the Writer's Bar, which was once frequented by legendary writers from across the world. My compliments to…

Being brought up in Dehradun, from my childhood days ( and im talking about the 70s) , "The Savoy, Mussoorie" was the second name of "Luxury"!! Never had a chance to visit it at that time as i moved out of Dehradun in the 90s. So visiting it for the first time once the Fortune chain took it over was a dream come true... Came here with my family in December 2013 & believe me every moment spent here is cherishable. The old wood charm holds good still.... the old block is made up of wood & has been delicately restored. The new block, where i stayed had tastefully decorated rooms which were super comfortable.  It is a place to go with your loved ones & just sit and enjoy the old charm. The Writer's bar needs special mention for being a part of history & you royal sitting there. …

The property is a breath taker to begin with , it's a heritage property with a blend of luxurious rooms , very good service , great value and infrastructure . It's also fairly cheap for the one In its class and is a pleasure to stay at . The food was quite average for an itc and the location is good but not the best as it's in the small mall road and is a ten minute walk from the main one . But believe me , I have visited other properties in jus sportive , but this one is the overall best to live in , so I would suggest you to end your research here and book it

We just loved the experience we had on our short stay for our anniversary on the 25th of Dec 2013. Was happy to see the renovated property, I must say they have done a superb job. Check in was very quick though the heating in the room given to us initially was not very good, we were shifted into another room immediately. Interiors of the room were very nice with a rocking chair in the room. The staff was exceptional and I must mention a few names here. Kuldeep, Smita and Sidharth took very good care of us. The GM Piyul Barua took extra pains to make our anniversary and stay enjoyable.  The special table in the sun for breakfast was utter luxury specially in this cold.  The live music at dinner time was very enjoyable.

We visited this property in the month of October and overall we liked this property. Starting from check-in to brief of entire property was good. When we entered the hotel we were amazed to see that the front office was ready for our reception and everything was ready. they hardly took 2 minutes for check-in formalities. Once we were in our room again it was pleasure to see the amenities and the kinds of fabrics and furnishing they have used to decorate the room.It was almost 100 yrs old property but the kind of rennovation they have done was superb and worth a try.. I had a group of 5 couples with children visiting the property between 6th Dec - 9th Dec. The service and the staff were impeccable, especially like to thank Bishnu.  Beautiful views from the resort. The rooms are well appointed and have all the modern amenities.

We stayed in this property for 2 nights with a groups of 6 friends. On arrival they greeted us with bouquet and explained various facilities nicely. In the evening they arranged bon fire which lasted for around 4 hours.   Next day all 3 rooms were upgraded from deluxe rooms to suites. It was indeed an amazing experience. I would highly recommend this hotel in terms of luxury, service, pampering, food quality and proximity to mall road.   Best experience was to enjoy dinner with live music.   Thanks Savoy  Ankit

We had super stay in a very neatly and nicely made hotel. It is a majestic property having history of 120 years. All rooms and suites are newly renovated with perfect modern facilities with breathtaking view of snow cladded mountains. Fortune staff is really damn good in hospitality and we were taken real good care. What is missing is a Spa & a temperature controlled swimming pool. We went for 2 nights and landed up staying 4 nights.

Visited mussoorie for two days. Found Fortune the Savoy an excellent place. Happy open place with heritage history ,Spacious rooms , Lavish breakfast , friendly and eager to help staff - all made our trip memorable . Another highlight was the open ground . I wish to stay here only whenever I visit the queen of hills .

A short drive to the hilltop, passing through a thicket of towering pines and deodars, leads you to a long  forgotten estate, now lovingly restored as The Savoy. As you step in to the cozy hard wood interiors, the freezing cold outside fades away instantly. The staff is equally warm and welcoming - constantly ensuring a memorable stay.  Rachna and I visited Savoy for our 6th wedding anniversary and it surely was the most memorable one yet. Thank  you Savoy for all the delights you had to offer to make our day special.

Amazing stay experience in the queen of hills...heritage property , open lush green lawns, excellent food and breathtaking view of the snow claded himalayas ..very well kept rooms and the feel of the wood everywhere makes it a cosy affair.though there were sm initial issues of stink in the public areas of the hotel but was sorted once brought to notice.overall a must visit place.Also I feel internet should be complementary atleast in the main areas of the hotel.

We stayed here for 5 nights and enjoyed every bit. Rooms were clean and excellent. Breakfast was mouth watering. I would highly recommend this hotel. If you have a good budget than this is the place for you. Staff was friendly and courteous

We stayed there starting Sunday till Tuesday afternoon. Celebrated our friend's 2nd marriage anniversary. A beautifully done hotel which is a very old property. Plus points, excellent break fast, rooms were okay, staff were trained n helpful, they even upgraded us to their suites all three rooms free of cost... Minus, no swimming pool they are planning but will take time..., no bath tubs which is a must as per five star standards, the bathroom locks were in bad conditions...  The hotel is five minutes walk from the Mall Road and please do not miss Lovely Omelette, Chinese at Kalsung... We didn't go for sight seeing. Would definitely come back again but will try some other hotel( no problem with this one )

This is the newly done up version of the hotel; it opened about 6 months ago. This is a place to be seen to be believed. It is about a minute's walk from the hustle and bustle of Mall Road Mussoorie but once you are through the gates, its an ocean of tranquility. The structure is an old colonial building done up extensively in wood. It has a majestic staircase leading to the main dining hall and the bar. The bar is very aptly called The Writer's Bar. It boasts of fine spirits and if you are from a big city in India, this place is value for money. There is a lawn next to the main building that has a croquet field laid out. It is worth at least trying this game out. Behind the rooms near the croquet field one can get a spectacular view of the Himalayas. I happened to be there on a…

It was on a vacation that i choose this hotel and i found it very comfortable for my stay with family, the rooms the ambiance and service is quite good. The food was something great and i certainly love it. Overall a good place to stay.

We with a group of friends spent an afternoon at The Savoys. It was a mindboggling super experience for us .Right from the smiles and greets at the reception till our coffee late in the evening ,all of it ..the food ..the service ...was par excellence.KUDOS to the staff and especially Mr Ashok Mahindroo and the team for taking extra care to make us feel extra special.\Thanks once again and keep the good work going. Deepak and Divya.

Too few are words to express our Experience in Mussoorie staying with SAVOY Fortune!! Have experienced Jaypee, Avalon, Fortune Grace, Royal Orchid and others in Mussoorie, but memories of this particular stay at the Fortune Savoy will remain with us forever!! Bathroom: Squeaky clean and compact. Food: On the first day of…

The wooden furnishings seem to be solid teak wood or mahogany and are wonderful. The grand dining room is a phenomena in itself along with the lovely chandelier at the entrance. The rooms are beautifully appointed and the basic rooms which we took had a lovely bed room, a powder room, a well appointed bath room and the back door opening out to a pristine verandah. My mother has been to Savoy as a teenager so this time my sister and I while on a break to mussoorie decided to hike up the walk to Savoy for some high tea. Half way up to through the hike just as we were about to give up and return owing to the hike, we saw a white statue lazily placed under a tree. And we wanted to see more. We entered through the reception area which was centrally warmed up for the cold season. We were greeted and escorted by Ravindra from front desk area. He showed us around this extremely royal and beautiful property with high ceilings, unmatched wood work, over 200 yrs old staircase with a beautiful design, lovely manicured gardens and magnificent chandeliers. I thoroughly enjoyed my time at the savoy. The hotel is grand & very well done. The sprawling lawns , high staircases  & the old colonial décor added a lot to the entire experience. Moreover the hotel staff was very friendly & accommodating. The hotel is situated at the corner of the mall road & one can easily walk down to the mall road. Food was very good & we specially enjoyed the high tea.  This would easily be one of the best places to stay in Mussoorie & should definitely be rated high for any traveller

The hotel has been renovated after having stayed in a run- down, dilapidated state for decades. And what a remarkable job ITC have done ! The place oozes with luxury and the general manager there says it is just the beginning.The rooms and suites are tastefully furnished, ambience of the lounges,garden, bar and restaurants is pleasing, food is excellent  and service exceeds one's expectations.At last Mussourie once again has a really good place to stay for a discerning visitor.It is suggested that the place should be transformed into a full fledged resort.

this is hotel located at nice place near mall road gandhi chowk & big in size like resorts so it is quiet one from the hustle bustle of the town one can sit calmly in his own world & near the town don't need to drive on small roads for the big resorts it is all in one. it is heritage. it is royal. it is luxary. it is high class. what else ??? one need on great holiday service food nd staff all is good but it is little heavy on pocket. they should arrange golr car from entrance & dorimentory for the drivers. during stay here one can enjoy the nature very well.

I have been going to Mussoorie once a year for as long as I can remember and it's fascinating to see the confidence with which big hotel chains are investing in this beautiful small hill station. ITC fortune is one of the new kids on the block and they took the gutsy decision to renovate a 100 year old hotel which is famous for its rich aristocratic history and a cock and bull haunted story.   This year this hotel was the talk of the town and I Ofcourse went to check out what the fuss was all about. It's pretty hard to be amazed with 5 star hotels anymore because they all mostly look the same with their ostentatious interiors and over the top feel but this hotel truly amazed me. Well, I really don’t know where to begin.  I’ve been in India for 5 years, after moving from the UK, and have travelled extensively throughout India. I had reserved rooms at The Savoy Hotel, having learned from friends who had previously resided there, that it was the most luxurious and beautiful hotel in the vicinity offering an unparalleled service. The countless rumours of a haunted 505 and the hatted man took me to this place, the oldest and most regal of Indian hotels. I thot I could catch the ghosts by there silver ankles... But what I got was superb service, an awesome stay and awesome food. The chef is a young and dynamic guy and the manager, who also manages the neighbouring fortune property is the most hospitable man I have met. Hats off to this hotel and its staff. The property and the hotel staff is what skyrockets in my book. The savoy is a permanent addition to my holiday.

Fortune The Savoy at Mussoorie, Uttarakhand is a heritage property which has been taken over by the ITC group and has been recently opened to the public fully renovated.  If the hotel industry is marked by the level of care, concern and hospitality that is extended by the Hotel to its guests, then Savoy would score a perfect ten. For some people it may be the level of creature comforts that the hotel may provide, but for my wife and me, it was the level of attention to the minutest of all details that made our stay most memorable. For example, my wife wanted a dish that was not on the menu. The chef specially prepared this dish for her. Visited The Savoy hotel in June this year when it was just re-opened after complete restoration. I was spellbound to see the renovated Savoy maintaining the same colonial look with all the modern facilities of the 5 star hotel. Spread on several acres of land with plush green lawns, tall trees, fountains, lot of open spaces to walk around with a spectacular view of mountains on the clear day and the Doon valley. Has whetted the appetite to return again soon.

This is huge Property now taken over by Foirtune Group. Though it was their first operational season, I understand that they must be facing some glitches. However stay was good except some issues in service. Location is much good than Jaypee. Spacious Rooms, Huge bar and coffee shop. Liked it.

stayed in suite in this hotel with family for two nights.  On 10 June 2013 morning there was no hot water in bathroom. At 10 PM there was no water at all in washroom. On complaining water service was restored in 40 minutes. Again there was no water at 4 AM and at 8AM on 11 June 2013.  It is not my nature to fight with management for discounts and refund. It was neither asked nor offered.  I can accept service flaws.  However after paying Rs. 15,000 per night, no water in washroom cannot be accepted.  Water in washroom in no luxury, it necessity and is provided by budget hotels also.

Many say that paradise does not exist on Earth. I however, beg to differ, as The Savoy is one such hotel which gives fruition to the fact that paradise does exist on Earth. Built in a English Gothic architecture, the hotel reminds you of the 1900s. And why not, because the hotel was built in 1902!This is a huge heritage hotel with acres of lawns and huge Deodar trees .Two of them are more than 300+years old. The hotel has a lot of 1902 furniture still preserved, and the almirahs in the Suites are the same ones which were installed in the hotel in 1902.  When we arrived at the hotel, we were pleasantly surprised to find ourselves in such a place. The hotel has a huge compound with lush green grass, and sculptures of women at the corners. It also has a Gym room, with state of the…

Visited the savoy recently with family. the moment you see it from the front you are in an awe ! It looks exactly ( I mean it) the same old n famous savoy except it has been reincarnated after 111 years in its present youthful charm,  green lawns , blooming flowers,  humming fountains , colonial furniture with all modern amenities centrally airconditioned, great views all around ! . Ever smiling staff that is happy to help always ! Great Dining experience in the grand dining hall. No wonder so many dignitories and celebrities have stayed here in the past. Go......... live  an experience

Most beautiful stay at Mussoorie...such a gorgeous property. I really left my heart back there.  One of the most memorable experience is when we were given a beautiful birthday celebration in the green house.  The food,  the staff, the rooms were  just excellent  Chef Prakash Negi is just fabulous he went out of his way to ensure the kids enjoyed good food as well.   Mussoorie is beautiful as it is but this hotel made the trip so special for us.  The location is just fabulous Right at the heart of Mussoorie on the mall road, we could walk down to do our shopping whenever we felt like. And at the same time the property feels secluded and the rooms are so quiet the clouds had descended  into our balcony.   Truly fabulous just check in.

The Savoy is one of those rare hotels that not just justify the hype surrounding them but far exceed the expectations created by the hype. My three-day stay (the first out-station trip in nearly 8 months) with my parents was perfect. The thoughtfully designed property, the hospitality of the entire staff, the quality of the food -- the hotel scores on every front.   While every member of the staff we interacted with was extremely helpful, I would especially like to mention Vikas at the reception, Sandeep at the bar, and Aditya at the restaurant for the care they took to make our stay memorable (I hope I got the names right). I loved the hotel's location. It's right next to Mall Road, but within the property, you never feel that you are in the middle of the town. The rooms are so well-designed and comfortable that we spent much of our time lazying around in the room or in the balcony or enjoying the beautiful hotel property.  Particular mention also must be made of the measures the hotel has taken to keep everything sanitized and minimize contact because of the pandemic. Hats off to the Savoy team!…

The thoughtfully designed property, the hospitality of the entire staff, the quality of the food -- the hotel scores on every front.   While every member of the staff we interacted with was extremely helpful, I would especially like to mention Vikas at the reception, Sandeep at the bar, and Aditya at the restaurant for the care they took to make our stay memorable (I hope I got the names right). I loved the hotel's location. It's right next to Mall Road, but within the property, you never feel that you are in the middle of the town. The rooms are so well-designed and comfortable that we spent much of our time lazying around in the room or in the balcony or enjoying the beautiful hotel property.  Particular mention also must be made of the measures the hotel has taken to keep everything sanitized and minimize contact because of the pandemic. Hats off to the Savoy team!…

We visited Mussoorie from 15th March'20 to 18th March' and stayed at Amatra Dunsvirk Court. It is a lovely property atop a hill with breathtaking views all around. We could see the snow capped Himalayas everyday and bask in the serenity. Our room was very comfortable and we were upgraded to a room with a better view free of charge. As it was atop a hill, its 1.7km upward from Library Chowk(Mall). Thus the hotel provides free shuttle service from 9am to 6pm till Library Chowk for both pickup and drop.  Breakfast was complimentary and very tasty with options available in Indian, American and Continental platter. We ordered in-room lunch and dinner service and food was tasty. The prices for in-room menu were reasonable for most items barring few, like one plate of plain rice @ INR260 and dal makhni @ 360, where as dal tadka (yellow dal) was INR260. The hotel provides complimentary mineral water daily.  Service was good and all our needs were catered to. Some dish preparations were customised as requested and it was very helpful. All staff were courteous and dedicated. Thanks to all the gentlemen who looked after us throughout our stay, namely Mr. Gourav (Manager), Mr. Shashank (Front Desk), Mr. Arun (F&B Manager), Mr. Subhash Thakur (Restaurant), Mr.Behari Lal (housekeeping). The boutique stay experience is detailed down to every level, from the food menu, to the well maintained lawns, the wooden furniture, the gilded insignia of the erstwhile Kasmanda state being proudly displayed along with other remnants from The Raj. None of the photos do justice to the outdoor seating, lined with magnolia trees at the back, and the wide, unhindered vista of Mussoorie's ridge and Dehra far away in the plains.   The wifi was absent though, and the rooms got a little cold during our stay there (early snowfall, the first time in three years in December!), but…

Very nice heritage property. Gives an old world feel. We stayed in royal room which was huge and had fabulous view of the Doon valley. Staff was courteous and professional.  Food also very good though found it little expensive. Very well maintained garden area is a plus for people with kids.  Hotel is situated on the mall road but there is a steep climb to reach it. Not a big problem as the Hotel staff arranges for cab very promptly for the ride up or down to the mall road.

The trip advisor pictures don't do justice to this beautiful property. We stayed for 2 nights and were very pleasantly surprised at how regal, peaceful and beautiful this hotel is. Lots of green space on the property, badminton court, and just places to hang out. I absolutely loved the portraits of the royal family (though you cannot photograph them). The lounge inside the dining area is a hidden gem that we discovered. Must spend an evening there playing board games or simply reading a book. Know that since the hotel is on the mall road, you cannot bring a taxi till the gates. you can either walk or take a cycle rickshaw for the last 100 metres. the climb to the hotel is steep, but the hotel cab picks/drop you each time. would love to stay here again.

Very beautiful property and excellent services . Lovely garden area and food .Room was also really good .Would love to come again. Staff was also very good .Very beautiful property and excellent services .

Wonderful heritage hotel , beautifully appointed. Excellent evening meal and breakfast. Beautiful gardens looking down over Mussoorie. Easy to walk to the Mall though a bit of a climb back up. Would thoroughly recommend.

I have always found hotels on the hills to lack a certain charm. But Kasmanda proved me wrong. A heritage property bang in the middle of Mussourie mall road was definitely not what I was expecting. The rooms are large and give you heritage feels; the property is quaint. But what stands out is its gorgeous lawn and terrace. The terrace offers an unparalleled view of the valley. Sunset view is heavenly. The service is lovely. The hotel would be a 100mtrs walk up from mall road - which can be a pain for people like me with weak knees. So the hotel provides you shuttle service from 10 AM in the morning to 10 PM in the night - taking you down to mall road or bringing you back up after your excursions. There is ample parking space. The hotel is neat and very nicely maintained. The old…

Great hotel once you get to it up a steep hill. Wonderfully renovated heritage hotel. The old photos are interesting. Food good. Shame the hotel has no licence though. Breakfast good although lack of tea and coffee. Have suggested just putting it on the buffet to make it easier. Had to wait 20 minutes for a half cup of coffee. Rooms comfortable and heaters are great. Hot water was good and toiletries nice except there was no shampoo. Better to have shampoo rather than talcomn. Great garden and great history and well looked after.

Had a absolutely wonderful time at Kasmanda Palace. Truely a beautiful place with heritage feel to it, lush gardens and a picturesque landscape. The place has a rich history is almost 200yrs old. Owned by the royal family of Kasmanda. The place is nicely maintenained and the service is really good. It is on a hill top away from the crowd. Must visit.

One incident made what could have been a memorable trip quite poor. The hotel manager insisting for an immediate CASH payment for a service that is usually complimentary. The hotel was recommended by a family member who has stayed before. I was surprised by the well preserved property and the location was outstanding. Excellent food and good service by staff. Shoor veer Singh at the restaurant was a stand out for his charm and quality service. However the manager insisting for the payment in cash for arranging the bonfire and that too refusing to add the charge to the room was a damper and honestly made me feel quite petty. This meant that at the middle of an event I was made to get up and climb all the way back to my room from the garden to fetch my wallet and make the…

Ambience is probably best I have ever visited any hotel. Hospitality is great. The vast garden in two to three layers above the hilltop in the hotel is so romantic. Royal heritage look and feel is seen over every room and nook and corner of the hotel.  Out of all RESTAURANT is out of the world.  Good dropping and picking up facility on a simple call,from Ritz cinema spot to Palace Hotel is very very satisfactory  U REACH KASHAMANDA PALACCE HOTEL             AND  B happy, b happy and b happy.  Enjoy the awesome beauty of MUSSORIE.

A great property which is well managed, has very good personalized service. Takes you into a different era with a narrative which is there to feel all over the place. Very helpful staff and they serve you each time with enthusiasm and smile. Many options for sit-outs during the day and the night with an option of camp fire. The steep climb to reach the property makes it that much more unique and away from the sound and noise of the Mall Road below. Their staff is always there to address this anytime.  Last but not the least ...great food

This was a last minute find for us.  Well worth the price we paid for an upgrade to the Royal suit.  The room was huge with a great view on the first floor of the old wing.  Food was great, location perfect.  It is a very good 3 star hotel, full of history.  Rooms were a bit worn out looking but we did not mind it.  The balcony's, open spaces and the lawns were great.

Excellent place to stay. Food is tasty. The staff is helpful and well mannered . The rooms are spacious , airy and good. The garden is rich with trees, flowers. Beautiful ambience, environment.  One of the best property in mussoorie

I Stayed with my Family for 2 Nights. The Rooms are Spacious,Staff were Polite and the Food was also Good. The Only Reason why I Didnt Give 5 Star is because we need to change car to reach to the hotel.
