Though they Provide free pickup and drop still it becomes difficult if you have elders and kids with you.

Staying at kasmanda palace was a unique experience in itself.the property is amazing staff courteous and food good. Kid friendly as well. The stay has motivated me to explore the options of heritage hotels anywhere I travel inthe future

We had a most comfortable stay at kasmanda palace hotel where everyone was extremely courteous and helpful. The food was delicious and the place was homely. We got lucky with the weather too. We would love to go there again and would not hesitate in recommending it to others.

Second visit within less than 3 months, awesome experience. Beautiful property, well maintained. Staff is polite courteous and helpful. Complimentary drop and pick from mall road is a great help. Every room is unique and very comfortable.

We spent  a delightful  day and night at kasmanda palace. We were quite glad with our impromptu decision to go to mussoorie to relive our childhood memories. Unfortunately we were extremely disappointed with the sad and dirty state of the mall road, with ugly new buildings, trees which had been cut and hardly any flowers. We wish all the heritage buildings in mussoorie are restored because that's what which would make it look grand and add to the nostalgia. Thankfully we stayed at The beautifully and lovingly restored Kasmanda palace, with verdant garden full of native plants and trees. This stay indeed lifted our spirits and made us feel that all is well with the world. The food was freshly prepared and delicious. The staff very courteous and warm. If we went back to mussoorie,…

I enjoyed my stay here. Rooms are spacious. Food is delicious. Staff is very cooperative. During my entire stay.. Mr. Pankaj was so helpful. Ancient property but maintained very well. Do visit it. Highly recommend.  They also offer complimentary pick and drop to Mall Road. USP of this place.. is easy to access Mall Road. Situated in the heart of city. Must visit. 👍🏻

Stayed on vacation for 1 night with a friend in Aug '19. The signage was adequate to locate the property, but the steep climb is difficult. Thankfully, the hotel arranges for pickup from a nearby location. The check in process was smooth, however the concierge refused late checkout in a quite abrupt manner.  The room was disappointing, with bare minimum amenities like toiletries & mini-bar missing. The washroom was spacious and elementary. The TV connection was terrible.  NO WIFI in the entire property, with patchy mobile network. There were frequent power cuts, didn't look like there was any kind of power backup.  Breakfast spread & taste was disappointing, and very chaotic. Basics like cutlery & tea ran out during peak rush hour, which was irritating.  All in all, NOT…

Heritage property, beautiful landscaping. The climb up to tge property by car is difficult but the hotel provides their driver. Hotel provide free pick up and drop till the mall. It's one of the best heritage property and views from the hotel is just mesmerizing. Food is good though on a bit expensive side but worth the price. Must visit. Visited this property for 2 nights stay with family.

We went as a group of 2 families in July. Though it was raining, the experience of Mussoorie and Kasmanda palace was awesome. Its a property with a lot of history behind it and has very spacious rooms with a lot of heritage attached to it. We had a valley view room and the view of Doon valley at night was spectacular with the lights sparkling like gems. The service is very good and so is the food. I've rated 1 star less because of the overzeal of the reservation staff for balance payment. We had reserved by paying 50% online, we were hounded by phone calls, Emails & whatsapp for the balance 50% as they wanted the same at the time of check in, our assurance that we'll not check out before clearing the bill (as is the practice in the hotel industry) didn't help. Sometimes overzeal…

I was looking for a heritage property to stay during my visit to Mussoorie and got to know about Kasmanda Palace. I stayed here for two days with my wife and what a pleasure it was. The hotel has a royal ambience and though very old but has ben maintained beautifully. It has large rooms, really king size and good furniture. The staff here is very polite and efficient. Hotel has a restaurant and the food is also delicious. I really look forward to visiting the hotel again.

Every staff member was observed to be with a smile all the time. Prompt service all the time. Prompt pick up from mall road and drop. Many sit out places. Cleanliness was up to the mark. Fully satisfied with the food.

I stayed from 11-14 july. I had paid 7000+ for a super delux room. we were 6 persons -3 rooms. I had to pay extra Rs.500/- per day for getting a Royal room although it was available for Rs.5300/- appx on GOibibo which I showed to the manager Mr. Rishi. But Mr.Rishi is a very amamant person.  when I asked about the Bonfire ,they first asked me to pay Rs.2000/- and later on Mr.Rishi agreed since I told him it was hotel's duty. He agreed and then started making excuses like the Log/wood is wet and then prediction of rain (Although no rain on 13th july in the venening) . Mr.Rishi should be more honest to the guests which is totally missing .He even did not agree to upgrade even one room although there were hardly 10 people on 11th July. Out of the other 2 rooms allotted one room was…

This was my second visit and the enjoyment u can hav at this hotel cannot be done at NY toh place in Mussoorie  Excellent staff and very nice food. U can simply tell them how u want the food be prepared and they will cook exactly same Best place to stay in mussorie

ROOM Kasmanda Palace is a well maintained 180 year old property. This is my second stay in a WelcomHeritage chain (the first was in Gangtok Sikkim, that was also a good property) and I am more than happy with the choice I made. We are senior citizen (67/65 years) couple, we requested a room on the ground floor so we don't have to climb stairs. They gave us a Royal Room on the ground floor, it was a large room 5Mx5M, decorated in heritage style, it has an AC with heating facility. We did use the heating often. The bed and furniture is antique style but very comfortable and functional. The toilet has modern facilities with hot and cold water and shower. The toilet is actually quite large too. The room had two large windows with awesome view of the garden and the Doon valley below.…

Kasmanda Palace is located perfectly. 1) Higher than Mall road so it is quiet and cooler. But not too far so one can always come down for stroll. ( there is car drop and pick up facility as climb is steep). 2) Well Maintained Garden gives a feeling of space and luxury. 3) Out door sitting area over looks the Doon Valley and provides great view. ( no need to go to Gun Hill) 4) Snacks and food is just right for all age groups. 5) Kids loved it.

If talk only for hotel property then it's good. But hotel does not mean only property but it essentially compete with its service, which is pathetic and unprofessional at this place. It's matter of frustration when after dinner at 7.30 PM itself in room, no body comes to collect utensils upto 10 PM. Suddenly at 11.05 PM in night our door was knocked loudly. We slept that time but woke up due to our door knocked in very unprofessional way. The door was knocked continuously . I noticed that a room service person from kitchen came with bill to take sign. Now there is nothing to say anymore. They don't respect the basic manners and professionalism of hospitality industry.

The stay was amazing. Totally worth every penny spent. The location is fabulous. It is convenient being at the Mall Road but still away from the noise as it’s in a hill. The service was prompt. The staff well spoken and courteous. Extremely good service. The view was spectacular  The food was tasty

Kasamanda palace is a one of heritage properties located in Mussoorie. It was old palace converted into hotel and has its own charm. The hotel reminds of old charm which was seen in video footage during old British raj or any old Maharaja time especially at the lobby with its wooden staircase. It is located perfectly on the mall road towards the Library End of the mall road, yet away from hustle bustle. It is on a hill from where you come down to the mall road. Hotel has car used for shuttle where they drop patrons to the mall road in just 2 mins. It is steep walk otherwise to get here so car is good service. Rooms are very spacious with all basic facilities required. Beds are excellent giving you feel of old British era and those type of beds are not seen in modern hotels so…

We spent the last couple of days at this gorgeous heritage hotel. My son kept remembering the ‘Grand Budapest Hotel’ movie because it looked so regal and pretty! While Mussoorie is overloaded with tourists, we could still enjoy the blissful calm nature and views of the mountains and Doon valley. Our room was very pretty, sparkling clean and loved every detail around the property. The restaurant serves delicious food and the hospitality s immaculate. Kasmanda also has the location advantage over other places in Mussoorie because you are within reach of everything and don’t need a vehicle to get around the town. We are certain, we are going to be staying at the Kasmanda Palace many more times in the future. We highly recommend it.

Stayed with family in May 2019. Nice and beautiful heritage property, perfect for a peaceful vacation. Courteous staff and special mention for Jasveer (6 star service) and Rahul who helped us with celebrating my little ones birthday. There is a children's play area, small badminton court, nice lawn, garden, amazing view of the Dehradun city from the deck. Not many hotels in this category would have these facilities.   it's a three star property so facilities are aligned to that. Pick and drop service to the mall road is helpful. Overall a recommended place for a peaceful stay in Mussorrie.

We had a very good experience at Kasmanda palace, Mussoorie. The palace has been converted into a hotel. The rooms are spacious with all amenities. The property is very well maintained with ample of greenery. The view from the hotel is simply mesmerizing. The food is delicious. The staff is very courteous. Overall a pleasant stay!!!

The Kasmanda Palace is an experience apart. A template for how the Heritage properties can be restored & run. The fittings in the bathroom symbolise the wonderful marriage of the modern conveniences with the heritage creation. Doors and windows shut with a click; just above the crowded Mall road yet far, far away from there...fantastic trees in the property with Cedar, Magnolia and much, much more attract all kinds of birds. Service is ever present and yet not overbearing. Wish they had fresh orange juice and fresh coffee!

It's one of the best heritage property and views from the hotel is just mesmerizing. Food is good though on a bit expensive side but worth the price. Must visit. Visited this property for 2 nights stay with family.

Had the the most amazing stay, the service & hospitality was outstanding. A Special shoutout for Shoorveer ji who made our stay even more comfortable. Would definitely come back for a leisure trip. Thanks!

We booked the garden villa during our 1 night stay in Mussoorie and it was just absolutely gorgeous! The staff is very helpful and polite. The room was very very comfortable and we really enjoyed our stay there. The valley and mountain views are beautiful from here. The garden is so pretty!! They even have a car to help you go up and down the hill because the walk can get pretty steep. It is not far from the Mall road but is also away from the hustle bustle so you can have a quiet stay. We can't wait to visit again and I would highly recommend this place to anyone who wants a peaceful (and romantic) getaway in the mountains.

The rooms had such royal feel, the service was amazing and food was outstanding , all in one we were very happy to have chosen this hotel . the view from the rooms was good. we had a bon fire night and the hotel made that evening very special for our group

Loved the warmth in the hotel. The room, the entry, the views, the garden and all of it old style - simply made our stay memorable. The car service for pickup and drop upto the base of the hill was commendable. Moreover the staff was really polite and welcoming. A must stay place in Mussoorie.

Will surely visit here again And will recommend it to others too This place is so beautiful and mesmerising The best part was its garden area It was so peaceful to sit their and feel the nature. If you are a nature lover and loves heritage artitechitecture its the perfect place for the stay

It was chilly during our visit, so we really liked the heater for sleeping.  The gardens and grounds are lovely, as is the interior of the property itself.  We also enjoyed the restaurant although the chicken breast was served undercooked.  We definitely hope to visit again!

Right in the center of town but far from the madding crowd stands the beautiful Kasmanda Palace, restored to its original opulence but featuring all modern facilities. The well manicured lawns can take on a marriage party or smaller affairs with bonfires and piped music which they provide in the evenings. The fabulous elevated sit outs provide you with an aerial view of the Doon valley and as the night sets in, you feel you are on a carpet of sparkling diamonds. If you wish to be indoors and entertained, there is a wonderful games room. As you enter, you come into an ambience of old world charm with trophies and antiquities displayed throughout the property and photographs that tell many a tale. You are amazed by the legendary politeness of the staff but believe me, they are…

Pros: Beautiful heritage property with magnificent views of the valley.  Courteous staff.  Big and spacious rooms. Close to mall road  Cons Each time one crosses mall road in your cab, you have to pay the entry fee of Rs 200. Outside vehicles are not allowed on mall road until 10pm, so either we have to walk/hire a rickshaw to reach the approach road to the hotel.  Breakfast had limited options.

We stayed here just for a day before he headed out to Landour as we wanted to explore Mussoorie. This being so close to mall rd is still away from all the chaos and madness and you can get your me time with nature.  This is a heritage property which is well maintained and we opted for the room at the heritage wing.We were pleased with the room, the facilities and most importantly the service which is top notch.  They have great viewing zones of the valley, lovely gardens and even a walking track. The complimentary breakfast was lovely . Overall we loved our stay and wish we had stayed longer. This would definitely be my choice to stay when i am visiting next . Keep up the good work guys.

Good and well maintained heritage hotel. Food Quality very good.Clean rooms.Good staffs.Just go for it. Situated in Mall Road only. Road to hotel is stiff,but the hotel provide free pickup and drop service..

A most wonderful propoerty to relax and drown one's linkage to the outside stresses. Well appointed rooms that are neat, functional & clean. Wonderful premises with a great viewing deck and many possibilities of memorable photos. A nice tea garden where one can while away the time in absolute calm. What makes Kasmanda Palace so special are the people who man the hotel. They make the place homely with their personal nature, always concerned but never intrusive, caring but never unctuous. All the trappinsg of the royal life of yore, wooden floors and stairs, hunting trophies, wildlife photos & paintaings, histories of the place and it's inhabitants. Spent time explaining to the kids the life of those times. My one wish - Really hope they can find space on the menu for a Garwhali…

This is my second time to the Kasmanda Heritage Hotel it won't be my last. This Jewel of a hotel is up in the Mountains and is indeed a heavenly place to relax and enjoy. The owners are warm and friendly, the staff and Chef are par excellence and the place is spotless with a lot of history of the Royal Family, displayed on the walls.   Thank you for the wonderful time & Best Wishes Dr. Viran Toor (Port Elgin, Ontario - Canada)

The highlight of the trip was the stay at Kasmanda Palace. The hotel has large rooms with beautiful views of the Doon valley. The ameneties are awesome: a large garden with beautiful flowers and a walking path,  a sun terrace, a cozy den and reading room, an excellent buffet breakfast, and warm and friendly service. And all at a reasonable price. However, most endearing was the warmth and hospitality of the owners, who are always on site and eager to make the stay memorable. Thank you so much!

Let me put it this way: Whenever you go to Mussoorie next, stay at the Kasmanda Palace hotel on Mall Road.  Whether you stay in the main palace building or in one of the new cottages, the experience is outstanding.  And the food is to die for!  The trip was good for many reasons including meeting old friends after many many years. But the hotel, the staff, the food, the ambience made the trip outstanding.  Fantastic hotel. Kudos to all concerned.  Naresh and Juhi Sharma

This hotel is set on a hill not too far up from the Mall Road.  Easily accessible by car.  The large variety of trees and other flora on the property make it an extremely pleasant place to spend a few days.  Service is gracious and the food excellent.  Lovely place to spend time with family...… And to top it all, the view of Dehra Dun and the entire valley from here is simply out of this world.

I would rather write a long review, because a short one probably won't make a justice to this wonderful place.  Booked this hotel for 3 night from MMT at a very reasonable price. We booked the royal rooms at the heritage wing.  The check-in was smooth. We were shown all the available rooms and we chose room number 8 on the first floor which is a corner room with a view, and thus provides much required privacy. The room has a huge sitting area, and a pretty decent bedroom. The sitting area and the bedroom both have lovely wooden furniture and a wooden king bed which blends perfectly with the heritage ambience of the hotel.  The bathroom was clean, toiletries provided was top notch, and the towels and linens are extremely clean. So all the basics are pretty well covered.  Now the…

This property is located on mall road or rather 500m above it. The trek is steep and Hotel provides their Car to pick/drop you right on the mall road. The hotel has beautiful wooden interiors, is quiet and has beautiful views. The staff here is welcoming, they stand up to greet you everytime you pass by. The only downside I can think of this hotel was FOOD. Pricing was reasonable but the taste wasn't consistent. The rice and dal changed flavors with the day. We fell in love with their Dal Tadka the first day but was bland the next day, same goes for their Fried Rice.  To sum up, their breakfast spread is the best, afternoon lunch is decent and evening dinner were spoilers. Avoid eating dinner at the hotel is all I can say, may the staff is in hurry to leave for their home at…

We had a very comfortable stay at Kasmanda.A heritage property with beautiful & well maintained Garden area with a good view of Mussoorie.A very friendly & hospitable staff.Rooms are very well maintained with antique look.It was pleasant to stay here.

Barring the location, there is nothing good about the property... The service is terrible....they need reminders or else they forget... I never actually got the wi-fi password, first day i was told they will share it in half an hour's time, no one actually bothered to call back, i checked in the evening, i was told its not working.  the same thing happened for water/Towels/Toiletries. they need to be reminded, They simply dont have the courtesy to call back and say if the service is delayed...  Coming to the restaurant- Breakfast Buffet(Hardly a buffet)- The fruit that was spread-bananas, were in such a terrible shape(both the days)-i had to ask the waiter to get me fresh ones-Came the "curt" response- :" thats how its available in the market" , on being adamant i got them fresh…

The staff is very courteous and took good care of us. The property is very well maintained. Also the property has many stories to offer as it was a palace earlier. The property itself is situated stone throw distance from Library Chowk , but at a good height hence offering a lot of peace from the hustle bustle of the market.  They have certain rules around serving food in the room. But its okay. They serve a few things.

Superb location, hospitable staff,sumptuous food, & awesome ambience by the rare artifacts from the yester years.  Recommend all to stay here if you are in Mussourie. It's located on the Mall Road so shopping areas are accessible along with other needs you might have.

well staying at kasmanda is surely an experience in itself...nice views of the valley...even though the trek to the hotel is a bit tiring....British era architecture...big rooms ...certainly a very nice feel....on the mall road yet away from all the hustle...

The Heritage Property is an excellent place to stay not one but for many reasons like  - Location, Close Proximity to Mall Road  Peaceful Though Located on Mall road still away from Hustle and Bustle of Mall Road  - Serene View- The place has an excellent view of Hills from Balcony and Sitting area and from rooms  - Food- Large Buffet Options in Breakfast with Good Taste  - Service- Service & Warmth of Staff is very good especially they are trained and Patient to handle Large Number of people . Everything was well organised with our rooms promptly available as soon as we reach the Property  We stayed there for our Team Event and it was a great Event and thanks for the Management and Staff for making it a Successful Event.  I will soon be making a plan to have a Personal Visit…

Luxury and beautiful decorated room, giving the feeling of staying in some Maharaja bedroom. The interior decoration in the corridor, walls etc. give the feeling as if you are a guest of some Royal family. Outside garden and lawns are very well maintained. Two decks with relaxing chairs provide a beautiful view of the city. You can enjoy the cloud bath by sitting over there. Overall ambience is very soothing and enjoyable.

Kasamanda Palace is a great alternative to mainstream hotels. With only 29 comfortable and spacious rooms, it is a truly intimate experience. The food is very good and the staff cannot do enough for you. The property is located at the top of a rather steep rise, however they provide a car and driver to collect you from the Mall Rd. This is a good location. They only serve beer however you are welcome to bring other alcohol which you can consume in your room, on the terrace or in the garden. Do be aware that commercial vehicles such as taxis and tourist cars are not permitted on Mall Rd so you will need to walk or get a rickshaw from Library Chowk. It's not far but if you have luggage there are porters available.

Good hotel. Location is excellent. Just at the starting of mall road. But while going to hotel better to ask hotel drivers to take your car to hotel as there is steep slope. Hotel provides you free car pick and drop from hotel to mall road. Rooms are spacious but lack few basic amenities like fridge, hair dryer, etc. Garden area is also big and very well maintained. Overall good experience.

One of the best hotels for family visits. They have a well maintained lawn and tea garden and two observation decks which provide better view of Doon valley than the mall road itself. There is a small play area for kids as well. Staff  is courteous and efficient and they do everything to make your stay pleasent and comfortable. Rooms themselves are okay for the budget and there is nothing really to complain about. The location is also good. Mall road is quickly accessible and at the same time you are cut off from the din and noise of the mall. The only downside - its on the mall road and your taxi will not go upto the hotel. They will drop you at the taxi stand and from there you have to get to the point where the hotel cab will pick u.

I have enjoyed a lot and would love to visit again to the property, would recommend any one who is going to spend summer or any vacation in mussorrie, please book your stay in Kasmanda Palace. It has a great location to offer for you.

Beautiful heritage place to stay, big lawn and beautifully maintained also. Got it at good deal through online. Stayed 3 days, felt awesome being there, though it situated little high but up down service is provided by themselves. Great Choice.

Beautiful property with great views. service is excellent Have stayed at the hotel twice, i would recommend it to everyone.  The only downside is they dont serve meals(they serve starters)in the rooms.

This sized property is rare to find in Mussoorie and gives a heritage feeling indeed. We were 5 people & took 2 Royal Suites & 1 Superior Room for one night stay on 8th June 2018. The view from the open area is indeed a delight & a well maintained small garden with some swings for the children are well appreciated. Rooms were quite big & respectably clean but lacks the WOW factor.  However, the Service provided is quite disappointing. The person in the reception was quite rude in talking when enquired about the location & parking at the property over phone. Secondly, I requested for drinking water in the morning at around 5.30 am since the water in the jug seemed contaminated, the person in the reception confirmed ok first. After about 10 minutes received the call that the…

I stayed in superior room from 4th to 6th june and 2 bed room suit from 6th to 8th. This heritage property is worth every penny paid.well maintained interiors The only thing needs little inprovement is breakfast and efficiency of cooks Food is very basic but good

1 . They dont provide room service for food or drinks. 2. If you ask anything from staff they say NO to you. 3. Sharp 12 o clock , i have received 10 calls for check out which is really rude.  4. This property is only for retired people, definitely not for couples, families, friends.  Over all experience this time was worse.

I visited Kasmanda Palace hotel in June of 2018.  This 'palace' converted to a hotel is located about 200 meters above the Mussoorie mall road and the climb to the hotel is heavy for the heart and the engine.   The hotel itself is very nice and occupies nearly 3 acres of space in otherwise cramped Mussorie. The hotel has a large garden with some swings, a massive balcony overlooking the Doon valley and plenty of beautiful flowers in the 'English Tea Garden'.  We stayed in the superior rooms in the new wing (I was wary of the upkeep of heritage rooms). The room was large, with a 2 seater sofa, chair, desk, a king sized bed. The room was clean enough and modern. The 'garden view' was not really much to talk about (the rooms in the old wing have great views of the valley).  …

Pros: 1. Awesome property.. replete with stories of the royal lifestyle 2. Close to Mall road yet away from the hustle bustle 3. Courteous staff.. tries its best to fulfill all your needs  Cons 1. Management scrounges at small things like toiletries etc.. we asked for shampoo, were turned down, didn't find dental kit etc 2. Upkeep: Heritage need not mean worn down. Furniture/Bathrooms need major upgrades. At these prices we don't need to see mould, dirty carpets and stained floors. 3. Penny wise pound foolish attitude: Towels are not the cleanest. Kettle needed to be washed thoroughly. Tea/coffee did not have any variety. I don't think these things cost much but have become hygiene stuff these days 4. Service: While the staff tries to do their best, the mgmt seems to have weird…

We stayed at the Kasmanda Palace from 27th May to 1st June. Right from the time we checked in or rather were picked up to be transported to the hotel the staff right from the car driver to the reception were excellent. The place is BEAUTIFUL to say the least and wish we had more words To describe the serenity of the place. Beautiful rooms. Amazing location. Very cordial staff and fabulous service at the hotel. Apart from the location and the amenities the staff at Kasmanda Palace is the best we have come across compared to even our international trips. They make you feel at home and treat you as a family member. The smiles of the faces of the staff as well as their readiness to help even on the smallest of small matters makes this place simply the best to stay in Mussorie.

it’s beautiful property that I really liked ind pics but I found it very OVERRATED.. i came here attracted by the name palace, welcome heritage bt the rooms i got here have no heritage/palace look or nything though d condition of d same is nice.. the exteriors n d gardens are worth spending evenings alone amidst nature bt if u have kids u will b upset to see d condition of the outdoor play area.. I also didn’t understand why d taxes here are 18% wen all over india it has been reduced to 5% over food bills.. d night duty staff jishant and jasbir also i would like to mention here were very uncooperative wen were asked for an extra quilt.. on being clearly specified that i don’t share my quilts was retorted by saying dat in case of extra quilt u have to pay 2000 rs d same as an…

It was my trip after 35 years to Mussoorie . By a stroke of luck I remembered Kasmanda Palace as some friends had managed a musical event there years ago.  It was a discovery that will get us back again and again to Mussoorie.  It is one of the best boutique heritage properties I have been to , maintained with a passion for history , grace , beauty , intelligence .  The staff is warm and welcoming , they customize food for you whether it's in the menu or not .  The gardens , the sit outs , the night lighting are all delightful.  The owners keep a close eye and it shows .

Fabulous quiet serene surroundings is what greets one at the fabulous Kasmanda Palace, Mussourie.  Fresh air blowing across and fresh and friendly staff greeting you always, and doing just about anything to make your stay memorable.  Magnolia, the dining restaurant, looks a picture and serves out some of the best dishes you would get to enjoy in the hills. Particularly don't miss out the chocolate icecream pudding. The Chef seems to have changed since the last time I visited 3 yrs back but the food is still impeccable.  The breakfast spread though can do even better with some more variety. The rooms in the old heritage wing are just supreme, grand, spacious and still carry the old world charm.  The foyer/lobby area is laced with a lot of history about the Kasmanda Lodge…

This was my second stay at the hotel 8 years after my previous stay and the charm of the hotel is intact.  The location is just perfect as the hotel is on the Mall road. The view from the hotel is perfect.  The staff is always smiling and ready to help. The hotel and its gardens are well maintained.

Really well kept heritage property. They have nicely preserved a lot of the history related to the place. Gardens, terraces etc. are really well kept. The Room Service and the Restaurant staff are excellent and they pamper you. 5 stars to that. However, Front desk doesnt seem to be as pleasing as you would expect from the brand of Welcome group. Apparently, for any request that you may have which is out of the blue, they do not seem to have the authority to take decisions on that. The owner here calls the shot. I thought this was entirely run by Welcome Heritage, but apparently, the owner of the property resides here and calls the shots. I did pay for the basic room and hence expecting for a free upgrade was not really being fair to them. However, i generally end up getting it…

The main reason to chose the place i must confess was the desk service, all the information on phone was prompt and special mention goes to Mr Sumit! the new garden view rooms were srisp and clean. The breakfast was a treat sitting on the deck in sunny winter morning. The view is loely and location convenient!

The suite we were in was pretty spacious. Please change the curtains though. It is very useful that they have a mix/drop service at the beginning of the upward hike to the hotel but the scenic view make sit worth your while. Breakfast should be improved.

We stayed at Kasmanda Palace hotel for a long weekend and loved every bit of our stay. The property is superb and very well managed. Staff is courteous and eager to help. Special thanks to the chef for churning out awesome food. Our kids loved playing in your sprawling lawns.. would love to visit again as it can't be better than this!

Nice hotel situated on the mall road close to the Library end. Its a short but steep hike up from the Mall Road. Hotel has deputed a Wagon R for ferrying the passengers up & down (Salute to the guy who does this monotonous job dozens of time in the day). The location is just great, so close to the mall yet so away from all the hustle bustle.  We stayed in Royal Room #11 in the heritage section, it reminded me of the forest Rest house that I have stayed in on many occasions. The room and furniture were heritage but the Bathroom was modern (in case you are worried). There is newly built modern wing too.  Property has very good lawns (Good to pass time in winter sun) and a very nice Sunset/Sunrise observation deck where British Royalty once took tea. There is a reading room…

GOOD LOCATION Heritage hotel Nice vegetarian food Cooks Waiters are cooperative  Nice Car service And finally nice view, people are in uniform . Working looks professional looks Market is close by. Mall is on walking distance

Visite Kasmanda Palace for this new year with family and friends. The place is peaceful, well maintained accompanied by great and helpful staff to make your stay comfortable. There was a well organized new year party which was enjoyed. Certainly a place to look at when you plan a trip to Mussorie.

Great property, calm and peaceful, great service, Stayed in 2 bedroom villa. amazing view. Thanks to Mr. Sumit ( the manager ), he and the whole staff are so good in taking care. Just below mall road but completely away from the hustle bustle too.

I stayed for 3 nights in the week before Christmas, a solo traveler in search of solitude. I had a really good time, and would love to go back again soon. The room was large and comfortable, the grounds really well maintained, the food and service excellent - and the view from the Observation Deck quite breath-taking.   Since my primary requirement was a quiet place, I was really happy with my experience. There are many areas within the hotel grounds where one can relax undisturbed with a book or just one's thoughts.   I stayed in the newer section and was fairly satisfied with my room. My only grouse would be that the bathroom facilities could be better. The heritage section looked more interesting though I didn't get a peek into any of the rooms.  The service was excellent and…

This hotel is awesome heritage property very good maintained with excellent services on the high top of mall road mussoorie,fresh air ,sunrise and sunset view from hotel room is mesmerizing,once you will stay here will always want to stay here whenever one will visit mussorie!!!

We stayed in Kasmanda Palace in the second week of December for our anniversary. It is a good place to stay with a bit of a royal feel to it. Rooms should be maintained in a better way in terms of upholstery and for it to be called a 3 to 5 star category room.  Food was upto the mark as per ITC Standards.  Breathtaking view of the Valley in the morning with some great service during breakfast. Will definitely like to return to this hotel.

The place is not worth the money. In the name of heritage, they are providing untidy room with old carpets. In my view, this place is not worth the high prices they charge. We were travelling in groups, so could move to another shared villa.

Stayed for 2 days in the property, Its Lavish and the location is very soothing. Rooms are spacious, well equipped and the service is great.  Property is royal and has lawns, gardens and a dining area as well. Food is fabulous too.  Reaching the hotel from Mall road is a tough task for elderly persons so it is suggested that if you are not travelling with your own vehicle then please request the hotel to provide pick and drop (they provide it)

If you want to have the ancient royal lifestyle feeling Kasmanda Palace is the best hotel to be in. Its best USP is the valley view point and specially in the night with lights glittering all around. The garden area is huge which is very limited in hilly areas. The overall ambience of the hotel was soothing. The food was excellent and added the pleasure to our stay. All in all a good location and place to relax with family, friends or team outing.

The rooms are spacious and nicely done though. The interiors of the hotel transport you back to 1950's. The best part is the open space which has lovely view of the valley and is a great place to idle around.

Great views, cooperative staff, well maintained green exteriors, widespread open area for kids to play.However, hotel needs renovation for its rooms, not sure for all but can comment about royal rooms, didnt meet the expectations. Bathrooms need serious repair! Finally shifted to a villa which had the modern amenities and was clean unlike royal rooms. Average food and views from the property are breathtaking.

This property has many thing others don't have.... Superb views , great staff , well maintained exteriors, heritage look & feel, widespread open area .  However , like all true gems this hotel needs a new shine & polish for its rooms. Whilst a heritage look is a great draw , the furniture & room decor needs to be upgraded for the hotel to be truly exclusive & SUPERB.  We spent 3 wonderful days here & enjoyed the breathtaking views from its rooms & open terraces. The breakfast spread is excellent....the crockery in the dining area needs a fresh look & maybe a change.All the staff is absolutely outstanding.  In my opinion , it's a great hotel but needs a extensive shine to be even better.

It’s a nice stay at kasmanda palace. I went to mussoorie with my family on holidays. There we stayed at welcomheritage property. I liked their hospitality. Food there was awesome. They have very supportive staff.

Must visit if wants to stay in royal property with small budget. Staff was very nice, property is very clean the view from garden just Awesome. Only the concern is the property is quite above from main market but the good part is hotel will offers free pick and drop from market.
great hotel to stay if you are in mussoorie. views of mussoorie from here was just awesome and garden was great. must visit if you are planning to mussoorie

A reallly comfortable heritage hotel with enthusiastic, helpful staff and wonderful gardens. Stayed half board and all the food was very good. Brought us tea on the terrace watching the view when we arrived and lit a bonfire in the garden in the evening. Huge well furnished room but there were a few minor things which needed attention, but these have probably been sorted out as we completed the feeedback form in the room. The history of the building and the family who lived there is tastefully presented through framed family photos.

The hotel is definitely one of a kind, which a charming atmosphere and very luxurious decor, both in the common areas and rooms. The rooms are very spacious, beautifully decorated and clean, many offering great views too. The terrace has even better views, plus there's beautiful gardens to enjoy your breakfast in. The food was very good and so was the service. There's a pretty impressive lounge area, but note that alcohol is not served at the venue. There's wifi in the common area, but not in the rooms. The walk up from the main street is rather short, but super steep. Would happily stay again.

Kasmanda is a gorgeous, quiet and relaxing hotel despite its close proximity to Mall Rd. We spent two wonderful nights here over my birthday and had a fabulous time - the staff are extremely courteous and they really care about looking after guests.   The house has an amazing history and it really helps you to understand Mussoorie as a tourist, particularly its royal past.   The view from the terrace is stunning and I highly recommend an afternoon tea here even if you don’t stay.   The breakfast is also great and the dinner menu has a wide variety of dishes to suit all.   All in all I would highly recommend a stay, a meal or even just a tour of this beautiful place.

Nice neat and clean room and facilities. All food were amazing and they serve everything on time.  This hotel really has a very nice view. I will strongly recommend this hotel for vacation with family.

A lot of the hotels in Mussoorie looked somewhat shabby compared to the photos on booking sites, but not Kasmanda Palace, it is beautifully maintained. We had one of the rooms overlooking the gardens and it was clean and spacious - the staff were helpful and friendly. As decadent westerners, the only improvement would have been a bar offering warming drinks, particularly as the weather can be cool and damp.

We found the hotel well-situated, right above the Mall Road. There is considerable climb to the hotel, but transport facility is available, because of which it is in an ideal location- close to the central area of the city and yet peaceful and quite. The staff was very graceful and cooperative. The room service was efficient and the food in general good quality. We had a room on the first floor with an excellent view. One of the most exciting features of the hotel were the multi-level terraces and a large English tea garden.  Internet accessibility was a problem. However, we could manage through or mobile hotspot activation.  In general, I would recommend the hotel for couples and for families.

Well yes, you read it right! Kasmanda Palace is a place which is not only inhabited by the royals, but they also treat their guests like we are their esteemed  guests.  The palace is not exactly on the  mall road but a serpents road leads up to the palace. The hotel is generous enough to provide a pick and drop service from and till the mall road.   The palace is like just another regal home with nothing much flashy or ornate but a softly coloured building with darkwood decor. One side of he hotel consists of lawns and a pool where mainly bonfire is organised. The extreme end is a nicely built terrace giving the city view.  There is one attic room which consist of old pictures and all the vintage furniture and artefacts.   Coming to the restaurant, they surprisingly serve the…

The hotel is very beautiful and nicely kept. Room view was marvel and spacious. The room was clean and hygienic. Food was also excellent and well served by restaurant staff. My family has enjoyed staying in the hotel. We were having trouble booking our day out but reception staff was kind enough to guide us well. Cheers to itc for maintaining the best service as usual. The true example to responsible luxury. Will visit soon

Staff is very friendly. Property is nice Car facility from hotel to mall road is prompt. Need little more focus on cleanness as room are quite big cleaning is important TV size should be very big as compared to room

Welcomheritage kasmanda palace is nice hotel to stay. They give best of the hospitality. I like my stay over their very much. Moreover food there is very delicious. I will recommend this place to all my friends.

The hotel is excellent place for ideal family vacation. Staff is very friendly and hospitality is just great. Overall experience is just great. Spacious beat rooms with great view. Recommended to anyone and everyone who wants to relax and enjoy.

I stayed in this hotel last week with my wife for couple of days. Staff was extremely courteous & available on instant calling. Surroundings & ambience are lovely. Special thanks to WagonR driver for being available 24*7. However one suggestion - please have wi-fi in all rooms. Other than that it was perfect, looking forward to be come again.

Booked royale room days in advance for husband, wife and child. Drove all the way from Delhi to be told by arrogant manager that you have take twin bed room instead of a king bed and extra bed as he has already given another room to a walk in customer. His exact words were 'Take it or leave it'. Had paid a premium for this holiday booking but he and ITC has forced husband and wife to take separate beds. Senseless, inhospitable tourism, blot on Atithi Devo Bhava. Guess we Indians are more accommodating to white skin and treat fellow Indians as second class in their own country. Never again in any ITC property.

It’s a nice place to stay, Last summer I went to mussoorie to enjoy my holidays with my friends. We stayed at WH Kasmanda Palace. We had lots of fun and enjoyed my stay there. We like their hospitality very much. Food there was delicious. It’s a best hotel to stay while in mussoorie. It was a memorable trip we can’t forget.

We stayed at Kasmanda Palace in last week of June 2017. It was last week for school vacation & it was enormous traffic enroute to Mussoorie. As property is on Mall Road, it was exhaustion exercise to reach it. When we reached at Kasmanda, we forgot the exhaustion we had & went in to the calm which property offers. this was our second trip to Kasmanda & property has improved for good. We had booked 5 rooms as we are travelling with five families. Views are really good from property & you can see whole Dehradoon valley from there. We had breakfast & dinner, buffet was tasty & suited for Indian tastes. As property is top of the hill, maneuvering your own vehicle can be tricky, better use property drivers to handle. Rooms bed can be improved but as property is heritage there is…

The royal room in the heritage wing with the garden view and Mussoorie view was a great stay. Located on an uphill mound that is interestingly difficult to climb, a good mini adventure each time you go to the Mall road and come back, the location is brilliantly kept away from the chaotic crowd and the messy garbage seen all around Mussoorie, espeically Mall road. The hotel is serene, calm, and enjoyable with its lawn gardens behind, the wooden stairways to the first floor, great display of heritage articles all along the corridors and inside the rooms as well. Excellent stay!

This is a heritage property maintained tastefully. Initially it was a church, then converted to a school and now private property of a royal family.        The staff was very helpful.   Food was real good and up to 5 star standards.  We stayed there during November and hope to stay there again. Good value for money.

Guys great job done by you and your staff.One thing you guys try and treat a 50 rooms guest in a 9 table dining area in a two hours time which seems a bit not viable other than upsetting a few.we unfortunately happen to be one .please shift the breakfast to a larger area.thanx

This is a truly heritage property converted to 29 hotel rooms. Located on Mall Road it's very scenic with great views of the valley. Very comfortable stay and courteous staff, great service.  Highly recommended for family.

I had a nice stay at Kasmanda palace. I went to mussoorie with my friends, to get refresh from our daily routine. We stayed there at welcomheritage property. We stayed there for two days. I liked their hospitality very much. They provided us cab service. Rooms there were neat and clean. Hotel staff is very supportive. Last but not the least they provided awesome food, Food here is delicious. I would like to recommend this hotel to all of my friends.

Beautiful property, scenic view, great service, tasty food. Enjoyed staying in their royal suite. Loved our stay there. Excellent location. Child friendly. If you want a royal stay in mussorie, this heritage property is highly recommended.

Hotel kasmanda Palace is most beautiful place in Mussoorie at walking distance to mall Road. Staff is great, I enjoyed my trip to mussoorie, specially my two years old daughter. They have beautiful garden and best views... And an area for kids.. Specious room. We stayed in Royal room which was really specious.Book your taxis from outside at library Chauk which is at walking distance.  Again a great Hotel...and heritage  building built in 1836.

It's a beautiful property well placed please ignore staff not very friendly and supportive   Overall experience was good due to vintage ambiance of the property and the staff can be ignored just enjoy the property

We booked the property for three nights in June, and although monsoons came early this year, we didn't regret our trip to Mussoorie because of the lovely stay.  The rooms are tastefully decorated and are very clean. The place is situated right at the mall and yet a ramp keeps it slightly secluded so one can also enjoy the quiet solace. The view is spectacular, you can see the sparkling Dehradoon lights in the night sky.   I have to mention the staff, who were kind enough to remind us when we forgot to get breakfast, and arranged everything else timely. They are polite and very sweet.  This was my 18th trip to Mussoorie, yes it was my family's favourite summer vacation spot, so you can imagine I would recommend the best. It's become my first choice now, and I hope the staff and…

Location was very well.... Nice & clean property...   Perfect location for Family with Kids near mall road........  Ample space for car parking and quiet place. Shuttle service to & fro for mall road is an icing on the cake  Minor teething issue which is ok

Property : This is a 186 year old property but which  maintained very well. Tiger, leopard, bear, deer skins etc adorn the walls throughout the property. One can see rare and vintage pictures of Doon Valley, Mussoorie and nearby areas. Lots of antiques, curios are displayed in most rooms.  There is a old wing and a recently opened (April 2017) new wing as well. The new wing has a lawn , patio and a short walking track, but is accessible to all guests.   They have a cosy Belvedere Lounge for reading. Meals can be had at the terraces which have valley view. Buffet service is not available at the terrace though.  Rooms :  We got Room no 4 on the ground floor near the restaurant. We were fearing noise ,but it was nothing so much to disturb anyone's sleep or quiet. One can get a…

I stayed in the Hotel for 4 nights in June. Great Location and Mesmerising view of the Doon Valley at Night. We opted for the Heritage wing and 175+ years of heritage preserved in a very nice manner. Rooms were Good and the breakfast and dinner were great in taste and the spread was good. Very helpful and cooperative staff. The pick up and drop to the Mall road is very convenient.

Heritage property. You will love to be near to nature.  Wonderful fish :) and overall decent food. Very caring staff and prompt service.  Enough parking space however to get car to their hotel is a task in itself :) as it's pretty steep to drive.

our sole aim was to find a place where we can relax and chill far away from hustle bustle of the City. Thats where we chose Welcome Heritage Kasmanda Palace for part of our vacations.  And our decision was 110% right. Right from booking to check-in to rooms to food to service to fun.... everything was just perfect.  I stayed from 27th May - 29th May the room i booked 2 SUPERIOR ROOMS.Size of the rooms was big, I was their with my family so with superior rooms we got one common room as well and that was with balcony and that was AMAZING looks like a big 2 bhk flat.  This property is situated on the top of the hill with excellent view of doon valley , Kasmanda palace is situated on mall road but far from crowd, road towards hotel is steep with a walking distance of 3-5 minutes,…

It's an awesome property to stay in mussoorie. I like their services and hospitality. I like this property very much. Thank you for making my trip awesome. will recommend them to all. highly recommended.

We stayed at the property for 4 nights. The hotel is well maintained and have set of beautiful lawns and terraces for you to enjoy your stay and the scenic beauty. The best part is easy access from mall road and  being perched on top of hill can cut you from the chaos when you want to. Hotel provides for free shuttle from morning to 10:30 pm to mall road. The staff is excellent and always around to take care of you. Their own restaurant Magnolia has a good menu and we tried most of the nonveg delicacies. The Indian ones were excellent. Pankaj from their staff, took special care of ours. The rooms have minimalistic furniture and decor..a little bit of styling can help. Bathrooms are clean and can be stylized. There is good parking space.. the children's play area and Belvedere…

The rooms, especially furniture, doors and sanitary fittings badly need maintenance. There was unbearable noise till late in the night. We'd booked a superior room in this property primarily for serenity and peace but the experience was just the opposite.

Wonderful stay at  Kasmanda Palace. It is a cozy hotel with large and beautiful garden area and lovely valley view of Mussoorie. Open dining restaurant adds beauty to it. Location is superb (near to Mall road) yet away from crowd. The free cab facility allows you to visit mall road any time of the day. My daughter loved the Kids play area. I would say a complete family hotel with all facilities for a AWESOME stay. Yummy breakfast buffet wont leave you empty stomach. All staff members were too welcoming and helpful.

Only hotel with palace surroundings of lawn and garden, large rooms and bathrooms,well equipped and with excellent food and services.Also away and silent from the maddening crowd! Easy transport to the mall and back Would recommend it anyday!

Kasmanda Palace is a nice heritage property, just opposite Ritz Cinema on Mall road. Entry road to property is challenging as the road leading to property is very steep. Hotel has parked a vehicle with driver to assist guests at the beginning of that steep road. Please take assistance of driver in taking the vehicle to hotel. Hotel is in a more than 100 year old heritage property and situated on a hillock, so you get a splendid view of Doon valley and Mussoorie. It has beautifully planned sitting areas and well maintained lawns. Food in restaurant was delicious and they served phulkas, which was an added advantage. Staff is courteous and helpful. There is enough parking space inside property. We were in a group of 12 people and visited on 21st and 22nd May 2017. We had booked 5…

this is the best place to stay as it is in main town and little away from the crowd and you are on the top of mussoorie mall road and enjoy the scenic views from all around the property it has good child play area terrace and well decorated entrance  with antiques. rooms are very big in size and well maintained the helpful staff always eager to help you food is too good in taste and well variety. moreover they have pick and drop service to you mall road on whole day at free

Very Nice Hotel along with best view of valley from garden, very Familiar Staff, Good Service only to improve quality of food mostly buffet breakfast.  Note: If going with own vehicle then driver must have good driving skills because hotel is quite above from Mall road.

Large room and nice staff; I had a wonderful time here! I enjoyed it very much! ; Thanks for the beautiful memories . Value for money . Overall I will rate this hotel very good. The Ideal Hotel at the Best Price.

The palace is beautiful and very well maintained.It is away from hustle bustle of the mall road, extremely serene and calm.The staff is very courteous and prompt in service.They offer sumptuous breakfast and dinner. Belvedre lounge is a quiet place to read.

This has to be the best place I have ever stayed in not just because of the standard of the rooms etc but because of the welcome and care showed by the hotel staff.  If I ever go to Mussoorie again, I will definitely place myself to the Heritage Kasmanda Palace!

I had an amazing stay at Kasmanda Palace on my very first trip to Mussoorie. Just loved the ambience, it takes one away from the hustle and bustle of daily life. The scenic beauty in around this place offers a lot to explore.

We visited Kasmanda Palace and had booked eight rooms for 5 nights each. Entire 4 generations of the Thariani family stayed here and had a comfortable, enjoyable and royal stay at the palace. The staff was very accommodating and was available at our beck and call round the clock. They made special arrangements for the elderly and infants. Complimentary bonfire night was provided for the entire family to enjoy. Great place! Will definitely visit again!

I stayed in Kasmanda from Apr 10th to 13th. Great place to stay ! Very satisfied.. I am very choosy when it comes to stay and this was 1st time staying with kasmanda and it lived to my expectations! Please don't expect luxury 5 star property. It's  a palace converted to Hotel! Everything is ethnic and royal !   Room choice : Take room on the 1st floor if you want good view! It's royal rooms and little expensive but for people money is no issue go for Royal ones. Other 2 categories are Deluxe and Superior. Deluxe with no view and superior with OK OK view.

If you're looking for some time out away from the hectic city madnessthen visit kasmanda palace. It's a beautiful and interesting hotel which was built by some captain? and is with royal family from decades now converted into hotel. It is tastefully and luxuriously furnished by the owners with art work and furniture of that period   The hospitality of the hotel is very good and I would recommend all my friends to stay here and would certainly stay here on my future Mussoorie trips

This wasnt our first trip to mussorie... been there a dozen times now. We chose kasmanda palace for our stay this time on the new years eve.  If u are a history lover the place has lot to offer. There is peace ..lay back under the sun n enjoy the rich book collection they have . They have made an effort to keep the interiors. Staff was quick to respond. Since the hotel is at heights we preferred not to take our car down each time. There is a hotel cab readily available for that. My only hitch are with the rooms. We stayed in the most prime rooms of the hotel.  Rooms are huge no doubt butcould have been made more cosy. The furniture seems to be just accomdated in the rooms ..without justifying its use.  The drain in bathroom used to get clogged.  Hotel staff 👍🏼 Food 👍🏼 (…

First of all property is very nice.ancient building welcomes you with many antiques and hunted animal figures.food was satisfactory not much can be expected at hills but still was good.rooms were big and provided air conditioning im winters too.terrace gardens provides excellent view of the doon valley perfect for morning tea and breakfast. The only problem faced was driving up to the hotel as its situated right on the top.but hotel staff was very courteous to help us by sending their driver to drive our car.and hotel provides free car service to and fro mall road. Overall nice experience
If you like Heritage Properties then i would recommend this hotel to you. Reasonable and good and a must stay place when you are in Mussoorie. The Food also is very good.

To start of the service is horrible,especially the reception staff. Very cold and indifferent. There is nothing called service. The restaurant staff is cordial though. Rooms are average. Nothing to talk about accept a good location

It's a heritage hotel built in 1800 but the upkeep of the hotel has not been kept well. we booked a superior room for two night's. Initially we were allotted a room in the new building which was not at comfortable and next day we were provided a room in the Heritage building on first floor with valley view, however the furniture in both the rooms,Walls, flooring needs IMMEDIATE RENOVATION as it is in bad shape, hope the owners are reading reviews and will invest in the property upkeep rather making bucks by selling the word HERITAGE.  Also, the hotel is not professionally managed with Reception guy not able to handle visitor queries and their service standards. You can't get dinner after 10:00 PM. Food was OK with fixed ala carte option. It was only after we checked with Manager…

The hotel was excellent.  The fact that it was old did not at all detract from the visit, it enhanced the visit.  I had sprained my ankle and the staff was willing to change my room to a ground floor room but I wanted to stay slightly mobile and opted for the second floor room that I had reserved.  The service was top notch, the food was excellent, the view was extraordinary.  The only draw back was not the hotels fault, it was demonetization.  Even with the problems with procuring rupees the trip was unforgettable as was this hotel. I would relish the opportunity to return.

Kasmanda Palace is a true heritage property located in heart of The Mall road in Mussourie with good,  spacious and well maintained rooms. The staff is very courteous and there is pick and drop facility available from 8am to 10 pm from Mall road. There is also a badminton court and beautiful terrace. Good for stay with family. Go for package deal which includes bed and breakfast.

This property is absolutely magnifiicent witn stunning views of the valley.I really like the heritage layout of the vast property.The most memorable part is having the breakfast at the higher deck area from where u can get the 180 degree view of valley.Now coming to shortcomings.i really didnt like the dinner which was tasteless and bland they need huge improvement on that,Although the breakfast was excellent.There is also a inconsistency in the view u get from the same category room although My room was changed next day which have far better views than the first one.Reception staff was excellent and pick up and drop services from mall road was prompt and complimentary

A heritage property refurbished to a hotel,  car parking is very difficult over here,  royal room is good and expensive too.  In the heart of mall Road mussorie. Most importantly mall Road entrance is closed from evening 4-10, this should be mentioned on all searches or T&C of hotel as it's situated on mall Road.

Kasmanda Palace is a heritage property right at the mall road, less than a KM from library chowk. I believe the property was constructed in 18th Century and you can see the old world feel to it still. I am being generous in giving a rating of 4 as 3.5 is not an option and 3 would have been harsh considering the service provided by the staff members. I would expect a bit more focus towards maintenance from a property aiming to be a premium stay option in the town. Few points to note for fellow travellers:   Bar: There is no bar at the property as mentioned in trip advisor profile of the hotel. In case you plan to drink please bring your own liquor which they allow.  Wifi: There is no Wi-fi in the rooms. You can use the same at the reception or restaurant (Magnolia) i believe. …

We stayed at this hotel for two days in November 2016. It's indeed a hidden jewel of Mussoorie as claimed by hotel's management.  The location of this hotel is excellent...right on Mall road. It is at a height with very steep climb, but that shouldn't be a concern because the pick up facility provided by the hotel is very professionally managed. The staff is very courteous and always helpful. The rooms are decorated in royal style and well maintained. You certainly get value for your money.

Its rare to find a hotel in a touristy location like this, which gives you lot of space. This heritage hotel called Kasmanda palace was constructed in 1838!!. Used as a residence by the British , then as a school and then as a hospital for invalid soldiers of Crimean war of 1856, it was purchased by the raja of kasmanda. Panthers, Tigers, bisons, rhino etc shot by the Rajas and nawab's decorate the walls. old heritage vehicles- hand rickshaw made in France etc give a glimpse of the india that was and the role of the British in building a part of it.                        This place has fantastic view of the valley, has great sit out area, Bon fire area, British style garden breakfast area....   small space for your children to play while badminton court for the adults. However…

I was supposed to visit Welcome Heritage in Sep but due to illness I was not able to go. So  I requested for date change which hotel accepted. However I was still unable to walk, so again I humbly requested for date change and I was asked by hotel to send an email with the medical documents. I did what they asked me to do so with a hope that they would entertain my request. But to my surprise my request was outrightly rejected by the Hotel. I was not expecting this kind of behaviour from such a reputed Hotel Chain.

This hotel gives you a quiet and comfortable feeling of luxury amidst the vintage furniture and decor. There's quite a lot of history to this property dating back to 1836.   We stayed in the Superior Room # 1 end November 2016 and it was cozy, clean and with all amenities like a tea/coffee maker with ample sachets, ac-heater system, LED TV and a modern looking clean washroom.  The complimentary breakfast was sumptuous and the restaurant menu offered a good variety reasonably priced.   The staff is courteous and helpful and the service is prompt.  This is a east facing property so the sunrise from here is worth watching.   We experienced a good Quaint little piece of Royalty high up in the hills....

The ambience of this hotel is what catches the eye first; with its sprawling lawns, intricately-crafted interiors and historical anecdotes gracing the wall, it does the term 'Heritage Hotel' complete justice. Tucked away at some height from the bustling Mall Road, it's an ideal place for one looking for some peace and solitude. The room provided all the basic amenities one would require and was fairly clean. The historical memorabilia littered throughout the hotel would be an added attraction for history buffs. Although the staff was extremely courteous and helpful, there were a couple of experiences that left us slightly underwhelmed - the reception desk informed us there was no Wi-Fi provided by the hotel, which is especially glaring when you realise data networks here can be…

great location , fantastic service and amazing property . Rooms are decent but food is good . No wifi in rooms & toilets need upkeep . Hotel shuttle car to and fro to the Mall road is icing on the cake ... Mussori the climate is good during november and people are good .

Very friendly and supportive staff. Nice and clean property with a real heritage ambiance and smell. A quiet place with big rooms. Nice place for couples. Great staying here for 2 days. Great pleace. Carry on. Good luck.

We choose this hotel after lots of research and it was all worth. This palace is trully an amazing place to stay. Rooms are big and super clean. Hotel staff is helpful. Location can't be better. Food is superb. I will come Mussoorie again only to stay at this hotel. Please pass on our thank you note to all your staff. You guys are amazing.

I was looking out for a heritage hotel to stay during this vacation and i was surprised to find a heritage hotel in Mussoorie. I was delighted to spend my 3 days at this hotel. The hotel has big rooms (I selected the superior room) and bigger lawns. One can peacefully sip a cup of tea and enjoy the evening walks in the hotel gardens. The service is good and prompt. Although the hotel is a good climb up from the Mall road, the hotel provides prompt pick up and drop service from / to Mall road.

We had been planning to visit Mussoorie since couple of months and there to we zeroed down to stay at Kasmanda Palace. Finally it was the Diwali break that the plan finally went through and we finalised to stay for one night at Kasmanda palace.  We were really excited to stay at a heritage property.   I would like to be as objective as possible in my review of the property:  Pros: 1. Location - right on Mall Road but at a very serene location. 2. Staff - the entire staff was very courteous and welcoming. Not even once did we had any complaint from them. 3. Room - nice big rooms with a feel of royalty. 4. Breakfast - a wide spread menu with a nice mix of continental and Indian options. 5. Garden - exactly the same what I was hoping for. Grand beautiful well maintained with a wide…

I was really impressed by the photo's itself of Kasmanda palace online and had hence made a booking. On reaching there I realized its even more prettier and grand than in the photo's.  It is based along the mall road, but atop a slope, so there is literally silence all around,which is such a bliss. From the patio one can have a view of the mall road below and beyond.  This place is really old, but very well maintained, and gives one the feeling of being in one of those Royal Shikaar lodges, which Kings in the olden days would have.  They have beautiful, well kept gardens, patios, walking tracks.. everything is prim and proper and running.  The staff is quite well trained, are quiet, attentive and non-intrusive, as if trained for a household.   Living there for the 2 nights and 3…

Excellent property in the gear of the Queen of Hills with great rooms ,comfort & Royal touch of the ancient times  We had a great stay with my Parents &Brothers family from London . Located right at the MALL had also a great staff full of warmth & courtesy

Location of the place is Fantastic. Its about 2000 steps steep climb from the mall. But i would rate the location is Very Good as you are right in the hustle bustle as the same time in peace. The place is a converted heritage building. The Rooms dint have ac's when i had visited the place, but you may feel hot in summers. The Food of the place is very good. The beds are of victorian style layout and clean. You can go in for this property but i found it slightly overpriced.

The place is really very beautiful. Food is good . We were there for three days. There is nothing to roam except kempty fall (Upper side) and mall road. If you want comfortable stay with peace then this the place. It's about 250 mtr from mall road. You will need to call reception or driver every time and he will pick you up from road.

Me and my wife Umi stayed two nights 16th and 17th September this year at Hotel Kasmanda Palace, Mussoorie. Our stay at this hotel was very pleasant and memorable. Staffs are very friendly, cheerful and food was awesome. The rooms were well maintained. The hotel is located at the centre of the city- Mall Road and it is an ancient palace built in 1800's but is very well maintained. The main weakness of the hotel is that there is no bar option and no Wi-Fi in entire area of the hotel. Wi-Fi is available only in restaurant. But my room was with the restaurant and I got Wi-Fi easily in my room. The guests will feel a separate test of the hotel than other hotels since the main building has many stuffed animal heads. In all, the stay was fruitful and awesome and a very new experience.

I belong to Dehradun and just decided to take a short break. I stayed at Kasmanda Palace for a night with my wife and my daughter and I was truly satisfied with the promises. They have a whole museum to the display, just felt as if I was going through the days of the Raj. Awesome... My little daughter was mesmerized by the English gardens. So well maintained lawns. The staff was so well mannered and I could sense that they have been properly trained by a royal family about how to treat the guests. One can make out that difference between the royal staff and a corporate industry trained staff. A round of applause for the gentleman driver of hotel cab who is always ready with a smile to bring you or drop you to Mall road. Also he helps the guests who can't drive their cars up the…

a good heritage property. with great views of the valley. rooms are a bit old but HUGE. bathrooms are remodeled and nice. The staff is very staid and a little lacking in speed and interest. lots of memorabilia. nice gardens. nice breakfast.  worth a try for sure.

I had plan to celebrate my wife bday in Mussoorie, and one of my friend recommended to stay in Kasmanda Palace. And was really right advice as per my requirement. I was looking for Peaceful, heritage property where my wife and I can spend some personal time apart from daily routine of NCR and techi world. And Kasmanda was right choice as per my experience. Its just walking distance from Mall road and you can't expect that much silence and peace around Mall road. Overall my experience was amazing with staff and rooms. Rooms are clean and big, but without any techie thing. I felt like I am in royal palace.  And its food is amazing, I felt like I am having home cooked food. It will taste good and you gone love the options of buffet. And their lawn is having amazing greenery beauty…

Our stay at Kasmanda was very pleasant and memorable. Dining area staff are very pleasant, prompt and cheerful. Rooms in the annexe better suited our requirement. The main building feels little claustrophobic and too many stuffed animal heads didn't appeal to our senses. Other than that, it is worth every penny. It is strategically located in the mall road, at the same time its at a height, therefore, its very quiet and peaceful. The hotel has its vehicle parked at the base of the hillock from where it ferries you to the hotel. Fit and adventurous people can climb up the hillock and build their appetite. The hotel also arranges for trek/ hike if you are the outdoor sorts. On the whole a very good experience.

this is nice hotel well maintained with very good location and view. staff is very friendly and food is also very good. there is no bar that option should be added. Also availability of wifi only in restaurant is not understood.it should be in rooms also. overall a good experience with few lacks.

Every thinkg was great! Make sure to get the new rooms as old ones are too old. he decor is palacial, staff is all helpfull, I acrually woke up at 6 in morning to catch the view from deck and was lost there till 10! Suggestion:  Try their Kashmiri saag and roti.
The rooms were very well maintained. The staff was also very helpful. The best part of this hotel is the location. Prime location on Mall Road! Worth staying!

The hotel is located at the centre of the city- Mall Road, hence making it easily accessible. It has a steep ascent uphill like other hotels in the town but there is a car that takes you to the hotel from the roadside. The hotel is an ancient palace built in 1800's but is very well maintained. The rooms were very good, the resturant food was awesome and the staff is also very courteous. In all, the stay was fruitful and awesome!

This is a great property. Takes you back to the British era. Staff is OK. We landed up early morning and they didn't let us check in at 7 am- which is fair, but usually hotels allow the guest to check in a few hours before actual check out time. The hotel is at a bit of a climb, so if you got small kids and luggage do give the hotel a call and ask them to send a car down. They usually do so promptly.

We booked a 'Superior Room with breakfast' online and paid full in advance. The room was assured to be having a balcony / terrace with mountain view. On reaching, we were allotted a room without any Balcony /terrace and without any mountain view.  In fact, it appears that this Hotel has earmarked a separate block of 6 rooms for travellers, who have booked their rooms online through other websites - 3 on ground and 3 on first floor - away from the main block. While the main block is well lit, with impressive fixtures and a royal ambiance with every room having a good mountain / garden view from an attached balcony / terrace, the separate block of 6 rooms appears as an outhouse of the main hotel block, poorly lit, poorly maintained and without any balcony or mountain view as…

Pros-good service,not fussy people Good food Shuttle to and fro to the mall..very helpful . I stayed in superior room and they were good   Cons-Wifi not in rooms,only in restaurant            A bit expensive              Fridge is not there in room            Hotel does nt organise much activities for kids esp older ones 8 to 15 yrs.There r a few for smaller ones

I stayed at this property for 2N&3D. Visited it during the peak season and with reservation via trip advisor itself. It is a beautiful property located on the mall at an altitude to provide you a nice view of mall as well as doon valley. However I am a bit disappointed by their service and staff.  Positives  1. Royal touch to the property  2. Located on mall road 3. Amazing antique collection all over the hotel 4. Highly spacious rooms. ( I stayed in the Royal room) 5. Good spread at the breakfast at reasonable price   Negative 1. There are 7 different categories of royal rooms as communicated to me by person at reception (second shift person) but they have not mentioned about it anywhere on the website and picture provided on various sites like agoda.com is of the best royal…

A Wonderful Heritage Property located in the heart of Mussoorie. A very well maintained heritage home it has beautiful Magnolia Gardens , Lawns surrounded by Cypress Conifers and Outdoor Sit outs with views of the Doon Valley. Rooms are spacious , the hallways are sparkling with many photographs from the past. The Food is Excellent and I have posted a picture of our first treat after a 2 hour drive from the Airport at Jolly Grant. Excellent Wash Room and great showers , it is a perfect place to stay on a break away from the plains during the Summers. The Location is excellent, while just minutes from the Mall, it secluded as well keeping away the noise of the Streets below. A great idea is the Car in the picture which saves you from a steep climb up. Addition of Quilts instead…

The most inappropriate service ever seen. After requesting for two adjoining rooms 20 days in advance,  we were given rooms in two different blocks.  The entire trip mood spoiled.  Have no more hopes from this property after seeing thier service and staff conduct

Heritage property, wonderful atmosphere, nice location, overall good experience. Nice garden and a wonderful view from the deck. The staff was very cooperative, quick service, good food. They arrange a car from Mall Road to pick up and drop guests up to the hotel lobby.

A palace that has been renovated as a hotel, the drive-up to Kasmanda Palace is a crazy, steep one with hair-pin turns and bends. But once you are there, the stunning view transports you to a timeless land. The Mall is a brief walk down the hill (walking up is strenuous but a great workout!) but the palace itself is quiet, serene, away from the mad bustle. The view of sparkling Mussorie at night is one you will not forget soon. The gardens are delightful and perfect to have several rounds of tea or whatever your choice of poison might be. The rooms are spacious, ours had a four-poster bed and a separate sitting area that overlooked the hills. The bathrooms are modern and well-maintained. The food is great!
