Not the greasy, spicy stuff that is usual at buffets. Will revisit for…

Hotel allowed some guests to hold a private party with loud music in the night, which you could hear in the room and all public spaces. Hotel kept justifying it, which is terrible and ruined the serene environment in an otherwise nice hotel with good food

Kasmanda is one of the very few heritage hotels I have been to that doesn't seem dark and dusty but actually very well maintained and inviting. The view from the terrace is absolutely beautiful and the breakfast is diverse and delicious.

Good food and service; beautiful vintage interiors; calm and serene; right next to the mall road-good connectivity; humble/polite staff  There was only one thing that we didn't like: the water in the wash taps would stink bad at times. But we could ignore that for everything else.

After all the dirt and dust in Dehradun in an awful and unfriendly guesthouse there, I wanted to find a peaceful, tasteful place to relax for some days. I chose this Heritage Kasmanda because of my travel agent in Dehradun, a great man. I couldn´t have found a better place! Large clean and tasteful room with all the equipment one needs. The temperature dropped down in the nights and I got immediately a great electric heater. There is A/C but I don´t like this at all. Before arriving I asked though they offer some international dish too because I was a bit tired of the Indian food. When I had my first dinner for curiosity  I looked what kind of Indian food they are offering. It looked so great that I decided to try - and it was delicious. Therefore all the 3 evenings I had dinner…

We spent 3 nights last week in this wonderful heritage property away from the heat and cacophony of Delhi. It was having nice,clean, spacious royal room (we were given Room 11 having beautiful doon valley view). The customer service was excellent. The food in Magnolia Restaurant (both breakfast and dinner) was good (though for dinner, only a la carte menu was available) and the overall service was nice and friendly. My special thanks to Mr. Pankaj of Magnolia and Mr. Santosh for making our stay so pleasant.There was a complimentary car service for picking and dropping occupants to Mall Road. My two kids aged 4 years and 2 years had a gala time playing in the lawn, riding bicycles, swings etc..  Our suggestions: The kids area needs improvement as the equipments were less and even…

We stayed with our family for 3 nights there with breakfast & diner incld. we all fell sick the very next day after having food at the hotel,from a 4 yr old to 60yrs old we all were in the room having terrible pain. We heard the other guests complaining to the hotel staff about the food & how everyone had been vomiting & having stomach ache,i expected them to offer us an apology or some courtesy but the staff was just listening & did nothing.

Nice historical feeling and pleasant rooms but the front desk was not at all helpful in any way. We asked him to secure us a taxi to take us to our next location but he failed to confirm. Internet only available in the hotel restaurant (not in your room). No alcohol (beer or otherwise) on the premise. Very, very expensive laundry service. Fluctuating prices on things like a glass of soda water with lemon juice (varied by 75-100 rupees from meal to meal). The road from the main road to the hotel is very, very steep. If you are lucky, the hotel will have a car waiting at the bottom of the hill to convey you but if you are not lucky prepare yourself for a steep, steep hike.

Recently I stayed at Kasmanda Palace and must say, I had a very good experience. The owner, Dinkar Singh personally looks into every details. The upkeep of the property is commendable. Rooms and baths are clean and tidy. I loved spending time at the terrace and lovely gardens. The view from the terrace is simple wonderful.  Coming to Dining, the food is excellent. Breakfast lavish. Dinner buffets are interesting with many choices.  My favourite corner in the property is the Lounge - with warm decor. I spent lot of time there reading over tea and coffee.

We stayed in the last week of May 2016.  Full Credit to the hotel and staff making our stay really comfortable.  Excellent Location, Excellent View of the Doon Valley, Great Interiors giving a palace feel and heritage rooms to top it all.  In a nut shell, was value for money.  The pick-up, drop facility to the Mall Road is also highly appreciated

Kasmanda Palace has an world charm which is endearing and intoxicating. Excellantly located atop a hill on the Mall, it is exclusive, far from the madding crowd  and yet amidst the crowd thronging the Mall. Thus you could easily take a stroll on the Mall savouring the delicacies and may be sipping a cup of coffee or masala chai, enjoying the wind caressing you or go on a ride on the ropeway. Or you could prefer to stay indoors in ythe Belvedaere Room reading a book with a cup of coffee. They have beautiful lawns and decks where you could spend hours just lazing around or talking to your companion. Outdoors they also have a walkway where 8 rounds make for a kilometre. For kids they have a kids play area. If you are lucky they also set a bonfire in the evening with music: a…

It's altogether different experience experience staying in a heritage hotel. The palace is full of history and you would find various antique items here. Hotel staff allowed us early check-in and also upgraded our room for free.   Rooms are excellent, you get a royal feel as soon as you enter the hotel. Food is good if not excellent. Staff is very polite. We didn't like the pasta and they recooked it again for us.   You get the beautiful Dehradun view from the hotel terrace restaurant. Don't think that any other hotel in Mussoorie provides such a big lawn and garden.  Hotel is located on the Mall road and they provide free pick-up and drop service from/to Mall road. You need great driving skills if you want to drive your car from mall road to the hotel as that road is very…

I believe it is very hard to witness so much beauty, kindness and customer expertise in a single go. The building in itself already pays the cost for the night. In fact, both Queen Mary of England and the Beatles have chosen to visit this palace in the past. Customer service is of top quality, the staff will have full attention on each of their guests. The food provided is the best food I have tasted over the month I have spent in India (words of two Italians). The rooms are perfectly clean, spacious, bright and fresh. The views on the valley and on Derhadun are stunning, especially at night when one can peacefully gaze the stars and the lights in the distance sitting exactly where Queen Mary had her morning tea over 100 years ago. I definitely recommend Kasmanda Palace over the…

Me a painter by profession liked Kasmanda Palace very much ...its not just a hotel ...you feel home  also.  Its not just a building ,  you see generatioons ...! One must learn from Kasmanda Palace  how to preserve old art and artefacts and add on to the beauty and maintenance of  a good hotel. I highly recommend this welcome heritage hotel to everyone .

I visited Kasmanda palace for a short break in the May 2016,  It had just rained in the evening before we reached, so it was a perfect Mussorie weather to be,  Kasmanda palace is situated right in the heart of the city atop a hill on the Mall road.  The rooms are decent for the price point, the property is also nice, the open deck hangs out loud in the night overviewing the city, a perfect place to sit down and have some time with yourself under the stars over looking the city lights.  The service Sucks!!

This heritage property maintained and run by welcome group  has an old world charm to it. It has retained many things of a by gone era...the majestic staircase that leads to the first floor, ornate planters and also tiger skins that adorn the walls.! The view of the valley from the room is breathtaking as also from the terrace where you can see the setting sun while sipping some hot ginger lemon honey drink. Good food and friendly service complete the expirence! The well manicured gardens  and the bonfire are the icing on the cake!

It is a really nice property .....views are unparallel ....food is very delicious ....rooms are spacious....bathrooms are not so well ventilated but are spacious .....gardens are very beautiful ..... place is very serenly peaceful ....staff is well behaved and polite..

Stayed here with family. It's a nice heritage property on the Mall Road. Very Important you need to pay 150 bucks at the entrance of Mall road and every time you need to pay the same when they u enter Mall Road. And incoming is restricted from 4 pm till 10.30 PM there. This resort has its own parking and they provide complementary cab drop till library chowk too. The food spread is quite decent. Staff is very helpful and courteous. We reached early morning and check-in timings were 2 PM. Yet they provided us rooms. Quite courteous of them ! Scenic view from the terrace is breathtaking. Interiors are quite subtle and sober. In short, one of the best stays at Mussorie !

We liked the location and the hotel, but the rooms are below average. The rooms are not well maintained and have unnecessary furniture and old sofas. The rooms will need a major uplift. Food was average, could have been better if this is a palace...  I will not come back and stay here again. It's not worth the money they charge for the rooms

It was first time for me to stay in one of welcome heritage hotel.kasmanda place is a beautiful property.can see whole mussorie view from it. Rooms r very nicely decor..bathroom r nicely cleaned..overall greatly touched by the service part.our kids fell ill in night,we call the reception in late night.but they come with in a minute and cleaned the room..even they called the Dr..  Food was really nice. Simple and tasty.very much impressed by service.

The property on the hills is really very interesting. The building is almost 200 years old, and has been a hospital and a school, before becoming royal property in the 1930s. The hunt trophies, carpets and the staircase make the place very atmospheric - with a bit of British Raj ghost story feel. No ghosts that we met, though.  The restaurant is good, and they make very nice moussaka and Indian dishes. The breakfast is ok. Not very western friendly but not bad Indian. Not excellent either.  The staff is helpful, but not very used to foreigners - the Kasmanda is big among Delhiites and Mumbaikars, specially for honeymoons.  They have a lovely terrace with amazing views of the hills, even down to Dehra Dun.  The only real big down side is that it's next door to a party venue that…

A hidden jewel off the Mall Road. One of the few Heritage Hotels left untampered with. It has amazing charm of by gone days. A lovely garden, beautiful rooms overlooking the valley and air conditioning making it so agreeable throughout the year. The staff are very polite and from time to time one meets the family that own and run the hotel in such a personalised manner. The terrace with the  Royal Rickshaw is such a pleasure to see. Enjoyed my stay immensly. I would recommend this anytime.

Easily the best place to stay in mussorie...the expanse had t b seen to b believed... Good food is an add on...has preserved its royal past...on the mall, but still away from crowds...provides free rides to mall in their car...

This turns out to be a REALLY interesting property. Its the palace of a king back in the 1930s and is full of memorabilia all along the walls and the rooms have heritage furniture.  The pros: Great big rooms                 Nice bathrooms                 clean                 with character, lots of history                LOVELY LOVELY gardens, english tea garden                superb views from the decks overlooking the valley                excellent food and chefs made exactly what we wanted KUdos!               lots of privacy and silence since crowd was less               on the mall Road so access to shops was easy               there is a drop off car which takes up up and down the hill as you need  Cons     NO WIFI in rooms              No safety locker in rooms         …

Overall property was great in the lap of nature but little bit overpriced. Furniture of hotel is really very old and not very comfortable. It need to be changed with new antique look furniture. There should be mini bar and safe locker in the rooms.  Apart from it, Food is great. Staff of hotel is very decent, decorous and prompt. Overall enjoyed our stay here.

We booked two room online for 21 Apr 2016 online via agora. We were allotted room no 15-16on ground floor. As soon as we entered in rooms their is bad smell of seepage and looking that room are closed from quit a time.  We tried to change but manager denied saying that no room available in this category. Since we have already paid 100 percent so we have no other option except staying their. Plus point was ambience , location just above mall road, great garden which is maintained properly .  However nightmare was quality of food we is costly as well as without taste. Choice was limited stating less occupancy. Tandoor was not operative.Specially In Dessert on Gulab-Jamun costed 100 Rs plus tax which was not good in taste.  Suggestion never book room no 15 and 16 and avoid food in…

The property is a heritage property nicely kept with lush green landscaped lawn and garden. Excellent ambience and great food and very good hospitality done from heart. They have pick and drop facility from mall road and all the staff is very courteous and helpful.

Good point of kasmanda is its huge garden. Very relaxing and rejuvenating. Wish they had a temperature controlled swimming pool adjacent to garden and a mountain view.   Disappointment: They didn't lit the campfire even on our request due to less occupancy.   Rooms were average and bathrooms are neatly maintained.   Most disappointing thing is their food. Veg menu options are very limited and priced extremely very high and quantity is very less compared to other restaurants. Felt its not at all worth to eat there but there were no options for dinner as it get cold during evenings and had to order from kasmanda. Desserts are not prepared fresh and most of them are from can packing or ice creams. They didn't serve us as per it's menu and didn't even inform us about the…

Serene but right in the hub of the mall road. Great property. Has an amazing garden. Has a few facilities such as a badminton court and a few more other facilities. The staff is very helpful but very disappointing food. Expected much more. Comfortable bedroom but the bathroom could be made just a bit better. These little things are what define a hotel as great or good. Overall a it was a very good experience. I enjoyed a lot with my family.

A cosy and comfortable stay at the hotel. The biggest USP is the location (on the Mall road) and the transport service available to and fro from the mall road.   Was taken aback as there are no other services available other than a room and restaurant.

What strikes you first is the history of the place....it used to be a church,then a British officer's residence,before being finally acquired by the king of kasmanda. So,we actually are given the royal treatment by the staff! we had three noisy kids with us ,but they were always dealt with smiles! the building and the ground are beautiful....and the view is simply breathtaking.... In the daytime, you can see a substantial part of mussoorie, and in the night,u can see the twinkling lights of dehradun....no picture can capture the beauty of such a view. Last of all...the food was just amazing....we used to actually look forward to the meal time..we had almost all our meals at the hotel...and paid complements to the chef on our last day. So,we might just end up going to mussoorie…

Nice location , good and cozy apartments , great location just off Mall road and A GREAT view from the hills..A very enjoyable vacation..Only negative is the traffic at mall road sometimes is too crazy and the private car /taxi cannot come to mall road after 4 pm due to govt rules..so , any plans to visit and park at the hotel have  to come during this duration

We went to this property to celbrate the new year and it turned out to the one of the most memorable new year celebrations. This palace is a heritage property and has been with the current for over 100 years now. It has been maintained in an immaculate manner. its built up the hill and its quite a task to reach there by walk. They have a car which they park on the mall road for the guests to take to the hotel. The overall property is huge and have view to the entire valley. Away from all the madness on the mall road. Very close to the bus stand. Rooms are spacious and have heater in them. Staff is very courteous and very friendly. The food never disappoint you in the hills. The breakfast and dinner was included. They have number of options in breakfast and dinner. Delicious food…

The palace is like the Kings Palace in heaven and the beauty. As soon you enter the lobby you are greeted by a full size stuffed tiger. The rooms have original beds used by kings and queen. There is a small staircase to climb the bed. Food is homely, less spicy and a small open to sky place to sit in morning sunlight with excellent view of the town. Best place to stay in  Mussoorie. Above all it is well connected to the main shopping market "The Mall".

We took a short 3 days family vacation at Mussorie and decided to stay at Kasmanda Palace. We had absolutely delightful and memorable experience. First of all, the heritage property is full of history and very well maintained to kept that experience alive! Complements to the chef of Magnolia restaurant, the menu choices and tastes are par excellence. Best part is the great service provided by hotel staff. It was very prompt, courteous and everything was served with a warm hospitality with a personal touch.  The Royal Room (#14) offers a great unobstructed view of the valley.

The palace is like kings place in heaven And the beauty is 24 x 7 maintained with neat and healthy environment as it is outside same is inside hotel The best place to relax in @ mussorie  Awesome dine ..... And u will just enjoy  ☺

After climbing the winding roads, we reached our destination around evening. Thick fog was hindering our view of the buildings. But the interior was captivating. Felt like we just entered some old palaces which showcased the trophies of the adventure. We were directed to our room which was on first floor. The corridor was decorated with the pic of rulers of the past. Truly a heritage building. Our room was spacious with all necessary comfort and the staffs were so kind. They have a amazing library where they also exhibit wide variety of antics collection. Adjoining to that is a spacious restaurant where they serve delious food. After enjoying our dinner there, we decided to have our breakfast in Garden from where we will get the beautiful view of these himalayan mountains. The…

We decided to go to Mussoorie for a short vacation from Kolkata and after some search and feedback from friends, chose Kasmanda Palace Hotel which also has a WelcomHeritage Hotel Badge. We had booked two rooms as we were a group of three including my wife, our  daughter and myself. Mussoorie’s cityscape is dominated by the Mall Road which is so in most Himalayan Hill resorts which have common history going back to the British era. Kasmanda Palace is located just above the Mall Road – near the Mahatma Gandhi / Library end (the other end of the Mall Road being the Picture Palace) and there is a winding short road going up to the hotel. The hotel fortunately has a car pick-up always available at the Mall Road level which keeps ferrying guests and their baggage up to the hotel and…

Welcomheritage has a jewel in the queen of the hills. Very well maintained property. You et to see trophy hunts hung on the walls and family pics of kasmanda royals. No creepy creaky noices as are common with old buildings.

Anyone visiting mussoorie must, must stay here, and only here. Charming relics of an era gone by, impeccable UK hospitality and divine views from the terrace. Terrific location, being right on the mall road, while not compromising on the quietitude and peace that one expects from the hills of Ruskin Bond.

Stayed at Kasmanda Palace with my wife, son and daughter during 21-23 October, 2015.  We stayed in two adjacent rooms (10 & 11, Royal Rooms, Valley View, on the 1st Floor). Very large and luxurious rooms with heritage furniture and antique items.  Instead of the traditional room heaters, these two rooms were equipped with dual type heating Air Conditioners, which were very effective in quickly heating up the big rooms (the weather gets quite cold after sundown). One of the attractions of this property is the huge and lovely garden area at the back of the hotel – very well maintained and excellent for a morning walk or a stroll in the evening or for a leisurely cup of tea. All over the hotel there were historical and heritage items on display, and one can literally spend many…

Our stay at Kasmanda was a very relaxing experience. Initially I booked for a Deluxe room, but due to some problems with the layout and interiors of the room, we complained to the manager regarding the same, especially as we were going to stay there for 5 days, it was reasonably necessary to feel at home. The next day we were upgraded to one of the Royal rooms, which was cosy, comfortable and had a good view. I am grateful to the management for the same. As we had availed an MAP package, our b'fast and dinner was at "Magnolia", their restaurant. It was very good food, but no buffet! Mr. Shoorvir in the Magnolia, one with always a smile on his face, is great at hospitality and service. But, nonetheless it is advisable that "nitty gritties" of the MAP plan should be discussed…

i was there forlunch wid my in laws and husband ....and i m regretting for nt staying there..will plan a family holiday surely the next time.beautiful scenery...mesmerising ambience....royal service...and excellent excellent food

Located nicely on the Mall Road, this property was chosen out of many options we had. Especially travelling during an off season finding availability was no issue which also worked to our advantage. Firstly there was hardly any crowd in the hotel and that's why the much needed peace was definitely there. Staff was courteous and helpful. Food quality was decent

A beautiful palatial property of Welcom heritage group of hotels. Kasmanda Palace has an imperial touch to it and it feel royal and makes yourself believe in indulgence everytime you visit this superb property.

Had been wanting to visit Mussoorie, for a while at last got myself packed and moved to Mussoorie. Was a last minute reservation at this Heritage property. The location was fantastic, service impeccable.Only thing which needs attention is the quality of bath and bed linen . Which had gone grayish . Else a perfect stay . And a big thank you for the entire team working there. Hope to be back soon , book for the Royal rooms on the 1st floor overlooking the valley.

Kasmanda is a Palace in literal sense. We stayed there for 3 nights in Superior room and thoroughly enjoyed the comforts, scenic garden view and royal food. The hotel is on top of the mall road, so one have to depend on the hotel's cab to take you up and down. Even that has been managed quite well as the staff are extremely courteous. We were served a-la-carte food for bfast and dinner, as vegetarians, we are delighted. You have choice of seating, in the dinner hall or the garden -  facing doon valley which takes the dining experience to the next level. Kasmanda is perfectly located to be a complete resort, but this is where we feel let down. A few more out door activities, may be even a dip pool, spa and gym would have made it complete.

Kasmanda is a beautiful property with beautiful lawns, breathtaking view from the terrace where you can have any meal anytime of the day & you wont be disappointed by the beauty. The property is itself a heritage property which welcomes you with antiquities from maharaja's time. Beautiful large rooms tastefully furnished blending modern amenities with antique furniture. Kids play area was another addition. Food was awesome especially the continental.  Downside: No tandoor during low occupancy so the menu was limited.  All in all a very good property & the manager Ahmed & the Staff deserve a special mention in extending the hospitality as well.

I have no reasons to admit that to stay at this heritage property was a last-minute decision, mainly because most of Mussorie hotels were sold out. However, as it turned out in the end, it was a good decision.  We had gone through the reviews in Trip Advisor. So, our expectations were set. We were there just to put our feet up and relax. And fair to say, we were not disappointed.  It's situated above the Mall road, so getting there with your car is a hassle. So, a loud cheer to their driving staff who helped me to get our car in the hotel parking.  We got two adjacent rooms in a separate section. The rooms were nice and clean, the staff was courteous so was the front desk person who responded well to all my queries even at 11 in the night.  It's a well maintained property and…

The location is good as its near mall but the hotel is located on a steep uphill location. You might need good car and driving skills go up there. The location is near the library end of the mall. They have orignal skins of lion, cheetah etc on display make sure you see all of them. They have a huge garden and a kids playing area which is only of kind in mussorrie. The property is well maintained and the rooms are spacious. They dont have refrigrator in rooms but they have airconditioners which i doubt can be used. They also have a car to drop n pick you from the mall, its free but would drop you only till the entance at mall. The staff is very courtious and friendly.

We stayed here from 4-6 Oct, and it is worth the penny spent. A beautiful castle like property, perched on the hillock overlooking the valley, with access from the mall road. The spacious rooms are cozy with plenty of wooden furniture. The decor of the lobby with the teak staircase, the wall paintings and the restaurant is amazing. Food is delicious and the staff is very courteous and helpful. We did enjoy the evenings in the lovely garden and the relaxing tables kept in the open, overlooking the valley. Highly recommended

Me being 5th time there is ample proof of the comfort and pleasure of staying there. Starts off with a chaos with Mall road being off limit for car by which the kids got stranded and Mr. Ahmed and his troupe sorted this out, circumventing all the hindrances within an hour, with his meticulous planning and delegation, but always with the smile on his face, which is omnipresent. Each and everybody around have a warm smile welcoming you at every step, always more than eager to accomodate every need of ours. No wonder such a beautiful place, the palace and it's porticos, verandahs, terraces, all opening out to mesmerising beauty of the hills have more warmth than any other place in the hills. Worth coming back to this wondrous lap of nature again and again.

A heritage property located very  near the mall road and yet peaceful when once inside.Charming and cosy. Food is excellent with healthy options if requested . Service is very good. reception staff and other staff very helpful and courteous. Liked the stay and in fact extended a day more . Has an old world charm and yet modern facilities to some extent . There is a beautiful terrace near the dinning area where one can relax under the open sky . Lovely experience.

I visited this excellent heritage hotel on 17th June 2015 and stayed there for one night. It was very beautiful. The rooms are really big and tidy. Hospitality is excellent. The location of the hotel is very good on mall road.  The food is excellent in taste. The gardens and terraces add to the luxury of the property.

One of the reasons to visit a hill stations for urban person is to breathe fresh air and unwind in a peaceful surroundings. If these are your reason to travel to Mussoorie this is the best place . Do experience there unique lounge near the dining area and breath the fresh air at terrrace. Early morning tea and late night sit down is amazing to say the least You can hear the bustle of the below mall and watch the millions of bulbs around. Amazing garden and the staff has preserved it well wide variety of flowers and plants. The first monsoon clouds are bringing magic to the place , enjoy it.

Let's start with check-in to hotel... It was long journey from Delhi and even longer wait to enter mussoorie. I called up reception to let them know late check in,meantime couple of people arrived walking. They let them in and later competed formalities.   Rooms were great, staff was overwhelming.  Food was mouthwatering (we were hungry too ☺)   Everything went perfect with hotel and location is perfect 👌.   Only issue is if you are walking 🚶 up Hill for hotel entrance, it's around 1km uphill, tough task . But hotel was generous to extend pick up at night even 11pm, last time being 10pm.  Kudos for staff,  I will definitely stay next time around. Royal, superior rooms do have excellent view but even deluxe have common balcony to enjoy.

We made an advance reservation in this hotel for 4 nights starting from 10th June 2015. Before we checked-in, we paid 100% of the amount , acc. to hotel's policy.   The entire stay was a nightmare experience for me and my wife.   Taking note of tips provided by travellers on TripAdvisor, we booked room #9 which falls under Superior category room. When we actually saw the room and the way its door has been put up, we weren't impressed because of privacy concerns. We asked the person manning reception to get us some other room, first he outright refused and said that no other room is vacant. (neither in Superior nor in Royal). We came back to our room and within 10 mins we got a knock on the door saying there is another room (#18) on the same floor. On the first sight, we found…

Kasmanda Place [a WelcomHeritage] property is the place to stay at Mussoorie. Located on the Mall Road, yet away from the crowds, the heritage property is well-maintained with spacious rooms, gardens and open spaces. Excellent for children, the property has a great ambience, peaceful and calm! Highly recommended!

Rooms are nice and cozy... Has A wonderful View to the city of Dehradun.... Upper Deck to chill around with friends and family in the evening. Huge Lawn for Children to play. Great Food and excellent hospitality. Worth a stay.

Very nice location and facilities. Peaceful and well maintained. Rooms are big and clean. Park and Children play area is very well maintained. My wife and son enjoyed a lot.  Little disappointment on compulsory buffet.

A 3 star profiling for this heritage property with excellent location is unfair...definitely deserves a 4 star or higher rating. Very helpful staff and excellent food...had amazing vegetable and salad combinations never tried before...like french beans and sesame stri fry, papaya salad with honey and pepper dressing to name a couple, variety of parathas made on request over and above the  dinner buffet, staff even packed our breakfast for our day trip to Hrishikesh. The location is the best in Mussoorie...proximity on the Mall road, yet highly perched on a hill. Royal rooms are large..overlooking the valley, however bed could have been better...was unstable. The property has a lovely terrace sitout area and an amazing lawn area. Kudos to the staff for making our stay memorable.

We loved our stay at Kasmanda Palace and what a find it was! We are thankful to Mr. Dinker Singh who accommodated us and blocked 03 rooms for our family  on a busy weekend and at a short notice in May. The place is very finely restored and refurbished and they haven't done much cosmetic surgery to it and I loved the old world charm in the palace.The atmosphere is very relaxed and their location is great. They are just a stones throw from the mall road yet its very quite and peaceful in there. We had the opportunity of meeting Mrs. Meghna  Singh who actively looks after the place and takes a keen interest in restoring the palace. WE loved every bit of our stay and thank the entire team at Kasmanda palace and do keep up the good work. We shall visit again and will definitely…

It's funny that I am writing the review though it is just day 2 and still here. I couldn't hold myself to share... We are here with friends and family..it is going to be a memorable trip. Everything is great. The people here are so nice . I would recommend this for one who wants to enjoy the scenic beauty coupled with nice hospitality and relaxing time

It's my second stay in Mussoorie and we enjoyed so much in one night. The spacious room, magnificent garden, excellent food, good facilities: we were totally pampered here.  My son enjoyed the play area, garden and surroundings. Really recommend this stay for family.

I wanted a hotel that was classy yet friendly, far from the maddening crowds and yet close enough to the "action" on the Mall!! Kasmanda Palace was the answer to our prayers. Large enough rooms that were well maintained -- we were 3 adults in one room. A very friendly lot of service staff. Good wholesome food in a home-cooked style and hot adrak chai and chicken sandwiches always available!!!! What more can one ask for a four-5 days on a holiday of solitute.  I did suggest that the manangemnt think of having more ramps/ handrails for the ease of elderly persons -- certain corners can get tricky for those whose knees are not in the best of shape. I also missed simple things like bread sticks or bread rolls with the soup and pies for dinner. Toast was happily provided of course.…

After walking in the Himalaya for two weeks and camping, the Kasmanda Palace, at first glance, seemed like luxury. It's oldy worldly with lots of character and charm.   After two nights there though, we realised it needed some revamping. While the rooms were large, there were various faults. The hot water tap in my bathroom didn't turn on, so it needed the attention of three different service staff to fix it!  Not quite the luxurious shower I was expecting after 14 nights camping!  The dinner buffet was nice but on both nights we found the food was cold. The staff, while trying to be helpful had trouble understanding a request for coffee with hot milk. It's all a little Faulty Towers!  All in all, an adequate hotel, but maybe not the grand old lady that you may be expecting! …

No other place in and around Mussoorie has so much of space and garden to relax as that of Kasmanda Palace. Even Company Garden does not have the garden to sit and relax. A super sunrise view and just a few meters on camel back road ... sunset.

Staying at Kasamanda Palace was like being guest to a british time Riyasat. Small property but well maintained by courteous and caring staff.   food is delicious. We visited in start of the winter, enjoyed having breakfast at small Burj near garden with a view of valley in clear sunlight.   the garden has a small but nice jogging track for regular runners like me.

Hi folks, this was my second visit to Musoorie (check my earlier review) and i decided to be there on the peak of the season that too a weekend coupled with 2nd October holiday. this was the only highly rated property available and i managed to get a room for 2 adults and 2 kids for Rs. 12 k a night. this hotel has both plus and minus and for me the minus were lil more. its right in the middle of mall road but then one has to climb a slop of 45 degree to reach to the hotel. but no worry the hotel provide free ride. its situated almost at the hill top and usually remained under clouds so if u r lucky u will get to see the bird eye view of the doon valley. the rooms are still been kept in an old era type flavour, the old 21 inch big TV. The ACs are mounted at a good height and it…

If you want to get away from the hustle, bustle of Delhi go to Kasmanda Palace in Mussoorie.  You will be pampered with excellent service, delicious food and an unparalleled view.  This is a heritage property with expansive grounds, patios and large, comfortable rooms.  The staff was very helpful, and both chefs were accomodating in preparing the dishes we asked for.  All in all a great time was had by all (3 couples).

After a four-day spiritual retreat in Rishkesh we chose to unwind at the Kasmanda Palace. We were greeted by incessant rain on the the evening we reached, and the people at Kasmanda went out of the way to pick us up from the Library Chowk. An excellent heritage property well maintained. The staff lived up to the expectations, courteous, cheerful and helpful! They tried their best to drive away the cold - even put up a bonfire on the large lawn for just the five guests who braved the elements! The tinkling of the wind chimes in the back ground, twinkling lights of the valley below made for a soulful experience! Food, N Indian, was well prepared. We had a great view of the valley from our room- the sudden change in the weather from bright sunshine to foreboding dark clouds was…

This is not a hotel so don't expect a swimming pool and gym. What it is is a beautiful heritage property, with large rooms, exceptional location, great food and very attentive service. The owners themselves are always around and make you feel as comfortable as you possibly could be. Stay here to relax, take in the magnificent views and ofcourse gorge on exceptional Indian and continental menu. For sheer relaxation, couldn't recommend it enough!!

We stayed here for one night on a quick trip up to Mussoorie.  Check-in was easy, and the staff was very polite.  We weren't sure what to expect, but we were really pleased with our room.  It was large, clean, and the view from our windows was incredible. We sat at the chairs and had coffee just to admire the view.  We easily walked to the market, as well as to restaurants close by.  I would definitely stay here again.

This is certainly the best Heritage property in Mussoorie and the location is perfect, very near to the mall road.  It has been recently renovated which adds to its old world charm. All the valley facing rooms have breathtaking views and there is a well maintained garden area as well. Rooms have the heritage decor yet they don't miss out on all the modern amenities. We stayed in the Royal room which has views overlooking the doon valley. Staff is very courteous..food is good albeit a little expensive. Strongly recommended for a relaxing and peaceful stay in Mussoorie. A big thumbs up to  Mr. Dinkar Singh and team..I'll be back!!!

Enter into Kasmanda & you enter into a world steeped in history, luxury & excellent service! Ideally located on the Mall Road, this heritage property is a must visit for those who like the old world charm together with all modern amenities. Very attentive & courteous staff & excellent cuisine on offer too. Truly a Royal Experience!

This is a amazing resort in Mussoorie . A weekend must visit for peole who love to be in serenity,greenery and hills.The bonfire organised by the hotel is excellent and foods is delicious. The hotel provide a feeling of heritage and modern ammenities. The staffs are very helpful and friendly.

We had an amazing stay at the Kasmanda Palace. The staff were very courteous and helpful. We had an amazing view of the valley from our room window. Overall it was nice experience. Would love to go back again. Pankaj Kansal

I would recommend Kasmanda Palace Hotel in particular to couples who are looking for a quiet yet well located getaway in Mussoorie.  This hotel is a heritage property basically the summer palace of the Taluqdar of Kasmanda which is located near Lucknow. The buidling is very pretty extremely well located near the Mall, and with a spectacular view. We went during the monsoons so it was a treat to be in the mist from time to time. The gardens were really well maintained with beautiful flowers including the lovely magnolia blossoms. The dining area overlooked the garden and it was a delight to sit there and have a delicious breakfast every morning.  The staff was polite and helpful. I would only suggest that they upgrade the bathrooms and the upholstery in the rooms. I know there is…

Went to Mussoorie for the weekend and checked in Kasmanda Palace after checking couple of hotels. Being off season all hotels had rooms, however nothing clicked. With my son, i wanted some place right on the mall road, with ample play area for the kid. Kasmanda ticked all the boxes with great location and nicely maintained lawns. The staff was courteous and always willing to help.The shuttle to the small drive downhill was always available. Though we were the only guests, on that day, the staff right from housekeeping to restaurants were on their toes. I really appreciate their gesture to make us feel comfortable. Had dinner at the restaurant and food was freshly cooked and tasted good. I would definitely stay at Kasmanda again whenever I revisit Mussoorie. Keep up the good work.

this has to be one of the better hotels in mussoorie....it is located upwards from the mall...the hotel car can pick u up from the mall road from where it is a steep climb...once you are up there you are in heaven...it is so peaceful up there ...the views from the hotel are stunning...the rooms are spacious and comfortable...the valley looks brilliant at night from up here...the staff is courteous and the food is nice...great property to stay in mussoorie...

had come while driving my scooty from Dehradun in January winters. Wanted a memorable trip to Mussoorie so tried the hotel and was glad about the decision! We saw one other room but decided to pay a bit extra and go for the one with better view. At night the view was beautiful with twinkling stars and lights. Morning had breakfast in open lawn with seating. Enjoyed the food basking in the winter sun. Thanks Kasmanda for the beautiful memories!

I had visited the property recently in October 2014. An amazing experience. The rooms are neat and clean. We hd a little problem with the geyser but the staff was prompt and helped us open up another room for using the bath till they fixed the geyser in our room.The staff is very friendly and helpful. They are very couteous and make you feel really special. We were with our kids who too enjoyed the place. The food was excellent A very peaceful and calm place. Would like to  recommend the place 100% and am sure to visit it soon and stay longer than we didi this time(3 days) Should mention the General Manager Mr. Rakesh Khanduri did suggest a couple of places around and was very couteous and a through professional. He also met up a couple of times during our stay and was really…

Hello people, The location of kasmanda palace is undoubtedly good,located few feet above the mall road.But it is not for very old people or people with small babies and toddlers.Road was undergoing some construction during our visit in november 1st week, so please confirm status of road before booking.Even though a wagon R used to transfer us midway the steep road,difficult with kid.Other hotels on Mall road are Padmini Niwas and fortune.  Hospitality was excellent in dining area ,though overpriced.Room service was only till 10pm.  Ambience_Agreed that it is old building but being overtaken by welcome Heritage group- In room furniture,bathroom amenities,TV did not match needs of modern guest.In modern era,guests booking a costly high ranking place expect better furniture and…

I am staying in Dehradun since 1968 and visited Mussoorie un numbered of times. This year I wanted to go to best place in Mussoorie to celebrate my marriage anniversary. I checked on net and came to know about this place. Its beautifully located and very nice place e to stay. Although its a bit expensive,but its not an issue if it becomes a memorable one. It gives you the feeling of staying in a palace. Very big rooms. Staff is very good and very hospitable.

The hotel is situated on the Mall Road. Although the climb is a steep one mainly due to the ongoing seswerage work for which the hotel car cannot travel the full distance, it's definitely an amazing place to stay. Very well maintained property, with large rooms & extremely courteous & hospitable staff who are always ever ready to offer their services. The view of the Doon valley sitting at the open area is picturesque. The gardens are well maintained & definitely it's a must place to stay when you are in Mussoorie.

We visit Mussoorie almost every year and had stayed at Kasmanda a few years back. After trying out various other hotels we decided to go back to Kasmanda this year. And we made the right decision in doing so. The best part of the hotel is its beautiful and realistic depiction of the palace ambience. The rooms are large and give you the feel of the heritage. The staff is courteous and the service is very efficient. The rooms could do with a few more basic amenities. The bonfire, the lawns, etc add to the flavour of the holiday. It is worth mentioning that they were quick to refund the money we had paid in advance, due to a cancellation. All in all a great experience, would recommend it to those who would like to enjoy a relaxed and unique experience, a touch away from modernity.

Stayed at this heritage hotel in the first week of Oct 14. The property is very well kept. It has nice rooms, beautiful lawns, open spaces and a lovely sit-out which offers an impressive view of the town below. Located right on top of the Mall Road, the hotel is actually quite a climb from The Mall; but a thoughtfully placed Wagon-R ferries you up and down whenever you want. The hospitality of the hotel is unmatched.The staff is extremely courteous and the food is delicious. We had an amazing stay. Will go back there for sure!

This is an excellent property. Everything about it good. Special mention for the service and staff. Don't think twice and book this place you won't regret it. I will definitely be staying here on my next trip to mussourie. The hotel has the best location and ideally situated from the mall road.

Stayed at Welcom Heritage Kasmanda Palace on 5th October 2014. Staff is courteous, excellent heritage property, spacious rooms, lawn. Enjoyed Bonfire in lawns arranged by Hotel Staff. Will recommend everyone to enjoy stay only in this property.

Great heritage property.. even though built in 1836, still very well maintained.. many open areas with lots of greenery to make u relax right on the middle of mall..  And above all very hospitable staff and great food..  strongly recommended for a family holiday..

Had a good time with my friends. ..friendly staff nd service is too good!!good property will surely visit again:)best part is thr location ..thr mall road is just right there.rooms were awesome neat and clean!!

I had meant to write this as soon as I came back in May but it got put off somehow or the other, What a holiday, we were a big group and the courtesy and prompt service were excellent ! The Manager went always the extra mile to ensure all of us were spoilt and that too with a smile. Go for the heritage wing for the suites. Best rooms Each and every person was service with a smile, from the car chauffeur who would pick you up at the mall road to the waiters in the restaurant ! You only have to look up and someone is there, they know when to disappear and when to be there, I believe this must be the way the Maharajas lived, no doubt it is carried on and well. The best part is the gardens and they even make a bonfire with food served outside at night. Perfect location in the city…

We were a group of 10 couples and stayed at Kasmanda Palace from 27/07/2014 to 31/07.2014. The rooms were good and the quality of food - Breakfast,Lunch,Dinner were all excellent and delicious with a lot of variety . The staff was courteous,soft spoken and the hospitality offered by The General Manager - Mr. Somnath Sarkar was praise worthy and excellent. We will love to visit again.

Very nice and clean property .................... staff are very attentive and friendly................. Beautiful maintained Lawn (park) as well...............  Food variety and quality is good as well.......

The hotel is situated at a good location. Though on a hill with steep climb but car pick up & drop services are very prompt. The ambience, size of room, food, courteous staff & the care provided makes it a ideal location for a holiday with added advantage of being on The Mall.

As travellers we prefer small quaint heritage hotels instead of lavish five stars, this hotel suited our tastes and is very nicely located on top of a hill and the climb is steep, but the view from the hotel terrace is great! Try the Suite rooms which are amazingly spacious and wonderful view. Decent food, warm service and cosy hotel made my stay very special. Would recommend to those who like private places than large busy hotels. It was nice to see the GM of the hotel himself was interacting with guests and taking feedback. Overall a very nice experience.

The hotel is a nice little gem that looks like a palace. Service was good and we were happy. However, there are certain things that guests should know before booking. First, the hotel is situated on a hill and an impossibly steep climb from the mall road. The hotel gives free rides to guests, up and down the climb, but sometimes there were many guests and we had to wait, as there was only one car available.  Also, the hotel is situated *AFTER* the government roadblock that is closed for long hours. Only cars with white plates (Indian) were allowed into the mall road and into the hotel's parking. People traveling in cars with yellow plates (|comnmercial/taxi) are not allowed through the roadblock, no matter what, including foreigners who live in India. We arrived in Mussoorie at…

Kasmanda palace..an ITC heritage hotel appeals to those like me who look for traditional style stay..palace type monumental and historically endowed property with full cordiality of in house staff..tasteful food..!! This place is a reminder of colonial past with its ornate curlicues built in 1836 with just 24 rooms..suited to each depending on what they opt for and pay for. Surely likeable..enjoyable by kids..on the mall road..it matches up all tourist and relaxation parameters. Add to it the deal offered by manager mr somnath sarkar on royal suit which suited me as we all wanted to stay in same room. So weldone team kasmanda..i stay for 3 nights..!!

It was like staying in a palace... Back to the old times.... Nicely maintained, excellent service, courteous staff..... Food was also good... Loved the view from the terrace..... Good job and keep it up

In the peak season of tourist in June at Mussoorie, this was the best place to relax and enjoy. The place was well maintained,  staff were very courteous. Has a good view, huge lawn and good outdoor area to relax. The old historical property really fascinated us. Spent quality time with my family.Would love to visit again.

Kasmanda Palace is right in the middle of Mussoorie yet completely away from the crowd and humdrum of a touristy place. We stayed here during July 2014 and it was an experience to remember. The food in the Magnolia Restaurant is excellent and the staff is very Courteous and makes every effort to make the trip memorable.. I would specially like to mention Mr Surveer and Mr Sachin Rawat who went out of their way and gave us a taste of Royalty at Kasmanda Palace!! Also Mr Tarun and Mr Santosh from the front office were very accomodating and helpful with the arrangements.  Overall it's a 150 year old heritage building kept exactly the old times way and it has brilliant historical photographs and trophies at display which are very interesting to see. The Raja of Kasmanda and his…

Excellent hotel, excellent food, excellent & courteous staff. Enjoyed every moment of our stay in this hotel. Highly recommended for families who just want to relax and spend quality time together.  Rakesh Whorra.

Spent two nights from 21st June 2014 in Royal Room with my wife Awsome hotel. Good and well maintain this heritage property.  We took for two nights Royal room package . First night we did not liket the corner first floor room. On our request Mr, Sarkar changed our room to ground floor inspite of heavy booking. Rooms v.good and spacious. Bathrooms are also big. Bathrooms are well maintained neat and clean.  Mr. Sarkar is very helful with similing face. He meet each and every guest himself . The staff is also very courteous.  The garden is well maintained. Outside sitout is very good.  Gym is not required because long walking on the mall and doing up and down is good exercise. I am from Chennai, TN, visited Mussoorie with my family between 8th and 13th June and stayed in this place. The rooms were really good and neat. Spent three fabulous days at this great property. Perhaps the best food in town. Extremely helpful staff and great view. Very close to the crowded Mall road but once you are up in the hotel it is just bliss.....Great spread of breakfast and dinner buffets....Hoping to go there again. Highly recommended.

Kasmanda Palace Hotel made me feel like a King in the Queen of Hills, Mussoorie. A flawless Heritage hotel with fantastic staff, I wud certainly like to revisit this place. the location is brilliant. staff is good. the lawn is spacious. room service is good , the staff is courteous..the entrance and exit to the hotel is easy. ample parking , the hotel is on a hill top so the view is also amazing.....  The stay in Kasmanda palace was truly a great experience of living in a heritage hotel. It is away from the hustle-bustle of the town .  Ours overlooked the spacious lawn and the mountains beyond. In a city which is being commercialised at such a fast pace Kasmanda pallace stands out as a hotel which cares for its guests. Kasmanda Palace, Gosh I Miss It, one thing's for sure, u are surely going to visit it after checking out, what a place it was to escape the scorching heat of delhi, absolutely loved it, feels like going back there agn n agn, Superb facilities, it's a bit high up the hill but no worries, the hotel provides u with shuttle services, good food,AND 4 nights i stayed there and had sleep of a lifetime every time

I don't have words to describe my awesome experience at this place. Honestly don't have negatives for this place. The room service as well as house keeping staff are awesome. Kasmanda Palace - Our choice for a short 2 day Outdoor Business meeting was based on 2 factors: 1. Backing of Welcom Heritage / ITC. 2. Unavailability of any other property at such short notice. fabulous hotel & ultimate experience in the lap of nature... best scenic beauty..  most cooperating staff & fantastic food...  one of the best heritage hotels in India... pickup & drop facility from mall road to hotel.. a must visit place..

I visited Queen of hills & stayed at Kasmanda Palace hotel with my family. I really appreciate the really good maintenance of the property. stayed with family in royal room of the main old building  from 10th to 14 th april 2014 ..............a true heritage property build in 1843 and even today looks new and perfect rooms are big and well decorated bathrooms need improvement's .The best part of the hotel is there food which  has exceptional  taste's  as true home made food . hotel has a big garden in which every day they have bone fire in evening ..............nothing to complain nice and perfect stay

Old wing is better than the new one.The old wing is a heritage property and well maintained .Excellent food and hospitality .Pick and drop service is available from the hotel to the market.The staff is very cooperative .

The staff is superly courteous and take a personal note of the guests' whims and wishes.
