The walk from road to property was tiring. but all was forgotten once we stepped inside the main building. The staff were very courteous, friendly and helpful. we  had hot drinks and snacks. the food was very good and the staff were also very good. the food was little late but it is understood being the odd hour of the day for food and it is also not located on the main road and have few walk-in for food .  we took a walk around the property. the person on reception was very co-operative, we had a look at the rooms. they looked well maintained . On the whole loved the property. will definitely stay in it if I ever stay in musoorie for a…

We only came to Kasamanda Palace by chance but were very pleased we did.  From telephoning to check rates and availability to our stay the team were courteous and helpful.  The hotel is really well located in the middle of Mussoorie and the steep climb is no barriers as the hotel car is there to whizz you up and down whenever you need.  We enjoyed the relaxed attitude of the hotel to breakfast, where you can choose where to take it - room, garden, terrace.  It's a super pretty hotel, with nice rooms.  Remember it's a genuine heritage place, not a modern one, and it's lovely.  Gorgeous views from the rooms at sunrise.

THis place made our stay in mussoorie a much memorable one. The experience was so good that we just didn't want to go out and explore the city- but enjoy d ambience of d palace. Friendly staff, excellent food and the much friendly atmosphere is worth mentioning

We stayed at Kasmanda between 29 -Sept- 02nd Oct, in the Royal Rooms. It was one of the finest trips we have experienced as a group.  The rooms were elegant and spacious. The foyer and the lobby was excellently managed; good soothing music to the ears and freshness of the garden all around. It was simply mesmirising experience & beautiful settings. One of the major highlight of our stay off, was the brilliant food that the chef provided in all the buffet meals. The staff was also well mannered and courteous.  I will comeback to Kasmanda again when I am in Mussoorie and I strongly recommend the same  to everyone who is looking forward to a nice and pleasurable holidat

We had lunch at Kasmanda Palace recently. It was a misty, cloudy day with clouds coming in from the Doon Valley. Very pleasant experience with nicely chilled beer. The garden was redolent with smells of Nargis and Magnolia and there was a magical feel to the afternoon. The food was good too. Onion soup, fried fish and some Indian curry.   A great place for a relaxed lunch on a summer day.

One of the best located amongst the lot in its category.Following the present trend amongst regular and avid traveller,the preference today is to stay farther from hill stations(due to obvious reasons like overcrowding and traffic etc.).But with this boutique hotel you can ignore that concern.Large rooms,manicured gardena, nice sit outs,impressive facade,quiet location and ideal proximity to the popular mall road...these are the few parameters,where it scores head on against other equally priced accomodations. Erstwhile retreat of some prominent(read royally connected family of some region in uttar pradesh...i think 'kasmanda' itself)..whose fascination for hunting is evident from the many trophies( animal heads) adorning the corridors, is now a boutique hotel. For the…

Kasmanda Palace is an old princely mansion which is run as a heritage hotel now by WelcomeHeritage and retains oodles of the old world charm  which makes it a nice place to stay in Mussoorie. Located at the edge of the mall road, it affords great views of the Doon valley below on a clear night. The major commercial area of the mall is about a 10 minute walk away though you can also get cycle rickshaws if you wish to avoid the walk. The hotel is located up a steep incline which will severely test your leg muscles if you are not used to walking but they also run a free car service until 10 PM which will pick and drop you to the road below so you dont have to exert if you cant.    The main section, which dates back to its days of the royal Kasmanda family is quite old and bears the…

Had the pleasure of staying in this hotel last month and we had most wonderful experience.  this is the best hotel we have ever stayed suitable for kids,old palace but very well managed, every small detail is taken care of,well organised although so many guests.   The bedroom was also very spacious. One small critism was I did not think the bed reading light sufficient (but this was unimportant). There was also a mirror with table and seat (for ladies to do their make up and a dressing area, before arriving at the bathroom.  I highly recomend this hotel, for the rooms, the service and the staff. It is rare to find that they all work together to provide a really good guest experience. Although I like trying different hotels, on my next visit to Mussoorie I will definitely stay at…

My wife and I stayed here in June 2012. Kasmanda Palace is a heritage property located just off the Mall road towards the Library Chowk. Though it is located in the middle of the Mall road, it is perched on top of a beautiful hill, which isolates you from the din below. Make sure that you get a room that overlooks the valley which guarantees spectacular views.   The Hotel is very charming with large wooden staircases, photos and paintings of the royal era, antique furniture, animal skins etc. The food is ok. Ensure that you sit for breakfast at the open porch below the restaurant. Its beautiful. There is a beautiful lawn where you can enjoy the cool breeze and nice views.   The rooms themselves are fine. Nothing spectacular. But they are clean and spacious and the hotel staff…

Kasmanda Palace is a very beautiful and heritage resort - something totally unexpected in the busy Mussoorie. The place is above the main road - but they have cabs to get you at the foothill - 1 minute drive, free of charge. It is very close to the market area. The architecture and the rooms rooms remind you of the royal era but the rooms have all modern amenities. Its good fun just to roam around the property. The staff is very friendly. I fell sick when I stayed there and they arranged for a doctor and even got medicines from the market. The food we had was good (although I couldnt have much). I would recommned this to anyone who wants to have some sort of luxury there. It is better experience than the typical 4 to 5 stars there.

These were even prior to our courtship days, I wanted to surprise Jasmine & took her to Mussourie on Holi. We thanked our stars as we got a First Class Coupe in the train to Dehradun and the following morning, we reached Mussourie in an hour by hiring a cab from there. Kasmanda Palace is an old world charm; nestle amongst the church, narrow walk-ways, on a hill. We enjoyed the hospitality of WelcomHeritage and loved our room and its incredible view of the mountains. Our gourmet experience at the Palace was also great and we thoroughly enjoyed our breakfast at the terrace as the Sun kissed our souls. The Palace’s architecture was Princely and it would occasionally rain during the day, which made a perfect setting for us. We wanted to stay longer but due to duty calls and our…

In the middle of Mussoorie Mall's hustle & bustle, this place is like an oasis. Very good service levels and good ambience. The old fashioned Rooms are great attraction and remind you of the era gone by. Linen are clean and bathrooms modern. View from the lawn is excellent. The Wagon-R shuttle to the mall level is prompt & efficient.

A great hotel, rooms are luxurious and spacious. Lobbys are well decorated and provide a great ambience with walls showcasing real animal skin. Hotel staff are warm and helpfull.  The morning breakfast, complimentary with the room was good, however the meals from the resturant (not complimentary) were not to the mark and require improvement.  View the room was fantastic.. complete downhill view.  Overall a great experience !!! Highly recommended !!!

nice and decent, royal rooms are cool, deluxe and other categories suck!!!! food is good, they make items according to ur prefrence. the staff is nice and cordial, best part is in the heaviest season we got the rooms.

A wonderful heritage property. Good room with all required amenities, lots of game trophies (Tigers, Leopards etc.)  which do look good but can make you sad as well. The property is very near to mall road and other attaractions of mussorie.

It was indeed a nice & beautiful experience while me & my family stayed at Kasmanda Palace during end June 2012.   The hospitality of the Kasmanda team is exceptional. You do not require to ask for assistance, they understand your need.  It is undeniably the best heritage property in Mussoorie. Imagine, you are staying in a Palace that built around 175 years back. The interior decor reminds the style the Princes used to live. We stayed in Royal Room which has the old charm with the present day comfort.  Foods were awesome. Whether it is Breakfast or Lunch/Dinner or even snacks, they take care of your health.  We will definitely visit again to Kasmanda Palace next time we are in Mussoorie.  May God bless all.  S. N. Bose

very nice location and center of the city. nice view of the town. Gives you a royal feeling staying there. Very good ambiance. The food is also good. close to mall road gave my wife and sister full time to explore the market area. They can improve on there board room activities. overall full value of money. General manager sales was an excellent person and if given a chance I would definaetly stay back there again.

From the time we reserved we felt like special guests.we were met by the manager at front office and he was a wealth of info!He got us checked in and gave us a map of Mussoorie and highlighted some hot spots. Our familily room was great....morr than big enough to accomodate the three of us. Bathroom is good size and plumbing is excellent (by other standards seen!). This hotel is also close to many of the main attractions in Mussoorie,which was nice. The day we left the front office staff called us a taxi to get to the train station. Overall this was an excellent place to stay and we would definetly return and recommend it to our friends.

Kasmanda palace is a treat for the senses. Let me give the pros first :  1. You will feel really indulgent . The rooms are opulent and yet extremely cozy. 2. Great location if you are in the mood for shopping. It is right on Mall road.  3. Excellent place for breakfast and a morning Walk. Surroundings are well maintained. Offers a nice view of the valley down while having breakfast (Definitely the high point of our visit)   And the one con of the place ?  1. Lunch/dinner was just passable. For a place as opulent as the Kasmanda Palace, you would definitely expect better tasting food.Breakfast was good but then it doesn't take much to make a good breakfast.

I went to Kasmanda Palace with my wife to spend a long weekend. The hotel turned out to be better than what we expected. Very quite, clean, nice food, friendly room service. Nice garden to spend some time. I have recommended it to a couple of my friends and their stay has been a pleasurable one as well.

It is a very nice place to stay and enjoy Holiday in Mussoorie.  The Location is very good.  Service is excellent.  Food and restaurant is funtastic. highly recommended. It is a heritage hotel and rooms are very spacious and clean.  They have a very good lawn which is very good and quite place to relax.

The hotel looks majestic both from outside and inside. The reception people are cordial and helpful. However do not expect breathtaking view of Doon Valley from the hotel room. One more thing to be noted. The food option is very limited and the taste of food is really pathetic.

Nothing is wrong with Kasmanda Palace but everything is right. We have stayed in to different rooms now and each are beautiful and comfortable with everything you could expect of a Heritage Hotel. All staff are welcoming, friendly and informative. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable with lovely valley view and in a good location being close to all amenties. The food served during the day and evening was well presented and delicious. All in all we had a great time. Going through the below reveiw we know how hard it is to please everyone but for us the Kasmanda Palace certainly succedes.

Having stayed in other properties of welcomheritage group, we expected a decent stay in Mussoorie at Kasmanda Palace but the experience was disappointing. The staff is indifferent at best, discourteous at worst. The amenities in the room are nothing worth to talk about - a 14 inch TV set in a room for which u pay 6500 per day, furnishings which have not been washed since the hotel was built, rugs that stink and creaking beds. We visited in off season so we were expected to place our order for dinner 4 hours in advance, specify the amount that we would eat and from the limited menu. The food was awful. Looking at the wonderful properties now available in Mussoorie the only reason to visit this place would be if you love dingy old buildings with carcasses of dead animals or if u r…

This place is a royal palace converted into a heritage hotel.  It is run by ITC.  The hotel is located at a height and you can get great views from here.  Prefer staying at the old wing as the rooms offer a great view and old style living.  Food is excellent and the service is also very good.  They go the extra mile to make your stay very comfortable.  Highly recommended!!!!

The hotel is situated right above Mall Road. There is a steep climb up to reach the hotel & if you are not confident of being able to handle your car up the steep climb, they will get it up for you.  The location is very central and that gives you the freedom to go down to the Mall Road whenevr you please to and come back and rest if needed.  Rooms & bathrooms are big. There's a nice terrace & garden area where you can enjoy the atmosphere. So, even though they over-charge for the services, the brilliant weather in Mussoorie makes you forget about the cost.  Food was okay but it lacked on variety. If it is an option, opt to pay only for the room tariff & try the restaurants that are famous on Mall Road.

It was an impromptu decision to stay at Kasmanda while looking for a stay in mussorrie. We had initially decided to stay at Fort Manor but came down to the mall to look for alternatives. The property is very beautiful and the service is simply superb !! The food choices are limited but made by very talented chefs.  Early morning breakfast at the terrace overseeing the valley is highly recommended !!   Kasmanda is the best place for a weekend getaway.

The hotel is a lovely property nestled atop the Mall Road at Mussoorie. The rooms, lobby and stairs speak continuously of the golden age of the Maharajas in India. The gardens are well kept, boast of a large variety of flora typical to Garwal and offer a panoramic view of the Doon Valley. The persons manning the hotel are very courteous, are knowledgeable on local cultures, always eager to help us and advise us on the best way to spend the holidays there. Food is good; the hotel is real value for money. Note: TRY WALKING UP THE STEEP INCLINE FROM THE MALL ROAD TO THE HOTEL. It will test your physique Always opt for the Superior rooms for breathtaking views of the hills and valleys

My family and I had a short break in Mussoorie last month. This hotel was recommended by a colleague of mine who had stayed there and spoke very highly of the Hotel and its services.   It was my husband's birthday, the lovely hotel general manager Mr.Ahmad even prepared a surprising birthday cake. What a touching moment! We had a very good sized room with Doon Valley View. It's very nice to stay in a hotel with period atmosphere instead of a soulless convention-centred building. The location is fab, a few mins walk from the Mall Road and also they have a pick up and drop facility for the guests upto the main road.  The hotel and its services were truly exceptional.Being a Heritage Hotel built in 1836 must say,that the management has really maintained the palace.  The service is…

The place is situated at a very great  height and it is a awesome property.But when I was staying at kasmanda I used to hear strange sounds coming from the lobby and from the washrooms. Otherwise it is a great place to stay and great food.But I would rate this hotel  as a haunted place.If you want to experience some thrill go to this place as the mysterious shadow of a man in your room might give you goosebumps in the night.

Nice heritage property which was once a palace is now a hotel maintained by one of the best groups in India. Very nice location with a view of Mussoorie as well as Dehradoon. Enjoy dinner served at the top with cool breeze passing by and allowing a wind chime to ring hidden somewhere in the tall pine trees with this magnificent view. The only problem with the hotel is reaching it after 10 PM. Its located above The Mall and a chauffeur driven car is always waiting for you on The Mall to take to the hotel.

Every thing was awesome, probably teh best view in Mussourie one can get is from here. Food is great, rooms and dining room could be bettr but seeing that its heritage and value for money a great stay.   The garden is huge and well kept.

Maybe I'm just not a fan of the heritage style, or maybe it's because I found Mussoorie itself pretty underwhelming (especially in peak season!) but I found the room tired and not terribly comfortable.  That said, we had a lovely a la carte lunch overlooking the valley when we arrived. And the sense of history and many objects on display are certainly interesting. I wanted to like this place more, but it just didn't quite win me over.

we were a part of a large group of friends with families to celebrate the new year! the hotel location is great...gr8 views. rooms were clean, neat, wooden floors in the new wing ( which is a must given the allergies that abound in carpets. Hotel has a history behind it... and it shows. Service was excellent... requests were attended to promptly and with a smile !

Oh what a hotel in a place like Mussorie...Beautiful rooms, patio, view from the hotel....Its just great... They have a wonderful garden which has exotic birds...Its a wonderful stroll there...  The service is not that great but I don't think that you expect the food to be Fast Food....Food is average & yes a little expensive as well....  If you are going to Mussorie and you want to stay away from the crowd and don't want to be scared...stay here....its perfect place to stay with family...  One of my friend has gone with my recommendation & has come back spell bound....

As you enter through the main door of this hotel, the first thing you would see is the giant fleet of stairs reminding you of the age old legacy that it carries. This hotel is aptly situated at a vantage point giving you a sumptuous view of the Mussorie town and Dehradun. In the night, as the town gets lit up, you feel as if the stars have descended on earth. The hotel is replete with mug shots of wild animals quietly indicating the fervor with which the erstwhile royalty engaged in their recreation. The many photos of the royal family, ancient leather furniture, radio etc. literally take you back in time. The rooms are spacious and the staffs, well, treat you no less than a king.  The hotel is conveniently approachable from the famous Mall road yet is comfortably away from the…

We ended up here last minute on a recommendation from a friend. They gave me a great price as we were walking in without a reservation. The hotel is in a beautiful old palace/fortress and has great ambiance throughout the hallways and rooms. Every room is a little different and individually decorated as I was shown a few rooms that were available to choose from. We took the lowest priced room but it was huge and had plenty of room for us plus our 3 kids. The staff was friendly and quick to help with all our needs, even setting up the mattresses for the kids on the floor while we were out eating dinner. The hotel has a great overlook of the valley and down to the Mall Road including a terrace for outdoor eating. There is a lawn and a small kids play area that was great for the…

The property was selected to have the family a great summer vacation in the picturisque mussorrie. The property has a very good location and is situated on a hill-top. it is located on the mall and the hotel provides pick and drop free of cost from the Mall. The rooms are well done and the food choice offered in buffeet is also good.

right in the middle of the Mall road... yet away from the noise and crowd. excellent view and hotel!  the only draw back of this place is that everything in the hotel closes at 10 pm.. so after that u cant even get a cold drink! even the free car service to and back form the mall shuts at 10.

If it' Mussoorie for me next time? It surely would be Kasmanda Palace. The views are astounding perhaps the best in Mussoorie any hotel can offer. The food was outstanding, and very reasonable. It was the best holiday experience so far I have ever had in any hill station of India.   Food is good but ordering north indian starterse good rather than trying local meals
Staying in Kasmanda Palace made us living in a royal way.  It gave us the experience of the Heritage India.

I liked this hotel. Some of the rooms are palatial whilst others are a little small. We had a small room but it was comfortable.  One down side was that our bathroom had a window (high up) openning into the bathroom of the person next door.  They smoked so everytime we went into the loo we had to breathe in stale smoke.  Interestingly enough you could hear every sound from the next bathroom.  The hotel put on bonfires in the evening and the food was good - especially from the menu.  The town is fantastic and the views are astonishing.  A chair lift to the top of gun hill is beautifully tacky.  The municipal gardens are great but the forest above them is even better.  Do not try to change money in the bank unless you have plenty of time or enjoy watching Indian bureaucracy.  I…

My overall experience was good. We had been there with friends and we had awesome time there. Food was good with ala carte in weekdays and buffet on weekends. Rooms have retained the royal touch and are well kept but my room had uninvited guests(rats). We had to shoo them in the middle of the night. I had left a feedback on this at the hotel desk. Hope they have got rid of them by now. Except for this instance rest of the things were fine.

I had booked superior room holiday package to celebrate the new year eve with my family. I received a confirmation per return email by the Manager Naveer Chandel and deposited an advance to their account.  However when I check in at the hotel at 5:30 p.m. I am surpised to see that they had downgraded me to a deluxe room (much cheaper).  No where to go at the wee hours, I check in at the hotel and check out the very next day. On my check out I am further surprised by the inhospitable manager, who demands me extra payment for some petty charges. Which I firmly refused and made a vow to drag him to the court. I am sure he did this on purpose to earn more revenue for his company, hoping I would hardly come to know the difference in the rooms. However I had seen photos of superior…

Kasmanda palace...as the name implies, is indeed a beatifully maintained summer palace of the erstwhile Kasmanda royal family.  Step into the lobby, and you're transported some 80 years back in time..just wonderful. The hotel sits on a hill, quite a climb from the mall road. The view of the Doon valley below is simply spectacular. The night times are awesomely romantic :) with a sweet li'l park and benches lined along to steal away a few moments. Our room was on the groud floor, very nicely appointed and quite big. All modern amenities are included in the rooms.  The hospitality was simply fantastic. The food was great, and so was room service. They usually had lunch and dinner buffets, with quite a wide spread of food, ranging from Indian to continental to Italian.  Overall, we…

Kasmanda Palace is an old Palace of the local royals, converted into an hotel. This is not to be confused with Kasmanda Lodge which is right next door and is a modern building.  Being a Palace, its in prime location in Mussoorie, i.e., at the heighest point in the town. Unfortunately, that also means a steep walk, considering that it is a part of the town where vehicles are not allowed. So, be prepared to move your luggage into hand rickshaws to move to the hotel. The management has a small car (Wagon R) that it uses to lug up the luggage and customers from the starting point of their gate to the property itself.  Being a heritage property can be a disadvantage, if the property is not as lavish as the palaces in Rajasthan. Kasmanda is one such property. Its mostly wood and…

This hotel has definitely seen better days.  It was the most expensive hotel we stayed in on our two week tour of India, and was definitely not value for money.  It must have been a beautiful place once, but is now run down, and a bit sad.  The views frrom our room were lovely, but the sheets did not look clean, there was no hot water in the morning, and worst of all, the breakfast included a very large insect in my tea, which I poured from the teapot into my cup. They did not seem too bothered by any of this, and at a less expensive hotel in India, all of this would be have been almost acceptable, but this was not a cheap option.  I would not recommend this hotel.

i stayed at this place after reading reviews on tripadvisor, and am absolutely convinced that this is the best place to stay @ if in mussourie...the food was outstanding...very reasonable..much reasonable  than the sidey restaurants on the mall road....the staff very courteous and go to any lengths to serve you and help you..the hotel manager kindly upgraded us to the royal room though we had reserved the superior room as we were a family of four...the rooms are very neat ,spacious ..well ,rather very spacious..the bathroom is the size of a normal room in many hotels!...they even served us breakfast in our rroms when we had missed to get down on time..that too without we insisting?? the views of the hotel are astounding, perhaps the best in mussourie..better than the few must…

This is the kind of place I was longing to stay for some time now, having  worked under stressful conditions for the past 6-8 months without a proper break. Things are still very leisurly paced here and so is the place, or that is what I experienced and loved the most. There is no hurring and one can dectate his / her own pace here. No hostle-bustle while still on the Mall. The car service from and to the Mall is a very well thoughtful addition to the otherwise delightful service. A good expanse of lawn for children to let off their vent as you take a leisurly stroll on the path encircling the lawns overloking the Doon valley. Bon-fire in the evening with family from a very private vantage point from the hotel looking right into the magnificient Valley of the Doon in clear stary…

A superb romantic getaway... superb location.. great surrounding..  Old world charm ... rooms are very big and give you a great feeling of luxury.   Lots of Royalty elements thrown all over the palace of the Maharaja's hunting trophies.   Exclusive place for hill station romantic getaway.

Nice little hotel with nice views of the hill town. Very steep climb up from the Mall Road is this hotel.  Few hotel rooms with big size rooms looking into a gardfen. they ahve a nice fireplace in the middle of the garden which is a nice place to sit in the evenings.   Good hotel with decent food.

Neat and clean. Friendly staff, good food. Average location. Large area - could have been maintained better. The doors and windows  need maintenance. We did have lot of cold mountain breeze sneaking in through the doors at night.

We book the property through some tie ups and so will not be able to comment on the price charged by them as we got a big discount. The property is located a little uphill on Mall Road but it is very convinient travelling as the hotel has a car service which drops and picks up guests from Mall Road. The views from the hotel are good and so is the food. However room service is only upto 9 pm so its better to order well in advance. We stayed in a superior room which was fairly large with an old world charm to it however no bath tub in the bathroom. Service was good overall but being a small hotel the menu is a bit limited.

We took our young children (6 and 2) for a 4 day winter break in Mussoorrie.    Hotel: lovely old building, sad but interesting hunting trophies.  Kids loved playing in the grounds.  Huge rooms - not quite as grand as the website claims.    But in November freezing - it was warmer outside than in, even at night.  Rooms have fire places but all you get is a passive plug in electric heater which does not have much impact and fizzed and crackled at the plug point.    Bathrooms also clean but freezing - we hardly bathed because - despite plenty hot water - rooms were tiled and cold.  In a hotel like this - and given that they water the garden - a bath tub would be nice.  Given the price, and the heritage theme, how about log fire and bath in some rooms?  They burn wood for outside…

This is a very nice hotel with reasonable prices and a very good service. The hotel is located slightly above Mussoorie's famous Mall Road, and near an old English church. The villa, a colonial British style mansion, was bought by the Maharaja of Kasmanda as their holiday home and is still filled with a lot of memorabilia, including hunting trophies (including a rhino-head!). The family still inhabits a lodge next door.  The rooms (we stayed in a deluxe room) are very spacious, with a separate dressing area and a spacious bathroom with skylight. We went on a cold day, so a heater was supplied and hot water bottles were placed in the bed. There's also a complementary pick up service from down the hill to the Mall Road (which is pedestrianised at busy hours of the day). The views…
Excellent service right down to the hotel car always seeming to be waiting to take us up the steep hill whenever we arrived back from the town or from local walks.

The hotel from outside is decent; rooms very basic. Kitchen is outsourced: the serving staff is untrained, cook rude and portions very small for the price.  Owner is not hospitable. He has blatant  focus on profiteering. Housekeeping untrained. Local kids working at the hotel are inadequately trained and low paid. Working 12 hours in cold weather without proper shoes since they can’t afford it. Untasteful stay.

We really loved the place and our stay was very confortable. Sumit and Deepak have been very kind staff. It is always good to see Tapovan again and get to know more things about Mussourie! We highly recommend this place for stay!

Its a heritage hotel with good rooms,  nice upholstery, good valley view. The food is a bit costly but good. Bt i am a bit disheartened with the service. Although the service delivery is quite quick bt it needs to be a bit more professional.  I stayed there for 3 days and not even on a single day did the housekeeping come to clean the rooms or the bathroom.  As for toiletries,  they just provide with a small soap bar and 2 sachets of shampoo and a worn out towel. No tissue rolls.  The hotel is very close to the mall on a stiff peak very difficult for senior citizens to commute. My parents who were senior Citizens had to choose staying in the rooms since we didnt have a car at disposal.   Apart from the above issue i would say that the property is at an excellent location.

The hotel is very beautiful and very peaceful situated on mall Road. The interior and exterior of the hotel are very well managed. The hotel staff is very kind and cooperative. we had the super deluxe room the room was spacious with a balcony and the food quality is also good. Overall stay at this hotel was very good.

I'm a solo female traveller. Loved the vibe of the hotel. The manager was a very humble and polite man who made the check in process very easy.  Everything was really neat and clean and they were asking everyone to wear their masks and maintain social distancing.  The view from the room was really good but what I really liked was their gardens.  One could just sit there all day sipping tea and munching snacks.  The best part is the location of the hotel. One could just walk to the Mall road or to Landour. It's very convenient.  I'm definitely coming here again either with friends or with family or maybe even another solo trip.  I'd definitely recommend it for female travellers as the place feels very safe.

The location of the hotel is excellent as it is walkable to the prime locations nearby. The rooms were lavish and cozy. The view from the hotel was legendary. The pricing of the hotel rooms is also very reasonable and the staff is approachable. Highly recommended.

A great place with great staff. Got amazing view and the rooms are spacious. Very near Mall Road and little lhama cafe. Would always go here if I go to Mussoorie again. We had gone with a big group and everyone enjoyed the stay.

An amazing place to stay with awesome views! The folks running this is place are amazing and accommodating! Rooms were clean, easy to access. Not too far way from the Mall Road. Someone was always available when we needed to park our cars in the gated secure parking - even at odd hours!

Good management. Mr. Sumit was very humble and kind person. Most highly recommended from my side. The outside view was very beautiful like heaven. All the staff members was very much friendly and supportive.

Overall I was very well satisfied with the Services . Especially with the Manager(Mr.Sumit).He was very Co-Operative in nature,Very Polite Behaviour.He was very well dressed.People like Mr.Sumit..They are the real pillars of HIMALAYAN CLUB.The suite was Awsome.Everything including the View,The behaviour of Staffs,The Parking facility everything was soo Good and i was very well satisfied. Internet connection a little temperamental, but with faster and more stable options elsewhere in town, this wasn't a problem for my stay. Beautiful place located at the peak of mussoorie hills. Himalayan club looks like It's straight come out of a an old colonial home. Gorgeous view of the misty mountains, courteous staff at the reception, yum food and lovely property. Please choose this place. Lovely service by nice ppl

It has become a family tradition for us to visit Mussoorie and stay at Hotel Himalayan Club. The ambience is lovely, the courtyard is filled with flowers and natural beauty. We stayed here for a few nights. It is a beautiful space with lovely buildings. The staff were a little clueless though the owner was very knowledgeable and friendly. Overall I would possibly go back. For the price it was pretty good. I wish they worked a little harder on making it great, it has potential.

We have stayed in this hotel for 3 days on a family holiday. We took 3 rooms.  As soon as we reached we asked for change of room type and building as the new building was at some height and my parents being old were finding it difficult to climb. It was done instantly without even negotiations for any charges.  The hotel staff are very courteous and are always ready to help. We had 2 infants with us, and we never had to worry about their food, milk and other needs.  I would highly recommend this place, as this is really nice, neat and clean, it has a great location, excellent view and great staff.  Hope to see you guys again soon.

So this would be a perfectly fine place if you didn't mind lack of toilet paper,no heat (the nights were cold), no bedside lamps, only 2 of the 6 lights in the room working, musty towels, dirty walls, mouldy shower and shower curtain (water running from the ceiling down the shower wall), no maid service and a toilet that wouldn't stop leaking on the floor even after we asked them to fix it. Pros: Amazing property. Own parking. Good food. Good spacious rooms. Nice courtyard. Well decorated. Cheap. Just at the cinema Hall end of mall Road. Nice restaurants nearby. Trip has been awesome apart from Journey part as it was very crowded in long weekend. Coming to hotel, staff was nice, queires and other concerns were entertained and bone file at night was very awesome.

Not only one has to go to a very difficult route and steep climb, the maintenance of the place is so poor that you turn the tap and it comes into your hand the food is horrible and to add insult to injury they are charging much more then shown on websites and there argument is the websites are putting money from there own pocket

This hotel view is really great and located few walking minutes away from Mall road.   Staff's here are very helping and at your service when any request is made for any difficulties in the service provided by them. Awesome location  Tasty food  Great service  Why else you want in mussorie . This is  the best place for budget customers dnt expect too much . I visited the hotel in month of August with my friends . We enjoyed a lot.

loctaion of hotel is good . room service is very good rooms were big and nice .always wants to stay in this hotel and enjoy the exprience  only this year i got the chance to stay there and in future always want to stay there food is good staff is co-oparative

Hotel is at height.two buildings one is in hotel and other is far from hotel.the new building is at more height.prefer rooms in old building because veiw is better from there.rooms and washrooms are neat.food is liitle expensive and average.room service is good.hotel is nearby picture palace.

We were 2 families including parents and children. We had a nice stay with all facilities. Hotel is worth at this price.  The new wing of hotel have rooms with nice view but not recommended for older people as you have to climb a bit of uphill.  There is enough space for parking if you have a car or two.  Bathrooms are good in size and clean.

A nice property with two areas one is with the rooms near and around reception area other one is just opposite to hotel it has staircase going up to the rooms which are newly constructed rooms are good spacious clean tasty food is well priced .staff is helpfulduring peak season the rates go as high as 2200+ which ishigh as there is no other amenity like free breakfast or other recreational activities overall I have start there twice and have lOved it WiFi workes near reception area only and is free. Property located near picture palace and has parking too.

We stayed in a family suite which was comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel has a nice old worldly charm. There are well planted flower shrubs around. However the food is average.

its located towards picture palace and hence u get less traffic than library side of mussoorie. the place has simple no frill rooms. the staff is good and the owner is a polite man who makes you comfortable. u get what u pay for. expect what u should,and you wont be dissapointed !

We stayed at Himalayan club from 25th to 28th june 2015 and were really impressed with the beautiful surroundings,nicely maintained front area with pebbles and flowers.The manager was very considerate to immediately change our family suite to main complex on knowing that my elderly  mother would be unable to climb ,rather he upgraded our family suite from standard to deluxe with no extracharge.The staff and helper boys were extremely efficient with very prompt room service.I would really recommend the place very safe for women/children .My seven year daughter had a great time taking her selfies in the Himalayan club and playing ball and blowing bubbles .The restraurant service was also appreciable as they were very adjusting to the food requirement especially no spicy food for…

Mussorrie is a good place to visit at this time. Climate was cooler in the evening time and in day time it was little hotter but good for travelling.Food is awesome for veggie people and there are several options available.For shopping it is not economical to purchase from Hills. Overall good experience.

it was an amazing experience staying with this famous heritage.Rooms are with lots of space easily available with extra bed if required.Quality of food was outstanding,one does not need to outside to have food,reasenable price with good taste.Staff was very pleased they were available all the time to serve us better.Ohner of the property was available everytime,very down to earth,cooperative,well behaved.Washrooms are so neat n clean,one can try to sleep there too.  Overall it was an amazing experience staying with "HOTEL HIMALYAN CLUB" .I refer u guys to stay at this hotel and enjoy the fun..!!!

This is worst hotel I have stayed in my life. They make you fool by showing good pics but even they don't provide basic facilities forget abt anything gud u r looking from hotels. The hotel is reasonably priced and has good rooms and suites to spend time at leisure. Food at the restaurant is not something to write about. Try to avoid eating at the hotel.  New block is preferable.

A really nice place . Very hospitable and pleasant staff and management . Very nice property overstayed a day just loved it . Had  nice outdoor dinner in the evening in the courtyard . 4 stars From mee for value for money .

I have stayed at better hotels at this price. Room was poor and so was bathroom. Most of the time the television did not work. The whole feel was that of a dharamshala not a hotel. Staff was attentive but they cannot change the quality of the room.

I was there from 11th to 13th June.  Booked through Cleartrip.  Nicely located, just above the Mall Road and great view.  Requested for a triple room but I was offered a double room with extra bed, which was enough for a family like ours.  It was a great experience.  Good, friendly staff, good food provided by in house restaurant and we opted one meal each during our stay and found all pretty good.  Hotel was clean and surroundings are also good with nice parking, although it's full in season time.  Found value for money as it is rightly placed in price segment at tourist place like this.

My son stayed with his cousins in June 2015, horrible experience. After making a call by me changed to a bearable room. The first room was very dirty filled with insects and toilet was dirty. This was referred by someone in Dehradun.

With an amazing view overlooking the valley of lights and an infinite view of the Shivalik.Range...i was very skeptical while booking the hotel but it turned out to be a true value for money with clean linen and prompt service. happy holidays to you :))

Its the best hotel if you are not looking for star rated hotels. I have been staying here for last four years without any problem. Owners of this property also reside in this hotel complex, which is the main reason this property is always well kept and guests are well looked after.

I am so glad I booked my stay in Himalayan Club. The first thing we  noticed was how big and clean the room was. Large windows with amazing  views of the Himalayan mountains. The manager was very nice to talk to  and service was quick. For a budget hotel this place has great value. Market food was very bad and expensive too. Hotel food came as refreshing surprise and was enjoyable to eat in the lawn outside They also have free parking which is an added bonus.

Hotel Himalayan club, the name itself reflects its identity of being an historical place which with changing time has been transformed into a holiday destination for many. Away from hustle bustle of daily life, this hotel is located amidst the mountains with a picturusque view of doon valley. The rooms are quite reasonably priced and the food is good. The hotel owners are quite courteous and this quality reflects in their staff too. New block is beautifully done up and makes u feel at home. When we went to Rockby near Lal tibba we saw historical pictures of this hotel there. So, for me its the best hotel in Musorrie. :)

This is one of tha best hotels i have stayaed in.Tha views from tha                       hotel were great.I really liked tha open spaces to chill and enjoy mossoorie weather.Food was fresh and really good and tha staff was very helpful.Overall great value for money.

We stayed with our family in last week in Super deluxe rooms in Hotel Himalayan Club. The hotel location is near to Clock Tower  with no restrictions of entry to this hotel. I highly recommend to book this place if rooms are available.      Stayed June 2015, travelled with family

Excellent location,awesome view from the rooms.You can see the entire city.The location is ideal and rooms are well maintained.Very cooperative and  friendly staff.Food was very good.Ideal for a weekend break.

The two stars I am giving here are for the location and promt room service.

I have stay in this hotel on 11 june 2015 for one night after seeing ratings on trip advisor but I find the hotel is not as good as it is mentioned in rating . the sevice is very bad location is also not as good as it is mentioned in the site. Overall it is a avg hotel. Not value for money

The interiors r good n so is d room service.. d only thing that bothers is d height...u really hav to walk atleast 1.5 km from mall road to reach d hotel situated at height...the slope is too steep...but overall a gud experience.

This was one of the most memorable stay with my wife anf kid and a couple of Friends with family. Hotel and rooms were beautiful  . courtyard had a european touch to it. I felt like the beer gardens of Munich. Service was excellent. loved the experience.

I was staying that hotel from 30th may 2015 to 2nd june 2015, the hotel was simply excellent. I had been there with a few friends and it was a splendid experience at mussorie. The hotel has a great ambiance, good service with neat and tidy rooms. It's a wonderful hotel located in the midst of Mussoorie, nearby mall road, close to almost everything. The hotel has spacious rooms and spectacular hillside view. I would personally recommend Hotel Himalayan club to every person who would want to experience the breath taking view of the hills. It is truly an amazing experience !!

We were a group of friends and thoroughly enjoyed the property. With almost 100% occupancy also the services were quick and satisfactory. Staff even guided us to a few must visit places, so that we could utilize the maximum time during our 2 day stay. i would recommend this place to anyone looking for a good stay that values your money. Have a pleasant trip :)

Great hotel which has 2 separate wings.........Hari Niwas which is the older block and Gopal Niwas the new block just across the road. We stayed at the latter. Since we had gone during off season, there was no rush of tourists and we had choice of room. The service was prompt and food was good too. Toilets were clean and so were the rooms. The proprietor Sri Amit Vaish was very accomodative and a perfect gentleman. The hotel is perfectly located....within a stone's throw from Mall Rd yet in a calm & serene locality. I would strongly recommend this hotel to all middle budget travellers with family for the very nice ambience it provides

Excellent service, good staff, room service,food,everything was very good. We really enjoyed our stay at Himalayan club. We had booked through net , they gave us best rooms available. There is lot of space for kids to play around. We were 11 members we all had great time staying here.  Next whenever we will go to Mussoorie we will love to stay at HIMALAYAN CLUB.

Family Suite was very good, neat and clean. Excellent Room Service. Very good location Ample Parking space available. Near to Mall road and Kulri Bazar. Recommended to all. Safe to drive into the hotel.

This is a very good family hotel, old but well maintained, divided into two buildings situated on a hill top. Our room was luxury one which has two big clean rooms, bathroom. Hotel has good parking space and is situated near to city and is easily approachable. Recommended to everyone.

Good hotel. Has big size rooms. Staff is very efficient. Well located, 5 minuted walking distance from mall road. Indian food served in restaurant is good however chinese food needs to be better. Price is a bit high. However overall a pleasant stay.

Nice newly renovated rooms,good food,easily approachable,gud staff,amazing view of himalayas from every room...i hav been to HC since last 5 years but never met any complaint regarding services of dis hotel..i alwz enjyd being here specially the property's gardening and the quality of food they serve(its alz fresh and according to ur taste).."Best quality at reasonable prices" is the 1 line specification for dis property....

Good view from some rooms. Location is also good. Staff is co-operative and even allowed us to have our own food. We stayed here in January. Good parking space and lawn is available. Recommended for a short stay when you are out most of the time. They are charging for heaters @500 per night.

We reached there little early before check in time and got the room easily, view from hotel is very good, felt relaxed when checked-in after a long ride from delhi to mussoorie, Frankly speaking wifi was not working properly and indian food is good but  chinese was worst. Hotel is ell connected by road and they have parking space also which is a plus point in any hill area. overall stay was good.

I visited Mussorie in March end with my family and stayed here for 3 nights. I stayed at this hotel due to proximity to mall road; Just 5 minutes walk from mall road and it fits in your budget. The rooms are excellent; comfortable cozy beds and the 24 hour geyser gives you hot water all day long. The room service is very prompt and we enjoyed the morning bed tea and breakfast tremendously.  The hotel has a new wing made with new rooms but the actual charm lies in the old block and if you happen to see old pictures of mussorie you will know that the old wing is 170 years old! And so well maintained. It certainly connected me with years and years of history.  I missed the snow but if you plan to travel to mussorie and it happens to snow, stay here for fantastic views of the city…

Get in touch with Uttam once you checked in. He is simply superb and agile in his service. Always with a smile and ready to help. Food is very good View - Very Good. Can see the mountains from your room. Toilet - Very Good and equiped with 24/7 geyser

Excellent budget hotel in Mussoorie, with nice, spacious rooms that have amazing day and night views of Mussoorie and Dehradun, very peaceful and quiet. best place to stay if you are in mussoorie as view from room is outstanding of course room are spacious and have all modern amenities,  hotel is located near mall road so you can easily have  a stroll in city.... food is good service staff equally good.... will surely be back and thus recommending it to others...

Good budget hotel, good location, close to Mall Road. The rooms were clean, hot water available. But the intercom of one of the room was not working. Best hotel to stay in mussoorie with family from its terrace you can see beautiful view of Dehradun in night, well mantained ,clean with quite location. Big and spacious rooms,value for money, its been more than 10 year we are staying there

The Hotel has a calming aura around it and is best for a relaxing holiday.

Definitely wants me to go there next time I'm in Mussoorie

Recommended   Not so good:  Rooms can be expensive during peak seasons (common to all Mussoorie hotels)  Food is on the expensive side (common to all Mussoorie hotels)  Need to walk up quite a height from the main road (common to most Mussoorie   hotels)   Good:  Excellent rooms  Excellent view of mountains from rooms  Management and staff are extremely courteous  Rooms and premises are very clean  Property is aesthetically pleasing with lots of open areas  Set in a quiet, respectable area and away from the din and noise of the city  But very close to the taxi stand, bus stand, main road (bang on the Picture Palace   Chowk/Kulri Bazar end of the Mall Road), Landour Bazar  Arrangements for heater and geyser available  Food is healthy and tasty  Prompt service  Sight seeing…

I would say just avoid this bloody place if you need a good night sleep.... Reception guys are arrogant. Also the dont accept cards for payment, cash only....

It is a very nice property located little away from mall road... Ample parking... Bful view... Nice not great rooms...  Soundproofing between rooms is poor... It is the best place in mussorie to stay.Higly peaceful place with heavenly views from every side.Lots of open space with a sight of Himalaya.And the best thing is,it is very convenient to mal road,friendly staff,and cheap and clean hotel.

Stay their with your friends and you'll love it . The best part about Hotel Himalayan club is their staff. This hotel is slightly away from the lower road but is very peaceful and a good location.

we were a nice stay at Himalyan club muussoorie. The hotel staff makes our stay very pleasant. This is one nice property in mussoorie.we enjoyed every bit of our stay there. Views are beautiful from here.the staff is very friendly.stay here is economical too.owner Mr vaish is very friendly and looks after the hotel very keenly.

I stayed in this hotel for one night in the month of Nov 2014 with my wife n daughter. I am very happy to share that its a very well maintained spacious hotel with lots of open area and big rooms.  The view of the Himalayan range from the balcony of the hotel was a big bonus. The staff was very cordial n helpful and as it was a bit cold in the night hence on request the hotel staff provided  fire arrangements in the open area free of cost.   The food was also very tasty, we had tried both veg n non-veg. The room service was also very good.   From one side of our balcony we could see the mighty Himalayas and from the other side was the mystic view of the Dehradun valley... which was really awesome during the night time.   We could also see the Gun Hill ( second highest peak of…

Rooms were OK, though certain basic items like a mattress was missing and had to be asked for . While we were charged for an extra bed (compulsory from 6 year old child upwards), they could only provide a mattress which we did not accept. Room heaters are available at Rs 500 per night. The food options were somewhat limited and slightly on the pricier side.

We stayed for 2 days in this hotel on behalf of diwali tour. I would like to stay in this hotel 'n' number of times I would visit mussoorie. Awesome staff, hospitality, valley view.... etc.  Must recommend Dal Makhani-Jeera rice as a food over here to eat. Being gujju the tariffs of rooms are helpful for middle class families. Family suite has 2 bedrooms and a main hall consiting of dining table and sofa set. Area of rooms is much more appreciable.  I just loved the view of mussoorie from family suite and also from garden restaurant.

We stayed there for two nights. Location is really nice in the mall road. View is also very good. We have opted for family room. It was very specious (Appreciated!). Room has few insects and not properly clean. Big windows are there but lock was not good (not sure about the protection). Food quality is good but price is very high. Overall it was a nice experience for us.

This hotel has very good view . Rooms are spacious as we stayed in family suit. Food is slightly costly qty is not matching the price tag. I think  kitchen is our sourced as I paid directly to other person while check out.  If you want to have the food out side you need to walk 15 mins to mall road where there are lot of options.  When we asked for the room heater they said they will charge rs 500 additionally ( we did not take it ) but for your information.

Hospitality was not so much good, room service was slow, view was good, hotel room was good.food was average thoug the prices were reasonable.              _----_--------_---------------+---------------------------

i went there for the first time in mussoorie with my family. would like to thanks to trip advisor because of them i booked this hotel.like to share some points. 1.They gave me pre check-in for two hours without any Extra charge. 2.Room are specious,peaceful,neat and clean.(Deluxe) 3.food is a little costly but delicious(specially kadhai paneer and dal makhani). 3.Tandoori item is not available. 4.There was a room service guy named "Kamlesh" was very polite and promptly responsive. 5.hotel is at little up but walking distance from picture palace bus/taxi stand. 6.would recommend and myself would like to re visit there.

Let me start with good points. Location is good very nice view..  staff friendly..very big spacious room.. reasonable price... delux room on ground floor is good..  Flip side.. suits which are suppose to be best are infact worst.. beds not comfortable.. room not clean.. furniture very old and dirty....T.v not good.. Managment should facelift these rooms.. once should avoid booking suit and go in for delux room.

Stayed at the hotel on the Independence Day weekend. Had gone with a couple of friends. We were given rooms in the Hari Niwas. Must say the view from the room was breathtaking. The hotel is very conveniently located with easy access from the Mall Road. The staff was very polite and courteous.  It's a complete value for money and fits right into your budget. Will definitely go back again to stay on my next visit.

We had a wonderful time at the hotel. The service was very good; staff courteous and the rooms and bathrooms neat and tidy. The view  of the himalaya was the cherry on top of the cake! Overall our stay was great value for money.

The hotel is located at an excellent location, with almost entire Dehradun & Mussoorie view. You can enjoy the valley as well as mountains at the same time.   The hotel staff takes good care of you & the food is also great, loved staying at Himalayan  club.

Well located - a short hop from Mall Road. Spacious. Clean. The best of all - a very courteous staff. We were travelling with a small baby and they very willingly helped with providing us boiled water, making khichdi for the baby etc etc. We stayed in a standard room and found it to be quite comfortable. It is not luxurious - but then, we didnt care for it as we were spending most of the day outside the room.

I stayed at this hotel for the first time in 2013 summer and liked it for its location, hospitality and service they offer. I stayed at this hotel again in  June 2014 during my last visit to Mussoorie and it was a pleasant experience again. I  stayed there for one week and was very much impressed . The best part is its location. The hotel looks beautiful from outside and pretty near to Mall road. My room had a beautiful view . The hospitality was good and I highly recommend this hotel.

The hotel looks beautiful from outside and thats the only good thing about it. The food is awful, even the Tea is not good. Some rooms have good view. Near to Mall road, but steep road to climb while coming to hotel. Service is not professional. They wont change the sheets and clean the room unless ordered. No AC, which sometimes makes the night uncomfortable. The restrooms and bathrooms should be upgraded.

I stayed here this summer. I had a great experience. The location is beautifull i.e. right at the mall and still peacefull. The rooms are really well made and the food here is also brilliant. Overall i loved the place alot.

I had Economy room that too in peek season (Jun 14). Rooms was bit small but it was clean. Room service was good.Hotel has ample parking. It will take 5 min walk from hotel to mall road. Initially i was lost reaching to hotel, but the staff help me over the phone to reach hotel easily. It is worth staying in Himalayan club hotel.  Overall, I am satisfied with my stay.

Hotel Himalyan club is one of the good hotel of Mussorie . It is situated on an awesome location . little bit far away from crowded mall road . The rooms are clean and spacious . Overall the experience is good.  o

Hotel Himalyan Club is one of the vintage hotels in Mussoorie. It is situated on good location (very near to mall road) and the serene downhill view of the hill station. Hotel Himalyan Club is one of the vintage hotels in Mussoorie. It comes out with an amazing location (very near to mall road) and the serene downhill view of the hillstation. Poor quality hotel. Dirty rooms, dirty wardrobe, broken sink. Staff denied to serve tea. Asked extra money for taking me to hospital at night. Said no for one spoon. Spoiled my trip. Worst hotel ever.

Its an amazing hotel with amazing views. I loved the services and the ambiance. Value for money. Hotel is located at very nice place,comparatively at higher altitude & very near to prime location of mall road.

Its my first trip in mussoorie. Overall this hotel is in good location in mussoorie. Location : Good Parking : Good Room Service : Good Food : Not Good, but satisfactory Driver stay facility : Not satisfactory

Hotel is located at very nice place,comparatively at higher altitude & very near to prime location of mall road.I stayed in deluxe room which had view of gun hill from the room window.Staff are polite.Food of hotel is slightly expensive but very yummy specialy karahi paneer n chilli chicken.They can even cook as per your preference.Only missing thing was that staff were not very much aware about famous places & routs of mussorie.Overall good experience & would recommend this hotel.

We stayed in room 205, as per the suggestion of a reviewer. The room had very beautiful views and a small balcony as well.  Their common area is very beautiful and the staff very polite.  However, I gave one star less because the room required upgrading in terms of interiors. The place has a very beautiful old world vibe about it and the room that I stayed in has a huge potential for a redo.

This is the place to stay when u come to musoorie!!! The staff are very courtious and help full we had reservation from 6 th June the check in time is 12pm and we reached here by 8am still they provided us with the room... Hotel is nice with enthralling location, good food, neat rooms, friendly service staff..ample parking..walking distance to mall road...pleasant experience. Recommended for the young...................

Will recommend this property for any visitor coming to Mussoorie. Anybody staying here once would like to come back again and again. The service is good. Situated within walking distance of Mall Road, you get clear view of the Himalayas. All in all, a great place to enjoy your vacations.

A very good hotel with beautiful views all around.Near to mall road,hotel has a good kitchen with homely food.Cleanliness and ambience very good.we were 3 families in 4 rooms and all the adults and kids were all comfortable.

My husband and I always stay at Hotel Himalayan when we visit Mussoorie. Whilst the rooms are spacious they are simple but clean and the water predictably hot!!!! (which is a verrrrrry important factor for us especially when it's really cold!). The hotel is within easy walking distance of all the shops and the service is and enthusiastic. The hospitality shown to us is always just so warm, sincere and friendly and we so look forward to returning each year.  Kevin and Debi Jones, South Africa

This budget hotel has the potential to make feel the tourists relax. I stayed in this hotel with my family. We got rooms on the first floor. The rooms are very comfortable and aesthetically beautiful. The rooms on first floor have big glass window with a sofa beside it, so that tourists may enjoy the surrounding valleys. The hotel is in close proximity to the mall yet being on an elevated cliff still away from crowd and noise. I would recommend all tourist to take up this hotel and enjoy their stay.

I went to Mussoorie with my family on 20th may for 3 days.         We had wonderful stay at Hotel Himalayan Club. •	The vegetarian food is delicious. An Average hotel with close proximity to mall road, good and prompt service but still lots of scope of improvement e.g food quality, quality of rooms and balcony to be improved, water taps were leaking.

We stayed at Hotel Himalayan Club for 3 nights. We had a very enjoyable stay at this hotel which felt like home away from home. The rooms were spacious and comfortable.The staff were very courteous and the food was excellent. For all those who want to visit Mussorie this is the right place for you.

Went to mussoorie for 3 days in first week of may. Had a very memorable stay at Hotel Himalayan Club.Beautiful view from hotel and just 5 minutes walk from mall road. A very comfortable stay ....relaxing holiday...Had steam service in hotel..which was a treat. Food was excellent ...with the service so promt..overall the hotel room was quite clean.

Went to mussoorie for 3 days in first week of may. Had a very memorable stay at Hotel Himalayan Club.Beautiful view from hotel and just 5 minutes walk from mall road. Hotel is located very near to mall road.   Rooms that we stayed in were 105 & 106 . Noticeable things: Very clean and nice rooms  Suggest take rooms on ground floor in Hari niwas. It was really lovely to stay in a hotel that offered great location and comfort at such a reasonable price. Rooms are bigger than usual and clean with comfortable beds. But we really got turned on by the dinner alongside a bonfire in their courtyard. Real Paisa Vasool.

Me and my wife stayed at this hotel for 2 nights. Stay here for its awesome location, fair price, delicious food and to top it all... Excellent service by the boys. Very close to the mall road yet away from the hustle bustle .... Ample parking space, nice cozy rooms with great view but .... no WiFi. Love to visit again !!

As said a nice stay and relaxing attitude sets any vacation stand apart. That is what we experienced in this hotel. Definitely recommeded and would stay again.

Very good hotel in a very good price. Loacation is good. Near to mall road and far from crowd.  Rooms are spacious. We stayed in deluxe room in gopal niwas. It has good view from the room. They have leased the kitchen to a third party. However it's not that expensive inside. Overall the stay was marvellous.  I would recommend this hotel. I will definitely stay again.

This is the one of the best budget hotel in Mussoorie, I am staying in this hotel since 2000. Specialty of this hotel is clean room, Parking and easy access of Mall road.  We miss only wifi and complimentary breakfast ;)

Hotel Himalayan Club is a clean hospitable hotel. It is built on top of a hillock so you get a lovely view of the Doon Valley as well as the mountains in the north. We had our lunch at a market restaurant, which was really disappointing but for dinner we thought of trying out the hotel. It was a revelation. Great food served with lots of smiles. Their lemon chicken was the best I've ever had. Thank you all at himalyan club for giving us such a memorable stay

The hotel gives you a vintage feel, There is not AC to control the temperature and bedding is very dirty. I asked the staff for toothpaste but they said they cant give it to us because it is not in menu. I suggest don't go to this hotel if you are looking for better options.

I went for holiday with my family in january.the hotel is very good and comfortablein middle of town.view is very scienic and staff is also very courteous. Service is very personlised and homely. property  hotel himalayan club  is located very near to mall road . location is very  fantastic . first thing is environment inside the hotel is just like a family environment . , staff is very cooperative  24 hrs service call any time even mid night also  . rooms are well maintained next is the kitchen is very hygienic , very clean . food was excellent what ever you like they will provide . from the site you can see the doon valley . the lawn is very beautiful you can relax in the lawn  in short what ever the facilities one is looking forward in the hotel are present in this hotel

It was nice hotel andvyou get what you paid.for budget trip it is affordable.food was fine and people friendly.it is centrally located and safe placestoo.hot hower was fine and ac worked well.i recommend this place.

I have been going to this hotel since my childhood with family. The location of this hotel is very good, its calm, spacious and you would feel relaxed over there. If you are coming to mussoorie for relaxing, I would recommend this hotel. The rooms are nice and spacious

At this hotel the food is awesome as if cooked in my home kitchen.. authentic indian food.. I hardly ate in the market..Served hot in the room also.. Comfortable relaxing stay.. This hotel is located very near to picture palace bus stand. This is calm and and cool place to stay. Food quality is not good. Hotel is worth for the money. Staff is supportive and helpful. We have stayed for a day.

We a familiy of four stay here from 10th Oct to 12th Oct. Overall experience was satisfatory. Hotel building & location is good from valley view point. It is quite calm and isolated. Wonderful hotel located in the midst of Mussoorie, nearby mall road. The hotel is located at a very beautiful location and has just been renovated. Hotel is hygienic, clean and has big rooms compare to another hotel, I had stayed last time. I stayed there 4 nights with family and found this hotel total value for money. wonderful location, spacious rooms, good food and personal attention by staff and OWNER himself. Self parking for cars is added bonus. We were arranged a camp-fire also. Overall WONDERFUL experience. DONT miss this Hotel. They have even a steam-room at very affordable rates.

Location, site view, easy approach to mall road, parking facility. Service quality, cleanness, hygienic, best in all these points. Food quality needs a little more attention. Tough it is good. Staff and manager all are very cooperative and well mannered.

Centrally located hotel with good sized, Comfortable and cozy rooms for a family. The ambience is very good. Staffs are corteous, punctual and good. The view from the hotel is excellent. Breakfast is exclusive and excellent.

Among the very good hotels in mussourie. Close to mall road yet away from the crowd. The rooms have very good views. Well trained staff and driver. Bedsheets, pillow, etc.. are bit dirty and not clean as expected. Overall good experience. Food taste also good. They also have multiple options in breakfast too. It's near to mall road so In free time, you can have nice walk or shopping. It's advantage of the location.

Cordial staff, best in class breakfast and excellent service! What else do you need for a great stay. Also it is located outside but a walking distance from the Mall. So keeps you away from all the traffic and noise.Highly recommended.

A very good hotel in prime location in Mussorie. Very near to Library chowk and they have ample parking space. The staff also was very courteous and professional.   But the food options are only Pure Vegetarian ( Not even Egg!), also the blankets provided by the hotel could be much better.

The best part of hotel is its parking and hill views.Its situated on library chowk .I feel so warm welcome by hotel employees . If you are a couple and plan to visit mussoorrie then this hotel is best for you.

If you are looking for super awesome location with in-house parking, courteous staff, super fast room service, good breakfast buffet, neat & clean rooms...Then your search should end at Vishnu Palace.

Room was good, clean and spacious. Himalayan view was excellent. Service was as per expectation. Near to Library chowk and bus stand. Breakfast was delicious. Hotel staffs were helpful. Strongly recommend to stay.

Courteous staff... Excellent service.. Cleanliness and hygiene well mantained... Tasty and hygienic food.. Location is the biggest plus point..I will recommend it for sure.. Loved it.. Had stayed for a week during 2nd week of Jan'20 in a Superior Himalayan view Room.Both of us had a very good view of snow capped mountains and good hospitality during our stay. The location and stay was very pleasant.

its nice hotel with fantastic tasty food very comfortless. location is awesome and specially given us the room with view. unbelievable experience like to visit again ig get opportunity to visit uttrakhaand

Nearby Mall road and Library Chowk, Prime location and near to all tourist spot, Average Pricing of room and food, Food provided was tastey and fresh, Good in Service and rooms,  nice view from Room Parking and restaurant

Nice location, easy to find, view from room is nice, there is a kids play area as well. But, ok ok breakfast - can do better in terms of service (porter availability, food options). We booked one day before and were lucky to get a room - albeit without a view.

Awesome experience. I really enjoyed it. It was a couple trip. The best part of the hotel is that it was at a prime location in mussoorie. View was awesome. Rooms were clean. We stayed here for 4 nights and 5 days and everything was perfect, the staff, the rooms, the food ( we had specific requirement for only honoring food with no onion and no garlic), they arranged fantastic food all the time and the owner of the hotel, Mr Ashish Goel was of personal counsel to us many of the times. This place is close to the market, it's clean with friendly staff & awesome view. Also one thing good bout the hotel is that they do have place for drivers to stay which is really excellent. Good work

The hotel is in the heart of the town, but at the same time very nicely located with ample parking. Excellent breakfast - I would say it's highlight. The hotel cleanliness and room service good. However, the food for room service itself need improvement.

No sense of customer service, waiters run behind for some time and they do not have a tandoor also which is too little thing to have in a hotel which is always full and is in demand always. They just dont want to improve.

We booked Himalayan view superior room and it was worth for money I paid, good privacy, excellent services and food was very tasty.... They have good choices in morning buffet and every item is very well cooked..

Excellent no other comment is require as fully satisfied with hospitality provided by the hotel and the food was delicious and honest staff and management must try to maintain the same and i wish good look.

Really comfortable hotel with all mod cons and large pleasant modern rooms. Helpful staff and great location near Mussoorie Library. Nice breakfast and good value for money. Great views towards the Himalayas.

Hotel was very good, excellent breakfast, convenient location, good service. Staff was courteous, we reached late at night still the staff gave us something to eat even after the restaurant was closed. Lots of parking, good view you can see the full range of mountains from the parking.

Myself and my wife visited Mussorie and stay at Vishnu palace hotel. We have stayed here several times at Mussorie. It is my favorite hotel at Mussorie. The main highlight is that it is situated right in the middle of the market. So everything comes in handy. Food is ok. The Hotel is located very near to the library chowk,Ample parking space available for vehicle,Breakfast is great with lot if choices.The staff is very humble and helpful. Excellent place for family stay

place for family to stay  Good staff and food  Awesome view out there  Special thanks to people in reception Service officers of Government gets discount too Thanks Me and family stayed there twice and we are looking forward to stay again

Good property with nice food and cooperative staff. Spacious room with good facilities only issue with geyser couldn't get hot water in morning. Otherwise it was a nice experience to stay. Food was very nice.

Nice and pleasant stay for 3 days very convenient location near the mall road worth the price.... Quality of food and service was prompt. Recommended for stay with family. Better to take up superior room with valley View.

The best part of this hotel is it's location which is just beside the library Chowk which is one end of the mall road. Since vehicle entry in prohibited in mall road, you will find cycle rickshaws just beside the hotels corner for sightseeing. Hotel has ample parking space. I would recommend you to stay in the Himalaya view rooms of this hotel, which are a bit expensive but the morning view is just worth the cost. Breakfast is buffet and worth the spend. Room service is apt.

I had been with my family on October 2019,  the hotel was clean, staff very polite. Located very close to the market yet quite scenic. The food at the restaurant was very good yet reasonable. Enjoyed my stay.

Things I like about hotel * Location * Cleanliness * Staff behavior * Security * Ample Parking  Just one thing I would like to point out is Service timing was a bit delayed. Rest a pleasant and peaceful stay in Queen of Hills.

Hotel vishnu is very beautiful n clean .n comfortable n staff is very nice in talk n presentable.The food is very great n hygine.I choosed himalayan view room thats aowsome,bed is very comfortable.hotel is very near to market

Just a few steps from Library Chowk/Mall Road, this is the best place to stay in Mussoorie. Rooms had nice Valley view. Cleanliness, food, location everything was perfect. Nothing to complaint. Great Hotel.

Good service... Good location... Good view... Good breakfast buffet...very Cooperative staffs... Good rooms with all comforts... We felt like home.. Dinner in room was an excellent experience.. What else u want

Location and staff behaviour was very supportive. Food and morning breakfast was also very nice.  Amazing location with very impressive view of hills/valley from window of room. It was full utilization of my money spent for the purpose.

Located very close to Mall road the hotel has an awesome view from the room for Himalayan view rooms. Food is of good quality within reasonable price. Washrooms are neat but some effort is required in maintenance as it is smelly at times. But overall a good experience and good stay!

Such a wonderfull expierence. nice  food great hospitality . All  families was satisfied . hotel staff were well manourd and good behaviour. even hotel honour was supervising the event all the time .thanks hotel vishnu palace

We had a great time at this hotel. There is only one thing I would like to point out- the food is a bit over priced. But the quality was very good and it was always delicious. Would like to visit again.
