It was a great experience to stay here. Excellent ambiance. Very humble n supportive staff. Palatable food. Humane management. Looking forward to visit again and refer to others also.  Thank you. Regards....

Good property. Pros:Just near to Mall road.Food is good,only veg.Cleaning is good Cons:Don't have buffet for dinner.Theg say that Himalayan View room is having best view,but actually it's not like that.

The hotel stay was good and hospitality is remembarable. We enjoyed food and nice to have masala dosa and dall kichdi.  Totally wheather was awesome and nice place to visit again. Sure will come again to enjoy the hospitality.

My parents (both senior citizens) visited this hotel during the Dusshera (Oct) of 2019 and had a wonderful stay overlooking the majestic mountains from the superior himalayan view room. The location of the hotel is pretty convenient to go around the various attractions within the city. The overall hotel compound is also very well maintained. Good location,2 min walk from mall road,staff is very helfull, neat n clean,  near by cab stand,  clean,food also gr8,with good service...  Had himalaya view room...  It was gr8 To stay here with my kids But they only serves vegetarian food...

Reasonably priced, value for money. Excellent view. Courteous staff; help voluntarily. Proximity to taxi/bus stand and Mall Rd. Clean toilets and round-the-clock hot water facility. Spacious rooms. Excellent dining facilities.

All the things are very good , it's near to mall road , Room service and breakfast are also very good , Behavior of staf , location and all that things are excellent. Children have enjoyed a lot in hotel as well as mall road ,

I stayed with my wife and two young kids in Vishnu Palace Hotel for 3 days in the month of Oct 2019. We took superior Himalayan view room. View from the room was wonderful. Breakfast buffet was good having lots of variety. Staff was nice, welcoming, quick service and always eager to help. Certainly one of the best hotels in Mussoorie.

Stay was comfortable...Location Excellent....Rooms were good...Washroom can be better...staff was nice...Parking facility was very useful....Breakfast was nice and all vegetarian... fruits choices can be better...

Wonderful excellent behavior so good Punctual well maintained quiet disciplined Himalayan view is superb This hotel is pleasant to stay for all people reasonable in price place is so much clean suggest every person to stay here

I had a comfortable stay. Everything is nice - rooms, service, cleanliness and location (especially if you arrive in your own car). They have ample parking space. Please try to book a room with Himalayan view. Food was ok, the good part is it is quiet near to the mall street and central library. Room maintenance was up to the mark. Room Charges are little bit high.

Nice hotel with ample parking space,clean good and spacious rooms, very close to library walking distance.  Delicious breakfast with good variety. Friendly staff. Room service good. Tea kit in room with electric kettle.

Good location. Ambience were good. Rooms were neat.  break fast good. -ve  Both channel remote and tv remove not working properly. Front desk staff were not flexible not even extend by 1 hour after 2 days are stay,

Location is great as it is on the mall road. Good and very helpful staff. They have pure vegetarian restaurant which serves very   nice breakfast. Rooms and washrooms were clean. Also they have ample parking space inside. Lift is also available which is required as it has 4 floors.

I really like the Hotel Vishnu palace service, food location, cleaniness everything is wonderful If i visit mossurrie again than I definitely want to stay in Hotel Vishnu palace again. This hotel is very good for couple and family stay and staff is also very nive. Food is also very cheap but they serve only vegetarian menu.

The hotel is at a very good location. Very close to mall road and have ample parking facility. Room service was good and the restaurant food was very tasty. The breakfast buffet provided have many options. Overall it was a very good stay for my family.

The hotel is located near the mall road and has polite staff. The hotel's in house kitchen serves good food and breakfast. The view from the room of the hotel of the Himalayas is amazing and feels very peaceful.

It's a great trip, great locality, very god behavior hotel staff and to good breakfast.Hotel are to clean.i wood like and sajest to Hotel Vishnu palace in mussorie for everyone.iF i will again plan for mussorie i will choose only hotel Vishnu palace.

The hotel was amazing. Very quick room service. Friendly staff and rooms were totally worth it in comparison with the price. Food was also very delicious. Though there was a lot of crowd yet they met the room service requests really quickly.

Hotel is located at Prime location near Mall road. Clean and spacious rooms. Opt for rooms with Hill View as other rooms are disappointing to say the least. Rooms are spacious but with old amenities. Location of hotel is best, it is next to Gandhi chowk, main heart of Mussorie. Hotel rooms are also very big & nicely maintained. Staff is very humble & room service is excellent, with genuine prices of food & presentation.

Very good hotel and having good himalayan view rooms.. Very nice to see and enjoy the nature from your bed. Only concern is pure Veg restaurant, no non vegetarian food in the restaurant. However, veg food is also very tasty

The hotel is located very convenient ly,5 minutes walk from the mall road,could see the mountains n valley from the room,staff is very polite n helpful, rooms clean neat n tidy,food vegetarian but very tasty,Overall a great experience.

Room was not comfortable & small.Blankets were not clean.Room service was good.food was tasty.Mountain view from our room was amazing.Take digital money because sometimes cash money not availble.Thank you

Very nice and supportive staff. Clean rooms and ample parking area. I have stayed in this hotel earlier and found this hotel and its rooms far better than others as compared to location, parking, cleanliness and hospitality of hotel staff within the same price range. The location of the Hotel is very prominent. There is ample space for the parking in crowded Library area. The staff and courteous and hospitality is good. Limited veg food options but the taste is good. Blankets not clean and must have covers No other amenities. View from the rooms is awesome

This property is on the library side and right on the mall road.The staff is very good and cooperative.A big Thank you to Ravi and Bhanu  at the reception.Very neat and clean, housekeeping, room service excellent.Breakfast is very good with option of North and South Indian with fruits.Only The chapatis in dinner is not up to mark,they should use chaki atta instead of flour mill.Many restaurants are at a stone throw.Overall it is a nice place to stay.Recommanded, will like to stay again

I was with my family for a long weekend plan in Massoorie. We stayed in Vishnu palace for 2 nights. Had awesome food best service and best scenic view from hotel gallery. Tip for others is go for room with valley view.

Room and location was very good. Sufficient parking space was available which is unexpected in a place like Massoorie. The best thing of this hotel is the quality and the taste of food they serve. Staff was nice.

A delight for pure vegetarians , the food is excellent and the hotel is located exactly in the heart of mussorie . It is very close to many tourist attractions.The management was cooperative and professional as well .

The hotel is at a good location just before mall road starts. Good view from hotel. Good view, great food and cleanliness... These are the basic things everyone looks for in any hotel and this hotel tops in all these... Service was also good... They give room service without any extra charge.... Great place for a family stay... Ample spave for children to play.... Overall a great experience

Our family stay was good at the place.But I think they should work upon the WASHROOMS.Please maintain the vanity as it was broken in almost many rooms.Please provide all toiletries including the hair dryer and Toothbrush for all members room is booked for.Fly Nuisance was a again a problem.But all other things overshoned these limitations. PROS- Room was good (Earlier alloted was dirty with musty odour) Very helpful staff Tasty Food Excellent Buffet breakfast Good view from basement rooms.

Our stay at this hotel was brilliant. We stayed there for 2 nights and didn't have any problem at all. The property is well built and it's located near the library bazaar so no issues of parking. The rooms were spacious and clean. The services were good too. And surprisingly the food was excellent we really liked the food there. The view from the rooms is alright and the only downside is that the rooms do not have any balcony so you can't really enjoy the view that much but you can still get pretty good shots of the view. The prices are good too and breakfast (buffet) is included.

Only the buffet was mostly South Indian, otherwise everything else was good. Rooms were well furnished. Water supply was constant. Water Geyser was working round the clock. Spacious rooms and option for extra bedding also available.

Beautiful views, helpful staff (special thanks to Mr. Ram Singh Rana). Rooms were decent, a little old. Very close to the hustle and bustle of Mussorie, can walk to multiple places.  Food was okay. Excellent value for money.

The biggest advantage of the hotel is its location and ample parking facility. Rooms were nice and having nice view of mountains. The only disadvantage is they have few options in breakfast. They offer south indian food in breakfast

Hotel location is near taxi stand library chowk. Himalayan view rooms are best. Near Gun Hill Point. Mall road starts from here. In house veg restaurant is good. Breakfast at hotel is best with lots of variety. Staffs are polite & professional. Good for family stay.

Hotel room was clean, interior of triple sharing room can be improved. Food quality was very good. Staff behaviour was very nice. Felt good to have word with chef as well. Location of hotel is also good near Mall road and view from hotel is nice.

Very near to mall road speacially they provide free parking facility which is a big challenge in Mussoorie. Rooms are big and speedy room service. Company garden 20 and kempty fall is around 15 km far from hotel(check google for more clarification) Overall good place to stay .

small bathrooms , shower did not work well small uncomfortable sofa cum.bed with poor mattresses  Ac should be provided actually it was very hot in day . otherwise room was good with good restaurant, yummy breakfast buffet and good lunch dinner.

Food is very tasty and good. Staff is very nice ,neat and clean ,we have awesome trip.nice weather and view from my room is very nice.most important thing is that staff is very nice and helpful . enjoyed a lot

Stayed with a large group in 5 deluxe rooms.. excellent location (2 minutes to library Chowk), has it's own parking, good view from rooms, well maintained, courteous and polite staff, excellent food, very spacious rooms..really could not find any fault anywhere.. would highly recommend.

Excellent rooms and service .Courtious staff and 2 mins walk to Mall road  . Had an amazing time and I will recommend to anyone visiting Mussorie .  Free parking and good arrangements for the drivers is an added advantage .

Rooms are clean, food is very delicious and room service is also good.  The staff is very cooperative and helpful.  You will enjoy your visit with your family and friends.  The hotel is on walkable distance from LIbrary road and mall.

Good value for money. Very good restaurant. Good location and staff.  Comfortable rooms and good cleanliness.  Breakfast was very nice with lots of varieties of food.  Viewing gallery was very nice with valley views.

Its a mid budget hotel located at walking distance from Library chowk. Views from hotel are decent but the problem lies with the way staff treats you. The staff was totally non-responsive and unconcerned. In our case, monkey entered in the room to grab some eatables and damaged my cell phone in the process. The management was shamelessly non-responsive & unbothered about it. Even after showing the shattered mobile screen & pics they were ignorant and didn't even had courtesy to apologize (leave apart offering to repair the mobile), for, they failed to inform us during check-in about monkeys' intrusion in the rooms. Besides, the restaurant and breakfast are okay. Rooms are average with smaller than usual washrooms.

We stayed at Vishnu Palace in mid-July during the monsoon season and were overly satisfied with the stay. The location is great with the mall road being closeby. The rooms and bathroom were neat & clean. The housekeeping staff was very responsive and the food was good. Overall happy to have stayed there.

I stayed in the hotel Vishnu Palace from 11/06/19 to 16/06/19 with my family. The hotel staff was very courteous. Food quality in the restaurant was excellent. Complimentary breakfast was also excellent

I stayed in the hotel for one night in a deluxe room. But I didn't see any deluxe type feeling. the location was fine. because it's near to the main market. But there are many issues it should be resolve for attractive good guest.  #Hotel  * Room was not clean. bad smell is coming when I entered into the room. *  Blankets are not covered. The sofa should be covered. *  Wardrobe is very small. * Old type lock system. we have to carry a heavy key. it should be modified. * washroom should be updated. * I saw there are many electric wires opened. it's harmful to small kid also for adult.  # Food * I didn't like the food at lunch and also at dinner.  * there are two types of restaurant service one is for Lunch and second for Dinner. when I ordered from the room so I got the diffrent…

We stayed at the Superior Himalayan view room which we directly booked from the hotel's website. The view from our room was to die for. Vishnu palace is located at a walking distance from mall road. Ideal location. Service at the hotel is very good. Food can be better but there are multiple options for food close by on mall road. (Upahar for pure veg) Rooms are clean and hygienic. Perfect place to stay for families/couples.

Its a good place to stay as it is near to mall road and accessible to everywhere. Room was cozy and good, there is parking place as well. As we know that mussoorie has very small roads and full of vehicle. So having parking is a plus point. Breakfast was really good with north and south indian cusines. Keep it up :)

Very good service, near to Mall room, safe parking, spacious & clean rooms. Breakfast was good. Recommend to all. Try to book online through makemy trip you can get good discounts. Will definitely book same hotel in next visit to Mussorrie

We stayed 3 nights, hotel looks a bit dated,room furnitures are old, room also is just okay.certainly does not deserve 4*. Food was good,and prompt service.Hotel staff was cordial & helpful,one more problem, they are reluctant to accept credit cards, I had to pay cash to settle my dues.

The location of the hotel is near to mall Road and the view from the rooms is amazing.. Food is good and breakfast variety is just too good. Good place to relax with family. Food service is very prompt.

A Good Hotel, Location is also good and convenient for mall road, A very good breakfast buffet, Room service and price excellent I can give 10 on 10 on this, You prefer to have lunch and dinner inside the hotel. Hotel Peek season rate was little high compare to hotel. But overall it was good experience to stay in 3 star hotel.

The luxury room became really torturous when we found no a.c while it was too hot to handle in june. Also there were lots of flies in the room which also seem highly torturous. Food quality was awesome.

Vishnu Palace is a very good hotel. I got a mountain view room. Stay at Vishnu hotel added pleasure to my stay. Staffs are co-operative and food was good. It had a park for children too. Also the location is on the Road side and very near to Library chowk. Only thing i missed was Gym, Request the management to add small workout area. It will be an add on for thew guests.

nice family hotel with best location in mussoorie near to mall road. best thing i like is company bagh is just 1 km away. good food for vegies. comfortable stay. go for superior himalyan view if with kids.... else deluxe rooms are fine for twins

Hotel is very close to the library side of Mall Road . It’s a big property with plenty of rooms. For a better view select Himalayan view rooms, you will have a green and fresh mountain view from your window. Food is good but as it is a pure vegetarian hotel don’t expect eggs or non vegetarian dishes.

Nice location.excellent breakfast. Room service ok.  We went on may 5th june. Though entire mussorie was over crowded but we booked online thorugh makemytrip. Thank god we did otherwise we have to spend in road. We saw people sleeping in road also. It was saturday. Entire delhi flocked here. Anyhow we enjoyed in the hotel.

Clean room, nice room service, very nice and well behaved staff, Hotel location is the best part, entire hotel is very clean and well maintained. food was also  very nice. Fridge was there in the room. amazing view in the window. I love looking at monkeys playing on the tree behind the window :)

It was a pleasant stay there at this Hotel.Staff is very cooperative .Must stay there whenever I go to Mussoorie.Will recommend to stay here for my peer. Buffet was also good but there is little bit of chance for improvement

It is a nice place to stay in Mussoorie in the heart of this hill station. Rooms are neat & clean, Lobby, open area, Buffet Hall all place are clean, Staff is so good & helpful, garden & kids play area also beautiful. Room with hills view really looks awesome. Love to come again & will recommend to friends & family. Price seems high - it was the only factor which need to be work on.

Home awy from home . Great value Service,Excellent Staff & nice location. Room service was great. Centrally Located.Backed by a wooded mountain in the Himalayas, this relaxed hotel along a bustling road with shops and eateries is 2 km from Gun Hill, a cable car ride to an overlook, 14 km from Kempty Falls and 28 km from NH507 national highway.  Warm rooms with wood-panelled walls offer free Wi-Fi, TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms feature mountain views; suites add living rooms. Room service is available.  Complimentary amenities include parking and a breakfast buffet. There’s also an informal restaurant, and a playground with mountain and valley views. A generator is on-site.

Manager and staffs behaviour are very good. Room is very neat, nice  and confortable with hill view. breakfast provided by the hotel is delicious. Specially pahadi dishes. I recommend to stay in Hotel Vishnu Palace.

The hotel is at very convenient location. Superior rooms are spacious. Some rooms have good view. Service of staff is excellent. Buffet breakfast has lot of good items. Parking space available. Shops and restaurants nearby.

We had wonderful time over here. Nice and helpful staff, excellent food, neat and clean rooms at reasonable prices. They made our stay and holidays memorable, surely will visit again and highly recommend others. Thank you very much for everything.

It is a good decent hotel for family. Bit away from the main Mall Road. Actually on the wrong side of Mall Road. Food is quite okay vegetarian food and just being right. Service is minimal and generator was not working when electricity was not there. Clean bathrooms. Cannot keep windows open since stopper is not there and with the wind blowing you will have it as a disturbance. Fans are not placed well. Most likely good for winter.

Food 🥘 is amazing and nutritious . The taste was authentic and variety of food was vast . Hotel rooms were big and affordable . It was an amazing experience. The ambience of the hotel was very good . It was an amazing experience

I rented a deluxe room which was big enough. Main issue remains with the cleaning of hotel furnishing. Blankets and towels were like a 1000 rs room. Carpets in common area were dirty. Breakfast was good. Reception staff is not very good.

every thing was right except bed sheets  blankets covers sheets they should not do with the coustmers like this .the person or the family pay too much in the seasons time to relax not to use the dirty beds. my personally sugestion to the hotel mgmt.to should check it

Room Price is very high as compare to room.Breakfast service was excellent.Room service was good.Staff was cooperative.Location is very nice for stay.Its near to the mall road.Good for stay one night only.

Very Comfortable for couple and family's, food was very good and normal rate according to other hotels, view is also awesome and centre of the market in the mall road and other places near to the hotel

Best location in Mussoorie..very clean and peaceful environment..staff were very supportive.. Room service was fantastic..breakfast was on time and very delicious...I will only stay there whenever I visit mussoorie again

We have three family and booked 3 rooms.Rooms and Beds are neat and clean.Hotel staff and Manager are very professionals and polite.Hotel staff always ready to help you.Good for family vacation.Only vegetarian food available and very good for vegetarian people.

Location is plus point.located on start of the mall road at library chowk.everything is available nearby hotel,whether it is a medical shop or food points or u wanna enjoy golgappas..but wifi is not working properly.and breakfast menu repeated on 3rd day

We came to masoouri first time and stay in vishnu hotel was also remarkable for its service food.  The breakfast was soo good to have in that pleazent environment.  My kids play a lot in amusement park in hotel. Thankyou

Very good hotel to stay. A prime Location is near library chak. 1 side view of open Himalayan valley is excellent. Rooms are very good and clean. Highly recommended to stay in this hotel. Only price is little higher.

Hotel is average and breakfast is not good... Rooms are small and outdated.... Only location is good .......rooms are not up-to mark and bathrooms are small and need renovation..... Parking is available in hotel

Bathroom did not have shower and mixer. Only bucket and mug was provided which I am not used to. Gave the impression of a Dharmashala. Bed linens need improvement. Location and food was good. Quality of food was good. Staff was courteous.

I have booked deluxe room. But they didn't give that deluxe room which show in the picture of Hotel website. That is different. I Am not satisfied their deluxe type room. And I have asked for change but they have not good response for room change. Only their Food  services are good.

Good Hotel with prompt service. Very supportive staff. Good buffet breakfast. Parking space is excellent. A bit expensive but at the end it looks like value for Money hotel. Rooms are fully equipped with all amenities.

I stayed in superior room. Here are my observations  Good- Location. It is located at a walking distance from mall road library Chowk side.  Parking- hotel has a big space to park your vehicle. Staff- Staff was polite and helpful.  Bad- Rooms do not have proper ventilation. Window was unopenable and permanently fix with glass. Due to this room had a kind of foul smell. When I checked in there was no  sheet under the blanket and I felt it was very unhygienic to use a blanket with out a sheet below it. Though after I called and ask housekeeping for the same they provided it but I believe it should be a standard affair to put a sheet under blanket.  The sofa upholstery was too dirty and had big stains. Bathroom is of small size. There was no shower curtain so after the very first…

Staff behavior great..breakfast excellent...room service prompt...food quality good..food quantity sufficient..room spacious and clean..location excellent..opted for MAP plan, satisfied..bit disappointed regarding view..

I really loved the location of the hotel and the "supirior himalayan view" room has an amazing view of mountains. I recommend all tourists who booked this hotel will have an awesome expirience. The toilets were clean. The food was delicious

Great service, wonderful Experience.Great host .Highly recommended.Must visit for superior Himalayan rooms have amazing beautiful views .Food quality was great ,clean rooms,quick service and perfect location.

If you are normal Indian family where kids are not very freaky types,  then the hotel is fine.  It's nearby most of the amenities.   The rooms are not air conditioned.  It lacks some hygiene factor in washrooms and beddings.  Food and staff is good. All vegetarian...

Good Staff, good location, good amenities. Liked the stay as well as decent spread of breakfast. Taxi stand is just 100 meters, Gandhi chowk 100 meters. One can get rickshaw from Gandhi chowk for moving in Mall road.

-Pros - Conveniently located on Gandhi/Library Chowk and also close to Mussorie Taxi stand. Rikshaw stand 5 mins walking distance, Being close to hustle Good spacious rooms, very tasty vegetarian food, awesome/excellent/very quick room service. Deluxe roo

I had a very bad experience. The room was below standard when compared with hotels with similar price range. Service was just ok so nothing to highlight. We had got malfunctioning electric kettle in our room. Upon several requests then did not provide us a working kettle.
