Kindly also note that despite paying for their malfunctioning kettle, I never got a replacement so my kids could not have their milk due to lack of warm water. Very pathetic and shameless hotel…

We stayed in this hotel on 5th and 6th June 2019. Our stay was very enjoyable. Food was excellent and served with servitude. Staff is very amicable and efficient. Inspite of being a big hotel and too much rush in the season, service was wonderfully prompt and efficient. The hotel is very clean and presents an excellent view of the beautiful valley. Also there are beautiful terraces in the hotel for good view.

Great to stay at vishnu palace . Food was exellent.  Nice management. Room conditions are satisfying. Garden adds to the beauty. I would recommend all to stay there.  All must visit mussoorie once. Nice place to spend the vacation time with your family and friends.

A superb property right at center of Masoorie with great hospitality by hotel people. We were 19 people including kids with 8 rooms booked and every thing including dinner was very well exclusively designed by them. Mr. Manmohan took great care of us and made our stay cosy and comfortable. They arranged a bufet and bornfire exclusively for us. We rate the hotel and hospitality one of the best in the region. The exclusivity was to such an extent that the menu was specifically asked to almost each of member. Our stay was from 19-21st Jan 2019. Great property and great hospitality.

It is always a delight to spend some nights at Hotel Vishnu Palace, a hotel that won't make you feel away from home. They have an extremely amiable staff, particularly Ram Ji and Bhanu Ji, and the services they provide... they are amazing!

Convenient location, but overpriced /overated for the quality. Old fashioned rooms, dingy corridor. Needs upgrading for the price they are changing. Food is good. Staff and services are fine. Not value for money.

Great place to stay. We stayed at -4 floor with Superior Himalayan View rooms Excellent Service with spectacular views. Food quality is awesome very hygienic. Although coffee wasn't well made but overall we had a great experience

Old type key lock systems and very small size rooms. Room service was good, buffet was good. But one thing lack of cooperation.i want to exchange my breakfast with dinner as we have to leave early motning but they denied to do so.

Perfect location.. Near mall road and ample space for parking.. Good food.. 😊 Staff was really courteous.. Room service was also very quick.. Used laundry services and good service.. Parking in hotel premises and location is best part of this hotel.

Visited this hotel.. staff service is nice,rooms are spacious with heater facility in winters. Complementary breakfast with mouth watering delicacies.. Room has a very clear view of mountains and at night it appears to be a sparkling sky..

Breakfast was verygood and reasonably priced. Flies in the hotel should be controlled with fly repellent machine. Conveniently located. Located close to the mall. Lot of eating joints around. Need more indoor games facilities.  Great ambience.

Awesome location, good food and fine service. We had a pleasant stay. Amazing view from the room, good ambiance and staff. Located near Mall road. Highly recommended for family and friends both. Very Nice Hotel

Hotel has excellent location and excellent approach by car and plenty of car parking. space. Some rooms are with excellent view of valley and mountains. Rooms are spacious, good for triple occupancy as one sofa can be extended to single bed. Food available is vegetarian n no Alcohol but you can enjoy your own alcohol in your room. Room service is good. Staff is courteous and polite. Breakfast(VEG) was awesome which included south Indian dishes.

I visited with my wife,Best in class for middle class pubic, Nice view from hotel room, staff was cooperative. Breakfast was delicious, Rooms was good and specious best part no alcohol was available in the hotel.

Hotel Vishnu Palace is very conveniently located and is just 100m from Mall road. Rooms are big and clean and service is lightening. Breakfast was also very good. Recommended to everyone and offers good value for money. The staff at reception was also very helpful. The hotel may not boast a big name but does everything right.

Good location parking inside near to Mall Road. Good view from room Food so so rest things are good Staff good and helpful  Room spacious and clean  Some activities for kids too is there  Overall good experience

Excellent service, good healthy testy food, reasonable price, clean hotel room toilet and entire premises. Excellent windows new. I booked this hotel through MakeMyTrip. Happy to stay 2 nights 3 days.

I stayed in Vishnu Palace for two days. It is a very good hotel if you are travelling with your family. The location is good, breakfasts are tasty. Rooms are spacious and clean. The staff is helping. I recommend this hotel.

Nice hotel, good food, ambience, good valley view from rooms, centrally located in Mussorie, child friendly, can be recommended to other. Good supporr staff, clean rooms, 24 hrs hot water, big area of hotel.

We were there on 21st and 22nd of this month, leaving from here on 23rd.  We loved the location of the hotel. The hotel is on the mall road. Although mall road is not allowed for cars / taxis, this hotel is in a area of mall road where taxis / cars are allowed to enter.  Another wonderful thing about this hotel's location is the fact that it is just about 50mts from the Gandhi Chowk, where you get almost everything. There are 2 chemist / medical stores, many departmental stores, and varieties of VEGETARIAN restaurants. So, yes, if you are a vegetarian like me, you are in treat! Hotel Vishnu Palace itself has a vegetarian restaurant which is very good, so personally we did not have a reason to eat elsewhere.   About the room, ours was good, but no view of anything. The window was…

I Am a regular visitor of Vishnu place.I booked 3 rooms from MMT But this time my experience was not good. They allot me a lower category room. Condition of rooms is not healthy. There is so much smell in rooms. When I complain to the staff they told me you must confirm with Hotel before booking. So I do not recommend this Hotel again. Also, I Am not satisfied with the MakeMyTrip staff. When I call them there response was not good. So my Side for Hotel and MakeMyTrip.1/10

Not worth for Money as we stayed at Hotel primal previous day and rooms and service was great in less amount And imp thing is ur hotel charged me for infant and my 6 year son staff was ok But not cooperative as hotel primal

A clean hotel. Location of the hotel is perfect. After reaching mussoorie i learned that some tourists cars are not allowed on mall road for most of the times. Only some cars are allowed.(dont know the criteria for not allowing cars). Within specific timings. As this hotel is before the mall road starts near the library chowk, we could directly take the car till the hotel reception at any time of the day

Very nicely maintained hotel, I stayed at Himalayan view room and really its worth seeing Himalayan range from room at evening. Breakfast menu is very nice specially we got many options in Jain dishes. Main reason to select the hotel was it's pure veg restaurant. Overall good experience.

The hotel being situated very close to the Mall Road gives you access to the night life easily. The rooms are good and their service is good as well. It being a Veg Restaurant arranges to get Non Veg directly to your room through another Outdoor Restaurant. The morning view from the hotel is excellent as you are able to see the snow clapped mountain peaks.

This is an excellent hotel with good breakfast included; Reasonably priced for comfortable stay; Ample car parking pace; Amicable staff; Very  great location right at the approach of the city.  Lunch/dinner not up to mark, but I highly recommend.

Nice room and very good location. Food was excellent. Good for the Family. Very good view of Vally from Room. Its near Mall Road. Very good room service as well. Staff is very humble and polite. I will recommend this hotel to everyone. Have a Nice trip....

Visited with my parents during the month of April for vacation. The location is really pretty n serene..rooms are very well furnished and comfortable. Room service is good as well. We reached really late night to the hotel due to traffic from Delhi, but we had called the hotel n had ordered for dinner as it was well past 9:30 pm. As soon as we checked-in, we received piping hot dinner.

Centrally located, near to taxi stand. Construction is a bit old but experience is no doubt awesome. Good food, service. Also the best part is their superior Himalayan view rooms. I would recommend these rooms for a nice experience

Excellent hotel to stay, good food, clean room, great view from room window, good staff for support, good location for many spots to see in Mussoorie. The hotel has a great location, just few hundred meters from mall road and library chowk.

very good staff and food very yummy🥰i love this hotel me sabko raya duga is hotel me jaye aur room le khana zarur khaya bs room ke cost thoda jada hai improve kre isko to hotel 5star bhi fail hai yaar

Hotel is nice with clean rooms. Food is just okay. There are few rooms with good view, but there is no way to select them while booking. Even though I booked highest category room, I did not get the desired room. They should introduce some way to select the rooms if a room of same category have different views

Being a frequent visitor to the queen of the hills I have seen a lot of hotels and this is no doubt one of the best. The staff is exceedingly friendly. The place has been renovated and now provides free wifi and buffet meals. Rooms are spacious and scenic and food is excellent. They have gone totally veg so we did miss the eggs in the breakfast in this stay. But it was wonderful as always!

Very enjoyable stay, great food, clean quiet room, helpful staff. All good👌. Always close your Windows though... we forgot and came back to 3 monkeys making merry in our room😱. Thank you Vishnu Palace for storing our case whilst we trekked.

clean rooms, good location, good food and best service. just 2 mins. from Mall road. good parking facility also - direct access to parking. floors go from -4(lowest level which has restaurant) -3 -2 -1 (parking) and ground floor.

Our stay at Hotel Vishnu Palace pleasantly exceed our expectations. The place was very centrally located and yet was far from the madding crowd. The staff was very courteous and always willing to help, smilingly. The breakfast was quite sumptuous and tasty. The food in the restaurant, although vegetarian, was extremely tasty and well prepared. All in all one would definitely recommend this place for everyone.

This hotel has a great location, just few hundred meters from mall road and library chowk, That is the greatest point about this hotel. Hotel is over all good. Built old style . Himalayan view room has awesome view of the valley. staff is not very friendly but helpful. Food quality and taste was average. Resturant closes by 9 30 pm. Room amenities and old style. Linen qulity iand cleanlines could have been better. TV doesnot have many options. BReakfast was veg and had fair options. Porch area is good to hang out. There is ample parking space.  overall I was happy about the place.

I stayed therr for 2 nights and three day. Excellent hotel to stay, good food, clean room, great view from room window, good staff for support, good location for many spots to see in mussoorie Overall a must stay hotel.

The location of the hotel is very good. The hotel food and breakfast was also good. Only thing we stayed for two days but not even once anyone came for house keeping even after calling them for the same.

Very pleasant and relaxing  stay,Tasty food,well mannered staff,lots of parking space,Idealy located scenic view from hotel,free wifi,tea coffee maker,free news paper,family friendly,felt like staying at home

Had an Excellent time... Great food, great staff, great service! The staff is v helpful and the food was so damn good!! The breakfast dosa, the evening snacks... Yummy yummy yummy! No complains except they don't have balcony rooms

It was a nice experience staying here. The food was very tasty. And the rooms were clean too.  We had to get the blanked covers changed but the service was very prompt. Overall a good stay. My mom and I felt safe in the hotel.

Very good location. Helpful and polite staff. Good food with a lots of variety. Near to Mall road and taxi stands. Overall great stay. Price could have been on lower side. I was charged 5000/- per night for Himalayan view room.

This is the one of the best hotels to stay @mussorie, the view from room is really amazing experience this can’t be told it should be self experienced.  I say it’s must stay hotel   Don’t miss this great experience

Vishnu Palace is my favorite hotel in Mussoorie en route to my trek destinations. The hotel is very clean, rooms are spacious and well fitted. Breakfast is wholesome vegetarian food. Rooms, I have stayed, offered a good valley view. Very friendly staff

Hotel and service is good. Only issue was that we had booked rooms and meals online. No where was it mentioned that only Vegetarian food is served with no provision for Non Vegetarian food. It should be clearly mentioned that hotel serves only Vegetarian food.

Stayed in the hotel for no of times good location, good staff excellent parking and good view. Breakfast menu needs to be worked on as we stay on Friday and Saturday nights so we get the same breakfast overall best staff

Excellent place for stay near to market and Gurudwara 👌👍, well furnished spacious bedrooms and bathroom's and best Himalayan view from hotel room very courtesy, reliable and loyal staff. Best system of buffet breakfast and separate dining room.

We stayed there for 2 days and had a very nice experience.Good location , polite staff , tasty food. I would highly recommend this hotel for everyone as everything was perfect. Thank you for making our trip memorable.

We stayed for 2 nights in Himalayan view room which provides good view of doon valley from room window. Food was fabulous. Buffet breakfast was good as well with limited but well-cooked options. Staff was courteous and supportive. They even offered us umbrellas when it rained.  Location is excellent just 100mtr away from library chowk. Taxi stand is 2 min walk away. Car parking is available with hotel.  Overall good stay....!!

My wife n her friends have memorable stay there. Initially they r apprehensive because it was all women trip but r very comfortable n safe stay at hotel.  They enjoyed the location n appreciate food quality and its reasonable cost.. Thanks p k sharma  9810065506

What we say nothing is negative.Location is good , view from are the best. Very comfortable, food quality and services very professional and fast. Test of food is best. staff cooperation is best. Its my best experience till.

I have been to Mussoorie number of times and stayed at different hotels. This time I stayed at this Hotel and regret why I didn't stay here earlier as stay was memorable. Hotel is excellent in all fields,  be it food,  room cleanliness,  spacious size room,  courteous staff,  facilities,  location,  etc.  All these made my  stay memorable, more particularly Himalayan view room and tasty food.  In breakfast,  good spread of items.  The location is just close to Mall and have good car parking facility.  Value for money.

It was very nice experience to stay in Vishnu place. The hotel was on good location with good view of hills. Room are go clean and good room service. The staffs are very nice and good response every where. 100 marks for vishnu place. I would love to visit it again and again.

Overall stay was good. Our room was with a Himalayan view and it was a good experience. The food was delicious and inexpensive. Kids were happy to enjoy their time in the play area managed by hotel itself. Overall the experience was really good. Its proximity from Library road is also a plus. A big thumbs up for this hotel.

Very good location. Close to the taxi stand for sightseeing and close to Mall Road. Very good room service .... quick and as per the order. Soft spoken staff.  It was very cold when we visited this place ... 6th to 9th March 2019. We needed our clothes to be ironed. The hotel people provided us with the iron box.  Good food, sumptuous break-fast, though buffet, we were served on our table also. Hospitality was really good. Scenic beauty ... nice Himalaya mountains view from the room & the terrace.

We stayed in this hotel in January 2019. Our room was with a himalyan view and it was a beautiful experience I must tell you. The food was delicious and inexpensive. We have never eaten such mouth-watering food anywhere in a budget hotel. Overall the experience was really good. Its proximity from Library road is also a plus. A big thumbs up for this hotel.

Overall stay was good. Location of the hotel is very pleasant and very comfortable. Cleanliness needs to be improved. Little more things to be provided such as paste and brush in bathroom. Food quality is good and taste is good.

Hospitality was really awesome.  Hotel although is 3 star but is no less than any 5 star of hill stations   Buffet breakfast was awesome   .would like to come here again n again .car parking was huge with total area was big

This is a Right in main entry of Mall Road. If taken this hotel entire places can be cover by walking.  It’s unique hotel where rooms are made in below reception. They have Minis 5 floors of room so the only drawback is view. It’s awesome view from reception.  Rooms are decent size for family of 3. Well maintained and facilities like heater, nice blankets, tea coffee machine, toiletries etc.  good 3 star hotel

Excellent place for stay with family. Breathtaking views of Himalaya from the room. Worth the money and decently located near the Library chawk. I have been staying there with my family for more than five years, at least five times in a year.

The hotel is near to Mall Road. Rooms are well maintained and food is good. View from Himalayan View rooms is amazing. Only downside is that they only serve veg food and there is no bar. Overall a very good hotel. One of the best in Mussoorie

Staff at this hotel is simply amazing, located at very precise location everything is near by. Best hotel to stay in mussoorie. Keep up the good work. KUDOS. Looking forward to visit again. Thanks alot.

I stayed with my family for a day in March n highly satisfied with the services and food. The rooms are clean n well located esp Himalayan view rooms. The buffet breakfast are having good enough varieties n the dessert kheer was too delicious. The USP of the hotel is the location, just at the library Chowk!

Great hotel. Nice view from the rooms. Nice room service. Will recommend everyone for the stay. Located just outaide mall road. So easily accessible. Everything was just perfect. Very happy to make my stay awesome.

Excellent views from room. Good quality food. Kids friendly. Peaceful place. Clean rooms as well as hotel. And moreover very secure. 24hrs hot water. Room heater is also available. And they prepared food for my kid as we mentioned. Thanks

It was a nice experience to stay at Vishnu Palace. rooms are spacious, staff was very cooperative, service is good and prompt. overall it was a nice experience to remember. The plus point here is that they have the provision for the parking. The view of the valley are awesome.

I personally recommend this hotel to all of my friend. Morning breakfast is extremely good. Customer friendly and service is best . We have enjoyed the stay in this hotel eventhough it is for small time.  Whenever i will be in massurie i preferred to go to this hotel

Excellent Hospitality. Enjoyed our stay with family. Enjoyed unexpected snow storm aswell. Staff are very friendly. Food is awesome. Thanks to the chefs. Beautiful scenic views from our rooms. Though it was too cold due to snow but hotel staff provided enough heaters to keep us warm.

Hotel is located near Gandhi chowk and has a nice view of the surrounding areas.  Not all the rooms are valley facing,  so be sure to pick the one with Himalaya view.  This is a vegetarian hotel,  but the quality and quantity of food served is very good.  Need some improvements in cleaniness,  so the 4 star rating.

We had a pleasant stay in Vishnu Palace Hotel, first thing I would like to share is the good location, very near to mall Road, rooms are very spacious, you can view snow clad mountains from the room, bathroom is also very huge, continuous hot water, very polite and helpful staff, room service is good, best is the breakfast menu, so many varieties  plus tasty food, very safe  stay at Vishnu  Palace, If I visit mussoorie again, I will stay at Vishnu Palace

Nice hotel, nice staff, clean room n toilet. Good food.. proximity to everything. I with my wife came to mussoorie to celebrate our 1st wedding anniversary. The scene behind this hotel is very beautiful.

Just book it for the view. Period. The staff, food and almost all the facilities are brilliant. There is no way you cant recommend to others. Its located ideally for commute and shopping too (few mins away from the famous mall road)

The view from the Himalayan Suite of the snowcapped peaks is a treat to the eyes. To top it up, the hospitality of the staffs are commendable. Must Visit this place as it is near to Library Chowk of Mussorie Mall Road!!

Great location and service, hospitable staff and good facilities.  Right next to Library and staff are caring and help with local Itineary and transport bookings.  The management is sensitive and hospitable.

It's was a very good experience. Himalayan view room are nice to stay in and staff was very professional and cooperative. Food is the second best thing after scenic himalya view. Must visit hotel for family and couples.

Good Staff, Centralize location, Nice atmosphere. I would like to recommend to the people that wherenver you visit Mussoorie, your first preference should be Hotel Vishnu Palace. We enjoyed a lot. Thank you.
Very bad hotel , smelling room , room service not good , very poor blanket , hot water not working , good food , small tv but working , bed sheets are not properly clean . Very Dusty and smell 👎 zero

Location is great,very near to mall,staff is very courtious and helpful,food is good however no non veg is there even no eggs also in morning.only thing is if rooms can't be centrally heated at least bigger heaters or oil heaters can help.rooms were very cold with a very small heater which is just for namesake.plus size of beds is very small in superior room also.otherwise it's a nice stay.

Really liked the stay , the view from the room was amazing. Food was really good both breakfast and ala Carte dinner. Above all exceptionally good service and courteous staff. Value for money !!Recommend!!

Room was overall good, services were good, helpful staff, nice ambience, hotel has its own parking that is very convenient. Only negative thing was that that rooms were very cold and heaters were provided were not upto mark.

We stayed here with a group of friends, we were 16 of us(6 couples). The hotel is right near mall road, from the outside it looks small but it a 4 storey building facing the valley. Views from the rooms are very scenic, we can see the snow capped himalyas at a distance. Staff is very friendly and very prompt. We had 2 infants travelling and the staff took good care of their needs. Breakfast spread was good with a mix of North, South and continental dishes. We had taken a package which included dinner, and the hotel checks with you on your preference. I really enjoyed the dinner which was served hot and was tasty and healthy ( not much of oil). The decor in the rooms is comparable to any 3 star property and the rooms very quite large in size. This hotel is just 100 mts from the…

Location wise excellent. Just next to the mall. Take a corn and walk along the gun hill and camels back road. Library Bazaar is next to it . Staffs and management were very helpful and served us with a smile on their face. Very much visitor friendly.  Food wise it's veg but it's awesome.  Lot of non veg food joints are available next to the hotel so don't worry about your non veg curving. Rooms and bathrooms were clean and clear as expected.  Room heater was included as basic amenities.so no complaints.Ample car parking space and Himalayan valley view was just breathtaking.  I enjoyed my stay @ Vishnu Palace and definetly recommend to others which will make your stay definetly memorable in Mussoorie.

We stayed at Vishnu Palace for 2 days (19-20 Jan 19) with a group of about 16 people (9 rooms). The hotel, ensured right from entry to exit we were well taken care. We had exclusive area for get together and individual rooms were also attended promptly. Highly appreciate the concern shown by Mr. Manmohan about our stay that even the buffet dinner was prepared with our concent. Even bon fire was organised for us and being cold outside we all had dinner outside.

The hotel stay was amazing with secure parking, Himalayan view room, Good heater etc.. The hotel staff was very respectful. The breakfast buffet was also great with both north & south Indian food varieties. Recommended hotel in Mussoorie

Room was clean, hotel staff was helpful. Morning buffet was mind blowing. Different type of varieties were there. Hill view room was amazing . Hotel is situated in main market so you can easily roam around Mall road and local conveyance is easily available.

We went there in January, it was very cold. The staffs were very attentive; although with not much english going on we could communicate well. The hot water is great and the hotel is situated in the center location so everywhere is walking distance. The view is amazing from the hotel so we pretty much just hang out there. The downside is the heater in the room was very small it couldn't heat up and it was freezing. We tried to replace the heater but it is not possible. Perhaps later management can use bigger heater for such large room. Overall, it was a pleasant stay.

It was Excellent holiday trip for me and hotel was very nice and staff was also cooperative with us...  It was very nice and good stay. Location of hotel was very good its very easy to reach there.....

It was a really nice experience of staying at Hotel Vishnu Palace. It was situated very close to Library towards Kempty Road.so easy approach. It's rooms were well maintained. The rooms were neat and clean. Good arrangement for keeping your room warm. Food was very nice. Breakfast was also delicious. Staff is cooperative. Overall good experience.

Great location, great rooms, great food. They have their own carpark which is a major advantage. It is very near to the main city square (Library) which makes it even more convenient. Breakfast was good too.

very good service and location.nice place to visit.weatheris also very good.like to visit again.food is also good as breakfat and dinner.rooms are very clean and safe and attractive.entrance reception responce is also good.

Good service, good location, good food, nice restaurant, nice staff. Everything is good. Value for money. One of the best hotel in mussoorie. Just keep it continue. We want stay here again and again. Thanks

highly satisfying and refreshing the experience was worth living It was immemorial and the feel was detoxifying. Felt like repeating the experience gain and again the view of himalayas was momorable Very very satisfying

Located very near to the Library, it offers very good view of a few snow capped Himalayan peaks. That itself makes it score high as most hotels on the other side of the mall road, offer view of Dehradun valley, which is hardly anything compared to a view, even if limited, of Himalayas. Rooms and service is good and offer a comfortable stay. Breakfast spread is very good. That said, the comforters for sleep were hard, old and lumpy, more like a thin mattress rather than a proper comforter. The layout of the hotel, floors are all below the reception and in relatively dark narrow corridors is not great. Overall though, very good hotel.

Visited Hotel vishnu during new year. Prima Facie, it looked to be an average hotel, however once we reached there, it was an altogether a different experience. There are many plus points but to name a few- Good Location from the mall road, good scenic view from the room windows, very good veg. dishes and above all very humble & courteous staff. Special mention to the Hotel Manager, who arranged a special Bonfire for us as it is not a normal practice by the hotel staff, considering the hassles created by some other visitors specially the drunk one. Note: It is not meant for Non Vegetarians, so be careful.  Overall highly recommended.

Pros-> Its location Cons-> Poor Bedding, Door mats, Poorly painted property seems very old when you enter the room, blower not working well, Quilts too heavy, first day Buffet had very few options.  People have probably rated it high just because of its location.

Our sweet short stay at vishnu palace will always remain for long in memories The hotel is pure vegetarian, our prime requirement Best location in Shimla just 1/2minute from library Hotel has all the latest amenities  GREAT EXPERIENCE   WILL VISIT SOON AGAIN

Had a great stay at Vishnu Palace. The location is very good just near mall road. The food in the hotel is very good with reasonable prices and the staff if very polite and courteous. I have stayed at Hotel Vishnu multiple times and it always have been a great stay.

Our stay at Vishnu Palace was very satisfying. The rooms and the services were very good, clean and appropriate. The house keeping staff was quick to respond. The kitchen staff was able to cater to all our needs which included food with no spice for the kids.The location of the hotel is excellent and is within 2 minutes walking distance to the mall. The rooms in which we stayed also had very good view of the Himalayas. We really enjoyed our stay at Vishnu Palace.

Location of hotel - Excellent.  Rooms -Excellent. Food-related Excellent. Staff -Excellent. Cleanliness -Excellent. We are thankful to this hotel for making our journey memorable. Hotel is also awesome.

Very good hotel.Nice location near mall road.Rooms are spacious as well as cleaned too.Bathroom also clean.Curious staff.Very fast room service.Buffet breakfast was very nice.Parking space was there also.Restaurant available & it's 100% pure veg.

this is my second visit to this hotel. Rooms are nice staff good &  breakfast buffet spread is quite nice. Food delicious. And the view from Himalayan view rooms is very nice. we stayed when outside temperature was -2 but the rooms inside were cozy with heaters provided. but its a vegetarian hotel & not much amenities like gym , play rooms etc

Room was away from happening side of mall road , had to walk 15 to 20 mins daily to get to other side of mall road.Advisable for people who want to roam around Gandhi chowk . Room was ok , breakfast was average.

Nice room with heaters and hot water. Parking facilities available. Very polite and friendly staff. Good breakfast but no eggs. Perfect for groups and family. Clean bathrooms and no water problem. Perfect location.

Hotel was very Good. Staff was Excellent. Rooms were very warm even at a temperature of 0, -1 degrees. Would like to stay again here during my next visit to mussoorie. Keep it up Vishnu Palace :)) Good luck.

It has all aspects required to fulfill a family stay. Food was absolutely delicious. The best part is scenic view from the rooms of Mighty Himalayas!!!! Location is easily accessible and centrally located.

The hotel is located at walking distance from Mall Road having few room categories. We booked this hotel because all famous properties were sold out on new year eve. The staff is helpful and food is cheap.   They serve breakfast limited varieties but taste was good. Rooms service need to improve. Nothing negative and hotel justifies the rates they charge.

A very decent hotel with generous and courteous staff prompt service excellent location very near to the Mall road. Best part was breakfast buffet with lot of varieties.Would again love to be with them in future.

Good staff ravi at reception was good. smooth ckeckout good parking breakfast spread ok. we go to the hotel on fri-sat and sun the preakfast we get is same. kindly change the menu as per weeks as well.

Very good hospitality. Staff very courteous. Comfortable stay. Food is only vegetarian, but very good.  We liked the breakfast. Good scenery from hotel.  Rooms are given with heaters, so stay was comfortable.

The hotel was amazing. Specially the mountains and Forest view from the hotel. The food is very delicious. Staff are very helpful and supportive Hotel Service is also very fast and excellent. Enjoying a lot .

I went to Mussoorie for a 2 days trip with my family. We stayed in Hotel Vishnu Palace. The Superior rooms are quite spacious. The hotel has very good room service. People are very courteous. The view of Himalaya from the hotel is elegant. Mall road, most happening place is next to the hotel. The hotel food is also very good. I will stay again whenever I visit Mussoorie.

Best hotel in MUSSORIE. Do not try any other hotel when think to visit MUSSORIE. Number one in all fields.. Rooms, Restaurant, cleaning, house keeping and above all mouth watering food quality. Very enjoyable and comfortable stay.

Very expensive as per the amenities and quality of the room. The tariff is on higher side and also there are very few options in breakfast buffet. The staff was very cooperative and room service is also very quick.

Very good rooms and extremely well service. Also the view from rooms (the ones of 4k/night) is excellent. Breakfast has good spread of veg items. And it is complementary. Location is very convenient as it is so close to mall area. You can have a good time here!

Visited Hitel Vishnu Palace for 3 nights during peak time of Dec 2018. Even through year end time, all the services and queries were addressed with satisfaction. We booked superior rooms which were spacies and comfortable with all Hygine factors and facilities both. Staff was alway helpful for any small issues or even for guidance and routes to visit palces in and around mussoorie.   Horel is located right at the end of Mall road at Liberty chock which is perfect locatuon for going anywhere  Although they provide only Veg food, breakfast and even evening restaurant food was tasty and fresh  Overall enjoyed the stay with family there

Very good place to stay in mussoori. The staffs are very good and service is very good too. They also have lift facility which helps the seniors.Parking is huge. Food quality is very good. We were there for 3 days in a 4 bedroom in December as the temperature was too low we got two room heaters.

Stayed 4 2N, booked 4 ooms, 2 superior & 2 Deluxe. all room were need and clean. People were very friendly. Breakfast and dinner was awesome and food was tasty.  live counters were good. Room heaters, wifi  could be improved.

Located in the heart of Mussoorie this hotel offers the best room service and food. I stayed there from 25th to 28th December 2018. The temperature was sub-zero but we enjoyed the best possible comfort due to excellent room service, 24-hour heater and geyser, and exquisite breakfast and dinner. The breakfasts were complimentary and we enjoyed those on the terrace under the soothing morning sun. There were one or two minor problems but those were addressed and solved immediately. Also, we had a Tempo Traveller which could be accommodated in the large parking space of the hotel itself.

Room was clean and had a great view. Food was tasty. The demerit was only one charging point was working. Location is great. Try to increase variety of breakfast as it is repeated every second day. Plus point is breakfast is vegetarian.

We had a pleasant stay at hotel Vishnu Palace for 2 nights.The room was family room and was comfortable.The hotel staff was nice and professional.The service was quick and food was delicious .Value for money.Only thing I felt was that the manual register entry and the old style locks on the hotel rooms to be old fashioned and couldbe technically improved.

We spent the Christmas eve at Vishnu palace and came out thoroughly satisfied with the hotel. The rooms are spacious, modern, well equipped and offer lovely views of the Himalayan ranges. The staff is attentive and the services are prompt. The location is also a big plus. It's a hundred metres away from the library chowk and the mall road, very close to the nerve centre and yet tucked away in a quite corner. There is ample parking too, which is comforting for any one who has had the harrowing experience of hours spent trying to find a parking in Mussorie. The one thing I would like to see them improve upon is the variety on their menu, though whatever we ate there was delicious but it would be great to have a wider range to choose from.

This was my first visit and the location of the Hotel is amazing, would definitely recommend to everyone. Superb food & verities at reasonable price. The behavior of the staff is friendly.   Superb view from hotel room as well. Would recommend superior Himalayan view..... Me and my family enjoyed lot . however, room can be decorated / presented better.

Rooms were clean, staff behaviour was friendly, prices of food and rooms are reasonable and the location of the property is amazing.. this was my firat visit and i would definitely look to stay in the same hotel next time around as well...highly recommended!!!

One of the best hotel in Mussoorie, would definitely recommend to everyone. Superb food  & verities at reasonable price. Superb  view from hotel room as well. Would recommend superior Himalayan view.....

The hotel provides a great satisfactory service in all the aspects. Hence, we had a most memorable vacation at Musoorie. The food, internet, cleanliness, hygiene, punctuality, behavior towards visitors, etc were so well maintained.

The hotel is really a place everybody will like in terms of good stay, good view of snow cladded hills and good foods. The hotel is situated in the heart of mussoorie and shopping and sight seeing places are nearby, yet they charge moderately throughout the year.Rooms are excellent in terms of décor and wide windows for perfect view outside. Staffs are very helpful and polite. Room service is very good. Hot water available round the clock. Its very good for family excursions. Buffet breakfast is very good. Only request to hotel management to augment room heating capacity with a bigger room heater. Stayed with around minus 3 to 4 degree in the night happily. The hotel management is excellent and have adequate parking area.

A good hotel with clean rooms, if a little cold. A heater was provided but it was only just up to the job. The breakfast was very nice and the staff were helpful. The view was definitely the highlight and was really something special. I would recommend this hotel to other travellers.

A little weekend trip to Mussoorie last week turned out to be one of the best trips. This hotel that we stayed at has beautiful rooms. Ours opened up to the range of mountains which was so pretty. The hotel staff was very accommodating. Even after checking out, they let us stay in a room to just chill and relax because our car was a little late to arrive. Overall, a very welcoming experience.

I visited Mussorie from 12/9 to 12/12 and stayed at Hotel Vishnu Palace. This is very close to Mall Road and since we took our own vehicle we could park it in the hotel premises. The hotel itself is deceptively good. The rooms and restaurant goes from 1st floor to Basement. So we got good mountain view staying on first floor. The breakfast served had plenty of variety and had good taste. Especially the South Indian varieties of Dosa and Idli on that day. The room service was prompt and the manager also arranged for a cake as it was my wife's birthday. Overall this is a very good affordable hotel with a pleasant stay.

Nice budget hotel with friemdly and polite staff always ready to help. Taxi stop is near buy so dont have to walk much afterba tiring day. Mall road is just 300m away. Voews from rooms are good. Bed and linen quality is decent.

Mussoorie is relatively an expensive place but we visited in December which is off season so we got the room at a reasonable rate. The view from the room was fabulous. The service was excellent and the food quality was top notch as well. But the most attractive part of our stay was the complementary breakfast which was just too good. There was buffet of like 15 items including sandwiches, puri, idli, upma, uthappam, kheer, cornflakes, chocos, fruits, tea and shakes where anyone can have anything, any quantity. I would definitely recommend this hotel for stay at Mussoorie.

It was a family trip to Mussoorie in Nov 2018. I selected Vishnu Palace on the recommendation of my office colleague and I must say that it was a great selection.We (me, my wife with two children) stayed in this hotel for 3 nights. Our room was Deluxe category room with valley view. Hotel has good & safe parking space. It is at walking distance from Mall road near Library chowk side. Everything about the hotel is good... food, staff, location. My kids liked the terrace and kids playing area. Hotel staff is well behaved and very courteous. They serve morning tasty breakfast with variety of items. Mr Usman (head chef) was very polite in getting feedbacks from guests. We preferred having dinner at hotel itself rather than trying outside. Non-vegetarian food is not served in hotel.…

Starting from the beginning,  great location, easy to reach. Excellent parking.Very courteous staff. Rooms clean, furnishings elegant, great hill view from room. Highlight of the stay....fabulous room service!! Food brought hot ,quicker than most 5 star hotels. And everything ordered was really really good.Buffet breakfast also pretty good.It's a no brainer to book hotels in all our subsequent visits to Mussoorie.keep it up Vishnu Palace!!

We came to musoorie for the night. It was amazing, the view from here was better than what we had thought. It is a bit chilly here but it’s worth it. There’s good locations to go to and People here are friendly

I stayed in the Hotel for 2 nights and booked standard room for 2 night for family (incl a 2 yrs toddler). though my overall stay with hotel is ok but there are few points which are worth mentioning  PROs 1.Ample parking, that saves time and cost and is convenient. 2.Close to Mall road and it saves you entry fee a situated just outside mall road. 3.complementary Heater: I have travelled across hills and no hotel provides heater as complementary and charges 300-400 per night but Vishnu palace does which adds to hospitality. this somewhere justifies high costs.  4.Breakfast included: Almost all deals include breakfast. Though there are limited options, but 2nd day, the Dosa prepared was just awesome.  Cons: 1. No card payment: though I pre-booked the hotel and had to pay only food…

Location of hotel is excellent as it right at the bigening of Mall Road. They have plenty of parking space. Food is okay, prefer outside food as it not value for money. Service is also okay, not that great.

We stayed there for 2 nights the staff was friendly and professional do add breakfast in your stay as their breakfast is awesome. Restaurant food can be improved and they can have bigger heater coz the rooms are huge but that heater was the size of hand bag . overall we had a great time there.

Excellent location, room windows mountain viewing, delicious and varieties in breakfast, ample parking for own vehicle,nice food and hospitality. Heaters available for room heating. overall enjoyable stay.

Only vegetarian food. Cleanliness is not upto mark as expected. Heater is available in room which is +point. Nonveg lovers please avoid. There are many better option nearby this location with some high cost

Good location, ample parking space, nice food and hospitality.  This hotel is near Gandhi Chowk on the Kempty falls road, which is open through out the day (unlike the hotels on mall road, which is closed during day). If hotel could offer cab services for local sigh seeing, would be a plus point.

We 4 adults of same family including elderly parents visited Vishnu palace on 24th Nov 18 from Kolkata via Delhi. Its an excellent place with best possible location with stone throwing distance from mall road and parking facility. Yes they are elegant front desk people are gentle kind and they provide lift/elevator facility for the floors.Our 2 Himalayan view rooms were interconnected ,very well decor,modern facilities with wooden floor and amazing view of mountain. Best part is buffet lip smacking breakfast with veg english indian south indian live counter..well ther fruit counter person wore cap and gloves to maintain proper hygine. Well done guys. Hope to visit once again.

I visited Mussoorie first time and stay in Vishnu Palace made this visit memorable. Hotel’s rooms are neat n clean, well furnished, Mountains view from room. Hotel location is very good. Food was fresh and tasty. Room service was good. Overall stay was very comfortable.

Very excellent room service and good hotel staff breakfast is very good and dinner also. And hotel staff also very helpful. Room is very neat and clean. And hotel place is very best location in musoori. Near to kempty fall

Look upto nothing except Vishnu Palace... I am a frequent customer of this hotel...Loved its location and also the buffet was so satisfying.Highly recommended and a family hotel with great staff and with vide range of facilities at such a price.....................................

The hotel is right next to library chowk/gandhi chowk at the entry of mall road. I booked superior Himalayan view room and I didn’t regreted that. I got a superb view of snow capped Himalayan. Hotel room was clean and provided all necessary items. Staff was polite and their food is superb with minimal rates. I had view issues with their free wifi connection which was quite intermittent and keeps logging you off. Otherwise the stay was best and would highly recommend to visit this hotel if going to mussorie.

It is really near to Mall Road. Their "Superior Himalayan View Rooms" are just awesome, but might get a little expensive during Season. The room view was breath taking.  Breakfast Buffet is just average, but Lunch/Dinner food is really tasty.  Room Service is quite okay, but service request might get delayed, during high work volume time slots. The room maintenance is quite impressive. Washrooms are clean.  In case, they forget to replace the toilet kit, you can ask for it, without being hesitant about it.  Parking space is quite spacious, considering that this property is very near to Mall Road.  Staff is co-operative as well.

The management and staff of this hotel guarantee every bit of pleasure. Quick service by courteous people. You name it and orders are on your table before you can blink. Cleanliness of the rooms keeps your mind clear. Rooms for as small as a couple to as big as joined ones for six persons. This you would expect from any property. What distinguishes this property is its location- the beginning of mall road. Elevators paving smooth way, you can sight its importance especially when travelling with parents.   What certainly mesmerised us was the fact that the management and hence the staff steps into clients’ shoes and then act.   We booked our stay here from Make My Trip for Oct end but due to certain unavoidable reasons a day before, could not make it and informed MMT. MMT simply…

Our room (Deluxe Double Room) was spacious and having partly mountain view. Loved the Complementary breakfast having verity of delicious items. Well maintained housekeeping. Well behaved staff. Very near to market area in Mussoorie. Perfect for family stay.

Very Polite, courteous, helpful Staff with prompt Service. Location is good very near to Mall Road. Food is exceptional with many variety. Room size was adapt for a family of 4, view was breathtaking.

Very nice view, nice vegeterian food, walkable distance to cab service, Bus station and library chowk market. And some of the rooms having best view of himalayas. And economial if we travel in weekdays.

Nice location , food is good, staff behaviour so nice .Hotel rooms interior good, Near abot Mall road. 24/7 hot water , room service is good , parking facility is available , family nd privacy maintain

Had a goddess stay at hotel. Location is very near to library chowk and mall road.. Staff is good and food is awesome.. Walkable distance from mall road and taxi stand.. Room with Himalayas view are best.. But washroom are very cozy and the room furniture needs to be upgrade

The view and the terrace was awesome.... Good was good... Staff was very helpful.... Very quick service... Complimentary breakfast had something for everyone... The plus point was it is completely vegetarian...

Very happy stay, best location, well managed stay, good restaurant, very reasonable rates. The only bit negative about stay is breakfast menu - it was same every alternate  days, also need to improve on taste of food. Also when a big group arrives, all resources of hotel is deployed there, leaving single families.

Excellent Hotel to stay in Mussorie. neat & clean hotel and Good Parkng space.. Morning buffet breakfast is good..including south Indian Dishes.. Perfect Place for Couples and Families.. Beautiful Himalayan View from rooms..

It was good experience to stay here food is awesome nd tasty ,hospitality was gr8 overall i will give them 7 out of 7 ,location nd room also good or beautiful ,service of tv also good ,overall service was grt

Superb Hotel. Neat and clean. Courteous staff. Good quality and quantity food. Very large amount of parking space available for car parking. Even though you check out they will allow to park your car on valet parking. Food cost us also less. Morning buffet breakfast is too good.

Perfect place for vacation for family.Nice helpful staffs.  Good and delicious food. Clean and big rooms. Quiet place.All was excellent. Room, staff and food were above from my expectations.Location is good.

Very good family hotel in Mussoorie.  Pros:  Location- just near to Library end and very close to all attractions like Mall, Kempty and Company Bagh.  Staff is very polite and good. Breakfast - Good Overall facilities and own parking - Good.   highly recommended if traveling to Mussoorie.

Value for Money in everyway..location is Library chowk, easy acess to all tourist attractions, food joints, grocery, chemist. View of the Himalayas is gorgeous especially this time of the year when snow peaked Himalayas we clearly visible from room and drive way. Staff is quite sweet and helpful. Food is good too.

Clean Connected simple and enjoyable stay. Very close to the happening Mall road. Himalayan view rooms. Good for family stay. Only veg food is served, if you're non veg, explore good options for non veg restaurants on Mall road. Breakfast was excellent

Good point are location and view from room was nice. We booked Himalayan view room on level 2. 1.Hygiene needs to be improved. 2.I have shared photos of WC which is cleaned twice on our request, still not properly cleaned. We entered the washroom immediately after the cleaning, it was stinking and the wc was not cleaned and therefore we asked them to clean it again. 3. I have also shared the picture of water heating kettle which was having some aluminium threads and water in it, we always check the vessel before using and hence got saved from drinking it. It got cleaned after we called them. 3. The blanket cover was not changed as it was having the body odour. Then too we thought it might be a wrong understanding but when we used the blanket we both got itching and rashes on our…

The hotel is at a very good location. 2 mins from Mall. Himalayan View rooms are gr8. Friendly staff. Complementary breakfast has variety of food. Live dosa counter.! Near n clean. U can get the entire view of the Himalayan range from ur view rooms.

Nice location with all facilities and quality food. Vey well maintained toilet. very nice room service. Helpful reception. Liked the parking facilities and facility provided to the driver. Overall it is very good Hotel to stay.

Nicely located property.Staff is gentle and supportive though a bit pricey one as I had traveled during pick season.Near to Gandhi chowk and mall road.Overall a perfect destination if you are looking for 3star property.

Great Location very near to Mall Road. Nice Room, well equipped with an amazing view of Himalaya. Great Staff very polite, helpful and prompt response on any service. Delicious Vegetarian food with great variety, Good Breakfast with Live Dosa counter. Special mention of Mr. Ram Singh Charan Restaurant Supervisor, he goes out of the way to make your eating experience memorable. All in All had a pleasant and amazing stay at Vishnu Palace.

It was a nice experience ,Great experience in mussoorie to stay in vishnu palace. Neat and clean , Nice hotel ,co operative staff  Cost effective. Situated near mall road , good parking space. For last so many years ,We always prefer to stay in vishnu palace,

It was a pleasant stay at Hotel Vishnu Palace. First of all the rooms are well furnished and also well equiped. The view from the rooms is spectacular. They have breafast included which was tasty and sumptuous. The staffs were also cordial and helpful.

Room was nice and amazing view. Room planning was really nice, proper ventilation. Food is very delicious and the staff is very cooperative. Rooms and bathroom are spacious and all modern amenities are provided. Highly Recommended.

rooms were extremely large and spacious along with amazing amenities which made our stay extra comfy and cool.they provided a room heater and the city view was just awesome...moreover the complimentary breakfast contained a lot of  varieties which is liked by meee...

The hotel is next to Library Chowk / Mall Road. Has great view of char-dham from the rooms. We stayed with family and really a good hotel to stay. The rooms and bathrooms are specious and clean with 24 hour running hot water. Very prompt room service, staffs are also very good. Breakfast was great and they also arranged customized our lunch / dinner as requested. The manager was kind enough to arrange all transportation.

This is probably one of the best budget hote in Mussourie. Rooms and bathroom are saciuos and packed with all modern amenities. View from Hotel terrace is excellent. The best part is a delicious and awesome buffet breakfast.

Overall stay was pleasant. Location near to Mall Road. Valley facing room is explicit, on a clear day you will see the snow capped mountain. Breakfast was food, only constraint was that they serve only Veg foods.  Thanks to the management for allow us early check-in and managing our extra day. Kudos to you guys for your hospitality.....................................................,................................................................

Nice environment, polite and sofapoken hotel staffs, good food quality at reasonable price.nice hill view from room window. Flexible time provided for checkin and checkout.  Very near to Mall Road and memory falls.

Location: Hotel is very close to Library chowk approx. 5mins walking. Also, is a known place, hence you can reach easily. There is a slope in-front of the hotel, if you are travelling with very old member, think twice.   Rooms: We booked for Himalayan rooms at -2 floor. Rooms are decent and have mountain view. It an old hotel renovated in recent times. Don't expect any luxury.   Food: Room Dine In facility is available at a decent price. Remember its a veg hotel. Okish spread in breakfast.

Food is good... view from is awesome...staff are very courteous...it is very near to library chowk and taxi stand where u can take taxi for touring..as it become more convenient... overall everything is good..

We stayed at Hotel Vishnu Palace on 22.10.2018 which was amazing experience for all of us. We were 2 families of 5 persons.  One of the best hotel at Mussouri. Net and clean room, as well as bathroom. Room heater was there. Led TV was there. Everyday hotel staff used to clean the room. The bed was very much comfortable. They have complimentary breakfast system. The food quality was very good. The most important thing is they have their own parking facility... if you are traveling with your car you need not to worry about parking. The total arrangement was very good. I wish to stay again.

Visited last january 2017, with my wife. One of the best hotel at mussouri. Net and clean room, as well as bathroom. Room heater was there. Led TV was there. Everyday hotel staff used to clean the room. The bed was very much comfortable. They have complimentary breakfast system . The food quality was very good. The most important thing is they have their own parking facility... if you are traveling with your car you need not to worry about parking.The total arrangement was vey good. I wish to stay again ...

Good location Great view clean and neat hotel and room.Prompt service Awesome breakfast spread .We stayed for a day and if we plan Mussorie again we will select Vishnu Palace again.The hotel staff  gives service with a smile

This is my first visit to Mussorie,  and after detailed analysis i select Vishnu palace. And after staying i can say the selection was perfect. I am highlighting some key points 1.Excellent hill view. Other hotels has view to doon vally but vishnu palace has himalyan pick view. 2.Excellent support staff. 3.Direct access with Car no need to walk 4.just on the mall. 5.Clean big room with room heater and 24 hours super hot water.  6.Good breakfast. Puri bhaji / Alu paratha Bread , veg sandwich, dosa / uttapum ,idly, two type juce,fruit counter , tea coffee, corn flex And last key thing they have a kids play area which is good if you are travelling with kids.

This was my 2nd trip to Mussoorie in October 2018 and over all 5th. This is the first time I stayed at Vishnu Palace since the place where I was regular was full and the owner suggested this place. I should indeed say it was an amazing stay at Vishnu Palace, I opted for the Valley View Superior room and every penny was worth. Firstly the room was great offering mesmerizing views of the majestic Himalayan range. I was traveling with my 3 year old daughter, so was a little skeptikal about the availability of non spicy food, but the people at the kitchen made sure the food was absolutely as per my baby's taste buds. The complementary paid breakfast was amazing and there were a lot of choices to make you feel spoilt for options. They did also have a small play area for kids with…

A very good hotel.Our room had a view of the Himalayan Range. The room is cozy and spacious.Our family of three was easily accomodated in the room.If you happen to visit Mussoorie don't miss to stay at this hotel. Opt for the room which has the view of the Himalayas. The food is also delicious. The break fast offered has a variety of food to choose from. Vegetarians will love to savour the food.

Me & My Family , Friends stay last week in Hotel VISHNU PALACE. Hotel IS AWESOME rooms are so species , bathrooms are net & clean. Hotel is near Mall Road (100 Mtr ). Staffs are very familiar, foods is delicious.ONLY I THINK I SAY HOTEL IS ( PAISSA WASOL ). 5 ***** RATING FOR HOTEL VISHNU PALACE. I personally suggest to every one, stay in Hotel Vishnu Palace.

Great Location very near to Mall Road, Efficient and Soft Spoken helpful staff with reasonable room tariff. The rooms including wash rooms were properly clean with o foul smell from linen etc. The food served at the Buffet Breakfast was great and fresh.  Excellent parking facility in the area. The view from the room was really nice. Overall my stay at the hotel was very good. Overall rating 8/10. Keep it up !!!

very good ambiance,location near to mall road,very nice sumptuous breakfast,next day we had to leave early at 7 o'clock,we received packed breakfast,very good hospitality,room service,cleanliness was also good,parking space & facility for driver also

Morning time such a nice view of himalyan range. We can see Himalaya coverd with snow very clearly from this site. Place is good for shopping also because very close to mall road and little far from timber trail. Overall good experience

Hotel is good . Staff and all the services were good. Prominent location which is very helpful to all yhe traveller. Food was good . But there must be some non veg item also. Veg items are good no doubt. But every time veg is not preferable.

Property is very centrally located, adjacent to Mall road. Rooms are quite spaceous. Staff is extremely helpful. They accommodated our Jain preference food instantly. Staff was polite and very professional in their service.

Stumbled upon this place while looking for a reasonably priced good family hotel and that’s exactly what we got. Comfortable rooms, good location topped with a delicious complementary breakfast.., kudos guys..!!!

We stayed in this hotel for 2 nights and we are truly satisfied with their services. The hotel is located in Library chowk which is one of the prime location of Mussoorie. We stayed in hill view room which is quite spacious and comfortable. Wifi was available in the rooms. Room service and house keeping team were prompt. The day we arrived was quite late at night. Though the kitchen was closed by that time they arranged for some quick dinner upon our request. Food rate was quite reasonable. Veg buffet breakfast spread was really awesome. Thank you to the entire team.

Excellent & fully satisfying stay for 4 days...Well behaved staff, nicely maintained room , excellent location, good dining facility & food/ refreshment available all the time on demand ... Complementary breakfast fully satisfying...Morning view of ice clad hill fully refreshing...

it's an excellent hotel , with a nice location and rooms with a great view. the rooms are quite spacious and clean with a fresh fragrance. the restaurant provides very delicious food.  it is purely vegetarian. they have a very good and polite staff , always helpful. there is a play area for children and a very large parking, which is a boon in a crowded town like mussoorie. I would like to thank Ashish for making my trip so memorable.  in the future too I would like to avail the services of this hotel.

Good,  polite and helpful staff... so nice service. Rooms are much better than what they look like in the photos put online by travellers... especially the Himalayan View Rooms... opt for the ones on 2nd or 3rd level. Vishnu Palace is Centrally and very well located in Mussorie. Great Stay:)

Our initial experience was little bad. After checking in, one of the two rooms door had problems which they took more than 2 hours to fix. I raised concerns and they apologised for the inconvenience and as a nice gesture gave us couple of baskets of snacks (chips, cookies, soft drinks etc). It was an unexpected surprise. Apart from this one issue, we had no other problems. Their service was great, staffs were friendly and helpful, room service was good, breakfast was great with many options, breakfast area is large - you can eat outside as well. Our rooms were Himalayan view. Rooms had large glass window that gave great view of the mountains. The bathrooms were not that great in terms of their design. They are little small too. Shower area should be on right side and wash basin…

Good location and decent rooms with great views. Great variety in breakfast and tasty food. Looks like a old hotel. Interiors can be better for the price paid. Worth considering during peak times. Thank you

Everything is good, room, food, location, view, staff except WiFi network. Breakfast buffet is very good.Food quality is good. Location is very near to mall road and taxy stand.Choose Himalayan view room for best experience.Staff is very cooperative and attentive. Only issue faced by us is WiFi connectivity. Just go for it without any doubt.

I have stayed in the hotel in the past also. This is home away from home to me. Food is vegetarian but excellent. Only increase the timings of service at least till 2300 hrs. Breakfast is good Add boiling water for tea on the buffet.

Brilliant property, location wise. Worth for Family Stay.Very Close to Mall Road.Service is Good at Hotel. Staff is very cooperative.Himalayan View Rooms are Pretty Good.Enough Food Options at Hotel Restaurant with Reasonable Rates.

The hotel room was nice and had great views.  But the bathroom was smelling so bad which made the whole room smell.  Also marks on the bedsheets and power kept going out in the morning.   I personally would return to stay here.

Much better infra and service than budget hotels. Clean rooms and very spacious. Great valley view. Good spread in breakfast. Excellent food quality. Clean bathroom though was a bit smelly however was immediately resolved on complaint. Overall, would love to come to this hotel again

Great buffet breakfast, well maintained facade,building,restaurants, excellent staff service etc. But room linen (stained bedsheet image attaced) and curtains are disappointing...expected a better hygiene...though I gave 5 star but a bit disappointed regarding that issue...still will visit again

We stayed there for two nights in a family room. This place is nicely located and very convenient to get access to mall road. Food is decent in taste and that's it.  I was surprised to see the staff all around. Especially FnB, they do not even bother to acknowledge your presence. No welcome, greetings, you come-eat-go, that's it. They feel a burden to talk to you, any small request is like a pain to them. Standing binding their hands on back and standing on a corner.  As we were leaving early the next day at 08. I requested recep[tion for breakfast around 07.45 or around. They reassured it will be there. When I went to the restaurant next morning, they said we don't have any information and started taunting that they don't have any information.  While checking out Keerti (I…

It was a good stay. There was problem of mobile network not available in -2 floor.Also felt that room charges were slightly overpriced. But all n all was nice place to stay.Nearest to mall road and one not need to walk longer distance to reach mall road specially in case of elderly people.

Situated right at the market makes it convenient to stay when travelling with family. Rooms were average, book in advance during holiday season to avoid paying surge prices.  Good was average, couple of good restaurants nearby.  Location is the best, rest all was average.

It was a good stay. Awesome. But problem of idea mobile network. Not available at -3 floor.Please consider to improve it. I gave 5 star but due to mobile network. I am giving 4. But if i'll come again then stay here definitely.

It was a family vacation with my 80 year old FIL and 17 months old nephew. We were looking for a place which is easily accessible by vehicle as well as nearby to the mall road too. This turned out to be the perfect choice. We had requested for rooms together and with the best view and we got EXACTLY that. All our 3 rooms were next to each other and had fantastic views! It was such a pleasure getting up every morning and look at the clouds play around the mountain.  The restaurant is vegetarian. But since the Mall road is nearby, there is no worries at all regarding this.

A good comfort stay. Excellent room and facilities. A good filling breakfast both south and north Indian. No non veg. A repeat stay would be done in future.  The wash rooms was neat and clean adequately provided with shampoo soap and body wash dispenser.  Rooms are good size double bed long sofa table. Kettle was neat and clean. Good view.

The Location of the property is very good, premium I would rather say. Property is vast very spacious, very good food, amazing staff. Helpful people. Over all it was nice experience. I wish Vishnu's team all the really best.

Approach is very good.breakfastquality is very nice.Safety point of you,I never saw any guard there.Staff is polite and cooperative.I recommend this hotel.Ecofriendly environment there .I seem massuoori is a nice place.

Value for money nice staff good food and clean room  safety friendly reception easily check in & check out.  Vegetarian food huge parking space. Over all nice experience must be recommended to family and friends

Nice stay with beautiful view.  Staff very supportive and helpfull.  Nice clean and spacious room. Just 2 min away from Library chowk. Food was very good.  Specially breakfast.  Enjoyed with family.  Thanx alot

We Enjoyed a lot at Vishnu Palace , awesome service , And awesome view from room . Room fare was little Costly 😃 , Room fare should be 2500-3000₹ per night to stay Amd it's also walking distance far from Gandhi Chowk And Mall Road

Service for Good. Rooms had some stinking smell, I think due to Rain. Some problem with Water Heater. Blanket provided was wet & smelling. Got it changed but the other had smell of Lemon Grass. Location & Ambiance are very Good.

Location is excellent Ample parking space is there Rooms are spacious and provide excellent view Good service provided Pure veg  Need to work on Food taste Amenities like towels and blankets provided were not upto the mark  Overall decent place stay with limited budget

Overall good.. but could be better if they add some extra activities or something to entertain.. Nearby to mall road, parking available, food is ok..  Good deal in the range of 2000-3500  Atleast a play zone for children required

We stayed there for a day. It was a perfect example of Hospitality.Immediate service on a single Call. Nicely served Breakfast with multiple cuisine. Overall it was a nice memory to visit again....😊😊😊😊

Excellent place to stay at Mussoorie. Good food for breakfast buffet and dinner, excellent service. Had a comfortable stay. Staff was very helpful. Helped us reach point of stay on time. Affordable pricing too

I booked 2 combo rooms. Both room TVs were not working. Wifi was frequently disconnected. There is no wardrobe in double room. Food was good. Very nearby to mall road. Outside view was also good. Rest is good

Good cosy hotel for family with kids.. Spend good time. Hotel have good parking facility and restaurant offer good quality food.kids enjoy in kids playing area. Hotel have lift accissible to old people till top near to parking area.

Excellent service,good hospitality and apt location.Hotel staff were very good ,they provided extra bed for my family at no extra cost.They told it's their gesture.Its located 50mtr near mall road and hotel has it's own parking space.Most of tourist are not aware if they choose hotel inside mall road then you need to park car outside and go on foot as car entry is prohibited.

Pleasant stay...with a beautiful Himalayan view...nature lovers...with near to mall road and company garden and also spacious parking for four wheeler...clean room...fooding service is also accurate and wonderful vegetarian food

I visited this hotel & stayed for 3 nights from August 10-August 13, 2018. The location of the hotel is great. We took superior Himalayan view room. The room was excellent. Complimentary breakfast is also good. But they have only vegetarian food. But taste was nice.

Awesome feelings. Great Hotel at Mussoorie. Feel like luxury. Parking available. Mall road starts only 200 mtr ahead where could be all marketing done . Nice place. All staff has good behaviour. Himalyan range can be seen from terrace. Room size is very comfortable and big.

The hotel is very strategically location that offers full view of the mountains, especially Room no. 228. Also, the breakfast is good and truly southy. The staff also deserve acknowledgement for the quick delivery of food at all times.

It was a good experience. Hotel staff was very polite and cooperative. Buffet breakfast was also excellent. Neat hygenic and clean place. Location of hotel is also excellent. Adjecent to mall road. Overall ultimate.

I have stayed in this hotel for 2 nights and 3 days ....they have given 4 hrs early check in that too without any additional cost💓 secondly their break fast was good with multiple options like fruits, parathas, upma ,poha pakode, cornflakes, juices, cornflakes, bread toast and many more on daily basis........it was a buffet with all cleanliness and dining area with a great senic view.  Mr Amit was so humble and co operative that on our request he has arranged a prior arrangement of breakfast on the day of our check out than their own usual time.  I AM HEARTILY THANKFUL TO  AMIT  THEIR STAFF WAS VERY HUBLE AND CO OPERATIVE...  WILL LOVE TO STAY HERE IF I VISIT MUSSOORIE AGAIN.  #SHIVACONTINENTAL

I came Mussorie to celebrate my spouse Birthday. She will always remember this awesome trip. We had a very nice stay at Hotel Shiva Continental, near to Picture Palace, Mall Road. The rooms are clean, sanitized and view is awesome. Clock Tower view and sound of clock is so soothing. It was a peaceful stay and room infrastructure and amenities were very good . Staff is courteous and so helping. Enjoyed our Food and did some activities like playing table tennis and carrom indoor at hotel as well which made our stay memorable. Food is very good specially Breakfast in the morning with unlimited buffet. Staff is very caring. Special thanks to Mr. Amit Singh. I suggest to have a stay with your family or friends.

Hotel Shiva Continental - A stones walk from the Mall (Picture Palace side). Rooms were nice and clean and spacious. We had a room with a small balcony (you may need to pay a higher price for that, but its worth it). The View of the Lal Tibba and the Clock Tower were great. Staff was courteous and helpful. The breakfast buffet was sumptuous. I faced some issues with the Wifi connectivity, but that wasnt really a bother since the mobile reception was great. We found the place great and will definitely make a repeat visit. No Coffee Shop but they do have a restaurant.

I will tell everyone about this hotel and recommend to visit here.

I came Mussorie to celebrate my spouse Birthday. She will always remember this awesome trip. We had a very nice stay at Hotel Shiva Continental, near to Picture Palace, Mall Road. We found the place great and will definitely make a repeat visit. No Coffee Shop but they do have a restaurant.

It's like home away from home.  Awesome location.  Car access till hotel anytime of the day.  Just a walk to mall road. Well maintained rooms.  N food is Well prepared can b altered on request.  Entirely an amazing stay.

Nice hotel in the picture place area...walking distance  to the mall road with lots of shops & restaurants around. Opted for the Super Delexue along with breakfast which was worth every penny. We were total 30 and it was corporate booking. We have booked around 12 rooms including deluxe, super deluxe, suite. All were good. Staff was good. It is a very good hotel to stay .I visited along with my wife and stayed there for 2 days. We had good experience staying there. The hotel staff is really good. The breakfast buffet is also good though costly.

I was visiting Landour with a friend for a weekend break and we picked this hotel because of its convenient location and connectivity. To reach here, we could easily walk down from the main bus stop. The rooms are spacious with clean washrooms. There was an issue with Hot water but the staff was very attentive and fixed it instantly. The rooms are cozy and well lit. The hotel restaurant serves variety of Indian food, we mostly ordered in our room. Food quality is good and not expensive too.
