First thing is good about hotel is most near hotel in Mussoorie. Food is awesome, it’s situated near picture palace. Bus and taxi facility available is near hotel. Hotel has also parking facility. Value for money hotel. must visit place.

Have stayed here with family from 08Dec to 11Dec food and hospitality both are very good, staff also very helpful  specially thanks to Mr Shubham  who have arranged Candle Night Dinner on our Marriage Anniversary and guide us for other information...Hotel is near Mall Road & picture place...overall Hotel is Very Good for location and service wise..

Have stayed here with the family for 1night on 8th Dec and the experience has been good.Dont know if Mr Shubham is the owner or the Manager..he has been very helpful.Keep up the good work.Rooms are nice,neat and clean.The only problem faced with the tap in the washroom.Food was good and the hill view from the restaurant area was fantastic.Will definitely be back in the future.

Had a great time here. Loved the location of the hotel as the best parts of mussoorie that is the mall as well as landour are at a walkable distance. Would surely recommend anyone visiting mussoorie. :)

nice stay beautiful rooms good service perfect location close to main market awesome food only thing is they don't have park parking facility in their hotel and should more focus on breakfast service which was complimentary all n all perfect stay worth for money

We were travelling in a group of 12 and stayed in the hotel for two nights. The rooms were cosy and well maintained. The food was good and nicely served. The staff was excellent and always very courteous.

For the price 2000 rupees this hotel was a very good deal. Nice room (sufficiently big for 2 persons), very friendly people and good location. Maybe not excellently clean, but OK for the price and for India in general.

We visited Mussoorie for a day trip and the hotel staff was very accommodating to let us book the room only for the day hours. The hotel is very conveniently located just a minute walk from a pay & park and close to all the shops and cafes. The highlight was the friendly staff who helped us in booking a taxi for local sightseeing.

Hotel is good. Location wise it is at 100 meters from the mall road. Rooms are comfortable. Bathroom is a bit small but it meets the need. if possible take a full view room. Also it is advisable to book room along with breakfast, breakfast was good. Expect only egg in non veg breakfast.

We stayed at Shiva for 4 nights as the final part of our honeymoon. Overall, we were give him excellent on our stay here relative to the other hotels.That was my first time in Shia Hotel. At evening I was reach the hotel, the front office very cooperative and doing very quick registration. The every corner of the hotel is excellence and standard.

Visited Mussoorie  on 30th September and stayed in this lovely hotel. The Hotel is just a walking distance from mall road (picture palace). food is awesome and the management and the hotel staff are very helpful.

Went there during summer 2017 in Mussoorie with family. It was really good. Comfortable rooms with valley view, comfy assisting hotel staff and a really nice outdoor seating restaurant where you can sip hot coffee while letting the mist overpower you.

Small but clean rooms., good interior, staff co-operative, good service, yummy food, view is also nice. Rest everything was fine. Overall it is worth of money.  Car Parking is chargable and not comfortable.

A perfect room with balcony was able to view cloud Floting from hill towards balcony, room and washroom were clean and staff was curtious, services were prompt.enjoyed food with beautiful view, perfect

Good Hospitality, Tasty food and Nice view from the Hotel. We experienced the comfortable stay there. Every person in their Staff has a polite nature. Very Good... IMRESSED and would recommend to stay.

This is perfectly located hotel out there. We approach there Nealy 7 pm at evening and room has already booked so nothing worry about accommodation. The hotel is near to picture palace and 7D Cinema also. If you go Mussoorie try to hire a room there

Hotel was good. Nice location. Food was also good. staff if friendly. Bathrooms were not up to the mark. They seem to be old, leakage in taps. overall good hotel to stay with family and friends. Try to visit again.

I had long trvel dat day , i reached 9pm mussoorie and finding the hotel all long finally i bet for "hotel shiva continental" .so much crowded coz of long weekend. I can understand thr were lots of rush on weekend but dats d challenges for them .im quite disspointed for dat ..breakfast was good ...

Nice location of the hotel and good rooms. Can stay with the family but the staff needs to be more courteous. Food is average. Had a family friends gathering at this place and had good time. Need improvement on the food and staff.

We both frequently visit Mussoorie which is a charming hill station, popularly known as the “Queen of Hills”. Its is situated 34 kms from Dehradun, at an altitude of 2500 meters above sea level in the beautiful Gharwal Hills. Mussoorie is one of the most frequently visited hill stations in India. It provides excellent respite to people who want relief from the hot sultry conditions of the plains.  Nestled in this hill getaway of majestic hill station,  just near the bus stand and the picture palace of the Mall Road is this beautiful small hotel Shiva Continental perched cozily on a pine covered hill slope with an enchanting view of the mountain range.  The first thing that struck us was that there were pots and pots of beautiful flowers and plants. Right from the entrance to the…

Nice overall with housekeeping required to be improved Only disadvantage is Hotel starts from minus level which may result in the lesser scenic view as compared to the pictures shown on the website. But was manageable.

location of hotel is very good ,near to market.rooms were neat and clean .The view from balcony was awesome in monsoon season.Food was delicious, the staff was courteous, particularly restaurant worker kishore was very well-behaved and helpful. Plantation was very beautiful. overall value for money

Rooms, food, cleanliness and hospitality- everything were excellent. The view from the rooms were great. I enjoyed the stay at hotel. Even the staff were very helpful. A member of my family fell sick and one of the boys took her to the doctor on his motorbike.

Nice cozy hotel with a beautiful restaurant with view of hill and snow very nice humble staff with prompt service with mouthwatering dishes served by the chef my family had enjoyed a lot thx team Shiva continental  Regards  Praveen  Lucknow

Neat and clean place with good tasty food. Service also is good. Breakfast menu / spread is also good and keeps changing daily. Only issue is the parking which is not far but difficult to get a proper parking space. Peaceful location not far from Mall Road.

The hotel has one of the best locations by virtue of being bang on the Mall Road and proximity to the key locations. The only plus point of this hotel is its location.  The hotel rooms are unclean and used toiletries were in washroom. Towels were in bad condition. Bathroom was very untidy. Shiva continental was at a good location to stay      . nice ambience, nice rooms  . overall it was a great experience.  no private parking  .  housekeeping staff  was arrogant  .  Food quality was really good    .  Keep it up!!!

Hi,  This Hotel is bang at Mall Road. Rooms are good. They upgraded my room to Super Deluxe and room was big, clean and very good.  Washroom was good but needs more cleanliness. All services were at an average level. Cleaned and hygiene. Even the food was yummy . Would like to revisit this Hotel whenever travelling to Mussoorie again. Would also wish to suggest stay at this hotel to my relatives and friends.

Good services,neat and clean stay njoyd a lot.Our stay was for 2 days.food was also yummy.i prefer to stay in super duplex rooms.view was amazing from our room.loved the breakfast area full of greenery.

I have stayed in many hotels but I liked Shiva continental very much and here below are some points which are very effective for the Hotel. 1) Location is very nice 2) We had taken two rooms and both are very cleaned. 3) Hotel staff are very supportive. 4) Breakfast was very nice. We would also like to stay in future if we go to visit mussoorie again!  Thanks, Ambesh

Really loved the hotel.My room was hill facing. View from the room was breathtaking. Enjoyed my stay in the hotel. If you are travelling with friends or family I will recommend this hotel. The service was good.

Nice place to stay. Very good staff.Location is a big plus for this Hotel. Food is also comparatively good. We had booked 2 rooms for 2 nights and the stay, check-in, check-out went very smoothly. Thanks to all staff for making the stay comfortable.

it was a very nice experience to stay in hotel shiva, It has very nice view n serenity . staff is very polite n i request the early checkin n they provide the same without extra cost.in short a great stay in shiva continental

We stayed there for 3 days and had a very good experience. The food was very good. The staff were very co-ordinative and the services were very quick. We found hotel's location at best place. It was near to mall road but still peaceful. Food quality was good though we only had breakfast. Rooms were clean. Hotel staff was supportive. Overall good experience.

It was very good stay at Hotel Shiva Continental. Rooms are very neat and clean. nice Ambiance and Luxurious room. Service is also very good. Hotel staff is very helpful. Food is great. I Love this hotel and happy to be their again in future.

I stayed there with my family in two sepearte rooms, it was pleasant stay & enjoyed good quality & tasty food. The rooms where clean & spacious with all ammenities. Wish to stay again in my next trip.

The hotel is located in the mid of the town , very close to major attractions like Lal Tibba, mall road, famous restaurant. Rooms are quite spacious and service by staffs are awsome. Every staff is  on their toe if u need any help. Food is nice and hygienic. Washroom is small, but its kept clean. Overall,our family stay was quiet pleasant here.

Staying in this hotel was a great experience. The food was great especially the aloo poori subzi in breakfast. Very co-ordinating staff. Had a backache and the room boy bought the medicine from his home. Had a lovely experience staying here.

staff n services are very well...! awesome place awesome staff awesome foods... i feel like a family members :)  all the services are fine. you guyz need to visit once, then u got the actually what i want to say. It is a pleasant hotel

This is a good hotel with good service. Only one drawback, hotel don't have own parking so you have to park your car on paid parking that would be 100rs for 12 hours. Hotel location is good, staff is good.

The hotel is huge... all staffs are excellent.. foods are best in town.. restaurants were awesome.. nice ambiance.. and a luxurious room. Please go and book this hotel blind folded. Love this hotel a lot and i shall must come to mussourie just to stay in this hotel again.

Very good hotel in budget. We booked via makemytrip And we got the value for money. Good people for reception and service. Hotel is very well maintained and very near to Mall road. View from the Super Deluxe rooms are good. But we had booked deluxe room so view was not so great. Food is good

Great experience, lovely ambience great room servive specially waiter name rawat. Outstanding experience bit please focus on food taste.Also the management is really cooperative.special thanks to director

Hotel is very near to the bus stand providing easy access. The Balcony rooms are good and food service is nice. The staff was cooperative and hotel too had facility for playing indoor games They guided us well on how to plan and where to travel first.

One of best Hotel in Mussoorie having three type of rooms at reasonable prices ,neat and clean hotel with restaurant having delicious food and having open space to watch hill view n enjoy food but only draw back is hotel is not having its own parking but paid parking place is just adjoining,nice n cooperative staff

Well as title says. We liked the room it was decent and clean. Staff the bell boy and waiters were courteous but food was bad. Specially the breakfast was pathetic.   It had very limited choices and cooking was bad.

It was one of the best places that we had stayed in mussourie. Beautiful surroundings, amazing clean comfortable rooms, greenery all around were one of the features of this place. The hotel was beautiful, room service excellent and stay extremely pleasant. No complaints whatsoever!  We stayed for 3 nights and would like to return again at next opportunity . The rooms were spacious and the hotel played an important part in enriching our experience of Mussoorie.

We visited Mussoorie in the second week of December 2016 with 20 colleagues on a 3 day fun trip, we had booked rooms on twin sharing basis. We had booked the super deluxe rooms with balcony at hotel Shiva Continental. The hotel is just walking distance from the mall road. Our stay was comfortable and nice. Will surely recommend this place.

Hotel is very good and at good location. Just 100 mtrs from Mall Road, 350 mtrs from Taxi stand. Breakfast at hotel was too good, a variety of dishes were there. Hotel staff is very calm, friendly. One of the best hotels in Mussoorie. I booked Super deluxe room with breakfast and balcony.

We stayed in super delux room. the room was clean and very well maintained with a great view. the property is beautiful with lots of greenery around. the breakfast options are healthy and sumptuous. the staff is very cordial and helpful. Overall a great experience

Usually vehicles are not allowed on the mall road but thankfully this hotel is situated at a place in mall road where vehicles can pick and drop you from the door step.  The hotel is very nice location and hospitality vise. Recpetion, the staff, rooms, everything is good. Only, the food can be improved a bit.  Overall, a very good hotel to stay at.

Hotel room's was clean but water seepage issue on wall, reception & room service phone not pickedup timely and not at all supportive. food service very poor served food was not at all hot.  Food was not tasty at all. Limited variety in food served during breakfast buffet.

It's a very good and beautiful hotel with very good location with all amenities .... start from reception very good hospitality..i have directly assist by owners sun and very helpful and friendly staff ....very nice one thing I want to share that please book deluxe rooms only because this rooms are more maintained than executive rooms very thing is very good very clean rooms .... breakfast is very yummy very good buffet ...and few is awesome from restaurant...go with Shiva

Neat and clean hotel, Staff very cooperative. Breakfast given was also good.  Blankets were not good initially but they replaced when we asked.  overall a nice hotel for staying, location of hotel is good.

Fully satisfied with the hotel staff and the service they provided....I really enjoyed my honeymoon....I must say the couples who want to spend their honeymoon in mussorrie must make their visit at hotel Shiva continental

A beautiful place to stay with family..staff is very friendly and the hotel is clean with all basic amenities ..location of the hotel is superb.. :)  We visited the place to celebrate our first wedding anniversary and we enjoyed our stay here   :)

I happened to stay at this hotel during my last trip in Mussoorie for official pusrpose. Location of the Hotel is really nice and on the mall road only,stayed there for 1 week and felt like home only Mr.Bhat (Manager),Chander ji and ownwer Shubham ji is very helpful and guided me alot . I stayed Shiva Continental during my visit to Yamunotri for 01 night. Hotel is really good option to stay if you want to stay near mall road but exactly on mall road. Hotel is having a vintage style lift which your children must enjoy. Food needs to be bit better.  Overall it is  a good option for budget under 2500. Goibibo will definitely pop a topping on it.

We booked Super Deluxe Room in this hotel through TripAdvisor in mid September 2016. Stayed in a room facing hill. Location is excellent as it is very near to mall but free from noise. ITs not atall worth the price. there are 2 types of rooms one valley facing and one literally Wall facing. reception is floor and the rooms are in basement all the way down 5 floors. Not atall value for money. for unloading luggage it took almost 1 hr. they overcrowd and thats becomes unmanageble. u can good options in mussoorie at this price.

This was not a hotel chosen on my own as I like clean accommodation . I attended a course which was held there at the beginning of May and it was included in the package. Excellent for a small group. I organised a conference for 20 persons for a duration of five days and got fullest cooperation from the hotel and its staff. The food was very good and punctuality was mainlined. All the group members were fully satisfied with the service and the response they got.  I plan to organisze similar conferences again.

So a group of us 17 people suddenly plan to go to Mussoorie just when the peak season has set in, this hotel not only decides to accommodate us, but make multiple genuine efforts to give you the best prices possible (showed me a ibibo hack as well! ;) ) Since the Day 1 of us deciding to go to Mussoorie I had been in contact with a Mr.Shubham, little did I know he would turn out to be the MD of the hotel! it was a nice experience staying at shiva continental .. the hotel needs little improvement in some fields but overall its a good hotel with nice view of valley staff is very friendly,cooperative and the hotel is full of greenery.. also has a good dining area and so it was a joyful experience staying  there

You can plan your stay without a hiccup.

No lift after 4th floor. to get to the reception you need to climb down a flight of steps..no provision of slope as well. We ordered food at 2:30 pm and were told that we can order out of 2-3 dishes as the cook is about to leave..  Positives: near mall road, build is modern

It was a blunder to book this hotel. I visited mussoorie with my friends and our experience was awesome. Room service and staff was good and very responsive. We stayed there in a Deluxe room and view was awesome from our room. My experience with Shiva Continental was very pathetic, In the room allocated to me bathroom was leaking , when I complaint the response was not up to the mark, in exchange they were ready to give me room on 6th floor, where i have to go by stairs as lift was up to 4th floor only. A very decent price for decent service. Very clean and well maintained rooms. No parking but wifi available. Good food with reasonable food rates to. We stayed in the super deluxe rooms and enjoyed our stay.

Visited mussoorie with friends in january . We liked the place but it could get chilly at nights because the radiators the hotel provides takes too much time to heat the room. The hotel is located adjacent to main market and on the road. The ambience of the hotel is good, rooms are small. No heater provided. We payed INR 250 for unworking heater. Hot water a big issue as they have timings for the hot water. The day I checked out I waited for hot water for 1.5 hours but still could not get even after repeated calling to the reception. The heater provided was not working. The extra bed means just a simple mattress without blanket. Food is expensive and average taste better eat outside. Won't stay here even if they give me free room.

i really like the hotel.i like the way they decorate it with natural plants.every where therr is garden feel.u feel like staying in garden.beutiful flowers on roof.beutifull and well maintain garden on roof..rooms are very much clean.bathroom is also good.playing area was good.all over excellent.go for it...thanks

I truly enjoyed my stay at the Shiva Continental in Mussorie. It had the quaint, small town ambiance, as well as being located near the mall road, which is where a lot of activity takes place! The staff was courteous and welcoming, and the hotel itself was well-maintained and a pleasure to unwind in. We stayed in the Super Deluxe rooms and I can honestly say that the room was fabulous. The view was exquisite and being a neat freak, I was happy to not spot a single speck of dust in the premises. The food was great as well. Truly a gem of a place, that is amazing to stay in to get the full hill experience.

A courteous staff, tasteful décor and picturesque location are only some of the elements that come together to make this one of the wisest lodging choices in these parts. I stayed here with my family for 4 nights, and to say that we were delighted would be a gross understatement. The hotel truly captures the essence of the hills. Tucked away in a tranquil part of Mussoorie, the calm and solace of the hotel is only outdone by the candid hospitality of its staff. The rooms were lush and comfortable, and the front desk was generous in giving us adjacent rooms as we were a family of four. Once you choose this hotel, you can leave all your travel woes behind, as the staff will point you in the right direction. We arrived here without an itinerary. The hotel manager was polite enough…

this is one of those hotel's which has provided with the best of cuisines along with world class house keeping service as well as the front office is very friendly.it has a very friendly atmosphere and from here the mall road is very near.

One of the best parts of my stay at Mussoorie. Great service and hospitality.I was more than satisfied with the rooms and quality of service. Thank You Team Seclude, wish We had a couple of days more to stay.

Beautiful Bungalow with good maintained rooms. Worst thing is you cant order any food or even tea when you want. They have limited time window in which kitchen is kept open. If you decided to stay in room to relax whole day then you will not at all get anything to eat or drink except water. Hate it the most. If you are Hungary then you will have to walk 3 KMS to reach restaurant. Staff simply says kitchen is closed and we cant give you anything not even piece of bread. This is the case in day so forget about night. Its better to make your own arrangements for food if you want to stay in room. Till i remember kitchen is open for just 2 hrs in morning,2 hrs for lunch nd 2 hrs for dinner, thats it. Rest be ready to hear big no from staff. Even if you managed to be on time for lunch…

We went to this place after our tiring journey of rishikesh and Haridwar because of rafting and bungee. Our only objective in Mussoorie was to relax.  This place served the purpose to the T. A beautiful place nestled above and hence also away from the mall road and other hotels was as per the name-secluded. The ambience was so peaceful that you could listen to the clocktower dongs far away. Advantage of this place is that there are only 7 rooms and so guests are also less.  The rooms are the highlight. They are very nicely made, cozy and comfortable. The decor is as per the colour theme. The washrooms, bed, amenities are too good, clean and tidy and very modern. Food was just fantastic. Though a bit pricey but worth. Their pizzas are a must try. The staff is super friendly and…

It's a lovely B&B place with an outstanding view and away from the hustle and bustle of commercial Mussoorie. It's a cute little property overlooking the doon valley. It is walkable from the taxi stand , which is very convenient if you want to go sightseeing. The staff was hospitable and the ambience lovely. The food is also very nice and homely.   The only minus point was that we chose the White room , which has a huge issue of privacy . You can hear everything that happens in the room next to it and the vice versa will also be true. The ventilation is also an issue . So choose either the blue, green ,purple or the orange room for your visit . Avoid the white room and the room next to it.

The property is a kind of home stay, with very friendly staff perfect location with awesome valley view. The food menu is limited but it is awesome and all freshly cooked. Suggested room is Purple Rain, as it offer good ambience.

One of the most beautiful location for a dream vacation. Very helpful staff & Comfortable stay.  We had booked Blue Moon room for 3 nights. Everything about the room was perfect. I will prefer staying here the next time we get plan to visit and would definately refer it to my friends and relatives.

The Seclude, Mussorie provides the perfect mix of staying the most picturesque location with the comfort of staying at home. The Hotel is strategically located ( about 5-10 mins walk from the Mall Road) and provides a breathtaking view of the valley. The rooms are stylish and each one has unique flavour of its own. A special mention for the highly dedicated staff led by Mr. Naveen who really were the difference between a good stay and an excellent holiday. I would highly recommend Seclude to everyone looking forward to spending some quality time in the ever so mesmerizing 'Queen of Hills'.

One of the most beautiful location for a dream vacation. Comfortable stay, helpful staff and yummylicious food. I was really impressed with the photographs by Rohit Seth in each room.  Like to take this opportunity to thank Naveen and Srikant for all the help provided during our stay. This was one of the best experience.............Best birthday memory for me

We had booked Orange Crush room for one night and despite a pretty short stay,  it will still be a memorable one...   Everything about the room was tiki-tiki-boo...   Shall definately be preferring staying here the next time we get plan to visit and would definately refer it to my friends and relatives... Kudos to the entire team!

Amazing views of the lower valley, on arrival we were welcomed with tea and cake. Attentive and helpful staff.  food was delicious (especially paneer butter) and rooms were clean and comfortable (all 7 rooms had different themes).  Only a 5 minute walk to Mall road. All in all a relaxing retreat away from noise and hassles of the city....... :)

Amazing views of the lower valley, watched the most beautiful sunset on arrival with tea and cake. Attentive and helpful staff. Delicious food and comfortable, clean rooms. Shower was temperamental but it was possible to wash with bucket and hot water.  If you like dogs this place is a must they have the best guard dog in India very friendly and knows paw! Only a 5 minute walk to Mall road. All in all a relaxing retreat in the foothills of the Himalayas!

Online presentation is pretty impressive but as is true with quite a few B&Bs reality is little different ..  We visited as a group of guys over a long weekend in chilly January. Since it's a place created out of a residence, each room is different and has different comfort levels and we took 3 rooms and comfort level would engage from 2 to 3 for each of these on a 5 point scale   High ceiling in one of the rooms kept it way cooler than our comfort levels only to realise couple of days later there was electric blanket as well in the room. You would expect that since it was a b&B managed by a visible staff of 2 people ..   Parking could he an issue since it is on a public road and unless you park your car with finesse it could ensure you get up way early on a holiday thanks to…

Great place,great service,great ambience and good people. This place has great views of the valley. There is a bonfire place and the lobby is a multi-use space with a lot of books and indoor games to entertain you on your stay here.

Nice, quiet property, away from the noise of mall road, but within walking distance of the major sights. A bit laid back though – works if you looking for a place to unwind. Interiors are well kept up.

We were a group of 6 adults traveled on 26th Jan 2017 for holiday. We were very excited for the property but in the end felt we got trapped by paying 100% amount for the full trip. If you are expecting a good stay with a comfort of the hotel then this place is not for you. The place has good looking one or two rooms but that is where it ends and it does not deserve 5500 per night. I wont  pay more than 2500 for this property. Hers a small summary  PROS - Good location. Just about 200 meters from mall road - Nice looking rooms and washroom -Nice outdoor area with bonfire faccility CONS - Not enough wood for bonfire in freezing cold inspite of charging extra for it - Water in washrooms huge problem, could not have shower on one of the days had to take shower in another hotel -…

Great staff that know the true value of customer service special mention for Mr.Naveen at the reception and the food quality was first class. View from the hotel could not have been better.. Room itself was well equipped and comfortable. I could go on but suffice it to say I was very pleased with my stay, and although short and sweet this time, I hope to be back for a longer visit in the future.

Pefect location to stay in mussorie. Very tastefully designed and well kept. Had a very comfortable stay. Walking distance from Mall Road. Had stayed at Palmpur property last year aswell. Had a amazing stay.

Such a nice place to stay! Nice location. Comfortable rooms. Average food. All in all, had a very good stay! Also special thanks to Mr. Naveen for providing services just the way we wanted! Cheers to our stay

Stayed from 5th to 8th jan 2017 with family and friends....perfect location walking distance to the picture palace side. Small place with seven rooms but very nicely done....none of the rooms are the same ....beautiful place to have bon fire with views of the dehradun valley ...the service and food at seclude was out of the world everything from check in to check out went smoothly ....special thanks to the staff Mr Naveen Mr Singh Abhijeet and Aunty they all made out stay special...served us tasty food and catered to our all needs ...will surely be going back to this property five stars from my side

This is a nice cosy bungalow turned into a boutique hotel... Each room has been tastefully designed, each with a distinctive colour... The facilities are up to the mark and the rooms are addictive... We had taken a New Year package and on both nights there was a bonfire, music and lip-smacking starters. Staff is very courteous and cooperative... Overall an amazing experience... Must visit... Mall Road is also at a stone-throw distance... Which is yet another plus...

Close to Mall road, yet far enough to ensure it lives up to its name - Seclude. Each of the rooms (we stayed in Orange Crush on one day and the White room in another) has an individual character, with some quirky decor - quotes on the walls, books on shelves etc. The service is slow but they warn you of that right up front. But everyone is very polite and helpful. Food is average. There is a really lovely view from the courtyard. All in all, quite a sweet place to stay. Recommended.

Our experience here was phenomenal. The staff is amazing, the rooms are just cool, great design, food is SO good, and views are breathtaking. We have three kids, and they loved it. Staff made special Christmas tree and decor for us, very thoughtful. Very clean, removed from mall road but close enough to walk to it easily. Very quiet and serene. Front yard area is such a great place for sitting, campfires, and taking in the views. This is exactly what we needed. We will surely be coming back here. We extended our stay three extra days because we loved it so much.  David

I  stayed for 3 days in November with family , its a beautiful property ..well maintained. Best part is the homely atmosphere , good food and the beautiful view of valley from the hotel especially in the morning .Staff is responsive and services are customized ...just what we wanted.

It was our second visit to this place...  Awesome food..  Awesome staff..  Awesome comfort..  And some breathtaking views of the valley..  I have to Mussoorie for like 15times and haven't seen such a beautiful property like seclude...  Do stay here if u want to experience serenity at its best..

My wife and I stayed at Seclude Mussourie for 4 days. Absolutley loved the hotel. Staff was very humble and helpful. Mr. Shashikant has some magic wand that cooks absolutely delicious meals. We were always served freshly cooked food unlike many other hotels, it was like having food at home. View from the hotel was stunning specially at night we could see Dehradun submerged in light. We stayed in Orange Crush room as my wife is an avid reader and it has some absolutely amazing collection of books. Purple and Wooden heart rooms are the best. Infact all rooms are beautifully designed. The only minus point is that water pressure is low which is common in most of the hotels at hill stations, so would not completely blame the hotel for this. All in all a great place to stay and have a…

What could get better than having breakfast while watching sunrise!! This place gives all the reason to visit Mussoorie and experience an amazing view just from your bedroom. Great food, service, hospitality, rooms (purple rain most recommended) good luck to Naveen and his team!!

If you're looking for some peace and quiet, Seclude is the place to stay! Strategically located, it isn't too far from the famous Mall Road of Mussoorie or Landour, for that matter. Very tastefully designed and extremely well-maintained, each room has a different hue and vibe of its own. I particularly loved the quotes, hand-painted on the walls and the lovely landscape on the dining room wall. The staff was very courteous and helpful. The kitchen menu they offer is limited yet delectable! I would definitely recommend the property and visit again! Warm and wonderful stay.

It's a very pretty little boutique hotel. Well maintained and very close to the Mall Road. The view from the hotel is spectacular, especially at night time. The staff is very courteous and helpful (Naveen and co.). It lacks a parking space and breakfast buffet, but isn't too much of an issue. However, cancellation and bonfire policies need to be seriously revised.  All in all, I spent an amazing three nights here. Great place.

I booked here in Aug2016 end with hope to find a peaceful hotel near to mall road. This place exceeded all our expectations including its location (walking distance to happening mall road, yet far enough from it noise) , view (clear view of entire valley, rooms 100m over road), design (colorful themes, wooden architecture, clean and neat bathrooms, well decorated dining and lounge) and above all the staff (only a couple of them who met all our needs). Those on a budget travel may find food a bit costly but that can be had in mall road as well. Room tip: go for Purple/White/ Green for couples - secluded yet with valley view. Red was too small for my comfort. Yellow and orange were on backside. Blue does not offer privacy (though great view).

We visited this place between 13-16 Nov.I must say the stay was worth remembering and repeating. As the name suggests the location is a lil Secluded,but walkable distance from picture palace. We took the blue room which is among the best rooms. View is perfect, Staff is very courteous and always ready to help.If you want to have dinner you must plan by 6pm and inform the staff else you might just end up having Maggi and sandwiches which is not bad either. A recommended place for folks who want a peaceful and cozy vacation.

We stayed at Seclude for 3 days..  We were welcomed with a banana cake, fruity green tea & friendly conversation and sightseeing advice from  the owner. The main attraction of the place is how beautifully it is decorated in  nice  colours & sayings...I stayed at the orange crush  room which had a shelf full of amazing books.. Seclude as the name suggest is tucked away at the top of a hill with a beautiful  view of the valley and yet it is just a 5 mins walk from the very crowded mall rd & the taxi/ bus stand. Though they have a menu u need to order well in advance as they make and serve only fresh food. Yummy home made food from paneer to chicken to soups & paranthas. The dining area also doubles up into a recreation area with loads of board games and books. However nothing…

Best thing about Seclude Mussoorie is its location which is fantastic. Not so near the hustle-bustle yet not so far from it.  View is lovely from the room. The food cook on order is just fantastic. We interacted with Shashikantji who was a great host. Will definitely love to come back for another longish holiday.  One small  advise (and not a complaint), we found that though the interiors of the room are tastefully done, purely from utility point of view, if a rearrangements can be thought of and a few chairs/sofa can be fit into a room without compromising the overall aesthetics, it will be great.

Just as we just got there, we were served scrumptious cake with a nice drink. Such a warm, pretty and well read hostess. Our holiday wouldn't have been half as good if it weren't for her. Just loved the place.. the rooms were bright and lovely with great views! Great ambience and interiors. Food was superb! Never had a better pumpkin soup! Pizzas were nice too.

Beautiful place...and like it's  name it provides seclusion and peace from hustle and bustle ,very nice concept of different theme based rooms marked with a nice quote in each room for that colour/theme. The dinner area is well staked with books and cozy sofas for avid readers to enjoy peace with a hot cuppa of tea or coffee. Breathtaking view of Dehradun atop the hotel, we also had awesome time celebrating Diwali with staff and other guests. Mr. Shashikant, the care taker and Mr.Abhijit were very helpful and  always available at our beck and call. Thanks  Looking forward to visit again...!!

awesome experience.. the rooms were great..we booked purple and blue room and they are nicely done..the caretaker Mr Shashi Kant was very helpful and provided everything we required.The location and the view from hotel was great..Best for the people who wants to relax..hardly 5 mins walk from the mall road yet so peaceful. not seen such hospitality before.

It's a wonderful place for vacations. Quite as the name suggests. Hotel staff is so helpful and humble and location of the hotel enrich your vacation experience. The color themes of the rooms are unique. If you are planning vacations in Mussorie then Seclude is the right choice to stay in.

It's a great place to stay for couples and families. Very quiet and seclude(as it's name says), but still just five minutes walk to the picture palace end of mall road. The room is cosy, clean & tidy and the bed is very comforting(Red Red Wine). The view of the valley is beautiful. Outdoor seating is great. Also has a fire pit for bonfire, which you can ask to arrange. Food is good. The staff is very polite and helpful. Overall a fabulous place to stay. Would definitely visit again and also recommend to others visiting Mussoorie.

It is homelike place to stay on hills. Great staff, food and wifi. The staff kept track of me throughout my travel from Dehradun airport to the hotel and made sure I found the place at night. Great food cooked on demand. Menu is short but great food. Very friendly staff. So if you are family or solo traveler you will enjoy to stay here. Best place for those who like to stay in solitary and want to spend time relaxing.

Stayed for couple of days recently. Overall happy with experience.  Thumbs up -  (a) View from the hotel  (b) Close to the mall road (c) The hotel common areas and rooms are tastefully decorated  (d) Focus on Hygiene and tidiness (e) Service like bonfire, Movie on projector in open air lawn (f) Courteous staffs   Thumbs down -  (a) The ramp which you have to walk to reach hotel  I will stay there again if I visit Mussorie in future.

Hills have always been close to my heart! I've always been going there to rejuvenate! Mussoorie is my most visited hill station as it is close to delhi! With time Mussoorie has become so much commercial, finding peace has became difficult! & then i came across this big beautiful bungalow located on a hill top! Just as the name suggests! 'Seclude' ! You will get the feel here! My purpose of visiting hills gets resolved here only! I have already visited twice here & many more visits to come! Staff is also very friendly! Will always make you feel at home! Will be looking forward to visit again!  Highly recommended!

Stating the pros first but some cons will  them later.  Pros:  1. Thehotel is undoubtedly at the best location with good outdoor activities. 2. Offers a breath-taking view of sunset.  Is peaceful and facility for bonfire and outdoor movie screening. 3. Good hygiene and cleanliness.  Cons:  1. The red wine room which we got was nothing like the pictures we saw online on OYO while booking  The room was way too small with absolutely nothing in it which made the place seem overpriced and disappointing as we were intending on Unwinding and staying in after 4 days of wandering and exploring. 2. Charging point are unaccessible and literally below the bed.  3. We had eagerly enquired about the fireplace and were told that bonfire is chargeable Rs.600 which could be shared between the…

This is one of the best hotel i have ever stayed in. Its amazing.. I was looking forward for a 10star rating option while rating this one... Its amazing in every aspect be it food, location, rooms, the place , lawn, indoor games, novel everything.... It just goes on and on...  This is the place i am staying in for everytime i visit mussourie.

Stayed overnight on 09-10 Oct.had an awesome experience.should have stayed longer though.the place is a very interestingly done up property.the small fireplace in the yard was a great break frm the usual hill station routine.the property is very close to picture palace though secluded frm the din of the town.true to I name.recommended for couples and small family outings.Will surely come back again.for a longer time next.

If you love solitude and want to feel at home even in your vacations then this is the right place to be in. Lovely ambience and to add on admirable hospitality. For is of best quality too. The staff is very very good

Just got home from celebrating my wife's birthday with our first visit to Mussoorie and The seclude - fantastic hill station and  outstanding place to stay! The entire staff - front office, housekeeping, landscaping - were always ready to help  and could not have been more pleasant.They arranged the beautiful cake and dinner for us with mesmerizing view of valley (Thanks to Naveen and the entire Staff). Everywhere you will find beautiful quotes and books.Very near to Taxi Stand and Mall Road The Room Purple Rain was lovely , full of creativity ,lots of books.And from our experience, We will return to The  Seclude...........

It was an 'ok' experience at seclude. The place is quite secluded but the room was too small. They say it has parking facility but you have to park on the road and that too on a turn which is scary and you will keep on worrying if your car is safe or not. The quality of food was also not good.

Stayed in White Room for a day - spacious room with wooden floor and a neat & cozy bed. A well-laid bath room with hand soap, shower gel, toilet roll and shining premium Jaquar fitting shows how the management cares for the guests.  Stayed for 2 more days in the Blue Room which was just as great with a large double-layer glass wall and mosaic floor. The toilet could have been bigger as the floor gets wet when one takes bath. All the furniture of in the rooms are made of raw unfinished large wood pieces and looks just great. A mini library in the dining hall is a good bonus for those who want to spend their leisure here. The outside is beautiful with a great view, with exotic birds chirping in the lawn every now and then. I would definitely stay here again.  The climb to the…

Peacefull and silent place compared to that with others hotel in mall road. Best place to stay alone with the bestest good. Best service, friendly staff and too helpful. They arrange for surprise anniversary and b'day parties on your request, i missed this so I want everyone to know. Overall the best hotel with beautiful view awesome food and quite good staff that too very close to taxi stand. I am going to visit soon.

i had an amazing vacation here! Resort is really beautiful with a glorious view. Excellent and warmth welcome by the staffs. Very friendly staff, great food and very clean rooms. The place is away from Mall road and the resort is perched at the top of it from where you can see the beautiful view. I would like to come there again and will suggest my friends and family to stay there only.

Just like the name, Seclude Mussoorie is seccluded from the hustle bustle of the town.  This property in Mussourie is the best place to stay. Right from the rooms to their service to the hospitality here is bang on! The view of the valley below covered in fog, from the hill top where the resort is alighted is breath taking. I would like to mention that it was my birthday when I was on this getaway with my husband, and the staff were sweet enough to decorate the lawn with balloons and candle lights and they made it more special by playing songs when I came out. This was a complete surprise for me and just made my day even more special. I would also want to mention the pet Sheru, who was so friendly and entertaining, I being a dog lover fell in love with him instantly and had a…

Secluded place away from busy mall road. Awesome view, nice and clean rooms, warm hospitality, great food. Overall a perfect destination for people travelling to Mussoorie. Really had a good time staying in Hotel Seclude

I had an amazing time here! The resort is perched atop a hill with a glorious view of the valley below. It has a rustic vibe with handcrafted furniture which the owner delicately built himself. It's warm and welcoming with a fireplace out in the verandah and places to sit and enjoy the view. The rooms were done thematically on romance and provided for an intimate and luxurious experience. The staff was genuinely helpful and made us feel like royalty. Hope it stays this way, will visit very soon again.

The place is amazing. Beautiful property with tasteful atmosphere. The staff was very friendly and served fresh homely food. It is peaceful yet not far from mall road. Very neat & clean rooms. We would definitely visit again.

Everything is not less than perfect, the cozy feeling of homeliness, the mouth watering complimentary cake, the mid night butter chicken, just love everything about the place. I would definitely recommend it to everyone, and I would stay in this hotel each time I visit Mussoorie. The Staff is really nice and the decor of the room is also simple and cozy.

We had taken Wooden Heart Room. Very nice decor with warm colors. Washroom was spacious and overall neat and clean room. Some fitting like reading night lamp was not working but we dint require it that much after long sight seeing in the day so did not inform the staff as well. There is a sitting area outside and you get a stunning view of Dehradun at night (Do not miss). Food was awesome just like home food and staff is very caring and helpful. It is situated at a height and approach might be a issue for elders but they can help you out with that as well.  Local taxi stand is just 5 mins walk from the place and you can also get buses as well from the same stand. Mall road is 4-5 minutes walk towards Picture Palace End. Over all , great property with great staff and great…

We stayed in seclude for two nights with a group of friends and had rented the entire resort. The staff is very friendly and leaves no stone unturned to make your moments special and memorable. The food is just like home made food which is always made fresh and served hot. The rooms are neat and tidy and every room is different. Best place for groups or even for people who love to read and enjoy the scenic view of the doon valley.

the best hotel in town .awesome location and the view ...its also good for groups as thw staff and the place is good .if you want to choose a room ..choose red red wine room it is the best with nominal rated ..must visit

the hotel is awesome ..must visit .  the staff is good and the location is also good .if you want to have a hotel away from crowd this is it .must visit for couples and groups .the cleanliness is good and the food served is also gpod

My Name is Sajid and I visited the place last week on 12th of August, 2016. I had never been to this place earlier and therefor was not sure aware of location or hotels etc. Based upon reviews I booked a room in Seclude hotel. Hotel location was very good, just 5 minutes walkin to Mall road or taxi stand, situated at a height where one can see whole Dehradun.  Staff was very cooperative I must say. Very neat and clean. Totally satisfied and would recommend anyone visiting mussoorie to stay over there.

If you ever dreamt of having a holiday home in Mussoorie, here's a chance of fulfilling your dream. Seclude hotel is a perfect holiday home...which offers an excellent blend of luxury with artistic interiors (very tastefully done-up). It's situated 5 min's from taxi stand (start of mall road) and yet away from hustle-bustle of the city, offering a peaceful stay (reason why we take holiday in the first place). The place has great view of the valley and overall me and my friend had a fantastic experience at this place (stayed on 15th August) ! Thank you to Mrs Ira Chauhan for the amazing hospitality. We would definitely come back to this pace...

Very good resort ideal for couple, faimly.  The view from the Terrace is spectacular, you can enjoy having breakfast, dinner and spend a lot of time outside. Food was good in quality and quantity and we never thought of eating outside. Mall Road is just 10 minutes walking distance, so you may leave your car and just go for a stroll.

I happened to visit this place recently. The location is awesome , The rooms are based on songs with themes matching the name of the song. The food was quite good and the staff hospitable. The weather added to the beauty of the place with the clouds covering the valley. Would definitely recommend the place

I along with my friends stayed there for a night. The overall look of this property is very attractive and interiors are very creative. The rooms were clean, food was great, staff was very cooperative and the location was convenient too. Looking forward to staying here again.

The hotel's location is what fascinates me and I have been to this hotel twice now. The rooms are well lit, tidy and moreover the view they offer is just so picturesque. The staff is humble and food also tastes good. On the whole if you want to take a break from your busy schedule and wanna head to the queen of hills then seclude should be your destination. Quiet,serene and blissful.

We stayed in the White and Red rooms for 3 nights.Incase you want to stay in close vicinity of Mall Road,this is a good option,Though the climb to the hotel is steep,the staff help with luggage and are cooperative.Mussorie has become noisy ,however this place is comparitively away from traffic.Preferred the White room ,very comfortable and clean beds.The place is relatively new and staff quick to fix issues.Breakfast was quite nice and we enjoyed the special tea made to our liking.Overall Value for money .

"Seclude" Mussoorie lives up to its name...It is located atop high ground on the hills with a view. It is quite and distanced from other properties nearby. It was a family getaway with four adults and two children, any apprehension on our part gave way to peace of mind and security when we reached there. It is a well-maintained place with neat and clean rooms, a Dining cum Ball Room and a Terrace. The dining area has a small library and you may spend some time reading books or listening to music in the evening or noon. The interior of rooms are fresh, walls painted in bright colours and good lighting. We had a big and one smaller room, the big one could have accommodated a Sofa though. The view from the Terrace is spectacular, you can enjoy having breakfast, dinner and spend a…

Stayed here in a group... And enjoyed every moment of our stay here.. The place is very taste fully done, great people naveen, shashi and abhijeet who manage the show and do every bit to make your stay as comfortable as you want..  You may find many properties which have been nicely done and have nice views and good location so just two stars for that.. And the remaining three stars are for the three gems of seclude Mussoorie.  Hope to be back soon.

Everything was so awesome, be it location, theme based rooms, open lawn, fresh and delicious food, staff and chef. The view of doon valley from lawn, while sipping hot cup of masala/flavoured tea will give you absolute relax. Chef is always ready to cook food of your taste and variety. All rooms are theme based on colours, you will love to spend each night in every room. Blue and purple has  best view from window. Orange has mini library in room. Yellow has perfect lighting setup, thus I can not say which room is the best. This hotel(basically its not a hotel, its a private bungalow which turned into hotel) is not far from picture palace, so you can just walk down there and go to cafe of your choice.   I have few suggestions as well: wi-fi is not reachable/week when you are in…

Everything was great, loved every bit of our stay! Tidy rooms n clean bathrooms, orange crush was exceptionally perfect. Staff was very courteous, friendly, helpful, cooperative. But the service was a bit slow. Food was yummy and fresh, the ambience beats every thing. A great place to stay to relax and Special thanks to Naveen and the chefs.

i stayed in this hotel for 01nights  booked in MAP plan for a valley view room. view from the balcony.food quality taste is good. and kitchen and room service staff is supportive(especially Naveen ).  hotel is having a beautiful lawn/garden . very good to spent time with friends .  overall hotel is good ,Seclude is a home away from home set amidst the serene mussoorie hills. the hotel sits a top a hill just b4 entering mall road and commands its locations amongst the clouds. The rooms are very well designed and comfortable on all aspects. Washrooms and neat and well fitted. The only issue is a small steep climb which has to b taken to reach the hotel from the parking zone. As mentioned by all others, the staff is quit exceptional and helpful. Esp Naveen who runs the show out…

To Start With, It is not a hotel it's a private bungalow which is converted in to a Hotel which has 7 rooms in different styles and themes....There are lot of positives and negatives with this..I will start with positives and goes to negatives I have experienced during my stay:-  Positives:-  Great View from the resort, It has open sitting area which has small pond(very small as it has 2-3 fishes) , next to it is fireplace, where you can party...projector is there for viewing movies...Dinning area has some books to read (although books are there in almost all the rooms)  Food is great and not very costly...Must have moong dal, pakoras, sambhar dosa, idli,rajma rice...  Rooms were designed very artistic..each room has its own theme and colour..nice interiors...spacious rooms…

WoW...!! That's the 1st word which come outta your mouth the moment u step in.. There's nothing more pleasing than to see yourself relaxing amidst the nature with clouds beneath your feet.. It's not just the Property which wins ur heart Quality of Food will win ur appetite too.. Both things wins 5 Star from My Side.. But, My Only Question and Dissatisfaction is On their Services (This is wrt The Owner) which has scope for an improvement.. An Addition of 3 Personnel in Administration  (Esp at Night) will be more than enough to win another 5 Star from Me.. 😊

We were a group of 16 people chose seclude after lots of online search....Awesome weather made us want more of the stay at the end of our trip. Few Pros and Cons. Pro: 1. My partner and I spent 6 nights at Padmini Nivas. We had room #10, large,  with windows on 3 sides and magnificent views. Staff was always available, friendly and helpful. We loved eating on outside terrace in cool morning sun, overlooking distant Doon valley. We are in our 70's, from New York, US, and had concerns about digestion, so we ate all meals at hotel and stayed healthy. Prices incredibly reasonable! Staff is knowledgeable and can advise about local hikes and trips.We walked 5 minutes up hill to fascinating Mall road with vendors, cows and monkeys.  Be prepared to walk hills and enjoy cold nights with just a space heater.

That was the awesome day. Everything was nice provided by you..thank you trip advisor. No words to explain those moments of my trip, I can just only say that was just wow trip.. again thank you trip advisor

Yes it s different type of property comparing to those like other hotels . This is an old property converted to hotel. It has two parking both from mall road and other road down side. Has a good apartment too having 2 two room sets. Nice view and location. Fooding was really good as mentioned in many of reviews. But Tandoor was not available apart from this we love there Thepla and vegetables. Staff was very co-operative.

The hotel room was good Book deluxe and above room The hotel staff is very courteous and friendly Food is also good The hotel is on the Mall Road and accessible to all places easily  The rooms are having enough space and bed was comfortable

The hotel is really quirky, with old features, big doors and high ceilings, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were large, as was the bathroom. The rooms felt quite cold when we stayed in them, so we relied on trying to warm it up with plug in heaters. This wasn't too much of an issue, we just had to make sure we slept with our jumpers on!

We had a lovely stay enjoying the beautiful views from our balcony and eating the wonderful food. Padmini Nivas is ideally located away from most of the noise but with the markets and shops just a short walk away. The room service was amazing and all staff were friendly and helpful, they arranged for us to have a guided trek through a beautiful nature reserve - very highly recommended.

Just perfect! Spacious rooms with added dressing space, spacious bathrooms, tastefully done corridors with seating arrangement, garden with swings, benches to peacefully observe sun rising and setting across the Doon valley. Best part is that it is bang in the middle of the mall road, yet a few meters of descent to this hotel gives as much peace and tranquility as any resort. Only caveat - may not be the best place for senior citizens as the ascent when going back to mall road, while short is quite steep.

I had a stay of 2 days here and I must say it was awesome. The property is very well maintained and the staffs are humble and very very helpful 24 hours round the clock. The location is at the Mall Road and hence you need not hire any vehicles to visit nearby places. Overall it’s a value for money and great experience.

The hotel is very well located on the mall road- yet away from the noise. They serve authentic Gujrati food and also very good Indian vegetarian food. Egg preparations are available - which are cooked in a separate kitchen space. The staff is very helpful.  Surprisingly each room had its own Set Top Box - so there were good  TV options. The surprising this was that everything worked ! The heaters, availability of hot water bottles, room service.

Noisy, decrepit, loud Mussoorie with its incessant and aggressive motorbikes and cars is one of our least liked places visited in India, and Padmini Nivas didn't relieve the pain.  This is another faded heritage hotel with an impressive aura of Raj history in interesting and evocative buildings, and with a wonderful view. The position does provide some insulation from the noise of the street and is fairly well placed for walking along the length of the town. However, this not a place to be in the depths of winter.   It is understandable that these buildings are designed for hot weather, but there was no real attempt to warm the perishingly cold lounge and dining room, so the only option while in the hotel was to go to the bedroom to huddle in front of an electric fire.…

Padmini Nivas is a wonderful place to stay - charming rooms, good vegetarian food and lots of flowers. I liked how it was walking distance from the main part of Mall Road, but still quiet. During the day, we had breakfast in the spacious porch and sometimes sit outside in the garden and read. The staff was friendly.  There were many different kinds of rooms. We stayed in a Deluxe Room that was in the main building. There was a Suite Room with a double and single bed. Some Standard rooms that were in an adjoining wing, seemed good if you were with a group and got couple of rooms in a row; and also the spacious games room (more like a glass hall) would be nearby.

Right up, don't know the reason this property is so highly rated on TA! The location of this hotel is just fantastic with excellent views from the rooms. It is also easily accessible from the Mall road.  This is where the good things end! The property is poorly maintained. It's a shame since it has so much to offer in terms of views. There has been not attention paid to maintaining the premises or the rooms. The lawns seem like they have been untouched for ages. The rooms are jaded, the bathroom fittings are from a different era altogether. If this is their idea of "heritage hotel.... Then God save them!  The rooms are quite inconvenient as well, and not at all suitable for senior citizens. They provide run down heaters in the rooms. They claim to have a famous Gujrati /Jain…

we stayed from 21st Nov to 25th Nov. Ideally located property. It is located downside of mall road.Mall road is the heart of Mussourie.And these converted heritage property gives very good of Doon valley.And management of Padmini Niwas is very guest friendly. I visited these in 2017 dec and checked in this hotel, view was nice, service was good staff was genuine, they treated me genuinely and. Everything was nice, Tariff was also justified according to room and services. Rest, If i will visit again, Hotel is fixed that much i loved it.

Around 4:30 pm, two staff members came knocking the door and told that the previous occupant had left something valuable. It was found at the corner of our room. Why did not the cleaning guy take care of such things? …

Comfortable stay. The staff was very cooperative and the overall stay was very nice. Would recommend it to all the tourists visiting mussoorir for booking this hotel for a memorable holiday. highly recommended

My husband, siblings and I decided to go to Mussoorie after a trip to Hardwar.   A friend had recommended Padmini Nivas and based on the recommendation we stayed there for five nights. Location : Hotel opens up in mall road.  Staff : Staff is very friendly   Food : ordered not that much but everything was nice  Rooms : Rooms are very basic, don't expect anything fancy but value for money price range.

If you are a mountain lover and love serinity, this is best destination for you in mussourie. Hospitality is unquestionable. They cook awesome food.specially the Garwali thali. You can spent an entire evening by watching the Dehradun valley from the hotel. The hotel is directly connected to mall road. Only crunch is, it's a bit heavy on pocket. But the quality is at per with the price. Recommended and I am planning for second visit.

My wife and I visited Mussoorie for a few days on our recent visit to India in September 2018.   Our stay at Hotel Padmini Nivas, a charming building with wonderful views, made our trip all the more enjoyable. The on-hand owner of the property, the managers and the staff were friendly and committed to making our stay enjoyable. All the meals were homestyle — varied and fresh, including local dishes. The hotel arranged a trek to the Jabarkhet Nature Reserve a short distance away - for a true experience of what it could be like if development could be managed responsibly. Highly recommended.  We would absolutely go back and unreservedly recommend to all who plan to visit Mussoorie to stay at Hotel Padmini…

The stay at Padmini Nivas was an absolutely divine heavenly experience.Everything - the rooms, service and ofcourse the Of d which was the USP of our stay.I will definitely recommend my friends to visit at least once in their life time.

We enjoyed a lot and very good hospitality and awesome food which is the best in Mussoorie and also you should visit jaberkhet which should not be missed. Thanks Vikram bhai the manager for good service

Padmini Niwas makes you feel that you are not away from home. It’s location, staff and all the managerial people are very courteous. The food ( only veg ) made me feel that I Never missed my home. Rooms are very comfortable and with all amenities. To stay at Padmini Niwas is an experience in itself.

I had the privilege of visiting Hotel Padmini Niwas recently for a family get together in September 2018.  Every one was conspiring to make my trip memorable and fascinating to the core! We stayed for a day on our way to Sankri for Rupin pass trek. It is a superb property, with great valley view. Rooms are very clean and spacious. The food is great and service is fantastic. Rooms are provided with a kettle and coffee/tea. Very friendly management

The rooms are amazing with an old world feel to them and offer an amazing view of Mussoorie. The hotel staff is always helpful and ready to fulfill all requests as soon as possible. It is situated in the heart of the mall road, which makes it my first pick, always.

This heritage property is the best place to stay in Mussoorie  On Mall Road yet away from the crowds in a niche with a valley view The rooms are spacious and the linen is clean! Amidst the hustle and chaos of the Mall, is a small haven of peace and tranquility called Padmini Nivas. There are rooms to suit one's budget and many offer wonderful valley views.  The estate has a history too.  There is a quaint stand alone cottage, standing on the property with it's own garden which is outstanding.  The meals are all vegetarian with egg dishes available on request. The place to be in when in Mussorie, fantastic views, very convenient location well connected to Mall Road, the rooms are great the staff very helpful and the vegetarian food is simply divine. A home away from home... With a very efficient and ever smiling staff, superb meals - especially the Gujarati thali, a helpful front desk to guide u to all the scenic spots in and nearby Mussorrie, a very motherly owner who makes u feel at home. A heritage property in the midst of the city (mall road) which takes u back to the golden era. Wonderful ambience and very hygienic - clean rooms, washrooms and a very efficient service. A place that touches ur heart. Will be coming back soon.

Great property right on Mall Road, with parking and great approaches. Heritage hotel. Mind boggling views of the valley. Rooms that take you back to the Maharaja era. Previously owned by the princely estate of Rajpipla. Prices very reasonable , services superb. Friendly front desk and great vegetarian food. They also arrange trips to nearby sightseeing spots. Will recommend to anyone coming to Mussorie.

Amidst the big, new hotels that are lining the hills of Mussoorie, we found this wonderful heritage property which  was a delight! The people running it, the service staff were absolutely wonderful. The rooms all have an old world Haveli feel including the bathrooms. There's a lovely courtyard to just sit, enjoy the weather and drink innumerable cups of tea. I stayed in this heritage property with my husband and son and had an amazing experience.We had booked a stand alone cottage with a private garden.The rooms had an old charm as if we were staying in haveli. Location of the hotel is nice - tucked in between the mall road and the doon valley.The garden restaurant had amazing views. Room service is prompt and nice.There are kid's swings and also games room for table tennis, carrom and billiards. Overall,highly recommended !!!

Spent a good 3 days in this beautiful heritage hotel for my sister's wedding. We we're lucky to have room number 3 which opened up to the garden from the back. This hotel is centrally located, right on the Mall Road. They have nice rooms with all amenities, serves superbly delicious meals n to top it all have a great ambience n courteous staff... Definitely recommended!!

I had booked the rooms with Padmini Niwas for self, family and friends from 5-7th July 2018. It was an experience that we all will cherish for a long time. There were several guest attending a wedding and the hotel staff went out of their way to make each and every one comfortable. Personal touch was their hall mark All in all a very…

A wonderful property with people on the other side of the counter who did everything to make the stay a homely one despite the pressures of families which had got together for a marriage and that too th marriage of a daughter.  Food was one of the main highlight. Everything has a taste unique to its own and the food was enjoyed by one and all. The owner is a lovely lady who, despite her age does not tire out. She is personally available and takes you n like family. Passion is her fuel to run this property at her age.  Thank you for affording such a wonderful experience.

Being from Delhi, when we decided to get married in July, we wanted to find a place that was cool, peaceful, had a heritage charm to it and felt like Home. Padmini Niwas was all of this and much more ! It is a sprawling old property, with cosy corners and a lot of plants (my favourites), private gardens and full of humble old world charm. The view of the mountains especially at sunset will leave you wanting to extend your stay :) The entire staff is extremely courteous and though we exceeded the hotel capacity by more than double with our guests, they never faltered in their conduct.   Mrs.Vohra (the Owner) and Mr.Vikram (the Manager) were simply the best hosts one could ask for. They made the wedding into a personal affair and went beyond their obligation to ensure our comfort.…

We booked Padmini Niwas for our daughter's wedding and words are not enough to thank Mrs. Whora, Mr. Vikram and all their staff for their personal involvement. If room service is improve.. like geaser,tea kettle n room to check out before giving then it's best place to stay n also we will recommend to anyone.We had a great weekend and food was very good,rest all other things view, resorts is at good location.

Food was delicious especially your poori and bhaji. We are missing that taste. But bathrooms were not so good. But that's ok. Location was very beautiful. As well as hotel's greenery was also attractive. We enjoyed a lot

Visiting this place was like reconnecting to oneself far away from the outer chaos world.We were mesmerised by being at this quite surreal place be it be surrounded by beautiful valley view in front,mall road on the top, roses at the backyard or the cold shiver while sitting on the swing. We visited this Heritage Hotel near mall road last weekend.    Located at a very nice location towards library. Hotel has a view of valley from rooms. Hotel is located at a very nice location. This is a great place on the Mall Road. It is a beautiful heritage building in the middle of the city but still secluded from the crowd with an picturesque view of the doon valley. Please try the various thalis at the restaurant!

Its an absolutely convenient and comfortable stay at The Padmini Niwas. Right next to the mall road.2 parings make the place even more accessible during peak summer vacations and you can easily escape the traffic.The food was great and the room service was excellent.My 2 year old started crying at 3 at night and even though the kitchen was closed they arranged milk for us on request.We are absolutely delighted to have chosen this hotel and its going to be our forever choice.

Nice old fashioned place. On the Mall Road, but once you enter the hotel premise it is peaceful and with good views. With a sit out in the front of the hotel with great valley view. The staff was helpful.

Its right on Mall Rd, so it's quite convenient. However, lots of heavy climbing required so would not recommend for senior citizens. The food is also pretty great. But there is nothing specifically to do here, but rest and have a good view.

One of the best places to stay in Mussoorie. The staff including Gyan Singh and Jai Singh make sure that your stay is comfortable and at the same time memorable. Our group of 5 people booked the suite room for a comfortable stay. The rooms were huge and were exactly like they shared in the pictures sent to us before booking. Fabulous quiet serene surroundings is What greets one at the awesome padmini niwas musoorie. Lovely property. Quaint and old world. Sweeping vista views of the valley. Quiet, even though its just off the Mall. Great staff and General Manager. Always there yet unobtrusive - willing to do that personalised bit for you without making it seem like a burden on them.

It was an amazing experience with our whole family...hospitality was amazing ...you must stay in this hotel whenever you visit mussorrie....the location, food, entire staff everything is excellent... have a pleasant stay....

A wonderful place with easy access to mall road. The hospitality even beats the location! Cozy cottages overlooking, lovely lawns, mouth-watering food and a helpful staff- everything that you need for a perfect family vacation!

Brilliantly tucked away Property in the heart of the mall road  Familiar faces cheerful staff foster a unique relationship.One that endures and adorn the spartan accomodation that the place offers  Keep up the good work

Everytime we have stayed there.... Has been a great experience! Nothing better than sitting outside on a bright morning and gorging on delicious paranthas... The manager was very helpful both for us and our driver friend , when organising our accommodation. After checking in we received complementary Indian Chai tea which we had in the courtyard in the sun, very relaxing. Close to all the markets. Great stay!
