Stayed here during last 4 days of March. Great central location yet fairly quiet. Very nice manager who provided excellent advice on sites to visit and some hikes and helped with organizing drivers etc.. The rooms are a bit outdated but very clean and functional. Wifi worked fine in the room and breakfast was excellent. Will go here again. Mussourie was very busy when we visited. We thought it was off season but it actually was a 4 week holiday weekend for folks from Delhi - traffic in the mountain town was VERY slow.

The erstwhile Rajpipla Palace paints a vivid picture of colonial days long gone by. The entrance lobby with their amazing tulips and lilies add a riot of colours to the green and whitewashed exteriors. Add to that Moti and Toofan, the pet dogs who are always there to provide innocent lovely looks that will melt your heart. The strategically placed sit-outs are great to see the world go by as you sip on your tea/ coffee/ hot cocoa and contemplate life. The rooms with their period furniture add to the charm of the place. The heaters make you feel cosy when it's chilling outside.   The Deluxe Suite is spacious for 5 people (we were 2 adults, 2 kids and 1 teenager). The bathroom was huge and basic amenities like soap, shampoo etc. inside was well provided for, except that there was…

This hotel is all about bombarding your senses with the elegance and beauty of a bygone era. Its architecture, decor, furniture, upholstery gets you transported to the early 19th century...  The Management and staff were simply amazing with their sense of hospitality. I had booked a double room for my 3 nights stay here. However, while checking in, we were upgraded to a personal cottage. That was amazing!!!.  The cottage was a true reflection of the british raj style of living. Clean bedsheets, quilts and blankets, pillows, towels, sofas and bathroom.The bathroom was equal in size of the bedroom. The cottage also had something called a "Powder Room" attached to the bathroom. Which was the massive attraction point for a history buff like me.  The food was tasty and the service…

Padmini Nivas is located on Mall road and is easy walk from Library end. I have stayed here once during 2010 and I really liked the ambiance and great hospitality offered by the  Man in charge!  I visited them again last year without any booking and they were courteous enough to accommodate. Hospitality was the same and I was wondering that even with change in time, they have remain modest and caring at the same time.  They have added variety of options in their menu which works really well although on Mall road one can find virtually everything.  For those who wants a peaceful stay with a touch of Old world charm, Padmini Nivas will offer everything they are looking for.

I have stayed here now 5-6 times in all seasons. A real heritage hotel that transports you back to a bygone era. Amazing views from the front porch, lovely rooms furnished in the classic style, the staff are gentle and obliging for every need, and add on to that possibly the best vegetarian restaurant in the whole of India. All this only hop and jump to the bustling Mall of Mussoorie, ad further afield the surroundings offer all sorts of hiking opportunities (don't miss the Jabarkhet Nature Reserve).  A great place to escape to.

Padmini Nivas is conveniently located on the Mall, but is still secluded and peaceful with a lovely garden. The staff has remained practically unchanged over our innumerable visits, and amazes us each time with their care and attention. The food is another highlight, always freshly prepared and tasty - with very good Gujarati thalis.   Shalini & Bharat

I have been coming here for more than 25 years and my kids have now become adults but even more than me and my wife my children don't want to go anywhere else and we call it our second home!All thanks to the hospitality of mrs worah and vikram zutshi along with their ever helpful staff and servers!I can only hope they never change!

Excellent location, good service, delicious food preparation. Been regular visitor to the hotel since 1995 it gives the filling of second home. Staff is friendly and always helpful. Strongly recommend.

We have been visiting this place for over 10 years now every year without fail and the feeling is incredible. Every One from The Owner to the Manager to The Attendant makes you feel special. I will strongly recommend this place for families and for quite couple time. With an unobstructed view of the dun valley cut off from the crowd yet just a short walk away from the mall road, this place has probably the best location in mussoorie.

Padmini Nivas has been our only choice of holiday accommodation in Mussoorie for over two decades now.  It feels like a second home. You're welcomed by a team that is always eager and on their toes to make your stay as comfortable as you can dream it to be.  They make special food for you if you have specific food preferences or health restrictions, keep the rooms are impeccably clean, help you plan your holiday if you so wish and they do it with a smile on their faces.   The surroundings are green and peaceful and the price is really easy on your pocket.  I recommend it wholeheartedly.

Nice heritage hotel with royal rooms. Good service and best food at reasonable prices. Highly recommend. Hotel has a large area which needs to be developed. Any way for kids still they have a large number of swings and games. Thanks

Stayed at this Hotel/Heritage property from 26-30 December 2017. The experience was simply fantastic. The location of the property is convenient, near Mall Road.  Simultaneously it is away from the "noise" that is associated with a Mall Road. The room  was spacious with a Tower heater (We went there with a Three year old) and the hotel service is efficient.Sipping coffee in the  morning in the open to sky seating in the garden was a real treat esp when the temp is 7 degrees.. A small slide and swing kept our daughter entertained as well.  The food was yum. The Gujrati Thali is their highlight and it kept up to its name. Breakfast everyday had variety - South Indian/Upma/Paratha/Eggs-Toast. Really spot on.  We stayed in Room No. 10- with giant windows overlooking the valley,…

The restro dere dont have any card swip machine and staff in restro is very rude..the manger who sit outside is really really very rude.spoil my day like anything. Will nvr ever want to visit dere again..the food was just ok ok..bad ambience old looking hotel.

Had stayed here for 2 days on family trip. Great time spent . Hotel staff warm and helpful.  Nice place to stay n views r  awesome . Nice location right on mall. Definitely want to come back again. Hotel has its own parking which is also an advantage . Nice view and ample space

I went there for two days in August 2017, and it was definitely a great place for me n my husband.when we reached there it was a mystic n foggy evening with a very cozy weather..it was the place where i really feel like a queen.it has a beautiful location in the hills of mussoorie...we had a fabulous dinner there n next day a very tasty breakfast.the service in this hotel gives u inner happiness..love to stay there again n really wanna click more n more pics as i did that time.

It's an awesome place.Best home like food.The location is the best in Mussorie.The valley can be seen from the bed itself.Amazing view. It's close to mall road but still it's away from the noises of mall road. It's a peaceful place.I had a great stay.

This hotel's service is very good, when we come to Dehradun, it eats food.Their prices are also very good and their service timing is also very good.We lunched here which was very tasty,We eat here Dal Makhani with  Rice.

1.Located at mall road itself. 2.Hotel is very beautiful and feel very relaxed and peaceful. 3.Food is very tasty. 4.Good choice if you prefer classy touch,cottage feel and not modern type hotel. 5.View is good as from the rooms.

This was the fifth time that I Revisited Padmini Niwaas.I am glad to say that nothing much has changed since my first visit in a good way except now that the whole staff recognizes us when we arrive . Needless to say the location of the this place is really amazing,just near the mall road yet so quaint and serene.You can see the whole valley from here. We would always  love to stay here whenever we Visit Mussoorie. Special thanks to Vikram and all the staff for making our stay  memorable every time :).

I came to this part of the country after nearly 15 years in October of 2016. Couple of things, the location is pretty good, it's just a short 2-5 minute walk away from the main Mussoorie Mall road. Second, the stay was comfortable and I was lucky to get a good room from where one can see the mountains from outside the windows. Though I didn't spend too much time in the hotel because I was on a short stay and there are too many places to see in Mussoorie and near about, I have only good things to say about the service. And on the day I was leaving, I had about a couple of hours before taking a cab back to Dehradun to board my…

This is my third visit to this property.  I visited this place with my family from 30 Nov 17 to 02 Oct 17. I made the booking in advance directly to the hotel because it was a long weekend. I had clearly mentioned my room preference in written n in reply they assured for the same. But when I reached the place after 7 hrs of journey the story started.... This old property does not give impression of a wonderful place-old colonial style room with clean and modern bathroom.But the secret lies in the front garden-on a good day one can see Dehradun (29 km).good views in the morning and also in the evening. Food served is only vegetarian and mainly in "thali" form (a typical Gujarati style).Service in the hotel and restaurant was very good-most of the employees were there for over 20 years.  On their notice board I read about Jabarkhet-which said "would you rather walk on a meadow than on the mall?" then visit us.

Worst hotel to stay with family no security at all few guys in room were drunked and abusing whole night but staff was unable to handle and no one present in reception also intercom was switched off after 11.00

Humble staff, Decent food and smiling service in a 150 years old hotel. What else one need. The rooms were clean and the bathroom tidy. They even have a pet dog at the hotel. Highly recommended. Would return back soon.

Beautiful, quite heritage property right on the mall road. Courteous staff always ready to help. Simple, hygenic and tasty food. Loved the stay.   Note for the management : Grass in the back garden needs to be trimmed.

Awesome place, awesome people and a memorable jouney..guruji travels best in delhi..services were very excellent with safe and secure jouney..i would love to go again with guruji travels and will share my lovely experience with others..

This is one of the best hotel in Mussoorie as per me. Very serene property, transformed very well from a lavish house of queen to a modern hotel. I loved food served very much. Staff is co-operative  Manager have over smiling face and owner has little 😜. Rest everything is good and up to the mark. Keep it up

The charm that this property holds is evident in the fact that, this is the 4th time that my family and I stayed in this beautiful hotel. This time we were a group of 11 adults and 6 children. The staff of the hotel were particularly accommodating and did everything in their power to provide us with a beautiful stay. The hotel is on the Mall Road yet away from the hustle bustle of the crowds. The view of the valley is breathtaking. Mr. Vikram and Mr. Ankush were very attentive to all the demands of such a huge group. The kitchen staff of the hotel deserves a special mention. They went out of their way in providing us with delicious meals at odd hours considering that we were travelling with small children. This is by far the best place to stay in Mussorie if travelling with…

This is the 11th time i have stayed here. This place has its own charm.  Perfect location, situated at the mall road but still away from all the hustle and noises. I have stayed in almost all the type of rooms here and think i have a spl connect with this hotel as i have been staying here since my childhood....

Nice location great heritage property, good food , nice people. we fully enjoyed the hospitality of thus nice hotel. I quite liked to ambiance  of this hotel, well maintained and really reasonable price.

We came to this hotel in May. There is no sign of the hotel on the road whatsoever. There is brilliant scenery from the hotel. Most of the rooms are very small as they formerly belong to the servants of the king of Rajpipla. The big rooms belong to the King and Queen. The food is ok but the kitchen is not clean.

This heritage hotel is gorgeous, like stepping into another era. It has an old world charm but with modern amenities. Tastefully decorated and very clean, we had a standard room in what use to be the bakery (if I understood correctly). We did see some of the older rooms which were full of character and also well maintained. Rooms are spacious, have stunning views and are a delight to return to after a day of exploration. The restaurant has good food and it is pleasant to relax on the beautiful veranda.The staff are really attentive and the manager very helpful. We booked 2 days and stayed 5! One of the highlights of our month in India.

Excellent ambiance.....loved the place...A must visit place for all....totally vegetarian food.just like home food...Total value for money.        Surrounded by natural scenery.              Located at very good place...centre of Mall Road.

This is a very old property but maintained very well.  Rooms have scenic view and food is appreciably better than other hotels of Mussoorie in this class,  go for it if you are looking for comfortable family stay at Mall Road.

I rate the place of stay on aspects of Ambience, Outdoor Spaces, Location, Food and Cleanliness/Maintenance. This is one of the few hotels that scored 5 on 5 1. Ambience:  This hotel offers great ambience with a distinct victorian character which is being very well-maintained with due respect to its heritage value. Being an architect myself I completely enjoyed the charming character of the building, inside spaces and furnishings. 2. Outdoor Areas:  Care and attention given to landscaping the outdoor areas in this hotel rivals the most elite hotels of Mussoorie. In my opinion, outdoor areas in a hotel in a hill station are even more important than indoor spaces. Meticulously designed and maintained seating areas, rose garden, games room, play equipments and a small lotus pond…

As i said its a home away from home so do not expect it to be a hotel. I will write my experience about the place in details below.  1st the negative's   1. Wifi is slow ( Manager assured its a temp issue ) 2. It's a pure veg kitchen hence if u are a nonveg then u have to compromise or eat outside. 3. It has been over 6 years since I have been staying at the Padmini Nivas for my annual family vacations and the experience just keeps getting better.   Rooms have the vintage charm and are very comfortable as well.  The staff is really helping and the service is great.  The food is a paradise for vegetarians...would really recommend the healthy poha breakfast and the Gujarati Kadi for lunch. Made to order dishes per your tastes can also be arranged.   Kid friendly with ample play areas, gardens, swings and games room.   The accessibility is perfect with personal cars and taxis as well.

The property is very well located, the staff is very cooperative, good food. I booked heritage rooms which were very spacious and clean.  The restaurant was also very good and the food was quite delicious.

Padmini Nivas is situated in the centre of Mall Road. So the location is perfect. We easily walked to reach the mall road. Even Camel Back's road is nearby. My family stayed in the deluxe suite which was perfect and we had a very beautiful view of the valley. The hotel staff is very courteous. The food prices are very apt and food is also nice. Overall our trip was made awesome by our stay here!

Had a comfortable stay. Staff was definitely very well trained and professional . Food was good... special varieties were available for Gujaratis ( which is uncommon in a place dominated by alu parathas😊)  Special appreciation for maintaining a good variety of flora and fauna...

Heritage property and not so big rooms and you might start wondering whether its really a top hotel in Mussorrie. Then u stay in this place for 2 days and you will feel it should be rated higher.  Location is amazing, its on mall road and still u don't hear a single sound from the road.   Service is awesome , food spread is unbelievable. We ordered everything from idli , dosa ,  poha to poori for breakfast and all of them we served hot and tasted great. They serve you , pamper you and after 3 days at this place we felt like never leaving.     Thanks for making our stay in Mussorrie a memorable one.

It offers location and view even better than promised on the website. Priveleged to experience the heritage. Needs to improve the bed and mattress for more comfortable stay. It offers the best view of mussoorie.

We chose to spend one night at this hotel considering its heritage background and good reviews about property. Its a small yet nice property. The rooms are reasonably good but not with much amenities. It practically gives you feeling of being at home. While selecting room for booking, I decided to book suite room expecting better amenities but it was no different than a normal room except that the main room was bigger in size and had a small room along. The food was very nice with homely touch. We decided to try the Gujarati Thali in dinner and it tasted very nice. The food was as it prepared at home. Even the morning breakfast was very tasty.  The staff was very courteous.  Coming to negative points the price is pretty high as compared to room amenities. Further, the hotel is…

This is a heritage property and is well maintained. The ambience is serene even though the location is right on the mall road. The people and staff are very helpful and nice. Rooms are clean and the food is good as well. We stayed at the standard room which had a small balcony with a hammock and 2 chairs and it was the perfect spot for having tea. There's greenery all around the place and some nice spots to just sit and relax. One particular area that we liked the most was just outside the reception with sofas and a nice view of the mountains. In the evening we just sat there for hours chatting, relaxing, enjoying the view and of course having tea.  Overall I'd say it's the best place to stay in Mussoorie as per the price. There are other bigger hotels as well but this place has…

Hotel Padmini Nivas has most probably been the best hotel stay of my life. The rooms have a breathtaking view of the Doon valley. The rooms are very comfortable with excellent room service. The whole area of the hotel is huge and sprawling. It has been a pleasure staying at Hotel Padmini Nivas.

We choose Hotel Padmini Nivas after long thinking and reviews. But our decision was totally correct. Hotel service, location, food and perpendicularly rooms all things are excellent. I will advise to check in Padmini Nivas whenever go to mussoorie. One can have great view of valley, very tasty and hygienic food, cooperative staff and easy access to the hotel. Location is peaceful. Beautiful garden, sitting arrangement overlooking valley is mind blowing.They have maintained the property. We stayed for 13th and 14th may two nights but i felt that that was not enough. I will come again if possible and will defiantly stay again for more then two nights. I congratulate Mr. Vikram and his team for such a nice service and thank you all for making our stay memorable.

The hotel is located right on the mall road and has enough parking. The rooms are decent in the old Mussourie style but not very posh. The service is very good and the management is very helpful. There is a nice garden with great views of the valley. Our family really enjoyed our time there.

This hotel is accessible from the Mall Road and the Cart Road lying below. The mall road is closed for vehicles during morning and evening hours. If you are not careful most of the hotels have access only from the mall road and you have to walk to the hotel and carry all the luggage! The view is excellent looking down the valley. Rooms are good though not spacious (there are deluxe rooms also). Toilets are modern.  The most attractive part is the food. All vegetarian. I am not a veg but really loved the taste of Veg. The caretakers are polite and the service excellent. They allot one person to take care of you for the entire stay. You can tip him separately and contribute to the common collection box. No need to keep tipping every time.

It was pretty mediocre for the price.  The grounds were lovely, the room was just ok, and I was unimpressed with the staff.   The grounds have nicely tended flower gardens and a view of the main drag below. It is a 12-15 minute walk to town.  The beds are horribly uncomfortable. They have the basic futon-style mattress common to India, but worn so thin that the boards underneath poked into my back. I ended up sleeping sideways to make up for it. The rest of the room was fine.  Here's why I was unimpressed with the staff:  -We complied with the posted request not to tip individual staff members, but the porters hovered an awkwardly long time outside our room waiting for a tip. Then when I went to put a tip in the collective box meant to be shared with the whole staff, the guy…

This place is phenomenally beautiful, it is amazingly well-maintained.. the views from our room were stunning....I woke up to an amazing morning here...had lovely breakfast in the open area...the folks running this place are very helpful Mr.Ankush...thank you so much for making our stay superbly wonderful We will go back to Mussoorie and stay with this same hotel again definitely

I think one of the best located hotel in Mussourie.  Awesome views, ultimate food especially for Hain food lovers courteous staff friendly manager made my family trip a memorable one.  Parking space is also ample. Recommended for family stay.

Its an ideal place for pure veg travelers. Food is excellent and most important is that it serves half plate also which prevents unnecessary waste of food. Management is very good. Staff is very polite & courteous. Very tasty & hygienic gujarati food is available.

This property is a heritage property from 200 years ago. This house passed hands of several British citizen during the pre independence era and finally landed hands on king of Rajasthan whose youngest daughter was Padmini thus the name of this hotel. The owners of this hotel currently live in Mumbai and they have done fabulous job at restoring this palace. They have preserved the furniture, lights and even switches from those times. All the rooms in this hotel are unique, we stayed in a cottage which is away from the main block of the hotel. The cottage is huge with veranda , dressing area and 300sq ft bathroom. It is a true luxury. The fire place is replaced by modern heater which is pretty cool.  The food here is great, amazing north Indian and Gujarati food at your room.  …

My family has been visiting this wonderful place since the last 20 years. We have seen it grow from good to phenomenal. It is simplistic, yet luxurious and classy. For me, it's a home away from home and I cant recommend it enough. A special shout out to Vikram and Jai for making the stay fantastic each time! :)

I was backpacking around India when I arrived in Mussoorie and people on the street led me to this hotel! Not knowing anything before coming here, I was very surprised at the quality of hospitality and facilities here. The building is heritage and has history. While not a modern building, everything is working and clean.  The view, beautiful gardens, and (slightly) secluded setting all made it a very relaxing experience. The decor is classy but not opulent - lounging in the verandah, sipping chai, and chatting with other holidaymakers does take you back to simpler times!  The manager was very helpful, including arranging a short trek in a nearby private nature reserve - this is definitely a recommended experience!

It is a very nice, earthy stay at Padmini Niwas. The hotel is situated right on mall road and is a 5 min from library chowk. The hotel has very beautiful gardens where the beauty of flowers was in its full bloom. I suggest staying in Room No - 7 as it provides unobstructed view of Doon valley and provides complete privacy for visitors.

A great property in Mussorie with slightly higher rate. This hotel can be considered as vegetarian paradise. Staff is quite responsive and they stretch to make your stay memorable. Only one thing that can be added is the fire place as that will give truly heritage feeling.

Pamdini Nivas - is tucked away beautifully between the mall road and the highway below.   The views from the property are fabulous and one can enjoy watching the Doon valley for hours and bask in the sun listening to the birds.   The property care takers Jay and Ankush are very friendly alongwith the Himalayan Sheep Dog named Moti.   The room in which we stayed was from the old heritage wing.   The room size was colosaal with 20 feet or more high cielings.  The room had an ante chamber which made it great for a small family.   The rooms had wooden flooring, was super clean and bed was really comfortable.  The food( vegetarian) was spot on and one could enjoy the leisurely breakfast sitting  outside in the verandah or the small garden both in front and back of the property. …

Had a wonderful stay in padmani  niwas. Rooms  are big and beautifully decorated gives the feeling of Royal stay,  Wash rooms are also  very big  , a Good variety of food in the breakfast, a very good. Family hotel

The property is very conveniently located at the Mall road. Its walking 5 Minutes from the library chowk and next door to Iconic Ritz Cinema on mall road. Once you come up from a slope of approx 50 Mtr you are right bank on the mall road. If you are travelling in your own car you can bring it to the hotel by paying Rs 150/- Govt tax to enter mall road in a private car. The staff is courteous and offer service with a smile. The food is vegetarian both Indian and continental with a separate section of Egg preparations. You can have food in your room, or on the terrace or in the terrace lawn or in a formal dining area. The food is delicious and served hot in cassarole. You can bring Non vegetarian food from outside and have it in the privacy of your room.The Most room offers good…

Very cosy and comfortable place to stay. Great service and hospitality.  Stayed at the deluxe suite room. The largest room used by the king of Rajpipla was too cold and the lone heater was of no use in the blistering Mussoorie cold. The night was super cold and uncomfortable.  Fortunately got the room changed to Rani padmini's bedroom which was a similar category but a smaller room and that was great !! Very cozy. Would highly recommend that.  This is ,however ,not the place for those looking for stunning valley views. Infact the views from the whole of Mussoorie overlooking the Doon valley is one of lots of buildings ! For the really beautiful views of the mountains, one needs to go out of Mussoorie. Just enjoy the weather !  Dearth of conveniently located plug points is a…

We stayed in the cottage upstairs secluded from the main hotel , near the cutest plant nursery. Humble ..mannered and experienced cutomer loving staff ..rooms are big and spacious as well as well decorated complementing the building structure ...just one thing ..lights are too dim .so just a suggestion to the staff to brighten up the rooms for a more better look. The outside sitting area is so nice and cosy with plants and flowers around you .. Food is absolutely delicious.They only serve veg food ..but its so well prepared and lovingly served. Mall us road is just a small walk away . Padmini Nivas in all was wonderful experience .Do visit !!!!

Went to Mussoorie in March 2017 and stayed with my wife and 3 months old daughter for 3 nights at Padmini Nivas hotel. Happy to say that the stay was pleasant. Very friendly staff, clean room/bathroom, happy to go extra mile to help you which we needed with our 3 months old daughter (boiling bottles, boiled water). We stayed in standard room which is the basic room, it has a small so to say dining area with 2 chairs and a table and 1 Jhula :). Booked from GoIbibo with 55% discount which was great and got the valley view room as requested at the time of booking. It is little downside on Mall road, so have to walk a bit on steep rise to get on mall road (little tough for old age people). Over all a very good experience, would have rated excellent if they had complimentary…

I stayed at Padmini Niwas along with my wife wef 11th March to 14th March 2017. We took a standard room (Room No. 21) - ideal for a couple. The room had a good view of the Mall (Library End). Mussoorie experienced unprecedented snowfall in 24 years, on 11th March in the evening. The room was provided with a blower to keep us warm . STAR MOVIES & other etertaining channels kept us preoccupied in the evening when the weather was inclement outside. The bathroom was clean & hygenic. Bedsheets & linens are clean. The most satisfying aspect of our stay was the delicious homemade Gujrati & other vegetarian food served at Padmini Niwas. Such was the taste that we did not try any food outside- not even coffee. Try mixed Parathas & Aloo Poha. The yellow Dal fry was an addiction for us &…

Had a wonderful stay here last week ( March 2017 ). My 3 days here were very comfortable and memorable. The place is very beautiful , clean and homely. The staff is very courteous. And the food has a very made at home taste.  PS. the owner is a very sweet person!

Beautiful place with beautiful views. The feel of nature close to your heart. Being a vegetarian myself, the food spread was excellent. Unlimited food without being charged extra is a sign of very good hospitality and good customer service. The eagerness to give the customer best service won our hearts. Thank you Padmini Nivas and the staff there for making our stay a memorable one.

This is a place where you would really want to go again and again.You cannot have enough of this place.Stayed at this hotel (and again I repeat, you would not want to call this place merely a hotel once you have been here) for two nights with family.We had an autistic child in our family, and the first thing which struck us is how beautifully we were greeted and she was told " We will make sure you can roam around freely here".They have an eye for detail, which is indeed so hard to find these days.  The rooms are beautiful.We stayed at room no 5, a family suite, which offers beautiful view of the Doon valley and the mountains.The place has an old world charm about it, and a beautiful royal feel.Lovely curtains, ancient wooden furniture, large skylights, kori borga ceiling, all…

Location: It's a 10 minute walk from the library and there's a route to the post office side as well from here. View: Awesome view of the doon valley.Most of the rooms have an uninterrupted view of the valley. Rooms: Decently sized with all amenities and very clean. Food: Though we had only breakfast and tea,it was homely.It's a vegetarian place but they do have a separate kitchen for those who would like to have eggs.  Now if you go on a holiday and can relax without spending too much money,right in the middle of the market without the cacophony,I think you have the best of both worlds. So for me it was the best.

Very Good Hotel, Rooms are spacious, Service is Awesome. Food is excellent its kind of homely food. I have stayed couple of times. Whenever I travel to Mussoorie I prefer to stay in Padmini Nvas. I highly recommend for stay with Family.

Stayed with family & friends and was lucky to get a room overlooking the Doon Valley. It is a Heritage property and is well maintained. Staff is co-operative and servile. Food was good.The family suite is awesome with private dining area and kitchenette, and most appropriate for friends. Offers ample space to sit together. Would look forward to stay again.

Located write in the heart of the city with amazing views of the city along with great connectivity to the nearby local vendors hawkers. Service is excellent at padmini nivas .  Sure the architecture of the hotel say that the British government before the independence stated there, till date has that old graceful looks.

This was our fifth visit to the Padmini Nivas and once again we passed a a very pleasant 4 days. Our room was large and comfortable and as always the service was very good. It is a great place to stay if you want to explore the area around or just relax in Mussoorie.

I'm so happy I chose this property! Firstly, the photos don't do justice to how beautiful this property actually is. It's like going back in time, and staying there :) The room we got (#7) was amazing. Though I was extremely unwell and couldn't step out of the room even once but the view from the room was simply breathtaking. The service was also good. We had a comfortable stay! Thank you :) Only 1 advise for the hotel - please accept different modes of payment (credit cards, paytm, etc.) as well.

I drove down to spent new year at Padmini Niwas with my Family. A heritage property almost 185 years old. Still maintained so well by the owners, credit goes to Mrs. Vohra her Family and staff of the Padmini Niwas. It will be very right to say it a Niwas then a hotel. You really feel at home. it is in heart of the city but still very peaceful and it is a place which gives you perfect solitude you are looking for. Had my new year with company of wonderful guest mainly from Delhi. It serves excellent vegetarian food. Might not be disappointing for one who is looking for Non- Veg once you taste the food here. apart from that Niwas has a play area for children, pool table-tennis table, chess etc. it has a beautiful lawn.  I will highly recommend this to all. and wish to return again…

A heritage hotel amidst excellent landscape... The lawn is beautiful with vibrant flowers.. play zone for kids etc. The rooms are spacious but a bit dull and depressing. The staff is excellent. Very friendly and service was too good. Probably this is the only hotel on earth to refund money in cash as we had stayed a couple of days lesser than what we had planned. Food was good. I feel the hotel interior and rooms need a makeover to attract more tourists.

The food is good, the staff is welcoming, and the views can be stunning. We wish we had spent some time in the garden, but we were too busy trying to see some of the sights around town and in the surroundings (for example, climbing up Gun Hill, going out for a hike at Lal Tibba near Landour, and so forth and so on). Just be aware that you may be awakened at dawn by monkeys romping across the roof of your room! Part of the charm ...

This hotel is in a very good location to explore Mussoorie. It is fairly easy to find and close by to many attractions. The family sized rooms were perfect to share with the group of friends I traveled with - lots of space for the 4 of us.”

A beautiful place with the ambience of the raj era. Very friendly management and staff.Theyhave a restaurant serving   some great vegetarian wholesome food. Will surely come back not once but many times. Highly recommended.

I was staying in this cosy place during 13- 16 december, 2016. Weather was chilly. The place has very warm vibe. Jai and other guy who manages property are very helpful and friendly. entire staff is very caring and make you feel at home. Our room No. 7 had amazing view of doon valley so every morning we woke up seeping hot tea enjoying spectacular view. great location, fabulous food, pleasing staff....its a good place to have relaxed holidays...the hotel has game room with snooker and ping pong table, if one at all gets bored. Its nearby- walking distance to mall road, camel back road and gun hill. it is advisable to venture out little bit and take stock of travel agencies around because we end up paying rather much more to taxi arranged with the help of hotel for touring…

Hotel Padmini Niwas is very nice and outstanding hotel in Masoori. The staff is very helpful and friendly. The atmosphere is totally free from noise and pollution. Food is also very delicious. The stay was very nice.

Quiet heritage property with some amazing views of the valley and great hospitable people in the reception. By far one of the best places to eat was "Suruchi" restaurant in the Hotel itself. Food tasted just like home cooked food. We were there in first week of december, so not a lot of crowd in the hotel. We took the standard room facing the valley. it was a little too small, but considering the overall ambience of the place this wouldn't seem like a issue. Being right on the Mall road is also a plus.

We loved our stay at Padmini Niwas. Waking up each morning to the views of the Doon Valley was just spectacular. It's in a great location at the heart of the town but is still very quiet and relaxing, being slightly set back from the road. Having come to Mussoorie by bus up the hill from Dehradun, we found the hotel to be an easy walk from where the bus drops off and was a good all round choice for a few days in Mussorie. Highly recommended.

My 72 year old parents decided to go to Mussoorie for their first trip north. Since they are pure veg and my mom has a major knee issue, I was in a dilemma to book a hotel which would provide them the amenities they require and the view and will not be too far from the Mall road!   Padmini Nivas is the perfect fit for families, elderly people and Gujratis! The staff is courteous and prompt. The food is delicious and fresh and it's just a short hike up to Mall road (Access is via an upward slope)  My parents came back with glowing reviews :) thank you team Padmini Nivas for a great experience.   Special thanks to Jay and Ankush.

If you are planning a trip to Mussorie to be away from hustle and bustle of a metro city and close to nature amidst homely setting then Padmini Nivas is the place to be however, if you are visiting with you friends and planning to have a blast then it is not the place. It will suit honeymooners the best followed by family vacationers. You will love the courteous, always smiling, always ready to help staff. Special thanks to Mr.Jai and the room service attendant Mr.Jai Singh. Highly recommend!!!!!

Hotel Padmini Nivas is an outstanding hotel, with very comfortable rooms and stunning views. Added to this are incredibly friendly and professional  service plus amazing food.  My stay at the hotel was very special and I can't wait to return.

We had been here in the month of November 2016 with Dr. Sarvesh Vora. We would like to rate the hotel as best and excellent in terms of Hospitality, Services, Staff, Management. It was a overwhelming experience staying in there.

We were staying at Club Mahindra and we decided to have one meal at Restaurant Suruchi at the Padmini Niwas. The Hotel is very well located and the quality and taste of food is simply unmatched. The staff is very warm and hospitable. The restaurant is multi cuisine but we were missing our gujarati food and hence preferred that. one of our friend Mr. Deepak Mehta strongly suggested this restaurant and we went for it and really enjoyed. The place was erstwhile winter palace of a maharaja from Gujarat and the old world charm is still well maintained in both exterior, interior and service. I strongly suggest to try food over here.

I've been visiting this place with my family for 2 decades now and I've always left with a big smile on my face. Everything from the authentic Gujarati restaurant to the hospitable staff makes it a home away from home. The GM (Mr. Vikram) is very helpful and pro active. A must visit when in Mussoorie.

Recently stayed at Padmini Nivas for the 3rd or 4th time and it was a great experience. What stands out is the attention to detail in every aspect by the manager of the hotel. However there's one area for improvement: in house entertainment / recreation. Can do with a better pool table, table tennis equipment etc.   The best time to visit the place is Oct-Nov or in the summers! The hotel is also well located in terms of visiting the popular eateries of Mussoorie.

I visited this property in Diwali 2016 with my wife and my daughter and had selected the place after going through the reviews here.  The property is a British original which changed many hands through the decades and started to become a hotel since late eighties. The British flavour is something which is to be really enjoyed especially if you have booked the cottages which are a little away from the main hotel block but worth those extra steps up to the cottage amidst the gardens.  There is a nice tea table place next to the cottage which is something I really enjoyed having my morning and evening tea with the family. The cottage is great and quite big and gives you a heritage feel.  The service and food was great and have no complaints at all. Everything was immediately…

This is the best place to stay in mussorie!Rooms,service and view everything is top-notch!They have both options,if you are a couple you can take a room,with family you can stay in a suite,cottage or apartment.Also a special mention for the vegetarian food which is hygienic and delicious!

A beautiful quaint place tucked away nicely among Mall Road chaos Pleasant old world neo Spartan architecture inspired by the ernstwhile princely rulers Polite and affectionate staff Perhaps the only hotel offering two side parking approachable from beneath the Mall Road as well A treat to stay and a joy to recommend Truly delighted

food is great ,  homely feeling ,centrally located    good view of dheradun and huge greenery worth staying money for value reasonably price property well maintained. i will definately recomend to our friends circle. Wish all the best and to keep it up

the best hotel i have ever seen in mussorie, with lovely ambience and heritage rooms, with  all amenities and food service and quality was excellent and i recommend this hotel to all for its location, view, amenities, food quality and over all very good experience

Recently spend a night at Hotel Padmini Nivas in Mussoorie and loved the whole experience. The heritage hotel is very well located and can be reached by car. Have ample parking space (otherwise difficult to find in Mussoorie).  There are a few categories of rooms you can choose from, as per your preference. We stayed at Deluxe rooms on the upper floor, with beautiful view of the valley. The staff is very warm and helpful. And decent food. Highly recommended, will be back soon.

I am a regular to this hotel. The best thing about Padmini Nivas is that though  the hotel is on Mall road it is disconnected from all the hustle of the mall. It has a great view of doon valley and very curteous and friendly staff. Best place to stay in Mussoorie.

This is a great property,spread over an area of 4-5 acres.It's on the mall road,very near to the mussoorie taxi stand.Famous cafes such as little llama,tavern etc are less than a kilometre walk from this place. This place offers a wide panoramic view of mountains .Their cottages look great.They have a big  reception gallery ,perfect for having breakfast and enjoying the scenery.It is a well maintained property with sportsroom,parking,gardens,dining rooms etc . Overall a great experience .

The hotel is perfectly located near Mall road of Mussoorie ( Hardly 5 minutes walking distance) . However it's heritage looks, beautiful gardens , and good food certainly forms its USP. Moreover the view of the Doon valley at night from the hotel was splendid and breathtaking. Must recommended to anyone visiting Mussoorie.

Such a nice place with spacious layout and right next to mall road. Food and service were great. We had mist floating around with some monkeys moving around as well :) room for 3 of us was spacious ( suite ) and comfortable.

the hotel is on the mall road but still away from the maddening rush of the mall. There are swings for children and the place is really green. The food is awesum. We didnt go to any other place to try any food. Their resturant is pure vegetarian and that is their USP.

I have revisited this property almost after 2 decades but pleasantly surprised to see everything almost same and even better. The location of this hotel is amazing .just after entering Mall Road . It has its own parking . Now the hotel has a grand view of Doon valley. You can see Dehradoon twinkle like diamonds in a clear night . The check in was ultra smooth as I had already made a prior reservation . Although it's kind of a heritage property so there aren't many rooms yet their service is always prompt . We were allotted room no 10 which has 180 degree view of the valley . The rooms are spacious and toilets have a good supply of hot or cold water  . The rooms give a feeling of a relaxed atmosphere. The furniture is antique yet well maintained. They have a good sitting both…

Hotel Padmini Nivas is located on the Library side of the Mall and just a few minutes walk away from the entrance to the Camels Back Road -- a great way to start the day.  The Hotel commands an excellent daytime and nighttime view of the valley and northern plains below.  On one visit several years ago we had a commanding view of the Diwali fireworks celebration.  Padmini Nivas is a lovely example of an older property that has retained much of its natural beauty.  Excellent staff, wonderfully prepared dishes, and we have always opted for the cottages / facing the south or the 'camp in the valley ' Dehradun.

padmini nivas is an amazing place to stay in mussorie. homely food. nice staff. comfortable stay. absolutely loved the place. the hotel is situated near to the library and the markets are by walking distance.

The place is very old and very well maintained. The owner takes a kene in the upkeep of the place and the place says it all.  The location is just next to the mall.  The rooms are decent sized and good.  The food is absolutely homely and good for Jain food.

We travelled to Padmini Nivas from 12-15th August 2016 in a group with a total of 8 rooms...adults and children between 5-11 years. The hotel is situated in a super location.  Right from reservation stage to helping us arrange cars from the railway station to the hotel..everything was beautifully managed by Mr Ankush and Mr Vikram. Fabulous food throughout keeping in mind everyones likes is extremely difficult, yet we did'nt face any problem at all. Mr Vikram assisted in ensuring that we had a fabulous stay in a beautiful hotel with outstanding service!

With 2 friends we came in this hotel for lunch...they have amazing and healthy food (I d recommend the Gujarati Thali and the Srikhand dessert). Everything was tasty and much better than many other hotels in town!

Its a wonderful experience for us . Rooms were very comfortable and very well decorated, hotel staff also very helpful , food was awesome, well maintained and properly clean lawns and garden. I highly recommend to this hotel at mussoorie. One of the best thing is its located on the mall road.

Dear Friends, to rate this hotel as only best, no way , its really superb...We two families went to mussorie for 3 days and had a stay at Padmini Nivas ... After lot of study i selected this hotel, i am the person who likes luxuries, so was scared once i reach ... will it be the best or not ... Now to say you the fact tripadvisor had rated 3rd in mussorie .... BUT BUT NOT ONLY I BUT ALL OUR FAMILY MEMBERS RATED NO.1 ....yes we had booked appartment and staying there we felt , we were in our luxuries bunglow ... the nature of staff too Good, very co-operative, well cleaniness, well maintained, the best locations from the Hotel... Over and Above, A lot Thanks to Mr.Ankush (manager) who advised me everything from booking, best places to go in mussorrie, shopping places, and lot ...…

After careful study of reviews, we booked Padmini Nivas as it looked very promising. But I didn't expect that this place would become my favorite spot in Mussoorie city. Believe me, the whole town is not as beautiful, hospitable and peaceful as this place. Out of my 2 days stay in Mussoorie, I would have spent 1.5 days here just because there was no reason for me to step out. Perfect stay.  Rooms : We had booked two standard rooms. Beautiful room with awesome view of Mussoorie valley. We got two adjoining room. Both rooms had a extremely comfortable queen size bed with good enough wooden furniture in room. Attached bathroom was clean and tidy and had 24 hours hot water supply. Both rooms had covered sit out area in front. Sit out area had a hanging chair.   Food : Out of 4 of us…

Located on mall road yet surrounded by so much of natural beauty. A royal n wonderful experienc, property is approximately 200 yrs old as told by staff but still well maintained with its originality. Staff is so cooperative n Mr. Vikram has been so helpful all the time. Room we were alloted was Rani Padmini ' s bed room, antique furniture. Our room was upgraded to suit without any extra cost. All in all a great time. Highly recommend if u  love nature n heritage property.

Ideally we would not have liked to stay in Mall road (as it would have been crowded and would have given us a city feel) but we were going to stay only for a night as Mussoorie  was just a break in our trip towards Harsil. However, by the time it was evening, we were having second thoughts. The stay was so awesome that we were seriously thinking about extending the stay.   The checkin was smooth, Ankush was very courteous and gave us an upgrade and ensured we comfortably checked in. The best part of the hotel is the view. Though the hotel is on mall road but the rooms are towards valley side so you get awesome views of valley. As we went during monsoons, there was mist everywhere and the experience of sipping on tea while looking at the Valley and mountains covered in mist is…

PLUS 1. Once in the property, you're cut off from the crowd. 2. Two access points (one from the approach road to Mussoorie and the other from The Mall.) 3. Car parking. 4. Family friendly. 5. Heritage property. 6. Mr. Vikram, the manager of the property is the face of the place since the past 20 years and knows how to make memorable stays for his guests. 7. Every room has a sit out area with a view. 8. Lovely flowers all around the place. 9. A games room with pool table and table tennis. 10. Excellent food. Must try: Shahi Paneer and Poha for breakfast.  Minus 1. Uphill walk to The Mall Road tough for older people. 2.   FAMILY FRIENDLY & HOW:  1. Play area: Yes they do have a swing, a see saw and a few other rides in the garden. 2. They will NOT charge you for the small meals if…

The age range of our group of travellers ranged from 6 to 70 and Vikram and his team kept everyone happy!  Being centrally located, everything was a stone's throw away.  Although the property lies on many levels, Vikram made sure the 'Parents' didn't have to navigate too many stairs. For the kids, there was the games room, the views and the monkeys who came to visit every morning.  The real highlight of our stay here was the service Vikram and his team offered. Everything from making sure we had a beautifully cooked dinner ready on the day we arrived (after having travelled all day) to swapping rooms for the whole party to keep us together even though it was really one room that wasn't quite right. The team in the kitchen really do know how to whip up a storm.  We ended up…

This summer, my family and I went on an adventure throughout northern India. Travelling with 6 adults and 2 children is quite the adventure and our leg in Mussoorie was perfect largely in part to Vikram and his staff at Padmini Nivas. The weather was perfect, as we got to see both rain and sunshine from our perfect little spot high in the mountains. The resort is beautiful and we literally were walking through clouds at this hotel. Feeding a family such as ours is also quite the feat, and the kitchen staff was phenomenal. The food was like my mom's home cooked food, and we devoured each meal! To top that off, my sister dislocated her shoulder the day we had to leave, and the quick response and care of the staff made even that mishap, one that was not at all miserable. Their…

Stayed there for 3 nights. Loved this place, very good food, reasonable price, wonderful views and helpful staffs. The only drawback is vehicles find it difficult to reach there, but that's nullified by its close vicinity to mall road. Strongly recommended.

The hotel has some nice reviews on trip advisor but the problem with the reviewers is that they do not specify the kind of persons they are, as people are different and what's good for some is bad for others, unless these people fall in the same category. My category would flinch at the sight of hair on a fresh towel or a bed sheet , won't be able to use a cover which has stains on it, would dislike seepage on the roof, grime and dust on the lamps or curtains. All mentioned above was what I got in their standard room. I know it is a budget stay but cleanliness is a must no matter what's the ranking of the hotel is. I don't see it logical to complain about the fact that they did not provide shower caps or a hair dryer as at the end we stayed in their standard room only, though…

We stayed here for three nights and it was wonderful experience. Amazing food, courteous hotel staff. We had great time here. Our room was on first floor with great hilly view. We spend most of our time inside hotel as property was awesome.

This summer we took a trip to Mussoorie with the kids. We planned ahead and chose to stay at Hotel Padmini Niwas. It is a hotel with royal heritage and we could not resist staying like royalty. When we arrived in Mussoorie, we had to drive up a steep driveway and then walk up to the Hotel...we fell in love with the place. If you are looking for a tranquil place to stay in the midst crowded Mussoorie then Padmini Niwas is the place for you. Old world feel, antique furnitures, lovely gardens and sit outs, rose bushes clambering over the property and a lovely view of the distant mountains and Dehradun down below. We loved our stay and our boys ran around exploring the property. The hotel is in the heart of the mall road and yet so far from the crowd. Step out from its back gate and…

Hotel Padmini Nivas has awesome and authentic Gujarati food available, for all those looking for gujju delicacies and thali, this is the place! Finally found one in Mussoorie!! Staff is extremely helpful and knowledgable, it is only a 5 -7 mins walk from main mall road! Thank you Guys!!

Located a couple of hundred meters from the library it's a typical Raj era property with big rooms and high ceilings. Their Restaurant is one of the best in Mussoorie and is not expensive at all. One can enjoy the breakfast in the sun while enjoying a view of the valley from the garden. Rooms in the main building are bigger but will not offer any views of outside. for scenic views go for Suites and cottages. I stayed for 4 days and had a very pleasant and satisfying experience.

Located centrally near the mall road. Nice rooms. Propably the best place to stay in town. Service is average we sort of expected more. Food is vegetarian. Best not to go during off season time.Rooms are spacious. They sometimes give good deals too. Would recommend this place to friends.

We booked apartment for 2 families consists of 4 adults and 4 children. 1)Location of padmini nivas at Mall road is best. 2) View from our apartment was unique. 3) Space inside the apartment was big enough to play by the children. Enjoyed alot all of us. 4) food quality and room service is also very good. 5) its a old heritage property, dont go with high expectations of luxury and finishing, though it is well maintained. 6) a little bit costly but overall experience was good and memorable.

We were told that one gets the best veg lunch in mussourie. Pls do not go off season. The set menu was not there as enough people were not there. Ala carte was below average. They used to be the best place in town. We have eaten in the past specifically the Gujarati thali.

The hotel is in main market place. Staff are very nice and co-operative, Food were also very testy and the rate was not high. Good place to go and stay there with family. Children also enjoyed. Nice view of hills and surroundings.

Ideally located. Car parking space which is normally rare in hill stations like these. Perfect hospitality. Wonderful heritage property. Toilets are super clean. We have stayed many times and recommended to our friends as well. Mrs. Vorah & Mr. Vikram Zutshi are very warm hosts.

The hotel located near to main market Road with lot of green and mountain view. Does have car park facility. The total facility inside gives a feel of living in palace. Some cottage rooms have great Valley view..

Situated in the main mall road, the location is very good. The property is very beautiful.It is a vacation home for royalty in good old days.  There is a small play area for kids and a TT room.  Food is good.  Our room had tall glass windows covering 1/2 the room and offered a great view. There is a lot of trees and flowers and it it maintained well and offers a soothing effect.  We had opted for the valley facing deluxe room. The room was small and basic, but we really liked it with the tall windows and the trees and the view. It felt more like a small hut.

A good hotel for family with main attraction being big old rooms with good vegetarian food and a wholesome view of the Doon valley. Its very near to the Library and has parking facility also. Only drawback is that its rooms are overpriced and the lacks in the service.

Without compromising on vehicular access (the hotel has a rear gate from the main road)and walking access to Mall road, Padmini Nivas was a good experience.  Standard rooms have little verandahs overlooking a tiny lawn and the Doon valley. The lawn is frequented by birds and monkeys.  The food was homely and well priced, but nothing is gratis. The staff as well as the owner are very responsive. My family appreciated the way that tips are collected and shared with the staff.  What definitely needs improvement is washroom hygiene. We changed rooms because the first washroom had smelly plumbing. The second washroom also required specific cleaning instructions before it could be used. Nevertheless, even water in the sink has an unpalatable odour. It was attributed to excess calcium…

its really nice place. hotel's compound is decorated by lovely flowers. its feel like royal place to stay. food is awesome. best place to stay in mussoorie. very close to mall road. u can enjoy night life of mussoorie.

The hotel is situated in a very good location, just walk-able distance from the mall and the library. The Doon valley view from the hotel is fabulous. The service is excellent. Food quality is very good. Overall, it gives you a homely feeling to stay in this hotel.

We travelled to Padmini Nivas on a weekend with family and booked 2 standard rooms. there was a long jam on the cart road towards Gandhi chowk but because Padmini Nivas has an alternate entry on the cart road it saved us atleast 45 mins. The check-in was very smooth and the hotel is located on Mall road 1km from Gandhi chowk approx. The standard rooms were facing doon valley and just above the cart road...it gave a splendid view..But I did not like the standard room setup as it has a worn out look and a smaller bathroom..But the next time I will choose a deluxe  or a suite. The room service was splendid and very prompt..the servers were very efficient and helpful.  The Hotel serves only vegetarian food and egg and no non-veg food. The food quality and taste was very good and the…

Managed to get bookings here at the last minute and we thank our stars for it turned out to be a Wonderful Experience. In every respect, this place is great, Excellent Location, Great Ambience, Very Cordial, Courteous and Efficient Staff/Service. Its a beautiful property in the lap of nature and rooms are very nicely located with great view. Though it may not be very luxurious or modern but rooms are reasonably good with all basic amenities working well and comfortable. After all its a Heritage Property. We shall always love to spend few days here as from Delhi its very much approachable for long weekends. Its important to mention here that the reastaurant here serves only Vegetarian (but serves Eggs) and food/snacks are excellent. Its worth your money.

Still recovering from the warm embrace of a 4 day stay at Hotel Padmini Nivas. To being with, the location. It is just off the mall, a 5 min walk & you're there, but when you're in your room it is totally cut off from the sounds of the mall. Instead u get to face a fantastic view from the in-room balcony. The rooms are comfortable and spotlessly clean. High ceilings, spacious rooms (and v imp - spacious and clean loos), the linen is soft, deco is tasteful. Room service is unobtrusive but prompt. And food is delicious. Its only veg but recommend the Gujrati Thaali, egg curry & Sujji halwa+ lots of masala chai. And - dont stay cooped in your room as there is a pleasant verandah and a courtyard with seating arrangements including a garden swing overlooking the Doon Valley. Its a…

I have been here in the SURUCHI RESTAURANT and food was awsome. Real Gujrati.  Will suggest guest if they prefer Jain or Gujrati food, please visit this Restaurant. Worth to pay!!!!!!!!,  Thanks ,  Piyush

I am a 3rd time visitor at this palatial type hotel.  Pro::  *Best location *Fabulous doon valley view *Courteous front desk and restaurant staff *Excellent veg food *You get home like feeling *For shopaholic, access to Tibetian market is just step or two away from hotel entrance  Cons: *Hotel rooms need some up-gradation. It is true that this site is best known as heritage property but owner can still do some internal renovation without affecting it's heritage look *Free Wi-fi inside the room was just for name sake. Always remaining either down or disconnecting every moment. If you remain nearby reception area then there is no issue with it. *Weak or aged people will find it very tough moving in and out of property due to very steep access to mall road. Management should…

Hotel Padmini Nivas is a fine heritage property, once a family home, situated in beautiful and carefully tended gardens with sweeping views of the valley below.  The rooms are well appointed and the elegant décor throughout the hotel  is complemented by handsome  antiques and exquisite flower arrangements created by the talented gardener at Padmini Nivas. The hearty breakfast is excellent and the cuisine at other times  is varied and has a delightful home cooked quality. We were impressed by the staff who are extremely friendly and helpful, particularly the manager who will do all in his power to make your stay as comfortable and as memorable as  possible.  If you want to experience the magic of India and its history and culture in a warm family atmosphere, we cannot recommend…

This review is not all about any one hotel where I stayed in Mussoorie. This is a general comment about selecting a hotel based on earlier reviews and photographs.  As one becomes a senior ( in age ) the usual reviews are not of great help. Details about the location of the hotel, the approach, location of restaurants on the premises and many other small details become important.The hotel management should give some details about these to help seniors choose the hotel and the room.

Its has amazing view and well maintained Rose  garden . The staff is very cooperative and polite .. A place to stay if u are nature friendly . For a couple standard room is a good option its bit small but nice  Superb::::

Hotel excellent but lot of scope to improve.  Positives - Great location, spacious rooms with nice old decor, lovely garden infront, great view, good service, polite waiters, homely food.  Although the list of positives seems unending but there are negatives too.   Negatives- It's pure veg, no bar, no complimentary breakfast, no buffet breakfast, fixed luch n dinner timing, limit menu options during evening hours, no fridge in the rooms, no hot water kettle for tea, limited toiletries,etc.  So don't expect a professional 4 star experience. It's a heritage property....so just check-in, admire the ambience n relax.

As the title suggests, my 2 night stay in Padmini Nivas was simply blissful.  The hotel property is huge with amazing rooms that have an ancient charm about them.  The valley view that the hotel offers in its garden is mesmerizing.  We were a group of 4 and had booked the cottage that they have.  The rooms were really huge and cozy.  The hotel staff was extremely friendly and cordial.  And the food here is also delicious, especially the aloo paratha (as one will find mentioned in various other reviews on Trip Advisor).  Having chosen this hotel simply on the basis of reviews that i read on Trip  Advisor, I was obviously worried as to how this will turn out.  But I have to say it surpassed all my expectations and I had a memorable experience here, especially the early morning…

We had only stayed for a day and the room was close the reception. The staff were courteous and the food was good. A nice place to stay for 2 days at competitive rates. I would suggest this for all veggies and not miss this heritage resort

Its an average hotel no a 4 star property as they claim. We stayed in the suite- the room was big and spacious. Staff is very very courteous and helpful. There was no view from the room. The location of the hotel is very good. Its ant 1-1.5 km walk from the main mall road. The food at the hotel is extremely good. Very home made. Overall an average experience.

We booked the hotel directly via email correspondence since they had a better rate than online sites. The hotel had an antique setting which is quite nice. Lovely reception area with a garden where you can sit out and enjoy your breakfast or a cup of coffee with a breath taking view of the Doon Valley.   The short approach to the hotel from the main road below is quite steep but the taxi drivers in that area are well experienced so you mostly wouldnt have a problem unless you're walking up. Then too you could probably call in and request the staff for assistance for your luggage. Mussoorie roads are all up-down and quite challenging for the not so active hill walker though you do get used to it. So short steep roads are prominent for almost all the hotels in that area.  The…

If you're a vegetarian who likes home cooked food, then look nowhere else.  Stay at this property to enjoy a great view of the hills. The location also makes it convenient to short walk down to the cycle rickshaw and taxi stands.  For children, there are carrom boards, table tennis, a small pool table too!  The staff is friendly and service is quick and personal! The food is very home like and well priced too.  The only point I did not like is the traffic noise since early morning as the property is on the main road entering the city.  However, a big thumbs up to the Hotel and the entire team for making our stay pleasant and comfortable.

Beautiful place with nice quaint rooms. The service staff is very cordial. We stayed here for 2 nights and enjoyed every bit of our stay. The property is clean. There are 2 entrances to this property - one of which is a steep climb.

I trusted the TripAdvisor ratings to book a 2 night stay at Padmini Nivas and I'm happy to say that it was the best experience of our Mussoorie trip.  We arrived late at night, but our room was well prepared and waiting for us. The hotel staff even accommodated our cab driver. We were allotted Haveli number 11, which is set apart from the rest of the property and overlooks the Doon valley. This gave the room the feel of a cottage. The interiors were well adorned and I loved the European touch. The whole hotel carries a beautiful mix of heritage and class about it. A little pricey, but something you will enjoy.  The service was prompt and came with a smile. The food was homely and fresh. They had a table set outside our room so we could enjoy breakfast in the warm sun on a cool…

It is easily the best hotel experience we had during our trip, my wife and me were visiting the north India first time and were blown away by the beautiful place and the hotel is located in center of the town.  The owner was very friendly and helpful, we were late for our flight and he got us an amazing driver who was the best, got us to the airport in time for the flight. The food is good, they have heaters in the room and nice hot water, nothing fancy but clean and decent within budget so it does not burn a hole in the pocket.

I stayed for 4 days in April 2016 with my family (my wife and 2 years old son) and I must say that it was a wonderful experience. Padmini Nivas has a beautiful property with breath taking views from hotel room. It has best location i.e. Mall Road, Camel Back road etc is so near (Walking distance). Manager Vikram and other staff was extremely courteous and helpful. Excellent  service. No words for food. Everything from tea, breakfast to lunch/dinner is mouth watering.  Whenever I would visit Mussoorie, I would not think of any other hotel, other than Padmini Nivas. Thank you guys for making my trip so memorable.

Me n my family had a superb stay at Padmini Nivas!! It is a beautiful heritage property with a classy ambience. It is conveniently located near the library end of the mall road. There is a 100 metre steep slope to climb to reach the mall road. There is a beautiful garden in the front of the hotel with a seating space providing amazing view of the dehradun valley. The rooms are cozy with all necessary amenities. The service is brilliant but they only provide veg food. (only egg available; difficult for non veg loving bengalis like me) the veg food though tastes great. The view from the balcony in front of the room is also mesmerizing. Overall a great stay; the only downside being the free wifi service which was virtually non existent.

Excellent stay at this property....Excellent service provided by the staff...Excellent location....Its a huge heritage property...The rooms are cozy, luxurious and lassed with mordern amenities...The swing provided with every room adds to the beautiful ambience...The view from the rooms on the first floor is better than the rooms on the ground floor...The food provided by the hotel is very hygenic, healthy and tasty...The Best part of this hotel is the garden in the front...

Another Brilliant Stay I am a regular visitor and every time the experience is amazing  The main Manager Mr Vikram is a host par excellence Great view, amazing staff and simply fantastic food makes the stay truly great Some of the Super Deluxe Rooms still have that Royal Feeling Simply Fantastic

Visited and stayed for a day on 13 April 2016 with  family.  Got reservation  from oyo rooms app. Oyo did a good job. But while checking in the manager or owner was having a  very cold attitude.   Rest the hotel is good. Good view . Good food.  Also   a younger guy was at  reception who was very warm and helped us. The older guy was cold and not very interested as if we  were staying for free    One request to the management please improve on ur PR  skills  rest all is great. I would have  given  4 rating but it a 3 for now.

Location: Hardly 5 mins walk from mall area, If entering after 4.00PM and you had a car then you had to enter through back parking. Rooms: Loaded with basic amentitites. Views are great from the room. Bathrooms need serious consideration. Needed some toilletaries and consumables. Food: Basic good veg food. Service: Very very good. Very helpful and always ready to help. Cleanliness: Good Internet: Free Wi-fi they say but very poor connectivity. Overall a good hotel but needs renovation as they charge a bit too high.

Overall was nice. Rooms, bathrooms were clean. Hotel staff also very nice. Very beautiful view from the balcony and close to Gun Hill and some shopping around. Got very nice food at restaurant but takes time.   -ve quite hard to walk to the hotel from the parking down there.

We stayed in the apartment of this hotel. a two bed room suite.  It was nice that the rooms were connected so we could enjoy our stay as a family. The dinning area doubled up as our children's playing area. The mini kitchen with utensils was handy in making tid-bits for the babies as well as warming up the food. The icing on the cake was the view from our balcony and serene surroundings. The hotel has old world charm and its a good choice for a sedate vacation.  Food provided is good homely vegetarian food. The problem-  Wifi- very poor- barely any connectivity- connection to my computer used to drop very often. so if you are planning a secluded holiday to finish of work via internet- then forget it. Amenities- at the tariff of 6400/- we expect good toiletaries and consumables.…

Friendly family-run hotel which offers terrific personal service. Hotel oozes character and is well placed about 200 yards from the Mall and the centre of the town. Nice veg restaurant on the premises and very obliging staff. Great views of the Dehra Dun valley from the rooms

Stayed at this hotel during December 2015 chrismas holidays. hotel rooms were clean. hotel staff and food was also good. although found it a bit costly (6000 rs per night, no meals included) Room tip :  we stayed at mountain facing room. they were good and peaceful.

Tucked away on the side of the mountain amongst beautiful gardens, Hotel Padmini Nivas is a welcoming friendly place. The staff are particularly caring and nothing is too much trouble for them in pursuit of their guests' comfort. My room had an enclosed verandah outside which had vast views over the Doon Valley and up to the mountain ridges. Although the weather was almost constantly wet and cold, and I was unwell most of the time, it was still a pleasant stay only due to the care and attention and the comfortable, old style elegance of the place. Highly recommended!

A nice heritage hotel on the library side, Mall Road, it has two entries one from the road coming to Mussoorie and another one walking from the mall road, it is a good property, have been there twice, if booked on time they offer discounts also.

We were a group of 8 bikers and we had booked an appartment and once suite. Property is a little old however if you like antique look then you will fall in love with it on first sight.   Food was awesome and it was complimented with super quick response/delivery time. Rooms were big enough to accomodate 4-5 ppl with extra weddings(off course) and both Suite and appt had big fridges in them. Also sink to wash your utensils etc.   Appartment had a very nice view to the valley. Hotel is right on mall road so just walk up the ramps and you are right on mall road. All in all we loved our stay there!!  Kudos to hotel's management and their staff!!!

Check in was smooth,good staff,got better deal online,didn't had food of the hotel,no free breakfast was given,some food joints are nearby and it's very near Library chowk,bit far from picture palace,but very nice and peaceful location. Room was medium sized but ample space,gave a feeling of resort type property. Entry from mall road was steep down. But overall good experience in cheap price,actually value for money. Only vegetarian food is served but you can order from outside or carry in.

Stayed there on 11& 12 Oct 2015. Excellent hotel with good garden and lovely flowers smiling & greeting you. Rooms were neat and clean. Small closed sit-out with Jhulla facing garden added much more beauty and enjoyment. Hotel is nicely located near library chowk, where much of the shopping and good shops are located rather than the other end of the mall. Hotel has a good and tasty veg restaurant with polite staff eager to serve you. Only problem is if you have elders, the entrance and exit to hotel from Mall road is rather steep and movement of vehicles is restricted on Mall road from 0700 hrs to 2200 hrs. Each entry/exit during these period cost Rs.100/-. Other than this small issue we had a pleasant and comfortable stay.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay. The hotel is well maintained - absolutely spic and span. The rooms are large and cozy even during freezing temperatures outside, and have their own verandas/balconies. We were provided all amenities including a room heater and Wi-fi.  The food was an absolute delight - lip-smacking tasty home-style preparations are  just what you'd want after a long day of walking and exploring. Shows that the staff really care for their guests. We had all our breakfasts and dinners in the room during our five days there.  The staff is helpful and friendly and can suggest hikes and treks for nature lovers (unfortunately, middle of winter is not the time for these hikes). They arranged a visit to Jabarkhet Nature Reserve which made up for the adventure we lost…

Last week I have visited to Mussoorie with my wife and 5 years old daughter, I booked the hotel through makemytrip.com. Staff are very friendly, food is good, location is approachable from mall road and library bus stand. Really we had good time during our stay.

So this is my first review. This was also our first trip with our 8 month old baby girl. And that is the main reason why Padmini deserves a great review from me!  Am extremely finicky and wanted to cook my baby's meals myself. I carried my own cooker and pan. And I was extremely pleased with the entire staff's (Mr Jai, Mr Vikram, Ankush, the chef and others in the kitchen) attitude and cooperation in this regard. I will give them a 10/10 for this. They provided me with full access to their kitchen, which I must add was clean and well kept. Second, the location was perfect for hubby and me. Close, yet away from the hustle bustle, nestled in a corner below the main mall road. Beautiful property and a lovely lovely view from anywhere you stand! Third, the food was customised as per…

Now that it's been like 10 days since I've returned, and the thrill from the hills has slowly faded away, I was suddenly reminded of the hotel i stayed in. One of the most comfortable and clean places to stay in Mussoorie. Stayed there for five days with a cousin, what both of us could vouch for is the food - which was incredible! Add the garden and the swing to the mix, along with Moti, the hotel dog, who is quite popular throughout the mall road :D   Everyone in the hotel management was nice and friendly, and it was really a great experience staying there. Would totally visit again every time I'm in Mussoorie :)   Cheers.

Went with a couple of friends in the month of December. Completely off season. It's a beautiful vintage property. The staff is extremely courteous.
