Even though it was off season, full staff was always present only for our group. From the room service to the bon fire and other arrangements, the service was very prompt. It's located very near to the mall road and the view from the hotel is gorgeous. Extremely comfortable stay and impeccable service! Would be happy to go back.

Very well located on Mall road and Very Good service by the staff of the Hotel.We are three fiends visited the hotel on 26 jan for one night only but its great.A lovely garden to sit outside and look the beautiful valley of Mussorie.

Padmini nivas has spacious rooms with average view of the valley. The rooms are clean but the toilets can be better. The garden is beautiful. The food in the hotel is good. They need to provide better tea/ coffee maker. We had to ask them to replace it twice. The location of the hotel is good.

Padmini Nivas is very well located and has a nice view over the hills. The Mall Road and the tourist attractions are within walking distance. The staff is extremely friendly, welcoming and very helpful. The rooms are clean, quiet and comfortable. The garden is beautiful and quite peaceful. It's the perfect spot for reading or having tea during the day. They also have swings everywhere, I loved it! I would definitely recommend it.

I came back to Mussoorie after 20 long years. Everything has changed in these 20 years except Padmini Nivas, and thank God for it. The hotel still retains its old charm, and you suddenly get transported to calm and tranquility when you start walking down the slope of the hotel from the mall road. The Suruchi restaurant serves amazing vegetarian thali and taste to very simple and yet so delicious Gujarati food has remained unchanged over two decades. The rooms though not modern are palatial and has a rustic charm. Certainly something of my choice.

186 year oldest estate which still retains its old charm well maintained  stayed in Delux suite room ,Very big rooms, nice decorated, very clean, and friendly staff. “Very Good Services with Quality food”.................Bathroom fittings need to replace

We visited Mussoorie in November and we found the location ideal, with two young children with us. The staff at the Hotel was very welcoming and we were helped with settling into our rooms. The hotel is right on the Mall Road and getting to all the fascilities was so easy. We had lovely views from our front Balcony and the views in the evening are amazing. There was a playgarden for the kids and they enjoyed their first hour. The only worry was that like rest of the Mussorrie, Monkeys did not seem very friendly and we had to keep an eye on the kids in case they went very very close to them. The food in the hotel resurant was freshly made to order, really delicious and the prices were very reasonable. We won't go anywhere else for food and our stay here was really enjoyable.

This is a palace built by king for his wife and is one of the best locations in Mussoorie.  We visited in December for our honeymoon and the place and nature is just awesome. We being gujarati enjoyed the stay since the hotel serves Authentic Gujju food. We took a delux room package and luckly got the best room in the palace. The staff is good and very very generous. A memorable experience.

We stayed here for 3 days and its was an amazing experience . From Manger to the kitchen staff, everyone is their for you and will do their best to provide you a comfortable stay. They upgrade our rooms and luckily we got the garden view room. Apart from comforting rooms, the food is very tasty.  The only regret we had that we can't stretch our vacations. But theirs always a next time.  GREAT HERITAGE PROPERTY!!!

I stayed with my family and were impressed with the hospitality extended by the Hotel staff. Padmini Nivas offers a great scenic beauty overviewing the mountains. Situated on the Mall road is a added advantage. The staff is very good and service quality is great. Highly recommended.

mussoorie was our first destination on our trip of uttarakhand, and hotel padmini nivas was booked after reading the reviews. the hotel is located near library chowk and there are two ways to reach the hotel one from the hotel parking side which has a steep walk which we took and the other way is from the mall road, but taxis charge extra to come from mall road ( extra charge plus tax to enter mall road). the hotel has two sections the hertiage area and the new block, we had booked a deluxe room which was in the heritage wing, we arrived there in morning and our room was ready so check in was smooth and fast no waiting, we were given room number no7 which is below room no10, small and cozy good for a couple, bathroom not spacious but clean, awesome view from the room…

Hotel Padmini Nivas is a heritage property built on Mall Road. Best part is the amazing views you get from the hotel front porch. We used to have our breakfast sitting in garden with lovely views n soothing sun amidst the december cold. We stayed for 2nights n had the best experience overall, be it the clean rooms, services by the staff, delicious food( paneer pakodas, noodles, idli sambhar, paranthas jus to name a few 😛) hospitalitality n proximity to mall road. The Manager was very friendly & other Staff was very courteous n helpful. Would definitely go back again ! Cheers !

I visited this hotel in the year MAY 2010.Found it through internet search n booked it online without any hesitation.The hotel is located very near to mall road which took 3-5 minutes to reach the mall road. Fantastic place for people who are in search of peace of mind.Food available was good.Staff was cooperative.Really a memorable stay

I stay here almost every year with my family. Amazing place and superb views. Awesome food. Nothing negetive about this place. Dada and Vikram bhai treat you like family.  Best place to stay..keep it up Padmini Niwas.

I have been here multiple times, and would be here every time i am in Mussorrie.Rooms are very good and spacious and very nicely maintained. The best thing is there hospitality and they are very helpful.

Stayed for 2 nights on the 26th and 27th Nov, 2015, and I would say that this Heritage Hotel is the place to stay in Mussourie,, A central location, Well kept and maintained, its rooms facing the valley, the ambience and the feel of this heritage property is great, and you can actually feel the old world charm.Nothing was out of place and the food was was very good. Rooms clean, bed comfortable, hot water, heaters provided in case it is cold, ( some place charge you), I would certainly like to return to this property. And off course very friendly staff at the reception and the restaurant. Keep it up.

We stayed here for 1 night after reading great reviews from Tripadvisor and booked a suite room. However we were surprised the suite doesnt have nice views of the valley..the deluxe rooms had a better view..food is nice but found it a bit expensive..

Stayed at the hotel in the 1st week of August and loved the property. The place has a lot of old world charm and offers great views of the valley. The estate is decently maintained though the rooms could do with a makeover. The location is superb with easy access to the market yet away from the din.  The staff is efficient and the food is good as well.  Will definitely visit again.

A memorable visit indeed! This was my second visit to the hotel after many years. The hotel is still amazing with great views of the mountain and very easy access to the main market (library chowk is just a few steps away). The staff is very helpful and always willing to take the next stride to make you feel comfortable. Once you are in the hotel you just feel you are right in the lap of nature!

Never visit this place by just fake review ... had one night stay with a horrible experience.. uncomfotable bed .. no extra sockets for charging phones.... No iron .. no basic facilities .. under repaire room with seapage.. really a heritage property .. small rooms with low roof..

My family had visited in end Sept'15. We were delighted by all aspects - location, food quality, upkeep of the property and hospitality.  Location : Access to the Mall Road is very easy. The fact that there are two parking makes it very convenient when one is coming from outside town or from the Mall Road. This is a big plus for a hotel in a hill station  Food Quality : My children (age 5, 9) loved the food so much that for them this is the benchmark. Even though the hotel serves only vegetarian fare, we did not miss non- veg fare at all. Breakfast  was fresh with a lot of options. You get home made Chappatis which is a rarity in a hotel   Upkeep of the property : For a property which is 100 yrs old it is very well maintained. It gives you a sense of the old times with modern…

I would like to stay in this property for months..this is not a hotel but like a family..everyone is too familiar..we enjoyed our stay in the month of October..this property is just 75 mtrs from the mall road,you need to walk for 3 to 5 minutes..but the walk is really enjoyable specially in the evening..the garden is really well maintained..you can have your breakfast in the garden overlooking the doon valley..the view from maximum rooms are just awesome..rooms are spacious,clean equipped with 32 inch tv,room heater,24 hours hot water,comfortable bed and sofa..but if you are looking for modern luxury then this will disappoint you..I feel the way they maintained it is really appreciable..no need to change it either..the big plus point of this property is their food ..its tasty…

After landing in Dehradun from Chennai, we drove to Mussoorie to spend one night before we set off again for our trek across the Rupin Pass. Our long drive brought us to this lovey quaint and hotel perched on the edge of a cliff. Big colonial bedrooms, beautifully appointed dining rooms and large panelled sitting rooms all surrounded with a big welcoming verandah was waiting there for us.  The toilets were perfect. We learnt that the rather charming Hotel Padmini Nivas that had been the residence of the Maharajah of Rajpipla. It had been known as the Rushbrooke Estate and had been given by the Maharajah to his wife Padmini Devi.  Good service, yummy food and a view to die for!! What more could we ask for.

We enjoyed our second stay at Padmini Nivas.    Here is my previous review: http://www.tripadvisor.in/ShowUserReviews-g297689-d736189-r180429138-Hotel_Padmini_Nivas-Mussoorie_Uttarakhand.html#REVIEWS  This time around, we drove in our XUV 500, but the lower level car parking was full due to long week-end.  Even then, Vikram called me regularly, while I was driving from Badrinath to Mussoorie and sent his staff to help me in parking.  The next day, my XUV 500 was shifted to the property via Mall Road by their own driver.  As usual, the food and stay were excellent.  The owners enquired several times about our comfort.  No wonder, they bagged tripadvisor awards continuously.

A stay in mussorrie, dont miss to stay in Padmini Nivas. We have booked this hotel only on the basis of reviews posted on trip advisor. We have just taken a chance but really this hotel is very beautiful. If you are looking for typical metro city style hotels then surly you will not like. This hotel is like a cottage and as natural as the beauty of mussorie. You will find greenery everywhere in the hotel even out from the room you will find your own garden, means completely a natural beauty. Cooperative staff, natural ambience, location of hotel, peaceful environment and homely food (Veg) is the USP of this hotel. Now my mussorrie trip will be always with Padmini Niwas. I will strongly recommend everyone to come to this hotel whenever they are coming to mussorie. This hotel is…

It was just for that one night, but the experience was just wonderful. It was a bit of an excursion to the hotel for our van could not make it up the narrow lane leading up to the hotel, which was once the residenco of the Maharaja of Rajpipla dating back to the 1830s! The property is very charming with well appointed rooms and courteous and helpful staff. The dining room is cosy and the dinner served though vegetatrian ( we opted i think) was enjoyable. The present management of the hotel are very consious of the environment and own a nature park (forest?) outside the town were the guests could be taken for the day for nature walks and such like.

Stayed here for 3 nights : Nothing very fancy or luxurious but its the old world charm that is the highlight of this place. The staff is warm & helpful, they service with a smile & that makes all the difference !  Recommended to all those who wish to soak in lots of sun and fresh air.

This is a very fine sophisticated heritage property in Mussoorie on the mall road.... For the narure n mall rd lovers, excellent property with homely delicious food n cozy service. My first choice. For the children a lots of slides n rides... Overall not very hi fi buildings but nicely maintained n developed. 5stars.

Had a 1 night stay here..i stayed there after reading many good reviews..but i felt it was overrated..rooms are not so good..view of valley from the suites was obstructed, which i didnt like..food is good..and the management is helpful, thats what i liked..also just to add, the climb from hotel to mall road is steep, so can be draining..

We have booked this hotel only on the basis of reviews posted on trip advisor. We have just taken a chance but really this hotel is very nice and our rating is A+++. If you are looking for typical metro city style hotels then surly you will not like it because this hotel is like cottage and  as natural as the beauty of mussorie. You will find greenery everywhere in the hotel. Cooperative staff, natural ambience, location of hotel, peaceful environment and homely food (Veg) is the USP of this hotel. We would definitely come here in future also. I will strongly recommend everyone to come to this hotel whenever they are coming to mussorie. This hotel is very near to Mall Road yet so peaceful. Ample space for parking too. And one of the best part is to have early morning tea n…

Arrived late in the evening at this hotel. We enjoyed the stay from that very moment on owing to the helpful nature and courtesy of the staff. They have a variety of rooms on offer. We had opted for a standard room. The room was clean and well maintained and had a good view. Food (Veg only) and room service is good and prompt. Mr. Vikram at the front desk was very helpful and gave us precise directions and suggested places to visit in and around Mussoorie in the limited time we had. Overall it was an excellent though short stay at this hotel.

Visited last year here.. Right on Mall Road.. Little difficult for old age person.. High slope.. Average stay. They have parking space but very bad occupancy for drivers.. I can understand that driver accommodation cannot be luxury but still I personally checked after driver's complaint. No one can stay there. Average from my side. Good vegetarian food.

The best place to stay in mussoorie ! High five to the food, service, hospitality and not to forget, the lush green garden views, the resort provides to every room. I was skeptical about visiting the hill station but Padmini Niwas made my trip 100% worth and memorable ! Would love to visit again with family :)

Padmini Nivas is truly a home away from home! It is a neat and clean, no fuss resort, but with all the amenities and treats you like a family member. The food is like home cooked food, fresh and simple and yet the A La Carte has the usual menu that sometimes tourists like to indulge in. Two of the best aspects of this resort are: A- It has a beautiful garden all around, and the resort follows conservation guidelines B- It is so well located - right on the Mall and yet totally private and one does not get the noise and clutter of the crowds.

Prices of Padmini Nivas are a little high for the value and service offered. We booked 3 rooms and there was noothing extraordinary in them except for continuous hot water in them. One good point about the hotel is that its directly accessible thru mall road.

Hotel is not awesome but nice place to stay. A little more cooperative staff and good food will make it awesome. I stayed there for two nights, staffs were not really bothered if I required anything. But still I'll recommend this hotel if you are looking for nice view of the hills.

Don't go with the name, we booked the hotel as almost all others hotels are booked, by going with tripadvisor rating we booked the hotel. But when we arrived all our doughs for this hotel gone away by stepping the hotel. Hotel is well maintained, front desk staff always helped with a smile. Very delicious fresh food. We definitely recommend and come again in this hotel.    Suggestion: Do a proper professional photo shoot of a hotel, hotel looks much beautiful then its present photograph

The name 'Padmini Nivas' created some doubt in my mind, but its a awesome place to stay in. Beautiful gardens/parks made me feel relaxed. Kids can roam around and have fun. Food is good and not expensive. Though i just stayed for a single night, but its was excellent👍

I visited this place with my family. We booked two Deluxe Suites for one night. And we were pleasantly surprised by the room quality. No websites offer details on their room types with photographs so I was a bit doubtful. But when I reached there, it was awesome. Both the suites were classy, with fireplace, living area, changing area, extra beds, large bathrooms and a palace like feeling.  Food was very good. We had lunch and breakfast for 5 people. And the total we paid was just Rs. 1400! And everything was fresh and delicious.   Location is a big big advantage. You climb some 100 meters from the hotel and you're on the Mall Road. Even the taxi stand is at a walking distance.   Will definitely visit again!

Stay at Padmini Niwas was just like staying at home. Staff is really helpful. Food was just like home made. Location is perfect. will recommend families travelling to Mussoorie. Only minor area of improvement could be little bit on housekeeping side like ensuring that toiletries etc. are replenished.

I stayed with Padmini Nivas in Mussoorie  for the second time in June 2015 with family, the fist being 5 years back. Nothing changed since then except adding a new blocks with more rooms. One big plus is the location of the property. On the side of the Mall Road, yet you could feel your own private space without the noise of the Mall Road crowd. The main block of the hotel still retains the erstwhile Raj-day look with high ceilings and wooden structure etc. The new blocks are more like modern day guesthouse rooms. I feel bit disappointed with the deluxe rooms this time. My earlier stay was much better in a spacious  apartment style accommodation in the old pattern architecture. The new room space was much smaller and the furniture and fixtures were very normal. The glass window…

We went to Mussoorie for the weekend recently. Hotel is centrally located on Mall Road. Parking available for cars. Hotel staff was efficient and friendly. Took care of requests promptly. Great plus. Restaurant prices are reasonable considering we are at a tourist place. Free Wifi was great. Hotel has good lawns and outdoors with sufficient benches and chairs. Smaller rooms are a bit a small but I did not care much as I was outdoors most of the time. Unfortunately I was not able to get the Gujrati Thali at the restaurant which I was looking forward to, as I was told it has been discontinued. Overall a great place, and I will stay there again.

A 200 year + old British bunglow which was later bought by a Maharaja for his Mistress Padmini Devi. The quaint hotel transports you into the old era which is beautifully preserved, from chandeliers to door latches!! Located right on the Mall road,easily accessible. Great food with variety for Vegetarians. Extremely helpful and cheerful staff. The flowers and tiny gardens are everywhere!!!! Our request for a bigger room was taken care of at the soonest. Definitely roam about the whole property, it's a discovery at every bend!! Definitely staying here whenever Mussorie!!

I stayed there from 21-22nd June 2015, with my family in three rooms No: 21,23 and 24 due to non availability of rooms in Mussoorie Gateway. I read ratings of Padmini n booked but after booking I realised that Padmini making huge amount to TripAdvisor and other rating company to maintain their rating. I am giving you details in positive n negative... Positive:  1. Good Location 2. Green Area 3. Parking for pvt vehicle only not for taxi etc. 4. Very closed to Mall Road.  Negative: 1. Worst hotel 2. Greedy Staff 3. Rude staff 4. Worst rooms 5. Very bad n dirty washroom 6. Poor quality of food 7. Very high charges of food (if u don't ask price first) 8. Charging amount for onion also if you order lunch or breakfast. 9. You have to walk straight height to reach there . 10. Worst…

This place has been my home away from home....This heritage property has lot to offer like nature,doon view,architecture and amazing hospitality....But this is not for those who believe in getting free bath accessories,amenities n all in the room....This place is for royal holidays with such massive rooms....Thumbs up to all the people at padmjni niwas....

Stayed here for only 1 night as didn't get rooms in savoy for my 3night stay. The hotel is in the middle of Mall Road so one can go to both the ends of road easily where the action is. I took there apartment room as we were family of 7 and it is very huge with 2 double rooms, dining area and a kitchenette attached. But nothing special though as carpet in the dining area was so dirty with all the stains that we cudnt walk barefooted on it. In the evening all kinds of insects and flies came in as windows were open so it made us sit in the lobby so difficult. And then we have to sit with all lights off. But the view from balcony is very beautiful. The entire Dehradun and can be seen. No ammenities in the bathroom were there except the soap and one bathroom is outside the room and…

Wonderful Time,  Caring Staff. Peaceful homely place.  Been a regular visitor for the last 7 years,  every year.. And the place seems to be just the same. The manager of this place,  Mr Vikram is especially loving and caring and makes sure our visit is special always.  All the best and keep up the good work

Seriously not a good place to stay, room tariff is too much from what you get in room Cons No Tea/Coffee maker No shower gel, shampoo etc provided Small rooms  Pros Near to mall road Courteous staff Nice outside sitting area with good view  Just add some amenities to your room

We have stayed in Padmini Nivas for 2 days took 2 rooms suite and deluxe suite, rooms were clean, spacious and well maintained. The staff was courteous and well behaved. Though food was ok but it was freshly made and served hot. We had a gala time staying in the hotel and enjoyed it thoroughly. The garden area is picture perfect for relaxing and taking photographs. overall wonderful experience

Stayed with family and friends for 6days in super deleux room.well managed property with excellent hospitality. This place is heaven  for vegetarian food lovers.very good location.situated at mall road close to liabirary. Hats off to vikram and his team.strongly recommend this place to all my friends

We visited the place in May and had a wonderful experience. It is situated right at the library end of Mall Road. The staff was courteous and helpful. The rooms were very clean and spacious. The best part about this place is the swift response you get from the staff, they are ready to help you out any time. The place is well maintained and the food is awesome(try out the aloo paranthas). The place has an outside sitting place form where you can enjoy the view of dehradun(it is marvellous).

We went with our 1 year kid and parents in April 2015. The good points are the location and general ambience with tulips all around. We had taken a family suite which was huge and very comfortable with a toddler. The parking can be a problem as the roads are closed during some hours of the day. The restaurant is not very great but serves decent breakfast. I would recommend it to people travelling with family and who would like to stay near the Mall Road

A friend and I stayed here for two nights in May. It was great to get away from the Indian heat and Padmini Nivas offered a great place for a retreat. The patio is amazing to sit and have breakfast or tea. We spent a lot of time reading there too. The people working there were friendly and helpful. The location is super quiet considering the proximity to a Mall road. We stayed in room 10 which was large and had amazing views of the Doon valley. The beds are really firm, so much so that I couldn't really sleep on my side. I also think that the bathrooms could use a good scrub, especially when paying a little more. But overall, the hotel is a really nice place to stay.

Comfortable accommodation... Very Humble Staff.... Lovely View of Valley... Delicious food... Own parking... Just down the hill on Mall Road ...making it quite peaceful and nearest to the markets as well.

Heritage hotel with a rich blend of British and Indian charm, offering a marvellous stay with hospitable staff, making our stay memorable in all respects.With a library and intricate wooden furniture to boast off, the hotel  also has childrens play facilities, a nice big and playful golden retriever, a beautiful garden with all kinds of flowers, surrounded by cedar and chestnut trees, and a breath-taking view of the sparkling twin city, Dehradun. What more can one wish for?

Though the building is old but still maintaining its charm. Good staff with very polite nature. We had apartment with kitchen facility, with gas facility. Good experience. Perhaps their Gujarati thali  is best in town. Room with the view is certainly number 10.

Wonderful hotel, with friendly staff and delicious food (very vegetarian friendly). Hotel is a sprawling, old colonial property with tonnes of character set high up on a hill with beautiful views of the valley. Has a charming garden and bungalow-style rooms set in the original buildings. Convenient walk from a bustling little market/town area.

Stayed for 2 days. Excellent location, beautiful valley view.Good Gujarati & Jain food, very cooperative staff, prompt in service. Clean &  High class room furnishings. All amenities. game room for kids.

Very good hotel to stay. Very helpful staff & nice valley view. Food is really good & you will love to eat sitting out. Minor problem is very steep slope you have to climb every time you go out. Very old property. We have not seen all rooms but standard rooms are too small.

Very Nice Hotel. I visited with my family last year in mid of May. As it was not peek time they have upgraded my room and gave me Cottage. It was very comfortable and nice experience. Food at restaurant was also very nice.

We stayed from 24th - 26th April 2015.   Padmini nivas is close to Mall road and Home like rooms are the only advantages.   We stayed in deluxe room which was independent and had entry from backside of the hotel. Room had an excellent view of Dehradoon city which was mesmerizing. However room was small with congested bathroom. Food provided was good but with limited options.  I felt that room was overpriced compared to the facility provided.   Staff was prompt and courteous.

Location would be the biggest advantage. It is approx 50 mtrs.away from the mall road ( library end ) which saves you from the vehicular noise of zooming bikers and the vehicles in general ( as private vehicles are now allowed on the mall road ). Food is good , with moderate dose of spices and oil.

The location is excellent. The hotel has the old world charm but could do with some refurbishment. View from some of the rooms is excellent. The open area in front of the reception also has excellent view. The staff is very hospitable. Food is just like home. We were very happy to have some awesome gujju food.

I stayed in this Hotel with my family. Hotel is nearer to Mall Road. The Hotel is in a heritage building which make it more attractive. Good location and prompt service. Staff  of the Hotel is very Helpful.

Stayed with my family. This hotel has many advantages - It is very close to Mall road. The hotel has its own parking. We had private balcony  Rooms (and the hotel) was very clean. Staff in the hotel are very helpful and room service is very prompt  Would stay at same place if visit again

I stayed in this hotel with my family. This hotel has many advantages - First of all it is very close to Mall road. The hotel has its own parking. We stayed in standard rooms which are little small but the view from the rooms were terrific. We had private balcony which helped us as we occupied multiple rooms. Rooms (and the hotel) was very clean.   Staff in the hotel are very helpful and room service is very prompt. The hotel has wifi in the rooms but I found the signal strength little weak.  From hotel Lawn, one can see beautiful view Dehradun (specifically at night time).   The hotel has a restaurant and serves eggi- terian food. Once again, prompt service - with high quality and good taste.  The hotel is in a heritage building which makes it more attractive. Easy to locate…

Nice rooms with basic amenities. Very friendly hotel and reception staff. Food is good.  Parking right in front of the hotel and below it.  Great view from the hotel lawn...no need to even go to the mall road for the view of the hills.  Great place to spend time with friends and family. Been there more than 20 times till now.  Prior booking is recommended.

It is a nicely done heritage hotel. Located just at the right place with an excellent view ...Serves very good Indian vegetarian food...staff is also very well trained... Have a good look at the rooms before choosing one as all the rooms are different ....

My family comprising of my  three sons and wife took a short trip to the Garhwal area of Uttarkhand and our itinerary included a night's stay in Mussourie. A search in Tripadvisor threw up many options, but our requirement was for an occupancy of five persons,  and we found that the 3* or 4* hotels were offering nothing special other than the usual two rooms with an extra bed. Padmini Niwas came up with that something extra, an apartment, with enough room and beds for the entire family. The hotel is a property right in the middle of the Mall Road, but so well hidden amidst the greenery and the shrubbery and the carefully tendered flowerbeds that you can't imagine you are in the center of the town.  The place itself is a hundred plus year old building, with all the faded grandeur…

Though I stayed here for one night but still one can judge what kind of hotel one is staying in. I checked in a bit late in late afternoon but no extra time was spent in checking in formalities. Fortunately the room was upgraded as the room I booked was on renovation.  The best part of this hotel is that its on Mall road. You need not to spend your money on taxis to take you to Mall road as I have seen on other hill stations. The other good thing I found good about Niwas is the food was up to the mark & that too pocket friendly. Mostly I have seen that dining in the hotel costs more if compare it to local restaurants.   Here, the things were opposite, the food on Mall road was actually expensive if compare it to the Padmini Niwas in house restaurant i.e. Suruchi. Service was…

We had stayed for 4 days in this heritage palace hotel.The rooms facing valley side have good views.Early morning view is just mesmerising. The veg food made by the chef was just awesome,specially Cutlets, The ambience is rich and well maintained. There are varieties of flowers and swing near the entrance. The lady owner was very sweet and charming.THEY HAVE big specious Tv Room where we could play games till late night. Heaters in all rooms. Worth staying.

We stayed in this beautiful property for 2 nights after some research on our own and mind you this does not let you down . Hotel has his own charm and views from the rooms are some of the best you can get . Food is good specially if you are vegetarian ,these guys don't serve non veg I did not find anything in the menu. Location wise it is at the start if the mall road so this is not a problem by any stretch of imagination, the eateries and shops are present on the mall road itself .You  can choose a rickshaw to commute or just use your feet to stroll around. Recommended to people specially if you are traveling with family

We booked the family Apartment here and It was one of our best decisions  to  do so. We could view the entire valley from our balcony. The apartment was so spacious and airy and beautiful that we thought we could have stayed a little more...It is made for four of a family , but we feel  even a family of 6-8 with kids could enjoy the stay. It was a home away from home. Restaurant and room service was excellent and staff and managers were very courteous . The current owner  of this 180 year old property of the British era , a Gujarati lady has ensured proper maintenance, good quality of service and excellent food. One must surely try the Gujarati Thali  at the place. Would like to come again and again.

We had been there for a weekend celebration in the month of December..Good property simple and serene.... courteous front desk...ready to help...hot water was available but would run off way too soon than expected...was becoming difficult for two people to take shower right after the other...how ever there was heater and extra blankets provided in the room..beautiful rooms..food was ok...could be better...but there are resturants near by on the same road....like kalsang and a few others...we ate mostly at kalsang..overall a good stay....leaves u with a relaxed mood...would love to visit them again if i ever visit Mussoorie

I don't have a word about my stay at hotel padmini niwas its amazing the view from hotel is excellent and staff is very co oprative rooms are very good i love to come back and always stay there and above all that food is very good

We finalized Padmini Nivas after a lot of research on the internet but dint book it online . We went there explored the place and then got a good deal with the hotel manager,same as what we would pay online . This quiet hotel is nestled on a hill,few minutes away from the mdda parking of mussorie.You can take your vehicle upto a small level n walk the way up to the hotel.  It has a small garden with an amazing view.Just sit on the swing,sip some hot coffee and enjoy the green mountainous ranges.They have semi deluxe,deluxe n premium rooms.Only the semi deluxe rooms have a nice view though the room maybe slightly smaller.Hotel is nice n clean.The premium room is grand with a fireplace and partitioned into 2 rooms n perfect for a large group of friends or a big family.Gives u the…

Our stay at Padmini Nivas was one of the best in India.  This hotel is centrally located on the main road in Mussoorie.  Out the door and up a small hill and you are ready to walk along enjoying the views and vendors.  The accomodations were wonderful, staff was attentive and helpful in expounding on sites to see, getting cabs and cars and providing food and drinks.  There's a small garden with a swing that faced the valley for an amazing sunset view.  As there was some construction in the hotel (which we never heard), we were upgraded to a nicer room.  The room we well appointed with beautiful furniture, tv with standard Indian programming and a nice bathroom.  All were very clean.  While we didn't eat dinner in the dining room, we understood that the food was excellent.  We…

5 of us friends stayed here and rented 2 cottages. Gotta say the view is breathtaking. Wake up everyday and have breakfast with a hillside view of Dehradun below and general scenic beauty to savour (their delicious Aloo Paratha was more than welcomed every morning too).  Polite staff and always willing to help and do their best to cater to your needs. Their dog is super adorable too! Only issue I'd say is maybe getting Tata Sky or something similar? Finding good channels for the time we were in was a pain.  Overall great location, not too far from market road yet distant enough from market road to avoid noise and general traffic etc.

One of the best places to stay in Mussoorie. If there is heaven on earth it is here it is here it is here. The staff with people like Gyan Singh and Jai Singh make sure that your stay is memorable. Its receptionist Vikram looks after all your needs big and small to make your trip a joyful one. The food served at its restaurant Suruchi is just outstanding. Always look forward to it. The rooms and service is exceptional not to be found easily this side of world. And what can be said of its breathtaking views of the mall and the valley below..leaves you speechless. Always look froward to visiting the place and spending as much time as possible here. Such treasures like Padmini Nivas are hard to come by and when one does come across such gems its hard to forget and let go of it.…

Very good hotel. I would think it is the the best value for money hotel. Prefer room no 11. Very nicely decorated. Gotta try food in the hotel. The breakfast served in the room is also very nice. Overall I would definitely stay at this hotel again.

It is poor to okay place. You get what you pay for. Pros 1) Very friendly and helpful staff 2) Food was okay 3) View from the hotel is nice Cons 1) Sub-par quality, everything is inconsistent and leaves something to desire few examples I can remember are cable TV works but picture quality is bad, Internet works but intermittently, hot water was not working the first day, constant banging noise from outside, no Toilet rolls, no backup power 2) Very steep slope to enter and exit the hotel so if you have elderly people traveling with you please avoid this hotel but this may be true for most Mall road hotels 3) very ordinary room decor, small carpet in room 10 must be at least 50 years old.

This hotel is best known for its British styled rooms, especially in the old wing! Whoa! It felt refreshingly amazing to stay in the lavish rooms built by the colonial power and maintained delightfully by its current owner!   Being a part of a group, we were lucky to enjoy two rooms, both splendid in their own ways - The old wing room was lavishly huge and reminds us of old age aristocratic vacations! The other room in the newly built wing (Opposite the reception) was another treat for its spectacular views! We never felt like leaving this place and had to leave wondering how we could have spent more time to spend at this splendid property despite the chillingly cold Mussoorie winter!  Being old and lavish, both rooms had all the required amenities. However, they request guests…

Between 1988 to 1992, we must have stayed there at least 7 times. Wonderful experience. Nice ambience, very hospitable and caring staff, excellent vegetarian food. And next time we come to Mussoorie, Padmini Nivas it will be.

A fairly old structure over looking the valley and hills, accessed through library and mall road. Its such a beautiful place that you want to stay there for as long as possible. The rooms are simple and clean, the food great, the staff ever attentive. The breakfast should be enjoyed in the sitout area overlooking the hills. An absolutely mesmerizing place, one of the few properties which tick all the boxes that makes you wanting to visit the place again.

Nice location as it is on the mall road, good for senior citizens as the rooms are all in the ground level. The food is good. Parking facility is available. Sitting area is available outside all the rooms from where a beautiful view of mussoorie can be seen.

What a supercool experience!! Just near to Mall Road with super views. Highly recommended for family tour. Nice food as well and surprisingly serve Gujarati Food too. Service is fantastic!!! Valley side room is very good.

we came here for a family holiday and booked an appartment  at padmini nivas. The view from the appartment is breathtaking considering it's a 180 yrs old property it is well maintained and procured its charm. The furniture etc is vintage and you will get a lot to explore. It's situated at mall road which is convinient and at the same time is away from the hustle. Finally if you don't want to stay in the usual hotels than its the place to be .....  Tip for room- If u r coming with family do Chk the appartment no 14.

Indeed, the perfect property to stay while in mussoorie, whether with friends or family. Wake up with an ecstatic vision of nature with beautiful views overlooking the garhwal valley! Rooms are good and clean with a heritage tincture. They also have their own nursery and their gardens are full of plants with bright colorful flowers and fauna worth an explore. Located en route the Mall Road. Food, especially breakfast was delectable! Was slightly disappointed as the management did not concur my request of getting tea early in the morning. But overall, a perfect stay in mussorie!

Amazing hotel, great experience , nice location, nice food. Staff good, rooms are spacious, nice n amazing view, must visit with family, near to main market, Its an heritage property well maintained. Food is well made and great taste.

Visited this heritage property on aug 2014 and again booked 2 times in February  for my inlaws..and believe me they were extremely happy with 10.no room and a cottage on the corner of the hotel. Whenever requested for better room management upgraded room if possible for them.  The main plus point is that you can park your vehicle just in front of reception and take your car to mall road when ever you want..even in late night too ...this facility is not available in any hotel on the mall road hotels. Second plus point is the view from the garden with a swing and a table chair in it from which u can enjoy the whole view of vally as wall as dehradun city specially from sunset to morning.. Food was always good..all staff from forth class to first class knows how to satisfy there…

I visited Padmini Nivas on 8th January 2014 and selected this hotel after reading a lot of online reviews. The staff is very friendly, the service is quick and food is delicious. But the main attraction about this hotel is the rich heritage that is associated with it. We had a warm welcome and a splendid stay at the hotel. Apart from this, the hotel provides a majestic view of the winter line. If you are looking for a nice hotel to relax yourself in Mussoorie, I recommend you visit Padmini Nivas.

I visited Hotel Padmini Nivas on 31 January this year with pretty high expectations as I have read fabulous reviews for this hotel on tripadvisor itself and I would like to add one more to them. To start with, they have ample parking space for your own vehicles, pleasing personnel to attend you at the reception and room service, rooms with beautiful views of the valley, a good enough food menu, gardens to sit and relax in sunlight and covered seating areas with comfortable chairs to enjoy rains. They have rooms to accommodate a tourist and a traveller, both. All in all, it was a wonderful experience.

This is my first review of Padmini Niwas on trip advisor, but this was definitely not my first visit. I have stayed here as a kid multiple times and now, me and my husband stay here every year. We love the hotel for the spacious rooms, fabulous valley views, excellent service, yummylicious food and the nostalgia it evokes! The food is Indian vegetarian and the quality of the food has remained constant all these years. Must go if you are looking for a personal experience :)

We visited Mussoorie in January and decided to stay at Padmini Niwas going by its rating and reviews on Tripadvisor and it turned out to be a wise decision. We visited in a group of 9(3 families) having 3 small children amongst us and booked 3 rooms. We were given adjacent rooms which were connected by a common balcony which was the best part about our stay. Rooms were clean and well equipped and View of Mussoorie was amazing from it. Food served was also very nice. Service was quick and staff was well behaved and efficient. location of this hotel was perfect . All in all Padmini niwas is a beautiful and very well maintained property and we highly recommend it to people visiting mussoorie with family.

to start with ...on my first visit to this hotel i am completely in love with this place! the excellent staff( i must mention they were ever ready to help you) who had all the solutions to your tiniest of doubt!! hats off to them. as i was traveling with my parents my most concerned thought was about food.. which i must say is excellent. and they provide jain food too! the rooms are really well furnished..the location is apt.and the property is well maintained. it has a very pretty view of the valley you feel the warmth as soon as you enter the hotel words are not enough to describe my satisfaction  p.s- was very happy when they arranged a bonfire on our request( we traveled from 26th dec2014)!!:)

We stayed in Hotel Padmini Nivas during Christmas and really liked the quaint old-world charm of the place. It is a 180 year old property built in colonial style which retains its heritage look and feel. We were charmed by the wooden interiors,  the fireplace,  the paths leading to small gardens, and the outdoor seats in the garden with fabulous views. We used to sit in the warm sunlight in the garden and enjoy breakfast,  or on the chair in front of our room and enjoy the stunning views of the Doon valley below. The hotel is very accessible in terms of proximity to Library Bazar, which is at just a 2 min . walking distance.  This hotel is highly recommended for travellers who want a little peace and quiet during their vacation, and at the sane time want to be near the Mall.

There is a term called "Customer Delight" which occurs when any service gives something extra to customer and the whole Padmini Niwas ambiance does that. I will review in points: 1. Location is very strategic as it's just 50-100m from Library chowk and Mall road. Mind you there are two mall roads in Mussorie, one near Library chowk,Tibetan market and one is where Kalsang, Chic Chocolate etc are present. This one is near Tibetan market. So you get everything from shopping, restaurants etc just near you. 2. Reception is always smiling and check-in is very smooth. 3. We took semi-deluxe room and the view was superb. Semi-deluxe comes with a covered Balcony which is good. I don't have idea of other types of rooms. Bathroom was clean and everything from bed sheets to towel was clean…

A very nice property located bang on the mall road with own parking and awesome food.   To start with, as the entry to the reception. The person was just smiling and making us feel that we were welcome there and not just we were the money machine. The rooms were decent and clean as they were huge but yes to remember that they are old style rooms. Don't expect to have luxurious rooms like Fortune etc.  The food was awesome and fresh which was very clear that that was cooked once we ordered that.  The open small garden is the place to relax and unwind yourself.  Overall a very very nice stay and would love to go again.

Recently been to Mussourie . Booked Hotel Padmini Niwas online . Was a little doubtful as it is a heritage hotel as to in what condition it would be . But once we reached the hotel my assumptions were shed by the way we were greeted . Was welcomed by the manager Mr. Jain , who is a very warm person and ever helpful. We had booked 3 rooms , and to our delight these were very large and very well maintained . The furniture was old but very well maintained. The rooms themselves were of gigantic dimensions and had natural light throughout the day . The location is very strategic and hardly 5 minutes walk from the mall road . It has a very beautiful garden and sitting arrangements in the garden and the porch . A very beautiful sunrise from the garden can be witnessed . The food is of…

This property is very beautiful. They have very nice rooms. We stayed in a deluxe room and it was very beautiful. The place is very quiet and yet it is very near to the Bus Stand and Mall Road. The restaurant is also very good.

We reached this place on 22nd November'2014 with a lot of speculation in mind.The first sight of this heritage cottage enthrals you with a lot of charm and positivity! The driveway to the stone-pebbled porch reminds you of those classic european cottages..The swaying dahlias and chrysanthemums in the gentle breeze and bright sunlight picked up the zest in our brief sojourn to Mussoorie. We were greeted soon after by a beaming Mr Joy, who has been the hotel manager for the last 24 years.The welcome drink was a heavenly ale with the flavours of ginger, basil, lime, honey and other herbs richly imbibed in and the pleasant waiter even offered us a second helping, seeing our smile as we sipped through..Mr Joy( the hotel manager) always had a smile, a genuine smile(not plastic) on his…

1) Excellent location with mall road at a 5 min walk 2) Reasonable price for rooms , i stayed in a semi deluxe room which was furnished with all necessary amenities, and also a separate veranda  3) Courteous staff 4) Good food , enjoyed having breakfast in garden with valley view in front 5)Serenity of the campus , despite of being located in vicinity to mall road , campus offers ample privacy   Overall excellent value proposition ....

we stayed here for 3 nights in the first week of November. We were a group of 19 friends. Very comfortable stay! Conveniently located. Since it was a palace converted in a hotel, the lounge and entrance area with high ceiling feels spacious and kind of majestic. The manager and staff were good, the owner took personal care to ensure that our stay was enjoyable.The food was good. Location is convenient. Bonn fire was arranged for us with music. That was a lot of fun! Our stay here added to the enjoyment of beautiful Mussoorie.

We had a two day and one night stay at this heritage hotel. Overall a very enjoyable stay. Located centrally, the quality of the accomodation, service and food was certainly above par. Staff was very friendly and helpful, especially Joy, the manager who has a very pleasing personality. This place is certainly value for money. Highly recommended!

We happened to stay at this place with Family on this weekend, i.e from 21st-23rd Nov'14. I must stay there have been quite rare occasions when we take back cherisable memories back home from a vacation that's been perfect. Needless to say, the hill station is pristine, yet our trip to Mussourie was unforgettable, owing to the fact that we opted to stay at this property.  The location is excellent due to its proximity to the Mall Rd, at the same time offers ample solitude. Well maintained property, extremely courteous staff and delicious "hot served" food. Infact the Indian breakfast comprising of all sorts of paranthas is a must try. All in all a total value for your money when visiting with friends/family.

I stayed at Padmini Nivas for 3 nights with my parents this November.  We initially booked a continental plan, but upon arrival requested for an MAP, and that was easily granted. I have a fascination for heritage properties and this one is very pretty! The array of flowers all over the estate is pleasant. They have convenient seating all over, so you can sit amidst flowers and gaze across the hills while sipping your delicious masala tea.    The food was delicious and suited our palate. It was a refreshing break from typical restaurant food, as the cooking method was simple.  The variety is not wide, but that did not matter to us. At the end of the day we were looking at a simple, less spicy meal.  It is a vegetarian restaurant though they serve eggs.   The staff is one of the…

I have been to this hotel thrice. Loved staying there on every visit.    Pros 1. Excellent location on mall road 2. Have got good parking space 3. Excellent food. Paradise for vegetarians   Cons  1. Rooms require little renovation  My request for early breakfast at 5 am was fulfilled. Some electricity problem was fixed at night. Toilets are clean.  Overall to sum up a good place to stay at very reasonable price with excellent food.

This Place was amazing with plants around including a lotus pond! I loved the tube roses and the room which over looked the valley. We had a great time, as the hotel is right on Mall road, but tucked away  from the  noise, with all attractions nearby

If you are going to masoorie please please go one time you love it.  restaurant food is too good. pure vegetarian. They are not make non-vegetarian food. Make our food after we place order. not serve  Just one day before food. Only fress food serve. Staff is so friendly and they give room services so fast and good. Room are good it's haritage building from British timr. There is rose garden, garden with slide, swing, telescope so kids are so enjoy  Thay have great books collection for small kid to every age persons and they are provide games to play in your room just like chess, carrom, table tannish, pool table. They have a plants nursury.

This place is a Mussoorie gem. Mr Vikram, the hotel manager, is warm, friendly, and helpful. We were welcomed back here as if we were part of the family. The rooms are very comfortable and the staff are very helpful. The food in the restaurant is outstanding. We have not found a palak paneer better than the one at this hotel.

This is an easy referral. We checked in for 2 days and our experience was wonderful.  Service: Starting with Mr. Vikram, general manager of the property, the front office and service staff are exceedingly polite and helpful. Any number of room service requests were cheerfully delivered at any time of day.  Location: Prime! Calm among the chaos. Situated on mall road but quiet enough with other guests and the occasional troop of monkeys for company. Sometimes at peak hours the road below gets noisy with vehicles tooting horns and police on loud speakers.  Ambience: Heritage we were not disappointed. Rooms were neat and comfortable. We had 4 rooms with a connecting hallway. Presumably the connecting doors are closed for nuclear units. Very smart.  Things to do: Apart from the…

Friendly staff...came quickly to pick my luggage though have taken entry from another gate. Manager welcomed us with glass of water and quick check in...though it was early. Great view, well maintained cottages with best gujrati food. Have taken my mom also along with me and was knowing the challenges of Hill station as she cannot walk for long or even take ladders (steps), she requires wheel chair. So to take a walk at Mall road, first she has to pass through heighted ramp of the hotel, which was an obvious challenge for her but looking at this hotel manager extended his help to lift my mom in his maruti omni car to cross the heighted ramp...which definetly provided relief to my family. I'm really thankfull to the entire team of Padmini Niwas for making my stay memorable and…

Hi, it's location is the best in Mussoorie , amazing hill view , well built cottages , veg food and excellent service though it requires a little make-over to the inner rooms with modernised equipments .  The hill view creates gaps for old people to walk the hill to reach the mall road. Overall a worth stay!!!

Was visiting Mussoorie after a gap of over 3 decades and decided to choose Padmini Niwas for a 3 night stay with my family. Let me say that it was beyond expectation. Right from giving me the choice of room to meeting my  specific requirements for food,  cleanliness, staff response, quality and taste of food, everything was perfect.  The location is perfect, on the mall yet away from the humdrum, situated between Library and Kulri, this place is just right for a family holiday, for that matter any age group. All the rooms face the doon valley and are well located.  The room number 11 (a cottage) is perfect for honeymooners. Sipping a cup of masala chai seated in the garden overlooking the doon valley is an experience to cherish. Food is excellent veg stuff.  A value for money …

We had made a group family booking at this hotel, its was a pleasing memoriable experience. The best part of this hotel apart from the big british era heritage rooms and lots of open space, is the positive attitude of its staff members, They just love their work and this makes them to deliver nothing but the best. Amazingly good food... best I have had in recent times. Simply Excellent view from the property, lots of open space... more than any property in town and best people at your service round the clock. Situated at the prime mall road (library end) the property gives you great accessability to all the tourist spots in the city. I would highly recommend a stay at this property.

stayed along with a family of 10 . Location and ambience par excellent. Veg food simple and very good. The general manager ever willing to accomodate all needs. Staff prompt and courteous . If accomadation avail in this hotel no need to look beyond. Would highly recommend to one and all.  Regards,  R Jai Shankar

Padmini Known for her beauty and reflected in this heritage property. Location great and ambiance lovely. Courteous staff. Place is not far from any place which is saying it is best located. Good  vegetarian food, clean and tasty. Only non veg is an omelet which is also well made.  Special mention of Mr.Vikram Zutshi who looked after all our needs. Must visit  place.

Its an old fashioned property with one level up from basic amenities. It worked for me because I have reached late in nite at Mussoorie still they were good to keep me. I like old fashioned bunglow, Hotel with an great view of Dehradun City in night as well as Day. In night it seems standing at it garden area some beautiful gold lying on earth. Morning were equally good especially while having my breakfast. About the hotel in term of amenities is fine but neater bedsheets will be more nicer..However, on my request they were kind to give me. All in all good hotel go for N don't forget to Negotiate Hard!!!

We stayed at this property early August, 2014. Liked the location, ambience and the courtesy of the staff.   This is just below the Mall road, yet, quite serene and quiet. Nice property with an old world feel.  Very courteous and helpful persons manning the show. Look forward to going there again

The stay in hotel padmini nivas was mine blowing.we stayed there in month of august last week with my wife. Excellent room with great hospitality. We had booked the room via cleartrip we will great thankful to this portal because of excellent service. Staffs were well trained polite and courteous. Wonderful   room of front facing with perfect amenities. Food quality was excellent. We had full enjoy during our lovely stay. Overall i will recommended this property all of my friends.

We were 6  in a family . We rented the Apartment. It had huge rooms with a common Hall opening to the Hills. Artistically decorated . Prompt Service. Main thing is that it is very near to Mall road ; Infact approachable by foot from two sides towards two ends of the mall road. My Brother from US was amazed seeing the size of the room and the Property The manager showed us the Queen"s room which again left us with memories.

Though I booked the Cottage, on the recommendation of the hotel staff, with whom i talked over the phone. Though was disappointed as one of the room was below average.  However, staff cordially agreed to change it.  I booked Deluxe rooms instead.  Rooms were average, but the view from there was awesome...It's an old property but nicely maintained.  Service is quick, food is good, but price is on the higher side.  Apartment, is the best place to stay if you are travelling with the family.  Is big enough to accommodate 6 people comfortably.  View from apartment is the best.    It's on the prime location, on the Mall road and Camel road.    I stayed for 2 nights and travelled with my family.  I would highly recommend this place for your next visit to 'Queen of the Hills'.    I…

Padmini Niwas is Heaven itself in Mussoorie. Location is superb as its located on Mall road. Their room service is very quick. Management is very humble. They try to give you the best service. The most important things is the food. Food was awesome. Thanks to Padmini Niwas to make my trip memorable.

I usually don't review a hotel unless I visit it at least twice ... because I visit a hotel more than once only if I am thoroughly convinced about good service .... and in this case I am more than satisfied as I rate it my second home .... excellent location, quality ambiance, services from the core of heart ... and many more what mony cannot buy

We stayed in the Deluxe rooms here for 2 nights in April 2014. Perfectly located on the Mall road.... everything within a walking distance...  The rooms are nice and large yet cozy.. very well maintained. The only downside was that the Fireplace was not functional. They had provided room heaters.  Food is only Vegetarian but very good...  Highly recommended for those looking for a quiet property which is well located.

I have been to Mussorie from 23-25 August. Reached the hotel at around 2.30 and booked the rooms. Room no 18 had sitting area in front of it with beautiful views of the Valley. Tried to ask the management if they can provide me with the LEGENDARY room no:10 but it was already taken.  As such had to settle down with Room no 18 which still has amazing view to the other side of the mountain. In case if you reach after 4pm you will not be allowed to enter the MALL road and as such you will have to park your vehicle at the parking area which is down the slope.  The view from the Hotel are amazing be it morning/noon/night. You can certtainly enjoy Brakfast/Dinner or drinks sitting in the open area near parking.   One of the best Hotels to stay in Mussorie. Food was delicious and…

I went to Hotel Padmini Nivas in 2011 and stayed there for 2 nights. It was during the monsoons and hence raining every few hours. However, the advantage of the hotel is that it is well located near the mall road and hence it was easy to step out to take a walk or grab a bite. Also, the view from the hotel is fantastic. Especially with the clouds down below - its perfect for sitting and watching over the city during sunset and after. A very romantic place with an old world charm to it.   Only negative is - because it is a old property you may not get all the modern amenities.

I went with my family during the last long weekend after believing what most people said about the Hotel in Tripadvisor. Its aptly said - seeing is believing. After staying here - I can say very well that its an average hotel but in a very good location and with an outstanding service team. They will make you feel at home. The hotel is a very old property and comes with its demerits (we had rain water leaking/ seepage at various places in the room). Due to power outages - one phase was not working for which water-heaters were not working. The Manager was nice enough to shift us to another room when the hotel was running almost packed. Due credit should go to the Staff and the chef for the good food they serve. They boast that they serve one of the best Gujrati food - I guess…

One of the best experiences of hotels in India. Great Location Very Nice and cottage type room Fast Room Service Food taste great  Overall the experience of the hotel is really nice. Truly recommended. One thing that I really liked is the Tip System for the waiters, They keep a box wherein you can put the tip, later they divid it equally amongst all staff members.

Hotel is on Mall road with nice, clean and comfortable rooms. Lot  of open places to sit and relax with great views. Hotel staff is very professional. Food is served is very tasty(though only vegetarian) . Overall, a great place to stay in Mussoorie.

I have been to padmini nivas twice, the latest in April 2014. I just love this hotel. There are too many good points about this place.  1. The view of the entire doon valley from rooms is terrific. 2. Hotel is near mall road yet away for the usual crowd. One can easily go to mall road via their slip road. 3. Padmini nivas has a lot of greenery :) You can just relax anytime in their beautiful gardens or sit on the swing watching the entire valley. 4. Rooms are decorated nicely. 5. This hotel is definitely value for money.  Best time to visit will be during monsoons when one can just sit in the gardens feeling rain. Best rooms will be with view of valley.  This is my permanent place whenever I visit mussoorie :)

We have visited Mussoorie in April-14, found this hotel through tripadvisor web site, I must say it is truly amazing place to stay in Mussoorie: 1) Perfect & peaceful location, the hotel is situated on such a nice location that the entire doon valley and  Dehradoon city can be seen from here. 2) Delicious food and very helpful people. 3) Even rooms are very nice in providing a perfect view, specially room no. 10. 4) It offers value for money.  A fantastic trip made memorable because of this hotel.

had a delighted experience.best place to stay in mussoorie.hotel staff is very nice plus a valued heritage with maintained professional staff at your service.view from the hotel are so good . food is good and go for breakfast included offer one of the best deal to go for.

Stayed here for 2 nights recently. The experience was very good and comfortable. This property is offers a unique combination of proximity to mall road yet away from the crowd and noise of the mall road. The hotel offers few of the best views of the valley from its front garden....and the staff is pretty professional and helpful too.  I visited in off season so got a good deal too.....  Overall quite satisfied with the experience..

We went Mussoorie for 2N holidays at HPN, I must say Hotel Padmini Niwas is the best place to stay in Mussoorie, it is a well maintained heritage property with good rooms, best valley view.  Hotel staff is very courteous and friendly. Food was awesome.  Rooms were neat and clean. The best thing one will enjoy and experience at Hotel padmini Niwas is the beauty of nature which is not available in normal luxury hotels.  Though it is very centrally situated in the heart of Mussoorie though the place is very quiet and peaceful.  Thanks Padmini Niwas for making my holidays a memorable one.

The experience was wonderful, the staff at the reception were proactive...the food was good, The rooms were great and they upgraded me. Staff were great and friendly and did everything to make my stay enjoyable. The staff at the restaurant in particular was fantastic, Pleasant front desk staff. Overall experience was good and satisfactory

The hotel is located in one of the best places.. Mall road on one side n natural beauty on the other.. Rooms r small but ample space outside rooms to sit n enjoy the nature. Food is good, Staffs are Ok. Prefer to stay on the ground floor. Overall a very good experience.

Hi,  I recently stayed in this hotel and found this excellent place to stay. Excellent location, service and staff courtesy. I highly recommend this hotel for stay. you might find rooms bit smaller than you expected but given that hotel is old enough and location is awesome, you can live with it. :)

i stay this hotel on 18-20 june 14.really appreciated hotel . manager vikramji is very cooperative.staff is also very courtious.location is very close to nepali market & mall road. only problem is for senior citizen to climb the hotel.food is very good .restaurant is also very neat & clean. flower in garden is also very different & catchy.her owner respected harshida madam is also very kind & coopeartive.i sugeest this hotel to stay in mussoorie.

We stayed in the property in first week of June'14 and really enjoyed our vacations. The view from the  hotel was absolutely breath-taking. The location of the Hotel is a plus point. The staff was very efficient and extremely helpful and took care of our every little need, without any reminders.   Good Food + Better Staff + Best Location = Awesome stay!  Overall a great place to stay.

We stayed in the hotel with prior booking in one of the deluxe rooms.   PROS: - The hotel overlooks the valley. - Some of the waiters are cheerful but not all. - Spacious rooms.  CONS:  - The rates are very high as per the service and quality. - The rooms are very dirty with layers of dust over the carpets, furniture and mattresses. - The location is tiring to reach from both Mall and Library as it's connected by a steep slope. -

Stayed in this place for 4 nights, last week. Right from the fist moment, it seems the motive was to make us comfortable. They saw, we were tired, so they asked us to check in first, relax, eat and then finish the paper work, later. Never seen that experience in Indian hotels.   The rooms were comfortable, room service was fast. The place is right in the front of mall road, and yet amzingly peaceful. Also the view we had of the hill, was so wonderful that we spent hours sitting in small lobby in front of room, sipping tea & watching serenity of the hills.  My daughter specifically liked the rose garden with hundreds of roses and other flowers, and clicked tonne's of pictures.   the hotel food was very nice, clean and chef easily adjusted masala to our taste.   overall, what else…

I have stayed twice here..first time with mom and sister and then with my wife. Both times, found it nice. Rooms are good, the view is amazing. Staff are courteous and helpful. Food is also quite good. Only problem is a steep climb from the main road. Overall a nice relaxed place.

Just stayed  in deluxe suite for 2 nights .would like everybody to keep following points in mind before deciding for it  1 The rooms are spacious but full of dust.Furniture was not cleaned since days.Doors needed repairs for proper locking. 2.The Restaurant gets closed at 10 PM .It is difficult to get even a cup of tea or water after that.The restaurant is costly also...a simple GUJRATI THALI for Rs 320. and many more.. 3.Staff is good and well behaved.. the manager (?)at reception with beard is quite rude. 4 To reach the Mall you have to walk steep slope of about 70 mts ..(difficult for elders ) 5 Overall management is not professional. the owners also do not seem to be interested in improving.

this hotel makes every stay memorable, its the best place to stay in mussoorie, being a heritage property its got a pronominal charm. the location is wonderful.the hotel offers few great views or the mountains.  The food is really awesome. The staff is very friendly and accommodation. No other place in mussoorie can offer the experience of  this hotel.  must stay!!! highly recommend.

An Awesome Heritage Property with a Colonial Architecture, well maintained, Also seen are a variety of plants and flowers in the property. A discussion with one of the staff members revealed that this property belonged to a Maharaja, who gifted this property to his second wife, Padmini & further purchase by the present owners.  The owner & staff work together as a family. They are so welcoming, courteous and warm. The food has been excellent. It would be a delight for Veggies, specially Jains and Gujaratis.    Kindly do not compare it with 5 star super luxurious hotels, since this a heritage property. I would strongly recommend this hotel for one who would love to stay in heritage properties.  This property lies near the mall road, but at a lower level which provides both - an…

We took the apartment with 5 adults and 2 kids The apartment has a fully equipped kitchen where we could cook khichdi, biryani etc. we could make tea and toast bread for breakfast The balcony gives a view that cannot be beaten by any viewpoint on mall road The apartment, with its luxuriously sized rooms, spacious bathrooms with dressing area, grand dining area overlooking the valley and a fabulous semi circular settee with windows was just just fabulous The kids just loved the spacious apartment and it took us a while to settle into the space :) The service was very non intrusive and yet prompt. Very efficient staff and very well mannered management with great ethics and etiquettes I think this is the best hotel in mussoorie by far... Just hope they reduce prices a bit.... Shade…

This was my second trip here. The warmth of the people and the overall hospitality is simply fantastic. The food is an added incentive. The service in this hotel is something which I do not even feel sometimes in branded hotels in India. Looking forward to my trip here again. Excellent in one word specifically as I work in the  Hospitality industry specifically handling renowned chains like Marriott, Hilton etc.

I have been to this place multiple times, i have stayed in their apartment which is highly colonial and the rooms are excellent. It is placed in the mall road so you have anytime access to the market in the mean time it is also away from the noise of the market.

Was not backing my instincts of opting for this location...  once I reached there, I felt great about myself.  very well made old country side house / club kind of a feeling struck me.  Right on the mall road with parking facility, owner who is keen to know and serve to best of her abilities and small little things made it worth the experience and price paid.   While they serve only veg food and eggs,  they do serve north Indian, Chinese and 4 continental dishes which are very well made.  The staff of the hotel wants to take care of you including the server to the manager and the receptionist.   There are couple of swings and slides for kids.  With breath taking views and nice common places to sit and have well made soup on a rainy windy evening - this property was truly worth…

if somebody had lived in government guest house or circuit house than this review will helps them a lot. The hotel Padmini Nivas gives me the same feeling while staying at hotel and my experience at hotel was 'Excellent'. The Government Guest house or circuit house are good because of their quality food, the best isolated location to relax and the crowd of elite bureaucrats.   The location of the hotel will give you the scene of very beautiful scenery. Location of hotel is such  that I can go to an extent to say that from my room i felt that i am staying at beautiful Darjeeling. Being foodie I first judge the quality of food and trust me the meals served at hotel were really 'awesome'. The staff members of the hotels will gives you the lots of suggestions to choose the best…

1) It is situated on the Mall Road with a parking from the lower side, you can conveniently park                your car downstairs.  2) Beautiful property, nice garden and some slides for kids.  3) Food was delicious.  4) The bathroom were clean and provided a bucket and mug   5) perfectly fine bed sheet and towels.

Beautiful property, cannot fault its upkeep. I visited with my family and we had an absolutely brilliant time. We stayed in a suite which we booked online and were pleasantly surprised by the size of it when we saw it! The room had a connecting break out area which doubled up as a second room. The bathroom was splendidly huge as well. The only downside was that the shower was not working so we had to make do with the bucket! The staff is extremely polite and courteous. Even though the food is vegetarian, it is delectable! Would I visit again? Most definitely yes!

We had spent 2 nights here in month of May 2014. This property is on Mall road, so very good location. There is another entrance also from below.   I would say the main attraction of this property will be the views and the old world charm.   The rooms are comfortable and clean, and it is pocket friendly. The food is also good though it's vegetarian food.   Staff are all good and very responsive to the needs of the guests. We had a one year old son and we had no difficulty in preparing special food, milk for him and the staff helped us with that.   I will strongly recommend everyone this hotel.

We were a family group of 18 and had taken 9 rooms. This was a second visit after 10 years for some of us. It was a pleasant surprise to see that the hotel retained its old world charm and was exactly in the same shape as experienced before. They have perfected the art of hospitality management.   The rooms are comfortable and clean, and it remains a budget friendly hotel. The food is also excellent, and the staff is very responsive to the needs of the guests.   This was a great place for the family, with so many sitting areas, a lovely view and location right on the mall. Mussoorie is a walker's delight, with the Camel Back road, lovely Landour and cloud's end.   Padmini Nivas offers great value, and an unforgettable stay.   Rooms 17-20 are great with a lot of sunshine, and a…

The place is located on a hill top so be prepared to climb a good few steps to reach the place. However the views, calm and peace is worth it. They arrange for your luggage to be picked and also the manager was a kind person who helped in arranging a birthday cake as one of the family was celebrating anniversary.    We went for standard rooms which were small, but very clean and well located...we were staying for a day hence did not matter. Food was really very tasty here and they serve Gujarati Thali too.. The property is a old heritage hotel which is well maintained..if you are looking for super luxury then look elsewhere...

If you are looking to relax and unwind, Padmini niwas is the place for you. We stayed in the deluxe suite. It was really clean, comfortable beds, very clean bathrooms and extremely spacious. The view is mesmerising. You can sit out with your coffee or breakfast and enjoy the peaceful valley view. Most importantly is their quality food, very tasty and thali is a must try. The managers and staff are very co-operative and polite and with quick service.  I will always come back to Padmini Niwas to drop all my stress.

The stay at this hotel is very relaxing as you have an awesome view of the valley and it's just next to the main market street called mall road. The food is also very delicious and freshly made. It's like home food. It's the best located hotel. The rooms are clean and spacious and the staff are very friendly and courteous.

I Had stayed in Padmini Nivas from 24th March,14 to 29th March,14. I had booked this hotel after going through review. Location of the hotel is on mall road.Since i am vegetarian i choose this hotel. Rooms were very clean and Mr PAVAN use to remind me everyday for cleaning of room. Mr Pavan through out my 5night stays saw that i am comfortable. All the staff were very helpful and co-operative. Veg food excellent and tasty.Breakfast spread very nice. Room services very excellent and prompt. I will advise all traveller to atleast stay in Padmini niwas when they are mussoorie. I will again visit the hotel next year.

I have stayed in Padmini Nivas more than once. With the beautiful doon valley on one side and mountains on other, this is a place were you feel like home.
