Aptly titled Nivas, you really feel like in your residence, a home away from home indeed. The food is awesome, and you are left with licking your fingers!! The staffs are very good and courteous. Great place to stay, and of course, the Mall road is just above you :)!!!

we had rented the apartment, the space was ample for 2 families with kids and the service was prompt & courteous. VFM, excellent vegetarian food just like home. Mr Vikram the manager was very helpful & courteous. good location and beautiful view..must stay property if visiting mussorie.

Amazing view.. awesome food.. although i was craving for non-veg food...but no complaints...food & services were commendable...   Vikram and team are doing awesome job.. Keep it up...  Dog "Moti" so adorable. The panoramic view from the room with morning sip of tea is the best stress buster. Away from the city noise... We stayed for 02 nights. The lawn in front of the reception, one can sit there for hours and enjoy the view & at night makes you feel like travelling in galaxy of stars...  Will totally recommend...

This is definitely value for money,good food,very courtacious staff.Overall good expierience.Ony  draw back is you have to climb very steep road to reach mall Road.This may be difficult for senior citizens to climb this nor it is adviseble.

Excellent heritage property at a TRUE value. Lovely location, splendid staff (Mr. Vikram was very courteous), fabulous food & marvelous MOTI. A must for every body who is nostalgic about the era gone by. We stayed for three nights and it was a peaceful, fulfilling, refreshing and satisfying experience. Hasan

We stayed for 3 nights at the Padmini Nivas. We were looking for a hotel which had an entry from outside Mall Road and still close enough to Mall Road since we were planning to reach by the evening by when the Mall Road would have closed. We found Padmini Nivas and it suited our budget perfectly. We took the MAP package and had an excellent break. Thanks to Mr. Vikram (manager), Mr. Jain and Mr. Ankush for taking care of all our needs. Also a special thanks for Gyan Singh for serving us all meals and conveying our every small instruction back to the kitchen. The owner of the place (I didn't ask her name - we just called her Aunty) was always welcoming us with a smile and personally asked us a number of times if everything was okay.  Pros - It is situated on the Mall Road with a…

Stayed at Padmini Nivas for 2 nights, and left the hotel with beautiful memories...  150+ year old heritage hotel with beautiful view of Dehradun valley, spread over 5 acres of land. This hotel offers beautiful experience in terms of room quality, vegetarian food(serves eggs on demand) and overall excellent service. Staff are  very polite and respond to your calls without any delay irrespective of the time of call.  If you are lucky to get the Room No:10, you can enjoy the beautiful view of valley sipping a cup of ginger tea from the room itself. If not at Room No:10 also, they had made arrangements to get the view from the garden.  Recommends this HERITAGE HOTEL for all groups, specially for family and couples.  Manojkumar Karwar Karnataka

Our 4 day stay( 26th March-30th March)  at Padmini  Nivas was peaceful, enjoyable and memorable indeed. This hotel offers a beautiful experience in terms of room quality, vegetarian food and overall excellent service. Had cups and cups of masala chai and ginger chai overlooking the Doon Valley. The hotel is situated right at the Mall, the most happening place at Mussoorie.  Felt good to meet Mrs Harshada Vohra(owner of the hotel),a warm and caring human being who gave   helpful suggestions.Our special thanks to Mr Vikram,Mr Jay,Mr Ankush and each and every staff member who took care of us. Borkar family,Goa

Our group took few rooms in this hotel which is located on a prime location in Mussoorie. This hotel is pricey but felt us wanting in many areas.   Hotel rooms are big and have decent view but are not as clean as you expect. Far too many powercuts. We were given the reason that due to snowfall they have no control, but being a hotel in a hill station..you got to have solution for that. Powercut cut meant loss of room heating and hot water, that left us in a lurch.  Food was good and staff was polite.

It is 170+ years property, well maintained and has beautiful view from most of its rooms. Excellent Service, Friendly Staff with Quality Food. Approachable with your car/taxi and walkable to the Mall road. Highly Recommended!!!

awesome experience.....warm hospitality...........courteous staff........best quality vegetarian food and ambient location......a perfect weekend getaway for family...........:):) above all...breathtaking view of the valley

i write 'oasis' , because it is  the only serene place among many cemented buildings scattered ALL over mussoorie..  Food --> excellent Location --> superb Services --> out of the world  Management --> Perfect ; under the guidance of the general manager Mr. Vikram...  Will definitely visit again , when in india ..

If you really want to relax and enjoy the scenic beauty of hill queen Mussoorie then look no further-Head towards Padmini Nivas.Best location amongst all hotels. Room service excellent, staff very courteous. Rooms are fabulous with close attention paid to basic hygiene and comfort. Its in-house Suruchi restaurant is a place to relish sumptuous Vegetarian meals. We enjoyed Ginger tea, Peanut chaat, Gujrati Thali and Paneer & Aloo Parantha the most. I am very thankful to Mr. Vikram (General Manager of Padmini Nivas) for boosting the morale and confidence of my son who has gone there to appear in an exam. Stayed at this property two weeks back for a night only, a much needed break from chaotic life of Delhi with the dear ones, and I must say this place is just amazing in terms of location, view and service. The food and room service was also good.  The best part about this hotel was the room, it was a cottage rather, with beautiful view of Doon city and its own sitting area outside (more of a private area).  We are thankful to the manager who let us check-in at the wee hour.   We might go there again and hopefully soon.

Stayed for 4 nights this March 2014, the following of Padmini Nivas is wonderful: a. Managers Vikram & Jay very courteous & helpful. b. Spacious rooms are neat & well maintained. c. Restaurant food (veg.) is excellent & staff that serves hot food is great.  d. View from cottage no. 11 (for 2 persons) is excellent & room no. 6 ( for 3 persons) is also very good.  e. View of Doon valley & Mussoorie is very nice. f. Well maintained campus, facility to sit in the porch and view Doon valley is good.  g. Mall road is 5 minutes walk.   We all family members enjoyed our stay here and look forward to visit this place often.

I visited the hotel last week. Everything is wonderful here. Service is excellent. Hotel staff is very helpful. Rooms are excellent and location wise the hotel is well situated on mall road. The food here is also excellent. I enjoyed the stay here in this hotel.

Went back to stay at Hotel Padmini Nivas in November 2013. Rooms were pleasantly comfortable, and the veg dishes at the Restaurant were too good. Being a carnivorous person, this is one place where I could thrive on veggie food for a week! Their nimbu paani with salt is the best I have ever had. The best part of the hotel is its ever smiling staff and manager Vikram. Hope to go back to PN soon.

I visited Mussoorie around the two weeks back with my family,it had snowed heavily around that time,all the for hotels were packed,luckily for us we managed to get a room at Padmini Nivas.We stayed there for a fortnight.The staff was very efficient and polite especially the General Manager,he was very courteous and helpful ever ready to answer to  all your querries , When we arrived at the hotel we were freezing it was a pleasure to walk inside spacious rooms which were clean aswell as cosy.The view of the Doon valley from the room was spectacular.The food despite being purely vegetarian is delectable.The  hotel is very well maintained,the gardens blooming with flowers,view of the hill,clouds floating,its  a beautiful sight.The trip to Mussoorie was enjoyable, but our stay at…

we booked Hotel Padmini Nivas after reading lot of positive reviews on trip advisor and I must say we were not disappointed with the choice. We went on a hired cab which was not allowed to go on the mall road so had to climb few steep stairs to reach the hotel. however once we reached there it was a wonderful experience.  The checkin was smooth, rooms were pretty big, views from the rooms was brilliant, location of the hotel was prettly close to all road. The hotel staff was also very helpful. we did a late check in and their kitchen was closing by that time. The staff advised to order food even before we could enter into our rooms.The food was homely and tasted pretty good. food was also priced very reasonably.  One thing I would advise as an improvement could to change the…

We went to Mussoorie during the winter carnival at the end of 2013. We had no prior booking and directly went to the hotel. We stayed there for one night and our stay left us with beautiful memories. Some of the positives and negatives of the hotel are Positives: 1. The staff is very courteous and helpful 2. The hotel is a heritage hotel and is very well maintained 3. Location of the hotel is wonderful.  4. We stayed in room no 1. 5. There is a beautiful lawn right in front of the room with provision for seating and running around. We enjoyed our breakfast there.  6. During evening the view of Doon Valley cannot be expressed in words 7. Rooms are big and very clean 8. Bathrooms are extremely clean  Negatives: 1. Only vegetarian food with eggs. This can be a problem for non…

Everyone from the manager to the staff were very cordial and well mannered.Great service.The excellent location of this hotel adds to the charm. Come here to enjoy the best of Mussoorie and its beauty.

We booked Padmini Niwas after lot of net searching and finally zeroed on it after Trip Advisor’s reviews. We stayed there for 2 nights.............. 25th and 26th January,,,,,,,,,, with our little kids. The hotel played a big role in making our Mussoorie trip memorable. Hotel is situated on Mall Road about 100 meters from the Gandhi/Library Chowk. Hotel can be reached from the highway too but taxis cannot go up the ramp so after a steep walk with luggage one can reach hotel faster with this shortcut. Pros and cons of the hotel are:  Pros:  1.	Its a Heritage hotel .....property dates >100 years back and is well maintained.  2.	Location of the hotel is wonderful. We stayed in Room No. 10 and it has panoramic view of   the Doon Valley. Mall road is also just a  few steps …

Staff is unusually courteous & helping. Even in the chiiling winter night, I woke up the staff at 2 am & requested for additions blankets. For our surprise, I did not face any issues towards customer care. The food services are very fast.

Padmini Nivas is clean and neat. Comfortable stay. Beautiful view of the valley when you step out of the room. Staff is very friendly and helpful. The restaurant is also good. Paranthas were yummy. The thalis are supposed to be very good but we could not try. The only negative (if you can call that) is that large vehicles (Tempo Traveller types) cannot go till the hotel - need to walk about 200m or so on a road that's a bit steep

Padmini Nivas is a lovely hotel cushioned in the lap of peace and tranquillity i.e. Mussorie. Beautiful Hotel strategically located (in terms of convenience and connect with the rest of Mussorie). Importantly the place is clean and hygienic, staff members are courteous and they are ably led by an equally (if not more) courteous & Hospitable Manager (Vikram) and owner (Mrs. Harshada Vohra). Truly re-defined my experience of a relaxing hill station holiday. This place has and will always have my vote.

I had stayed at hotel during the last week of December 2013...and it is the third consecutive year I have stayed here at padmini nivas ...I can not imagine staying at any other hotel in Mussorie. It has superb location, excellent rooms, brilliant homely veg food....simply love the food...one of the best thalis I have eaten.  The staff is so nice and helpful. They always have a smile on their face and ready to help you in whatever manner required...including suggest places one could consider visiting in and around Mussorie ...  the not so frequented sight seeing places....or atleast places not on regular tourist circuit.  The rooms are spacious, airy and comfortable...most importantly very clean.   This hotel takes the concept of "Hospitality" to an all new level...which would be…

This place to me is quintessential mussorie considering all my trips to mussorie have always meant living at padmini niwas .... The place has a charm and vibrancy all its own .... the affable and hospitable staff, the fact that it retains its palatial charm and the beautiful valley views  .... A well kept property with comfortable and clean rooms and a convenient location (walking distance to library, camel back road and picture palace) and a nice homely feel to it  .. definitely gets my vote of excellence

We had an off-session Mussoorie tour on 2012 and there we stayed at hotel Padmini Nivas. It was a delightful stay. We were new couple and they made the Mussoorie visit special for three days. The manager Jay was very friendly and one of the stuffs Mr. Gyan Singh was excellent in dealings. The place was not only nice, it had an enchanting impression to cherish forever. Food was too good and rooms were beautifully decorated. A neat and clean homeliness, a beautiful library and sitting room, small nursery of sessional flowers, the open and well maintained premises, serene and calm valley view with a very photogenic natural beauty and the warmth in people’s heart made the stay memorable to us.

Our experience at this hotel was wonderful on all counts. It has a good location - very close to the Mall road but about 200 metre down a slope. So you are cutoff from the hullabaloo of the mall but close enough to walk there any time you wish.  The rooms are spacious and comfortable. We stayed in a suite (15A) which had a large living room as well as a separate changing room. The room service was extremely efficient and the front desk people were friendly and helpful. The hotel has a small garden where we used to sit and have breakfast while looking at a panoramic view of the Mussourie valley. The entire experience was very relaxing.  The food is also very good. They have only veg and eggs but despite being a hardcore non-vegetarian, I never missed not having non-veg. The…

Booked this hotel via Cleartrip, hotel was good and clean, bed sheets, bathrooms were very clean. Had requested room heater while booking which was ready in the room, when we checked-in. staff very friendly, ready to help. advantage of this hotel, it is on the beginning of Mall road. little sloppy road to reach the hotel, but its worth as most of the hotels here either you have to climb up or get down the road.  A must mention about the food, it's very good tasty and homely food. i would recommend this hotel.

I stayed in Padmini Nivas from 21st to 25th Dec 2014 in Room No-8 with my family. In a nutshell the stay was very nice including rooms, valey views, room service, cleanliness, mouth watering food, staff, maintenance, garden, and flowers. The hotel was well decorated for XMas. :-) One thing I felt is (based on my travel experience) the room tarrif can be a bit low what I paid. Rest it was an awesome stay @ Padmini Nivas.

If you are going to Mussorie, This should be the hotel, On the mall and also faraway from hustle bustle of the mall. Location Excellent, Food Good, Service Excellent . I do not rembember the manager name but he was very hospitable and nice and had good knowledge of area . I also want to thank you the room service guy whose hospitality was also excellent. Rooms are Good . Prices are also reasonable. I would suggest this property

If you're planning a trip to Mussoorie, it has to be Hotel Padmini Nivas.  I'm currently staying here and writing this review. Top class rooms, top class food, top class service and of course THE BEST view. A slope away from the main Mall Road.   Highly recommended. Don't miss out on this one.

I along with my wife and kid stayed there from 17th - 19 th Dec'13 in room no 10. It was a short trip as Mussoorie does not has much to offer apart from ofcourse the weather & peace for which we get away from our daily chaotic lifes.   Padmani Nivas is a wonderful property right from the rooms to the food . Staff  was courteous , rooms were quite spaceous  offering beautiful hill views .Room heater ,neat & clean washrooms & food on order . The reception area & the place around it is very well maintained , you can sit in the sunshine and enjoy scrumptious breakfast . The Lawn is full of flowers offering not just a beautiful view but also you can capture scenic photographs . The property is worth every single penny they charge, it is not a 5 star category resort ( No swimming pool…

Just getting to the point. Stayed there on 22nd to 24th Nov 2013 for my aniversary , booked a deluxe room Room No 11. Pros of the Hotel:- 1. Location, near to library chowk and not picture palace. mall road is 10 minutes walk 2. Great view of valley, you can enjoy the sunrise the sunset and great views while having your breakfast  3. Different from other luxurious hotels yet price effective. 4 Hotel with a lot of greenery and without any noise. 5. Had few meals which are good better than available in market. 6. Hotel has a parking. which I coulndt use as I was travelling via taxi,train. 7. Good flowers and nursery and excellent maintained gardens. 8. The hotel has a box which you can tip last day(box says its a collective effort to serve you so why pay individual) quite…

I can count my stay at Padmini Nivas in the last week of Oct-13 for 4 nights as one of my most memorable ones. Undoubtedly, Padmini Nivas will be my first choice if i happen to visit Mussoorie anytime in future. I had this brief vacation with my family including my parents, my wife and a 2 year old son and while you do so there are certain things which always hit your priority list.  1. appropriate food for your parents and small children like mine; 2. accessibility to the main market; 3. flexibility from the hotel staff's side to help you have comfortable stay, be it house keeping, room service, sight seeing arrangements, general guidance of the city, overall behavior of the crew, assistance during medical emergency, etc 4. appropriate lodging for you to enjoy your stay with…

I stayed in this hotel during July 2010. Me and my friend stayed in this hotel for one night at it was very nice stay. Rooms are clean. The staff is good well mannered. Service is also good. I haven't ate much in the hotel just ordered Tea and some pakodas and both were good. Its location is also good with good view and reachable to main market.

After immersing myself in the yogic wilderness of Rishikesh for 2 weeks, the quiet misty magical mystical hill-station Mussoorie was the perfect place to retreat to with my girlfriend. Nestled in the foothills of the Himalayas with so much to see and do, Mussoorie really is a fascinating place. And there is nowhere better to stay then at Hotel Padmini Nivas. The rooms, food, staff and location are from some romantic era where worrying was not to be present. This hotel is perfect in every way. There are also great specials during low season. Vikram the manager is a highly interesting chap and will give you tips on where to go and what to do.

At the outset let me warn you, if you are looking for a luxury property with all the frills .This hotel is not your cup of tea. But if you want to stay with the most gorgeous view of the hills in town in a natural ambience ,you have reached the right place.  I have been staying here since last 15 yrs and i have yet to be disappointed while staying here. the food you get here is awesome to say the least.  Service is homely so do not expect the artificial services of the hotels .  For my money this is the best property in town. Period

Me n my soulmate enjoyed stay here. Best located , just 3 mins walk to mall road , Best scenenic view , semi deluxe rooms are attached with beautiful garden , landscaping is beautifully maintained ,room was  comfortable ,good hospitality .we stayed in semi deluxe room . Prices are slightly high but that doesnt matter to get memorable experiences. I will visit here again

The says it all!  Yes, another excellent hotel that we stayed in during our trip in Sep 2013.  The hotel, the staff, the room, the amenities, the location, the vegetarian food, everything was excellent.  I self-drove my FIAT Linea to Mussoorie from Mcleodganj with my wife.  We reached Hotel Padmini Nivas, Mussoorie at 8:15 pm. But, my Linea had tough time in negotiating a steep, narrow and gravelly curve as it lost its momentum at a hair-pin bend. It would not climb uphill from zero speed, resulting in spinning of front tyres without traction. I smelt burnt rubber. The other side of road faced a deep valley, but there was no parapet or crash-barrier. My wife got down and I started doing forward and backward manoeuvres. At that time, a hotel staffer was walking down the road. He…

We had a marvellous stay in Mussoorie at Hotel Padmini Nivas. Wonderful interiors, very good service and some excellent dining too, must recommend the hotel's authentic vegetarian cuisine. Very reasonably priced too for a beautifully located property. Just off the mall road, 5-10 mins walk to anything you want. Our room was at Rose garden side which gives a breath taking view of Doon Valley. Rooms are spacious and well ventilated. Clean wash-rooms with all modern amenities. Authentic old furnitures were really remarkable. Staff were really helpful, tough this is a vegetarian property, the staff members suggested really nice place near by for best non-vegetarian food in town. No show off, Padmini Nivas gives you great hospitality experience. A perfect place for family get away.…

its realy great time for me and my wife.specialy room no.11 its realy wonderful experiance frm this room.i wil always refer this room.good services ,good quality food i think over all thing are good.thanx for padmani niwas all satff.

We stayed at this hotel on 2nd September, 2013.  It is a lovely hotel with a beautiful view of the Doon valley. Location is conveniently off the Mall Road. The rooms are very spacious, and so are the bathrooms. Cleanliness is also good, and the staff are extremely courteous. Being vegetarian, we had no complaints with the food and the service, in fact it was superb. We definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who visits Mussoorie for a relaxed holiday.

Stayed in last week of 30 august 2013. Location was ok,i think place itself is fabulous. So no special credits to room etc.There was bad smell in the room might be it was closed for long time, was bit unclean especially bathroom. Being off season felt the prices were over the top. Food was ok, staff was friendly but didn't find this hotel much impressive. Will not recommend this one!!

Hi, We have visited Hotel Padmini Nivas on 15th Morning and stayed there till 17th August. Before leaving Delhi, I read reviews on Tripadvisor and booked  my rooms. I was travelling with my Mom,Dad and wife. Since my parents were with me,I requested them to allocate rooms on ground floor. There was ample parking,on Library road and walking distance from Mall Road. Excellent View with neat and clean specious rooms. Staff is very helpful and courteous in making our stay wonderful. Food is too good,must try there Kadi pakoda. And not costly at all. I must recommend stay at Padmini Nivas and a fixed place for me and my family on next trip to mussorie....

Not a 4* or a 5* property. But soothing for sure! Great location, heritage tag, nice service. Above all the staff treatment being so homely, we didn't get a chance to complaint. To a good extent I may say it's worth the money. Just be conscious on the vegetarian food and the rates on higher side.

Enjoyed staying in the hotel for 2 nights…. we really didn’t face any problem during our stay 180 year old property is very well maintained....rooms were nice and clean and had very nice view of valley and garden …. Specially like the way they have option to join the balconies of the rooms for group of guests They serve only vegetarian food.... which was our preference and everything we have ordered was very well cooked and tasty.  All the staff members were helpful and cooperative

Four of us stayed together in a suite, while on a short break. The location was convenient, the food was very good, and the views from our room were inspiring.  The staff were very helpful and we enjoyed spending time in this historic setting.

Had been to this heritage hotel, while I was in Mumbai and made the booking via phone and depositing advance in hotel a/c. I had read lot of reviews before deciding on going for this one. And believe me, I really was a super happy traveler as soon as I saw the hotel, its location and most importantly our room. Brilliant interior design, very carefully chosen artifacts in whole property. The in-house restaurant was also brilliant. The best part was the food, from breakfast to lunch to dinner, I just had not complaints at all and since I am a pure vegetarian getting good food was top priority.  I wish I can spend 1 week of monsoon time in this hotel again in future.  Highly recommended for family and honeymooners.  Himanshu

So there we were. My Mom, Uncle, Aunt and my five year old. All piled into out old trusty Santro on a beautiful remain drenched Saturday when we decided to have lunch at the China Bistro (a must drop-in in Dehradun). After eating a lovely lunch and having an even lovelier chat with its owners, we decided to explore. And found ourselves after an hour in Mussoorie. It was already 5 in the evening and so, we decided to stay put for the night. Hotel Padmini Nivas came recommended by my uncle and aunt who had stayed there earlier. They couldnt quite remember how to reach it so we called them on the phone. And sure enough, after a short wait a man from the hotel came and guided us to the hotel. That was the beginning of a lovely warm hospitality of this hotel. Endless cups of tea and…

The 180 years old British estate with its bungalows is very well maintained. Being just off the Mall makes it very quiet and easily yet accessible to the Mall. Great views of the hills and Doon valley.   The staffs are happy people eager to serve. Mr Vikram Zutshi, who takes overall care of the hotel, is very helpful. He turned out to be an accomplished artist having done his exhibitions in Paris and other places. Many of the rooms have his subtle touch of artistry.   Food that we had, paneer and vegetable fares, are tasty. Difficult to get a dining room like that today with high ceiling, fireplace and Raj era deer busts up on the wall.   We lived in a bygone era of Raj glamour without burning a hole in the pocket.

Very good location at mall road, and the staff specially mr. Manish is very supporting. Rooms are clean and have a view to don valley. We have stay hear 4 night with good experience. I would recommend this hotel for all vegans, who would not only enjoy good veg food but also good hospitality .

This was my second visit to Padmini Niwas. It is such a comfortable property and very ideally located on the Mall. We stayed in the main house. The Room was large and very comfortable. The furniture was in the room was just right and not cluttered. The back of the room opened to the view of the valley. The hotel is encapsuled by greens and very pretty flowers. The hotel is at different levels and each level has these nooks and corners which offer great view and some of them are ideal for just quiet and peace and for reading. The front of the hotel also overlooks the valley and there are seating available for you to just sit and enjoy the view. Many a times, while on the property, you will be engulfed in the clouds. The night, in my view is the most spectacular as it provides the…

I have been to this hotel three times and I plan to go back again. This is a colonial bungalow turned into hotel and gives you a feeling of a home in hill-station you always wanted. The best part is the location which is right below the mall road overlooking the doon valley. I loved having breakfast every morning in the open area with a fantastic view. The food is good and they specialize in Gujarati Thali. The rooms are clean and service is prompt. All this available at relatively economical prices. I would recommend room number 11 which is actually a cottage and gives you an additional privacy. The room tariff are relatively economical considering the benefits you get. I strongly recommend this hotel if you are looking to relax and enjoy old world charm.

Excellent hospitality , home like vegetarian food !  The staff was extremely friendly and helpful.  The views from the rooms were amazing. I would recommend this hotel for all vegans, who would not only enjoy good veg food but also good hospitality .

A simple, clean and value for money property. Its a well managed heritage hotel with homely food. You will not get a better location - its amazing to have a property in the middle of the Mall. The rooms are clean, bathrooms are ok but service is pretty good. The garden and view of the hills is icing on the cake. If you are looking for something clean, hospitable but nothing fancy - you have come to the right place.

Great place to unwind, on the mall as well as away from the mall. Very well maintained heritage property. Very friendly staff, going out of the way to help and make you feel at home. Rooms are well furnished and nicely decorated with fresh flowers. Well maintained gardens and great view of the Doon valley ,With clouds coming to touch you. Ample parking space. Play area for kids and indoor as well as outdoor games for adults. Very relaxed atmosphere. Home cooked fresh and delicious food. Didn't feel like going back home.

We visited the property in the second week of june ,we stayed in the cottage no 11 .it gave a beautiful view of the hills .the food at the restaurant SURUCHI was the best in town .The staff was very co operative .We checked in the hotel at 8 am they gave us a room to freshen up till our cottage was ready .a special mention to Mr VIKRAM as he takes keen interest to maintain the property .I have visited MUSSOURIE six time in the past  but this was the best.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

I stayed here for 3 nights and didn’t really want to go back home after that. As soon as you enter the hotel you get to see magnificent view of the mountains covered with clouds. Most rooms have fantastic views. The staff is very courteous and provides you with all the help you need. The hotel manager Mr. Vikram makes sure to be as accommodating as possible and goes an extra mile to make your stay memorable. Food is great and if you are a vegetarian you cannot find a better place than this.  Complete value for money hotel!!

I stayed in Padmini Niwas for 2 Nights from 21st May 2013 - 23rd May 2013 after going through the reviews in Tripadvisor. The location is great (very near to Mall road) and the rooms are spacious, nice and very well decorated. The garden is very well decorated with full of roses,. The food is delicious and you can get only vegetarian dishes. Though you can get egg but its from separate kitchen. We got everything from the menu whatever we ordered. The bathroom was neat and clean with all Jaguar fittings.The staff was polite, kind and helpful and the room service is exceptional. I would certainly like to visit again and strongly recommend this property.

We stayed there for 2 nights and 1 day. We had made the booking by Goibibo for 2N&3D, but due to certain issues we could reach there at 11 PM only. They have won our heart at the moment we stepped in. Since it was late so they did not ask for any formalities, we were given Room no.11,the cottage which we had requested them over phone. I do not know where to start from, the Hotel is located at mall road, a heritage property with beautiful flowers all around. The room service is excellent, food is good. Mr. Vikram is a very nice person with good sense of humour. Staffs are co-operative. Room no 11, the cottage , the most ideal for couple, complete privacy with private sit out area, huge room with a big bathroom, complete Maharaja/Maharani type feeling. Only one request, the…

i stayed at this hotel way back in june 2008 and must admit this is one of the best place to stay at mussorrie. the cottage suite in this hotelis just amazing. located at mall road this hotel gives some lovely view of the hills.

After going through all the good reviews, I booked a room for 3N stay in Padmini Nivas, 5 weeks in advance through Goibibo and paid full amount. Before the booking, I had called up the Padmini Nivas manager to confirm the room availability. On getting the confirmation, I booked through Goibibo as I was getting a 20% discount. After booking, I forwarded the automated hotel confirmation email received from Goibibo to Padmini Nivas. I did not got any response from them.  Just 1 week before my travel, I get a phone call from Goibibo informing that the hotel room is not available and they would try to accommodate me in some other hotel. I told them that I spent lot of time researching on the hotels before deciding on Padmini Nivas and I had also checked on room availability before…

I was there with my family i.e. we n our 2 kids for a summer break. I wud start by telling u the only lacuma of this hotel , we had to climb up a steep slope to reach the reception as the cabs r not permitted to get to the hotel so we had to climb up from the  back side, the main entrance from the mall road is equally tiring and makes it a bit difficult to move in n out of the hotel too frequently.  Apart from this every  other thing was just fantastic, this being  a heritage property, the rooms were huge and still well maintained n well furnished.  The check in was hassle free and this is by  far  my best experience with any front office of a hotel, it  doesnt stop here only, the room service is equally good and every staff seems well trained and truly professional.  One thing…

i would suggest everyone preferably vegeterians to stay at padmini niws in mussorie. hotel premises, rooms, room service n food is the best. centrally located on mall road making it easily accessible, full view of mountains n valleys across mussorie, fully spacious for other activities are some of the additonal advantages. full kudos to padmini n its staff for making my family's stay at mussorie a memorable experience.

Great location and food, nice quaint hotel. Lots of flowers around and the traditional noble interiors in the dining and visiting area make it an experience in itself. A little overpriced though at 5k for the deluxe room.

I stayed at Padmini Nivas in April 2013 with a friend. Lovely, quaint hotel, great location just off the mall, wonderful view, delicious food and top-notch service from everyone. We had no hot water in our first room because of a plumbing problem, so we were updgraded with no extra charge to a lovely cottage with its own garden. I travelled nine times to India, and this may be the best Indian hotel I've ever been to. Very highly recommended!

Had a great stay at this hotel. Location and food is really great. Service is equally good  no frills hotel at great price. Recommended for vegetarians looking for a peaceful stay at the queen of hill station but no idea why is it called so. May be its the weather 😊

As informed by other trip advisor this is an Very good quite property with an excellent view. The rooms are very clean and huge. If you are bored about a typical hotel then I suggest you must try this. Foods great , service good, only a slight disappointment on the approach tricky road to hotel. Hope the hotel authorities look on this matter. But a must recommended stay at Mussoorie.

actually i am writing this review a bit late...i stayed with my 2 friends at padmini nivas in last April..selected this on trip advisor reviews...its simply awesome....the location is very beautiful...try to select rooms that are valley facing....special mention to the food its simply amazing..we just loved it...be it paav bhaji or north indian food its very tasty...there is a small road in the hotel that leads to mall road...

We reached before check in time but staff attended us and arrange room for us, we don't have to wait a minute. Staff very well guide us to reach hotel easily. Food was very nice. Great view from our room enjoyed very much while rain. I like most the open area, garden and the doon valley view from hotel front. Slope from entrance gate to reception is very steep so difficult to walk. overall very pleasant stay for 03 nights.

Been to this place in April with family and everyone of us has loved the location of the hotel,food and service of the staff. we have reached the place at midnight and were happy to see the staff awake welcoming us and making the quick check-in. Didn't have to wait or do the check-in formalities after the tiresome drive. Mr. Vikram the Manager was very helpful in guiding us to some exotic places. The hotel is located right on the Mall road entrance and the apartment room which we had taken had very nice view. I have booked the hotel after seeing some good reviews down this page and it has also won the Travellers choice award. As the hotel website says it is the perfect blend of nature and heritage.

It is a good hotel for family stay though beware with old people there is a very strap slope to reach the hotel not recommended for old and heart patients. Food is also very ordinary. Hotel is neat and clean and is on the mall road towards library end.

We stayed here for a night at this hotel on May 1st . Our experience was average . At first we were offered Room No 7 , Which was quite pathetic bedding's and Sitting area. We informed the same to the manager who then changed the room to Deluxe suite type with additional , basically which didn't mind . But in the night there were sounds ppl constantly speaking as there were no proper sound proof. Even that we considered as minor thing , But what made us our opinion was the attitude from the dining staffs who were not so accomodative  and had bad attitude if requested for any favour  But Overall it was average stay experience for us . If you really dont care about the above this is the best place for day or two

I stayed there 4 days in room 18.   LOCATION: the place is in the Mall (central area) but quiet and apart from the street.  There’s a nice and well kept garden and a comfortable veranda near the reception entrance. I couldn’t appreciate the view ‘cause it was rainy season and we were constantly in a thick cloud. The building is nice and has a charm of old dolls house. One weak point is the access to the hotel: you have to walk in a very steep concrete ramp/slope. It was  always wet because of the season, and once I almost fell down (despite I am young and I was wearing proper trekking  shoes)  FOOD:  The food was ok.  We had dinner  two times there, but it seemed that everything we ordered from the menu  wasn’t available, so we thought they just wanted us to order the most…

The hotel can be found on the Mall Road, you have to pay 100 rupees to access the road via barriers but you will need to take your car out again as shops, cable car etc are all close at hand. The rooms were fairly well furnished, nice and clean and nice breakfast was served in the dining room. The evening meals were a real treat and people come from far and wide to dine there in the evening as the food (vegetarian only) is so good. The views over the valley are outstanding. Would definately recommend this hotel if visiting Mussoorie.

The Hotel Padmini Nivas is well located on the Mall, but is still very quiet.  The hotel has old world charm, and great views looking out over the valley.  The restaurant is vegetarian only, but still very good.  Excellent value, I would recommend.

The hotel is located at good location if you are a nature lover, stayed with infant,  very good service and food quality; The hotel staff is cooperative, very good view of Doon Valley. The hotel was as I had read the reviews on TripAdvisor.. Upto the mark..

Great location, on the Mall Road, yet away from the hustle bustle of the local traffic. Parking faciity within the premises. Neat, well maintained rooms,considerate staff, hot n fresh homely food and astounding view, makes Padmini Niwas my first choice, every time I visit Mussourie. I ve been there enough times with  family over the past 16yrs, and have always returned with fond memories. They have maintained their standards, rather improved over these years.

Location of this hotel is awesome just on the mall road , rooms are very good but liitle issues of cleanliness food is very good and homely , if u wana stay this hotel just stay in block with reception

Perfect place to stay for a quite hill station holiday. On the mall road yet away from all noises with a beautiful view of the valley. Staff help at the hotel was great. we had a great time . will visit again Best wishes Balaji R

Was a bit apprehensive when our friend recommended this hotel but all worries n doubt were left at bay when we finally reached this hotel. A hotel with good location - at mall road yet not amongst the hustle bustle n sound. Beautiful view from the hotel, clean, excellent service, really home made like food (which was so needed as I was traveling with small kids). Kids swing n garden, it even had a Library (thats sucha bonus for a book lover like me).  The staff and the ambiance, super.  The overall experience was excellent.

The complete experience at the hotel was very warm, cozy, hospitable. The food served is good Indian homely preparation. The property has a nice heritage character. The also have parking. The best part are the outdoor sit-out spaces overlooking the Dehradun valley.. The place has a very nice glass table tennis room with views of surrounding mountains. Yes! some people may find their prices to be relatively high, but they are justified for the overall experience. The rooms are nice and people / staff are good.

this was our first visit here,but i must say,when we left we were as if we belonged here .. this is a really good place to stay,with family, good traditional food, beautiful interiors, helpful staff,big nd clean prpoerty... one of the best i hv so far visited.  It has a really nice view over the mountains,nice facilities and comfortable rooms. i must recommend this place to anyone who visits. full value for money.

A picturesque hotel, with a nice view over the surrounding mountains and the nearby valley. A sort of "Heritage" dining room, nicely decorated. A convenient location, not far from the bus stand. A comfortable room, warm and properly equipped. A good value hotel.

The Hotel Padmini Nivas is a good hotel with excellent location and property. The rooms are big. The view from the room is very good. The service is up to the mark. Its location is excellent, at the center of the Mall Road. The property of the hotel is very big and clean. The tariff is not worth the facilities. According to me, the hotel is overrated because if you compare it with any other hotel of the same category, you will find this hotel is overrated. Overall, it is an OK hotel.

Book Well in advance, Also the rooms are available at 900 to 1000 at this hotel during off season. Makemytrip is overcharging 1400. These online Travel Companies do lots of Negotiations with the Hotel. Go for Direct Reservation at the Hotel.

We (myself with my wife and little daughter) stayed in this hotel from 12 November (Morning) to 14 November, 2012 (Morning). We were overwhelmed with this hotel. The location, amenities, service, behaviour of the staffs, everything were beyond our expectation. Before booking this hotel, we saw many good reviews of this hotel from Trip Advisor. But, we were not sure whether these reviews were real ones. But, when we reached this hotel and stayed for two nights we were extremely satisfied. Positives: 1. Excellent Location                 2. Heritage ambient of this hotel                 3.Very pleasing behaviour of all hotel staffs starting from reception desk to room service boys.                 4. Good quality food                 5. All types of modern amenities present in the…

We had a family suite & the experience was simply great. Not our first time but it is always difficult to get accomadation if not reserved WELL in advance. Atmosphere is just splendid. Homely yet very professional. A complete Vegetarian place.

Simply i can say superb Nivas@Padmini,The Suite rooms are huge The place is also conveniently located and has good access to mall road and the taxi stand. The Palace has good surrounding views from the reception and the small garden.The staff is very courteous. Everything is perfect rooms,service,local..

The location was good.the rooms were good.the service of staffs were good.overall it was a good stay. didn't find any fault. and most importantly the man always with a smile in the reception made our stay more happy.

it was our first visit to Mussoorie and must say that we were lucky to stay in this enchanting place. the staff, the ambience and the excellent home food - all made our stay memorable. the hotel is located on the mall road (towards library end) but the rooms are pleasantly away from the hustle and bustle with expansive view of the doon valley. would love to visit padmini nivas again.

Padmini Nivas is a different kind of hotel then the normal hotel you have in Mussorie. It has an old age charm at the same time kept very clean and tidy. Good view of the valley and simple, tasty food. I would love to go pay visit to this Nivas once again.

When my husband first booked us into Padmini Nivas - I was a little skeptical, the name sounded ancient to me!! But believe me - within a matter of minutes, I fell in love with it. Why? 1) FANTASTIC location - the hotel overlooks a gorgeous valley. You can sit right there and have your meals/coffee. I spent hours sitting by the swing there. Sheer bliss and utterly beautiful 2) Very quaint and nice rooms - we stayed @ what was the erstwhile secretary's cottage!! Lovely rooms and very well maintained. And somehow, from a different era 3) The best good you'll find @ Musoorie! Aloo parathas to die for, spinach soup - the best I've eaten!  4) A very nice manager and very good service from ALL employees. Please go there - you will NOT regret it. I even met people who've been going to…

Excellent cottages with hill inspired wooden flooring.  Good food and service and the view of Dehradun in front of you is simply memorable, especially at night.  City of Blinding Lights  Excellent location - near the mall road and still very peaceful and private...

This was my second visit to Padmini Nivas, both times with family. The best part about this hotel is the location and the serenity you experience the moment you get down from the busy Mall road. A good place to relax among the hills.  I have stayed in the Apartment, as well as the Delux Suite. The apartment has a marvelous view of the valley, and a small balcony to stand at. The Delux Suite is on the inner side, and opens to the garden.  A 5 star experience is not to be expected, but all your needs are met. The staff is very homely, the food, hot and delicious, served to your room, a warm welcome in the cold evenings, the view from the hotel lobby is pristine.  Rooms are big, rather huge (since this was an erstwhile palace), and thus cold. There are no heaters, but lots of…

just one word. wOw.. its heaven on earth really!! very nice place,great food,brilliant staff.... the location is really beautiful...i have been travelling in many cities,but this hotel has the edge over any other i know .. i am amazed that how it dosent have the top spot..it really deserves it,specially on a website like tripadvisor,which is the only guide for innocent travellers ! whenever i come around,i will surely visit this place...

Overall a nice stay in PN.  Very good service.  But a lack of choices in menu card.  Lot of monkeys. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here.  Pros: Excellent views Beautiful property with a lot to explore and awesome flowers Good food Decent parking space  Cons: Rooms are not modern Heater was ineffective Lot of monkeys around the property Location is not one of the best. it was a good 10-15 mins of walk to the mall.

Our stay in December 2012 was a memorable experience.The hotel is a beautiful old building in a superb location with stunning views down into the Doon Valley. We had a well appointed, cosy cottage and especially enjoyed breakfast on the terrace and tasty food in the evening. The manager and staff were all very friendly and helpful. This was our second visit and will certainly not be our last.

We chose PN on the basis of good reviews on TripAdvisor  - &  they did not disappoint in any way.  The property itself  has a charming old-world feel as it was an old colonial estate (lodged halfway up a hillside)  & is conveniently located just below the mall -  but  what  makes it stand out is the unfussy attitude & genuine courtesy of every  staff member we came in contact with.  They are no pretentious luxury resort ,  but they do all the small things right  --  friendly service , clean-well designed - fully functional rooms, room heater & hot water supply , great mountain views, small -but-nice sit outs to enjoy the winter sunshine  &  even a little TT room / indoor games etc . The restaurant serves great food - but is vegetarian only. All in all -  thouroughly recommended…

Padmini Nivas is a palace converted to a hotel and it definitely retains some of the old world charm in the decor and furnishings. The place is also conveniently located and has good access to mall road and the taxi stand. Some of the rooms offer an excellent view of the valley and we were lucky to witness the winter line from the large windows of our room.  The staff is very courteous and will go the extra distance to make your stay comfortable. The restaurant is quite good and it is an experience to have breakfast in their garden overlooking the valley.

I have had the privilege of staying at this property several times & my admiration of this place increases with each visit. This is a heritage property located much before the busy mall road area at the Library end & is therefore quite and serene. The beautiful views from the rooms overlook the valley & are great especially in the mornings & evenings. The lady of the house will proudly tell you that the sunrise & sunset views from the property are amongst the best in the world. I COULDNT DISAGREE with her even if I wanted to & im glad at that :)  Much like most other heritage properties, this place has an aura & charm of its own. It only helps that its that nicely maintained & kept as well. The rooms are basic but for the non-fussy traveller, its what the doctor ordered. Its a…

I have a very nice experience in this hotel. Room, toilet every thing is very clean and well maintained. Staffs are very cordial and are always ready to help. The atmosphere of the hotel is splendid. A well-maintained garden is the attraction to the children. I will remember the every moment I spent here.

The choices for hotels are many in Mussoorie. We stayed at Padmini Nivas after having done extensive research on a host of hotels and the only one that consistently rose to the top was Padmini Nivas. We stayed there for a week in November and loved it. The location is excellent and close to everything but just off the path enough so as to be a quiet getaway from the noise and bustle of the town. The food is the best in Mussoorie, bar none! Even if you don't stay here, do yourself a favor and dine at the hotel. The rooms are quite large, clean and comfortable, though admittedly more basic than some western travelers may be used to. The service is friendly and attentive. The hotel manager, Vikram, made our stay memorable and we really felt at home. The hotel is also quite…

This was my best experience after the Waynad homestay. I stayed here from 21-24 Oct 2012 in their Super Deluxe Suite with my parents and sis. The stay was absolutely fabulous, enjoy King size rooms and order and get served like a King. Have stayed in 4 & 5 rated properties but the kind of service and food was something to relish upon. Its a 5 acre property just 100 metres below the Mall road at the Library end. The property is located on the ridge and has steep slope both from the Mall road and parking. So incase you have elderly person with you ask the hotel for a complimentary drop/pickup to/from Mall road. The service is very prompt and the best part is they are eager to serve you.  The rooms are stunning, everything is done tastefully maybe since its a palace, Hall size is…

We have stayed at the Padmini Nivas four times now over a period of 14 years and it has been a great experience each time. This is not the Hilton or Taj, but for a friendly welcome and quality personal service, I would recommend it.

Hotel Padmini Niwas is excellent place to stay in mussoorie with homely atmosphere and good service. The rooms are very spacious and clean.Hotel staff is very good with personal attention to each guest. Food is also very good & they have mastery in Gujrati Food.If u r in mussoorie Padmini Niwas is the best place to stay & enjoy the holiday.

I stayed at Padmini Niwas with my family for 3 days and 2 nights. We stayed at the "Apartment" room which I say is the best place to stay if u r traveling in a group or with kids. It had 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a lobby with dining table, a big refrigerator and a nice small balcony with a spectacular view of the Dehradun Valley. This hotel lived up to every bit of my expectations. Rooms were clean and tidy. Everything perfect. The Location gives it extra points with easy walking distances from the Mall and the Library end (Though the entrance of the hotel is a bit steep so had to put some effort in it :P) .  They have a really good variety of food. I didn't expected to see "Bajra" roti and "Dal Dhokri"in their menu. The food was good and they had kept the oil content low on our…

Padmini Nivas was in an ideal location to all the sights of Mussoorie. We stayed in the room that was the Piano Room and it was charming! The bathroom was a bit basic but everything was spotlessly clean, the service excellent and very friendly. The Managervwas charming and could not have been more helpful . Thoroughly recommend this little gem in the hills.

The best thing about the hotel is its location.. the Mall road. But thats the biggest disadvantage if you are travelling by car. Entry for cars on mall road closes at 5pm.  That means if you go for sight seeing to nearby places, you have to be back before 5pm .That was a big mood spoiler for us.. The food over here is vegetarian ONLY.. but quality is good.  Rooms need to have better maintenance. Room service is good. And mind you not all rooms have a good view. We booked  deluxe rooms but had to upgrade it to the apartment because there was hardly any view from the rooms we got. The hotel is valley facing no doubt..but you have to walk out of the room into a lobby to get a view. That means no valley view(sitting inside the room). Overall it was value for money!!

Padmini Niwas is an excellent example of service with warmth and affection. It is a perfect combination of splendid beauty overlooking the Doon Valley. We have tried staying at many other hotels in Mussoorie but the warmth extended by Padmini is incredible. The room size is spacious and food is simple but yet excellent on taste.

A palace converted into a hotel, this place is remarkable for the friendliness culture which runs through the organisation length and breadthwise. Everyone kept adequate distance, but were available at a phone call or a look. I second all that has been said positively about Padmini Nivas, and add that the courtesy extends to what they need not do, but do purely because of the friendliness ingrained in the staff and the owner. All the days we stayed there, we were almost enveloped in passing clouds so that we did not get a clear glimpse of the Doon valley, despite having a cottage overlooking it. Wonderful old palace seemingly held together with gloss paint. Excellent location just off the Mall. Amazing views over Dehra Dun. We were made very welcome, although the dining room in the restaurant was a bit formal. The room was spacious and everything worked, more or less. There were lots of attractive places for sitting outside, and a lovely garden. We stayed for two nights in between mountaineering trips.

We stayed in this Hotel for 3 days from 13th to 15th Oct'12. The service was prompt and food was good too. Mr.Vikas , the general manager, has been extremely helpful and also helped us in arranging a Xylo to Auli. What more, they were warm, helpful and hotel rooms were well maintained.   It's location on the mall road is extremely close lot of places that we intended to visit.

An excellent option. The rooms/suites are well furnished, the location is good and staff polite and helpful. The view from hotel is fantastic. The hotel is accessible from Mall Road (preferable) and also from before the Mall Road entry barrier. Kids loved the 'super dog' who is usually found lazing around but is very friendly and obliges the kids with some playing..

I booked this hotel solely based on the reviews on this site and the hotel turned out to be as good as the reviews it has got here. The hotel is situated on the Mall road but the moment we walked down the slope towards the hotel it felt like walking into a peaceful place away from the crowds. The room was immaculate and the sitting area was an icing on the cake with a cane swing and glass windows giving and amazing view of the valley below. The garden area gives even more beautiful view of the place, sitting here for a while took away the anxieties of daily routine from my mind. The property has been maintained pretty well with beautiful flowers n shrubs all around. The food was excellent and so was the staff. I would say it felt like home away from home. Would definitely like…

We stayed at the hotel for 3 days. It was a comfortable stay at the cottage which was just behind the Mall Road. The cottage is surrounded by all greens around. Everyone at the hotel was very cordial, particular Mr. Manish. We  would like to come again at Padmini Nivas.

First trip to Mussoorie and couldn't have chosen a better place to stay. Were there for two nights and three days. Staff was very cooperative. The rooms were clean and cozy. Was a beautiful experience. You come out of the hotel and you are on Mall Road. Had a wonderful time. Would definitely be going again.

I and my wife stayed in this hotel from 28th September to 1st October 2012. The hotel is situated on the mall road which makes it very convenient to visit the places near mall. Almost all the important facilities like GMVN office, taxi stand etc are in the walking distance. View from the hotel from most of the rooms is excellent. Staff attitude is also very good. Food is just awesome.  It also has a small nursery, and also collection of beautiful flowers.   Some of the cons are small rooms. We went as 2 families for 3 nights/4 days between 29 Sept and 2 Oct. The resort is beautiful and has been maintained very well. There are all the modern day facilities like running hot water, TV etc etc...but despite all this, it has retained its quintessential charm of the era when it was built (during the Britishers). The staff is diligent, warm, friendly and very helpful. They will go an extra mile to keep their guests in comfort. The management, under the able guidance of Mrs. Worah and Mr. Vikram Zutshi, are friendly and interact with the guests and also recommend places of interest. The gardens spread across the entire area are absolutely breathtaking and neatly kept. We have been staying here for the past 12 years whenever we visit Mussorrie and are never disappointed!!…

I stayed at this place for 2 days with family and key motivation for booking this place well in advance was the positive feedback i saw on this forum. But i felt extremely disappointed with my choice. This place does not stand anywhere near to reviews it has got. You must doom your expectation to hell to enjoy it.  Tidy noisy rooms lacking ventilation, bad service, use of children area as parking bay - there is no limit to the such illustrations. The only silver lining was the food - Good Indeed.  Will NEVER-EVER go back there.

Positive reviews at TripAdvisor made me choose Hotel Padmini Nivas for 1N stay with my spouse and kid. We checked in on Aug 13, 2012 and checked out the next day. As it was off season we got the booking at quite economical tariff.   We stayed in a deluxe room (No. 7) which was spacious enough for us. Our room was well kept and offered amazing view of Doon Valley. The sit out area near the main entrance is quite relaxing and have few rides and swings for kids to enjoy. Hotel has a Games room and Plant nursery which we couldn’t visit due to intermittent rains and our short stay.    Suruchi Restaurant of the hotel offers mouth watering food. As a tourist one misses homemade Tawa chappati but not when you are in this royal estate. Dinner was surprisingly good and for breakfast we…

We stayed here for 3 nyts 4 days. Overall it is good hotel. Old Property and well maintained. Services were excellent.. Staff was friendly and co-operating. Nice Well maintained Garden.  We enjoyed our Stay and recommend this hotel.

This was my second trip to mussoorie. The first time I had been there with family on the recommendation of a friend, but this time on my vaccation, it was practically this place that made me do that extra effort to come to Mussoorie. The garden is in full bloom... beautiful flowers and the decor of the rooms and the suite was exquisite and very tastefully done. Staff here is so warm and helpful.. they do recognize you and welcome you from their hearts. Money is well spent and efforts are worthwhile .... Love this place. Being from the State of the most lavish and exquisite holiday resorts Rajasthan.. Padmini Nivas is what I personally found to be just perfect for someone who enjoys and cherishes a quiet and serene time ... :)

Heritage property near library mall road  Has more space around rooms, beautiful garden.  Location excellent  In mussorie noise pollution is everywhere  Buses,taxi,car sound till evening  Food is pure veg  Staff very co operative

First view of the hotel might not overwhelm you but as you spend time here then you would realise the overall quality of the place and its surroundings. As told in all the reviews, this is a heritage property. The Managers of the place are quite courteous. The food is excellent. The stuffed paranthas were great. The surroundings are very well mailtained. The facilities include an indoor play area, which can be used if needed. The hotel is easily accessible from the Main Mall road.  Also the view from the hotel is great. We went in the monsoon season hence there was not much oppurtunity for catching any good views however whatever we saw was very promising. The Bestest Hotel in Mussoorie,India (Situated at Mall), We gave them ***** 5 Star Rating, Everything in the hotel including meals, hospitality, view, staff, just ausum, too gud. They treat you like a family, ......:)

what a lovely place to stay in mussoorie! it's a heritage hotel and yet very much affordable unless you are on a backpacker spree. the staff of the hotel is very courteous and helpful. everybody, from men behind the desk to men serving food, are very good natured and go out of way to fulfill your needs. the location of the hotel is fantastic. right on the starting point of the mall road from the library side end. if you are coming from dehradun, catch a bus that goes to the library side and from the bus stop, it is merely a 5-7 mins walk, though uphill through stairs. it is also easy to go to the camel road and lal tibba area from here. in the delux room where we stayed it appeared as if we were staying among the clouds. had a lovely view of the valley from the room. even the…

I visited Mussoorie from 17th july till 20th july.Fortunately it did not rain for the 4 days we stayed there,so we enjoyed fully.The best thing i loved about the place was people are so honest,they are reluctant to even accept tips.Unlike lots of tourist places,here service providers focus on service and not money.  Stayed at Padmini nivas,had read good reviews here so decided to go for it.I must say that the property is an absolute value for money.Lots of positives about this property:  1) Location: Right on the mall yet far away from noise and maddening crowd.A very calm and quite place just perfect for relaxing.The garden and the view from there is pleasing.  2) Staff: Awesome staff be it the GM's or the waiters,everybody is really really courteous and always have a smile on…

We were 4 ladies but we felt very safe there , the hotel is an old palace of rani padmini so it has all the lil royal feelings, they have a beautiful hall, beautiful garden and view, it is near  mall road and not yet crowded. The food was awesome. Heater was provided in the room. Staff was also very good. Would love to come back

Very nice hotel.. you can enjoy the closeness to nature and located on the mall road. Staff is excellent.There is a nice garden to stroll around in the hotel itself . food is good. When come from Dehradun ask the cab driver to drop to Padmini Niwas. It is near to the Bus stand and should not charge you anything extra. Better still is when you book taxi from outside Dehradun Taxi association , tell the counter clerk to drop to Padmini Niwas. will cost you 650 bucks..

Stayed 3 nights in the hotel from 26th to 29th June and had booked 2 rooms for a comfortable stay with Parents and kids. Totally loved the place. The hotel is suitably located around 200 to 300 metres from the Mall road entry from the Library side. The hotel is pretty cosy and the rooms are equally good and well maintained. The service is excellent with the wait staff ensuring that all your needs are met without the need to reiterate.   The best part of the stay was the awesome food cooked in their kitchen. This has to be one of the top-reasons to stay at the hotel. Wondefully light home cooked like chapattis along with good servings of vegetables is a treat. The food served in the Hotel is vegetarian although they are able to service requests for any sort of egg preparation. …

The name of the place is very deceptive. Inside, it is a cosy home like atmosphere. Situated on a cliff, providing great views of the valley. It is close to the entry end of the Mall Road. The staff are very service oriented. I'd been there 2 yrs ago. The interiors weren't 5 star but was clean and comfortable. Quite reasonable priced. Best part is their food which is fresh, tasty, home-like and affordable.

I travelled for the first time to a place like massourie with my family. We did a deep research on most of the hotels and we found padmini niwas exactly like we were hoping. Location is great, it feels so fresh when sitting on bench and looking at clouds and skies on the morning and in night also view is awesome. The only thing which i can be included as a negative is tv and cable tv quality but its was of least importance as we spent all day roaming around. Rooms were good, room service was excellent and food was exceptional. The food tested just like home. We tried 2-3 other restaurants also but not a single restro could beat the taste of padmini niwas. Overall my experience was awesome and in near future also, i would like to stay in Hotal Padmini Niwas

We enjoyed our stay. The service was good and the room was comfortable. As the wether was cooler than we were accustomed to, we did find the dining room a bit cold and draughty, but the service was excellent and the quality of the food was good. There were spectacular views from all the terraces, and we could see the clouds come and go! the gardens were beautifully kept and full of lilies when we were there. Access to the Mall is easy, and cycle rickshaws are the best way to get around - but we also took a horse ride along the Camel Back Road.

True to itself, a trip advisor review never fails me and so has been our stay at Padmini Nivas. Let me get to the point immediately with the Pros: 1) We were upgraded to a suite while I had booked for a deluxe room and trust me with 2 kids, it turned to be such a blessing.  2) The much talked about food, it is as homely as it can get, I had a 2 meal package and it was just wonderful telling them what we would eat as breakfast and dinners, have it served fresh as per your requirements of taste and ofcourse it tasted smashing. My kids loved the food and we never missed a meal. Try their wonderful chai, Chole Bhature, Paranthas, Bread Pakoras, The good ol dal, and the hot chapatis. 3) Service, not sure if I had access to their best guy, but this person was always smiling and could…

I (with family) stayed for 2 nights. Overall this a nice place to stay.  Good: 1. Location : On Mall road. You can walk on mall road anytime, shop, enjoy the food etc at a walking distance 2. Staff : The staff was cordial and very prompt on services.  3. Nice small garden with valley view.  Bad: 1. Rooms appear to be overpriced in comparison to quality 2. I had booked a suite which is claimed to have valley view. It is actually blocked by the roof of another block on lower step. 3. Parking, that is the case with most of the resorts in Mussoorie.  Overall with nice staff the stay was good. In next visit I may stay at the same place.

My stay here was very pleasant and am really thankful that they have kept and maintained such a wonderful place to stay in. Being a tourist I'm always concerned about being conned etc but my stay in Padmini Niwas got me a sigh of relief. The rooms are beautiful and clean. Services too are perfect and the view from the hotel is spectacular. I have recommended my friends and relatives to stay at Padmini Niwas and myself too am staying here in the future.  Best wishes, Partha Barman & Family, New Delhi & Assam

went to mussorrie last year in Nov,11 for our anniversary and stayed in this hotel for days.location is good , easily approachable  to main market,near bus stand.Had good service , have locker room where you can keep your luggage after checking out free of cost.  overall it was a good experience

Lovely view of the Doon Valley...blooming roses, hydransias and fushias.. lush green garden was what that greeted us at Padmini Nivas. It appeared to us as an oasis amidst a sea of hotels in Mussoorie. It was a mind blowing experience as always to spend some time in the lap of nature. Excellent service quality and homely food was the cherry on the cake. Quality of rooms was good and ammenities provided were satissfactory. Very tastefully and artistically decorated rooms and interiors. My suggestion to fellow travellers is to take a room that offers a view of the Doon Valley.

after thorough research of budget hotels and after due diligence and particularly trip advisor reviews,which i believe are true and accurate,we booked for a double bedroom in the hotel. Upon arrival,we were warmly received by the reception staff,after been  taken to several available rooms,i was kind of not satisfied,finally ,they offered me a great room opposite to the resturant.The room was pretty big,hat a half oval sitting area along the windows,abig bathroom.we were deligthed with the room. The most important aspect that iwas wanting was the hotel is of heritage genre,the location which is slab bang on The Mall Road,Yet very quiet and serene,good landscaping. I particularly liked their veranda,which is quite big and great to sit out and relax. The staff are very friendly…

Great people....... Great service... Great rooms... Loved the time that i spend here with my family...... Great location just near the mall road.... Got great market excess..... I just loved my time here.... The BEST IN MUSSOORIE....!!!!

I must say this is one of the few hotels who has kept it's sanctity intact among money minded hotels flourished at all hill stations.  The most striking feature is it's heritage genre, which keeps you coming again and again.  The premises are very well landscaped with different varieties of flowers in full bloom.  The  hotel location is ideal ... among the lap of nature as well as close to mall road , camel back road and taxi stand.  Rooms are very clean and comfortable offering excellent valley views..  Food is only vegetarian but amaa,,,zzz,,ing ,,,A special mention is must about their "aloo parathas, chole-Bhature and stuffed bread pakodas"  My ratings on a scale of 5 are as below  Rooms- 4/5 Food - 4.5 / 5 Cleanliness- 4.5 / 5 Value for money- 4 / 5

With flowering gardens, delicious dishes and attentive service, Padmini Nivas offered a secluded oasis from the crowded bustle of Mussorie. Situated literately just below the main street, the hotel provided quick and central access to the shops, restaurants and treks of Mussorie but with enough distance to block out most of the street noise. Descending into Padmini Nivas from the mall feels like arriving home: the antique charm of the heritage hotel mixed with its tasteful modernization makes for a comfortable and cozy place to nestle up in one of their many benches amidst a colorful garden and read a book or sip a chai. We spent many early mornings and late afternoons swinging on the swing or drinking tea at the picnic table that overlooks the Doon valley.   Our personal waiter…

Despite being on Mall road, one does not feel cut-off from the nature since the entire hotel, a heritage property, its small garden, most of the rooms face the natural surroundings overlooking the valley. As soon as one enters the hotel from the rood, one instantly feels fresh and away from the hustle and bustle. Food is outstanding and reasonably priced. Overall, one gets a very homely feeling staying here. Accommodation is not luxurious or fancy but comfortable. Staff is warm too. Very good value for money. There should be a bit more cleanliness around kitchen area backside on the path leading to the rooms. And if breakfast should preferably part of the room tariff. Strongly recommended for stay and/or dining too. Great value.

Located conveniently on the Mall road,its a good place to stay though a bit inconvenient because of rubbish traffic restrictions of the local administration.The rooms are spacious with clean linen.Service was good and vegetarian food was OK.Dinner to be ordered well before 10pm.

From the beautiful rose gardens and singing birds to the delicious food and the friendliest Bhutiya dog, Padmini Nivas is a place you dont want to miss. Right on the Mall road yet cut away from all the hustle and bustle, this hotel will give you the quiet coziness of being in the hills yet leaving you with the accessibility to everything you want to do in Mussoorie. The staff is friendly and prompt, the food is simple yet tasty and the rooms are luxurious. Great place to bring your family or even visit with friends. I loved my time here.

Stayed at Hotel Padmini Nivas for a night... and left wishing that the stay was longer! Even during our short stay, got a glimpse of the hospitality of the staff, which was talked about in earlier reviews. We could not pay the advance in time, but Mr.Manish was courteous enough to reserve a room for us on a short notice. Check-in was smooth, & the room was more than comfortable. After a long day of travel (Mumbai-Delhi-Dehradoon-Mussoorie), the place was just perfect to unwind. The restaurant was very good, safe choice for dinner as well as breakfast. Infact we went out for a walk in the over-crowded mall, & happily came back to eat the the hotel itself. Definitely recommended!

padmini nivas an ideal dream place to stay with a great expeience of a life time ..... truely an heritage hotel.... amazing landscaping ... wat an amazing stay with a perfect ambience and surroundings ..... it has to be named mini valley of flowers....in every corner u find flower,,, and my room no7... great view of dehradun valley  stunned me .... neat and clean with hospitable staff..... i will like to stay in only padmini nivas when ever i visit mussoorie ..... i used to wake up early sip my cuppa tea with the amazing view of dehradun valley ...... the staff took so much care of me and my mom .... just like family .... i m so lost in the beauty of that hotel ....if in life u want to stay in a true heritage property its here in padmini nivas mussoorie.......

Padmini Nivas is loacted just meters way from the library in Mussoorie. The location is peaceful and it reminds us of the heritage hotels with ambience just perfect for a long holiday. The staff is very caring and the manager personally attends to all the guests. It has a fine resturant that serves delicious Gujarati thali.. It is one of the few hotels left that provide you the option of watching TV in a central palacious hall which reminds you of good old times where families spend quality time together. We had booked the suite room which is an experience by itself. Had a wonderful stay and memories of this hotel will stay for a long long time.

Padmini Niwas is a great place for family travelers..have been staying here for the past 25 years every year and each year it keeps getting better and better. Mrs. Wohrah the owner and Mr. Vikram the General Manager make you feel totally at home. The place being on Mall Road is totally peaceful has a great view of Doon Valley. The food is excellent for vegetarians especially Jains and Gujratis as they have a special menu for them. Don't feel like leaving the hotel once you are in here

Stay at Padmini Niwas is an out of the world experience. Rooms, food, service  and hospitality is all a five star experience. Hi All,  Hotel Padmini Nivas is the best place where you can make yourself so much comfortable as you will feel that you are in heaven and service and everything is very much fantastic as i dont have words to express my feelings. A perfect holdiay destination. We had a great time, rooms are clean and cosy with perfect ambience. The hotel team is very helpful, warm and extremely friendly. The food is simply awesome, with sitting facility overlooking the Doon Valley. In short a Must Visit place in Mussorie.

We stayed in this hotel in Jan, 2012. It was very cold but our room was very cosy and comfortable. The hotel staff was extremely warm and courteous. They treated us very well. The rooms were very good and clean. Daily housekeeping services were provided. The Food was very good and homely. The Hotel had a garden where one could sit comfortably and have lunch. We satyed at Padmini Nivas end of Jan this year, ie 2012, It was still cold, but luckily we had great sunny days. The hotel was extremely comfortable.
