This is 1 of good hotelsto check inn, great hospitality by entire staff, good ambiance & hygenic conditions& over & above all really tasty food.

We stayed at Padmini Nivas's spacious and very tastefully (antiquely) furnished suite with friends and kids. I have holidayed  in Mussoorie every few years for the last decade and a half. Padmini Nivas is always my first choice. The staff treat their guests so warmly that you feel like part of the family. we stayed in this hotel sometime ago..the hotel is really very goood! the services,staff,atmosphere, everything is just perfect,, i was reading some reviews of other travellers and found one really funny one..there was this person felix who wrote about monkey terror..i think he must be watching a movie like 'godzilla' or something..! if you are in a hill station then naturally there will be monkeys around..its nothing new........ still it is a marvellous place and we would lve to visit it again and again!

We travelled with family,and fortunately we found padmini niwas after looking at many other heritage properties..as soon as we entered,the welcome that we received made us decide to stay..courtesy Mr.Vikram..after having a look at all the options,we decided to stay in deluxe rooms,which had beautiful view of the valley....the rooms were elegentely done up,and the service was par excellence..the best part of the stay was homely atmosphere and the personal touch..we won't think twice to book padmini niwas again!..its a perfect 'home away from home'..

I was there at Padmini Nivas on 24th and 25th December, 2011 with my parents and brother. We had a great time. It is such a pleasant place, with quant clean rooms. While located on a busy road, the hotel is extremely peaceful and feels away from the madding crowd. As a hotel, Padmini  Nivas offers a comfortable and warm stay in Mussoorie. A favourite amongst regulars, Padmini Nivas has been the place I've stayed in for the past 22 years on my every visit to Mussoorie. Hotel Padmini Nivas is situated at the Library end of the Mall Road. I had the opportunity of staying at Padmini Nivas......with my family, for a short vacation. This is a heritage property, well-maintained, with very helpful & sobre staff. I would recommend stay in this hotel, but, the food is a concern area.....limited menu leaves you with little choice.

wonderful experience room rate are bit high peaceful environment,good staff no extra unnessary charges . but these people should help in some extra packages of sightseeing.they showed us every room and changed if we feel uncomfortable in any of the room.
Experience the old world charm and hospitality of this delightful hotel . Speak to Vikram and he will take care of everything ... suggest the cooking class as well .

While in Mussoorie on 9th and 10th of September 2011, I had the pleasure to stay in this Hotel with my family. Found this hotel through Lonely Planet. We have been staying here every summer for the last 10 years, and it has become an annual ritual. Regardless of where else we might go in the summer, we spend at least one week here. At the same time, kids can be left in a fairly safe environment on the property itself, or sent off to the Mall road…

Excellent hotel and more than value for money. Everything about the hotel was amazing from the moment we arrived at the hotel till we left. Staff at reception and service staff at hotel took very good care of us. It is a purely vegeterian hotel and food was fantastic - homely food with appropriate oil levels to keep you healthy. View of Dehradun from the hotel is very good. I got up in the morning at 5 to capture some of the amazing shots. It was the best hotel stay for our complete hotel trip. Very relaxing.  Best…
The stay was really awesome and best I ever had. The food is great so as the service and rooms. Will stay again

The stay was very comfortable as the staff took very good care.It felt as if we were amongst family.Food was good and surroundings were beautiful with lovely fuchsias and roses all over the garden. We were surprised to read a customer's comment calling it a Dariyaganj kind of experience,all that can be said in that context is that people have no taste for quality services and amenities,their opinions are sadly based on what preconceived notions they have.It is criminal to voice such opinions that can be seriously misleading.

Fantastic stay.  True hospitality and real consideration.  We found the staff where very sensitive to our special needs related to my wife being disabled and using a wheel chair.  Last time we stayed we where in a hotel on top of the hill above Hotel Padmini Nivas costing twice as much. In fact in my experience its one of the best experiences we have had. …

Great place to stay , on Mall road with good view & super food quality taste & service too. It is a heritage property so not at all like new commercial properties that one should be expecting but a nice old styled beautiful property with rose garden. Also view from the property is very beautiful , you can see the valley from the hotel verandah

The management took exceptional care. The GM is a pleasing person and so was the Owner. We were given inputs by GM to when we wnt sight seeing. The hospitality of the entire Padmini team is worth remembering. Thanks again will visit soon

We stayed at the hotel for 1 night on 7th May 2011. From the moment we arrived, we were treated as royalty! What can I say? Location: 2 mins walk distance from Mall road. Greeted warmly, beautiful check in area, good staff with fabulous service, hotel has an intimate feel, loved the seating area and restaurant. Our room was neat and clean amazing bed was with super comfort, hot water was available 24 hrs. We certainly did not have any complaints. Hi, we stayed at the hotel this may, first the rates are ballooned for the very basic amenities they provide, plus they cancelled one of our bookings without telling us. We stayed in Padmini Nivas during April 2011 with family. The hotel has good location near the Mall road. The staff was very co-operative. Our check in and check out was smooth and room had all amenities. The icing on the cake was fantastic food. We enjoyed our stayed !!!  Atul B.Shah

Views from this hotel were amazing, its near the mall road.culture and sightseeing is best part of padmani niwas. The Staff were all excellent and happy to help with anything.!!  The hotel and Rooms were all very clean and traditionaly maintained. All in all we really enjoyed staying at this hotel!!!!!

Padmini Niwas is my favorite place to stay in Mussoorie, and the panoramic views of the Doon Valley below are alone worth more than the reasonable tariff.  The original colonial-era architecture and surrounding gardens offer echoes of past grand times, and the charming attentiveness and manners of the staff also seem to come from a bygone time.  While certain aspects of the rooms (some carpets, mattresses) could be updated, the linens are clean, and the hot water supply reliable. Padmini's pure vegetarian food is wonderful, and should not be missed. If you are not sure what to order, try the thali, which offers a wide range of delectably prepared North Indian food. The central location of Padmini Nivas inspires lovely walks in all directions, so you can really get at feeling for…

The staff is very friendly and helpful. The place was the property  of some former king. The dining room has high roofs and there is an old fireplace, which is a blend of Indian and British styles.  The suites are in the main building, the so called deluxe rooms are in another block ( upper floor is deluxe, lower is standard ). Frankly the deluxe rooms are called deluxe but they are pretty standard. But the rooms have a view of the Dehradun valley, so  that may be the reason. The person  at the desk was helpful in giving tips on places to see, but at the same time he is reserved and quite busy with bookings.  Its a short walk up to the mall road, and the church.

I stayed in Padmini Nivas with my spouse for 3 days and 2 nights. We had a really good stay here. The view was breathtaking and the ambience was good. The main lobby and the dining area was really superb with a lot of vintage items. The food was very good and the staff was friendly. It is very near to tibetan market and mall area where practically everything was available.One negative was that the room heating wasnt sufficient and the room that i stayed had a cramped bathroom. If you are staying here especially during winters check the heater provided in the room otherwise you are in for chilly nights.

Beautiful location, wonderful infrastructure, specious room, extremely comfortable bed, great view, very curious staff, neat and hygienic atmosphere, right at mall  We had a great time even kid had great time due to swings and open area

I had been to this hotel in Jan 2011 and must say it a wonderful place to be in.  Cozy hotel with nice rooms and courteous staff. Perfect value for money with 1200 per night in off-season.

A home away from home, excellent vegetarian food, comfortable and cozy rooms, efficient service and a friendly manager. A must stay while in Mussoorie...We had very tasty food specially Maharastrian......I like this hotel

I stayed with my wife for one night. I think it was very comfortable stay. I liked the view from the hotel. The rooms were clean and cosy. The staff was courteous. The tea was awesome! One of the best part was the retro feel to the entire place. It has restored the past with modern comfort. It is quiet yet close to mall road. I would recommend this for couples and bit older than younger people.

We spent 1 nights and had a great time. This hotel has everything one can dream of at a place like Mussoorie. this hotel is great value for money , the food is ok , but this is not a problem as the main mall is walking distance from this place. for old people this can be  trouble as you have walk a steep hill to reach the mall . The room service are also ok and the staff is frendly

We were a group of 17 people and stayed at hotel padmini niwas for 3 days. We had booked 6 rooms. Rooms were very nice and food was really good, variety was not too much though. This Hotel is really fun to stay at. The Padmini Nivas is one of the oldest buildings in Mussoori, it was origionally named the Rushbrook Estate and was owned by the Maharaja of Rajpipla. The Hotel is located on a ridge with magnificant views of the Himalaya to its north and the Doon valley to its south.. Its charms include grand rooms containing carved fireplaces, strange hunting trophies and other timely reminders of the Raj . It has wonderful landscaped gardens . The Hotel offers a wonderful veg resaurant which specialises(amongst other things) in Gujarti cuisine .There are some recreaional facilities on offer including a pool table and table tennis. The hotel is a stones throw from the Mall and the ropeway and is definitly worth a stay should you find your self in Mussoori.

Just loved every bit of our stay at Green and Breeze Resort. Best hotel to stay with your family or friends if you are looking for a budget vacation in Mussoorie.   Great Location and a well managed property  and very helpful staff Hygienic and clean rooms Frontdesk goes a step beyond to make your stay comfortable Last the food - Just Amazing  Just one shortcoming that is water heating problem which is common on all hill station locations.   Please book in advance (executive rooms) to enjoy the best experience as the property is in high demand.

Excellent staff with good services . We took 4 rooms every room was facing the beautiful doon view and also the room size is pretty decent as compaired to other properties in mussoorie. Food is mouthwatering . We will definitely come again.

Everything is very good in this property , kudos to Mr.Neeraj and his entire team who were available at every point of time.  We surely recommend this property incase you want to stay away from the traffic and hustle bustle during the vivid period .

I visited Green and Breeze resorts with my family for a weekend getaway. Food at the resort was not the best and we had to rely on a restaurant at Mall Road that is a 15 min drive from the resort.  Overall, a good experience.

I stayed here with my group . Everything was upto the mark starting from the check-in to checkout . The food was excellent . The service guys shubham , Ajay , jagveer ( sorry don't remember all the names ) were always ready to serve you with smile . Special thanks to Mr. Neeraj and the entire team of green n breeze resort who made our stay memorable and magnificent.

Great dun view balcony rooms.great experience.best hospitality.specious room curtious staff.best hotel in mussoorie.i love food also tasty.indian and Chiniess both. Rooms are neat and clean like bedsheets and blankets. Copretive staff. Thanks for make our trip memorable.

I stayed with my family in this beautiful resort after the lockdown period.  It was a fabulous stay with the mesmerizing view from all the rooms.  The location is quite good and also the room size. Everything is excellent . Thankyou guys for making our trip memorable .

One of the excellent property to stay,Away from the hustle bustle of the city. Fabulous view and good room size.   The entire staff is very helpful, we will definitely visit again.   Thank you team rosa mussoorie you made our holiday Memoreable.

A nice quaint hotel which has staff that are not concerned. We checked in amidst a group and waited at front office for 30 minutes in the cold only to be followed for payment as their network was a challenge. Once the payment was made they didnt care. We were seated amongst a big group of Veena World and left to fend for our own food. Also never book the Duplex room coz only 1 heater allowed (as per policy). The electricity konked of at 1:30 and we were informed that the technician could only come at 6am. So they couldnt care if we froze in the meanwhile. Overall for all the inconvenience they said they could take care of a meal for us. If you have to stay there make sure it is summer.

Amazing Everything. Great food, Location, Views. Helping Staff, Easy to find. Cozy and Comforting Ambience. Quality of food, and rooms is quite great. No actually downside of booking the hotel. Go Ahead!!

There are benefits of staying in a branded hotel like Rosa Green n Breeze. I experienced utmost proffessional staff who strive to build a repute with the guests. Cozy and well-appointed rooms. Try the special menu at Bite restaurant which serves delicious and piping hot food throughout the day. The hotel is strategically located away from mall road to ensure peace and calmness for the guests nevertheless mall road is just a 10 minute drive from there.

Recently stayed at this hotel with friends. It is nicely located with peaceful surrounding. Away from all those traffic noises. Staff is nice and food was also good. Overall we enjoyed our stay and at this price range it is certainly good deal.
Wonderful location amazing room view if you are looking property in budget with good room view then highly recommended food was good staff is friendly familiar place thank you for the pleasure stay 🙂

Couldn't have asked for a better place to chill and be in peace than Rose Green n Breeze, Mussoorie. The view from my room was so satisfying, my entire stay was absolutely full of pleasure and new experiences!

I found my lost soul there, feeling alive.  view was great, love to breath there, fresh air.  I love the destination, its home to my wanderer soul.  escape from life hustle.  love love and lot of love  wanderer.

We were fortunate enough to land there on a rainy day. The mountains kept hiding behind the clouds playing hide and seek with us. The rooms were clean, comfortable and spacious. Being a reader, it was a perfect place to whip out a book and sink in to the peaceful and natural surroundings. The coffee was a cherry on top.

The hotel has the perfect balcony view to stay up late. The lights literally twinkle. It's breathtaking. The deck they have is great- we had breakfast there and what a view it was. The food there is good too- good dal loved it. The services of the staff are great. They really take care of you. Would definitely visit again.

Amazing room and outstanding view of mountains from room and balcony. I went for an offsite there and I enjoy this location very much. Room was absolutely fantastic. A peaceful location to accelerate our offsite summit.

Worth every penny paid! Being very specific about the cleanliness, I was pretty satisfied with the room. It was clean and spacious and had an amazing view.  The staff was helpful throughout and made sure that we have a relaxing vacation. Would definitely visit again.

Pros: 1. Room is good. 2. Location is good.  3. View is good.  Cons: 1. Bathroom stinking. 2. Recreation room not managed. In fact, all the room-service clothes were placed there . You would not want to stay there for more than 1 min. TT board is there but racket is unplayable. Carrom board is there but someone dined over it and striker would no go anywhere.  3. Price for food is exorbitantly high.

Visited this hotel with my family.  Hotel has construction work going on, which was not informed to us.  Much far from main mussorie and no nearby market or amneties.  Will never visit it again.  At least they must keep adequate breakfast.  Bad!

Please all don't get confused by its name as resort or 3/4 star property. It is no more than a lodge or hostel with full of unprofessional staff. Rooms have no fridge No AC with poorly fitted bathroom accessories. Telephone not working properly and if u complain they will come to change your room as I was asked to change twice during my 2 day stay...  No spa... No Bar... No breakfast served properly in restaurant... Quite far from market... Menu with higher rates as per the quality of hotel...  At last don't take a chance to visit the place as their can be many properties u can opt for. VERY UNPROFESSIONAL.

I went there with my parents, wife & kid. Renovation work was under process but the staff were more than willing to make our stay comfortable. We were initially offered 2 interconnected rooms with a beautiful view of the valley. However on our request we were accomodated in a set of new rooms away from the noise of renovation. Time & again the staff were checking on us if we have any problem during our stay. They guided us properly on our sightseeing also so as to ensure that we are not fleeced. Food thought a little expensive but of good quality and preparation. Better cleanliness in the rooms will add more colour to this vibrant hotel. 24 hrs warm water is  available. View from the room is splendid. Little away from the hustle & bustle of town hence affords the peace & quality…

I happen to attend a destination wedding in Mussorie for 2 days and decided to spend my final day at Tulip Inn Green n Breeze. I must admit the hotel is very strategically located as it is away from hustle bustle and gives a very serene view of hills. The staff is very generous and welcoming and they always greet you with a fantastic smile on their face. The main highlight though has to be the "FOOD" and I have to confess, even after visited so many hill stations and staying put in different hotels, the food quality is worth every penny spent... Fresh food and quality hospitality makes this hotel one of the best and more affordable choices.

The hotel is decently priced and the food is very good. They cook fresh and the taste of the dals taste like home cooked food. The staff is courteous and always available for help.   The view outside the hotel room is beautiful and they charge decent, the hotel is inexpensive. I would recommend this hotel to those people who want to have comfortable stay, good food,like and are not willing to spend much on hotel/accommodation.   I would like to add that the cooking of food takes time (we went during off season) but the taste is worth the time taken. If I were to hangout in mussoorie again, just for food itself I would stay here. The price of food is also decent and affordable.

Last week we decided to celebrate our anniversary in Mussoorie. We had a lot of options of hotels but we wanted to avoid the crowd and hence went for this hotel. The location  did not disappoint us even though it was a little far from the main city. But since we were driving down we did not mind the distance. The hotel room had a lovely balcony view which was facing the Dehradun valley on one side and the Mussoorie hills on the other. At night specially the view is breathtaking. The food and the housekeeping service was also pretty comfort table. The room  was equally comfort table and a special mention to the staff members for decorating the room on special request for our anniversary. For all those who plan to drive down a good parking space is another plus point. I would…

We booked 3 rooms for 3N/4D. Out of which only 1 room was good while other 2 rooms had bedding issue. Beds were constantly making sound while you move your position. In 1 room leakage issue was there in bathroom. Food was good. Hotel is 3.5 km away from Mall road. Nothing is there nearby apart from jaypee hotel.... Private vehicle is must for this hotel. If you are not having your vehicle don't book room here. I lost one Milton thermos from hotel. This is what I can share about my experience. If this review is helpful than do like the post.

Good experience in Mussorie during my one of many trips there. Staff is nice and good services. Only thing I’ll mention is their payment gateway is clumsy so if u are paying using card be prepared to wait for confirmations while staff thinks u haven’t paid! Though paying bank clearly says money is deposited to their account just that it takes few hrs for hotel to see the payment slight inconvenience  Overall an excellent property

Celebrating my sons 18th birthday! was a wonderful experience management was so nice and helpful food was so delicious well presented and the service was out of world ! Wonderful destination to celebrate parties! Thanks Tulip inn Green Breeze for a wonderful arrangement! Will be back surely again!

We were a group who took three rooms for our stay in Mussoorie and Landour at Tulip Inn Green n Breeze. The views from the hotel courtyard are just beautiful and breathtaking. Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the main city, read mall road, the property offers a serene surrounding to relax and unwind.  Both Landour and Mussoorie mall roads are within 15-20 minutes drive. An added bonus to the views are the polite and helpful staff at the hotel. No matter what the ask, you can count on the staff to deliver and ensure that your stay is pleasant. An important point to note is that we were not a family but a bunch of young couples and still did not feel any awkwardness or unwelcome behavior. They even arrange a private bon fire on request and you can go revelling deep into…

1st things that will strike about this property is its breath taking view. By far the best view of Mussorie. This a NO ELEVATOR resort so you will need to take stairs each time you want to go out or come into the hotel. We were in room 115. Room was very nice and big. Pretty well equipped too. Just the down side was the TV. Remote kept braking over and over again. They claim for 24 hrs running hot water but it’s hardly ever a case in any of the hotels on hill stations. This is no exception. The view of valley and Mussoorie from the room were just breathtaking especially the Sun set and Night views. The view will awe you. This room had defective basin which initially had no flow and later a leakage. They did offer another room but this room according to me had the best view so…

The hotel has a best location inBarlowganj  leave aside JP Hotel .  Barlow Ganj is very good and quiet place to stay in Mussoorie .  The hotel is good  ,have good spacious rooms   ,But service is just ok ,cleanliness of the premises is the concern ,they have staff but they are not guided to take care of cleanliness .  I will give 5/5 to the food they serve and the  best is it is available round the clock .  Rest if they improve upon hospitality they will certainly get full on full.  All the best

Location is nice,I could see the full view mountains.Staff is amazing and very very cooperative.Specially the reception staff rocks.Poonam from reception helped us to decide in Sight Seeing packages.Also when I forgot one of my small luggage bag,it was couriered to me free of cost back to Noida by Mukesh Pal who handles the reception desk.I really enjoyed my stay here.

Well Tulip In seems to be a new chain of hotels, though their logo seem to be similar to the logo of earstwhile Tulip Hotels and Golden Tulip Chains.  There is one property in Mussoorie, under the Tulip Inn logo, so it can be confusing incase you don't ask for Green and Breeze Resort in Barlowganj.  We the property is situated next to Jaypee Manor away from the madening Mussoorie crowd and traffic. A perfect location.  The property seems to renovated recently. Most of the rooms have balcony facing the valley and the Mussoorie hills. Rooms are spacious and well equipped and also with safe and a 32"LCD.   The food is fine but little overpriced compared to small portions they serve for most of the dishes.  The service was also fine if not prompt.  The property has a small play area…

It was an amazing experience staying in this property with great hospitality offered by Mr Rohit and Ms Poonam . Great view , cooperative staff food was also good , rooms were excellent . enjoyed my stay .

It's an amazing place..The staff is very helpful and courteous..Food is really good...View from the resort is beautiful..Rooms are comfortable and you get all the facilities in the room..It's a must visit place

Good location, friendly staff great view. Overall had a very pleasant stay. View from resort is nice and is away from City hussle. Food was very good with  a vierty of options . Must visit for families.

Right from the reception to the hospitality to the decor everything was on point. It was the first time I went to mussoorie with my friends for my birthday and it was a memorable experience thanks largely to tulip in. Kudos to the team. Wonderfully managed. Unbelievable views and mornings which make the lungs very peaceful, unlike Delhi. All the best tulip in. I hope your chain becomes the next ITC or Even better :)

Used the venue for a family wedding. Fantastic views from the property. Staff were great and friendly. On the whole an excellent experience, great good with a venue situated in a calm and peaceful location.

I was there for my best friend's wedding and the location couldn't have been better. Prime location, stunning views and super accommodating staff members. The food was delectable and service was immaculate. I'd definitely visit again.

Excellent staff and service...front office was supportive and helpful...food is OWSUM with quick service and service staff was polite and pleasing..Overall hospitality was excellent and recommended to visit

My daughter mayras first birthday celebration was awesome in tulip in Green n breeze  resorts love to join this resort again keep it up green breeze staff was v good and coprative view is class love this place

It was my first trip with my baby at that time he was just 9 months old. Hotel staff was very nice. They all were very caring and supportive. Specially mention Miss Nitigya,she was very polite, harm and caring....

I visited the hotel in 2017 and in 2018... The staff of hotel was very supportive... When I reached there welcome drink was server... The hotel was fully packed even then the service was good and food buffet was too good... Very nice place to stay with family... Rooms were neat and clean.. No complaints... Thank you green and breeze for my trip so good

review title - good hotel at massourie location - massourie ( outskerts ) with nice viewof dehradun  ideal for - family / group stay  Ambiance - average  food - 7 out of 10 - several choices in BF/ Lunch Dinner buffet   service - good staff is courtius / helpful / informative  other facilities - average rooms / play room with TT / carrom  near byplaces - massourie  Pros - cost effective hotel as compared to massouris top touriet spots. you have to travel uphill for sightseeing to Kempty waterfall / Gunhill point  cons  - no parking place / you have to walk 200 meters if you are going by bus ( only cars can reach till reception)

An excellent visit....we were here for 2 nights excellent service friendly staff  mainly the front desk (nitigya). We will visit again soon.....n recommend to others as well.. Thank you all for making our stay wonderful...

Hi, I visited mussoorie to meet my friends , i choose the hotel with a exoctic view and best at lifestyle. Very nice hotel which we experienced  very nice Service from all which is too good,awesome view from room no 312 , we enjoy living their specialthanks to manager Mr rakesh sharma & also  miss poonam front office,

Remarkable Palace like property and every bit of your Money's worth with a fantastic experience, Food, Cuisine were Excellent & Truly luxurious, good hospitality, memorable trip with tulip inn green n breeze hotel. Special thanks to lady at front office NEETIGYA ARYA

Stayed in Tulip Inn Green n Breeze in April 2018. We had travelled with Kesari Tours (for those of you unfamiliar with that name, Kesari is a v popular group tour operator from Maharashtra). The hotel is clean, with lovely views. Try and get a room on the 2nd or 3rd floor so you have the view of Dehradun on your left and mountains of Mussoorie on your right.  Rooms are clean, well maintained. Each room has the hot water kettle. Each room hs a balcony. Beware! there are MONKEYS here, so do not leave your balcony door open! There was enough running water. But hot water was a problem. I guess it often is in hill station hotels, especially since we 47 people and there was great demand for hot water in the mornings.  The waiters carried heavy buckets of hot water to rooms on the 2nd…

Hotel is good,  staff is so co operative well mannerd,  food is also nice. Rooms are also good. Mr mukesh,  mr ajay,  miss nitigya,  miss poonam ,  mr mohit from service staff they all are so co operative taking good care of the guest

I stayed here for 3 days.... Had great time... Amazing location... Awesome view...nice rooms . Very helpful and polite staff. especially mrMukesh and mr Ajay. Both r very humble.ready to help anytime . Thanks guyzz

Superb experience Mussoorie at tulip inn green n breeze.. Nice hotel  location.. Superb view from room balcanyes.. Staff Service is very nice specially mr D N JOSHI is very helpful.. Front office staff is very helpful knowledgeabel specially miss POONAM and mr AJAY.. Thanks tulip inn green n breeze..

Hotel has very nice view from the top and food was very yummy special thanks to manager kamal kumar. All dish had very good quantity. One can enjoy hot cup of tea on sunrise which was very awesome experience.

Things I liked- stunning views, good sized rooms with balconies, very comfortable beds, a little shy but lovely staff, TV with a good option of channels, well stocked bathroom with running hot water.  Things I wasn't a fan of- slightly temperamental wifi and extraordinarily milky tea and coffee (although, this could be preferential thing?)

The hotel is very well located. It faces the valley and you can get the best sunset view from your room balcony itself. It is about 5 kms from Mall road but it is worth it as one cannot get such a good location near the Mall Road. The rooms were clean. We had 2 rooms. One facing the valley and one backside. The staff is polite. Meena who handles housekeeping and the spa was very warm and polite. Toiletries were of good quality. The food in the restaurant was good. They have wooden flooring around the bed so the floor is not cold when you first step down from the bed, which is very thoughtful. The only problem faced was the plug points were tight and placed low and had to be looked for.  But overall a good stay and i would certainly recommend this place to others.

Nice hotel with good location and their staff is very good nature. rooms are with good view and they are very spacious with 24 hr hot water even they have room heater. they have free wifi connection even in room also the connectivity is thr

The stay here was really great. Hats off to the staff of this hotel. I mean they beat the 5 star staff in service. The view from the room is great. The food is priced right and tastes well. The best part is that you can actually drive into this property and there is ample parking...Overall a great experience.

The hotel is outside the town of Mussoorie, which makes it quite a peaceful place to stay. The staff are attentive and very obliging. The building could however use some work: there are a few places where wires have been left bare, and some parts of the premises look a little shabby. This minor criticism aside, it is a very nice place to stay.

If you are looking for a good hotel with an amazing view and great service than the Tulip Inn at Barlowganj fits the bill perfectly. The manager there is extremely responsive to customers and personally supervises to ensure staff is on their feet and meeting/exceeding guest expectations. On the flip side if you are looking for a place that is close to the shopping area  than you are better off looking out for something on Mall Road near the Mussorie Library. Another negative of the place is its plumbing system that spews out too much water. In a hilly area they should look at installing water dispensers that economise water output. Also you may want to keep your voice levels in your rooms down because it really does carry quite clearly to adjoining rooms.

Tulip Inn is an associate property of Country club. It is right next to Kaylee Manor. Situated 5 kms before Main Mussoorie it's location n approach is good . The rooms though can do much better. The bathrooms had a particular smell which was prevalent. The rooms are okay. Food prices were on the higher side considering the quality of food.  Overall a property that has the potential to do better.

This place has amazing views and it has lot of activities and facilities. However, the major flaw in this hotel is its location. It is very far from the main city and thus you miss out on roaming on the mall road after dinner. The is staff is very polite and professional. Five star for that. Food is nice and they customize as per your needs which is also awesome. Room could have been better considering the amount charged per night and could have been maintained better as well.

Tulip Inn is one of my most trusted hotel chains. I've never faced any difficulties in services or hospitality. High value for money as always and courteous staff. The rooms are clean and offer great view. I would highly recommend them!

This hotel was arranged by  our package tour operator, Room was generally neat and clean and the location is good & can have beautiful view of the valley. We had breakfast and dinner in this hotel and it was satisfactory

This hotel is very far away from the main road, and the road to this hotel is too dangerous. The staff was very unprofessional and was not trained. the rooms were stinking and the worst part was i could hear what people (staying in room beside mine) were talking. The breakfast was good though. The washrooms were filthy. The Manager was very rude and don't know how to treat customers. The room tariff is very high, but the services are below than the expectations. Staying in this hotel was a total waste of money for me.

We stayed in this hotel for 2 days ( 21st Mar to 23 Mar'17)  when we were on Kesari Tour of Nainital Mussoorie and Jim Corbett. I would like to share only 1 incidence out of many which is the height of all. After sightseeing at Mussoorie, we came back to our room at Hotel Tulip Inn Green & Breeze Room No. 211. I immediately took the photographs and called Kesari Tour Manager Mr. Kishor Sonavane and Mr. Vaibhav Mangela. They were also stunned to see this and immediately went to talk to Hotel. Is this the…

Overall the hotel was not good. Staff was not well trained and they don't welcome/treat the guest in a professional way. When we check in the hotel, the room was in bad shape and there was the cleanness issue everywhere in the room. There was no water in the hotel and also we could not find the hot water till the next morning. My experience was the worst. Request the hotel management to improve on delivering areas. Thanks.

This hotel is around 5 km away from main mall road and give you peace to enjoy the nature. Hotel staff is good. However there was lots of interupption with respect to wi-fi. You will require your own vehicle to reach this place as there is no other options available. Food is bit costly.

well for starters they barely had anything in the menu to serve due to one reason or the other and what they did have to offer tasted horrible, not at all worth the money they ask for the dishes. We ordered a plate of pakodas in which we barely got 6-7 pieces and it cost us rs 300. Most of the hotel is under construction so it's very noisy throughout the day. In the morning the water running in the bathroom was dirty. And the rooms were just about all right. I'm never going to book that hotel again. If I'd had the option of refund I would have cancelled my stay there.

The property has gone down tremendously . Worst experience ever had. The entire trip gone waste. The bed linen had paan stains inspire of telling the mgr no action taken. Overall experience pathetic . Worst hotel ever visited

Tulip Inn, is a good property a bit far from Mall Road (5-6kms) & other restaurants and tourists attractions but can be compensated with its location and breath taking views from the rooms.  Room size was ok, and easily accommodated four of us (two adults & two kids) the sofa cum bed provided in the room was a great plus.  Service could have been a bit better and the food quality was just ok, we can't say it was bad nor it was delicious.  Last but not the least everything can be ignored as we could see snow fall from our room.  Will re-visit for sure.

the property is located away from main mussorie . it offers good views away from the hustle & bustle of mall road. the rooms were good, but the staff needs to buckup. the food at the inhouse restaurant was good.

I came across this property as matter of luck. My confirmed reservations in Jharipani castle was missed !! by the Jharipani Castle management and this was the closest hotel in a similar bracket. So at 8 PM after travelling so long I was yet to get a place to stay. The 'Tulip Inn' proved to be right kind and perhaps a far better place.  The front desk handled the reservations swiftly and well. Dinner was as per our choice and taste. From the room (Studio) and balcony you can see the twinkling stars and the city lights. The views both at night and day time were great. It was something that met our requirements of a calm and peaceful holidays perfectly. I am looking forward to be there again

It was a beautiful property, I went to visit Mussoorie in June with my Family. I stayed there for 3 days and its a good experience. Very clean rooms, good hotel service and good food as well. I was right choice select this hotel for our stay.

Stayed for 4 days in the month of July. Good location, great view, nice clean room, helpful front desk and average food. Front desk helped a lot in the way of suggesting the local attractions. Only problem, main city is app 10km away and every time, one wants to go to the city, has to pay a big amount taxi fare. However, it was a nice stay.

Hotel has peaceful environment and amazing views. But is located far from city. A trip from hotel to Mall Road costs Rs 300 for on side. Otherwise its a good choice. People there are cooperative specially the kichen staff.

I was staying in room 214 which was duplex suite with balcony and facing towards Dehradun Valley...i have booked this place via country club membership...The place is almost 7 Kilometres away from the hustle bustle of the main city...You won't get any traffic to reach at this place...  Pros : The room service is prompt Reception is friendly Staff is nice Play area for kids is good.. Tandoori items was not available at 2130hrs on my third day...Same was available on…

This hotel is situated around 10-12 kms away from mussoorie and one has to search for the location to reach there. View of the valley from outside of the hotel is just awesome. Stayed here for 2 nights.

Everything in this property :  rooms, food , spa etc is on costlier side and all services: rooms, quality of food, room cleanliness, amenities, spa is below standard. I must say that I am absolutely disappointed with this hotel. I booked it after seeing nice rating here but what i got was horrible. Such a costly hotel should offer all amenities in the room and not act like a stingy person waiting for guests to ask for them.   Our family had a good…

The hotel is a 5-6 km drive to the main city (e.g. Mall Road). And it is meant for people seeking complete relaxation, away from the city. There is not much apart from these 2 hotels in Barlowsganj.   The hotel is just behind Hotel JP Manor - I heard this was Uttarakhand's first 5 star hotel and in Barlowsganj.   The hotel is overall quite good. Rooms are not so big - but quite clean. Every room in the main section of the hotel faces the valley and has a balcony where you can sit and just enjoy the fresh breeze of the mountain.  Service is also quite good & prompt. We had stayed in this resort through country club. It was a good experience. The room was spacious , clean and nice, The view was excellent with Mussoorie hill top above and valley below. The hotel had facilities for children including games room with table tennis, carrom etc. The restaruant service was good but price was a little on higher side. Room service was also good, The hotel has a spa also but we did not use it. Negative is u need you own vehicle as it is far away about 5 km from main mussoorie mall road.

This property is aptly ranked at 62 out of 70 hotels in Mussorie. Its totally worthless. I request country club members not to go here and save your money from getting wasted. Staff is warm though. Food quality and taste very bad. Rooms are very low standard. Smell in washrooms.

We liked  1) Location very convenient - south of Musoorie 3kms in Barlowganj away from maddening crowds 2) Rooms 203/204 excellent, spacious, large balconies 3) Booked on Cleartrip - and this property is part of the OYO rooms  4) Views are great of the valley and hillside 5) Breakfast is large and impressive 6) Staff at check in check out reception and room service are fabulous  What we did NOT like  1) WiFi was very bad (slow, and almost non-existent) 2) It is a budget value hotel (rated 3*) but amenities in toilet (soap/shampoo were small and sparse) but they did fill up on request 3) If you are looking to be in Musoorie proper or even Landour this is NOT where you want to be

Hotel Manager was very Rude and not ready to accept her mistake. Pics shown over the site is not at all matching the correct room shown . Even not for single person that space was enough. Hey, this Shiv Prakash Singh ..... i stayed in this hotel from 21st oct 2015 to 24th oct 2015 and it was a delightful stay there. I booked this hotel through oyo rooms and check in time given to me was 12 am  but i reached mussoorie by 7 am i thought hotel will charge me for 5 hour early check in but they didnt charged even a single penny for this and each and every staff member of this hotel was very generous, helpful and welcoming. This hotel is located at a very peaceful and extremely beautiful place. If u love peace and want some quality time away from cities rush then this hotel is the one. Mall road is too busy and noisy place to stay. Food was also very delicious esp. Brkfst. But quite expensive as it is a 3 star hotel. I would suggest to change tv because atleast 3star…

I walk into a room and find hair lying in my room, sofa not clean, table dirty, walls in bad shape etc..... Room No. 510. I call the duty manager and he does not feel necessary to visit me. Surprising to see the pathetic attitude of the staff. I would not recommend this to any one. Thanks Divya

The stay was worst. The food,service is good but their are not many varieties. The toilet had no space even to turn around. The water pressure is very low and their is no answer from the management. It was too expensive for the service and the kind of room provided. Overall stay was bad and overall a big no from my side

Away from the hustle and bustle of crowded Mussoorie Mall Road and 5 kms from the main highway is the Hotel Tulip Inn in the Barlowganj area of Mussoorie.   The hotel is opposite famous Jaypee Hotel and is 7-8 Kms from Mall Road. The main advantage of hotel is that one can have Panoramic View of entire Doon Valley from Balcony itself and no need to go out. The scene specially scores high during night hours with lights flashing from entire Dehradun City.   We served with Welcome Drink on arrival. Tea and Coffee can be prepared in the room itself as they have provided with kettles in every room. Carpeted floor to reduce the coldness of hilly areas and standing heaters are also there in rooms. King size Bed, LED TV and well maintained and cleaned washroom are few of the features…

The staff is extremely good as it gave us rooms when none of the hotel had rooms on a busy weekend. The manager there also booked the rooms on phone and this definately saved our day and night.   The hotel was also courteous enough to open kitchen for us in late hours and serve us good hot food.   The rooms are average though clean and also have a nice view. We took 2 rooms joined to each other , no. 102 and 105. It had a small kitchen in it.  Only dwarback was that the rooms sockets were not working and it took an effort to charge mobiles from far off sockets.   Hotel is located at a nice place.

The hotel is situated 3-4 kms away from mussoorie. Had peaceful and quite surroundings. Its an average value for money hotel, where you can not expect luxury. But the rooms and bathrooms were clean and the room size was reasonable. Our room had a balcony from which we really got a stunning view of doon valley. Staff is helpful. We ordered indian dishes from the restaurant ans we got a hearty and tasty meal.

The Tulip Inn Green and Breeze resort is 5 km away from Mussorie and if you do not have your own vehicle your trips to Mussorie are going to be limited. The hotel itself is average and parking space is a problem. The hotel does not provide any drinking water bottles so visitors must cater for their own water. The tea coffe maker was dirty and the bath had no tub. A cheap option if one cannot afford the Jaypee Residency next to it. A budget hotel which is not to the taste of the well to do types. Rokeby is more recommended. For an extra bed they open up a sofa cum bed and Bill you extra for it.the view however that the hotel offers is good and is close to Jharipani Falls

I have visited Tulip Inn, Barlowganj for 3 days 21/5 - 24/5. But sorry to say that I have booked hotel form its picture in website and found totally different i.e. renovation work was going on. No proper flooring in the rooms. Bathroom accessories are not proper. Electric fittings not properly working. We were informed that Hotel is near from market but it is very far from market and no transport facility available.

It was a pathetic experience as we had gone with family for relaxation considering Tulip as good brand. In fact Hotel was under renovation, flooring was not upto the mark even bathroom fittings were not proper. Internal charging points for mobile was in bad condition. First aid facility was not available as some minor accident happened with other guest.

location of property is good and room given to us was good but food was pathetic and there was no activity in the resort for entertainment ,while our stay work was going on for games and activities.we recommend stay there but for food you have to depend on nearby restaurant or to the mall road which is 4 kilometer away,housekeeping staff was slow on response .overall good stay on locationwise because it is nearby to dehradun also.

over priced, worst location and approach, very far of mussoorie , you do not feel staying in  mussoorie , think 10 time before going to that place , even there are lot many good hotel available for lessor price on Mall road,also note they can cancel you booking without information ,  they are big opportunist can sell your room to walk in guest Or someone who pays more than you.  not a hotel for families & couples .

Beautiful rooms , great staff specially the Manager Ms Mamta she and her staff goes out of the way to help guests , though there are some issues with hot water in the bathrooms which they should take care of because you don't expect this from a group like Tulip. The place is far from the mall road taxi charges 150 to Rs. 200 one way local bus charges Rs. 10/- per person but it comes on specific time which u need to check with the hotel . Quite calm place to relax and enjoy one could enjoy peaceful walk outside the hotel and experience a different mussoorie .  Food is really good at the hotel but prices on the higher side.  Overall the building and the common area of the hotel is not to appealing .  Hope this help

The food served…

it is wastage of money to stay there,no electricity,no hot water all time,please it is near j p hotel but not near j p.staff is careless,we spoiled our holiday there and you please donot do...property is good but hotel is not maintained,all the time we just want to leave this hotel ,it is far from mall road ,i dnt perfer any one to waste your holiday there

The resort offers best view of the valley and Mountains , you can view both Mussorie and Dehradun from the Room , it is 4-6 KM away from main market.Hotel room is ok but bathroom is very small.room is clean but it not up to mark.room main door is glass door so if yr curtain not close any one see room activity from gallery(for ground floor).not to much activity here.better side is less crowded and relaxing place.food is ok but price is high.staff is helpfully.small children play area with some swing.tv(not lcd),coffee maker in room.

An amazing property decently but a lil overpriced, but well not bad at all. Clean bathrooms with toiletries and hot water. Puff slippers, iron, hangers and a nice almirah with locker. I wish we stayed more but sadly only a night.  Would love to come again!

went there, stayed there it was really nice time we had. lovely place and good services. the value for money. when ever you visit there ask for "Kheer" in desert it was lovely and enjoyed. it is on the way to the city but you stay here and travel to the other parts and come back

I stayed from 28/8/14 to 31/8/14. The room stinks horrible and the air freshner was no better. The moisturiser and shampoo given was horrible. It is better to take just 500rs hotel at mall rather then going for this hotel. Staff is rude. Rooms are just fine. No other facility. Should not be called a resort. Expansive and pathetic food. Location spoils ur whole trip.

Lovely Place with great view. Little far off from Mall road. This is actually good as it offers great view and is away from the congested and polluted mall road. It will be great if you can get a good package deal as base price is on the higher side. Service is good, rooms are spacious & view is just awesome.

It's a big resort near Jaypee Manor, Mussorie. But the sad part is that space could have been utilised more innovatively and smartly. There's nothing much to do in and around the resort other than a poorly kept indoor games room and some swings for the kids.  It would have been much better if it provided facilities like a swimming pool, spa etc as there are very few resorts in Mussorie with a pool and such ample space.   Overall the resort is comforting and well maintained. Food was cooked according to our taste and time. A very peaceful place with good view.

lovely place and excellent view. all the rooms are nicely done. the best value for the money I thing should travel at least once and stay at this place. little far from the mall road but nice cool place to hangout and have a nice weekend.

We had booked this hotel during last week of feb being off season. The rack rates of the hotel are around 5-6k, but got a good deal being off season.   Location The hotel is located quite far away from the mall area in an area called barlowganj, well before proper mussoorie. The hotel has 3-4 names which is kind of confusing. Though there are little niggling things like leaking faucets, small heaters, loose switchboards. Otherwise the rooms are well maintained and clean.  Food…

The staff is friendly and food is also good (limited veg menu and i am vegan). However, this resort is located in Barlowganj, 4 - 5 kms away from Mall Road (main mussorie city area or happening area). The local cabs charge Rs 200 for one way trip to mall road, which i think is unreasonable for 5 km travel. The resort also does not have any resource for activities like fitness center, swimming pool, spa or massage center. In off season, I would definitely recommend to…

stayed there from 13-aug-13 to 16-aug-13 , hotel was ok with very limited to do things, no gym or bar was there , staff was friendly with good food to eat ,, try to travel by your own car as it is far away from mussoorie city and a drop to city will cost you 200 bucks i.e 400 bucks for going to city n coming back to hotel, nothing to do around the hotel as it is aought of village if travelling with family it is ok to stay ,,but if travelling with friends prefer staying in Musoorie city. I travelled there with my wife n son so it was a altogether good stay

Green 'n' Breeze is one of those locations that most hotels greatly envy...it was a shame we couldn't see much of it from our room! If you unfortunately end up in a standard room, try not to stay on the 112 block. Our view was only partial and it got even less from there. The service is ok, but the menu is a joke. What a fantastic property specially view from rooms was 'Awesome'  i have stayed in June 3rd week.Resort was fully  occupied.i checked in early morning 9:00 i was allotted Studio room Front View, Room was  clean and hygienic ,Dry kitchen was available in room, I stayed with my wife and my son for 3N4D we enjoyed beauty of the nature

Very peaceful location though a little off the track & could be hard to find for a newbie in Mussorie . Limited parking [I believe every hotel there has the same problem].  Excellent view & good service.   Highly recommended.

I found mussoorie to be a very crowded place.Thus the hotel i a good option if you are looking for relaxed holidays away from the madness of the place. otherwise if you want to spend the time doing what everyone else is doing i mean with the crowd then this is not the place. normally the roads leading to mussorie from the hotel gets choked due to traffic killing a lot of your time in traffic. Otherwise a good property in itself with courteous management and staff. good rooms and amenities. very clean and prompt. everything is excellent apart from the distance from the city that too in times of traffic.

We stayed there over the last weekend of June 2011, the rooms & bathrooms were well maintained,, the valley view rooms have amazing view which is a great thing if you are holidaying on hill station.... the resort runs with a tight space and there is no lawn or open area for relaxing..... only thing is a little space on the entrance of resort's reception which is normally occupied by the vehicles of guests staying... your movements will be restricted to your room in case of rains as it happened with us. The food is no so great, but they'll make something special on request if you want... however few snacks we ordered were great in taste, otherwise the food is avoidable.... Staff is courteous and friendly and but they have trouble in handling peak occupency....  Our overall stay…

We stayed here in Studio room between 12th to 15th of july 2010. Although hotel is little away from Mussorie, yet a very nice place to stay. Since, It is away from the main mussorie, so away from the noise as well. One can get very good sleep in the night here. Views of valley and hills are very nice from this place. Hotel staff is very friendly and cooperative. Food quality was also very good. We liked the food very much. In short, I got everything, what I wanted here. I would like to come here one more time next time. This place will always remain in my memories.
Location of Resort is excellent. Nice and cool view. Hotel staff is co-operative. Must improve on Power backup and room service. Overall experience Excellent...

The hotel is newly built may be just 3 years old. The rooms were very asthectically designed and spacious. The doon valley view was excellent. You could also see Mussorie lights. The car parking was enough and safe but had problems taking out car because other cars were parked there in morning and evening. The service was very poor but the staff was courteseous and the food average. It is about 5 kms from Mall road (Picture Palace side). If you come from Barlowganj side, you will likely miss the entry since there is no board indicating the hotel. It is adjacent Jaypee properties. Infact their entrance is side by side but the hotel is just below the Jaypee property. However when you come from Mussorie side, you will be able to spot the entrance.

The resort offers best view of the valley and Mountains , you can view both Mussorie and Dehradun from the Room , it is 4 KM away from Mussorie which secludes it from hustle and bustle of the town , transport is available throughout the day from Hotel .  The resort has good with spacious rooms , I stayed in a studio room which had a small kitchenette and Dining area .  Rooms are clean and airy . Food is OK .  On the downside , the pressure of handling too many guests showed on the infrastructure of the resort, many of the power points were not functional or Broken , Room cleaning was bare minimum confined to only changing bedsheets and making up Bathrooms . Play area for kids had very limited equipments , for adults promised pool table was nowhere to be seen but table tennis…

We stayed for 3days.. It is 200 meters away from picture palace barricades on Mall road. From there hotel is at walking distance.. We greeted by hotel staff at reception and check in procedure was very fast.. We had  taken fern club room having nice velly view. Size of room was oky but bath area size was very small.. Hotel having small activity room for kids ..  Resturent is at ground floor and having nice velly view.. Food was very testy and chef jayprakash  and his team was very cooperative... They made special Pahadi dinner for us..Service was good and fast..  All the staff of hotels were cooperative, helpful, courteous..  We really enjoyed our stay at Hotel .

We stayed in the hotel The Fern Hotel Mussoorie. Really good food and nice experience with Mr. Abhijeet. Good service, humble and stylish person. Was fast and interactive with the whole crowd. Had a lot of fun

This is at 200 m from the Picture palace barricade where a taxi will drop you and one has to walk to reach the hotel.  Hotel is nice with a typical architecture of apartment type room positioning. room size is OK, can accommodate an extra single bed.  Service was good, prompt. there is an activity room and a dedicated reading area at the 1st level.  Restaurant is at the ground level, has an excellent valley view. The food was nice, quality was good, price was fine and portions were large.

I was here for 3 days….the staff is really good and kind.The food tastes really good and the view is amazing it is really near to mall road that’s a good thing and the environment is really clean.The hotel also is really beautiful and clean…If u ever come to mussoori u should stay here

Great team, hospitality and management by Mr Behl and his team !! We took 10 rooms, from checkin to restro to room service !! All were well managed !!  Wishing more power and love to all of them. Thanks for making our stay so memorable !!!

The hotel was amazing, the staff was very friendly (especially Magan uncle) the food was delicious. The room was squeaky clean .It has the perfect view, the mall road is very close too!  Don't hesitate to come for a visit

Maga was our helper and was very nice and sweet if u visit here please take his service. Also this hotel is all u need for a good trip. It has a valley view, mall road nearby and the food here is scrumptious.  I hope you like your visit here as we did

Fern hotel is a good place to visit a picture capturing view from the balcony is much soothing when u wake up …… the dining area with Mohan makes the environment joyful and friendly…. Words would be less to describe the pleasurable experience in th fern Brentwood hotel

Hotel is very nice and well maintained. Staff is family friendly and services are excellent. ...... I want thanks Mr.Moham Murari and shilpi for their wonderful and good hospitality for my family. We will recommend this property ...

Excellent hospitality and warm attitude of the staff make the stay pleasurable. Mister KAMLESH rendered tireless efforts for our comfortable stay.  The food was excellent too. Overall a good experience at the resort.

I enjoyed staying in this hotel... early morning view from the balcony is wonderful...  staff is so polite and cooperative. Always ready to assist you in a good way. Mr suresh from restaurant served us so well along with his team members ankit shilpi and kamlesh.

The fern brentwood spa and resort …. The view of this property was incridible and peacefu…the food was delicious specially chhole bhature live counter….Thanks to Mr Mohan Murari and shilpi was very passionate
Beautiful place & view.👍🏻 Excellent staff service & hygiene👌🏻 Food is scrumptious 👌🏻 Special thanks to Shilpi & Mohan for showing us wonderful hospitality  ☺️☺️ ☺️ thanks for the anniversary cake.

Hotel view 10/10 go for valley view Hotel service 10/10  Hotel food 10/10 Hotel hospitality 10/10 For their staff specially shilpi and mohan thanks for showing great hospitality.. really enjoyed my stay. and yes thanks for the anniversary cake.

Property is very good amazing view amazing location very neatly managed staff specially mohan Murari cooperated very nicely also the bakery chef Sahil has amazing taste in his hands, Jst need some cleanliness in rooms and the bathroom isn’t sufficient.

Excellent staff and hospitality. In short its a perfect stay. The property appears decent and outside seating of restaurant is good. On the feedback, personally I have come up with a lot of good memories from there. 💝🐼🐒🦋

Had an amazing experience! Great service by Mohan , Santosh and Shilpi. Very courteous. Enjoyed the breakfast. Rooms were very clean. Pleasant and friendly staff . Delicious food. We will be back soon.

I had an amazing stay time at this property, and with that the scrumptious food. Avijit was really helpful & kind throughout our stay at this property which helped us a lot. Highly recommend him to take on senior responsibilities managing this property!

At first, when we were navigating to the hotel, the narrow road leading to it, kinda gave us a doubt how the hotel, but that got eradicated as soon as we arrived at the hotel From the moment of checking in to the checkout, everything was upto the mark and even surpassed it by a large margin. The view, the stay, the food, the staff, everything interplay with each other to make your stay, serene and enjoyable one Shoutout to Kamlesh, shilpi, prashant and mohan for been utterly helpful and cordial during our stay Great experience

Its one of the iconic places if you are a regular visitor to Mussorie ,I have been witnessing this property since i was a kid but never stayed there. So this was my first experience of Brentwood Mussorie .Very centrally located hardly 2 minutes walk from Mall road with good parking space.  Property is well maintained with all modern amenities available.Staff is really well trained especially the Restaurant staff which took utmost care of us. Got a room with a valley view and it was one of the best views from mussorie.. One can indulge in tambola and live music which sets up the evening and you can relax leaving all worries behind. In short its a perfect stay if you travelling with family/friends .

Excellent location. It's near to Mall road but gives you sufficient isolation. Excellent staff and hospitality. Good food with very good variety. We took breakfast and dinner meal plan. Kids friendly. Beautiful view. Enjoyed every bit of our stay. I would definitely recommend it for anyone comming to Mussoorie

The hotel is at one end of the mall road (picture palace side) and right after entering the mall road. Muncipality charges Rs. 150 for personal car to enter the mall road and reach the hotel. The taxi stand is just walking distance from the hotel.  Avoid Winter Green Room or Winter Green premium rooms as they have absolutely no view of mountains / valley. The property appears decent and outside seating of restaurant is good.  On the feedback, to start with there is no Spa or Resort at the Fern Brentwood Resort and Spa. Just another hotel. The checking experience was pathetic. The front desk was either overloaded or was disinterested. We were not explained about any amenities, inclusions / exclusions about the room or anything else while check-in, unless each of these was…

The tow day stay at the property was a great experience.  The hotel is convinently located with well maintained rooms and beautiful view of of Valley. The food at the in-house restaurant Whistling Pines was awesome and ensured we keep experiencing different items during our stay.  Abhijeet took great care and was an excellent with his suggestions and service. Thank You

Excellent experience at Brentwood again ! This hotel was quiet decent and with a good view. This hotel had good food and ambience. The USP of this hotel was Live Singing in the evening which was too good. The hotel staff was quiet helpful. It was close to mall road which makes it even perfect with very good parking space

Ravi from housekeeping had excellent service always on time and the food of the hotel was very nice room cleaning by Ravi was excellent all the staff were friendly and had great service it was a very nice experience

Some places have amazing vibes and we experienced that in  @The Fern Brentwood Resort & spa. Missouri's. We stayed for 2 days and we’re amazed with the hotel hospitality  hotel staff is so helpful with everything you need and a big shout out to Mr. Magan for his kind behaviour and hospitality, location is so good near to Mall Road, mesmerised ambiance and well maintained. Overall great experience.

We felt amazing accomodating here for 3 nights.. special thanks to Drishti and Somya from front desk who took care of our stay. Keep growing girls.. good wishes for you..  Live music is great at evening along with bonfire we enjoyed it.. thankyou fern brentwood

Ravi from the housekeeping department has done an excellent job. The staff is very hospitable and we got excellent service here. Recommend to all who come to Mussoorie. We had a very good time and we’ll visit the hotel again.

Well, as there are tens of hundreds of hotels in Mussoorie, it could be very confusing to choose one. I was lucky to have chosen the Fern brentwood. Amazing location, ample of parking, excellent staff and great quality of food. I was here for a short family vacation and enjoyed every moment of my  time in the hotel. Check in was smooth. Both, Somya and Geeta were very courteous and welcoming. Room was clean and spacious with all modern amenities that anyone would ever need during the vacation. Well, their providing Biotique quality brand toiletries in the bathroom is something great to write home about.   I mean in these days where every hotel is pretty much cutting on quality stuff to offer to their guests, it was certainly a commendable thing to do. It was a pleasant stay, breakfast is good and even in house dining is quite nice. The staff is overall very friendly. Nadeem at the front desk was very helpful and courteous. We had a small baby with us and they tried to make us feel most comfortable. Thank you.

After staying in a hotel like Sterling, I found this hotel to be extremely good. Excellent service, good food, neat and clean and best part is it is on mall road. ITC has no doubt maintaimed the standards. Will definitely recommend this hotel.

Our stay at fortune was an awesome experience because of warm hospitality, delicious food , scenic views & comfort with kids ....  shall definitely come again & shall refer to friends & family as well 👍

We keep coming back to this hotel every year, for its superb view from the terrace and lobby. Great location at the library end of the mall, allows you to prevent the holiday traffic  Rooms were comfortable, and staff responsive even though the hotel was sold out The food is awesome, probably the best in town. We opted for al a carte mostly to try a wide variety of cuisines on offer. The taste Got is snacking all day Evenings were spent at the bar, which had great music and dancing floor as well, a beer bucket at a great price, sealed the deal Everything one can expect from an ITC Hotel!

Poor maintenance, wooden flooring coming off and it injured the kids..Staff didn’t attended despite repeated complaints.  Breakfast spread is repetitive moreover the staff around don’t bother about the refill or whether the table is clear or not..  Overall Worst experience from ITC

Great Hotel,  Awesome experience.  I would like to recommend  this Hotel to everyone who is looking up to come in Mussoorie. Everything is at its best.  Rooms,  Food,  Service,  Location.  I Deeply thanks to the staff of this hotel to make my trip at its best.

It is walkable distance from Library Centre. The prices are high.  We found the buffet too expensive.  So, we ordered alacarte. We had lunch in the outdoor restaurant.  The view was memorable. Service and food were good. Can try once...

Hotel is just on the mall road ...if u are fond of shopping then good place to stay but surrounding is very crowded. Hotel os good ..room are very spacious ...would love to come back . View is also very good ...

They have a nice outdoor sitting restaurant area, great for evening drinks.  The cocktails & mocktails were nice. Service was good. The veg. tandoori sampler was quite good however the quality of paneer was just ok.  Saw the rooms also. Did not like the non-balcony rooms.

The hotel has a very beautiful & scenic view to offer. The staff here is extremely warm, welcoming & ever so ready to help. The rooms are also very spacious and the food is also pretty good. Overall a great stay & highly recommended!

Staying at the Fortune Grace was  great idea, since it is so conveniently located. Great food. Great view. Good location & great service. A little expensive but value for money.  A walk down the mall road in the evening, meal at one of the numerous small restaurants if you want  a change from the hotel menu (which was very good too). Picking up a taxi for hire is only 3 minutes away from the hotel.  Ask for a hotel with a balcony and your trip is done!

Fortune Resort is conveniently located in Mussoorie to access Mall Road however, It is in a very crowded locality. Get one’s Car to and from this hotel can be a real pain.  The hotel requires s major re-decorating. The decor is old and worn. Rooms are dark and not well lit. They have a stale feel and our room smelt of cigarettes. Paint and new lighting - is the bare minimum required.  TV had very intermittent or non exiting reception of world channels For the price of the room / all channels should have been made available - consistently.  The staff were amazing - so helpful do courteous- nothing was too much trouble - even remembering customer preferences in the breakfast restaurant.

Had booked directly and has paid in advance to an account in Delhi. My stay for a twin was from 5th May for a night. Arrival: at 1210 hrs, was told that a Double bed valley view was blocked for me when I had specifically mentioned a Twin as my daughter was accompanying me. The rest of our stay was fine. Dinner in the lobby restaurant was okay although they  messed-up the order my daughter had…

i will not call it a mid range hotel. it is a luxury hotel but an excellent bargain for money you pay. excellent staff, service, superb food-both veg and non-veg and nice bar. We stayed at the private terrace suit and just the terrace and atmosphere was worth the whole trip!!! very safe for kids and young children also. if i have to make a suggestion- convert it in to a resort and add a heated swimming pool!!..but otherwise, definitely worth a while to stay and enjoy...

Here's a place which will please people of all age groups. Great location! Mall road (Library Chowk) begins hardly 20 steps from the gate of the hotel.   1. Nice big play area for kids with huge variety of games.  Sad part: Air Hockey, Pool and XBox are chargeable... yes! for in-house guests too!  2. Take the valley view room (WITHOUT Balcony) as you will not be able to enjoy the balcony much as there is monkey menace!  Suggestion: Don't opt for room with food (Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner) included as there are plenty of eating options around the hotel once you leave hotel gate. Example: Laxmi Misthan, City Point and Uphar were good!  3. Hotel location is superb! Very very close to the Mall road. Begin walking on the Mall road and all locations are quite close. The rooms not up to the mark had booked valley view room but was given a room which a view of their chimney and terrace shed. The valley view rooms on the 6th floor offer beautiful views.  The breakfast variety is amazing. Loved theur masala chai, idly and chutneys along with live counters. The rooms are spacious with all the basic amenities. Good wifi and good quality of toiletries.  Helpful and friendly staff.  Mall road ends ( or starts) here near the library. So easy access to the camel back road and all the other must see places and shopping experiences. 50 rs rickshaw will take you to the other end of mall road to gunhill cable car point.   I will definitely stay here at my next visit and will definitely recommend this to families with children who will love their game room. Even we adults will enjoy the games they have.

It was a very wonderful experience by staying in this hotel .Starting from the location to rooms and the foods and services everything was perfect. The staffs were very courteous .The quality of  food and beverages was too good.I would definitely recommend this hotel to my every friend.

We visited Mussoorie in the month of August 2017. It was my first visit to Mussoorie and experience was amazing. We did all the touristy stuff like visiting Mall Road, Dhanaulti, Lal tibba etc. Now regarding the resort it couldn't have been better.  Location of this resort is PERFECT! It's right on the Mall Road so you don't have to take out your car and get stuck in traffic. You can visit Mall Road walking. We had taken a valley view room and the trust me view was beyond words. We stayed here in the second week of December 2017. This property is situated right at Gandhi Chowk on Mall Road. The location of this property is it's biggest USP. The rooms were a bit cramped up. The terrace restaurant offers some breathtaking views of the Doon valley, especially at the time of sunset and also later, when the lights are on! The breakfast spread was pretty elaborate and tasty too!
