Excellent location of hotel,at one of Mall road. Staff very welcoming. Rooms fairly spacious and heating system very effective. Breakfast spread quite varied with plenty of options to cater all tastes. Spa facilities of fairly high standard. Highly recommended hotel for stay with families.

About fortune resort suitated at the rite location..in the heart of mussorrie with ample parking the welcome is very warm.. rooms are comfy.. checkin went smooth.. hospitality is amazing.. breakfast spread and diner buffet is yummy.. the staff are easily approachable.. the view from the hotel terrace is beautiful and breath taking.. easily connected to mall road for shopping and hogging street food shall recommend this property.. kudos team fortune resort mussorrie..

Fortune grace is in the main hustle bustle area unlike other heritage places which are away from the noisy Mall Road ... the hotel is quite nice if you like to be midst the busy area of Mussorie  The lift is still under construction n many floors to climb up and down if you want rooms with a decent view

Very friendly staff, good location right near the mall , with a great view. Food quality was good too.  Variety of restaurants in the hotel a bit limited, could be enhanced.Overall very good experience.

This property by ITC is one of the best, and the hospitality is at its peak, food is very good.. i i was given chance i will visit this property again and again. the view from the deck is beyond words,   visit there at least once

Visited with family and my bst friend had regular buffet ..it was really delicious and authentic food ..sply my son like the pasta .. Specially thanks to Bhupendar and Mr. Nyegi and their team .. Wish you all the best ..

We had chosen this hotel as it is a ITC brand hotel. A very good four star hotel in the heart of the town, just at the library end of the Mall Road. We had booked two rooms, a valley view room and another a valley view room with a balcony. We were alloted the rooms on the sixth floor which is the top floor of the hotel and has a very nice and an uninterrupted valley view. The valley view room without balcony was a huge room with ceiling to floor glass windows. The room are well lit and has a simple but modern decor with all modern amminities and a nice bathroom needed for a good star rated hotel. The valley view room with balcony are fabulous.It has a nicely done wooden roof and flooring as seen in many European hotels. The balcony was also nice. Both the rooms were clean with…

We planned our quarterly meeting at this property & found it to be one of the best property @ Mussoorie. Rooms were good & food was also relishing. The best part is it's open terrace which gives a clear view of the Dun valley on clear weathers. Infact, it's just adjacent to Library Chowk which is one end of Mall Road & perfectly located.  Tip - Go for Valley facing Rooms on higher floors. They do have some standard rooms with no view at all...Avoid them as there is no fun if you visit hills & don't have valley facing rooms.

It was memorable trip and had a awesome hospitality experience in fortune during our stay. Had a lots of enjoyment and fun and celebrated new year with friend's. Hotel restaurant food is also delicious with a amazing view of hills and greenery. Special thanks to Mr. Abhishek Saklani he is a gem very nice guy who took care of our stay. Will definitely visit again and will recommend to all my colleagues. All the best to the entire team keep up the good work and the excellent standard and service.

We were disappointed by the town of Musoorie and this hotel. We stayed here a weekend. We were given a basement room next to a towel closet. Wireless was spotty and only allowed limited users. The buffet dinner and breakfast were acceptable. The traffic to nearby Kempty falls was so bad that we spent 8 hours in the car on the hill with nowhere to go. The traffic was poorly managed and the drivers did not follow road etiquette.

One of the worst managed new year party.. Where DJ and  star performance was kept at such a space where all members could hardly stand forget about seating arrangement.. not recommended atleast at an insane price they asked. Not recommended.. disappointed

Excellent service, Warm welcome, awesome view/location. had a great experience. The staff is very supportive and kind. u can enjoy your breakfast/lunch/dinner  by sitting inside the restaurant or in the open area. The resort has spa and gym facility with latest technology/machines. Never forgettable experience/trip. thank you @ all Fortune Resort Grace Staff.

best hotel in best place,its is one of the finest hotel in masorri.i love to stay there.good thing for this hotel is that the market place is just out of it.special thing and that i like the most about its is its bar part.its staff is of very friendly in nature and provide good service.its bed is so comfortable.if we compair this hotel to another hotel in massoori in term of luxire i prefer 'fortune'

I visited this hotel for a conference I have no word to express my experience about hotel fortune resort grace. We liked the location as it is situated very close to the Library chowk & The hotel Receptionist Mr Kartik was very friendly and gentle person. I want to visit again in future. All staff very kind and supportive.Breakfast buffet is awesome & food quality was good Rooms are very Good Outside Restaurant was very spaces Thanks fortune Team.

The resort ambience was awesome. The staff members were courteous, with special mention about nodding with 'Namaste' with smiling face. The entire hospitality services was wrapped with professionalism. The foods were excellent. Overall it was very pleasant stay.

We liked the location as it is situated very close to the Library chowk. Tourist bus and taxi stand are just 5 mins away. Good facility for children to play. Staff is courteous and pays attention to your requests. Enjoy the view from terrace. Rooms on the 4th (Reception level) are not recommended. We changed the room as it has no view and if you open the curtain then you'll see duct and anyone can come and stand there as it is accessible.

Rooms were not view facing. Food was not that yumm.. Service was very slow... Night view from outside of hotel and hotel terrace was very nice. We could see the complete Dehradun city from the terrace of the hotel.

The hotel was at a good location but as expected the rooms were not having any view . The outdoor sitting area was amazing but the breakfast spread was not very good. Lot of waiting till anything ordered arrives and half of the things seemed  to be as if they are a day old . Overall a good stay with not very good in house resturant options available

•I stayed in this hotel with my family during my holiday trip in Mussoorie. The hotel is just on the library end of the mall road which is very prime location. But these rooms are pretty small. Even it was very difficult to put an extra bed in the room. You can have good view of valley and hills from the balcony. But I shall suggest rooms above the lobby level for better view. The hotel do not have a lift, so you have to climb stairs to reach upper floors. They have rooms below the lobby level as well, but not good for view. The amenities in the rooms are also appreciable. They…

The location is very good, right on the library end.Though i prefer Picture palace end as all good cafes are on the other side of mall road. Hotel is by ITC so the staff has to be good.Firstly it is not a resort, its a hotel Secondly please do not take rooms on the ground level as there is plenty of noise. The coffee shop and lobby is at the same level which makes it very very noisy. The hotel should do something about this. Breakfast spread is good.

As a regular traveller, there is always an urge to see newer things and explore the unseen treasures of nature. But, at the same time, there are certain places which we keep on visiting repeatedly; not missing any opportunity for visiting such places again and again. Fortune Resort Grace, Mussoorie is another such place for me. My repeated visits to the said property have made me know the hotel better and, my faith is reaffirmed with each successive visit, that the hotel deserves appreciation for delectable food, room service at a call and an affable and welcoming front desk staff apart from the advantage it enjoys for its locational vicinity to the mall and its hilltop view of the Dehra Valley.        By way of wide travelling I have always tried to explore and discover my…

Thanks Fortune Grace,  We came because our Homestay plan turned out to be a disaster as it was not suitable for family and kids. We enjoyed the stay - especially the breakfast was sumptuous at the Terrace.  Just few things -  too many artificial namaste greetings can be awkward by your attenders, and secondly there was none to second that, when we checked out from floor no. SIX - is also equally awkward.  Also, we could not get a room with the view - which was unlucky - but next time, we hope we are lucky concerning the room availability!  The hotel manager Mr Koustubh (similar name - apologies if I got you wrong) was friendly and warm.  All the same  -  we enjoyed the comfortable stay and food.  Thanks  Harish CB

We stayed during the weekend of Independence day and booked a club room for 03 nights.We were welcomed by Ms. Shivani at the reception and our checkin was smooth.The room asigned us had a beautiful view of doon valley.The indidan food was good and special thanks to Ms. Meena Gurung for cooperating with us right from our reservation request.Would certainly love to visit again in future.Thanks team Fortune!!!

I think its a one of the best Hotel in Hills with all the excellent service  and best location as Hotel at the Mall road,  open area for  breakfast with the scenic view   and Hotel has its own parking space

Fortune Resort Grace is an excellent Hotel located perfectly at Library Chowk. Staff is very good very ever smiling welcome and greetings with "Namaste".  We opted for Valley View room with Balcony and it was perfect. The view from balcony was serene. Rooms are very well managed and are of decent size. Bathroom is very near and clean with all amenities.  It has open dining area which is awesome, have your meals breakfast and dinner here with pleasant view of valley with clouds coming and going. Awesome place, highly recommended. Breakfast spread is awesome with live counters of delicious dosa and eggs.  Would love to visit again. Best place in Mussorie with Mall road at 5 min walking only.

all the facilities in the hotel are awesome. and best thing is that we r staying with babies and as many time we ask for making the baby food they do it without any delay.... it was the best thing ...

We were lucky enough to be able to make the booking in this hotel in a very reasonable price. Amazing staff, very spacious  rooms, courteous  supporting staff specially the gatekeeper with a big moustache who would always welcome us with a gracious smile!!  Very delicious food and undoubtedly we enjoyed staying at this hotel.  P.s. Readers do not over think just make this place your first choice for the stay!!

Was stay there on 29th and 30th of July. Quality of food is good, staff in very gentle and supporting make my trip good. only request i would like to say that if some parents stay there and if they ask for Milk for there kids please do not include in bill. believe me your ranking go much higher. Rest is very nice alike room's were clean, service is also very fast and quality of food is out standing.

I stayed in this hotel in early July-2017 with family for one night. Hotel property is just at the entry of Mall road, on the hill. The view from the room is fantastic. You actually feel to be on top of the clouds. Breakfast spread is also good. And food is tasty. What is not good is the way this hotel is maintained. There was water leakage in our washroom and water was coming and filling whole washroom. Even though I made complaint with front desk, they took no action. After filling the whole washroom with water, it actually was stinking. Front desk is extremely lazy. For the amount they charge, the maintenance of the hotel is terrible. Not a kind of Fortune hotel which you will visit at other places.

The property has a small main gate but the name has enough credibility to make you enter in. it is a beautiful hotel with a perfect location. Yes, I did feel that I was living over the clouds. The sitting space outside provides a perfect view of the mountains and even has a provision to have your meals served there,also accompanied by an open kitchen. Though the rooms are very comfortable but they do have a provision to accommodate more luxury which would actually add more positives points to this hotel. Having said that, the breakfast is something that needs some improvement, especially in terms of adding more variety and live kitchen items.

So we stayed in the so called family suite.... it was nothing like a suite... just a standard interconnecting rooms with a balcony. we went there in the month of July could be there peak time but  we paid a good amount of around 18,000 +++ for a night. and the stay could have not been worst.... in all the aspects our stay at the hotel was disappointing.

Location of this hotel is very appropriate but there are few places where this hotel lacks. Rooms are suffocated and are quite smelly. Beds are not comfortable as the mattress are too soft for the back. There is no lift in this hotel. I feel if you are a tasteful traveller and like to stay at good properties then this hotel is not for you.  Rest is on the availability of rooms in the queen of hills.

I have stayed in many 4-5 star properties all across India, but this one wins my heart by a long long margin.  First it's location - absolutely near to the mall road - which is the most happening place in the hills. The hotel is old but very very well maintained. A day before our arrival the hotel gave us a call asking for our check in time - only few hotel chains regard their customer to this high level. I was on a holiday with family and friends. We were 2 families and they provided us an interconnected rooms - which won our heart - a privilege, I believe, only few hotels can provide. We checked in to find ultra spacious room which was in the vicinity to the child place area which had stock of games for children and also interesting ones for their parents.   We ordered food in…

This a luxurious and well maintained hotel. Lives up to standards of ITC hotels. It may look a bit shoddy from distant but it's a well maintained and one of the best properties in Mussoorie. It has all the amenities one can expect from a great hotel - gymnasium, kids play area, recreation room, wellness and spa. Open terrace is blissful and having dinner there is an amazing feeling. Hotel staff is well trained and helpful, everyone has a smile on their face when they greet the guests, be it the security guard at the main door or the folks working inside the hotel. Breakfast menu is sumptuous and quality of the food is of higher standard. I recommend this hotel to all the people traveling to Mussoorie.

Very kind and supportive staff. Walkable distance from the main square. Walkable to markets. Beautiful landscapes behind the hotel. Stay was very comfortable. I had asked for extra bed for my kid and I was surprised that the they put the bed on the floor though I remember them mentioning about this during the booking. I have always loved ITC properties at hill stations. Breakfast and dinner buffet included in my plan and I must say they had a very good variety. I being a south indian didn't like the sambar they did but it was not bad either.  Stayed two nights only. The room was spacious. The only disappointing thing about the stay was that there was no view. We couldn't open the window as there was monkey menace. The window opens to a side walkway the worst view anyone can get.…

Amazing hotel to stay . At a good location . Breakfast spread is good . Close to the Mall Road . View from open area of restaurant is wonderful . Room size is also good . Quiet hotel with al amenities just lacking swimming pool .............

Fortune grace Mussoorie- march 2017 Stayed there twice, one of the Good hotels in Mussoorie, nice location ( just at starting of Musoorie mall road ) & good views.  Enjoy a walk to camell rock in the morning, Small but comfy rooms. Every thing is good about the hotel.  ( its a hotel not a resort ) Good staff

Rooms are nice, cleaned, bit less spacious but manageable. Hotel's location is near Library bazaar, 2 mins walking distance from mall road. A nice property but price of the room is bit higher as compared to the size and facility of the room/hotel.

Overall - Thumbs Up ( read the disclaimers below first)  Pro 1) located at a great location at Library side. I prefer Picture palace better since that area is happening. What i mean by Great location is that it is very conveniently located on the start of mall road, not far away like other premium resorts NOR it is up the hill.   2) excellent infrastructure with Kids play area, Open balcony, view  Con 1) Major con - we went there in middle of summer vacations and cabs were not available on the return day towards Doon. The reception manager just shook his hands off saying he cant help. Well not that nothing cant be done, its the matter of sending a runner to Taxi stand ( 5 min away) and hailing a taxi back to hotel. He wasnt ready to send his boys. I understand his written hotel…

Was visiting my Alma mater after 30 years ! Am happy we chose to stay here for 3 nights. The rooms were spacious with the required amenities. The service ~ right from the doormen, front office staff, restaurant servers & housekeeping staff was commendable. They pulled out all the stops for breakfast to give guests a variety of options & a well balanced spread. We tried the dinner buffet but I'm sure they can do better. The Spa has a beautiful view & the masseuses were adept at loosening out the knots & helping us relax after our serene walks along Camel's Back Road, the Mall and Landor. Not that it is important (since we have Google) but in my humble opinion more information about adventure sports should be readily available. Like Bungy Jumping, River Rafting in Rishikesh. etc.…

We stayed in the valley view balcony room at this resort for 1 night in June and had a great time. The rooms are extremely spacious, the balcony offers great view of the doon valley. The breakfast buffet had a good spread, we ordered in room dining twice and the food was good both times. The only 2 things I did not like at this hotel was a) that the bathrooms were really tiny and b) that it is located right at the chowk where there is traffic always and the pollution is soo bad that I literally felt that I have smoked a pack of cigarettes.

Great staff . Best experience. I was here for 5 nights and the experience and the hospitality was great. This was my third time in this hotel n we loved the hotel this time too.staff is very helpful and the kids section is good too. Food is on a better side compared to old visits.

It was our first visit to this up kept luxury destiny and was one of its kind. I would like to thank the entire management and every team member of this hotel for a memorable stay.  I would be back soon and will spread the word that this is the place to be in Mussorie .  Thanks again.

This was our 3rd time at this hotel in last 8 years. And I have seen it deplete in quality every time we visited. We were there from May 26-29, and in a group of 20 people. We had occupied 7 of their rooms. We were given rooms with balcony on the 1st floor, which is three floors down from the reception (without an elevator). The floor was stinking like a gutter throughout our stay. We informed the management many times about this, and we were given no concrete answer. Everytime we complained, their would light up some essential oils, but that didn't help. As a result, we either stayed restricted to the room, or at the reception with our group. Rooms need an urgent attention. It is not how ITC properties should be! Broken corners, shaking chairs! ufff!!! Food is average! Though…

The hotel is located at Library Bazaar which is at one end of the Mall Road. So you can easily walk down at any hour of the day and enjoy the Mall Road without being bothered about commuting related issues. It has free parking. We opted for a valley view room with a balcony. The room size was small but it was comforting in its own way with all the basic amenities. It was located on level two of the basement and the hotel does not have a lift so this gave us a little hard time as we had infants and elders with us. The breakfast spread was decent. We ordered Room Service on the nights we stayed. It was also decent but the variety was limited. Play centre is good. They also have a gym and spa centre which we did not use. Overall, a good experience.

Fortune Grace Resort is a nice property to visit with family. USP of this hotel is its location. Mall road starts just you come out from the hotel. Nearby eating options are avilable incase you do not want to eat in hotel. I had a velly view room which had an amazing view of velly.  Room was neat and clean and staff was good.  Bar has been closed here due to some givernment law enforcement in Apr17. Hotel has beautiful Kids room,My kids enjoyed alot there.  Food is OK and can be done much better but I understand its a hilly property. In that regard food is OK.  It was a happy holiday.

Me and my wife stayed at fortune resort grace for 2 nights and stay was awesome.. The staff is really courteous, warm and helpful. Everything was worth the price paid. The food was very delicious in restaurant and in room dining. Got a valley view room and the view was amazing. Just too good, loved it. Thanks for the hospitality.

Stayed here for two nights in April with my family. It is end of the Mall Road so the location is very good. We actually took two rooms - one with Mountain view and one without view and actually found the rooms without view bigger and better. So if you are traveling with kids, the rooms without the view would be a better option I think. The rooms were modern and comfortable but you need to switch on the heater 20 mins before you a take a shower!!  We were there on a long weekend and the hotel was really packed!! While the staff were generally helpful, the check in took an disbelievingly long time, which was really frustrating. It has a kids play room which was great for the kids. friends trust me its pathetic than dharamshala of a town, my guest stayed in room no: 404 dated 20 may at the time of check we found used room provided to us.  chips,biscuits,wine bottle, broken hair all over the room. smell not able to disclose, after a big debate they just cleaned and provided the water bottles etc and my agent talk in front of me that they will upgrade my room next morning but at the time of check out they said no rooms available and talk to the guy who committed you yesterday. its itc group of hotels and ranking is five star.  for any further clarification poke us will give you the client name and number to get complete details.

Awesome hotel awesome staff awesome hospitality rooms are clean .... Mall road is just outside the hotel which is a big convenience...staff is very friendly and helpful ... Breakfast buffet is awesome must visit ... I have been to Mussoorie so many times but this is the most convenient hotel I could find....

We were surprised to see cement encroachment at Queen of hills Mussoorie.still it is beautiful place to visit.this particular hotel is at excellent location close to mall road.you can take a quick walk on it. Food quality is excellent.service very prompt, room size is small.  (we had booked valley view superior rooms)

It is really a very nice hotel with excellent view of the valley and with open air terrace restaurant. If travelling with kids it has a very beautiful and large play area.  It is practically at one end of Mall road so all you have to do is walk a few steps and you are the mall road.  Only problem I faced was the food needed better treatment. Thats the only weak point they have.

The Fortune grace Mussorie's  is centrally located at library road end, the welcome is warm and the view from a valley view room is excellent, The rooms are just about Ok and definitely could do with some improvements like AC maintenance , better towels etc , the breakfast has a nice sit out area but it is advised to go early , as during season time rush handling and service becomes a challenge , . I am very sad that i have booked this hotel. The hotel management says it is 5 star hotel but its not a 5 star hotel. the hotel name is FORTUNE RESORT GRACE. what does 5 star resort means ? ... There is no swimming pool in the hotel..neither it have lift nor it have play ground. My friend & I stayed at this property for 2 days. Honestly, we made a spontaneous trip to Mussorrie and hence it wasn't planned. We went to this place to get a room & the staff was okay. I think the prices was way higher as compared to the room & the decor.  The location is hectic as the moment you walk out of the hotel, you get to see the everything possible on the road. I wouldn't recommend this place to those who would like to go to quiet places to get away from the hustle-bustle of a city.  However, if you want something close to the market and this is the place for you. We had an okay experience. I wouldn't say awesome or great.

Very well located at the library chowk overlooking the valley . From valley view rooms the panaromic view of the valley is superb. Rooms are comfortable but the interior furniture needs a cosmetic makeup.Clean linen and comfortable beds made up for the much utilized wooden furniture.Food quality very good. The restaurant overlooking the valley is a place where its a joy to have your hunger satisfied. You are in the midst of start of mall road as you step out of the hotel. Overall a good experience and comfortable stay at Fortune Grace.

This hotel was a gem in musoorie, The rooms were large and the view was spectacular , the location was perfect as it was on the corner of the Library, right in the Centre of Mall Road , it was right next to the Taxi Stand , and Cycle rickshaws were readyily available , coming back to the hotel , the service was incredible, they had complementary breakfast , which was phenomenal , they had fruit , all sorts , toasts , cheese , pancakes,cheese toast , oatmeal , cornflakes , dosas and idlis , poha , juices and a whole range of non veg food , it was our wedding anniversary and they arranged a small party in our room with cake and sparklers , they suggested places we should visit , they were very knowledgeable , clothes were pressed and washed , we had a beautiful time , the view…

A good property near to library square ....though access has narrow road like all other hotels ...good food ....restaurant on big Terrace  ideal place to hang around .....good service ...rooms spacious clean with good toiletries ....

We stayed here as a family. The check in took 1 hour and they expedited it after we complained. The good at the restaurant also arrived after 50 minutes - we ordered snacks.. They also forgot one dish. The hotel arranged a car for us to go on a tour. The driver asked for more money than agreed..   The only good thing was the soft bed and the view.

We stayed in Mid February for couple of nights and spent our anniversary there. It was a pleasant stay and our 2 yr old son enjoyed a lot. Their kids play area is well stocked and is safe for kids. Buffet had a wide selection and food was generally good. Overall the staff is very courteous including the security personnel who became friends with my son :) . Rooms are very clean and chic and hotel location is great.  Our only gripe was with hot water availability, we had to complain but i guess it is like what it is. The bathtub is rendered useless coz of that and needs to be fixed.

rooms were clean and food was awesome.the staff was bery polite and helpful.the front desk was very helpful.Gaming room was up to date and had all types of games like video games and physical games also.value for money

Spent two nights at this hotel with family and had a great time. Got a great room with a balcony and a view. Had breakfast and dinner as part of our package and the food was excellent. The hotel has a large play area for kids and hence the children just loved the place. Couple of things worth noting - There are monkeys which move early in the morning on the roof and this can disrupt sleep. Also the hotel is at various levels and is missing a lift. Would love visiting again in future.

Nice clifftop hotel based half way up the mountain near the beginning of the touristy Library Bazaar/Mall Road entrance with restaurants & shops. Quiet despite being close to main road. Taxis nearby to go to different tourist attractions. Clean and tidy. Spacious rooms. Wi-fi. Staff all friendly and helpful from Security to Doormen to Bell Boys to Reception to Floor Managers...all greet you with a Namaste. Buffet breakfast great with amazing views down the mountain - sit inside or outside on balcony. Thanks to Nitesh for his friendly service at breakfast. Critique: towels need to be replaced as a little worn out; would like see some Western food in with the breakfast buffet for the foreigners - but hey, I am in India :) Otherwise, a very good hotel. Highly recommend to use.…

lovely place to stay , nice ambience lovely everything , whenever booking fortune do remember there are two fortune hotels the savoy and grace , savoy is higher end with big open lawns  its bit compact but equally good

Do not spoil your holiday by going here. The ITC standards are a big joke! At midnight the staff are doing maintenance and other room occupants are getting wild too. Had to complaint about something or other every pathetic hour we stayed here!  Only good thing which deceives you to stay here is location.. but dont be deceived by that... lot of good options around which can fulfill that!  Never booking ITC again! Will make official management complaint. Smelly rooms dirty bathrooms and awful staff. Am sure none of u would want to pay 8 grand a night for that....

Each Successive Visit is Better than the Previous One  We keep on visiting Mussoorie off and on whenever we get time because of the vicinity of Mussoorie from Delhi. The town is, of course, an attraction but the still bigger attraction is the stay at Fortune Grace for which we keep on craving few days in advance of the visit. It takes us no time in getting adjusted to the cosiness of the room which is offered to us by the hotel desk staff. On the front desk Ms. Rekha was kind enough to make a call and enquire about the time of our arrival at the hotel. The reception staff offers a warm welcome as ever. I get the inner most pleasure in spending time at this hotel. Jesus was once asked when the Kingdom of God would come. Jesus replied that it is not something people will be able…

The hotel is located on the library end of mall road, which has a nice hustle-bustle vibe, from where you can take a cycle-rikshaw ride to the main mall road area for just 50 bucks. We took a valley view room without a balcony, and it was spacious and clean.  We had breakfasts and dinners at their restaurant and the food was quite delicious. The staff is super courteous and always smiling, willing to help you out in every which way.   Though it is small property by a 'resorts' standard with not much open space, but it has a nice warm feel to it.  There's a kids and gaming room to entertain kids and adults alike, with various indoor games. My wife tried the spa and she was quite happy with their service, though it is a bit expensive. There is a small gym too.  I would say that…

The hotel is located near library, mall road, Hence it is centrally located and markets on mall road is at walking distance. It has parking facility, Jym, Spa,children play room etc. There was also an open terrace adjacent to restaurant. The buffet served was fine. We enjoyed our stay in the hotel..

The hotel is conveniently situated at Library near the Mall Road. The hotel gives a good view of the valley from one side. Chose the valley view rooms. The hotel staff is very helpful and  efficient. The food served is good. The hotel has a play area for kids

Excellent Location at Library Chowk !   Experienced G4S Security !  Well Trained Staff !  Well decorated modern spacious rooms with valley view. AC and TV in the room. Courteous Staff, Wonderful food, Every part of the hotel is very clean, feels at home.  Good space for parking and walking. Nice place to have parties at the open terrace. Enjoyed our stay.

Our delightful experience at Fortune Resort Grace started right from the time of entering the hotel premises when we were greeted by the hotel staff with a Namaste and a warm and welcoming smile. This courtesy was extended by all staff members we came across. The hotel staff was very attentive and eager to please. Great service, excellent food. Our room was very comfortable with a panoramic view of the Doon valley. Hotel itself is very conveniently located right next to the Library at Mall Road. Overall : A 'must visit' property with very courteous staff.

It was a great property. We really felt wonderful. Service was amazing. Location is superb. Special thanks to the staff who really took great care of us. I would like to stay at Fortune Grace during my next visits as well. 👍👍👍👍

Lovely place with very courteous staff ideally located at library chowk with ample parking facilities with a great view of Doon valley from most of the room's.  Also if your looking for a place for business conference they have multiple room's for the same.  Will recommend to try their Fish tikka.

I had booked Fortune Grace ( FG) through Goibibo.  Located at the very center of mussorie, FG is an excellent example of hospitality at a reasonable price..since I was with a baby,our check in was quick n smooth. Senior staff made sure that the room warms up as it was quite chilly outside. Rooms are spacious n comfortable with almost all the basics that u can imagine..most of the rooms have a valley view. the room service staff is prompt n quick..in house dining is open 24 hrs with selected options..food though tasty is on an expensive side ( the only issue that I could find).                     The breakfast buffet spread is reasonably good and tasty. Two juices, fruits, bakery products, three types of breads, porridge, baked beans, corn, south Indian idli n dosas, vermicilli,…

Start from location, check inn and till check out enjoyed our trip. Good location humble staff,good food, rooms are good everything is good. They have ample parking space which is a plus point for hills hotels  Will visit again for sure

Overall a 4* star property with well equipped room and polite hospitality.  If you want to walk to the mall road, then this is an excellent hotel.   Only thing to remember is that hotel has only stairs and no lift/elevator.

stayed for 2 nights. Booked 3 rooms.Good views.Rooms,staff,food and facilities were good.Heating was not very good but they provided us with extra fan heaters which was excellent. Internet was good.They should have more veg dishes in the menu.I would recommend this hotel.

I stayed at Fotune grace with my family for 2 nights(6-7th Jan 2017) . Though I have been to Mussoorie quite a times & stayed at different hotels; staying at Fortune grace was a memorable one. The property is nestled at a place where one can see the picturize beautiful valley. Right from the reception, dining area, kids zone etc are well upkept. Though I stayed in their Standard room which don't have any view, it was comfortable. One can opt for other choices if cared for valley view.The hotel staff is very friendly & cooperative. Good food, great ambience makes this property worth staying. As it's located near the mall, one can come out & roam around easily.

I stayed in the hotel for 2 nights with my family and 2 of my relative's family. I enjoyed my stay in the hotel. The location of the hotel is very good, very close mall road. The hotel staff was very cordial and the services offered were very good. Overall a very good experience with the hotel and would surely book it on my next visit.

This November, we went to Dehradun and onwards to Mussoorie and stayed at the Fortune Resort Grace. This was our first visit to Mussoorie and we absolutely loved it. The hotel is very close to the Library Chowk at the entrance of the Mall Road. We had taken two adjoining rooms having valley view….n it was fantastic. The rooms were very clean and well maintained. Despite the cold outside, the hotel apparently has central heating and was very pleasant. The food was amazing and the staff were very friendly and helpful. Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed the experience and would definitely love to make a return trip. kudos to all the staff.

prime location, Very good rooms, my family enjoyed lot. Service is appreciable, Food quality is very good, quick response of the staff.  Over all good experience , every one can enjoy staying in this hotel

One of the best hotel exactly at the end of the Mall Road Mussoorie. The location is a big advantage of it. Now coming to the hotel the ambience is superb, the view is stunning, food is excellent. The staff is very  helpful and everything is at par. The spa is still not open and is under renovation was the only drawback.

We had very nice stay at Fortune Resort Grace. This is located just at the starting of Mall road at 5 minute walking distance. Room is quite spacious and well-maintained. We stayed in valley view room which gives breathtaking view of Doon valley. Food was delicious with nice spread. Staff was very courteous with great hospitality. Hotel has recreational facilities including kid’s play area. This is an added advantage for families like us having kid.  In totality, must recommended hotel and would definitely visit again this hotel!!

I am a fan of mussoorie, you would inevitably find good weather here around the year. There are some places/hotels here which you cannot afford to miss. Fortune Grace is one of them.   Located right at the entrance of mall road on library chowk it saves you a lot of pain for going through mall road but still saving on the proximity when u want to have a walk at mall road.   The main attraction of this hotel is the open terrace where you can have breakfast or lunch admist the picturesque mountain and view of doon valley.   Fortune Grace has nice spacious rooms with courteous staff. I would recommend it as a MUST STAY if you are in Mussoorie

We stayed here from 27 to 29 November 2016 in room no 604. Hotel has good views, rooms are good but bathrooms stink. We made complains even to housekeeping and we were provided a room freshener that's it. Still after using it that bathroom used to stink you couldn't even stay there for more than 2 mins. So we had to stay in a room with a stinking bathroom only which was a horrible experience. Breakfast buffet was good but for dinner buffet we were asked to take ala carte from menu itself. Food was good though in buffets you get more options. We came from taxi from Rishikesh but our driver was taken on last day from hotel main gate as Mussoorie taxi union doesn't allow outside taxis if they take tourists back from Mussoorie. So hotel had to arrange another taxi for us. Please…

Amazing staff, delicious food and gr8 hospitality! This is my review of this hotel in Mussoorie.  A few staff members to remember : Mr.Jitender - the doorman with his "namaste", Mr.Sachin, Ms Rekha & Mr.Neeraj @ the reception, Mr.Narendra, Mr.Arjun & Mr.Rajveer @ Orchid were a treat : my wife & me were floored by their warmth.  Will surely come back and njoy their hospitality : Soon!  BTW, do not miss the spa!!

I have stayed in many hotels but personally Fortune Resort Grace has the best location with a fabulous view overlooking the doon valley, we opted for valley view rooms with balcony, rooms were very crisp & clean with a very nice cozy feel to it & also the view from the sit out space from the balcony was very breathtaking which gives a nice feel of nature and weather. The welcoming and escorting was good and the staff is quite friendly and helpful, well groomed & courteous and they went out of the way to make our stay a memorable stay as one feels to be known and to be at home. The buffet spread was good along with a great variety and the food actually tasted good. The other highlight was the great gaming facility for adults, teen and children from where again you have a…

The Fortune Resort Grace works as the perfect choice for a family getaway in Mussoorie. We were floored with the warmth of the staff, the prompt and courteous service, delicious food reflective of what all ITC hotel brands are known for and the excellent location of the hotel. Our children thoroughly enjoyed the Kids Recreation room and the view from our room and the restaurant terrace is breathtaking. Unlike many hill station hotels, this hotel has a parking of it's own with enough space to handle all resident guest cars even if all of their 75 rooms are occupied. We had a memorable weekend largely because of the excellent advice the hotel team members gave on what to prioritise amongst the several things to do at Mussoorie in the 2 days we had...Overall, a memorable experience…

Beauty on Top of the Doon Valley  I feel that all the hotels associated with the ITC brand have something distinctly adorable; my this feeling became stronger and stronger with my each successive stay in ITC brand hotels; and of late, this premise is converted into a strong faith for me that Fortune Grace is another embellishment in the brand ITC and is working dedicatedly for keeping the ITC flag high in India.  I love my journeys as a nature enthusiast, when every two months, after spending much of my time under fluorescent lighting and in front of a glowing screen, I try to find escape in the lap of nature.  This hotel becomes special and symbolic for me; I vividly store the memories of intense and concentrated beauty of the valleys and the landscape, the birds and animals…

I with my wife stayed at the property for 2 days last weekend. It was a nice stay at this hotel. The rooms are good with Valley View of Dehradun which at night is just like stars twinkling. The food is also great. The Staff is warm & friendly.  Will love to stay at this hotel again whenever we come to mussoorie.

1. Standard rooms have no view of anything - opaque glass is all you get. Depressing rooms with no natural sunlight 2. Service attitude at front desk could be better - took 3 rounds of phone calls to get Wi-Fi password-they simply refused to believe that I  hadn't got it on sms  3. Moment of truth fail - owing to the 500/1000 ban, was stuck for cash to pay a local cab. Asked hotel to charge my debit card and pay the cab-  they flat out refused on "policy" grounds. Would have appreciated help instead of rude refusal.  I guess I would rate the hotel average if one can overlook the rooms without a view, but my service requirements were a fail, so going with what I felt.

its a very well located property, just at the start of the mall road. You can park your car at the hotel, and then go for a walk at the mall.  the view of  the valley from the rooms, and the terrace (where you can take your breakfast and dinner) is beautiful.  food is good, the staff is very helpful.   although, avoid taking the balcony rooms, as the non-balcony rooms above can see completely in your balcony, which hampers privacy.

Just stayed in this hotel and had a pretty good experience . Location wise it is very good just next to the gandhi chowk taxi stand. All eateries, markets are at a walking distance. We took a room with balcony and had an awesome view from our room. Staff is really good and helpful. Breakfast spread was quite descent. Rooms are nice , though they should have some room heating options too as during evenings room was very cold. Only dissapointing factor was the bathroom. The size is quite small and we had a major drainage problem in the shower as every 2 mins the water would stand while taking a shower and just wouldn't drain out. We informed the housekeeping staff but the problem remained.  Rest our stay was quite comfortable and hassle free.

Staff was extremely courteous. Valley view room was just breathtaking. More so in the night where you can see glitters of Dehradun from your room (I occupied Room No 309) just the same as you notice from an airplane window on approaching a city. The interiors need an urgent touch up and furniture require a make over. Understaffed as it seems during peak service period like the breakfast timing. Gymming was good. Food was average. Location is great as it is on the start of Mall Road. Special mention of their front desk staff Ms Rekha who was just superb.

A very well located property just at the start of Mall. Your car can go right upto the hotel. A bit old but still a decent place to stay. Gud bfast spread and nice food. Excellent Spa facility by highly skilled professional both for ladies & gents.   I got a complimentary upgrade courtesy Sachin, a nice person handling my check-in. Vijay in Restaurant was also very courteous and gud at his work.   Only problem is Gym, some equipments very old n not properly maintained.  Overall if at Mussoorie, a gud place to stay.

We stayed here for 2N. It's a very well located hotel , right in the beginning of mall road , which makes all the action walkable. The staff of the hotel is very courteous,  and quick to respond.The breakfast spread is quite nice. The rooms are well maintained ,However the property is quite old and may need to be refurbished.

We stayed with them from 9 to 12 oct. this year.The property is fantastic and is located on Mall road Mussoorie. Excellent location with good parking space.The rooms are neat but require a face-lift as the decor is now outdated.The F/ B is real good .The staff is very cooperative and the hospitality is great.

Stayed in this hotel from 7th to 11th  Location : soooperb ....at the start of mall road ( library side) your campus gates opens on the mall road.....all shops..eateries....hustlebustle happening at your doorsteps....the rooms face the valley with exotic doon valley view Views : the best views come from the dining area and the terrace but my favourte was from kids area and the spa area.....yi are literally flying in sky Food : food was awesome.....the chefs are good and service very promp....the complimentry breakfast has a grand variety.....and the rates are quite resonable Rooms : clean and spacious but the extra bed was only a mattress layed on floor Surprisingly they have split unit ac and fans in room Negative :: how did the architect miss the elevators.......??? It was a…

Excellent Hotel in MUSSOORIE with great hospitality and it's location is an additional advantage. Rooms are neatly managed. Variety of foods are available though north Indian cuisine is better for the rest the Chef need to work.

Great hotel with excellent location(Near to Mall road). There was a lot variety in the buffet. Food was really good. Rooms are comfortable. Service is also nice. They also a have an additional play area for the kids.

I traveled with my parents, wife and one year old daughter and I liked the property very much. My review and recommendations can be made out from the review below:  - amazing staff: professional, well suited, etiquettes, all were at least at part with any for star hotel around, may be better. They let us in earlier than check in time and leave a bit late then check out time. Responsive, friendly and very quick I must say.  - location is brilliant. It is located exactly at peace library just outside the mall road barrier with all the access to mall road and taxis and cars can anytime get in and out of the hotel at anytime during day or night.  - kids recreation facility was a well equipped room with facilities for 1 year to 10 year old kids. Also, it had table tennis, air hockey,…

The location of the hotel is ideal and yet it offers a great quiet stay! Front desk was very helpful, gave us upgrade upon arrival, a room with balcony! very nice and comfortable room, excellent service. The staff was very polite and courteous. Overall a great stay, the spa was also very good.

We visited with a group of friends for our monthly get together... The check in was fast and smooth.. The rooms with balcony and valley view are good but a bit small... The food was okay.. But the presentation was pathetic... Service was good... The buffet breakfast was good.. Overall a nice experience...

It was first vacation of my 1 yr old and it could not have been better. From security to reception to room service, you will be received with so much warmth that will enable your stay wonderful. Every employee deserves a big round of applause for the awesome work they are doing and should deserve a bonus :-). We stayed in the valley facing balcony room which was good. There is a recreational area for kids, which is really cool and we spend quite some time there. Travel tip: If travelling with an infant you can order the 'khichdi' which is really good. Try to get the valley facing balcony room.

I visited this hotel beginning of august.Rooms are good. Really I enjoyed their food.staffs are very good. Very good hospitality. Hotel is in nice place and good view. Thanks for all Staff and management.

This property at Mussourie is the best place to stay. Right from the hotel rooms to their service to the food served here is bang on ! Visited in Sept with friends and the staff couldnt have been more polite, organised and efficient. It was a leisure trip organized by the company and we were close to 20 in number!  All our rooms were not just clean, cosy and organized; they made sure that every room was equipped as per special instructions given. Hats off to the team!

After trying all 4 star and 5 star properties during my 5 days stay at Mussoorie, Fortune Grace has the best F & B quality to offer at that price. Only J W Marriot matches it but off course at a high price. Fortune Grace have minimal items of wine and spirits on its menu but they are good and pairs well with the right quality food offered in their menu

this hotel has an unusual layout. we go into the lobby and then go down many flights of steps to access TINY rooms which have the most incredible view from a tiny balcony! what a pleasant surprise. though the room is so small that a stamp is bigger. The view is grand. The location is perfect. just walk down from mall road and enter the jhotel. the restaurant is lovely with decent food and fantastic night views

We have been exploring nature by visiting all important towns in India; searching for opportunities for reflection; which can provide us space so that a more contemplative frame of mind can open up - leading to deeper insights, clearer understanding of mother nature and also to liberation through attaining trance like conditions by flying freely like clouds in the blue sky at Kulri. Kufri or Ridge Mall Road while at the same time simultaneously savoring exclusive hospitality of some exquisite hotels and resorts in India. What makes me feel truly at home while being out of home is Fortune Grace at Mussorie; I experience a profound calmness while staying there; joyously and blissfully stepping out some times in the day for having leisure stroll at Library Chowk which is all day…

Best place in mussorie.The rooms are good and clean.i stayed in room no 110,The main thing is that the size of the room is big,you can roam easily in the room because of its large space.and one of the special thing it's valley view which is easily seen by the room balcony ans also from by hotels large terrace ,there u enjoy most beautiful moments .the food quality is excellent and like the most. There is only one drawback in the hotel is lift. Lift is not in the hotel.

The hotel is located right at the end of Mall road. The hotel has excellent staff. We loved our stay, The Orchid Restaurant serving buffet breakfast, lunch and dinner has a good valley view and is very well done up. The Terrace which serves as an open air lounge has a good sitting arrangement with a fabulous valley view. The hotel has a small but well equipped children play . The main attraction - Kempty falls is about 15Kms from this hotel and all other places are within 10 KMs of this place. We would love to stay in hotel again

Hotel is very good, staff (Mr. Neeraj, Rakesh, Bhupendra & vijay) are very helpful & Friendly. Hotel is very neat n clean.  Best part is mall road is on walk-able distance from the hotel, Biggest parking is in mussoorie.

Recently visited Mussoorie , stayed at Fortune Resorts Grace Mussoorie , the finest hotel on the Mall Road . Best part of the hotel is its location and having plenty of parking space . We were given valley view room with balcony it gives you awesome view of Doon valley . Also like to thank General Manager Mr. SINGH & Mohitji , Shivani , Neeraj , Meena & other hotel staff  for making our stay comfortable enough , it was my third visit to this hotel and found better & better every time . Also like to congratulate entire team of Fortune Grace for maintaining highest label of guest satisfaction among Mussoorie hotel . You all are doing wonderful job ...Keep it up. Good wishes .

The hotel staff promised us to provide the balcony rooms, but provided the other. Walking distance from the Library Chowk. Food was good, in breakfast they try to cover all regions of India. Fog was not there when we visited.

The place is nice cosy and it is walking distance from the Library Chowk.On the Mall and away from the din.Lots of entertainment for kids and good choices on the menu.They serve a scrumptious breakfast,food is really good and the staff is very hospitable,right from the guard at both the gates and each and every staff at Grace.We chose theValley facing rooms with the balcony and we did capture beautiful views.Beware of the monkeys,t hey are always on the prowl for anything and everything  Fortune Grace certainly is value money

Positive :  Great location right at the start of Mall Road where evening is fantastic  Great food though a bit expensive (Eat dinner at Mall road) View from room is very nice and rooms are excellent Parking is available which is a luxury at Mussoorie Kid play zone makes it right hotel with kids Easily accessible for all places to visit in Mussoorie  Negative :   Not the right place if you want quiteness   Final Verdict :  Should Stay

It was a memorable experience during our stay at Fortune Grace. Right from booking confirmation done by Meena, Manager Mr Mohit's warm hospitality and amazingly well groomed, courteous restaurant staff of Vijay and Sanjay made our stay very comfortable.  We checked in on 10th July evening with my wife and two infant twin girls aged 9 months. The Valet service was very friendly.  We checked into a beautiful room with a nice balcony facing the entire valley . Light drizzle, mystical weather and cool breeze made the whole weather beautifully romantic and serene and the whole property of Fortune Grace was so luxurious , be it the Gym, Restaurant, Reception Area, Kids playing area, Open air restaurant view facing the valley, courteous staff made the stay comfortable. we only moved…

"Best Location with Wonderful Experience.." that's how i can define Fortune Resort Grace, Mussoorie.  Located right at the Library chowk at the Mall entrance, we loved the stay here. Smooth check in and very courteous and helpful staff, the hotel has great ambience and buffet spread was quite lavish.  We were two families with kids. The staff is most cheerful making you feel at home, instantly, from the welcome at the entrance to the overall conduct,  I must also not forget to mention Prashant, who takes great pains to ensure that your order is made to perfection ! such is his dedication ! terrific experience always to dine there.

We stayed here during the weekend after Diwali and I would rate our stay as a very relaxing and comfortable one. Thanks to the nice hospitality provided by the hotel staff. The rooms are quite big in size with a very comfortable bed. The toilets are clean and of decent size. The staff is very friendly and helpful at all times. Check-in and check-out process is quick. The parking lot is quite big and offers a very scenic view of the valley. The hotel is very well located at the library chowk end of the Mall road.  The Kids Zone in this hotel is the best place where you can leave your kids along with other kids to have great fun. We were two families and our kids had an amazing time at this place. Plenty of games for kids as well as adults (pool table, TT table, Foosball, chess,…

The good:  Approach from Dehradun is excellent, location is great - within 100 meters of Library point, and parking space is in plenty.  Check-in is fast and efficient. The reception staff very graciously ventured out to adjust the applicable taxes within the quoted price - practically an approx 10% discount, and this, without even asking. That it was off-season time was obviously of help. Room service was fast and efficient.   The property is well managed and beautiful, though no garden here. The eating area on the terrace has a great view indeed and its a pleasure to eat here. Didn't get the chance to use their gym or spa or children's play area, but reviews sounded good.  Overall, the first impression you get is good and inspires confidence.  The not-so-good:  Although the…

Very centrally located just next to Library Chowk . Approach road is narrow and tricky, same for Shilton Hotel and Hotel Fortune Grace. They have enough parking space. Mall road is around 100 to 150 metres from the hotel. The check-in was smooth and quick. The ambience of the reception and hotel is good. The staff was courteous.  The restaurant is just opposite the reception and food was very good. The rooms are good and so are the bathrooms. The cleanliness is good.  The room service was quick. The only problem is some of the rooms do not have a nice view and it seems a bit expensive hotel. There is recreation area for children and adults on the 5th floor and is good.

Took a short break with family, planned at the last moment at this beautiful hotel. The location is perfect, the views mesmerising, the food delicious, the personalised attention and service left little to be done, except to laze and take in the faint smell of pine trees. They were managing at least 15 toddlers on the property with ease. The Management, particularly Mohit holding Fort at the Front office and a gracious General Manager made it difficult for the family to leave the Hotel. The F&B service personnel too were very attentive to individual tastes and soon learnt the likes and dislikes of my kids. The Hotel also has a well equipped play area to keep kids engaged during in-house hours. We would highly recommend this wonderful hotel for a family getaway and  we surely…

An excellent hotel located right at the beginning of the mall road as soon as you enter mussoorie. Ample parking space and very well organized. The rooms are great and the ambience is very refreshing once you enter the hotel. Staff is very polite however some improvement is required in terms of attention to guests once the restaurant gets busy although the staff efficient otherwise.  Food is very good and especially the terrace restaurant is a very nice place to relax. The valley view rooms with balcony are very nice and a nice plavce to relax within the room and enjoy the weather. Overall a great experience and a must stay place.

Hotel receptionist was trying to get more money for the taxi service I requested.  I refused to accept, I use other hotel's service for my trip. The location is poor, taxi driver could not locate it. Food is so so.

An exceptional hospitality was displayed by the staff of the hotel which set the right mood for all of us. Service was simply outstanding by 'RAJU' with food complimenting it to the extreme. Very humble and knowledgeable staff created the appropriate environment of relaxation with fun at their Terrace. Ambiance, food preparation and presentation, service all were elegantly handled displaying real professionalism...

The hospitality was pleasing. This was my second visit to Mussoorie and I was in many ways better than my previous visit for which a lot of credit goes to my stay at Fortune. Food was delectable and service was quicker than expected. Also the location of the hotel is mesmerizing.

Me and my wife visited the hotel in mid October. ....and she was so happy to see the hotel....we were greeted well. .. Check in was speedy and we were informed well about the facilities available. .. .The rooms were neat clean,  comfy and spacious. ...we were even provided room up gradation from standard to valley facing room.  Bathroom was also very neat with all the needs met...hot water, hair dryer and all other items one might like ....  We only had breakfast in hotel as rest of time we were outing in mussoorie. ... breakfast menu was full of options. .. from north Indian to south Indian specialities along with continental food Staff was courteous and helping A bit expensive. .. but luxury do comes at a price Overall a very good experience

Amazing location with a very well trained staff, amazing food and hospitality. Loved the location of the room along with the Balcony.Kids enjoyed a lot at re-creation center. Worth Staying. Great job team.

Excellent & Attentive Service. I visited Orchid at Fortune Resort Grace last week for the first time & was amazed to see the attentiveness & warmth of the service team. Special thanks to Mr Rakesh who took special care of my family members & there needs. Its a great place to visit with family.

A decent hotel in Mussoorie with basic amenities.. Most basic thing of having central heated water is not there , so u have to wait for turns to get geyser to heat up and that water is also quite less .. Seems they have small geysers .. Rooms are nice but small ... Food is quite decent though ...location is the best in Mussoorie ... Right on left side of library with huge parking space in the hotel .. Staff is quite helpful ...

I just booked this hotel as it is run by Fortune group, but i am sorry to say its a chit on the name of fortune brand. Cleaning is very bad especially in lobby washrooms and same with the rooms, morning breakfast is ok type but it also need to improve a lot.  Please please please improve your cleaning of rooms and of washrooms

I was initially hesitant when this was booked as some fellow TA travellers were not so upbeat about the property, however when we got here I was pleasantly surprised. The hotel is a fairly 3 to 4 star property and modern. Don't expect it to be on par with ITC properties in large cities but that being said, it was clean / comfortable with efficient staff.   Ramesh at the restaurant deserves a special mention as he is undoubtedly one of the most pro active people I have met at a dining area. He put up with my endless requests due to the fact that we have two small children, and was ever courteous.   The view from the coffee shop is to die for and the location priceless, being right on mall road. The one low point is that it does not have a lift but no harm in a little exercise as…

best in service, best in comfort best in every thing. stay in fortune become unforgettable stay of my life. its the best place for stay in mussoorie. i will suggest my frendz to stay in this hotel when evry thy visit mussoorie.

I made last minute booking with only one standard room available. It has been a good experience staying with Fortune. Yes, I missed the balcony and valley view, but we enjoyed other things of the hotel. It is nicely located at the Mall. The food is great for all cuisines for South and North Indians. The kid zone added more relaxation and fun time for my son, 3 years old. We spent most of the time at the kid zone. It is nicely equipped for kids upto 5. Internet is very expensive about Rs. 500 for 24 hours. The staff at the buffets is very friendly, also handled our son very well helping to prepare the dishes for him. The rooftop buffet is nice with wide view of the valley. We spent many hours after dinner at rooftop enjoying the cool breeze and clouds. The room service needs…

We had a great stay at Fortune . The best part being , it being situated so close to the mall . The hotel is built beautifully , with lovely rooms . We enjoyed the great breakfast and evening tea buffet. The staff was really helpful and courteous . Our rooms with balcony were very comfortable , i would suggest to go in for balcony rooms as the without balcony rooms feel nauseating .  Overall we had a great stay as kids enjoyed their play area .

we checked in at the ITC fortune and had a great experience from the time we entered.. firstly the reception desk staff who were prompt to listen to the needs of customers as we were booked in standard room but asked them to change our rooms to view room which was attended immidiately.. the food was good but not as great. breakfast was good. we were a 4 families travelled from delhi and enjoyed every bit of it. the ambience is great and the wlking distance from mall roa makes it easier for us to go at any time. the staff is curtious and helpfull. we enjoyed it. thank you for a wonderful stay !

We wanted a short getaway from our daily routine and wanted to stay at a decent property where we could spend a quality time. We booked it for the ITC badge it carries so that our short trip remains memorable. But, the nightmares started as soon as we entered the premises of hotel and met the front desk staff. The front desk is incompetent. Reservation desk is terrible. If you are there during peak season, get ready for a rude shock. Don't try to communicate via emails. They don't know how to! I would never have them for my corporate or personal stay. Only thing good about the place is location.

I booked this hotel because it was an ITC group property but I was terribly disappointed. Please book this hotel at your own risk - Me, my wife and my father has terrible food poisoning because of the pathetic food. I am convinced that they keep recycling their food for many days. This was the worst and tasteless food I have ever had in my life. It might be surprising to many but they did not have basic medicines in their hotel. A doctor was called after we raised hell and there was absolutely no apology from the hotel staff.  - The toilets are pathetic and they do not clean them when handing over the room.
