Was there for 2 days with my family.Location is in the Library,not very far away from mall.One thing i am surprised by is the lack of elevators in this hotel.How do you expect old people to climb 50 stairs at a stretch.Gym is for name only and is serious need of up gradation.Staff is excellent and i found them very polite.In all my years of travelling and staying in hotels , i have never come across better trained and hard working staff.Food is excellent with good variety of South Indian,Chinese and North Indian food.Rooms are decent sized and were cleaned regularly.An excellent place to spend your vocations.

This was the sixth stop for us on our 22 days North India trip. We were tired. The reception staff was polite but dodgy in answering straight forward questions. When one buys a deal with a travel portal, a large gap is kept for the hotel authorities to manipulate things as they suit them.  What the technical words suggest in the deal given to us, is interpreted quite differently by the hotels. Fortune Grace, was one such experience.  We got the tiniest possible room, with practically no manoveribility , thereby cramping us to a terrible state. We do admit the room was clean, the view of Dehra Doon below, during the night time  was really good.  The food was good on the rooftop terrace. The staff was polite and quite forthwith, in attending and advising. The variety of rotis was…

it was my 1st trip to mussoorie.so with a great hope i book the fortune resort grace,so called an itc groups hotel.now come on the point.  1.location...very nice,just on mall road.heart of mussoorie. 2.front desk....the most untrained,rude n confuse front desk stuff ever i meat.they took 30 m for ch.inn . 3.room...hotel is a g+3 story building without any lift ,the hotel is not accessible for aged person.i booked though hotels website valley view room with privet veranda n b/f .they allow me room no 107,which is 3 story down from lobby,coffeshop. there was no view of valley,only view of long tree and junk of hotel, 4.food.. the most shocking part of my total trip.the use rotten chicken,so tasteless food  ever i had.i missed my last day of trip due to the food.my daughter become…

good hotel. good location too, close to the mall road and overlooking the valley from the restaurant. the buffet is very less variety as compare to an other itc group hotels. very nyc setting on the outside with seating area. lack of elevator a problem. there is a play area but evrything is chargeable from pool table to the xbox games. tt is free. now the rooms i stayed in where good with balcony looking over the valley however monkeys are a serious threat and be scared of them.all in all good place to spend your vacations at.

I visit the queen of hills last weekend from 5 to 8th june and stayed at fortune grace hotel. For 3 days i paid around app. 30K for standard room with no balcony and view of there junkyard. Though i reached at 2 PM but got the room at 4 PM saying but front desk that we will give you room on fifth floor so i wait for it, but what i got i mention above. I thing the room at first floor with valley view is far better that room on 5th floor with junk yard view. Totally befooled me for 2 hrs. after one day stay the room opposite to my room vacant and ask reception to change my room but they simply reply they are full booked with new customer so they did care for existing customer like me.  moreover wifi is also paid and after spending 10K per day you only got breakfast in ur package. …

to start with,1.it's the end of mall road(poor location) 2.v booked there premium rooms:which were 4 floors down,without a escalator or elevator. its was a TORTURE. They even charge u for a ice bucket.  3.All the food served was pathetic,actually pathetic is a small word.Not even a single meal was satisfactory. now just think you are 4 floors down almost like without an acceptable quality of food on a vacation with young kids. 5.im 100% sure they serve stale food, kids went sick.  plz plz plz dont go

I just made a trip to Mussoorie last week and stayed at Fortune Grace. I would like to recommend people traveling to Mussoorie for staying at this hotel, since its close by (walking distance) to 'the mall' road; the most famous street in Mussoorie. Since it was our first trip to queen of hill stations, we preferred to stay close by to the main streets. Nice hotel and situated right at the top of a hill. It has good views of the doon valley. Not all rooms are valley view rooms. One can select 3rd floor or 5th floor rooms which are overlooking the valley. Rooms are spacious, airy and nicely done, though i haven't checked all the rooms on other floors. My request for change in rooms was also taken care off, without thinking twice by the front desk person. Good spread of breakfast…

I was there for three days. Nothing to see from valley view rooms and standard  rooms are too small and congested. You need to pay full during check in! Food are good but overpriced .buffet is rs 950 plus taxes,,!. They don't have travell desk but location of the hotel is technically good. There is foul lousy smell in front of room no. 209.

This is a very well situated hotel in Mussoorie , ideal for mall walks . The proerty has a good valley view - no mountain view. The restaurant food is average andd the hotel staff are not the most efficient. Facilities provided in the room and bathroom are not adequate and the front desk is not articularly helful.

The hotel is located perfectly..just on the Mall Road, but the approach to the hotel n the parking is a little congested. But, once u enter the hotel, u forget these minor problems. The staff is quite friendly, the food is good n the rooms are awesome. The rooms are very clean, spacious, airy n comfortable with great views of the Doon valley. The room-service is also nice. Overall, a nice experience! :)

It takes a lot to drag down the ratings of a beautiful resort having a perfect location, breathtaking views from its valley view rooms and a very hospitable staff that greets you in the parking and serves you efficiently in the restaurant. The check in staff at this resort managed to do just that. In spite of FULL ADVANCE payment at goibibo they REFUSED check in as ALL guests were not having a govt issued id. We were always under the impression that only one member of the family of four who has made the bookings required an id and we provided that. But they wont budge. We were not unrelated adults but a Husband - Wife - Two Sons  family . It was with great difficulty and harassment that we managed to get the ids after getting our house in Delhi unlocked by the neighbours and…

After a long adventure in Nepal and India, we decided to make a stop in Mussoorie for a bit of R&R before our voyage back to the United States. We spent 4 nights in the Queen of the Hills at the Fortune Resort Grace. Perched high on the hill just off Library Bazaar we found just the spot to relax, enjoy the hospitality and spa, all with a wonderful view of the Doon Valley. Ms. Kajal at the front desk was excellent at answering questions about the area and facilitating travel for us. Mr. Karambir Singh, the Food and Beverage manager insured the meals and service was top notch, and could hold a spirited conversation and offered information and advice on enjoying our stay at the hotel. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone.

We stayed in the resort for 2 days in third floor..all the rooms were well cleaned and maintained..the rate of liquor in bar were at a higher side otherwise we had a great time in resort..our small kids also enjoyed at re creation centre...overall good stay.  Thx to entire team to make our stay a memourable one..especially Saurav

All the rooms are well maintained with excellent service from the  entire team....cheers!!!! We asked for extra tea amenities and within seconds it was delivered to us...it shows how prompt the staff is...keep it up

Extemely well maintained property at a awesome location with a gr8 view...excellent staff,food & rooms...taking the breakfast n dinner package is recommended...lavish spread of continental n indian cuisine for breakfast with live counter for dosas n omlettes made 2 ur choice 2 perfection.  Dinner had a wide selection of conti n indian dishes with Chef Shashi n his team taking a lot of care...Dinesh our attendant at dinner deserves a special  mention...housekeeping is very effecient with catering to all our requeats..

The view is fantastic , the hotel is easy to access and isn't steep , the food was good and there was a lot of staff for our welcome . But the hotel for the price didn't seem to be worth it as it was just like a boutique business hotel and with the savoy just aside it becomes a better option within the same price category

pluses: the location of this hotel is somewhat perfect.. right at the hustling bustling Libary Bazaar, Gandhi Chowk. generally the staff (especially the front desk staff) was courteous and the ambiance as well as the feel of the hotel was full of warmth. room was clean and had a nice view over the valley.  minuses: the glasses on the bedside were not clean. no bottle opener available in the room. soap/bath gel bottles were almost empty. the washbasin drain (room#309) was somewhat choked and got full quickly every time i used it. no slippers provide in the room. tv channel selection system was difficult to operate. one on service; it took hotel staff almost forever to get me a matchbox.. twice.

stayed with family of 4 members at sortune resort grace mussoorie . location of hotel is excellent near mall road . valley view rooms offered nice vies . the staff of hotel friendly .the rooms is very spcious .one of the best place in mussoorie ...

Stayed with extended family of seven members at the Fortune Grace for two days. The location of the hotel is excellent. Being at one end of the Mall Road it is near to all the action but also just far enough to offer a quiet stay. Had valley facing rooms which offered great views. The rooms were spcious and well appointed and we all had a comfortable stay. The spread during breakfast was elaborate, tasty and varied thereby meeting all the requirements of all in the group. Overall a nice resort with helpful staff which ensured that we had a fabulous stay.

We stayed at the hotel for a family get together and it was great place and a good hotel. We were in a family of 8 and it was a decent hotel for family outing. The climate was also great and hence it enhanced our stay altogether. The staff was friendly and the rooms were well kept and clean, overall good for a family outing. We will definitely come back.

One of the best places to stay in Mussoorie , We stayed for 3 nights at Fortune resort and had very comfortable stay. Rooms were spacious with nice amenities. View from the balcony was also amazing. The breakfast spread was elaborate and tasted good.  We tried the restaurant as well and was satisfied with the quality of food. All in all a nice place to stay in Mussoorie.

it is superb location ,just on mall road and very easy access to any where within seconds.....However food was not up to the mark...but overall highly recommending this hotel....except food....and choose rooms with valley view without balcony...co operatin from staff are very good except restarunt staff....( it was terrible...)

A neat and clean hotel with the touch of professionalism. Is located in the centre of mussorie right at the main crossing as you entre. Car parking is a blessing and the rooms are very decent and clean. Food is excellent though a bit on the high side with a roti at Rs.150 each. Steps are steep and there is no lift so beware senior citizens.

We stayed there in October 2012 for a couple of days. The Hotel location is great, in the middle of the city. You can access everything easily. But the hotel is OK. Room was small even though it was supposed to be a suite. Food wasn't great - we preferred eating out.   Their restaurant has an open terrace which is a good place to eat if monkeys aren't around. We had lunch there on the first day. As soon as the food arrived, a couple of monkeys with a great determination to eat of our lunch showed up from nowhere. Apparently, it's a regular affair and the hotel staff is well trained in this area. My two kids, while feeling threatened, had a good laugh narrating the story to their friends.

Hotel Fortune is located in Gandhi Chowk Mussorie and this  hotel has very nice rooms though bit small and the hotel offers very good value for money. The rooms are neat and clean and service staff is also really good. Food served is nice and service is fast. The bathrooms are neat and clean though they are bit small. This is overall a nice hotel to stay in Mussorie whether on Business trip or on Holiday.

After my stay at Park Plaza Delhi, I continued my trip along with my family to Mussoorie. We reached the Hotel at 1 AM and the staff welcomed us with a smile. Since I am a Club ITC Platinum member all my 4 rooms were upgraded to rooms with the Valley View. The rooms were only worth a 2 Star status. They were very small and most of the furnishing were worn out. The next  morning breakfast was very ordinary to say the least. There where not many dishes on the spread either. I know hill resorts cannot match the buffet spread of other hotels but I expect a 4 Star Fortune resort to be better. The place is old and the management is not doing much to revamp it.The recreation area charges you for everything. The only good thing about this resort is its location. There are loads of shops…

Stayed in the hotel for 3 nights, 15/08/13 to 18/08/13. It is totally value for money kind of property. Excellent house keeping, courteous staff, good food and centrally located. I highly recommend to stay in this property.  Highly recommended.

Nice and comfortable rooms with good service and food... Bathrooms are a quite small but yes all facilities are there n NEAT(come on u r nt in ur house...so adjust a bit)  The kids zone is amazing and neat...   What else u need :)

Beautiful. That is the only word. We visited Mussoroie in Jan 2013 and stayed there for 3 nights. Liked the location. Staff is courteous. Food is Good. We liked the sit out. During breakfast you can enjoy the beautiful view, nice bright sunshine and cool breeze. Over all a nice a pleasant experience.

Had been to this place in the month of May..This property is located very close to the mall road and yet it offers a breathtaking view of the valley.. Food is good..But the menu options r limited n little expensive..Buffet Breakfast served is sumptuous.. We had initially booked a valley view room with balcony..But they forgot to inform us that we had to share our balcony with some scary monkeys..So we had to "degrade" ourselves to a valley view room 'without' a balcony n dat too without any refund. nor was the excess amount adjusted in our food bill..We had booked 3 rooms for 2 nites stay.so the refund amount wud hv worked out to around 7k..The worst part was the cold and indifferent response that i got from the hotel manager. There is no lift so it might get inconvenient for…

My cousine and Astt. Manager with ITC Fortune Dron Chaudhary recommended to me this property in response to quest for my honeymoon destination.We reached the destination amidst heavy showers,first week of February,raining heavily,near to empty resort,just married couple wanting to spend sometime alone..i couldn't have asked for more.The place is like a fairy tale,a force to reckon with balcony room,complimentary wedding cake,despite thunderstorm for all four days we spent here inroom temperature was awesome,warm and comfortable.The next big thing of this property is the bartender Mr. Narendra Singh...he's just an out of the world act,in a league of his own,blends and cocktails he mixes are amazing,taquilla and Indian wine were my picks for evenings.Amazing view from…

Hotel has a very nice valley view, so its advisable to take a valley view room. Location is good as it is close to Mall road. Food is average. The best thing I liked about this Hotel is the view from the balcony and restaurant area. But I would really recommend them to have a better cab services. On the checkout day, it was raining heavily and I had asked a day in advance for a cab to station drop, but that day they said cab cant come due to traffic and other reason and you will have to walk to taxi stand, there is a cab arranged for you. In that rain I had to walk to stand with my wife and baby but did not find any cab waiting for me there. Also there was no heavy traffic. After 30-45 mins and rain still on I finally got a cab. It was really very inconvenient. (Visited on…

really nice to stay in the hotel really great experience, Every thing was nice and great, food, staff, ambience, great. but no use of taking rooms with valley view balcony as the Monkeys are always present and do not even let you enjoy your balcony.

Let me be brief by saying that things cannot get better than this.  This is surely one of the best hotels of this hill station.  I easily recommend this place for a relaxed and comfortable holiday.  Nicely done clean rooms, well kept washrooms, play area for kids, nicely done sun deck and couteous staff.  My package included complimentary breakfast which was lavish and tasted good.  Although i stayed there only for one night on 26th but was well looked after by the staff.  Just one concern the food and beverages were slightly on the higher side and may not suit every budget.  That said, there are numerous options in the hill station suiting every budget.  Overall excellent stay option bang in the middle of Queen of hills.  Recommended.

Excellent hotel with awesome services. Had a memorable stay with my complete family. Staff was very courteous. Value for money. Hope will come back soon. Kids enjoyed n parents were more than happy. Compliments to Mr. Rathore (Fortune, Jaipur) for advising such a lovely property.

The stay at Fortune was just a stop over for one night before my stay in another property in Mussoorie. Located just next to the Library at one end of the mall road, this is a place of right choice for those inclined in staying in the midst of action and crowd. However this is a totally commercial property and if you are looking for a peaceful and relaxed vacation, this may not be the ideal choice.   It was the peak season when I stayed with my family and the hotel was packed to the brim. The breakfast area almost looked like a warzone. Despite being grossly understaffed, they were trying to do their best. The food was just about fine.   There is a decent play area for the kids and this kept my kiddo occupied for the evening.If you don't mind staying in the midst of a market,…

We had a nice room facing the gardens and we quite liked it. The breakfast at the hotel was excellent. Staff was nice and friendly, location could not have been better. Parking is a big mess in this small hill town, but the hotel provided free parking.

I was really disappointed by Mussorie last summer vacations when I took my kids there --- its nothing even remotely like it used to be 15-20 years ago...so crowded and dirty and the Savoy has been broken down and is being rebuilt so we settled on this place...I guess its ok for the price they charge but the rooms are really small, even the alleged larger room we took with a balcony and the food is so so...go to mussorie if you have no other choice...this place is okish if you go

We were two families, on a leisure trip to mussoorie. Stayed at this hotel from 25-26 May 2013, because of the brand name. The housekeeping was poor, there was no child bed. Only mattress was put on the floor. For toiletries such as Dental Kit, Moisturisers etc one had to call the housekeeping. No replenishment of these kits. Even the tea coffee kits were not replenished on daily basis. You have to call the housekeeping to get the same. No bathroom slippers !! The tariff charged was 8689+1300(forchild) for one night which was very very high compared to the poor services provided.

this was my third visit to the same hotel.must say there isnt another option if you want to stay in a good hotel and right next to mall road.good food and nice modern room.kids had a great time...also do check out the newly open spa ..

Excellent hotel with lovely view. staff is very courteous and make you feel at home . We checked in pretty late  at night but were received well and got  a lovely meal to eat . Rooms are well maintained and the staff guided us well to visit places around . The breakfast  they serve is great with amazing variety  in menu . We enjoyed our dinner on the lovely terrace and got served piping hot food . Very close to the mall so we could just move out at any time and reach the mall in five minutes . Safe for kids as we left them playing in kids room to go for  a  walk . A must visit place .......

Excellent hotel.lovely view. the food is awesome n breakfast buffet is too good. the staff there is very cooperative n rooms r well maintained with all modern equipments ..................MUST VISIT children enjoy in their play room. the hotel is located at  walking distance from the mall. its a place to remember and to come again n again.we come here very often

Checked in on 29th March for a 2 night stay. The hotel is situated such that everyone gets an amazing view of the valley. The staff is courteous and very helpful. Had a few glitches during the stay but got sorted out on the way. Caution: When they have a "Beware of Monkeys" sticker on the balcony door, they mean it! My cousin actually had a couple of them pay her a visit!!! The staff promptly came to help :)  The food is gr8, varied and as per everyone's expectations. We Stayed In A Valley View Room With Balcony, Must Say Everything About This Hotel Is Great... Food: In-Room dining was excellent, we tried, Paneer Combo, Garlic Naan, Kasmiri Dum Aaloo,…

Very good hospitality and care. Their local sight seeing guide Yash was amazing and guided us to the outdoors and points of OUR interest with all relevant information and history. Highly recommended.  Places covered and must see for nature scenes are the George Everest House, Cloud end resort

Without doubt one of the favorite hotels I would now prefer to stay in Mussorie !! Upon arrival we were warmly welcomed by the staff and general manager (Mr Arijit & Mr Sharma . The staff was extremely friendly, the restaurant was very flexible in food choicess and timing (appreciate this!) Mr Ajay (F&B Manager ) ,restaurant supervisor team and entire Staff of Country Inn Mussorie deserves a special thanks , food quality was awesome  We had three great evenings here, which obviously also added up to the experience.   Thanks   Anuj Agarwal

Very good trip. Room was clean. Staff was pleasent. dormatry  for driver was paid . Good location and located 6800  ft . No traffic disturbance. Shuttle service was suitable . I reccomend the hotel and value for money .

Absolutely wonderful food at the restaurant. We was really easy choose since the menu has good descriptions. We wasn’t sure what to order and F&B Staff helped us & gaves us a delicious food,The staff are so helpful & friendly. Definitely worth a visit!!!

Hi, I recently stayed in 3rd week of nov, 2018 in this hotel...being country inn, i expected it to be a decent stay overall....  What i liked : shutter provided to mall road a very good nature walk tourist guide as per experienced by my husband  What i didnt like : very average in room dining food...ordered tomato soup...it was so oily...and ordered baked vegs lasagne...full of cauliflower with little brocolli and lots of peas along with other vegs..( the morning complimentary breakfast buffet was good though ) when requested for refill of tea and coffee sachets, the boy simply dumped all the sachets on the tray on the room table....

We stayed at this hotel as our first preference and it was the 2nd time we stayed over here. Talking about hotel, they are amazing in every sense, from staff to service, there anytime shuttle services, there helpful nature. The hotel is located at a very quiet place surrounded by green belt. The rooma are pretty descent and worth every penny. The day we checked into hotel, we saw this activity list this hotel offered. There was this Jungle morning walk, being a nature lover me and my wife decided to go for it which is offered at very minimal price INR 150 per person. The fresh breeze, the green…

It was a nice trip and all servicew were up to the mark including morning walk activity. This made our trip memorable. Thanks to our guide SAGAR.  We have collected unforgetable memories in radison. Pleasant stay.

The staff and the services offered by hotel are par excellence. The scenic beauty and location of the hotel is just awesome.Quick and hassle free pick up and drop service to and fro library chowk. The food is delicious and the daily activities are full of fun with proper time management. Overall have a great time and a great stay.highly recomended and full value for money place to stay in mussoorie.

Hello  My self mr nirav shah from surat-Gujarat-India. V have been here with family during 12th nov to 14th nov2018. v r very much happy with F&B in country in suits . All F&B staff r very much supportive. Specially executive chef SHER RAM & his whole team who always say yes for our any JAIN items in our breakfast & dinner. He specially cooked delicious jain food varieties specially for our group. V enjoyed quality food & amazing service over here.F&B director mr. UMED RAWAT & his team also co-operate us in all ways in reastaurents very softly & politely. At last all F&B team was just superb & amazing in service & co-operative in all ways. If u r staying there must visit & enjoy delicious food of chef SHER RAM. Thank u all F&B team members 🙌🙏🏻

Country inn is an excellent place to stay in Mussoorie, they have spacious rooms with perfect balcony views for sunrises.  Country inn also provides a morning jungle trail walk of an hour and a half, a walk of 4 kms partly through the jungle making you enjoy the scenic beauty of the town. There are evening bonfire and games at the hotel terrace to entertain the guests which are organised by Mr Yash. We really enjoyed them.  The morning walk was guided by Mr Yash who made our experience even better. He told us about the history of Mussoorie and many more stories about the place, trees and mountains. In the middle of the walk, there is a meditation point where we spent 15 mins to calm ourselves in the middle of the nature’s beauty. Overall, trip even more fruitful and enjoyable.

Hotel is professionally managed, calm and peaceful location is what most attracted to me...staffs are excellent. they over delivered in every aspect..sometimes sensed in advance what could we or my kid need and ask beforehand, rarely found now a days...ordered b'day arrangement in last moment but they arranged somehow and that too complimentary..!! Food variety/quality was sometimes not good specially breakfast need improvement and wanted to cut 1 star for that but due to superb service letting it go....if you r looking for a hotel away from hustle bustle then must go for it.

We went there to celebrate my mother's birthday & indeed it was a memorable one...starting from the rooms allotted to us , to the services and to the food everything was commendable. The shuttle service is good and it just drops you near the Mall Road. Recommendable services......

I visited Mussoorie with my daughter last week and we stayed for 2 nights at the country Inn. Very nice property and very courteous staff. Enjoyed the food too ! So me of the trona have very good view . It's well located ... little walk to the mall road but the hotel provides free shuttle to the library chowk which is the central point. One of the bonus features was a 2 hour trek organized by the hotel ( extra payment basis). We took the morning walk with Sagar, our trek guide who is a native of Mussoorie. It was the most memorable part since he had so many anecdotes to share and we got a unique glimpse of Mussoorie. Don't forget to pack your walking shoes ...

We had a pleasant stay at this property. Well managed comfortable. The highlight was the polite and pleasing staff ready to go out of the way to help you and make you comfortable. Will visit again. Strongly recommended.

Moved from another hotel to Country Inn & Suites midway during our stay in Mussoorie.Great experience. The staff were courteous and the service was great.  The property is old but well maintained. Rooms are clean and spacious.Food at the Mosaic restratunt was good.The pickup and drop service to Mall Road is really helpful. Used their help to get a local taxi for sight seeing as well.Over-all a great experience and would definitely recommend this hotel

Little did we know that with a huge group of 38 people we would've been treated with such hospitality and priority. Starting with Welcome drink which was quencher in itself worked wonders, their in house preparation of some berries keeping in mind with journey sickness, nausea... The facilities provided by them like forest trail, painting, art and craft, tatoo making(paid)....Not to forget the live singing by Liyaqat Ali ji during dinner was cherry on top of cake. Overall it was a pleasent trip for all of us.

Well the hotel is not at par with other raddison blue hotels. Service is good, food ok. We loved the games and morning trails organised by Sagar and Yash!.. They were very good and fun! I was told it is recently taken over by raddison so will give benefit of doubt... Over all pleasant stay.

Pros - good staff, clean property, nice rooms with valley facing balcony, good pick up and drop service to library chowk. Cons - hotel rents top floor for parties so be prepared for some high volume music till 10:30 at night, breakfast buffet is very ordinary with limited choice, monkeys come in through open balcony doors even when you are in the room !

It was nice experience with CIS Musssoorie.. First of all I thanks to all the staff. The front desk staff was very friendly, cooperative with excellent service and They always keep smile on their faces. Every single person I met was professional, cordial, and went out of their way to make us feel at home. Property is good and well maintain. Rooms are clean with all basic needs. Comfortable beds and pillows. Great bathroom with Bathtub and shower. Iron, Coffee Maker and Mini Fridge provided in the room. Nice view from my balcony,The food is amazing.Even the food Delivery Service to rooms is Impressive. A big and special thanks to Surinder who went out of his way to make our stay memorable. Also the girl at Coffee shop Nazreen was very cordial and helpful. KUDOS GUYS...

I seriously loved my stay with country inn suites by radisson...they have amazing food, well behaved staff, wonderful activity areas, Spa and lovely rooms. Will definitely stay there again in future and will recommend to everyone planning to visit mussorie.

Stayed here for 2 days. Room was spacious for 2 adults and 2 kids with an extra bed in room. Pickup and drop service from hotel to town is really helpful as the hotel is away from Mall Road. Food was awesome. Decent car parking space. Wifi in the room was good. Thanks for arranging cake for my daughter's birthday. Tambola and other games make our trip more entertaining. Special thanks to Sagar for full day sight seeing and morning jungle trail.  Continue your services like this 👍.  Aloke Sethi

I stayed there for 2 nights, but I will stay again in the future for sure. All the rooms in this hotel have an amazing view around the mountains. One can feel the fresh air and just relax in the balcony, the room size is also good. Clean hotel, friendly staff, tasty food in the restaurant.

The hotel is lil away from mall road but they provide shuttle from 8 am to 10 30 pm. Hotel staff is very friendly. Location is very peaceful. I recommend it to all. Its just that the breakfast has a scope of improvement.  Otherwise everything is perfect.

Country Inn is not on the Mall road but a little away at a very secluded, peaceful location. I recommend this hotel wholeheartedly for those who prefer peace of mind more than hustle bustle.  POSITIVES:  - Free shuttle service to and from the mall road entrance (library chowk) - Small but decent car parking space - Food and alcohol rates pretty reasonable - We took a deluxe room, and it was very comfortable - Nice, free wifi  Special mention to head chef (Mr Sher). My wife and baby have food restrictions and the head chef customized the meals for us and prepared them exactly the way we wanted. Hats off to him for him for listening to our needs carefully.  NEGATIVES: - Did not like the fact that they collected the room rent upfront (had walked in without a reservation but that…

Team,  Our visit to mussouri was tremondous and i think for this credit goes to your hospitality.   Loved the way your staff treated us as they went miles away and ensured our stay is safe and meomarable.   I am glad that we made the right choice of staying at country in as we could not have asked for anything better than this.   Big shout to Mohan, Rajesh and Sobat for sorting everything out and taking ownership whenever required - All deserve pay rise !  Thanks Saurabh

Excellent stay with good food all times.. Nice support on shuttle services...   Good variety of menu in bf..  Can support more recreation activities..   Excellent support from housekeeping nd in room dinning .

Whether it was the room (with a quaint little balcony), the service, Food quality and taste and to top it all up the very courteous staff, we had an excellent stay. The staff really reached out to you and goes out of the way to take care of all the needs. We were there for almost 6 nights and never even once we felt out of place. Look forward for visiting the property again in our next stay. Tip: they also provide a very good shuttle service from the hotel till the Library market between 8 in the morning to 1030pm.  Live Ghazals every night in their restaurant was a very soothing way to end the day.

The hotel is located at a very prime location.. it is brilliantly ckean and staff is very courteous. We lived the ambience and the room decor.. but had a little goof up with the luggage.. but would love to visit again as the place is really nice

good hotel, nice staff and they were very funny with friendly, great food served. nice restaurant full clean. superfast and tasty breakfast early morning other complementy wifi . bathroom also clean  with nice . lovely stay at hotel

Premium quality service..... Best place to spend time in mussoorie.....  Team members provide good nd quality services...... Quality services at an affordable rates....  Must visit hotel when to stay in mussoorie.

Travelled for 2 nights with my family, room was good, staff is very hospitable. Food & Services in the restaurant were excellent. Especially thanks to Ajay & Exe.Chef and also to their teams for making my stay more comfortable . I'll surely recommend this hotel.

The first and foremost advice to give is avoid this hotel bcoz of its location.The hotel staff has made arrangements in form of cabs but what about with our own cars ...Too terrible experience..Plz plz do avoid this hotel. Even the attendants in the restaurant during breakfast are least bothered to serve you.

They are just using name of Radisson under contract. You can check on Radisson web site, this Hotel is not listed. They don't have standard close to Radisson. For 27 July I had booked room through MakeMyTrip. Room booking was for Superior room with Jungle view but got room on ground floor with car parking view. They don't have any other facilities except room and food. Who the hell 4 star given them.

Beautiful property and great staff. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay as they also provides shuttle service to paid parking which made our visit to mall road easier. Wonderful breakfast and in room service. Highly recommend this hotel for a comfortable family stay.

Excellent hotel with excellent location,extremely clean & comfortable . The Mall road shops,restaurants are within walking distance. Would definetely recommend this hotel to everyone. It's a true sample of an excellent hospitality. The food is delicious and the service in the restaurant is outstanding. Not to miss the singer who daily makes everyone's evening memorable. Thank you Arijit and his team for going that extra step for making our stay memorable.

There was a wow experience because of the environment, food and property. Also mall road is not too far from the same place even we can go via a walk. And the main thing of the hotel is its location with the beautiful view which made our more special. THANK YOU Guys!!

The hotel have wonderful staff, excellent location, excellent food, good ambience, good room accessibility to main points.... All these combination together forms an experience and this hotel has offered them in a package. So it become a memorable experience in "Queen of hills.... Mussorie "

Check in on 12 july . Loved the staff , the staff really took great care for us.  The location is perfect . The kids zone and spa is soo gud , specially the open tarrace with lots of enjoyment . Staff is professional and room quality is excellent

This is a wonderful hotel situated at a convenient and peaceful location at Mussoorie having all the necessary facilities. The staff here are the real assets, the Games area and Spa services are cherry on the cake. I personally enjoyed this hotel very much.

It was a lovely stay with ur hotel.  Food was relly tasty.  Services good staff was really adorable my special thanks to the gentleman who was there at the receptiom (Mr. Sandeep) i was just FED up with my journey but this boy makes me happy during my checkin thanks alot Mr. Sandeep.

Stayed here for two days with family and it was perfect. Restaurant Buffet food is good and we really enjoyed our stay. They offer shuttle service to the Mall road. I would recommend this hotel and would like to stay again

Nice stay ,service good Tambola,morning walk and other games make your trip more entertaining . Staff co-operative Located at good height and not much far away from Mall Road  Complementary pick n drop to Mall Road  But building is old

The hotel does not live up to its name. However, it’s location is wonderful. Morning walks organised under Yash and Sagar are breathtaking. Must visit for this reason. Staff is cooperative; good kid zones; average buffet

Hours of waiting to reach hotel in Season. Food was ok. No indoor outdoor fun activities for kids. Nt spacious at all. Cozy rooms. Nt stand on 4star ratings. No cab facilities for outing. In room food wasn't good.

Location was very cool, its away from heavy rush of mall road, i felt in the lap of nature, all around there was peaceful atmosphere where one want to relax. room was neat and clean,staff was very polite and helpful, food was good but there need some improvement in preparation. shuttle service provided to and from road by hotel was good facility. oner all it was nice experience

Visited the above property in third week of June with wife,daughter and grandson.The accommodation is very comfortable with a excellent view of mountains.The quality of the food served is much more than value for money.The breakfast buffet has got a nice mix of dishes on offer.The staff is very courteous and friendly.The only minus point is the approach to the hotel is via municipal paid parking LOT.And during peak season you are likely to get stuck in traffic jam for hours when you are just 500 meters from the hotel.Even getting out of hotel in peak hours is a big hassle.Also during peak season the pick up and drop to Mall Road doesn’t work as advertised ,so unless you are fit enough to walk on uphill roads you are likely to get stuck at the hotel.Wish they sort out the…

After three beautiful nights at Mall Road our initial program was to stay at Dehradun. But looking towards the lovely weather of Mussorie and hot conditions of Dehradun, I have changed my mind and decided to stay in mussoorie only. Our first and last choice was county inn. Fortunately I got a good deal and we checked in. What a nice property , it is. Well appointed rooms, lavish break fast, nice activity room, ball rooms, courteous staff and what not. Prompt services. I have booked a cab for Rishikesh through hotel. Amit was front desk guy who was constantly helping us from the time we booked the hotel, till we checked out and departed for Rishikesh. Lakshya and Rakesh made our stay very comfortable. Would like to extend my thanks to team manager Mr Chaturvedi. Would love to…

This is my second visit to Mussoorie and this time we have tried this Hotel, finds it amazing, very friendly and helpful staff, excellent location, great finger licking food, rooms have an amazing view. Excellent pick and drop facility to the Mall Road . Overall an amazing property to stay.

Amazing hospitality.must visit Awesome food Staff is helpful and caring.  10/10. Enjoyed my stay to the fullest.  The price range is also recommended   From day 1 to day 5 me and my family enjoyed to the fullest

Our company Alluring India Tour organized a stay of an American group last month. The stay was incredible. Everything was handled with efficiency and attention to every detail was given. The rooms allotted were spacious and clean. The food at their restaurant – Mosaic was delicious and every meal had a well balanced menu. The chef and restaurant manager were exceptional and always attentive to our group’s needs. Alluring India Tour would like to extend a big thank you to all the staff who were so helpful and contributed to a wonderful stay for our group.

On Sunday morning we took taxi to Mussoorie from Dehradun airport and was on the way and welcomed by floating clouds & rain during entry to Mussoorie. Unfortunate traffic theft our 3 hours but those moments regained with room picturious view, warm welcome by hotel staff,  cleanliness and hygine of hotel.  thanks to CIS staff for their support and hospitality.

If you want to be at a place which is near the city hot spot but bit away from the noises, here is the one property you should go for. There's a complimentary pick and drop till the downhill. Excellent terrace to enjoy yourself for an evening drink and chitchats

Country Inn is located close to mall road (around 1 km), but away from the hustle-bustle. There is a narrow path (a little steep) that leads to the hotel and the hotel offers pick up and drop to Savoy / Library chowk from 8:00 AM to 11 PM.  Staff is helpful and pleasant. Special thanks to Executive chef Sher Ram, Neelam at the reception and Arijit  In terms of views, only the 3rd and 4th floor would have good views and only some of them which face the mountains, few of them overlook the valley and another private property there. There is another sit out area (with a bonfire and option of a few drinks / snacks) on the 2nd floor, at the same level as the balconies of the 2nd floor rooms   Beware of Monkeys :-) and keep balconies closed (or be very alert). Few of them joined me for…

Nice, clean and peaceful accommodation in the crowded town of Mussoorie. We stayed there during one of weekends in month of May 2018. The hotel is little away from the mall road and gives you beautiful views of the Kapurthla Palace.  The staff is attentive and takes care of all your needs diligently. The food is awesome, I think the one of the best I had anywhere, its low on spices, fresh like home cooked and above all the kitchen staff is always happy to customize as per your request.  A perfect place for holiday! home away from home :)

Our stay at Country Inn and Suites by Radisson is very comfortable. I would especially like to thank the F&B staff led by Mr. Ummed. U guys are amazing!These guys are very warm and always ready to serve you.

I went for a family trip during March weekend to Mussoorie and booked Country Inn for my stay. The location is near to mall road but to reach Country Inn, there is a steep road. Hotel provided pick up and drop near to Mall road else it would have been difficult to come up and down again and again for sure. We were given the room at the ground floor where the view was not at all good, so would recommend to book upper floors instead. We had breakfast which was very good and it had good options. Staff was helpful. The best part was that I forgot one of my important belongings at the hotel and they couriered the same to Delhi which was simply great.

Amazing food, good tikki chat. Amazing hospitality.   Wonderful surroundings, best thing is driveway to hotel or walk toward hotel. Good Staff Service.   Thanks to Neeraj for good service and make our evening.

Excellent location!!! This property is at an higher altitude from the mall & so scenic views are awesome. One can have a nice view of mountains & valleys from the room balcony. Rooms are spacious. Staffs are courteous & always happy to serve you. We have enjoyed a lot in the spa. Food served in the restaurant is delicious & the cherry on the cake is the live music....very soothing & nostalgic.

The view from the room is beautiful. I had taken the suite room so the view was very nice. The place is located on top of the hill and hotel provides shuttle to the market. The room is very nice and neat. Bathroom is very spacious. Definitely a very good choice.

Location : Near to Library road.  But can't walk as property is approx 1 km away and that too steep road. Good thing is Hotel provides free shuttle service till late evening without any hesitation. Would appreciate the driver. Always carry Hotel reception number it takes approx 10-15 mins for shuttle to come. Rooms: Not quite large but okay for a family of 3 (2 Adults + 1 Kid) Recommended rooms towards Himalaya.  Mind you that not all room have Himalaya view. I had requested so much for a good view room but then also they gave me a non Himalayan view room, in-spite of low season and hotel was not so full. Bad part is I stayed for 3 Nights. And hence 4 Star from me. Well maintained bathroom. Service : Good I can say not the best Breakfast : Spread was really good. Food : Costly…

Lovely hotel with calm serenity...good food....excellent service. Stayed in 410 had an awesome view. Kids room had some good games and my child enjoyed a lot. They also had outdoor playing area with swings.  Hotel provides shuttle service till savoy hotel. Free service Special thanks to Neeraj in restaurant and Surbhi at reception.

I stayed at Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, Mussoorie for 2 Nights 3 days in March 2018 with my family. I requested them for the room with nice view during the check in and they accepted my request and allotted the room on 4th Floor. Room was well appointed and there was a decent balcony to sit out. The view from the balcony was amazing. We could see beautiful views of Mussoorie from there including snowy hills of shivalik range. We could also see a beautiful mansion known as Kapurthala House, it has French Architecture, and it is just opposite to the hotel. The overall scene from the balcony was giving us a European feel. Room was overlooking the Terrace Restaurant of the Hotel. They organized bonfire on the Terrace Restaurant daily during our stay. Room was comfortable and…

We wanted to stay at a hotel that offered a luxury stay and a room with a beautiful view of the valley. However our stay was disappointing for several reasons -  1. This hotel is far from luxury. Having stayed in a number of luxury hotels I was disappointed right from check in which was very haphazard and with no personal touch.  2. Rooms were dated, bathroom stank despite being cleaned multiple times. Flush didn't work properly.  3. Despite paying for a valley view I only realised that the property does not actually have any valley view rooms (the suites may have a small part of the valley view). Our view was just looking at some trees and a palace - nothing exciting and definitely not worth the money we paid for this.  4. Food is very average, I developed a bad stomach eating…

The view from the balcony was really nice. Even the room was comfortable. Helpful staff. Pickup and drop is also available to Mall road.  Quiet and peaceful place. Very relaxing.  Food was also good.  Would recommend it

We stayed here in the last week of March.  Only thing good about this hotel  is the service. The rooms are dated. The washrooms need major major refurbishment.  The hot water comes in spurts. The tiles are stained and so is the shower curtain. If they attend to these aspects they can compete with the best. Have to look into the common washroom in the lobby too. Awfully dirty and smelly.  Would certainly not repeat unless these issues are adressed . But then it's ones own choice. If one is ok with all this the hotel is good. Food is also manageable,  though not great.

The hotel should be last priority when booking.Make my trip should not recommend this property.The Staff are very rude and in helpful. They write they will take your request for early check in but do not mean it.The say free shuttle service but they never provide it .

Overall a very good experience.  The hotel is around 15-20 mins walk away from the Mall Road. They provide a pick and drop shuttle service which is quite efficiently managed. The special Himalayan tea as a welcome drink was awesome specially in the cold weather..Excellent food...Loved the fish n chips...Spacious rooms, nice balcony view....the rising sun rays peep into the curtains and brighten your day....

Hotel is located very near to mall road. Staff is very courteous and supportive. Hotel provide shuttle service from hotel to mall road. Hotel server excellent buffet and breakfast. Taxi stand is nearby and recommend to get taxi from taxi stand as if you avail the service from hotel they charge additional 200bucks. Hotel is bit off the main road and if you are driving your vehicle be attentive that you don't miss the diversion else it is tedious to turn n come back on those narrow roads.

Positives : Good Location, Good view of the valley, shuttle from hotel to mall road, 4 star amenities, polite staff - but will not reach out to help Negatives : Food is about average. Its not on the mall road. However it provides view of the other side - so if weather is good you can see some peaks of himalaya.

The hotel was very well located as you can drive till the property. The rooms are nice and clean and the breakfast buffet is a good one to have there. Although it is not on mall road but the hotel provides a free pick & drop service so it's very convenient for everyone. The views from the hotel are very scenic and have few nice locations to capture photos.

Check in on 19.03.2018 Loved the stay. The staff really took great care of us. Special mention for chef his personal touch and making sure we get what we like finger Licking Food. Full marks to him and Country Inn & Suites friendly staff. Highly recommended.

It’s a great experience ... good service ..  good food 🥘 .. Nice stay.. Offered wellcome drinks ..🍷☕️. feel like special. Room are comfortable  well cleaned ...........  location out side beautiful views its a good experience..great hospitality... thanks team grt hospitality... will we back agin...

The location of the hotel is just perfect, although the mall road etc. is not accessible if you're on foot but the hotel free pick and drop service till 11 in the night which is very convenient. As far as the cleaniness is concerned, rooms as well as the washrooms are neat, with some wear and tear (ignorable). Staff is always on their toes to serve you the best they can, a big thanks to them. Food(Breakfast Buffet) is satisfactory and it is one area where they should improve.

I visited country inn and suites with friends on holi holidays ..... the rooms were surprisingly clean and bathroom was too . The view from was beautiful overlooking Doon valley. ... but the best part was hospitality of the hotel ... they fullfied all the request from us .. breakfast was decent ... and room service was good and prompt.... but we kept few mangoes which we kept in the mini refrigerator was suddenly gone after make my room ..

Don't go by the brand as it is comes under Carlson, you will get to know about it when you reach there. Nothing is maintained in this hotel from rooms to bathrooms. Way up to the hotel is quite cheeky. Don't drive you car there if you want to keep it scratch free. Zero value for money.

I stayed with family including my year old daughter. We requested room services lot of time and and were always greeted with a smile. Also, liked the breakfast spread for the morning.  Room: I opted for private balcony room and they gave us an room in top floor, so better views from there.  Tip: Do not worry about your trips to Mall Road as hotel provides shuttle services and drivers are print in responding. Overall: Will love to visit again, thanks to the whole team for making our short stay enjoyable.

I had visited the hotel on 21st February 2018, quite neat and clean hotel. staff well behaved, courteous. Restaurant menu quite elaborate, prices quite competitive, food quality and services both are equally good.

I stayed here with family. This hotel has an excellent location. The rooms with balcony have a very beautiful view.  Hotel staff is polite and very helpful. Services are prompt. Live music in the Mosaic restaurant was good. The singer was excellent, really liked the music.

The booking/ hotel manager is not even interested in calling back for booking enquiry. He seems to be busy with his work so much that they give a damm to customers request for call back inspite of requesting him to speak for several times.   Really bad experience.

The hotel is comfy and cosy... near to the Mall Road ... and the best part is they provide free pick and drop to the Mall Road for the guests.. v stayed in a deluxe room with private balcony ... was a good and clean room .... food is good ...

we stayed here for one night and fully enjoyed our stay here.Hotel is very beautiful and very near to mall road.Rooms are clean,well furnished with a beautiful balcony.Food is good with so much varieties.They have a baby play area in hotel.Biggest thing which i liked is everybody is so polite here..guard reception people,restaurent people everybody will talk u with a smiling face.In breakfast a service boy neeraj kept my little baby busy so we could enjoy our breakfast,that was such a nice gesture..Thanks country inn for making our journey memorable

The hotel is located 1.5 km from Mall Road. The hotel provides shuttle to nearby Mall Road. I think the hotel needs an immediate renovation as some of the furnitures needs replacement. The plus point I find is a large balcony attached to my room from I can find the nearby  snow peaks.

Stayed with family for Two nights. It was last minute plan so no prior reservation.  Check-in was smooth and friendly staff. Always ready to help with options. Service and food quality was very good, also breakfast spread. Hotel approach is steep and narrow road, but smartly managed by Hotel. But once in Hotel Pick up and drop to and from Mall road is complementary and quick. Enjoyed and will stay again if in town.

The Location of the hotel is very prime.They have 50 + Rooms & Suites. Always packed.The food is too good here specially crafted by very talented & experienced Chef Sher ram.who is very active & instrumental in taking care of in house guests. Property does have a heritage feel with all modern amenities available. Best view rooms are on 4th floor.Best part is food & drinks are not costly in restaurant or in rooms.Staff handling front desks are also very professional & helpful.They have a pick up dropping facility to mall road which is very good. Competing with so many new brands & still staying on top is very challenging & needs extra efforts which team Country inn is doing. Would love to stay here again. Book it & feel it

close to mall road, good location, staff very courteous, Good value for money. Wifi does not work most of the time, Breakfast area is not very Hygienic,  Prompt and efficient in room dining service, Slow front desk and hence takes unreasonable time for check in and out.

fab service provided by hotel staff and food is Excellent, car service , parking, and music in night also fire bone were fab. internet also fast.  he overall experiance is good. next time i stay in this hotel for sure.

I visited with my family on 23rd De along with kids... Location view rooms hospitality and specially food... all too good... Neelam on front desk was very helpful to provide me early checkin ... thnx Chef for the mouth watering Jain food provided

I was at country inn Mussoorie for three days. Must say this place is good for family stay. Excellent service and view from the hotel is awesome. Lovely hotel! One of our favorites of our three month South Asia trip! Room was comfy, reception was helpful and polite.  Hotel is well located and rate was good as well. We had a fantastic Weekend at country in Mussoorie. It is an excellent place to stay for those who love Nature. Hotel is very much Family oriented with good and caring staff.Good place who are travelling with family especially kids. Overall it is value for Money.

Good service, good food, perfect location and comfortable rooms. Perfect blend for a relaxed vacation. The stay was pleasant. Front desk staff was super helpful. Restaurant staff was outstanding. Food was good, hotel was clean, room service staff was attentive. Everything about hotel was good. the hotel was amazing, and the facilities were outstanding.the staff was very courteous. good place to stay and spend holidays with family and friends. staying in a hotel means a lot, not just getting a shelter out of home but hotel is place where people spends value time with value people therefore i find country inn is place where you can spend a value time with people you care.

Very good hotel away from the hustle and bustle of town but close enough to get to. Rooms are comfortable with very attentive and helpful staff . Provided a shuttle service to the town roundabout which is helpful. The restUrant served good food . Overall would recommend staying here.

I went to missouri for a short trip for two days. the shuttle service from hotel to mall road was amazing. break fast was awesome and the view of valley from my room was amazing.... I paid 5500 per night and the room that i got was super amazing...

Had an excellent experience at this property, the staff was very responsive and positive. The property was located at an excellent eccentric view point. The pick and drop services were excellent. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Overall wonderful property to look forward for .

The property is nothing like a carlson group unit. There are many other hotels in a cheaper price and much better ambience and hospitality. The doors in the room were damaged. Great property in the woods with beautiful view from balcony. Nice big rooms and awesome breakfast buffet. The staff is very cordial and responsive. They also provide pick and drop for mall road which is very helpful.

Its location is unique; so the approach road, Mussoorie roads are little difficult to drive and this hotel is at most odd location, smaller approach road to reach hotel, but near to Mall road start (2mins drive, 15mins walk), unless you are fear driver. Rooms are big and they do have twin bed rooms, beautiful view of mountains. Hospitability as it best, no complaint from room service to restaurant, everyone is helpful. Best part are:  1. Quiet and relaxing  2. Complementary shuttle service to and fro mall road from 8 am till 11 pm  3. Prompt service  4. Quick check in and check out  5. Kids area  6. Its a very good property, food was good, hospitality was awesome. The only thing which I did not like was it location. It is a beautiful place in every way...be it location, ambience or staff.    We stayed in Deluxe room with a valley view from balcony.  The room is of good size and bed is comfortable. during the stay there I found the rooms cosy but you need to be fit if you are to use the stairs though after a bit of investigation I found they had a lift too. if you don't have your own convenience don't stay here because the city centre is a wee bit too far to walk. over all it's in a secluded zone.

The stay was all good and perfect.  I will love to come back again for the silent surroundings that were the best part of my stay. Food is all very tasty. Nothing much to say, Sandeep is very kind person. Thanks Country inn.

Hello Country Inn......Thanks for making memorable trip, We all friends happy by your service and hospitality, Myself Amit from Chandigarh five friends stayed 2 nights in two rooms here in month of January 2017. Awesome place to stay with family. Best part is the pick up and Drop facility provided by the Hotel. Staff was very helpful in guiding the locations around. Visiting at the time of snowfall is like the cherry on cake :)

We stayed in this property for 3 nights. The Executive Suite room had a lovely balcony view!  What deeply impressed us was the hospitality and gracious conduct of all the hotel associates. If anybody is staying in Mussorie, this property is a must recommended place!!

property is very nice but bit expensive as compared to facilities but still worth visiting. swimming pool is the facility which hotel lacks. If they introduce it , it will be value for money. Rates for Buffet should be reduced

Excellent room, good room service, excellent food. All the services were 50% better due to prevailing lean season. Well done. had a great experience.. Loved our stay. Next to the mall road, yet bit distance to cut off the noise and crowd. Lovely view. Good food. Great staff. They have a drop n pick up facility to the mall road which is excellent.

Hotel is excellent and reasonable. The quality of food is excellent .I prefer to stay again when ever i will visit again. The location of hotel is also at a best place and have a ample of space for car parking

I enjoyed my Stay in CIS Mussoorie  as hotel staff is very nice, go out of way to make stay comfortable. The place is very calm and in truly relaxing environment. One of the best places I have stayed in Mussoorie. Excellent location, nice staff and very caring service, excellent food quality, very nice staff in dining area, room neatness, room service and more, Absolutely value for money, Food quality was awesome and staff in your restaurant was very cooperative, humble and ensured that we get food absolutely as per the taste we asked for. If you are English and like a beer, you may well be out of luck, as although advertised, there wasn't any available during our stay. We had a voucher for ONE complementary drink, even though we were a pair. No beer, so we had a local whiskey and water each. That cost 380INR. One free. The location is lovely, and you are provided with a free taxi up and down to…

v cooperative and smiling good hotel staff,nice food,good shuttle service mr Surender from reservation staff picked us from Mall Road when driver was unavailable.hotel is situated at the perfect location,will stay again and recommend friends and family.

Great experience it was staying in this property, All the staff was helpful and even the trainees were best in their job. from the check in to check out the experience was awesome. This property provide shuttle service to mall road from hotel and they are very punctual too in this with in 5 minutes the cab is available every time.Food was delicious and trainee guy served us food in our was very helpful. First time i ever experienced a good hospitality from any property. Thank you country inn for making our holiday memorable. we will miss you and will visit soon

We were 2 couples with a baby (<2 yrs) and were looking for a suite or a family room(2 bedrooms), where we can stay together as well as have our privacy. After much search we zeroed in on "Country Inn & Suites" and "Royal Orchid"; what made us go for Country Inn & Suites was the way our even small queries were answered by Surbhi, the fact that they had attach balcony in each room and they provide shuttle service to Mall Road. The property is atleast 1.2km from Library chowk, walking on hilly roads with a baby is really difficult ;)  We reached the property by afternoon, the check-in was very smooth and the herbal tea was really refreshing. The suite was as described and shown in pictures (website). The kids play area was in the open and just below our room, added advantage since…

We had a nice comfortable stay, whether it was rooms or housekeeping or the hotel staff..everything was prompt and taken care of. Was a little disappointed with food but maybe we made the wrong choices. as per the chef they specialize in north indian whereas we kept ordering continental but it's cool.. overall a nice property

highly recommended                fun filled and peacful location with humble and experience staff, fantastic view of gangotri and yamunotri snow peak, bonfire in the evening with taste snack followed by dinner at mosaic

Very good hotel,Rooms are spacious,Service is awesome,food was good excellent  view of mall road from rooms facing valley side. Bonfire at evening was awesome. They also provide pick up and drop from library chowk. Surely visit again

Being a part of Country Inn we thought it will be a great property but turns out to be a different story Altogether.  No proper Hot Water in Bathing Area..It was a Chaos at the BreakFast Time.. No utensils available. No Food Available. When asked for Orange Juice the person said "Sir Kinnu Chheel Rahe hain". Chocolate Shake got finished in a blink of eye and never came back.. Sambhar was cold as Ice and Idli were Rock Solid.. Morning Tea was in Flask but as an Ice Tea.. At Omlette station person did not know how to cook it and it was half cooked.  It was a let down. Only thing good was that we were provided with a Shuttle till Mall road even after check out and got picked up quickly...  But please take a look at the Food part.....  Thanks

I stayed in Country Inn Mussoorie just because of Country Inn brand value but my decesion was wrong.  This is a very small property located back of Library Crossing. Rooms are old and having basic feel, No perfect Valley view. Hotel provides free cab service for pick and drop to Mall Road Starting point. Staff behaviour is good. Overall just an average property.

We were a large family group that stayed here from in February 2017. Our original reservation was for an earlier date in January, but for some unavoidable reasons we had to postpone our travel, and the hotel was kind enough to accommodate us without levying any cancelation charges, which we greatly appreciated.  The entire experience from check in to check out was very smooth and all the hotel team members extended warm hospitality and any requirements were promptly looked into, whether they were for the F&B, Housekeeping or the Maintenance team.   The rooms were comfortably appointed, and of a decent size.   We wanted vegetarian food with Jain meals, and the quality of the food was very good.  The hotel is slightly away from the Mall Road, which is actually a good thing as it…

every thing is perfect , nice location , wonderful polite staff , awesome cleaniess , value for money , good facility given by hotel tranfers to mall road unlimited times , food quality is very good ...

the best place to stay in mussoorie. awesome staff ( very courteous and polite) and delicious food (mosiac breakfast and diner with live music is nice). all time pick and drop available. clean and neat room , superb view from balcony. overall and a must visit and stay property. lot of good memories taken.

The hotel is located at good location. Rooms are comparable to any good five star hotels in INDIA. Having a balcony is an added advantage. Food is tasty and won't disappoint you. Shuttle service is excellent. Cars should have ready seatbelts in case you feel those necessary. Staff is prompt.

Location is a bit away from the busy hustling town which gives its guests a relaxed stay or in other words a true hill station stay.The freshness can be felt in the environment and surrounding because of its location. Although because of the space constraint they don't have a lawn for a stroll but its an over all good property to opt for an relaxing stay.

Wonderful hospitality, smiling faces.. Nd gr8 food... Enjoyed the bonfire... Everything from parking to entering the hotel to ck out things were very smooth, specially the cab pick nd drop service from hotel to library...

The hotl is nestled in the green cover of the mussories hills, in a calm and serene atmoshphore, a little away from the mussorie mall road. The shuttle service of pick up and drop to Mall road is an added advantage. The quality of service is also highly appreciative. The room were very neat and clean. The balcony attached to the room provided an excellent view of the rising sun. I and my family enjoyed staying there. The inter-connect room provided to me was another appreciative effort of the hotel staff. Overall, a very excellent hotel and a must stay for all.

Been to Mussouri many times , but this time stayed at country inn .the hotel is away from mall road but good for people looking for silent place (they have shuttle service thru out the day.. to and fro for mall road )... the check in was awesome very smooth ,, the staff is very courteous ... Lucky us we got upgraded to a room which had the best view of valley ...room service was great as well ..buffet breakfast average ..as expected from a hotel in mountains but the standard of a carlson group is kept ..stayed for two nights .. was very relaxing trip .... but still a memorable one ...

The word almost perfect is what defines this property and our stay there...almost perfect location as you need their pick up and drop service to reach there is you are not driving by yourself...else you need good driving skills...almost at the centre of mussorie...very good, accomodating and honest staff. Putting special emphasis on honesty. Early check in was provided, late check out allowed, ever smiling and helpful staff. Not much to do though cycles are available if like to drive up and down the hill. Food was good although need to work on the menu as not much variety is there and not all the items were available.  Bottomline : sitting on the balcony of your room, watching the sunrise with yoy adrak wali tea on a cold winter morning or reading a book while wathcing the…

Just go n check out..you will enjoy their hospitality..will love to ho again there.e excellent location..this hotel is not at all greedy..it's value for money...best hotel in pmusdorie..will recommend to everyone

Wonderful location of the Hotel take me out their. A KM away from the Library Chowk.The Hotel staff were polite,humble. Free pick up and Drop till library made our trip more comfortable.During my visit got the chance to see the live snow.Will surely come back again

Great front office staff with lovely breakfast buffet check in check out both was quick.love to come back again.surrounding was really beautiful.room was clean,room service food was awesome.A excellent hotel.

I have stayed in the hotel for 2nights and 3days. It was the first time i have visited Mussoorie. They did not provide mineral(bislari bottle) for drinking. When i order breakfast it took 1hr to provide. I have order English breakfast Tea and Lemon tea. After 30mins they said they do not have English tea and brought cold lemon tea. Did not even apologies for the trouble. This was the worst hotel i have ever stayed. Even for room heater I had to give lots for explanation. It was below average hotel and basic facilities.

It was my first trip to mussoorie & i was going with my siblings.. after spending good time on tripadviser i decided to book this hotel.  I would rate this hotel 5/5 for everything starting from  *Warm welcome  *Quick check in formality  *cozy & clean  rooms  *good view  *hot water in freezing cold  *prompt response by staff  *good speed wifi  *excellent spread of breakfast  *free pick & drop to the market through out the day.   I would like to narrate one experience,,  Staff had already warned me to keep my balcony door close to avoid monkeys in the room  & we forgot to do so when went out.   By the time we came monkeys almost eat every food item we had in the room including minibar!!  At the time of checking out i was expecting my bill including all the minibar items,, but…

Poor room service, bad quality food. Found hair in my cuisine. Unresponsive team. Had to wait long for any service I wanted. Hotel lacks basic amenities like iron, bath tub, tooth kit etc. Hotel staff is also misguided by providing wrong information about complimentary amenities in my room.

A hotel with a great location, extremely hospitable staff. Free shuttle to mall road at your convenience. The quality of food is average, but the rooms are well- appointed. Those with a balcony and hill view are good value for money.

It was a liesure trip that I undertook with family. Considering the brand name associated with it one expects a worldclass experience however the experience is only slightly better than that offered by any other big Mussoorie hotel. The hotel staff were polite but lacked the exposure or worldclass training that staff serving with a brand like this should have. The food was nice but lacked in good variety or choice.

Stayed for couple of night. Wonderful property, excellent staff, free  shuttle service and good restaurant.  Free wifi. Overall a very good experience and will definitely recommend the hotel and will stay again

Booked this hotel due to the brand name and had the expectations as per that. Unfortunately started with the bad experience and had a second thought for this hotel. Lemme start from the beginning,   1. Map routed us to some different location.  2. Upon entering saw some other guests sharing their sad experience to the manager.  3. Hotel enterance and the facade was not as per the star categorisation as Carlson has a high standard round the world. 4. AC blower wasn't effective at all in the room.  Well everything got neglected by us due to the warmth and hospitality shown by the staff members.  All of them were so much courteous and was caring the honest smiles in their faces. Hands full of appreciation to the duty manager and his team.   Received the momento upon departure which…

The best thing about this hotel is the location, it's like 0.5 km (aprox) away from mall road and for that they provide free cabs for pick up and drop. Good staff, no compromise on hospitality. Had a hassle free stay here with my family. Most exiting thing is children's play area and ball room for kids, so if you traveling with your family and have kids, this is the perfect hotel to stay. Much recommended.

This is a good hotel with nice rooms. The food is good. It is on a beautiful location and view from the room is great. The hotel has recreational activities for kids and adults. It is just 10 mins walk from the mall road.

Awesome stay in this Hotel.  Good food. Wonderful hospitality. Nice and clean. Prompt service.  In short - No complaints..  If you're going with your family on holidays  just book this Hotel without second thoughts.  ...........

They claim repeatedly that all their rooms have valley view, but dude, NO! It appears so only in the photographs. There is a valley, but not right next to the hotel. The balcony opens to the parking below and you have the smell of petrol,diesel or dust rising up and coming in all the time. We went there and paid a huge sum to get away from exactly these things! The rooms are relatively small, clean bathrooms, no bath-tubs. Warm water available. There is bon-fire at night on the terrace which is good. You can order drinks and snacks by the bon-fire. The breakfast spread is good with very well mannered and extremely polite staff.

Decent hotel in mussoorie with good hospitality. Timely service of cab to  mall road and pick up. Breakfast is good. Room is big and balcony is adding more value to all rooms. We are visited in off season that's why we are upgraded to delux room. View from room is good.

I will directly jump to positives and negatives -   Few negatives first - The road to hotel is bit narrow(only 1 km). Though hotel provides pick up and drop to mall road but i would recommend this hotel if you have your own vehicle/Cab for better comfort.  Positives - Once reaching hotel you will feel the beauty of mussorie. View from rooms are amazing. Deluxe rooms are better with balconies and direct sunshine comes to the room in mornings :) . Take the breakfast package as the food quality is much better than the outside restaurants. Kid zone area has the best view from the hotel. Recreational activities like spa,indoor games were available but we didn't get time to use them. The staff members were extremely polite and helpful. We got the early check in as we had reached bit…

Staff is always smiley face I like it for their environment for all. Wellmaintain the hotel for cleanness and hospitality is always it too good. Food was just amazing no word to explain (amazing) 🤗 Shobat, vijay and shiv they performed very good job. Last the one only Head chef Sher ram what ever he cooked was outstanding.

I loved to stay their.all the staff is very well behaved and helpful.rooms are very beautiful and well maintained,food in the hotel is very yummy and tasty.services of country inn are very enjoyable.i will recommend this property to all

Awesome location, amazing stay, Nice ambience, awesome experience and special thanks to make my room decorated so awesome on my request it was absolutely value for money.  Surely visit next time and country inn will always be my first choice of stay in every visit.

The hotel is above expectations as always. It has 49 rooms in total. Our room was on the top floor i.e. 4th floor. The view from the room is exquisite. Breakfast was really good ranging from south indian to continental and paranthas, they had everything. Service is prompt and they provide free shuttle service from Library chowk to their hotel.   I'll surely come here again.

I was on Honeymoon. Hotel was good, Room n washroom  was neat n clean. Breakfast was awesome that was including in our package. Hotel staff was good n helpful.   Dinner was expensive in hotel n not so much tasty.

Perfectly located and very nearby the Mall Road and other attractions with their shuttle rides .The views are Great with high ranges and yea with an extra company of the monkeys.  The room s are very spacious and clean with an attached balcony.  My overall stay at the country inn was really a pleasant one.  Breakfast was just ok can be improved. The in room dining was fine otherwise I recommend this property to all for a comfortable and a not so expensive stay.

My overall experience of the trip was really a nice one. The stay at Country Inn and Suites was pleasant and the services were up to the mark. Breakfast was delicious. I recommend the property to all for a comfortable homely stay.

A great location, not far from the Mall Road and other attractions. The pickup and drop facilities are great and prompt even on wee hours.
