Great view of mountain ranges and an old castle like property gives any Victorian property a run for money.Neelam and her team are very forthcoming and accommodative.Would recommend to travellers.

I had stayed in this hotel from 12-14 November,2016. Hotel has enchanting view since its on hill, food quality was good. I was on business trip accompanied with 50 passengers Services offered to my client was up to the mark. This hotel is also close Mall Road where shopping can be done. Overall enjoyed stay and had nice experience.

The hotel has good location - with scenic view, if you opt for rooms with balconies. Staff is helpful and courteous (except couple of ladies on reception I had to face during checkout). There were minor infra issues - like lift getting stuck, which was to be opened forcefully by staff - but genuine help from staff made up for any minor inconveniences. Breakfast is good. Overall it was good experience.

No doubt the location of Country Inn & Suites by Carlson Mussoorie is unmatchable. The road to hotel was enchanting with view of lush green tall trees with cool breezes making it all the more chilling. The hotel has kid zone, the swings and roof top eat out place with bonfire which made the stay more pleasurable. Also, it offered view of Nanda Devi and snow peaked Himalayas. The rooms were clean and well arranged and courteous staff.

The location of the hotel is central on mall road. The attractions and places are within 1 hrs ride. Hotel staff is helpful and rooms are quite. They have free shuttle to drop and pick up at mall road  The Indian cuisine food in restaurant is tasty but little expensive. The monkeys show up in balcony so not always safe to keep windows open. Overall good experience and worth the money spent.

This is a nice property with a great view from rooms. Staff was cordial and the services were great. They also provide free drop and pick up services to Mall Road. Overall a good experience. Keep it up!!

We stayed here for 2 nights. The location is little bit difficult but all heal station have this kind of high heights area so it does not matter much. The Hotel is in Luxury catagory and having all Modern facilities inside. The food was very good and the service is also beyond the expectation. They have Live songs program with dinner and the restaurant staff is very co operative. We said them for a Packed Breakfast in early morning 6-30 because we want to leave mussoorie early in the morning and They gave us packed Breakfast of our choice. My Special thanks to Restaurant staff for their quite well attitude.

The hotel is located slightly away from the mayhem however they have excellent connectivity to the city centre which is hardly 5 mins away. The quality of food is ok. The staff is nice and courteous and goes out of the way to help you.

I liked this hotel as they are providing all required facilities and quick check-in and were clean and hygeine is also maintained and food was also tasty and served in good way and I liked this hotel and staff was also good.

Loved each and every bit of the hotel. Food was amazing with specialities in various types of food. City view rooms preferred. Good scenic view and wonderful sunrise experience . Rooms are clean and bathrooms are hygienic. Preferred for long n short stay.

The rooms are nice and clean and the room service menu is nice and the food tasted great. The breakfast buffet was Ok. The location of hotel is nice, it's near to mall road although they provide pick up nd drop from mall road. Only problem with the hotel was they don't provide cab services for airport drop due to union issue in Mussoorie. So my advice is please bring your own car. Rest everything is great.

Stayed at this hotel and I must stay that the hotel is an ideal place to relax. The location is supreme and very well connected to all places. Rooms are big with balcony. Housekeeping staff was very good. Breakfast venue was small but good breakfast.

I went to mussoorie with my parents from 21 Oct to 22 Oct 16, and stayed in room no 401 and 402. It was really a very nice property, The Staff was too cordial, welcoming and too decent and always ready to help you within their limits. I went for mussoorie sight seeing with my parents on my request they provided me a wheel chair on loan for ferrying my mother to Mall road in the evening, it was really helpful as she was not able to walk much. The food was too good again the catering staff was cordial and welcoming. They also provided me two complimentary coupons for the oasis bar. The Bon fire in the evening on the oasis terrace is just a cherry on the top and provides the required warmth for the stay. Really great and my compliments to the country inn team of mussoorie. Really a…

The only plus point of the hotel is the location and the shuttle service to library chowk. The rooms are spacious but interiors are dated. Bathrooms are poorly designed with dated tiles and poor drainage. Our family member suffered a fracture by slipping in the bathroom. Worst part was the hotel did not offer help to reach to the hospital as well. Despite of the hotel having two SUVs, we had to hire the only available old school van to reach to the hospital which was half an hour away.Even after informing the reception of the accident, nobody from the staff arrived for help.

Neat large rooms, good location which is near to the famous Mall Road plus the hotel provided pick up and drop from the hotel to the Mall Road. Would like to come back again. However they need to improve on their Room Service which I found to be delayed most of the time.

Wonderful place to be in Mussoorie with such classic hotel and elegant view... Rooms are well maintained and Food quality is simply fabulous... Staff at Hotel is very overwhelming and supportive... Would like to visit very soon... Full marks.

Fantastic hotel with lovely view.Awesome location,hotel provide free shuttle service till balmiki temple.the food is good and room service is just awesome.overall a wonderful place to stay and enjoy with family.

I would rate this property to be quite excellent . It was one of my best experience ! The staffs are extremely professionals and treat customers like a King !!! Clean and spacious room and fantastic restaurant . Kushal the Senior front office executive  has been best of the lot - service with a smile !  Be sure to stop by for a wonderful experience . Kudos to the management !!!

Great and awesme place to visit and relax with lush green atmosphere and cooperative staff. Its a scenic place and the environment is clean and even the rooms are very clean and tidy  Will surely come back to have an awesome experiance once again........

The view oF Himalaya is awesome From suites,wonderful location of the hotel,staff with smiles,buffet spread with lods of option. Beautiful place to enjoy with family. On next visit to mussoorie will be with cis only.

The stay in this beautifully located hotel created new memories. The support of the hotel staff was really nice. Hats off to their commendable job. The rooms were clean and spacious which made our stay very enjoyable. Would recommend this place to near and dear ones

Overall a very enjoyable & positive experience. This hotel has the best staff I've ever met; extremely courteous & professional. I find it perfectly located away from the city noise & hustle-bustle, yet only a short walk from the Mall road (Library end). Loved the newly opened Oasis bar & bonfire. Thank you for a very enjoyable stay, every time! Hope to stay here again.

Nice hotel to stay. Staff is very courteous. Buffet breakfast was very nice and chef was flexible to cook somethings as per your needs. Rooms are little over priced. Little off on the hill so reaching there can be little difficult but they provided shuttle for going in and out till a common point. Overall decent experience

Stayed the for 2 nights..i feel room price are bit high..rooms are spacious and u get a very good view of valley from some rooms..food is good but almost the same menu in breakfast and dinners for two days..hotel should improve the inner decor..

Amazing Property, very friendly and helpful staff, excellent location, great finger licking food, all rooms in CIS are front facing and offer you an amazing view. Excellent pick and from facility to the Mall Road . Overall an amazing property to stay

Although it was a short stay of just two days ,but the hospitality of the staff was wonderful and especially Mr. Kushal's behaviour and co operation was awesome and he is really a commendale guy!!!    The hills around offered a beautiful scenic view ...hence altogether it was an awesome stay there...looking forward to visit carlson again very soon.

very cooperative staff.excellent location.excellent food.internet is very slow need  for improvement.overall good hotel to stay.location is near to famous tourist destinations, value for money hotel,overall 4 star out of 5.

We were two couples and our overall stay was comfortable. Food and services was good enough. However, one would expect a little more from the 4 star property. There was broken paint visible on the walls of rooms and bathroom. Also, you can notice the dampness on the bathroom wall all over which gives you a feeling of budget hotel. One more instance which irritates me was at the time of check-out I requested for some water bottles for driving back, however management informed me that they are out of stock for water bottles. That was a really shameful response.

Great shuttle service to Mall Road. Proximity to Mall Road is good , not at all far even on foot. Nice staff and good customer service. Breakfast spread is also good. Deluxe rooms are clean and spacious. Would definitely visit again and well recommended as well. Had to wait a long time when asked for tea in breakfast, happened on both mornings of our stay. Rest no negatives at all.

Pros: 1. Clean and comfortable rooms with balconies. 2. Complimentary drop and pickup from library chowk since it is difficult to walk to the hotel. 3. Decent buffet breakfast. 4. Helpful staff.  Cons: 1. The views from the rooms is not one would expect. The rooms are basically in wrong direction.

rooms are modern, but not maintained, rest staff is friendly,  no valet and concierge service, located away from the mall, food is good monkey menace cant open windows so dont pay extra for balcony rooms

Best choice when in Mussorie near city center. They have cars to shuttle you to city and ample parking as well. My kid liked the small area with some swings and trampoline. Food is good and breakfast spread is nice. Rooms are very cosy and well maintained. Staff is couteous with hopatiality of Carlson group. Beware of monkeys in balcony....they try to enter in rooms as well if door left open.

Myself and 2 frenz had visited Mussourie for 2 days. It was a walk in check in.  The location is awesome,  staff is well trained and rooms clean. Mosiac provides a varied variety of food and dishes, moreover provides a gr8 ambience and gr8 dining experience. 10 out of 10 from my side.

Country inn was a cherry on the cake if i describe my experience. Rooms were Cozy with a beautiful balcony which comes with a mesmerizing view of a castle and a beauteous fresh view of heaven touching mountains. Well i am short on words to describe.  When it comes to the backbone of the hotel which was its staff from the step in to step out they were so cooperative which made our stay full of comfort. Special thanks to "Nandini" the sweetest and most hardworking among all who made our stay homely, with the room upgrade to sending my belongings back to Jaipur which i have forgotten.  In short  if i summon up my stay   Cozy room Beautiful view delicious food Cooperative staff  Thanks Country Inn and Suites to make our trip comfortable. Looking forward to stay with you soon.

modern property but not maintained properly, cleanliness is an issue, away from the mall but pick up and drop facility available, food is good and fresh, monkey menace, toiletries dont smell raasa especially shampoo and shower gel seems fake

it was a perfect stay with CIS and services provided by them was   very good. it was a short stay, i would recommend my friends to stay at this prestigious hotel. staff at this hotel is good and happy to serve. cheers!!!

I am a Club Carlson Member thats why we opted for this hotel.   The location is far from the mall road and the shuttle service provided by hotel was not prompt It took 30 mins to reach just at the parking lot which is 5 mins away.    In the Breakfast they are not able to give and good shakes or even a Thick cold coffee.   Rooms were Small and Room service was slow. Overall very dissatisfied with the hotel.

hotel is lil bit away from library chowk but shutle provided by hotel is make your tour easy and shuttle is absolutely free to library chowk.. rooms are very neat and clean , food is awsome. i would like to the say thanks to staff for hospitality. it is full value for money

Nice Hospitality , Great supportive staff,  Excellent food , only drawback old property & maintenance not upto the mark. Overall happy with the stay. Location is very good , walking from the mall road.

The location is bit far from the mall road but the shuttle service provided was why we opted for this hotel . Overall satisfied with the hotel . Rooms are good and spacious.    Had buffet dinner at the hotel and wasn't much satisfied with it .

Overall it was a nice trip, the stay was also comfortable at the hotel, one of our rooms also got upgraded to deluxe with the other one. The only thing which bugged us was the arrangement of umbrellas as we visited the hotel during rainy season/. Hotel staff wasn't distributing the umbrellas properly, gave 2 umbrellas to a couple, one for each of them but just had 2 for our 5 members. Otherwise, our trip was superb, staff is also very cooperative and friendly. The wifi speed can be made better though. Also, I would suggest that they should add some more activities like gyming, gaming place for adults etc to engage people.

It was my Worst Experience, there was nothing for activities . Massage center was not available for Male because the staff person was on leave. Bicycles were available in there premises  but that was outsourced. Refrigerator was noisy and room service did not bother to fix it had reported all these experiences but no other bother yet for any sort of Compensation. At the time of checkout , bellboy was not available to put the luggage back into my Car

Visited in last week of July. Staff is very friendly. They Upgraded my room to executive suite free of charge. The hotel is around a km away from mall road but the hotel provides pick and drop facility which is very helpful. Service was prompt at all times. The food quality and variety is good for breakfast.  Only one suggestion that the property needs slight maintainance is it seems old.

We spent two nights here and I must say we were very happy with the room and other facilities provided by the Hotel. Though the hotel is quite far from the Picture Palace but its very close to Library chowk from where one can easily walk down or take a rikshaw towards the Picture Palace.   There is a free Shuttle Service provided for Mall Road which is available till 11:00 PM at the night.   The Morning Buffet is okay, needs improvement in terms of taste.  Our overall stay was great and we enjoyed our trip too.

For a Holiday Hotel Experience : You need to have excellent staff, excellent location, excellent food, good ambience, good room & accessibility to main points.... All these combinations together forms an experience.And Country Inn has offered them in a package worth terming my holiday as " Memorable in the Queen of Hills...Mussorie"

Its a beautiful property located on the hill of musoorie.clean and comfortable rooms with decent balconies to offer with a beautiful view.breakfast was decent..the only drawback is its little far from mall road of the city by walk.

It is always gud to visit such properties with gud  luxury rooms, gud hospitality,gud food  the staff is very helpful  The approach to the hotel is also gud, the scenic beauty from the hotel is too gud.  Our group enjoyed a lot, planning for more groups

From hospitality to everything was awesome. I really recommend this place. I really appreciate as all the staff from Manager to restaurant staff were very quick and helpful. Location of hotel was nice, appreciate their pick and drop services from Mall road.

rooms were good but morning buffet was awe full it seems that vegetables are not fresh at all. there pick and drop service was not up to mark as they keep us waiting more then an hour on mall road. over all it was nice stay if we exclude there morning buffet and shutel car services.

Country Inn has good properties around the world. Mostly with a decent amount of luxury. Not this one. Erstwhile Oasis hotel, this property does not do justice to the brand. The rooms are spacious, bathrooms not so much. Beds are a bit too soft. Furniture and fittings look cheap and dated. Needs a bit of a makeover according to me. Lunch was good, breakfast was okayish. Location is good. Parking is ample for a low season. I noticed the kid's playing area out in the open. I really wish it was somewhere inside away from the monkeys. Also hard flooring and an open balcony with slides and swings? Kids shouldn't be left there unattended. I expected more when I booked this hotel, simply because of the brand name and hoping the company also realizes this and picks up its game. I got a…

Over all good. Few things I have mentioned should be improved like Lawn Should be there, Discotheque is must. Shuttle service provided by the hotel is good. Overall Good experience. Definitely we will recommend others also.

This is a good country inn from Club Carlson. The rooms are big and nice with balcony and decent bathrooms. The rooms that I got were valley facing and had a very good view. The best of this hotel is the staff which was excellent, both at the time of check-in as well as check-out.  The hotel's approach road is too steep and can not be covered by walking (at least, not by me). Though hotel has complimentary pick and drop facility till the end of that steep road, I would prefer if they can make that pick and drop till library and secondly, they should have more cabs for this service. I had to wait for more than half an hour at the time of check-out and after that I had to ask a staff person to do something for this. Hotel does not have a swimming pool.  Food here is good and they…

We stayed as family for two nights from 25th till 27th June, 2016. Amazing location of the hotel, very professional staff at reception, service and all other departments we communicated with. The room we stayed was having picturesque view from the balcony and was having all the standard amenities, well cleaned. The Management helped to give perfect itinerary for the places to visit in Mussoorie. Special thanks to the Kitchen team for the Baby food of my daughter and the local delicacies were so tasty. Breakfast was very good; selection of the dishes were perfect. Live counter at Dinner Buffet was enjoyable with yummy pastas.... Special thanks to Mr. Anurag for making our stay memorable. Overall its beautiful city with superb hotel Country Inn & Suites by Carlson.

This hotel has all that you expect from Country Inn. The rooms are nice, the food is good, the staff well mannered and the stay is comfortable. The only problem is the narrow access road leading to the hotel. However, if you are trekker, there are lots of decent places you can just walk to from here.

Pick up and drop facility needs improvement as the hotel is situated at top and it is very difficult to reach the hotel without any conveyance facility provided by the hotel otherwise there is no problem

We stayed for 2 nights in deluxe private balcony room. Room is spacious and airy with a wide balcony to enjoy the surreal view of valley and some nice hotels across the road.  Please note that this hotel is a little away from mall road but provides free shuttle to and fro. The only caveat is that the shuttle timings are from 10 am to 10 pm so you need to get back within that time. There is nothing much to do in the hotel so you end up sleeping early - which is not bad considering the awesome view from your room early morning.

It was a very enjoyable and pleasure stay. The room was very neat and clean with all the basic amenities provided. The room service was also quiet fast and the resturant also offered various options during break fast. The only factor is the location....its long way from the Library chowk, but, the hotel has provided shuttle car for pick-up and drop.

We stayed only for 1 night in Country Inn and Suites By Carlson, Mussorie but we had a nice experience. The room was spacious with a balcony and the view was nice. The breakfast menu was vast and tasted good.

We had a stay of 2 nights here and the stay was memorable for all of us.  They have all the major amenities available along with a few luxuries for their guests like a basketball court, lawn tennis court. Table tennis and a few arcade games if you love to stay indoors. A nice and small sitting area outside every room overlooking at a lawn making you feel close to nature. They have an open as well as a closed area for dinning and they do conduct live music performances for their guests on some occasions which adds on to the sweetness of the whole experience of the stay.

Stayed in this Hotel from 27-30th June 2016. All the 49 rooms in the Hotel were occupied which means it was completely packed with Tourists. The quality of food is good but during the breakfast hours, there was a chaos because of high demand but the service was quite poor. Since during end June, July & August months, we do expect good rainy days wherein tourists in hill stations can be confined to the Hotel but in the name of activities room there was only one carom board and children play area was also in open space without any protection from the sun and rain which means u have nothing to do if it rains which it did during our stay. The car parking space is inadequate and not systematic resultantly after 10pm whatsoever may be your urgency, if your car is stuck between other…

Fantastic hotel with lovely view.location is awesome very near to mall road.hotel provide free shuttle service till the mall road.staff was helpful in all the manners.full marks to hotel food as they are having plenty of variety in there food menu.i will definitely choose the same hotel during my next stay.

Wonderful property with awesome view of the valley on one side. The access road from the top floor is just awesome and it is walking distance to company bagh.  There is scope for improvement in the breakfast.  Overall a wonderful place to stay and enjoy with family.

Beautiful & comfortable rooms with great staff hospitality.  Its a must visit hotel !! Breakfast spread is good, need to little work on taste & quality. Will recommend the place to friends and colleagues.

No words to say that much it is good i love it i will  visit that hotel again and again and location is excellent the view is so excellent for couple it is good place every one must visit thate hotel i love location and cleannes and staf .

We got this hotel at a very special rate. Turns out that Mussoorie isn't as happening as Manali. There is nothing to see or do here. I would highly recommend Mussoorie and this hotel for newly weds. There is so much of privacy and comfort that you can just hang out in the room all day long. I didn't quite enjoy the meals in the hotel restaurant but their breakfast was sumptuous.

The hotel is equipped with all the usual amenities. The restaurant is good but the food could be better. The parking is a little bit of an issue. But the staff is helpful and the service is very prompt. Had a comfortable stay.

The Excellence in Customer Service under able supervision of the General Manager Mr Anurag Chauhan is the primary reason for us feeling extremely satisfied with our stay in this Hotel.  Also some other staff are noteworthy of mention - Atul Keshav  the supervisor in F&B who worked so efficiently in high pressure situation during buffet breakfast and front desk staff like Kushal Sharma and Nandini who were very pleasant and warm. Thank you Team & Staff at Country Inn & Suites Mussoorie for  making our stay in Mussoorie  more  memorable !!!

The location is on a slightly higher altitude so is always cooler. It is situated about 1.5 km from Mall road. There is a non-stop shuttle service to a location that is 400 m from the Mall road so that is a great facility. The hotel also has a good parking space. Its  a neat and clean hotel with decent good sized rooms. The balcony is an added feature. The ever smiling staff tries their best and are always willing to go an extra mile. One restaurant staff named Vijay Pal Singh won my heart by giving us immaculate service on all days we dined there. He was super attentive and exceeded my expectations.  The live singers in the restaurant during dinner were absolutely superb, though were slightly loud for my liking. The breakfast was nice, the morning bakeries needs improvement. …

I stayed at the hotel for 2 nights with my family and it was a pleasant experience overall.  Though it is just 1 minute drive from Library End of the Mall Road, still the location is up the hill so you would need a car to reach it.  Also, not to mention that the approach to the hotel has a paid parking site in between which makes it a bid bad. Most of the time the approach road is blocked just because there are cars already waiting to get a parking space in that parking.  Apart from this the hotel stay itself was a pleasant one, we and our kids enjoyed it to the fullest. They do have a small play area as well for the kids, which was nice.  The quality of the food served is also very good.  Nice place away from all the hustle and bustle of the city, peaceful and quite.

Nice hotel with excellent staff.  Somehow the charm of Country Inn Suites was missing some where !  Food is excellent ! F&B staff is extremely good and dedicated in helping you in many ways.  Parking & open areas are very less which is the disadvantage to the hotel.

A great & comfortable place to stay while you plan your visit to Mussoorie. You will be welcome by well trained & attentive staff which is usually difficult to find in hill station hotels. Buffet Breakfast is good, though there is a scope of improvement. Live singer during dinners is a plus. The only drawback in my opinion is the location, especially during peak season as the road leading to the hotel is completely blocked by traffic which lasted for hours and we ended up walking uphill !

The location of the hotel is undoubtedly great and the staff is very polite and courteous and always keen to serve you at their best. Nice place to stay and enjoy with family, friends and business trips. The only missing thing is a lawn where the residents can sit and relax together.

i stayed here for 9th to 12th june 2016  .smooth and fast check in .superior rooms didnt have a double bed and deluxe room too two single beds were joined together and they were moving away from each creating space in between ,couch and chairs were moving a bit old i guess .breakfast buffet was owesome ,but other than that food is expensive and not good except some chinese dishes .indian food was below expectation .all in all let let down by furnitures and other food .

Stayed for a weekend. Though good rooms and delicious food, the tarrif is overpriced if we compare with the facilities and amenities provided. The singer singing Live music during dinner in the restaurant is the show stealer. Parking is good. Shuttle service to the mall road is prompt. A lift is there so it will be easy for the senior citizens and differently abled. The resort is at a high altitude thereby one  will experience cool climate at all times. Staff is very polite and courteous and always look to help you.   One time stay is recommended.

Comfortable Stay  Good Location.  Co-operative staff.  One of the very few hotels to offer complimentary pick and drop facility very close to the mall road.  Can do with more options in the in-room dining menu.

(1) very good location , easy to find, beautiful view (2) smooth and fast check in (3) big room with private balcony (4) Videocon 30" tv with Tata Sky digital cable connection (5) no AC may be because of hill station but it was so hot when we reached we wished there was an AC in the room (6) room heater for winters (7) good complimentary wifi (8) sound sleep quality.  The USP of this property is their well mannered, eager to serve, ever smiling staff. Service was top class every where from check in staff to breakfast area or room service. Very good breakfast , smooth check out.  NOW the minuses: (1) the furniture is old and out dated (2) bathroom fittings are old and not in proper working condition (3) linen and towels were faded, not cleaned properly. Towels were smelly and…

Good People to stay with, good view , and good food, Nice hotel,   The hotel is crisp, and has all the facilities needed and the staff helpful and cooperative, the location is also very good as its Not on the Main road and yet not far away a balance of accessibility  with privacy

Very good located Hotel at Hill station Queen of Hills Mussoorie. Food of the hotel is very good. Room size and room service both are very good. In the evening, singer sings and really creates a excellent Mahol for food. The real time one can enjoy at the Hill station. Pick & drop by hotel to the down road is again excellent facility by Hotel. Check In and Check Out was the excellent facility.

Travelled May, 2016. Two couples and three kids. Hotel location is rather secluded and no 'happening' places are nearby, so if you want to experience night scene, stay at picture palace. At country inn, our check in was smooth. Upgraded to suite with a great view. Room service was fast. Food quality OK. The only problem we experienced during our stay was that there is no travel desk and though the front staff tried to help, we wasted a day haggling with taxiwallahs of Mussoorie. My honest advice; if you are with family stick to mall. No need to go to Kempty fall, company garden, lal tibba etc. Hotel spa facilities are good. Overall, it was a nice hotel in Mussoorie.

Everything was so nice....nice food, nice staff. they provide cab facility ( pick and drop) to mall road to hotel. they have a huge restaurant with wide variety of cuisine. rooms are spacious with nice view.

Wonderful hotel, Excellent staff and fantastic views.. Took a family vacation and from the time we entered to the time of checkout, everything was simply amazing. In particular Khushal, who was a manager there was extremely helpful and went out of his way to make our stay even more comfortable. A must recommended place in Mussoorie

This is the best place to be away from hush bush of mall road complete silenece and peace.The food is very good and fresh.The staff is very hospitable and caring . Hotel is very well maintained and they run shuttle also if requested can drop you till library chowk. Go for it worth living there.

Hotel is very good including staff and Room service and restaurants is excellent. Breakfast is also very good food quality is very good I I'll stay once again in this hotel if I will visiting Mussoori with my family

Wonderful entrance. Warm welcome. Quick check in and guiding to room. Well appointed room with all facilities and mini bar. Location is absolutely valley facing. Almost 120 deg snow peak view from room and floor lobby. This could be one of the best hotels to stay here. My month of travel was 08 March 2015. It was birthday of my wife and the has helped me to celebrate with surprise to my wife with the cake and decoration etc. Full mark.

This is a cozy little place tucked away from the bustle of the Market place but still central to everything at this small hilly town. Everything about this hotel is right-sized - rooms, restaurant, etc; they even have a children play area. Live music/singer at Dinner is a highlight.City view rooms add to the magic. All in all, one of the best hotels to spend a little holiday in the capital of honeymoon destinations!

Stayed at this hotel for one night...Not worth money spent for it.  Hotel reception at staff needs some training as they clearly seems to be lack of confidence. Water kettle was already broken with cover sitting on top of it.  Pros:-  Nice location apart from mall road crowd & noise Nice reception ambience  Cons :- Poor finishing of Washrooms seems to be dirty also Breakfast needs improvement with more variety Hot water is not available 24 hours as quoted by hotel..false commitments Washroom tap comes in my hand while rotating it.It was just fixed by Jugaad earlier also.  Overall this hotel needs much improvement and is very much below level of Carlson hotels....so plz go for this hotel when you get a fair deal & discount !!!

good hotel with spacious rooms, play area for children was good. Hotel is near to Mall road also. But food options were not great, buffet was not all good on day of our check out and hotel was also too much crowded.

Ambiance 7 out of 10 Food 8 out of 10 Room 9 out of 10 Staff 10 out of 10  Nice property, near by to all the main attraction specially mall road, the have service of drop and pick up till 10 pm  One draw back they don't have any bar in this hotel. Go for deluxe room with balcony that too on 4th or 5th floor.

hi was at the hotel from 1may for 3days excellent hotel with great view and very good location. the staff is excellent and helpful we were group of  nine and arrived at the hotel at midnight due to some inconvienience while travelling but we were served hot food and dinner  hats off to the staff a very thankyou for making our stay memorable

Comfortable stay, Excellent Food, Good Service, Good location, Shopping location is near the hotel, Site Seeing is also located near to the hotel. Family enjoyed the stay and enjoy the holiday in Mussorrie. Compared to other hotels, Country Inn is good. There is Kid recreation area too.

I had an amazing time in this hotel. Its beautiful, clean and view is amazing. Food is yummmm..staff is great ...thank u team for making our stay so comfortable. I will surely stay in same hotel when coming next to Mussoorie

Although its a 4star hotel, approach to hotel is not that good,very difficult to find the hotel, there was No mini bar, no dental kit given, bathroom kit was also incomplete. Water bottles given to us 10 min after we entered the room, it was not in fridge. Hotel is not having any type of basic medicines for Kids.

its really a nice place to stay with excellent service. rooms are clean and well maintained including the room heating. its very near to city centre. only flaw is very narrow passage to hotel.  they do have children play area too.

Nicely selected view and location of the property makes it a choose in 4 star category. But missing bar makes it a little disappointing. Rooms are good. Little bit maintenance required. Overall great property with friendly staff and good food.

The hotel is located 500m from the mall road and the ride from there is uphill on a very narrow road. But the hotel provides a shuttle service to and fro, which is very prompt. The views from the hotel are beautiful and the whole ambience around it is very calm and relaxing. The best part about the hotel is the staff, they're are very courteous and eager to help all the time. The food was excellent and very well priced. Overall an amazing experience.

The property is one of the best placed in Mussoorie. The  amenities provided are very tempting and at its best level. The staff and caretakers are very well behaved with all the right etiquette. The food is also delicious with a wide range of cuisines offered including the morning buffet breakfast. The view from the rooms is very natural and breath taking.

Good property, Stayed there twice in past rooms are nice and plush. Food is amazing, Good service provides a drop till parking area to reach mall road.  Can do better in terms of mantaining the property but overall a good friendly hotel. Goof staff courteous.

It's a beautiful place to stay.I had a memorable stay with my family, food was excellent, rooms are good, view from the room is valley facing staff is very decent and well mannered, the main chef takes proper care of your needs. Finally it was a delightful stay.

It is a good hotel to stay. Though it is little away from mall road, they have pick and drop facility. Its location is good, but there are other hotels with better view. Rooms are big and good. We enjoyed the delicious food with live music and nice buffet breakfast. Services were good. Over all we enjoyed our stay.

The hotel is nice, location is ideal if you want to stay closer to the hustle bustle of the town. Rooms are nice and comfortable, though the views aren't that great given that lot of commercialization has happened. The hotel restaurant serves decent food and the singer (live) makes your evening wonderful. For most part the service was good.  Though its a nice hotel but it can be better. Some of the areas where there is scope of improvement are 1. Games arena - The stink there is just unbearable. They should shift this to some other location. Not safe for kids at all. 2. Room service - at times the tea served was not hot, they tend to miss silverware or sugar along with the food/drinks. 3. Room maintenance - Nails from floor can hurt people really badly, this should be regularly…

The hotel is a little far from the mall road. But they provide a free pick n drop that makes library chowk/ gandhi statue accessible.  The rooms condition is average compared to the price we paid and also to the other Carlson hotels i have been to. The pics of the hotel online are really nice as compared to the actual look of the hotel.

Location of hotel was very nice, not too close to hustle bustle of Mall road not too far away that turns you down from walking out of your room. Extremely courteous and positive staff. Nice Buffet breakfast and dinner with live singer.  Little disappointed with overall cleanliness of the room , mainly room corners, fan, corner lamps and other such areas which are not very commonly touched. But neatness  of all such rare touch points of your accommodation always leave you very pleasant and satisfied. I usually don't pay attention to all these details if on a business trip but this was family trip with kids so expected extra hygienic conditions for kids as they touch and explore every inch of the room while playing.

Me and 2 of my friends visited Mussoorie on 17th April for a 2 night stay. The hotel was a perfect home for us. Excellent food and excellent service. It was a safe haven for us. Staff is courteous and always ready to help. We always found them smiling. Our trip was excellent thanks to this hotel.

Nice hotel at ideal location with wonderful view.room was nice and cleaned..food was good and staff was friendily .must stay for visitors and dey provide special service to pick n drop you at mall road..it's good to stay..

Got here on 10th April with my wife and kid.  At first they showed us three rooms and all of them had terrible smell. So much so that they themselves could not come inside. Was asked to upgrade by paying 1000 more. Room given was 117. A bit old but was ok. We then went to the lobby and found horrible smell coming from their main lobby loo. Pics attached. The property doesn't feel like it is worth a five star at all. Rather they really need to work a lot on it. So think twice before booking here.

It's on a very nice location. The staff and service are very good. Rooms are very good. Live Singer is good. Food quality and number of varieties should be increase. All over its was a very nice stay.

We really enjoyed our stay with  optimum comfort . Staff are well supportive and helpful. I give it 100% score. Location is also fantastic with full scenic view for balcony.   For my family it was indeed a great stay. Hope to go again in future

From heena tour bombay we are visiting masuri stay at country Inn suit masuri the worst experience room no103 ground flour view of trees we request change the room but refused  overall bad experiences on2 April 2016

Located on one corner of Mussoorie.Drive to Hotel is tiring as road very narrow.Rest all very good with the staff at attention at all times for small things also.The food is very good,only you have to early to grab a seat as the place is small to seat everyone.

We visited this place as a family in March 2016. The room had a great view while the hotel is  close to the library chowk. However the last leg of the approach road is very narrow. It was a task for two vehicles to cross each other in such narrow road. It is convenient to have your own vehicle when you are staying in this hotel.  The room was spacious, clean and well maintained along with mini fridge and few supplies. The bathroom was spacious and very clean.The room had an attached small balcony overlooking the mountains.  The property has a spacious reception cum lounge area. They also have games room for adults and children plus a small outdoor play area for kids.   The staff was very polite, courteous and prompt in their service. The breakfast spread was excellent with…

My stay was very comfortable and I am very happy with the hospitality given by the staff. I enjoyed the bonfire that was hosted and the location of this hotel which is near to mall road. Plus there is a small kid activity area which will sure make your kid feel delighted.

Decent property with good location..rooms not that spacious...Food and staff excellent but small property compared to the standards of Country Inn...no recreational activities. Some open space or a garden would have added stay pleasure

This property is located at nearly less than a Km distance from Library Chowk and can be easily accessible throughout the day by car as you don't have to enter the Mall Road (which restricts the car entry from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM)   Please note that the Check-In time is 03:00 PM which is of course not a good deal as per its per day cost. I opted 'Deluxe Room with Private Balcony' and to me the room was just above average.  - Location is awesome. If your room has a private balcony, then you can enjoy the view of beautiful Mussoorie ridge. Enjoy morning and evening time with your partner in balcony.    - Provision of safe locker in the room.  - Tidy Washroom but small in size. Bathrobes, toothpaste and slippers were not available.  - Free Car Parking. Here, you can save few bucks…

Average hotel situated in city centre. Difficult to acsess. Very narrow road. It was a family trip. I was the reviews on trip adviser and make my trip. The rating was higher. But my family was not happy with it's location, lay out, infra structure, bathrooms, cleanliness etc.

Sofas of room 107 placed inside room caved in, seats are not fixed, kid got badly injured.  Complementary breakfast is below average. Milk served along with corn flakes was almost water,..,.. ...........

The property is quite old and not very conveniently located. Very narrow one track road leads to the hotel. While it is not too far from the central Mall Road area, it's not walkable due to the poor road and surroundings.  Rooms are average. View from room is ok on one side.  Service was ok, staff try hard but are not that well trained.  Only one restaurant in the lobby, food quality was not bad. They do not serve alcohol as they don't have a license.   Consider as a "value" hotel, 3 star at best.

I'm staying at this hotel and just left the restaurant without eating because I spotted a rat. When I mentioned to personnel they just laughed about it and didn't take it seriously. No, it is not ok to have rats roaming around as if they are pets in a supposedly high range hotel.  They need to have better pest control to avoid such incidents.  Also, when we went to our room just after checking in, we had to call housekeeping to have the bedsheets changed since they were very dirty. They gave us rooms facing the entrance which are very noisy.  Rooms need to be updated and need a refresh. The person who took us to our rooms didn't have the courtesy to take my elderly mother on the elevator even though he could see that she has difficulty walking and uses a walking a cane, he made…

Hotel was very good and staff was too cooperative, complementary breakfast and wi-fi was also good. I also like pick up and drop facility from hotel and to hotel. Hotel spa and library facility was also good. I love to stay here again.

I stayed there for 3 nights with my friends ,our stay turned out to be amazing .Really loved the services.buffet breakfast was not good ,it disappointed us .Over all our stay was good .This property has a good view.

The property has been taken over from oasis, which was the earlier name. It's been redone and rebranded. Rooms are nice (4star as per hilly standards in our country). It has a restaurant and the breakfast buffet was sufficient. There is car parking available in the property too. For recreation they have Carom and a Tt table. They also provide free pick and drop service to a point near to the mall. I would definitely recommend it.

Staff is very cooperative and attentive. Hospitality of the hotel is very good. Deluxe rooms with balconies have beautiful view. IF you wanna enjoy the view stay at higher floors.  Housekeeping needs improvement. And Linen definitely needs replacement. They are worn and stained even though fresh ones. Empty food trays to be cleared immediately from the hallways and not on Next day.  Miss Neelam from front office and Miss Khan from Restaurant Special thanks to them and 5* stars for them

This particular property needs renovation specially in bathroom and need to change menu for buffet breakfast as well taste wise breakfast was merely average not upto standard of Carlson Group. Staff was cooperating. Bathroom need renovation and hot water facility in bathroom was not upto mark

i recommend to all this is a very class hotel.me and my family really enjoy in this hotel.peaceful place and no tention for no-entry. staff behavior is cool and breakfast menu is good.also food quality is fine.

I stayed here for 2 nights with my husband and 2 year old daughter to celebrate our 5th Anniversary. Initially, I dint find the hotel attractive, because of the road that leads to the hotel which is quite narrow. But, later after reaching the hotel my view changed completely. The reception area is nice, the rooms are spacious, staff is courteous. We were offered a valley view room upon request and they also upgraded our room to deluxe without any extra charge.  The complimentary wifi is very good. Its rare that you find free wifi with great speed and connectivity in a hotel. The buffet breakfast was not that great as compared to other hotels that I have stayed, but it wasn't bad either.  The property is located on top of the hill, so it offers great views of the city. It has…

Amazing experience staying at Country In Mussoorie.. It's good to stay near the crowd in Mussoorie without much disturbance.. We were five in numbers could manage to get the interconnected room at a very low price.. Beautifully made but management should take care about the image of the brand as we entered to the bathroom in the room was stinking as if it has been shut for a very long time.  Would recommend to stay their..   A Perfect night view

I stayed there twice, the location is very good. If someone wanna stay near to the centre but away from the crowd and noises this is a place. Rooms are big & spacious, bathrooms are airy & nice. Overall its a good option to be considered. Service is on time and staff is co-operative.

Excellent Experience. Courteous and very supportive Staff. Especially thanks for Mr. Rakesh, Mr. Prabhkar, Mr. Sharma, Mr. Keshav, Ms. Neelam for making our stay memorable. Excellent Location. Prompt Room Service, Excellent Food...  Would like to visit once again with our group. Thanks to all making our stay unforgettable.  Regards Ashutosh Garg

This property will want you to revisit Mussoorie. Quiet and tucked away on a hill it was on a lovely location. The rooms were excellent and well maintained as well the service. We used the  complimentary hotel car to get in and out of the hotel to visit the downtown area. All in all i have only praise for the management to offer all the services. The buffet breakfast is also worth mentioning. Would definitely revisit.

It was a very good experience to stay here. The only annoying part was monkeys due to which we couldn't sit or stand in balcony to enjoy the view rest of things are good. The shuttle facility is really good.

Hotel is good with different view rooms.. we visited this during the winters i e december end. i mean wow.The rooms are good and spacious. Breakfast buffet is very good. The weather was amazing. Each n every rooms had heaters. Hygenic place. It has an amazing view. The location of the hotel is amazing. The staff was very courteous and helpful. No pollution and no in hygiene.

Hotel is good with different view rooms.. we visited this during summer . rooms are good . Breakfast buffet is very good. service of hotel is nice. Just a problem with parking area. it is little far from hotel and you have to walk little. some rooms have nice view of valley. over all it was a good experience to stay here.

Excellent property. Great view of the valley specially sunrise. Courteous staff and excellent food.  10  min walking to all major locations. Regular pickup & drop by hotel vehicle . Breakfast spread is amazingly large catering to the taste of both national & international guests. Safe playing area for children and a handy library for the solo traveller. Overall an amazing expirence. Built on top of the hill with an old british built chalet built next to it ,to give a great visual delight.

Located on a hill top, Country Inn provides a breathtsking view. Rooms are beautiful, spacious and staff is very polite and helpful. The hotel is on the library end of the mall road so accessibility to mall road is not an issue. You get complimentry shuttle for pick n drop till 10 in the night. Food is great and very aptly priced esp as compared to insanely priced restaurants in any of the bigger cities these days.

This place is good fir a change from the hustle and bustle of the day activity of the mall, but for variety of thingscyou have to visit the mall of mussourie which is the heart of uttrakhand. Peaceful and clean area.

Stayed at country inn for only one night and was a good stay. The hotel is very well presented and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The hotel is very clean but unfortunately we had hair in the shower before we even used it. The breakfast and dinner buffet are good, found the a few of the dinner curries a bit spicy but we're not labeled to say so. Free wifi is offered.

going by the brand name this place was booked for a night, but was an absolute let down. The place lacks cleanliness, for the price quoted the rooms are very basic. The food is really bad. The buffet breakfast too is lacking in variety and taste too. The staff is nice and helpful but its the management of the lace which needs to put in an effort to make changes. Some of the rooms offer a great view.

Hat's off to the dedicated team of professionals at this hotel...right from the security guard, the lady gardener, managers, each and every staff one notices: 1. We are glad you are here attitude!!! 2. What more can we do? How may I help? 3. The response time is fantastic, issues, if any, are sorted out positively and real fast 4. Once done there is follow-up check and counter check 5. Amazingly the staff are well informed and provide correct information immediately!  It was an amazing experience for us and we will use this as our bench mark for other hotels.  We met, per chance, a couple who were celebrating their 1st marriage anniversary...the hotel has specially organized an evening they will remember...we were a witness to this occasion!   A few minor recommendations:  1.…

The hotel is very good and had an excellent experienced. I booked 2 rooms for myself and parents. My parents really liked the hotel the housekeeping staff was very courteous and helpful. What was asked they really took good care of my parents. Breakfast spread was also good with good variety.

this hotel is far most the most amazing hotel with good staff good parking good food and good everything .my room was decorated with baloons for a special ocassion and believe me it was worth a nominal sum paid really very impressed by the hotel will definitely visit this place again . thank you

rooms are good with  a doon  valley view  Also ,we celebrated  republic  day with  all guests and  staff--flag   was  also  hoisted. bathrooms   are also clean and  maintained,,the rooms  were  very  warm as heating  was quite effective  in  the month  of  january  also food quality of  restaurant  is  also  good Best  thing is free shuttle  to  mall till 10 pm

A very quaint but decent hotel in Mussoorie, which is a bit far away from the Mall (the main shopping area) - but easily accessible by local transportation (car). The rooms are big and nice and the ones with the balcony provide breathtaking views of the mountains. With the weather being amazing - the stay become quite memorable.

the service was up to the mark can't be better than this and food was just amazing.the room were very well situated and the environment was very neat and clean. the breakfast buffet was very lavish and very well organised and enjoyed the stay to the fullest.

Visited for two nights in Sept. While the hotel grounds, rooms were quite likable and staff very cooperative, the food was a letdown with buffet spread offering limited options. You can use the hotel shuttle unlimited no of times to go to Library Chowk from where everything is accessible on foot on the mall road. Ensure you come to Library Chowk for hailing hotel shuttle and not picture palace which is at other end of the mall road.

Nice place to stay. Food is also very good and the staff is really coperative and hard working. They also provide the shuttle service from hotel to main market wherein you can easily reach out to Mall road.

Very hygienic and beautiful rooms. Staff was very professional. But the reason I would never return is the food which was a major let down. We ordered room service sandwiches and burgers. Cold sandwiches no accompaniments and burnt burgers. When you are hungry and overly dissapointing food is served is the worst feeling. This would be the last place to have a meal in entire mussorie. Curdled curd for breakfast. We told the disappointment at reception during our breakfast but still all was on the bill and we politely paid even for burnt burgers.

The property is well located, right in mussoorie and at a height and offers a scenic view. But this is just one of very few positives about the property. Monkey Menace is a huge deterrent in the room comforts. So much so, that during our 2 day stay,we regularly encountered MONKEYS in the balcony. They are pretty huge and intimidating in behavior. So balcony is out of bounds for the guests. The food is pretty ordinary and the restaurant staff is least concerned about your concerns. They expect you to eat buffet day in n out and Ala Carte, if ordered, is below par. Tasteless and cold. Mosaic is a bad experience. The linen in the washrooms is in tatters as well. Smelly and discolored, it does not give you a very fresh feeling once you are done with the daily routine. To top it all,…

We were a couple with 11 years son travelled with our own car to mussoorie.The hotel was easily approachable,ample parking space.Superior Rooms were very cozy with balcony and great views.Rooms were spacious with all toiletries placed well.all modern room amenities were available.Very nice food,very couteous staff,Very friendly ambience and play areas.Very nice location at mussoorie.We loved this place and thanks to countryInn for making our stay memorable.

Excellent hospitality. Rooms not at all as shown in photos. Staff in the hotel is courteous. The shuttle service provided by the hotel is very convenient. food in the restaurant is good, however for breakfast it is advices that one should have before 9.15 or else there will be a waiting of 15 minutes at least for a table

good place to stay and have a great time...amazing view..extremely halpful staff and very courteous...great to be treated royally. i would like to recommend people to go and try out the wonderful hospitality

The hotel is situated right at the beginning of the mall road. They offer complimentary shuttle service to and from mall road. The staff was courteous and very helping. The view from the room was splendid. The room and washroom was clean and tidy. The buffet breakfast offers almost everything one wants to have in breakfast. Room service was good. Check in & check out process was pretty smooth.

a great trip to the queen of hills and the hotel property is nicely located with good enough rooms. All deluxe rooms have a sitout and have heaters. Breakfast is repetitive and menu remains for alternate days. There is complimentary pick up drop to mall road which is a good service. High Speed internet is complimentary and something to vouch for.

Stay was absolutely fantastic, warm and helpful staff specially front office, I will definitely recommend to friends and family,I was there for the last 2 days of 2015 and what a show put up by Country inn & Suites team, i really have no words except one simply fantastic. Thank u for grate service.

This is on a narrow road from the paid parking for mall road. They have complimentary pickup and drop off to the mall road and is convenient. Food was good too. Service was good - very responsive.  To improve: The airconditioner was not clean and blew a lot of dust and got me sick. There is no facility for drivers

Excellent hotel with helpful staff. Recommend to stay during Mussorrie visit. Rooms are clean with latest amenities. Food quality is good. Travel desk is helpful. Mall road is at accessible distance and pickup and drop facility is provided by the hotel

Need to work on food quality as well as option. as the option in buffet was limited specially in breakfast and quality was not that perfect as it should be. The room in which I stayed was not well maintained. The walls of the room were having seepage. The basin of the wash room was having a crack. And the toiletries were not there.

Nice location, not on mall road but not far away from mall road too. Complimentary pickup and drop to and from hotel to bus stand. Food in restaurant was above average. 100% value for money in terms of room tariff.

Stayed here for 2 nights during a recent business trip. The hotel is situated within walking distance from Library Chowk/Mall road. I stayed in one of the suites (#117) and must admit that the view was absolutely amazing.  What's great - The hotel location and the accompanying views  What can be better -   1.The food at the restaurant 2. They do not have a bar - which is a bit of a surprise !

We booked four rooms for two nights after searching multiple options. Pros- Peaceful, well maintained. Excellent buffet spread. Has a table tennis play option. Dinner buffet also very good. Great view. Esp. morning sunrise view. Cons- Slightly away from mall. But hotel provides free drop pickup. Beware of uninvited guests to your balcony. (Monkeys)

Good hotel, nice ambience, courteous staff. Nice buffet. Value for money. Only one drawback is that the Hotel is located away from Library Chowk / Mall Road, but this is taken care off by the hotel staff, by arranging regular pickups and drops. Would recommend for family stay. Good hotel, nice ambience, courteous staff. Nice buffet. Value for money. Only one drawback is that the Hotel is located away from Library Chowk / Mall Road, but this is taken care off by the hotel staff, by arranging regular pickups and drops. Would recommend for family stay.  Good hotel, nice ambience, courteous staff. Nice buffet. Value for money. Only one drawback is that the Hotel is located away from Library Chowk / Mall Road, but this is taken care off by the hotel staff, by arranging regular…

had a great time during my 3 nights of stay. very nice staff, mesmerizing ambiance.  food was delicious.room was very well made and was clean and tidy. I'll recommend everyone to try this place and I am sure u'll  be able to resonate the same view as mine.

The rooms are good but view is there.Didn't use there food service so cant comment about it.Spa is horrible should improve on it.Housekeeping & maintenance should be alert if they are having any maintenance problem as the generator was not working the whole day.As i have stayed in other country inn property so I was expecting much better.

A good hotel in Mussoorie. Nice rooms with balcony, however there are a lot of monkeys which may come across you if you are sitting in the balcony. Food was very good in taste. Check in was easy and comfortable. Room service was also good. Overall a good hotel to stay.

An tastefully placed location and hotel in mussorie. All aspects were as expected for a business traveller. Good food, rooms gives it a better feel.  One night stay less than a day was good enough to access the way the upkeep and hospitality of the staff.  Hence overall a pleasant stay!!

Hotel is located on the hill with all the rooms facing the valley. Higher above rooms provide very good view of the ranges and sunrise in the morning. People in mussorie are quite courteous and hospitable which is seen in the hotel staff too. Being on the top of hill, there is quite a trek to the hotel but hotel provides complimentary pick and drop service to the main road. There is kids play area and also bon fire in the evening.  For the cons, bathroom seems to be bit crooked as while bathing as water clogged, the staff attended it but did not help much saying that it is like this only. Breakfast options was okay and room service was average.  Given all, would like to go the hotel again to see the sunrise :)

I thank you team, for such a nice experience and stay. After much of long tiresome work I wanted to have a relaxing holiday to comfort my family and myself. I had a long drive and stopped at multiple locations before reaching hotel. I reached hotel at 9 PM and the reception staff was so efficient and sharp that they recognise me immediately and I did not had to say any word, but just regular security checks. Food was nice and so as their services. Overall staff was too courteous. It takes some time and to reach to hotel but it is their good part too, as, View from room balcony were really fantastic. Food quality and taste was too good. Though we had options in the market but every time we preferred to have food at hotel. I had my feedback for information to guests for buffet,…

Services are not up to the mark. Doesn't have any health club nor any swimming pool not any entertainment area. food was not tasty. Housekeeping facility were also not good. In this price range you can find many better hotels there

i feel it is Average maintained hotel. my expectation was high because this hotel is part of Club Carlson.View  from room is also average.  Be careful with monkyes, if you open the Balcony door. Small Parking place during season time you need to enquire parking before booking.

Great food and scenic beauty from the balcony are mind blowing.   Hotel provides pick up and drop facility to the town's important locations.  Must visit if you can spend some extra bucks for pampering yourself.

As per title. Bathroom water usually cold, at best it was sometimes warm. Good restaurant, great staff and food. Room was nice. No accommodation for driver, who had to sleep in his car when the temperature was close to zero degrees. Apparently this is one of the few hotels in Mussoorie without sleeping quarters for drivers. Because of the 2 issues we are unlikely to stay at this hotel again.

I stayed in the hotel for 2 nights with family. I was very Very happy  with the stay. Got room upgrade. Location of the hotel was super kool & we thoroughly enjoyed my stay.  Grt location, grt food with reasonable price.  I will surely come back for more...  Thanks a lot

Nice big room n lovely view from balcony...  Breakfast buffet tasted just ok and menu was same for my 3 days stay, but dinner was great..... Bathroom supplies are provided only when u ask....staff was very polite ....hotel was really value for money..... Overall a comfortable stay

I will miss the view that I got to see from the room. Very peaceful place. Would like to visit again. The hotel is near to mall road. Room service food wasn't too good though but overall experience was very good.

The location is good although if you are looking for luxurious stay then its not the place.The food quality is ok not very impressive. The benefit of stay is the resort is very close to mall road and provide comfort to go to mall road any time.

For me Mussorie = Country Inn .. Hotel has wonderful staff very good hospitality ..  I have visited this hotel twice and both time it hasn't disappointed in any way .. The room are always clean and food is super ..

There are 2 kinds of rooms here - Supreme and Deluxe. Deluxe is better one which has a balcony. All rooms are valley facing. Try and opt for a room on higher floors and on the left wing of the building to get the best view. Its about a km from mall road entry but they offer drop and pick up from that point which is very necessary. Breakfast is well spread and staff is courteous. It also has a nice children's area. Overall a nice stay.

Very polite staff and they tried to accommodate all our requests. The room had a great view and bed was very comfortable. The place is positive because of the staff. We ended up extending our stay and chilled at the hotel. Yes, some beers could have been great however we learnt that they don't serve alcohol. We experiences some problem with the hot water. It wasn't really HOT.

Had comfortable stay.. Nice rooms and excellent view from balcony..need to provide bathroom amenities without asking for it..Breakfast was ok..can be improved..Overall its a very good property..highly recommendable..

The trip to Mussoorie became a memorable one because of our sttay at Country Inn & Suites by Carlson. A lovely property with a very warm and inviting staff and ambience. The room was very comfortable with all amenities that one wishes. The bonfire in the evening was truly welcome surprise. Food was indeed mouth-watering. The entire staff was very nice and really took good care with a smile.

The room are very big an spacious with balcony. Very clean bathroom. Very good ambiance in he hotel. Good food in Mosiac restaurant specially the breakfast, It was delicious. Free Shuttle service. Overall we had a nice 2 day stay.

The road which leads up to the hotel can be missed , if its dark and the climb is pretty steep up the 800 meter walk to the hotel. The hotel is on the top of a hill , and gives an overarching view of Mussorie, though our room wasn't great, and looked out on to a meeting area.  The rooms are cosy, though our room was low on ventilation , and we felt heavy in the morning when we woke up. The buffet breakfast was below par , but we had a good dinner. The car parking area is a bit of a nightmare , with barely space for 10 odd cars , but as many as 25 were parked the night we stayed, so that was a challenge , especially parking and departure in the morning.  In spite of the infrastructural inconveniences, the service is very good, and makes up for the minor inconveniences. I would…

I Stayed in country inn by carlson so many times and i really enjoy.rooms are very nice and room service is also good.but some more improvement they needed like in some breakfast they need more freshness. and dental kit and shaving kit in bathroom they provide on demand its not good as this is 5 star grade hotel

Good stay and rooms were very nice and clean.. food was ok can be improved. Rest all was very good. The wait staff and frontdesk were very helpful too. Overall a good exerience in the midst of nature.

Nice clean rooms and bathrooms. Great view. In house dining is a bit in the expensive side and not that great. Better to venture out for some lip smacking food. Excellent staff. Could do better by engaging guests in the evening by live music,  bonfire etc.

We stayed in this hotel for just one night. The hospitality was good and would definitely recommend rooms on the higher  floors for better view of the place. Though the breakfast was not so good, the a la carte being served was pretty awesome.

I have selected the same hotel  from make my trip site. Though location is very good, there is a property with same name of other group. Some signboards are required.  Overall stay is very good, food in restaurant is very good. Complimentary Breakfast has also lot of varieties..

I stayed CountryInn & Suites for 4 days, had a wonderful and romantic time. My room was upgraded from superior to delux without any cost. Me and my wife loved the hospitality, service, food, pick/drop alot. Perfect for family sply honeymooners. Would love to visit again and again.

Overall a good experience, though some of the basic ammenities like gymnasium is missing, children's play area is outdated. Hotel staff is nice, pleasant and warm. Hotel can add some group activities and games.....The Spa experience was really rejuvenating one.....

Excellent location,very humble,cooperative staff.View from balcony was amazing.Very fast shutle service for pick & drop to mall road.Rooms were very clean,neat & tidy.An excellent hotel,must stay.wow!

Last minute booking and great room! Service was great! Room was clean with good view of the city. Amazing customer service. Felt like the staff truly cared about the guests. Very clean & quiet. The hotel inside was great. The bed was comfortable and the room altogether was pleasant. We had the top floor like we wanted. The outside was a bit more run down than the pictures show. The girl at the front desk was really just there for a job.

This Hotel is best to stay everything was Fantastic , Rooms, Bathrooms, Services, Food and Staff I will recommend this Hotel for Stay to all, who want to go with family, Single or couple, its was nice experience for me when I visited and stayed

As I was quite aware regarding carlson country Inn & suite services this time my full family experienced and enjoyd. Our age group was 1 year to 41 years old.  Every body loved country Inn & suites Mussoorie forever.  We would go every year this is our promises.

Location is good and close to the Mall Road, when you go to a hill station to expect warm/hot water in the bathroom which was never there for two days Also the breakfast quality is not good. We complaint to the front office however they were not concern as if they know about the issue and on top of that they never felt sorry as if they are doing an honor to us.

A very well maintained hotel with an extremely courteous staff. Food was good as well. The only thing they need to work on is adding more of In-House activities. Food Menu is also not very expensive either but the only this which was missing from it was Liquor Menu.

Overall it was a great stay with you guys in Mussorie.  If someone is looking forward to visit Mussorie than do stay in Country Inn as the hotel staff are very cooperative and soft spoken and services are really good.  If we talk about hotel staff so whenever you meet them, they will greet you saying Namaskar every time which quite unique now a days.   As far as food and room in services are concerned they got a best recipe in town for every dishes which they have mentioned in there menu card.   Highly Recommended..!!

courteous staff excellent service superb food ,  we have had no complaints at all every thing went very smooth , hotel location is just 2 min away from mall road , shuttle services is complimentary , room with balcony is recommended.

The great thing about this property is located at nice location near Library close to mall road, hotel provides a local shuttle for drop off and pick up close to Mall road .Very quite and peaceful ambiance. Great and excellent service by all staff members from front desk to Restaurant including housekeeping. Warm welcome by front staff Nandani, Neelam ,Lalit, and Kushal Sharma  Front Desk Manager, Thanks to Mr.Anil MOD and House keeping Manager for taking care of us and for including our favorite dish in the buffet we requested for. On the top we appreciate the excellent service by the server Vijay pal who took care of us for entire stay. Some of the things we will like to bring to the attention of Management and Club Carlson CEO That this property needs renovation and change in…

very nice. My parents had gone for a pleasant trip and they really enjoyed staying there. It's really nice, clean. Food is really good. It's worth the money!! The climate was really good. It was a good trip.

Need to get the rooms renovated and even the shower was not giving enough hot water. The Spa was not functional.room service was good, valet service was good, belly boy was great...the room view even though I took a deluxe room was not good I could see only some tree and the terrace of the hotel

Hotel Country Inn & Suites by Carlson is extremely good hotel. I stayed there for a day only but I enjoyed my stay thoroughly. The location, the room, the ambiance, the food, the service, everything is so good. A must stay hotel to enjoy the experience of staying in a Hotel.

i stayed with my family for 02 nights in Hotel Country suites by carlson.Hotel is excellent as per location, service, staff, parking, food. Rooms are spacious food is good & ambience. Superb.. They provice pick up drop at mall as per yur wish.

Being a member of d carlson group and having being stayed at many of the group's properties , I was sure of an excellent service but there was nothing special about my stay in mussorie.  I had booked two rooms well in advance but was given rooms with the most pathetic view . Both my rooms were facing the toilet.  As compared to other properties the buffet breakfast served was not up to the standards which carlson group maintains. Shortage to towels and water problem among a few other shortcomings I found during my stay.   A lot needs to be done to bring it upto the standard what we look for in your hotels.  If you want to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the crowd, plan on staying here as it is tucked in a corner with the happening mall road at the opposite end of the…

Good hotel at the price you pay. Multi-cuisine restaurant is there to treat you. You can have chinese, indian, good buffet breakfast which is mix of continental and indian. Near to Library chowk. Overall, great experience and relaxing holiday

The hotel staff,  rooms,  ambiance is good. It is a comfortable stay. The issue is reaching to the hotel. It is at the campty fall road and it is a slight uphill ride. It is costly to reach each time one opts for a cab. They do have a shuttle though but with the traffic it gets to much. But this is true for the entire Hill city. I would recommend the hotel for families.

A nice property neatly tucked away on a hill away from the Hustle and bustle and still only a small walking distance away from "The Mall".The hotel runs a shuttle for the Uphill part of the distance for those preferring not to walks on the hills. Nice view from the room with an open air bar area in front and lovely "Kapurthala Castle " in the background playing hide and seek in misty clouds.Ordered room service. Food was excellent

Had booked this hotel thru Internet. We were given a small room with a common door to the adjacent room. We could clearly hear the people in the next room and I am sure they could hear us as well. The food was below average and needs improvement. The property is located in such a place that u have to ask for free hotel shuttle each time.

This is really amazing hotel with equally amazing staff. Staff was really really helpful and full of courtesy. I have two incidence where they were full of courtesy. First, we needed some medicines for headache  they were not having it in their First Aid box. They urgently sent some one and brought them. Secondly, we ordered Egg Curry and hotel was not having them, so they again sent some one at 10:30 to brought them.  Rooms are really great . But some rooms doesn't have good valley view. So check for the room correctly.  I stayed in this hotel thrice. when ever i visit Mussoorie i always stay in this hotel only.  Their Breakfast buffet is really awesome.   Only one bad thing, that cost wise they are at slightly higher node and one more. The pathway that we take from main to…

Food quality is good but it could have been better with more varieties. Quality of  amenities in hotel need to be improved a lot and the main issue is bathroom facilities where all the things need to be changed with fresh ones.

Being a Club Carlson member got my welcomedrink, got an upgrade with a lovely balcony.Room size is good for couple, though we were brothers this time. Food is very decent, just upgrading the breakfast spread will help them live upto the 4star tag. Decent parking space and a serene place for a silent rendezvous.
