I loved my stay with country inn suites by carlson...amazing food,well behaved staff and lovely rooms. Will definitely stay there again in future and will recommend to everyone planning to visit mussorie.

Shall like to stay again if ever visit Mussoorie, recommend friends and family  . But shall definitely want improvement on (I) food quality (ii) Room Amenities and (iii) noise level of the kitchen exhaust that pollutes the balcony

When you enter Mussoorie, the cool breeze welcomes you and this hotel further enhances that experience. This is an excellent property. To begin with this hotel is situated uphill very near to mall road. Just walkable distance from main market area and they do provides cabs to drop and pick up from main road. Enter hotel and the nice decor and super friendly staff would make you feel special. Hotel staff is very good. They have ample parking space for cars. Room is very spacious had an amazing view from window. In room dining is good and serves delicious items. However, buffet breakfast was not so good and had limited options available. Had buffet only on day 1 of our stay. In non-veg items they only had the sausages available, that's it. And i felt the restaurant didn't had…

Hotel is Excatly on the Top of Mussoorie. The View from Hotel is really Amazing. I was there for 2 night (AP Basis). Everything was fine. Room service was awesome. Excellent Food, Excellent Staff Excellent Room Everything is Awesome On top, Rates are reasonable

It is definitely a home away from home and the staff is very very cordial friendly and responsible. I had been to mussorrie in sep 15 and booked another hotel reading some false reviews and left the hotel immediately. Carlson took an instant booking for me just over the phone and Mr Kushal - on duty manager was kind enough to come and pick me from the midst of no where late at night and bring me safely to the country Inn property as the chauffeur was out for dinner and he did not let me wait. I was very touched by the gesture and all the other staff like Nandini and Venus were very helpful and caring. Although I had gone alone but made great new friends. The site is amazing, food is great and service is excellent ! Also, it is very near to the Mall road and has a great Spa too.…

Visited this hotel last weekend. Location: Uphill, good. Valley View is not available from every room. Breakfast is devoid of taste and Carlson quality standards.  Staff is courteous.  They provide pick and drop to the main road near library square till 10 pm in the night. Suggestion is to increase the timings slightly as restaurants on  mall road are open till 11 pm.

The Hotel is situated on a hill with beautiful view, the staff was courteous as ever and the food was awesome. We ordered Mutton Rogan Josh which was perfectly crafted to excellence. Special Thanks to the Chef.They also upgraded my room :) Thanks. Hotel provide shuttle to library chowk on just a call. Many Reasons to visit again and again. There is one carlson point issue which I believe would be resolved for my stays as it was a third party booking. Thanks CIS Team for making our stay cozy

Hotel view is fab. Near to kapurthale view and the climate is rotated again nd again. Its a amazing to stay there. Food was yummy and serive is fast and menu is reasonable prices. Resturant staff was very coperative and mannerable. Hotel hospitality is good.overall excellent stay there.

Hotel is located around 1 KM from Mall road, beautiful property with spacious rooms with all modern amenities. Higher floor gives better view of valley. Food is also decent. Staff was very courteous. Has parking space as well.

A Carlson Rezidor property speaks for itself and its services are bound to be great and self explanatory. Lavish and modern decor rooms and great spread of breakfast is the usp. It is much secluded from the city hustle too.

Nice Location, They provide pick and drop to the Mall so it is very convenient The buffet breakfast was good  The rooms were very neat and clean and had a very good view.  Room service was quick and staff was helpful

I couldn't have asked for more, spacious room, excellent food, courteous staff, kids zone for my infants and above all the hotel is amid dense greenery and location too is excellent.  Above all I was offered off season discount which sweetened the overall deal. I will recommend this hotel to anyone specially with kids.

I was there for two day on business trip. The hotel location is very good and view of valley from valley side rooms is superb. Rooms are big and neat and clean.    The hotel management and staff are very co operative. Breakfast is average but good quality and good variety in veg and non veg. Food quality is good.

Its nice hotel to stay for vacation and leisure trips. Its bit away from bus station. But the car service was superb. so no problem. location is nice. staff is polite and helpful. room was nice clean and large enough. breakfast was superb. I recommend other friends to go for it.

Positive - View from hotel rooms is just awesome. - Rooms are very neat and clean. - Hotel staff is very good , nicely dressed and helpful. - Complementary breakfast on ground floor and options were good. - If you are with kids than swings and fun games available on roof. - Hotel provides cabs free of cost till mall road. - Free wifi inside the room.  Negatives - Location of the hotel was bit difficult to find. - Around 2 km upside hill from mall road.  Overall good hotel to stay for couples and  families

Such a pathetic Hotel. Super bad management and basic rooms. The location is also very far from main markets. The rooms are not at all like the pictures they have put on the website. The behaviour of the management is like they are giving you the room for free. Much better options available nearby. I would strongly recommend to avoid !

Hotel View and Location is extremely good , Rooms are Big and if you are lucky Room with Balcony is really very good . Its on Height easily approachable . Just one thing i found little average Food of the Hotel otherwise staff , location and amenities of the hotel is really very good

Hotel is on peak of Hill with over looking entire Mussoorie. Hotel is at walk able distance from Mall road but same time gives you your space and peace you are looking during your stay at Hill station. Hotel provide pickup drop facility to Mall road. Restaurant & food is good, staff is very friendly and takes good care. Rooms are comfortable and bathroom are spacious - ask for room facing valley - city view.

The location of Country Inn and ambiance is awesome. Although the approach road is very narrow. Its a good place to stay, the breakfast was also good and tasty.  Overall very good place to stay. I would recommend this hotel to my friends and relatives.

A small nice hotel with a courteous staff... pretty close to the Mall Road and yet away from the city crowd being tucked away on a closely hillock. Nice stay. The food though needs attention and some innovation. Nice for a small family vacation.

Though I checked in for the Ist time, I was a little apprehensive about the stay. However everything right from the rentry point to exit was found to be perfect. Above all the restaurant staff was very nice, food quality excellent, variety of food was there. Thanks for upgrading my room to Deluxe......I would surely like to visit again.

The staff were warm and welcoming. The rooms were very cosy and ours faced Kapurthala Palace, which was beautiful to wake up to every morning. The Breakfast was excellent with a good variety. We even opted for a foot massage which was not bad. There was a pick and drop to the main road as the hotel was a slight distance away, but besides that, our stay was wonderful.

Great palace, the executive rooms are great and spacious. The staff is very courteous and efficient. The food is good. The bathrooms are huge and clean. The restaurant menu is great and is resanabili priced. The decor is good. It is situated near the mall road and has a great location too . You should come here to gave a nice holiday.

Visited this hotel in July as a part of my business trip or I say fun trip every year my co. do this exercise & we plan these small trips for our team. This year we choose to visit mussoorie & booked this hotel for 3days & 2 nights. Initially not happy as it is almost 1 & half hour journey from DDun station I feel tired & irritated & can’t even blame anyone as this is my idea. But once we are in hotel the front desk executives are so helpful it just take us few minutes & we are in our rooms. After check In we plan a small day trip nearby place but to my surprise that day there was non-stop raining & the hotel drivers are out to pick other guests so one of the executive arranges or I say he himself drive us towards their drop point Highly appreciating, Thank you Mr Kushal…

I have visited this hotel in july with my colleagues.enjoyed my staying there.Rooms are clean & the decor  is peaceful :) The reception personnel were very helpful in advise on what to do in the city.  we request for a late check-out, it was approved also, even on a off season time, some hotel would not have approved it.as mentioned already special thanks to check in staff  Tip: Better view from rooms in 1st floor.

Have been to mussoorie quite a few times. Booked 3 rooms for 2 nights 3 days in country inn this time through cleartrip (got an amazing deal). We were 3 couple with kids. We went on week days specially so that we get peace from the weekend rush usually which is there in Mussoorie.   On Arrival we received a wonderful refreshing coconut welcome drink which deserves a mention here. We asked for Valley view room at reception but was not available so we were upgraded to complimentary deluxe room instead which had a wonderful view of Maharaja Mansion (which i personally loved though not much liked by my friends as against the valley view). The rooms were spacious and   This a was supposed to be a relaxed trip so we lazed around in the hotel/room/balcony most of the time which was fun…

I have visited this hotel during August with friends. Hotel is near half km from main taxi stand on hill. They have provided free pick and drop till taxi stand. Room are nice and spacious. Hill view room have a balcony with make stay more comfortable. Morning sun rise was amazing from the balcony.  Hotel have a limited parking space which is limited to across all the hotel in the city. Staff  was nice and food was also good. Hotel didn't have the bar that is the limitation. Overall gud property.

The staff was very courteous and very accomodating. We returned late from a trip on the last day of our trip and could only check out more than three hours after the scheduled time but the staff was very understanding and we didn't face any issues. Although a little pricey, the hotel didn't disappoint.

It is at the other end of the Mall Road i.e. the the Library end. There is nothing wrong with the hotel.. However nothing very exciting. It is an average hotel,  Rooms - Just Nice Views from the rooms  - Just Nice Staff - Just OK Sleep Quality - Just OK Location - Just OK.. It is not a WOW experience. So if you go there you will not be disappointed.. However nothing gr8 to mention about the hotel

Location also good, hardly walk-able distance from mall road. scenic view from all corners of the hotel. food is very good for any state people. Attendants are very cordial and helping every one with smiley faces. Drivers are not getting any place to sleep which has to be addressed.

Country Inn & Suites by Carlson offers very peaceful and relaxing stay and yet very close to the Mall Rd. giving perfect reason to chose this hotel for stay. Its dining and in-room service offers really delicious food and enjoyed the stay at the fullest.

Approach to hotel is bit difficult although mostly taxi goes upto hotel and hotel provides pick up and drop upto halfway to Mall area rest You have to walk very congested road. Views are exellent. Situated at good height, Calm and Quiet, Monkeys always present, Well maintained Nice rooms with Balcony. Prefer upper floors as lift is there..BreakFast was good. Staff courteous. Small kids play area present.

the hotel is nowhere near a  four star  the rooms are not clean and fresh as one would expect from Carlson rezdor group, no travel desk no gymnasium, old bathroom fittings, cots carpets ,almirah, not value for money, ordered for in room dining but had to wait for almost 1 hour befor the food finally arrived, alomond milk as promised while booking was not provided

the hotel is almost like a 5*.. the staff were brilliant and the room was amazing.. the amenities, bathroom, extra services were all perfect and we couldnt have asked for anything more on a hilltop..  the view from the hotel room is breathtaking.  keep your windows shut in the evening to avoid unwanted visitors like monkeys & insects.

Staffs are very good. rooms are neat and clean. location of the hotel is very good. Breakfast was good, The lunch & dinner food quality needs improvement.  open area is less.  some site seeing facilities may also be incorporated by the hotel.

I was here in this hotel as part my my uttaranchal tour this hotel had a great view of mussoorrie town . The hotel is located admist lush  green trees and there is a comforting silence around the location which made my stay further comforting . Rooms service and hygiene are of top class .Hotel staff are very polite and courteous .

We stayed here for 2N3D and had a very pleasant stay. The Location, Food quality, Local Staff everything was just great. We were upgraded to Deluxe Suit and well treated by everyone. Specially impressed by Rahul and the Chef Captain. Location is very nice, less than a km from mall road with pick and drop facility. So a scenic beauty and no hassles of mall road traffic. Food quality was also very good, apart from regular buffet they obliged by serving anything different we wanted. All in all its a nice place to stay and relax away from hectic metro life.

Country inn and suites by Carlson is a great property...USP being the location..amazing view from the hotel..rooms r clean n neat...they HV pickup n drop to mall road from 9 am to 9 pm..mall road is 600 MTS away...  Food was decent..breakfast was good..  A great place to stay with family...thy HV kids play zone as well...

I went there during winters though, so was extremely delighted with the price that I got this hotel. They also upgraded our stay as a courtesy gesture as it was our first visit.  The rooms were clean and neat. They also had a shuttle service to pick and drop you till the taxi area. This was a great help.  The staff was extremely helpful and well mannered. They helped us in planning our tour more effectively. The food quality was also nice.  Overall, a nice play to stay.

just an awesome property.. if u r planning for 2-3 relaxing stay near from Delhi, so just go for it...  food is good...location is best and hospitality is unexceptionable... in short just go and stay in calm and fresh atmosphere..

Excellent place to stay, highly economical compared to other high-end hotels in the city. Very near to the city-centre / Mall Road. Drop facility to the hotel is provided  Services, facilities, rooms all are very good. Breakfast buffet is good with decent choices from North India, South Indian and Continental stuff.  The rooms are clean and big, got free upgrade from Superior to Delux Rooms.

We stayed in this hotel from 6th to 8th March 2015. I need to say that this is one of the better quality hotels that I have stayed in hill stations. The hospitality and food is good, and even the staff is very courteous and smiling. The rooms at 4th floor provide amazing view, and the hotel is very close to mall road. The hotel provides a free drop to the paid parking area (hardly two minutes from the hotel) and the mall is then a walking distance from there (takes less than 5 minutes). The hotel also provides a very good wifi connectivity (wi-fi is complimentary).   With regard to food, the same is good, and has a good variety in menu to choose from.   Overall an amazing stay.

We stayed during the month of march. It was good hotel and right price. Room service and food were amazing. Very comfortable stay and location. Room rooms had a very good view. Staff was very helpful and courteous.

this hotel scores the most in its location .. the hotel is nowhere near a five star and can bearly be called a four star .. it doesnt have a bar and the rooms are spacious but not as clean and fresh as one would expect from this franchise .. the staff is very courteous and  responsive the breakfast buffet is good the restaraunt food is also above average . book online with tripadvisor and get better deals than their original website . i was a bit dismayed by this hotel as my experience at country inn and suites at amritsar was far more superior

We stayed here just for a day but were very happy with the room & hotel staff.  We did not want to spend 8-12k, so Jaypee, Savoy & others were out. B/w fortune grace, which is managed by ITC, and Country Inn...country Inn definitely is way better! Tastefully decorated rooms with clean bathrooms and all other facilities. Would definitely stay here again.

I stayed at hotel for 3 nights ,I booked from make my trip and this was my second visit to this hotel. Hotel is good with fantastic location, also it is very near to mall road.  I would rate the hotel for more than 3 star.

Located near Mall Road. The hotel is an new building and well interior maintenance are excellent. The reception personnel were very helpful in advise on what to do in the city.  Breakfast were excellent , will fresh fruits and juices, Tea,Coffee, Paratha, Butter, Subji and it is different everyday, they serve like as our family members. Hotel management are arrange car for local sight seeing which will paid by us. We stayed for 2 days and we did not remember our home.  Appreciate their service special thanks its staff, all helped us lots generous, helpful, courteous. Highly recommended.

Nice place to stay with family. Very economical. neat and clean. Great hospitality, helpful  and smiling staff. drop off and pick up from the mall road. Great location, up the hill, great view from the room window.. Great recommendation.

We chose this hotel over Jaypee owing to location and did not regret !!!  Country Inn certainly lives up to the expectation with Staff as one of the highlights. Right from doorman to cleaning staff, don't forget to greet. Reception people are prompt and helpful.  Starting with hotel location, it is an uphill hotel (around 500 meters <quite steep>) from library end. Though steep, they offer pick and drop to common parking which comes handy. I like such locations as  keeps noise away.  Rooms are clean and spacious with all star amenities. Room service is prompt as well.   Food spread was good and tasty. Found value for money  Certainly a value for money hotel.

My wife and I stayed at Country Inn Carlson Mussoorie for two nights. Had a wonderful experience. Staff is courteous and flawless in their hospitality. Secluded location for a peaceful stay, yet very accessible as it lies on the Mall road. So all in all thumbs up with full recommendations.

I stayed there last week, and over all the experience was good with the hotel and the staff. Food quality was good. caring staff. nice place to stay for family as well as for couples. it is a bit far from Library chawk, but the hotel provide free ride, so no issues at all.

its an excellent property well maintained and excellent food vehicle drop free every time ,nice view and hospitable staff wish to visit next time again and refer my friends and relatives ,very safe location for stay

Was there with group of 30 .. awsome service  and interiors..food was great...staff was too good..woul stay there only if visit next time...mr. rahul who was looking after all was there all time and served us well.. the view of himalyan ranges was making remarkable stay ..in rooms . No dout that it is far from mall but they provide that pick and drop as well

The location of the hotel, Spacious elegant rooms, are the only two good things to say about the hotel. Despite mixed reviews I read on Tripadvisor before booking the hotel, I opted to stay in this carlson group property and was heavily let down for reasons already stated by many other reviewers:  1) The entire lobby smells of food. Don't know in which centre of the earth have they located the kitchen. But the lobby should rather have some pleasant odour to relax you on a holiday.  2) The bathroom smells badly. Its something to do with their centrally controlled ventilation. 3) Bathroom taps, wall, floor was broken, which means the property lacks maintenance. I could not manage a mix of hot and cold water from tap lever (played with it for a while and cut short my planned…

This hotel is situated on hill which gives very good view of the Himalayas. The rooms are very fresh and do not have dampness unlike many hotels in Mussoorie. The hotel is situated on the way to kempty fall and very close to the market. The hotel's cabs pick up and drop guests to the main chowk free of cost. You just need to tell them 5 minutes before pick up or drop required by you. Overall, a very good hotel to stay in Mussoorie. I have stayed at this property three times.

Very nice hotel with corteous and friendly staff. Services of the hotel and staff is commendable. Only thing that needs improvement is the bathroom of the room as the one in ours was stinking. Hotel is very close to mall road and they also provide shuttle service from hotel till mall road which is a delight.Buffet Breakfast has a wise choice from Indian to continental.

Excellent Location, Staff & Management . Great Rooms with Scenic View. Mouth watering Food and great service. Front office staff is  very hospitable and smiling face. We experienced from last to  First Snow fall  all credit goes to Mr. Sharma.

Good location and very good services. Room service and food quality is very nice and staff is very friendly. Quiet hotel in the woods. Internet access is good. Easy access to the city market. Overall a very good experience.

Stayed there for two days on a family vacation. We booked a superior room and due to v less occupancy got upgraded to deluxe which made a v good first impression.  However, the bad food quality and taste was a v big demotivator. Even, after giving personal feedback to the chef, the food did not improve the next day. Also, kids found a liquor bottle in the room while playing, which says a lot about how the clean up the room.   Also, there is a lot of monkey menace in the hotel balcony.  Even, thought we got upgraded to deluxe (the only difference is the balcony) we could not use it.  As it was not advisable & safe. Not sure, why they charge different rate for the rooms for.  I would not stay in this hotel in future and would not recommend it to anyone.

Stayed with my colleagues for one day. I am thankful to this hotel to make our visit successful and to add more fun to it. Good food, courteous & caring staff. Excellent location with good view of Himalaya from all rooms. Nice spread of buffet dinner & breakfast . overall value for money.  Strongly recommended for personal / official visits.

We stayed for two nights here on mid nov 2014. Good location; you can see Himalayan range from hotels.  Mall road is 500mt from paid parking and hotel provides pick & drop facility from paid parking.  Rooms were neat and spacious.  Overall food is good.  Only problem I see that there is not much for leisure time/kids in hotel except fish aquarium.

i just came back from mussourie yesterday and the first thing i am doing is writing the review for this awesome hotel..really good hotel awesome service ,staff very helpful very polite..rooms are good spacious and well designed.e stayed dere from 10 jan 2015 -12 january 2015....one more suggestion dere are hell lot of monkey dere so please keep ur balcony closed when u leave for sightseing..we faced this problem by mistake we forget to close the balcony door while leaving and monkeys entered our room and take all the eatable items in the mini baar with thm ...for this we have to pay to the hotel ..be carefull..at part from this the property is awesome food was very tasty..whenever i ll come to mussourie again i ll stay here only

Rooms are small and not up to the mark. washrooms were in bad position and not cleaned staff was helpful but less in number according to guests internet was not working properly  food and service was good. security people were very helpful.  In Totality Not value for money.

Needs to improve a lot. Food is overpriced.Room service was delayed. We called four times to room service to clear our lunch plates from room. Room heater was not working at all. Pictutre quality of TV was horrible. Only positice thing was the location nad near to the mall road.

We stayed for two nights on 1st and 2nd Jan.  Pros Excellent location, courteous staff, good food, complimentary pick drop facility from paid parkinng.  Cons House keeping needs to improve. We were givn room after 30 minutes and that too was not clean. We had to change the room immediately. Next day the room was cleaned only after repeated follow ups.

After visiting Haridwar, wé stayed at Country inn and suites in Mussoorie for 3 days. Wé reached around 7 PM and had to wait around 30 minutes before Check in. Wé were given a welcome drink. Rooms were Neat & tidy , clean and spacious. We had to walk around 500.mt up from the Car parking at the end of mall road. The hotel provides pick and drop service to and from the Car parking. Complimentary breakfast was tasty. We all enjoyed our stay in this charming hotel in mussoorie

Over all stay was good except spicy smell in lobby(we have observed this issue in almost all hill stations we have visited so far in north india). staff were really supporting. food was really best in class. hotel location is amazing just near to mall road hence we can roam around as much as we want. over all experiance was delighting.

We stayed for one night in February 2014. Hospitality was brilliant overall. Staff was courteous, caring and always smiling. Breakfast buffet was good, tried various dishes. Room was clean and beautiful with amazing view. I would highly recommend this hotel.

Stayed here for a day only and we were greeted with an upgrade of our room... must appreciate their services, very apt and courteous. Front office staff supports you for any or all the requirements that you put up to them. Room service is at par and food quality and quantity is much proportionate to the level of service the hotel is providing. Best part of the hotel is the location.. walking distance from the mall road and on a hill to give you a clear and a splendid  view of the Himalayas.. Definitely a must recommended hotel to stay in for any visit to Mussoorie.... Looking forward for a next trip...

After visiting Club mahindra kanatal , wé stayed at Country inn and suites in Mussoorie for one day. Wé reached around 2 PM and have to wait around 30 minutes for Check in. Wé were given a welcome drink. Rooms were Nice , clean and quite spacious. Hôtel is situated around 500.mt up from thé Car parking where thé mall road ends. Hôtel provides thé shuttle service to and from thé Car parking. Complimentry breakfast was good.   Tip: if you want thé hotel cab to pick you up than Call thé hotel service desk atleast 20 min prior.

We decided to stay at Mussoorie for a day after attending a family function at Dehradun. As our trip was not planned, we had not booked any hotel for our stay at Mussoorie. After few phone calls, the front office staff of Country Inn & Suites invited us to see their property. A little away from main busy city area, this property is in very quite place. Yet the place has all facilities you can look far. Our room was spacious, neat & clean. And the view was amazingly beautiful. Dinner at Mosaic restaurant was also an excellent experience. The staff was courteous & highly professional. Breakfast at Mosaic was again was a great experience. This property has its own private parking area. We were unwilling to leave this paradise. Will definitely visit again & strongly recommend this…

over all good, we had fun and enjoy the limited time at Country Inn & Suites By Carlson Mussoorie, we had good time in Country Inn & Suites By Carlson Mussoorie and queen of hills, will soon be try to come at  Mussoorie

The last time I visited the Hotel in Feb, my friends and I were really happy. We had a clean, well maintained room. The housekeeping was courteous and professional.   So, naturally I decided to visit again this time around.  Only this time we were first given a room on the 4th floor, allegedly as an upgrade, but it was not ready.   1. Question - How come the Front Office does not know which rooms are ready to be occupied by new guests? No communication with Housekeeping??  We were then shifted to a room on the first floor. After I asked I be shifted to a cleaner room, I was given one which was ok,   3.…

Excellent Hotels bit away the main towns....clean and well maintained rooms...nice staff both at front office and restaurant....good food and service......Hotel run shuttle service from Mall road to hotel.

Everything about the hotel was great. Really helpful and excellent staff throughout all the hotel. The food was good and the rooms were lovely kept exceptionally clean by great cleaning staff. We will definitely go back and recommend to anyone.

i had been to Country Inn & suites with my family and it was my first hand Experience with this group in India.Club Carlson is covering Radisson BLU as well as Park Plaza Group.A very good hotel in Mussoorie with not a good distance from main market place,but then its covered by complimentary pick up & drop till the market place which is indeed very helpful,otherwise it`s very difficult to reach the hotel.Having said that,Location is the plus point of the hotel from where you get the view of mussoorie if u happen to stay in leftside rooms of the property.We had booked their Executive suite,which was on 4th floor and had uninterrupted view of the valley,with a very spacious room to station a family of four.A decent view fro the balcony itself.I should mention here that they have…

over all nice property and room are good worth it location is also a good staff is also  supportive value for money for stay but i ll give 2marks less for food its not value for food so one can go and stay there is no problem and mussoorie is good one

We stayed at Country Inn on one of the weekends to Mussoorie and had a very pleasant experience. The staff is very polite and courteous and we even got a discounted rate when we checked in. The hotel is perched on a steep slope about a kilometre away from Mall Road. The hotel however has a pick and drop facility. This way you remain close to the Mall Road while at the same time being away from the noise and din. The rooms are pretty nice and comfortable and the buffet breakfast is quite enjoyable. Overall, a very cosy stay! P.S.: Special mention of the security guard Dipak who always had a smiling face and greeted you with a polite Namaste whenever you passed him :)

Had visited this For a Holiday with Family.  Location: 3* As hotel is located at on a very steep Slope of about 1km where only small private cars can move or hotel cars. They have a service of pick up and drop till midway Parking lot but not till down the slope which is little tiresome but still can manage. Have call from outside to inform hotel reception for our arrival to pick us from down parking lot. So always have to wait till the pick up car arrives. As this not taken for a 4* property so down grade to 3*  Amenities & Cleanliness: A very kids friendly as they have a kids play area where kids can spend quality time playing. Lobby, Rooms, Security all great. Cleanliness too Good. Keep up. Bathroom fittings need improvements as it was leaking but was taken care of immediately…

Stayed for Two nights for our anniversary & it was a awesome stay. We were treated like Royals.Hotel in surrounded by forest from all sides & therefore very peaceful. Rooms are very spacious, clean, modern & all are valley facing. You will find all the staff members at the Mosaic Restaurant always smiling & ready to help. Despite having buffet breakfast, they will serve you the breakfast at your table itself.  Highly recommended for those who are looking for peaceful stay at Mussoorie.

We stayed with family in countryinn on first wk of octoberfor 2 days.rooms cleanliness was verygood.staffs were very pleasant and helpful.food was awesome yummy..I recommend all those who are looking for a  peaceful stay at mussorie.....

Thanks country Inn suites for making my trip to mussorie a really memorable one I stayed there on 3 and 4 September 14 with my wife and little daughter staff is really courteous and responsive, food is good, rooms very clean and spacious do try the suites room if you are staying there hotel is good value for money and is located at convenient distance from mall road though you have to walk a little from where hotel staff drops you but considering that you are getting excellent hospitality at a very nominal price it is worth it I would like to congratulate Mr sharma hotel Gm for building such a nice team and he was himself setting example by asking guest if their stay is comfortable this is something from which many so called big brands can also learn I would also like to thank…

I travelled Mussooire from New Delhi on 18th Oct'14 on my own Car. Below are some terrible experience I faced during my 2 nights stay in Country Inn & Suites, Mussroorie: The Reception staff seems not at all hospitable. I just can figure out from their face, attitude & service which is provided start from beginning. We have been allocated room on 1st floor which is very close to reception. The room is decent one except some bathroom fittings clearly broken or missing, which is clearly not accepted from this hotel category.The floor beneath bed is full of dust, seems not been cleaned for months, I realized this when trying to search for my son lost toy... :-) The view from room balcony is parking and nothing else....Obviously, this is not for which we booked Delux category room…

Fantastic...from the moment we checked in.  A week is a long time to judge the consistency in services, facilities and hospitality.  At Country Inn & Suites, Mussoorie, the guests are the first priority.  Spellbinding location of the property, absolutely neat and clean interiors and exteriors, well appointed rooms, exceptional staff, be it be the Security Guards at the entrances or the Front Office guys, Housekeeping staff or the ever smiling staff in the Dining Rooms.  What stands out in terms of hospitality is the infectious smile that comes along every time the staff at the CI & S greets you.  And mind you, its never fake. The Resident Manager Mr. Vikram is virtually omnipresent and surprisingly pops in and out, the moment one require his support.  The charming gentleman…

Right from the very first service interaction call with Mr Surinder Chauhan, till the wonderful send-off by the ever-courteous front office team at CIS Mussoorie - my experience was a very good one, to say the least. At the outset, I would like to express my sincerest gratitude to Namrata, Kunal, Rahul and Surinder for their tremendous co-operation and excellent service ethic throughout our stay - Life becomes a lot easier, if you have a support staff that backs up their smiles with actions that speak louder than expressions :-)  About the room - It was sheer luxury and opulence, thrown in with all the modern amenities that most Hotels offer nowadays. The private balcony offered stunning views of the natural vistas all around - while the washroom was spacious, clean and…

Staff was courtious, rooms were clean but the hotel lacks a good play area for kids and recreational area for adults. The location is close to the mall but although the hotel has a pick up service from parking area the approach to the hotel is poor.

Room and bathroom make quality is good. Mattress was too soft for my back so I had a terrible back ache and had to sleep on extra mattress on the floor. This is the 1st time I had to do it in any hotel. Internet never worked and party loud music kept me awake till late at night.

The location of the hotel was good with valley view from the balcony ..which was the best part .  The room sizes were pretty small .. the lobby and ambience not too great .  The food  taste very average .. ul get much better food in mall road (mussoorie).. Overall average experience. .can try other hotels

Since it was a official visit for the purpose of training by the company, we could hardly get any time for local visit. However, half day trip was organised by NCGG. Missoorie is really a nice place and we enjoyed to the whole of our heart.

I went with my friends for 2 nights.We had a good time there.Service is good nd very good atmosphere,friendly staff and the lavish buffet is something not yo miss and its worth staying in country inn.

Good location, near the Mall, pick-up and drop-off facility all the time to Mall road at all times, nice food and great hospitality makes this hotel special for me.  Nice buffet Dinner and breakfast served lavishly. Great views from room balcony and good size rooms and bathrooms.  Overall a wonderful stay experience.

I visited Mussoorie in the late March of 2014.  Found Country Inm and Suites and decides to book the same going by its name. But I have to say its nothing special.  The complimentary breakfast was pretty basic.And when we asked them for a computer for shifting photos from camera to the pen drive they said they have none free ever. Even the cable at the Tv was a pretty local one with regular disturbances and poor quality given the time of t20 wc.   But having said that the facilities in the room like the hair drier and specially the bathroom was well maintained along with that even the room was spacious. The view from the room was fantastic too.   If they maintain some parts of the service they provide i believe it would be a great buy.

We decided last minute holiday plan to Mussoorie around 15th August weekend  . We booked Country inn online . It was a wonderful stay with kids . We were two families and booked two rooms , this place is nice and  situated in the start of Mall road plus they give you free pick up and drop from parking downhill. Overall nice big rooms , good food .We stayed on third floor with a wonderful view of mountains . Lush green surroundings an lots of monkey's for kid to see .  Loved the stay !  one caution if you are travelling with kids please make sure the room doesn't get locked from inside as few of their rooms have problem , lock doesn't even get opened from outside ,we faced this ................so be cautious . Rest all is wonderful at this place

Good Hotel  Breakfast was good but dinner buffet was not so good  Food taste was good Pick and drop facilities was not good  They ignored to drop and pick from the mall road chowk. But destination was good for couples with no children Because u have to walk very much

I stayed there on 16th August for one night with my wife and 2 Indian friends. The rooms were spacious and clean and our 2 rooms were connected, which was very helpful. The views from the balcony were formidable, unbelievable, unforgettable. In the evening a car took us near a place where we could take a rickshaw, highly recommended. We requested special laundry service, fast and good. The breakfast was very good, we all enjoyed it.

We booked 4 rooms for six nights in the end of July. Everything was nice other than a few inconveniences. First of all the monkeys are a menace. There are signs on the balcony door not to leave them open because of the monkeys. They come and jump around in the balcony chairs so didn't feel like sitting outside. We had an issue with the key cards too. Everyday we needed to get the cards fixed because they would not work. Hated going to the reception to get them fixed sometimes even upto 3-4 times  for all four rooms. Overall the experience was nice. The food was great and service was above expectation.

Would love to come back after such a heart warming hospitality. Staff were gentle and approachable. Good food, good taste. Bar was the only thing missing. Would love to see some sitting area outside the room.

i booked this hotel because this was the only hotel having two bedroom suite, over all hotel is good, rooms are spacious and very well maintained, but bathrooms are small and lack bathtub, food they serve as ala carte and buffet is good and very economical but again they dont have a pub/bar . location is nice away from hustle-bustle but lots of monkeys make it less enjoyable. maal road is aprox a km away they do have a free cab service for pick up and drop but it leaves you in mid way better to hire a cab or take your own if you have kids . over all it was a nice experience but can be made much better by improving cab services, control monkey menace and luggage loading and unloading should be faster and cab service need to be better. thanks and good luck to your team.

i selected this hotel because this was the only hotel having 2 bedroom suite , it is about a km away from maal road good thing is that it is away from hustle-bustle but bad thing is that you need a cab everytime you need to go out. food is excellent buffet was awesome and very economical too. rooms are clean and well mantained . bell boy service need to be improved.

We travelled once again to Mussoorie,my grand father had lived here for 9 years.It was a great tour to these hills almost touching the foothills of Himalayas.  Hotel is located close to the main street. The staff is extremely professional and courteous. We had a minor problem in our room and it was solved in a matter of minutes and a nice surprise for us. The food is excellent, Head Chef did stuffed Grilled Chicken to my taste. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

Lift is not properly maintained.  When we checked in at 10 pm there was loud music playing in your banquets. The whole room was buzzing with the sound of DJ. After complaining 3 times it was finally stopped at 11:30pm.   There was a complete chaos in breakfast. Inspite of so many staff the service was very improper. Most of the items were empty and glasses was missing. Also the restaurant staff was very uncorteous. Even during lunch they took 10 minutes to refill Rotis.  Also we had a conference at the 2nd floor banquet. Not only the banquet is poorly maintained but the facilities were also at their worst. The projector was not working properly which spoiled our whole conference. There was no collar mike. The conference hall was of a standard of 2-star hotel. No proper technical…

I was looking for some affordable luxury to spend some quality time with my daughter who study in the convent school, situated close to the Hotel. My wife wanted to stay in JP Hotel but i wanted something close to mall. I have stayed in many good hotels of Mussoorie but found this Hotel the Best. I regret not staying here in my past visit.  Great place , mind blowing

My tour to Uttrakhand would have been incomplete if i had missed this hotel. Great location, awesome food ( specially the pasta in spicy tomato sauce and mushrooms ) and above all a warm welcome. I felt special when i reached hotel, staff is well trained and courteous. I will love to come back here in my next vacation.

i stayed with my family for two days, my younger brother did the booking in this Hotel. It was better then i expected. Big rooms with clean areas. Mussoorie is a good place for nature lover like me. Staff was helpful and helped me with local attractions. I specially liked this Hotel because my kids loved it. It is a kid friendly Hotel where staff is trained well to know ur needs. I will come back to stay here with my friends.

I stayed with my family n friends ....had a small child with me....the staff was realy helpful in preparing the food for little one....n realy want to thank the manager of the hotel who was kind enough to upgrade us to a balcony room so that d kids could enjoy....the breakfast menu was just great...thks ll surely visit again

Have stayed in this hotel for one day, We really regret that we were on a short trip as the hotel is worth staying for at least two to three nights. the staff is polite and the service is excellent, love to see the smiling faces on the front office. Have stayed in suite and it was really well made up rooms spacious and well maintained, excellent view from my room and my daughter enjoyed lots of rides in the small children corner adjacent to my room. have really enjoyed the hospitality.

We stayed at this property in June this year, it was my 3rd or maybe 4th visit to this property. Beautiful location, excellent service right from check in till check out.  Breakfast set up is very nice and lots of varieties to offer.

Our stay at this hotel was an excellent one. Friendly staff, Prompt service and great location are some of the high points of this hotel. Rooms are quiet and comfy. The only drawback was that there was no GYM . . .  on the whole a comfortable trip and great stay. kudos to the team...

we stayed at country inn mussoorie this may. Our stay was very pleasant and comfortable , bcoz of the warm hospitality of the staff. The food was of course excellent as were the rooms . loved it all !!!

Not satisfied with the services...it is exactly 2 kms from the main mall road...they lie that ot is 500 mts...breakfast buffet is not satisfactory. ..if anybody wants to go for the brand name then thats something else..otherwise dis is not worth staying.....

I stayed here for 5 days with my family , and it was an awesome experience. If we talk about the view ..its really really awesome. Food is yum..enjoyed each bite. Rooms are excellent and staff is so much cooperative and helpful. Would like to visit again and surely would like to recommend to others:)

We stayed here for 6 nights and enjoyed every bit. Rooms were clean and excellent. Breakfast was mouth watering. I would highly recommend this hotel. Staff was friendly and courteous.I will always stay here...really happy.....

I really enjoy the trip to mussoorie this summer with family , We stay at Country Inn & Suites by Carlson . There food and services are excellent , thanks to hotel staff to make my trip memorable , next time I will again stay with Country inn & Suites   .

Being a Club Carlson member I usually look for their hotels at first, this hotel is not at all a good hotel to stay. They feature this hotel with a spa but it's just for the name, it can be called as a closet with massage chair. Will Not return to this one ever and don't recommend this hotel to people who look for the best.

Strategically located property with elegant & beautiful interiors having the palatial Castle Hill Estate at its backdrop promises the picturesque stay. But the management needs to emphasize more on hospitality values viz., Leisure, Comfort & Services.  Courteous Staff, Elaborated breakfast spreads & Complimentary Mall-Road shuttle service are the only nicest things over the Exhaustive Food Rates, Dirty Towels, Poor Room Service, Worst Housekeeping Services, Monkey Menace, No Mini Bar, Voice disturbances from Parking Bay, etc.   Bottom Line – Management needs grave perusal on key fronts like Services, Sanitation, Parking Bay Nuisance!!   For a Leisure stay, Country Inn Mussoorie is not at all the option…

Last month i visited this hotel  with my family. i was more than happy with their service. Hotel staff is extremely polite & helpful. they also provid the shuttle service to mall road.The quality of food is  Excellent. in short its good hotel to stay.

Try something else if going for leisure with family and small kids. This property is recently bought by Carlson. Sadly, they are still using old and dirty bath/face towels. Rooms are fine. Food is quite expensive. NO BAR. Staff is very good. Please avoid rooms facing parking lot, as lot of drivers chit chat and cars noise disturb you all the time. Needs lot of up-gradation and changes.

We visited this property in month of may 2014. I was more than happy with their service. Hotel staff in extremely polite and helpful. They also provide free shuttle service to mall road. Buffet breakfast and dinner was also very good and wide variety. I was travelling with my 1 year old baby they also served me tava chapati for baby. In short home away from home.

Extremely rude manager, dirty bed sheets, severe monkey menace.. Our stay at Country Inn spoiled the trip. The location is a little off.. though the hotel provides pick-up and drop to one end of mall road..it gets a little restrictive if you like traveling unplanned. The breakfast was just average. Was woken up in morning by noise of monkey thrashing the balcony furniture. Would not stay here again.

Such an amazing experience. ..thanku country inn...stayed here for 2 bites and must say amazing service...great food...helpful staff with a big smile....It is actually value for money hotel...Visit this hotel for u...highly recommended

We, a group of 8 people, stayed at Country Inn on 25th and 26th April. The property is very good, very well maintained and clean. Views from the room are fantastic. The food was very good; we used to get drop-offs and pick-ups from the Mall road even at odd hours - the team was really helpful. The only minus point was that the elevator was not working for 2 days, hence we had to walk four floors upto our rooms. Else , it was a fantastic stay with superb hospitality. The property is beautiful and is highly recommended.

I was dissapointed with my stay in country Inn.we had to wait for an hour to check in our hotels rooms....the food is average and the complimentary buffet was pathetic...hospitality is poor....will not recommend this hotel to anyone.

I was there with my sales and marketing team for an offsite event. The property is clean, and well managed. I had a particularly good room overlooking the valley. An evening in the balcony sipping hot Darjeeling tea was like being in heaven. The staff are very courteous and the over all experience was a very pleasant one. There were a couple of things that didn't go right and surprisingly they had to do with the approach road. There is another hotel on the same road and it is possible residents from that one, or local taxi drivers had parked at the base of the hill. The second problem was the hotel car that acted as a shuttle. It wasn't…

Average rooms, great bathrooms, average views. Be prepared to wait for hotel pick-up and drop service. However the hotel staff make-up in service for what the hotel lacks. Rooms need refurbishment now, internet at 256kbps is very slow Breakfast spread is great, however the hotel needs to put signs for those guests who like to feel the food in the serving trays before they serve themselves (disgusting to find people touching food to see if it's warm enough and then leave it back).....ask the staff, that is why they are there!!  Good for 4-nites, we checked-in 02may…

I have stayed at this property on a number of occasions before. Having a child who studies in a Mussoorie school it is essential that you have a regular place to go back to. This one surely makes me feel at home which is why I keep returning. We had a excellent stay at Country Inn & Suites, The room with balcony had a great view and was very relaxing. I personally thank the staff, who were very courteous & helpful. The food was also nice. The only draw back was there was no Gymnasium, rest everything was just perfect.

We had a great stay at Mussoorie with Country Inn & Suites. All the staff were very helpful and courteous. Room & view from the room was very nice. Overall had a nice time, would love to come again whenever i am travelling to this region.

Staying in Country Inn & Suites by carlson Mussoorie is just wow!  Excellent food and very cooperative staff . staying in a deluxe room is really good experience . room are spacious and well maintained .

This was more of a business hotel. Good facilities but cumbersome to get to your room. Lots of cooking smells outside our room on the corridor. Food was average not too bad. Service was great . Would try another property in future.

I checked in to this hotel on 13th November, 2013 with my friends. The stay was awesome and we enjoyed a lot. The staff was very polite and professional. The room was very neat and interiors well done. People at reception were very frinedly and helpful. The food was good too. I would always stay at this place whenever I am in Massorie. I am rating you 5/5.  - Ankit, Noida

This place is very good & an amazing view from garden area. Food quality along with variety was amazing & so the welcome. Staff is very supporting & helpful. Mall raod is full of energy & local food is worth trying.

This is by far one of the best places I have stayed in. The hotel gave us an upgrade and also offered a room with great view. Everyone at the hotel was super polite and helped us. Food offered was great and breakfast has lot to offer. When we were having our dinner at the restaurant my 3 months old daughter started crying and one of the waiter asked if he can pick her so that we can have the food. Very friendly hotel. I will be suggesting this hotel to everyone.

I visited mussoorie in the last of January this year with my husband ...We went to celebrate our first wedding anniversary and enjoyed our stay in Country Inn & suites. I booked this property directly through hotel. The hotel service is awesome.. Staff is cooperative and friendly. The only thing i felt that the hotel is over priced and they didn't offered any discounts whereas later I realised better deals were available online...

I checked on trip advisor for the hotels before going to mussoorie. Finally i decided to go to Country INN and Suites. Because i read mixed reviews. But my experience was awesome. I had a word with Mr. Sanjay. Hotel Ambience is really good and staff too. I really liked my stay there. I would recomend to everyone. They give you pick up and drop till parking. That is really good. I didn't took my car. It's better to take rickshaw or take a walk so that we can enjoy the beauty of mussoorie mall road.

We enjoyed our 5 day stay at the hotel in November 2013. The rooms were very clean and staff was very cooperative and friendly. They offer a pick and drop facility to the mall road which is a icing on the cake. Location is very good as it offer a premium view. Food is good but can be improved.  All in all we had a great stay at the hotel

No matter where you go but if you get Country Inn & Suites there it make all the difference! This time my business travel had been much much more exciting and relaxing at the same time, I keep travelling to Mussoorie frequently for business and its always been hectic and tiring. I am glad this time Country Inn was near by my work place and it has made all the difference about this trip. This hotel management has always keep their promises no matter which part of the country they are. Mussoorie has got better with country inn there. I would really like to Thank you Country Inn & Suites for making it so much convenient and exciting business trip. looking forward again to visit there.

Located in nice peaceful place near library with easy connectivity and food joints around .There are several restaurants in hotel as well , Room is filled with all modern equipments light sensors and view from the room is majestic , room service , food of hotel is wonderful and house keeping will make your day. Bed and cushions are super comfortable which will force you too stay in them and make you lazy. Hotel staff is always on their toes to help you anytime.

The hotel is good and so is the staff. Located up the hill which is not very convenient always to climb though the hotel provides on the house shuttle still you have got to be strong. Overall experience was good and I would certainly think of staying there again if I visit Mussoorie for the weekend. Reception staff is excellent!!!

I visited this property in November with my family and was pleasantly surprised. Stayed there for 2 nights and I must say that this is clearly the best hotel in Mussoorie I've stayed in. Its nothing too posh just has the basics right, like clean, quite, great service, happy faces.  Check in was quick and hassle free, room was clean, bed nice. Staff seemed genuinely happy to help which is not quite common. Bottom line, it was a good and comfortable stay and will return when in Mussoorie next.

we had arrived @ mussorie very early, And the Hotel was kind enough to accomodate Us for early check in .. they were very helpful in providing suggestions dor sightseeing...the staff and hospitality was absolutely great and we were thoroughly impressed with the housekeeping..breakfast was good.. extensive spread.. ranging from indian to english..the complimentary drop off and Pick up service waa also very useful.. can be used multiple times.. we had a very memorable atay thanks to the staff at Carlson!

Country Inn and Suites Mussoorie is a nice hotel. The rooms are large, the toilets are spacious and clean, the view is good, the food is acceptable. However, there is something lacking.  The staff, for one, is semi - trained. Some of them are polite and eager to serve while others are disinterested and unapproachable, even sullen.   Local calls cost Rs 15/- a minute. The "transfer to mall " facility actually drops you 700 mtrs away from the entrance to the mall.  I am not sure that I would like to stay in this hotel on my next visit.

Stay at Country Inn & Suites at Mussoorie is a great experience as the location of the hotel is great just near by to mall road where every one usually hangs around whole of the day be it food, shopping or sight seeing. best part of the hotel is that they provide the 9am to 9pm shuttle service to mall road though you to walk a bit to really reach the mall road but its still worth the height to which the trained drivers drive every time. I visited this hotel for a overnight stay at mussoorie. I didn't book the hotel ahead, and walked in without a booking. The front desk was helpful and helped me check in quite fast. We stayed there for 3 nights and requested for twin beds we were told that someone will come and separate the beds but no one came till the end of our stay. Room was not at all worth paying the amount that we paid. It was a rip off. Management must take actions to improve the quality because everyone works hard and pays that much amount and expects good service so that they can and come again.

a very calm and comfortable stay not too far from mall road, neat and clean rooms and ambiance backed by a very helpful staff, pick-up facility from mall makes it easy to commute, excellent restaurant .

mussoorie, "queen of hills". stayed in country inn & suites with family and friends for two nights. Pleasant and relaxing. Rooms with balcony looking at snow capped himalaya is great treat to eyes. Staffs are cordial and always serve you with a smile. Food is good and its worth spending the money.

Had few concerns :  - The room temperature wasnt great , expect some better ventilation/ or install AC. - Althogh LCD was installed the cable connection was not digitized , resulting ordinary reception of signal - The breakfast had variety but few items like parantha, poori were prepared  using maida , using normal flour would be highly appreciated.   These are small concerns , hope hotel management works on that .  Will surely recommend this  hotel.  -Mayank

We spent three nights at this hotel in Sept'13. I was accompanied by my wife and my 5 year old Son. If you are looking for a serene location away from the hustle of mall road but at the same time very near to mall road, this is the place. All you can hear is the creeping of the birds and the air brushing through the leaves of numerous green trees surrounding the hotel. This service is available 'n' number of times during your stay that also with a smile. Rooms are ultra clean, service is quick and the staff is very friendly and smiling. Food: Below average  Overall this hotel is at best 'above average' and not luxury and should be priced likewise. Food is avoidable. View from the room balcony was great and especially spectacular at night. when i stay in the hotel wow hotel. When i enter the room location is good.the service also very good. Pick and drop service also good this is plus point. Food was also good. I enjoyed very much.the staff was very helpful. I i go formussoorie  then shure i stay there

Stayed at this hotel with family for first time, this place is awesome, nice view, peaceful.  Night view of town is spectacular.  Food is excellent and services up to mark.  rooms are nice and spacious with balcony.  Overall Excellent Stay!!!!!!!

The location of hotel was scenic and peaceful. This is one of the best hotel in the mussoorie enjoy all the places in the mussoorie and stay in this hotel with good and good facilities . Never be think about some other places . Parents and friends are fully enjoyable in the place and have very good environment inside and outside the hotel.

This visit was the first memory after my marriage with my wife. It was a very beautiful experience and stay at country inn & suites made us feel really comfortable. Bieng travellers when we arrived at mussoorie in march, we had the most serene and beautiful feeling to experience the delight of nature. Just standing inside this place you can actually feel the warmth of friendliness and the restaurant is carrying the great gastronomical delights. We stayed in may,  I must say this hotel is best... No its outstanding in its service,  hospitality, cleanliness, food n the list is endless...... I guess  that's the best journey of ma family.... Luv to visit again thanku country inn

Planned this trip with family of 4. Chose Country inn and suites as i've been to other Hotels of CIS too and enjoyed my stay. Even this time, CIS was wonderful...nice staff, big room, great view and wonderful weather. Food was also good. I took summer package for 2 nights and 3 days and surely enjoyed my visit.

The food was pathetic,room service was worst...In spite of calling thrice we were not assisted...on complaint abt the same we were given an apology note by Mr. Ajay the F & B Executive and offered for a complementary dinner...once the dinner was through we were asked to pay a bill of 3000/-.we were repeatedly invited for dinner and it ended like this...wat an invitation?

We have spent time at Country Inn & Suites twice now.  We have been pleased both times.  The road up to the hotel has been fixed now which was absolutely necessary.  The customer service and breakfast buffet are top quality.  Good place to stay.

Extremely stylishes luxury hotel in Mussoorie. Reception was always friendly and helpful. It was clean and everything was cleaned properly.We stayed already 3 time in successive years in this hotel. Swimming pool was great.

We spend 2 nights here. The hotel-building is top class, no question. Everything there that you need. Very good location on the strip, in the middle. The food is very good with a lot of variety and the Hotel staff is very coperative and always ready to serve before you say.

The hotel has a very bad approach road....it has a cafeteria on fifth floor for their staff and it is very noisy... We stayed there for four nights and we had to change our room three times... The food was good and lot of care was taken by their F & B Manager Mr. Sharma and the chef.. However we feel we could have stayed in a better hotel for the same price..

Stayed there in april 2013. Approach road was aweful. But when there it was as good as any country inn hotel. Staff v helpful though struggle with english. Service was v good. Staff v helpful. Didnt tell us that check out time was 10 am which is bit earlier than most hotels. Unless find something better would use it again. Thnx.

I stayed in this hotel for two days, during March this year, in the hotel after reading reviews on Tripadvisor. It was off season and the hotel has very low occupancy.   I have given my feedback to the carlson mgmt however for the benefit of the readers here it is:  The Good 1. Good location away from the rush and dust of the the mall road where most of the other hotels are. 2. Has excellent views to the snow clad mountain ranges to the east/northeast 3. Hotel rooms are well maintained and clean 4. Has pick and drop service from the mall road  The Bad 1. The restaurant is overpriced and the menu is limited and quantity is also less. Also the food offered is not very tasty. It is better to have food in the numerous restaurants on the mall road. But the hotel staff can use this…

I had went to this property 3 years back when it was OASIS HOTEL. The hotel looked good then but staff and the service would even compare to the one that they present now.It has just gone north towards being great. Though the road leading to the Hotel was in very bad shape but still the guys out there were trying their level best to help out the customer by providing the ride downhill from the hotel to the mall road. Kids area can surely be improved,it lacks big time.

we visited the Queen of Hills Mussorie on 05/04/13 to 07/04/13 with few friends for our Lions Conference. The hotel rooms are nicely done, well lit and adequate washroom space. The staff was courteous and on their toes even for minor problems.The buffet breakfast needs some improvement in terms of variety of items served. Overall a good and nice comfortable stay and experience.

I stayed in this hotel in Jan 2013. It had just snowed, hence the access road which is certainly in bad shape , was all the more slippery with the ice. It is very steep and is very difficult to walk on , our car could not climb the slope with slippery ice. Even the pickup and drop provided by the hotel (innova) to the mall road could come only half way . We had to walk in the ice to reach the vehicle. Otherwise the rooms are good once you reach the hotel. Prefer to take higher floor valley view rooms. Rooms are spacious and toileteries are of good quality. Though the food was just okay. They did not have a buffet spread for the breakfast . Service was good and prompt. Please check the rates online on their website. I ended up paying more even in off season as I checked in…

Excellent services. Staff is very helpful and the food was very nice. Specious room with a balcony over looking  beautiful view of snow covered peaks. I would love to come back and stay with the same room # 112.

It has all we look in a hotel. Nice food, Good Location, Nice and Courteous Staff. It is the perceptive and friendly service that makes it worthwhile staying.The room we had was spacious and pretty.Thank you very much for making our stay so pleasant!!!

Roads in entire Mussoorie are in very bad shape perhaps due to sewage line work.  This has made the Mall Road, other roads as well as approach road to this Hotel difficult to walk and drive. Very nice property with clean and comfortable rooms.View from room was amazing.staff was very humble and friendly ,specially from  housekeeping dept  vijay,priyanka was very helpful. food was good.restaurant service was ok.

The food was awesome. I really liked south indian food. Sambhar n green chutney especially. Even the chef Lakshminaryan was very helpful n cooperative. The room was clean and well organised. The experience was great, enjoyed the stay completely. The service was good and there was good variety in the morning breakfast, specially the south indian stuff was great. Will surely visit again in future.Thank you sterling.

""Last month we return home. We stay in your resort for 4 days. And we enjoyed it! The apartment was clean, plenty of space and with beautiful nature scene. After coming to Dancing Leaves, I started loving the mountains. A nice place to explore Mussoorie. Thanks to Chef Lakshiranayanan for the idlies at the dinner. A true south Indian test. Good cleaning of the rooms and view from the resort is just amazing. Will come back again.

Excellent resort with all facilities. Coming from Chennai, the weather was blessing for the family. Chef Lakshinarayanan was helpful during our stay. The spa was good. Steps was a challenge for the seniors but it subsided with all the services.

Last month i visited this beautiful place in uttarakhand. A true heaven is not a myth if we talk about this. Those beautiful clouds and the nature. Beautiful place for friends group, for honeymoon couples for family too. Overall this place is for all. You can see the true colours of nature and the changing weather every second.  The place is very clean and beautiful  It is a hill station so 365days are good for them. Mainly people come during summers but if you want to feel the winters  The snowfall, hailstones and beauty.! We stayed here during the Eid weekend and it was right in the middle of the peak summer season. There are a few parts of our experience that stood out and I'd like to highlight them here: - We were first given a room that had a great view with one entire wall of glass panels but there was no window that we could open. Since we'd travelled all the way from Delhi just so we could enjoy the weather in Mussoorie, it we were extremely disappointed about having to be cooped up inside a room with no ventilation. There was an air conditioner in the room but we felt that defeated the whole purpose of staying in the hills. Also, there aren't really any common areas that are open where you can sit and have a cup of tea or a meal while enjoying the weather. We had booked this property…

However, the rooms in the entire resort is spread over and the approach to the reception and dining area may be a bit tiring, especially for old people. The food quality is average and nothing much for kids except a kids area which basic activities. Mall road is a few kilometers away from the resort, although easily accessible through a paid shuttle which charges INR600 to and fro. Overall an average experience

Excellent Location and services by the staff. Awesome views from the room. Mouthwatering delicious food served in the restaurant. Special mention of Mr Ashis Maity, for the special care taken during our stay.
